headline: Truck license number missing; grease in fryers
summary: The business license number was not on the sides of the mobile food truck; it must be at least 2 inches tall. Dirt and food debris were inside the fryers, and debris and grease were under and behind cooking equipment and refrigeration. Must clean and sanitize.

headline: No backflow device on prep area ice machine
summary: The ice machine in the prep area has no backflow device. The operator must provide one. Passed.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures, glove misuse, dead flies
summary: Handlers touched faces or dirty items while gloved, then prepared food. Hot and cold foods were held at unsafe temperatures; about 15 lbs and 125 lbs were discarded. Sticky traps held dead flies.

headline: Three-compartment sink too small for trays
summary: The three-compartment sink cannot fit the large trays used in the kitchen. Staff were told to use smaller utensils or install a larger sink. No pests were reported.

headline: No certified manager; no pest control log
summary: No certified food manager was on premises while waffles with eggs were prepared and served; a citation was issued. There was no pest control log book, vomit cleanup supplies, metal thermometer, or test strips. A food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: Hair restraint missing; slow hand sink drain
summary: An employee was found without a hair restraint. The front hand-washing sink drains slowly and the manager was told to repair it. No pests were reported.

headline: Dusty fans above meat prep area
summary: Dusty fans above the rear meat prep area must be cleaned and maintained. No other problems were listed. No pests were reported.

headline: Hair restraint missing; no light in walk-in
summary: A food handler made a sandwich without an effective hair restraint. Dried debris was found between the toaster oven and cooling unit. Plumbing fixtures in the employee restroom need cleaning. The walk-in cooler has no light.

headline: Public inspection summary not posted
summary: No summary from the previous inspection was posted for public view. A new summary was left and staff were told to post it. A citation was issued.

headline: Blocked hand sinks; slime-dripping ice machine
summary: Two hand sinks were blocked by mixers and sanitizer buckets; removed on site. Black slime was dripping onto ice from the ice machine. A low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer and was tagged. About 45 lbs of food discarded.

headline: Coffee debris under lower reach-in units
summary: Coffee beans, dirt and grinds built up on the floor under and behind lower reach-in units. Staff were told to pull equipment out, clean and maintain the area to prevent possible pests. Pests were not reported.

headline: Dusty kitchen ceiling vent
summary: Dust was observed on a kitchen ceiling vent. The vent must be cleaned. No other issues were listed in this inspection.

headline: Ice machine heavily soiled with pink, black slime
summary: The ice machine interior was heavily soiled with black and pink slime dripping onto ice used by customers. The manager was told to discard the ice, clean and sanitize. Exterior and a floor drain also need cleaning.

headline: Oysters lacked shellstock tag; freezer heavily iced
summary: Fresh oysters in a container had no shellstock tag; the tag must stay attached until the last item is sold. A citation was issued. Plates were stored face-up and the walk-in freezer has heavy ice buildup.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold holding; onions discarded
summary: Grilled onions at 115.5°F were in hot holding and were denatured and discarded on site. Guacamole, coleslaw and mushrooms were too warm for cold holding; about 23 lbs were discarded. Hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Worn cutting boards; dirty storage floor
summary: Cutting boards were worn and must be replaced when worn. Floors in the rear storage area need cleaning to remove debris. This re-inspection passed.

headline: Dirty racks; sink stoppers and faucet needed
summary: Storage racks with grease and dried food debris need detail cleaning. The three-compartment sink needs three working drain stoppers. A hot-water faucet at the mop sink must be repaired. Floors along walls and corners need cleaning.

headline: Slow-draining sink and missing stoppers
summary: The women's washroom hand sink drains slowly and the three-compartment dish sink is missing stoppers. The manager was told to fix both. No pests or food temperature problems were noted.

headline: Mouse droppings and flying insects found
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found on shelves, canned goods and floors, and over 30 flying insects in several areas. Manager told to call an exterminator. Also: missing food labels, dirty equipment, no hair restraints.

headline: Mold-like specks in ice machine; leaking faucet
summary: Pink and brown mold-like specks were on the ice machine shield; clean and sanitize it. The two-compartment sink's hot water faucet leaks. Restroom ventilation is not working, and the all-gender washroom has no ventilation.

headline: Hair restraints missing; restrooms need cleaning
summary: All food handlers need hair restraints. A balled-up wiping cloth was at the sink, cardboard shelf liners were used, and soda nozzles were dirty. The toilet room needs a covered waste can and detail cleaning.

headline: Freezer icing, missing thermometer, no handler training
summary: The kitchen refrigerator needs a visible thermometer. The reach-in freezer has excessive ice to defrost, and grocery bags should not be used for food storage there. A food handler lacks a training certificate.

headline: Unlocked cold units; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Cold-holding units in the path to customer restrooms were unlocked. The person in charge must add a lock and signage. The certified manager had no allergen training certificate and must obtain one.

headline: Rat droppings found in basement storage
summary: About 40 to 50 rat droppings were found in basement storage, on utensils, and along walls by the walk-in freezer and cooler. Pest control and cleaning were ordered. Paper towels were missing at two sinks but were provided during inspection.

headline: Door gap, greasy ovens, proofer debris
summary: There is a gap at the bottom of the front entry door that needs a tight-fitting seal to prevent pest entry. Both ovens have grease buildup, and the proofer has food debris and flour. Clean and maintain them.

headline: Previous violations uncorrected; repairs needed
summary: Previous core violations were not corrected, including door gaps and damaged freezer gaskets; an extension was granted. The deli cooler has no working thermometer. Containers are unlabeled and there is a grease-trap odor.

headline: Repeat violations: thermometers, storage, cleaning
summary: Thermometers are missing for the deli case and hot holding cabinet. Boxed food must be raised off floors, and crates and rust must be removed. Repeat violations include damaged walls and floors, grease buildup, and unlabeled containers.

headline: Walk-in cooler light out; allergen training expired
summary: The light in the walk-in cooler is out and must be repaired. The manager's allergen training certificate has expired and must be renewed. Verification must be kept on site.

headline: Hole behind water tank; allergen certificate missing
summary: A hole behind the hot water tank must be closed and made smooth and cleanable. The certified manager has no allergen training certificate and must obtain one and keep it on site.

headline: Cold beef too warm; ice machine debris
summary: Cooked beef short ribs at 47.7-48.8°F in the walk-in cooler were discarded, about 20 lbs. Debris is encrusted inside the ice machine. A repeat violation: openings at the revolving door base must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Meat thawing in prep; food on floor
summary: Frozen meat was thawing in the food prep area; management was told to thaw TCS foods properly. Food was stored on the floor in the rear prep area and must be elevated. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly.

headline: Previous violation uncorrected; no waste contract
summary: A previous violation was not corrected: no record of a waste disposal contract. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags. Greasy equipment, freezer area and floors need cleaning. Restroom door is not self-closing.

headline: Damaged cooler gaskets; no allergen certificates
summary: Damaged gaskets on three-door coolers need repair. No allergen training certificates were on site. The person in charge must obtain them and keep them on site for review.

headline: No pest control logbook; broken thermometer
summary: No pest control logbook was on site, and a licensed pest control provider must be contracted and serviced. A broken thermometer was found in a cooler and handwashing signage was missing. Pests were not reported.

headline: Missing hair restraints; milk crates for shelving
summary: Employees prepared and served food without hair restraints. Milk crates were used for elevation, and wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Missing stoppers and frozen food in plastic bags were noted. Prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: Low hand-sink hot water; dish machines not sanitizing
summary: Employee hand sink water was only 70°F; a technician fixed it on site to 102-105°F. Two dish machines had 0 ppm sanitizer and were tagged out until reinspected. Hair restraints were missing and milk crates were used as shelving.

headline: Greasy equipment; leaking handsink pipe; expired certificates
summary: Clean fryers, cooking equipment, prep tables and basement refrigeration. Repair the pipe leaking under the kitchen hand sink. Food handler and allergen training certificates are expired and must be renewed. Some vents were cleaned on site.

headline: Black slime in ice maker; no hair restraint
summary: Black slimy substance dripped from the ice maker into ice used for consumption. Management was told to turn off the machine, remove ice and clean it. An employee had no hair restraint and a water leak was found.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate was on the premises. There is no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure, no metal stem food thermometer, and no sanitizer test strips. The manager must provide all of these.

headline: Pink slime in ice machine; leaking faucet
summary: Pinkish slime buildup was found inside the ice machine. Food prep staff lacked hair restraints. Rusted storage racks, a leaking one-compartment sink faucet, and dirty pit floors were also noted. Allergen certificate was missing.

headline: No certified manager; front door left open
summary: No certified food manager was on site while sliced deli meat and beans were prepared and served. A citation was issued. The front door was left wide open and must be closed to prevent pest entry. Washroom doors are not self-closing.

headline: Cold breakfast foods held too warm
summary: Hotcakes, creamer, shredded cheese, bacon and a sausage burrito were held at 45.5-54.1°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager discarded about 5 lbs on site. A citation was issued.

headline: Frozen chicken thawed in standing water; rodent droppings
summary: Frozen raw chicken was thawing in standing water in a sink. About 30 mouse droppings were found behind the grease trap in the main prep kitchen. Rodent elimination and pest control were ordered.

headline: Personal items over food supplies; faucet leak
summary: Employee personal care items were stored directly above single-service articles in the kitchen; a designated area is needed. The one-compartment food prep sink faucet leaks and must be repaired.

headline: Over 60 mouse droppings; flying insects found
summary: Over 60 mouse droppings were found on shelves and floors in rear storage and under the three-compartment sink. Numerous flying insects were in prep, dish and storage areas. A 1/4-inch gap is under the front door. Call an exterminator.

headline: Ice machine mineral buildup; drain leak
summary: Slight mineral buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned and maintained. A minor leak on the drain pipe below the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Over 60 mouse droppings; sinks inaccessible
summary: Over 60 mouse droppings were found behind a door in second-floor water heater storage. Three hand sinks were blocked by linens, pizza boxes and ice. Chicken sausage at 64.8°F and raw sausage at 69.6°F were on the prep table.

headline: Cardboard liner, grooved cutting boards, clutter
summary: Cardboard reused as a floor liner in the rear meat walk-in and prep area must be removed. Deep grooves and stains on cutting boards must be fixed or replaced. Clutter near the rear exit must be removed.

headline: Raw wood flooring; door not self-closing
summary: Raw wood flooring behind the counter must be painted or sealed to be smooth and cleanable. The toilet room door is not self-closing and needs a self-closing device.

headline: Flies, unsafe food temperatures, low dish machine temps
summary: Over 20 small flies were found on the second floor, with activity in the dishwashing area and bar. Mashed potatoes were at 116.4°F; chicken and yogurt were too warm, and the manager discarded food on site. Two dish machines were tagged.

headline: Sink blocked by bussing tubs
summary: A stack of bussing tubs blocked the main prep kitchen hand sink, preventing staff from washing hands. Staff were told to keep sinks accessible at all times. Pests were not reported.

headline: Sink backs up; food stored on floor
summary: Wastewater backs up into other compartments of the rear three-compartment sink; repair required and a citation was issued. Boxes and water bottles on floors or crates must be raised six inches. Damaged gasket and dirty drains and hood filters also noted.

headline: Bare-hand food contact, warm coolers, low hot water
summary: Person in charge lacked a certificate at first. A cook touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands. Several cold foods were held too warm and discarded. Hot water too low; ice machine slimy. Many repairs and cleanups were also ordered.

headline: Grease and food debris on cooking equipment
summary: Food particles and grease were found between cooking equipment and on exterior surfaces. The floor under cooking equipment and the three-compartment sink also need cleaning. No pests were reported.

headline: Cardboard used as liner on prep surfaces
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner on food prep equipment and tables. The operator was instructed to remove it. No other problems were listed in this inspection.

headline: Low hot water; pink slime in ice machine
summary: The front bar hand sink reached only 92.8°F; it must reach 100°F. Pink slime on the rear ice machine chute dripped onto stored ice; clean and sanitize. Foil-lined shelves and unlabeled dry ingredients were also noted.

headline: About 35 dead cockroaches found
summary: About 35 dead small and large cockroaches were found behind equipment, by the walk-in cooler, under booths, and on the rear ramp. Staff were told to remove them and clean. Grease and cardboard boxes were also noted.

headline: No certified manager while handling meat
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager was on site while beef and pork were handled, and the person in charge had no certificate. One food handler lacked required training. A manager must be on site at all times.

headline: Wet mop dripping onto floor
summary: A wet mop head was dripping onto the floor near the mop sink. Staff were told to store it properly and maintain that.

headline: Leaking pipe under 3-compartment sink
summary: The middle compartment pipe of the three-compartment sink is leaking. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Missing hair restraint; burnt-out light bulb
summary: An employee prepared and served food without a hair restraint. A broken light shield and a burnt-out bulb above the rear prep table must be replaced. No pests were reported.

headline: Missing stoppers; floor and faucet repairs
summary: The bar and dish area three-compartment sinks lack stoppers. Floor grout and tiles are damaged in the rear and basement prep areas, and faucets leak. A hood filter is missing and a hood bulb is burned out.

headline: Regrout floors and clean greasy hood
summary: The floor under the rear dishwashing three-compartment sink and mop sink must be regrouted. Grease buildup on the ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned. Cardboard shelf liner should be removed.

headline: Soil buildup on bar sink and cooler
summary: Soil has built up inside the rear bar hand sink and the rear cooler. The manager was told to clean the sink and ensure all coolers are cleaned and maintained.

headline: Pushcart missing thermometer and license number
summary: The pushcart had no ambient air thermometer inside. It also had no license number on either side. Staff were told to provide both and maintain them.

headline: No certified manager; sinks lacked soap, towels
summary: No certified manager was on site while pizza was prepared from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The rear bar sink and unisex toilet lacked soap, paper towels and signage, and toilet paper was missing. No citation was issued.

headline: Door gap, hair restraints missing, allergen proof lacking
summary: The front door has a 1/4-inch gap underneath and is not rodent-proof; seal it. Food handlers in prep areas lacked hair restraints. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables. The certified food manager has no allergen certificate.

headline: Dirty toilet room; missing thermometer
summary: The toilet room door and floor were not clean, with debris and black stains. A thermometer is missing from a cold-holding display unit and must be provided. Pests were not reported.

headline: Handwashing signs missing at sinks
summary: No handwashing signs or posters were near the exposed bar hand sink or in either washroom. Signs must be provided and maintained at all times.

headline: Greasy cooking area and dirty dish area
summary: Grease on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelving in prep areas must be degreased and sanitized. Reach-in coolers need detail cleaning. Food debris under shelving and around the dish machine must be cleaned more often.

headline: Food stored on floor; hair restraints missing
summary: Soda cases were stored on the floor in the rear prep area and must be raised six inches. An employee had no hair restraint and another wore dangling bracelets. Caulking, floors and vents also need cleaning.

headline: Gaskets taped; toaster oven interior dirty
summary: Black duct tape covered gaskets inside a two-door cooler; remove and repair them. The interior of the rear prep toaster oven needs cleaning.

headline: Dish machine leaking; no backflow device
summary: Water leaked onto the floor under the dish machine and must be repaired. No visible backflow device is on the employee washroom utility sink. The drawer cooler thermometer is inaccurate and must be replaced.

headline: Cold foods too warm; no allergen training
summary: Beef, deli meat and turkey were held at 50-54°F in the front prep cooler; about 11 lbs were discarded. Food stored on walk-in floors must be raised, and mop heads must be hung. The food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Rear door gap; missing sink stoppers
summary: The rear exit door is not rodent-proof, with a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom; seal it to prevent pest entry. Three-compartment sinks lack stoppers and must be provided.

headline: Chipped coating on cooler shelving
summary: A large kitchen cooler has chipped coating on its shelving. The manager must repaint or replace the racks. This re-inspection passed.

headline: Warm cold-holding food; live flies in prep area
summary: Chicken (48.9°F), corned beef (48.0°F) and hamburgers (up to 46.6°F) were held above the 41°F limit in the prep cooler; about 6 lbs were discarded. Four live house flies flew in the prep area during food prep.

headline: No handwashing sink in cooking area
summary: No handwashing sink was found in the cooking area, as required. One must be installed with hot and cold running water, soap and paper towels.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while chicken, hamburgers, dairy and sliced tomatoes were prepared and served. A manager must be on site whenever open. Floors, drains and fryer areas need cleaning.

headline: Greasy kitchen; damaged floors and ceilings
summary: Grease buildup was found on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelving. Damaged floor tiles, grout and a ceiling tile need repair. Dirty microwaves and a freezer interior also need cleaning.

headline: Clutter in storage; dirty coffee and soda areas
summary: Crates, signs and other items cluttered rear storage and could create pest hiding spots; remove them. The coffee area and the floor under soda shelving are sticky and dirty and need cleaning. No pests were reported.

headline: Door gap pest risk; food stored on floor
summary: Front entry doors have a 1/4-inch gap that must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Food stored on the floor in rear storage must be raised six inches. Raw wood shelving must be sealed. No food handler training was available.

headline: Warm cooler, no hot water at bar sink
summary: Cooler air was 55°F, above the 41°F limit. Dish machine wash temperature was only 103°F, below 120°F. The bar three-compartment sink had no hot water. Toilets were soiled, and floors and ceilings were damaged.

headline: Public summary not posted; cutting boards worn
summary: The previous inspection summary was not posted for public view; a new one was left and must be posted. A citation was issued. Deli sinks lacked handwashing signs. Cutting boards have deep grooves, and a sink faucet leaks.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings; missing menu advisory
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings were found on floors, inside cabinets, and on duct equipment in the control panel room and rear storage. The manager must call an exterminator and clean. The menu lacks a raw-food advisory.

headline: Shrimp thawed in sink; cups used as scoops
summary: Frozen shrimp was thawing inside the four-compartment sink and must be thawed properly. Single-service cups were used as dispensing utensils. Single-service items were stored on the floor and must be elevated.

headline: Wiping cloths left out; dusty dining vents
summary: Wiping cloths were laid on the prep table and must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Air vent covers in the dining area are dusty and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; sanitizer and hot water failures
summary: The person in charge had no certificate, and no certified manager was on site while chicken and rice were served. A food container was stored in a hand sink, sanitizer was 0 ppm, and garbage overflowed. Insect-killing devices must be discarded.

headline: No certified manager during food preparation
summary: No valid City of Chicago certified foodservice manager was on duty while chicken and rice were prepared and served. A citation was issued. Floors throughout the food prep area need cleaning along walls and corners.

headline: No certified manager until mid-morning; no training
summary: No certified manager was on site at first; one arrived at 10:20 AM. Milk and tacos were handled without one, and a citation was issued. Rusty plates were in the ice bin, and a food handler lacked a training certificate.

headline: Door gap and damaged floor tiles
summary: A gap along the bottom of a door could let rodents in and must be made tight-fitting. Damaged floor tiles and stained ceiling tiles need repair. Debris under sales-floor display shelves must be cleaned.

headline: Dirty ice machine; sushi sink missing splashguard
summary: The ice machine interior was not clean; remove ice, clean and sanitize. The front sushi bar hand sink has no splashguard, and cutting boards sit beside it. Expired food handler certificates and no allergen training proof were found.

headline: Unlabeled containers and food on floor
summary: Unlabeled food containers, food stored on walk-in floors, and uncovered food in prep coolers were found. Scoops were left in dry goods, and stoppers, a light shield and cooler thermometers were missing.

headline: Rust on shelves over cutting boards
summary: Rusty shelving above cutting boards in the meat prep area could contaminate food-contact surfaces. Staff were told to clean or replace it. Cooler door tracks and floors around grills also need detail cleaning.

headline: Hand soap at prep sink; utensils stored improperly
summary: Hand soap was found at a food prep sink; remove it and provide soap only at handwashing sinks. An ice scoop was stored with its handle buried in ice, and stirring spoons sat in standing water.

headline: Torn gasket, leaking sink, boxes on floor
summary: A prep cooler has a torn gasket and food residue on its gaskets. A leak at the bottom of the front prep hand sink must be repaired. Boxes of plantains were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Hood filters are dusty.

headline: No certified manager; summary not posted
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid certificate and must obtain one. Missing handwashing signs were posted on site. A 1/4-inch front door gap must be sealed. The previous summary was not posted and a citation was issued.

headline: Dusty vent above front fridge
summary: The vent above the one-door fridge in the front counter area has excessive dust. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain it. No pests were reported.

headline: Incorrect truck license number; missing screen
summary: The license number on the side of the truck is incorrect and must be updated. A window screen is missing and must be provided to prevent insect entry.

headline: Live flies found in several areas
summary: About 25 live small flies were on walls, boxes and shelves in the front, bar and dishwashing areas, plus one large fly in the rear prep area. Pest control was recommended. Several toilet-room hand sinks did not run water.

headline: Missing backflow device; no allergen training
summary: The backflow prevention device on the ice machine could not be found and must be located or installed. The certified manager on duty had no proof of allergen training. Staff were told to meet requirements.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: The person in charge had no valid certified food manager certificate, and no certified manager was present while beef, chicken and beans were prepared. Worn gaskets, rusty racks and dirty equipment also noted.

headline: No soap at sinks; no food handler training
summary: Failed. No soap at handwashing sinks in both washrooms. No food handler training for employees and no allergen training for the manager on duty. Fly strips hang in dishwashing; no test kit or backflow device.

headline: Doors open to pests; wiping cloths and clutter
summary: Passed, but the front and rear side doors have half-inch bottom gaps that must be sealed to keep pests out. Also wiping cloths sit on prep tables, washroom doors do not self-close, and clutter could harbor rodents.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; repeat violations
summary: Failed. No cleanup supplies for vomit or diarrhea events were on premises. Repeat violations were not corrected: no covered waste receptacle in the employee washroom, greasy dumpster and walls, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: No sanitation certificate; no health policy
summary: Failed. No person on site held a posted original sanitation certificate. No employee health policy, no vomit cleanup kit, and no raw food advisory on the menu. Also no metal-stem thermometer and no espresso backflow device.

headline: Heavy leak under hand sink; greasy cooking area
summary: Passed. A heavy leak under the handwashing sink in the dishwashing area must be repaired. Accumulated food and grease debris between cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: No backflow on ice machine; floor and paint issues
summary: Passed re-inspection. The ice machine has no backflow device. Gaps under first-floor prep counters must be sealed. Wood flooring and peeling paint on basement floors and a restroom wall must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager; black slime in ice machine
summary: Failed. The person in charge lacks a sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while food was prepared. Black slime drips into ice from the ice machine. Many repeat violations, including greasy floors and lack of health policy, were cited.

headline: Undated chicken soup; dirty cooler and shelves
summary: Passed with conditions. A 7-lb container of cooked chicken soup had no discard date after three days; about $70 of food was discarded. Prep cooler, ice maker and walk-in shelves need cleaning. The walk-in needs more lighting.

headline: Three-compartment sink still floods on drain
summary: Failed. A prior priority violation was not corrected within the timeframe. The three-compartment sink is not working properly: when one compartment drains, another floods. A citation was issued.

headline: Undated cooked chicken wings; unlabeled bulk
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked chicken wings held more than a day in a prep cooler had no prep or discard date. The manager must date all cooked TCS foods. A bulk salt or sugar container needs a label.

headline: Washroom door does not self-close
summary: Passed. The washroom door does not self-close. The manager was instructed to repair the closing device.

headline: Prep cooler at 60°F tagged out of use
summary: Passed with conditions. Prep line cooler #3 measured 60.0°F with no food inside. It is tagged 'held for inspection' and must not be used until repaired. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and a women's restroom needs a waste receptacle lid.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; frozen food in plastic bags
summary: Passed. Wet wiping cloths on several prep surfaces must be stored in sanitizing solution between uses. Frozen food was stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer and must be moved to food-grade containers.

headline: Leaking pipe; holes in walls; no handler certificate
summary: Passed. A pipe under the three-compartment sink leaks, and holes in the dishroom and mop sink walls need repair. Staff washroom door does not self-close. Cardboard is used as floor matting and must be replaced. No food handler certificate was on site.

headline: Leaks, damaged freezer lids, dirty walk-in cooler
summary: Passed re-inspection. Multiple leaks at the front hand sink, two deep freezers with damaged lids, and dirty walk-in cooler and freezer interiors must be corrected. Rear ceiling tiles are damaged.

headline: No certified manager for 30 minutes
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site from 2:35 to 3:05 PM while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared. Repeat violations were not corrected: greasy hood filters and no allergen training on site.

headline: Ice machine limescale; leaking sink drain plugs
summary: Passed. Limescale-like buildup is inside the kitchen ice machine and must be cleaned. Three-compartment sink drain plugs are in poor repair and leak when shut. They must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Carpeted floor in storage area
summary: Passed. Carpet in the fourth-floor storage area must be removed so the floor can be made smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Bare hands touched ready-to-eat food
summary: Passed with conditions. A food handler touched ready-to-eat cheese, cut tomatoes and deli meat with bare hands; a priority violation was cited. Ready-to-eat foods in the walk-in cooler lacked date marks, and some food sat in plastic bags.

headline: No backflow device; food handler lacks training
summary: Passed re-inspection with two required fixes. The espresso machine water line has no backflow prevention device. One food handler has no food handler training certificate. Both must be provided.

headline: No cleanup kit; rear door not rodent-proof
summary: Passed, with a 90-day grace period for the missing vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit, since this was the first inspection. The rear door needs weather stripping. Ice machine, bar gun, men's room, floors and rear clutter need cleaning.

headline: Leaking cookline handwashing sink pipe
summary: Passed. The cookline handwashing sink pipe is leaking and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; restroom receptacles
summary: Passed with conditions. Handwashing signs were missing in bars. A menu raw food disclosure was added on site. Front entrance doors have an opening to seal against pests. Basement bar sink water was off and must be restored.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; meat thawed unsafely
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dishwasher had 0 ppm sanitizer and was not used until repaired; maintenance fixed it. Six slabs of meat were thawed at room temperature. A missing paper towel supply was corrected on site.

headline: Large pots cannot be sanitized in sink
summary: Passed. Pots are too large to sanitize in the three-compartment sink. A written procedure for washing, rinsing and sanitizing large pots must be provided.

headline: No certified manager; disconnected bar sink
summary: Failed. No manager certificate posted. A bar handwashing sink is disconnected from water and unusable. No food handler cards on site, no pizza cooler thermometer, and a repeat violation for private garbage hauling was not corrected.

headline: Basement handwashing sink unusable; sewage backup
summary: Failed. The basement prep handwashing sink is not connected to a drain. Wastewater backs up from the bar's three-compartment sink. Prep coolers must be turned on and kept below 41°F. The menu lacks a raw food advisory.

headline: Fly paper hanging; debris under dry storage shelves
summary: Passed. Insect fly paper is hanging from the ceiling and must be removed; the pest technician must be told insect control is needed. Residue and debris under dry storage shelving must be detail cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine black substance
summary: Failed. No valid certified manager on duty. Ice machine interior had a black substance; ice was ordered discarded. Boxed food stored on the floor, uncovered food containers, broken dumpster lids and heavy grime were also cited.

headline: Floor damage and leaking three-compartment sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Missing floor grout and damaged floor tiles in the dish and prep areas must be repaired. The three-compartment sink leaks from all pipes and must be fixed.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles and cracked light covers
summary: Passed. Water-stained ceiling tiles above the dishwashing area must be replaced. Cracked ceiling light covers above the same area must also be replaced.

headline: Hands washed in three-compartment sink
summary: Passed with conditions. A food handler washed hands in the three-compartment sink. After instruction, the handler washed at the designated handwashing sink. Debris under the prep table, rear counter and hot-holding equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Missing allergen training; rusted cooler shelf
summary: Passed with conditions. Certified food managers still lack required allergen training, a prior violation not corrected. Fryer bottoms are greasy, a cooler shelf is rusted, a wall tile is missing, and a hole behind the employee toilet must be sealed.

headline: Cold burgers and cheese at 45.6–50°F; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Cheese, veggie and bean burgers and bacon held at 45.6–50°F in a grill reach-in cooler, which has an ambient temperature of 49.3°F. About 16 lbs ($250) discarded. Some managers lack allergen training.

headline: Cardboard shelving and rusted racks in storage
summary: Passed. Cardboard used as shelving in the storage area must be removed. Rusted racks in the storage area must be replaced.

headline: Leaking drain; ice buildup on cooler condenser
summary: Passed. The cookline handwashing sink drain pipe leaks and must be repaired. Ice buildup on the pantry cooler condenser must be removed. Ice machines need interior cleaning, and one manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Roaches found in locker room; cold food too warm
summary: Failed. About 10 live roaches were seen in the basement locker room, plus dead roaches. Cold food held at 48.6–59.5°F (limit 41°F); about 30 lbs discarded. Also no vomit/diarrhea cleanup supplies and a leaking toilet.

headline: Pork thawed in sink with few ice cubes
summary: Passed re-inspection. Pork tenderloins were thawed in the three-compartment sink with only a few ice cubes. Use cooler overnight or cold running water. A hole behind the water heater must be sealed, and a manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled sinks; hole in wall; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Passed re-inspection. Pots and pans in the dish area were not stored inverted. Three-compartment sinks in the bar and rear dish area are not labeled for wash, rinse and sanitize. A large wall hole and missing ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: Mold-like ice machine buildup; wastewater backup
summary: Failed. Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine dripped onto ice; the person in charge was told to discard the ice and clean the machine. Wastewater backs up into sink compartments. Dining-area restrooms lack handwashing signs.

headline: No cleaning procedure for mixer; rust on grease trap
summary: Passed. No written procedure exists for cleaning large mixing equipment in place; one must be provided. A black substance on the wall by the three-compartment sink must be cleaned, and rust on the grease trap must be removed.

headline: Greasy oven and hood; restroom waste receptacles
summary: Passed. The salamander oven is coated in encrusted grease. Restrooms lack covered receptacles for sanitary products. Dry storage shelving has dried debris, and hood filters and ceiling tiles have grease and dust.

headline: Minor faucet leak; basement ceilings flaking
summary: Passed. A minor leak at the basement three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Basement ceilings are not smooth or easily cleanable, and chunks of paint are falling from them.

headline: Expired allergen training for managers
summary: Passed. Certified food managers' allergen training has expired. They must renew it and keep certificates on site for review.

headline: Dish racks on floor; restroom signage missing
summary: Passed. Dish racks on the floor in dishwashing and rear prep must be raised six inches. Dark residue is inside the ice machine panel. Customer restrooms need handwashing signs, and the employee restroom needs a lidded garbage can.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; no raw food advisory
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings were found in compressor units, fryer cabinets, shelves, floors, and food court, prep and dishwashing areas. Manager must call an exterminator and clean all areas. The menu lacks a raw/undercooked food advisory.

headline: Ice scoop touching ice machine exterior
summary: Passed. Slight residue is inside the ice machine panel and must be cleaned. The ice scoop was stored in an open wire rack touching the machine exterior and must be stored in a protected manner.

headline: Live roaches found in several areas
summary: Failed. Live roaches were found in the rear dish area (about 4), on the dish storage rack (about 5), and in front prep (about 2), plus dead insects. A prior insect violation was not corrected; pest service is required before December 2.

headline: Manager certificate arrived late; sink blocked
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager during food prep; one arrived after the inspection. A rear handwashing sink was blocked by crates and paper goods. Sanitizer read 0 ppm and was emptied. Milk crates are used as shelving.

headline: Mouse droppings in kitchen storage; low hot water
summary: Failed. About 30 mouse droppings were on dry storage shelves, and 40–50 were behind bulk containers. Raw eggs and chicken were stored over noodles, which were discarded. Restroom hot water was below 100°F.

headline: No screen on service window
summary: Passed re-inspection. The service window has no screen and must be provided. Floors and walls under cooking equipment have grease buildup and need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine in unfinished basement; dirty floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ice machine and soda syrups sit in an unfinished basement room with exposed pipes that could drip. Scoop is stored in a water bucket. Basement clutter and dirty floors must be addressed.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; pest log missing
summary: Failed. No certified city food manager was present while chicken, potato salad and other TCS foods were prepared and served. Pest control log lacks service records. Staff lacked hair restraints, and fryers and floors were heavily greasy.

headline: Cold food at 47–51°F; about $300 discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Several TCS foods held at 47–51°F were discarded, about $300 worth. An upstairs walk-in cooler at 50°F was tagged. Basement walk-in racks are rusted, and freezer chests have heavy frost or a broken lid.

headline: Cold food at 46–59°F; 35 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Cut tomatoes, pasta, red sauce, roast beef, mozzarella and leafy greens held at 46.1–59.4°F in the central line cooler. About 35 lbs were discarded. Missing thermometers and handwashing signs were also cited.

headline: Front door opening; sink lacks stoppers
summary: Passed re-inspection. An opening at the base of the front door must be sealed. The three-compartment sink needs stoppers, the utility sink needs a backflow device, and a hole in a bar wall must be repaired.

headline: Chicken held hot at 104°F; beef too cold
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken in the hot-holding area measured 104°F, and beef and Impossible meat in a reach-in cooler measured 47–50°F. Manager discarded about 2 lbs and 20 lbs. Burn marks on a wall behind the fryer must be replaced.

headline: Rodent droppings found; hot food below 135°F
summary: Failed. About 50 rodent droppings were found in prep and front counter areas. Hot-held au jus at 100°F and marinara at 84–94°F were discarded. Restroom lacks hand towels, and no metal-stem thermometer was on site.

headline: Ground beef and beer held too warm; 15 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Ground beef at 54.7–58.6°F and Bierra at 48.3–53.1°F in a cold-holding unit (limit 41°F). Manager discarded 15 lbs ($290). Cutting boards are stained, floors have debris, and a hood light is out.

headline: No certified manager during chicken and beef prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No city-certified food manager or valid documentation was on premises while chicken, beef and rice were prepared. Allergen training certificate is expired. Ceiling vent above the prep area needs cleaning.

headline: Sink faucets leak; water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. The ice scoop was stored improperly in the ice bin. Both faucets on the three-compartment sink leak at the base and must be fixed. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the toilet room must be replaced.

headline: No employee health policy; incomplete cleanup kit
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on site. The vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit is incomplete and no procedure was on premises. Bowls and utensils in prep areas were not inverted.

headline: Sanitizer at 0 ppm; food held out of temperature
summary: Failed. Three-compartment sink had 0 ppm sanitizer, and dishes were rinsed without sanitizing. Hot foods at 124–129°F and cold salads at 49.5–55.6°F were discarded. Hot and cold holding units were adjusted on site.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No city-certified food manager (CFM) with an original certificate was on site while yogurt and nacho cheese were prepared. Cooling units lack thermometers, and a bulk sugar container needs a label.

headline: Allergen training required for managers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Certified food managers must obtain and maintain allergen training certification.

headline: Eggs at 59°F; refrigerator tagged out of use
summary: Failed. Eggs measured 59.1°F and a rear refrigerator 60°F; 3 lbs were discarded. The refrigerator is tagged and must not be used until reinspected. No current pest control log book, and debris and dust are on floors.

headline: Deep-cut cutting board; spillage under sink
summary: Passed. A cutting board attached to a cold-holding unit has deep cuts and marks and must be replaced or resurfaced. Spillage and litter under the front prep sink must be cleaned.

headline: Cutting board, moldy racks, slow drain, dirty floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. A cutting board on a prep cooler must be refinished or replaced. Walk-in cooler storage racks have moldlike buildup. A rear hand sink drains slowly, and basement floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; milk crates as shelving
summary: Passed re-inspection. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizer. Milk crates used as shelving can hide pests and must be replaced. A manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Passed re-inspection. Soiled green wiping cloths were stored on prep tables throughout the prep areas. They must be kept in sanitizer solution of at least 50 ppm when not in use.

headline: Uncovered utensils; sink seal and floor tile gaps
summary: Passed. Utensils and equipment on the drying rack were uncovered and not inverted, risking contamination. A kitchen handwashing sink is missing its seal, and floor tiles near the three-compartment sink are in poor repair.

headline: Coolers too warm; restrooms lack hot water
summary: Failed. A meat walk-in cooler (52°F), a display cooler (52°F) and a four-door unit near juices (45°F) were too warm and were reset on site. Restroom and juice-area sinks lack hot water. Pest control logbook is missing records.

headline: Food containers not stored inverted
summary: Passed. Food containers were not stored properly and must be stored inverted.

headline: Restroom needs lidded can; no handler certificates
summary: Passed. The restroom needs a garbage can with a lid. No food handler training certificates were observed and must be provided.

headline: Gap at rear door; greasy hood; clutter
summary: Passed re-inspection. A gap over 1/4 inch between the rear door and frame must be repaired to keep insects out. The hood above the stove is heavily soiled with grease, and clutter near the rear door must be removed.

headline: No certified manager while serving eggs, chicken
summary: Passed with conditions. No city-certified food service manager and no posted sanitation certificate while eggs and crispy chicken were served; a citation was issued. Dirty light shields, floors under equipment, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Knife stuck behind freezer; greasy prep tables
summary: Passed. A knife was stuck between the wall and a reach-in freezer; the manager removed it. A can opener blade needs replacing, prep tables and cooking equipment need degreasing, and walls and ceilings need dust removed.

headline: Ice machine buildup; restroom lacks lidded bin
summary: Passed. Slight buildup on the interior side of the ice machine must be cleaned. The restroom lacked a covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products and must have one at all times.

headline: Grime on walls, microwave and walk-in shelving
summary: Passed. A cutting board has deep dark marks, the microwave has grime, and walk-in shelving has rust. Items stored on basement and walk-in floors must be raised six inches. Restroom fixtures and rear prep walls need cleaning.

headline: Rear door gap; dirty display coolers and restroom
summary: Passed. The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be repaired to keep pests out. Display cooler interiors, restroom fixtures and floors need cleaning. The rear yard must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Workers skipped handwashing; cold food too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Workers did not wash hands after handling a fly and other tasks; they were told to wash. Refrigerators at 45.8–53.2°F held food too warm; about 23 lbs ($115) of food was discarded.

headline: Greasy fryer openings in front prep
summary: Passed. Deep fryer openings in the front food prep area have a buildup of grease and food debris. They must be cleaned to prevent pests from feeding or harboring.

headline: About 30 live flies on prep-area walls
summary: Failed. About 30 live small flies were on prep-area walls; all insect activity must be removed by reinspection. Also pink buildup inside the ice machine, food buildup on shelves, and dusty ceiling vents and floor drains.

headline: No certified manager; fried food and sushi too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while open. Fried shrimp, fish and sweet potatoes at 74.3–83.1°F were discarded, as were sushi fish at 45.1–54.0°F. Fryers were uncovered after hours; no handler certificates on site.

headline: Restroom receptacles lack lids; clutter
summary: Passed. Restroom waste receptacles lack lids and must be obtained. Cardboard boxes of unused items and garbage bags stored on a prep table shelf must be removed.

headline: Refrigeration units lack thermometers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Refrigeration units lack accurate, working thermometers inside. All refrigeration units must be equipped with them.

headline: Storage door gap, dirty coolers, unlabeled container
summary: Passed. Rear storage-side door has a bottom gap to seal. Reach-in coolers and freezers need food spills removed, a bulk container needs a label, and peeling ceiling paint needs removing. Corrections were ordered.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; greasy hood filters
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ripped or damaged door gaskets on prep-area reach-in coolers must be repaired or replaced. Hood filters have grease and food buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Prep coolers not working; no water at sinks
summary: Failed. Prep coolers were not working and must hold 41°F or below. The handwashing sink and three-compartment sink have no water. Handwashing signage, sanitizer test strips and a partitioner are also required.

headline: Dead roach on dining room windowsill
summary: Passed. Dead roach activity was found on a dining-area windowsill; it must be removed, detail cleaned and sanitized. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced, and a prep-area handwashing sink drain leaks.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; missing hair restraints
summary: Passed. Bulk flour, sugar and other food were not labeled and must be. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints and must provide them.

headline: No cleanup kit; no backflow on mop sink
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit on site; one was ordered but not received. The mop sink lacks a backflow device. The restroom lacks a covered receptacle and self-closing door. The ventilation hood is not working properly.

headline: Cooked chicken held at 48°F; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked chicken held at 48°F; manager discarded 8 lbs. A hand sink near food prep lacks a splash guard, knives are stored between coolers and equipment, and a reach-in cooler has torn gaskets.

headline: Dead insects after pest service; greasy equipment
summary: Passed. Dead insects were found where pest control service was performed; they must be cleaned to prevent feeding of other insects. Cooking equipment sides need detail cleaning, and dust surrounds the fan vents.

headline: Spills on cooling units and floor drain
summary: Passed. Cooling units stored in front prep and rear dishwashing areas have spills on interior surfaces. The front prep floor drain and floor have spills and food debris behind heavy equipment. Cleaning was ordered.

headline: No sanitation certificate; cold salad bar discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. No sanitation certificate was on site while food was prepared. Cold salad bar items at 54–60°F and eggs at 56°F were discarded (about 30 lbs). Bar sinks lacked soap and towels, now corrected on site.

headline: No proof of allergen training
summary: Passed. No proof of allergen training was shown for the certified food manager. Documentation must be kept on site.

headline: Soda nozzle buildup and faulty sink drain stoppers
summary: Passed. The soda machine nozzle has heavy syrup buildup and must be cleaned. The main kitchen three-compartment sink has drain stoppers that do not work properly and must be repaired.

headline: Pink ice machine buildup; unlabeled spices
summary: Passed. Pink mineral buildup inside the ice machine near the banquet hallway must be cleaned. A spice container lacks a label. A garbage can is needed near prep-area handwashing sinks, and the oil tank has grease buildup.

headline: Leaking hand sink; food debris on floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Leaky piping on the front prep hand sink must be repaired. Front and rear prep floors have excessive food debris. Food handler training certificates must be kept on site.

headline: Passed; dirty floor under three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Dirt buildup on the floor under the three-compartment sink must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; no valid food handler training observed
summary: Passed. Employees lacked valid food handler training and the certified manager allergen training. Food handlers lacked hair restraints; soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Oversized equipment needs an alternate washing method.

headline: Passed re-inspection; door gaps and dirty floors
summary: Passed. Rear exit door has 1-inch gaps to seal. Floors in pizza oven area, walk-in coolers and freezer, and garage storage have dirt and food buildup. Items on floors must be raised. No proof of allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Passed re-inspection; openings could let pests in
summary: Passed re-inspection. Gaps at the base of the front revolving door, east dock door, and north entrance door must be sealed to keep pests out; a garage exit door was left open. Also: rusted shelving, missing grout.

headline: Passed; cleaning needed on equipment and floors
summary: Passed. Inspector required detail cleaning of the can opener, cooking equipment sides and tops, and floors under cooking equipment, plus removal of ice buildup in the ice cream case. The three-compartment sink needs a proper faucet.

headline: Passed; food debris, worn boards, no allergen training
summary: Passed. Food debris and spills on cooking equipment, shelving, coolers, and prep tables must be cleaned. Worn, deeply grooved cutting boards must be replaced. Also: uncovered washroom bin, stained ceiling tile, dim lighting, no valid allergen training.

headline: Passed; clean equipment, floors, and walls
summary: Passed. Inspector instructed cleaning exterior surfaces of cooking equipment where needed, and cleaning floors and walls around and behind equipment where needed.

headline: Passed; heavy grease in exhaust hood
summary: Passed. Heavy dirt and grease have built up inside the exhaust hood above cooking equipment. Inspector required detail cleaning of the hood, filters, and pipes/conduits, then ongoing maintenance.

headline: Cook touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands
summary: Pass with conditions. Cook was seen handling ready-to-eat tomatoes, breads, and vegetables with bare hands; citation issued. Also cited: no beard restraint, improperly stored wiping cloths, unelevated outdoor items, dirty floor under ice machine, and missing allergen certificates.

headline: Passed; employee food mixed with customer food
summary: Passed. Employee food was stored mixed with customer food in the walk-in cooler and must be separated. Also: unlabeled bulk salt container; toilet-room door propped open beside dishwashing area must stay closed.

headline: Conditional pass; dishwasher tagged out of service
summary: Pass with conditions. High-temperature dishwasher malfunctioned and is tagged "held for inspection"; do not use until repaired. Also cited: no vomit/diarrhea spill kit, missing handwashing signs, employee without hair restraint, 1/4-inch rear door gap, and missing allergen training for a manager.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing; cat present
summary: Failed. Low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm chlorine and was not sanitizing dishes. Inspector found a cat in the basement; it and all its items must be removed. Also: dirty curtains, loose floor tiles, mops not hung to dry.

headline: Passed; leaking pipe and rear door gap
summary: Passed. Leaking drainpipe under rear handwashing sink and missing backflow device on utility sink cited. Rear door has 1/4-inch gaps to seal. Also noted: debris, dust, soiled trays, damaged floor tiles, peeling paint, wall and floor openings.

headline: Failed: foods held too warm, discarded
summary: Failed. Many cold foods held at 47.4–59.3°F were discarded, about 100 lb. Walk-in cooler air was 54°F and cold unit 52°F; repaired on site, air later 40.2°F. Also: excess freezer ice, dirty ice machine, uncorrected washroom trash lids.

headline: Passed; improper thawing and taped ice machine door
summary: Passed. Frozen tripe was thawed in standing water; must thaw under running cold water or refrigeration. Employees kept open drinks in rear prep area. Ice machine door is cracked and taped; must be replaced. Employee toilet-room door must self-close.

headline: Passed re-inspection; fly trap in prep area
summary: Passed re-inspection. A fly trap was found in the food prep area and must be removed. Also cited: leaking three-compartment sink faucet, dirty floors and walls, water-stained ceiling tile, and wall loose behind the handwashing sink.

headline: Passed; unlabeled flour, staff items on food shelf
summary: Passed. Bulk flour container was not labeled and must be. Employees' personal items, including purses and clothing, were stored on a food shelf and must be moved away.

headline: Failed: pest control records out of date
summary: Failed. Pest control logbook held reports only through 9/25/23, with no 2024 service reports; citation issued. Packaged cake slices in display cooler were not labeled. Cardboard liner on rear prep tables must be removed.

headline: Conditional pass; rear door gap, incomplete spill kit
summary: Pass with conditions. Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap to seal. Vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit lacks face masks. Also cited: dirty shelving and sinks, missing backflow device at mop sink, unused equipment, wall holes, and no second-floor washroom ventilation.

headline: Failed: unsafe temperatures, uncertified manager, dishwasher tagged
summary: Failed. No city-certified manager present while food was prepared. Delivered pork and chorizo at 44.2°F and 46°F, plus pizzas at 69.4–71.7°F (too cool to hold), were discarded. Chlorine dishwasher showed 0 ppm and is tagged out. No current pest control report on site.

headline: Failed: no pest control log book on site
summary: Failed. No current pest control logbook from a licensed pest company was available; citation issued. Operator must keep a logbook and at least two pest service reports yearly. Also cited: greasy fryer and wok station, grease on walls and floors behind cooking equipment.

headline: Failed: handsink lacked water; pesticide in prep area
summary: Failed. Front prep handwashing sink had no water until owner restored it; citation issued. Four pesticide spray cans in prep and storage must be removed. No food thermometer or chemical test kit. Also: no employee health policy or vomit cleanup supplies.

headline: Passed; storage and cleaning problems cited
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior needs cleaning. Duct tape on walk-in door gaskets must be removed; box freezer must use food-grade bags, not plastic grocery bags. Walk-in baseboard needs smooth coving. Unneeded items on rear patio must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Raw shrimp and fish held too warm; discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Raw shrimp at 56.5°F and raw fish at 52.7°F in the prep cooler were discarded, about 30 lb; citation issued. Shrimp was thawing improperly on a prep table. Also: no handwashing sign, unlabeled bulk containers, leaky drainpipe.

headline: Failed: sewage backs up into three-compartment sink
summary: Failed. At the bar, the three-compartment sink backs up; when one compartment runs, sewage backs up into the other two. Must be corrected; citation issued. Minor leak on side of dish machine must be repaired.

headline: Failed: handsink lacks soap, towels; no sanitizer
summary: Failed. Prep-area handwashing sink lacked soap and paper towels; citation issued. No employee health policy or training on site; citation issued. No sanitizer for the three-compartment sink, stem thermometer, or test strips. Allergen certificates also missing.

headline: Passed; plates stored facing up
summary: Passed. Plates were stored facing up in the prep area and must be stored inverted.

headline: Missing soap and paper towels at handwash sinks
summary: Pass with conditions. Soap was missing at the front counter handwash sink; paper towels were missing at the dishwashing and employee bathroom sinks; citations issued. Food in grocery bags must move to food-grade containers. Also: missing splash guard; plates not inverted.

headline: Passed; prep sink leak and dirty floors
summary: Passed. Hand-drying provisions and soap dispenser over the prep sink must be removed so it isn't used for handwashing. Leaking drain pipe under handwashing sink must be repaired. Floors under cooking equipment and grease trap need detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: 150 mouse droppings, live flies, roach
summary: Failed. Found 150 mouse droppings in basement and first floor, plus 60 small live flies and a large brown cockroach. Pest activity must be eliminated, droppings removed, and a pest control service completed before next week's reinspection.

headline: Failed: prep cooler not working
summary: Failed. Prep cooler was not working; all cold-holding units must work and keep food at 41°F or below. No citation issued. Also cited: truck missing license number on its sides and no trash receptacle on the truck.

headline: Passed; plastic bowls used as scoops in dry food
summary: Passed. Single-use plastic bowls are used as scoops in bulk dry food containers throughout the kitchen. Inspector instructed replacing them with multi-use scoops with handles to prevent contamination.

headline: Passed; door gap, missing hair restraints
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear dishroom door must be sealed to keep pests out. Food handlers and bakers lacked hair restraints in prep areas. Basement packaging and dry storage were cluttered and must be cleared and stored at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Sanitizer at 0 ppm; glove and hygiene lapses
summary: Pass with conditions. Sanitizer read 0.0 ppm at both three-compartment sinks, and utensils were shelved unsanitized. A food handler cut ready-to-eat vegetables in gloves worn after handling carts, without washing hands. An unauthorized customer entered prep areas. Citations issued.

headline: Failed: dish machine tagged; moldy ice machine
summary: Failed. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at only 10 ppm; tagged, not to be used until re-inspected. Black mold-like substance found inside ice machine. Spices stored on sanitizer bucket. Bar handwashing sinks lacked soap; missing hand towels were corrected on site.

headline: Passed; dust and spills need cleaning
summary: Passed. Minor dust buildup on walk-in cooler fans must be cleaned. Spills on the floor under the three-compartment sink must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; dead roaches found on glue boards
summary: Passed. Several dead cockroaches were found on glue boards throughout the premises, including in the kitchen, near the register, at the waiter station, and in upstairs storage. They must be removed from the premises.

headline: Vacuum packing without approved plan; machine tagged
summary: Passed re-inspection. Vacuum-packaged food was made without a city-approved food safety plan (HACCP); about 1.5 lb parsnip discarded, machine tagged, citation issued. Also cited: damaged floor tiles, items on floor, dish-area wall debris, missing food manager allergen training.

headline: Passed; door gap and no food handler proof
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of front doors needs sealing to keep out pests. Pop crates used as shelving must go. Water-stained ceiling tiles and a damaged toilet-room wall need repair. One food handler lacked proof of training.

headline: Failed: food held too warm, discarded
summary: Failed. Eggs and other cold foods held at 50–54.2°F in the prep cooler; manager discarded and denatured them. Cold foods must stay at 41°F or below. Also: incorrect raw-food menu notice, meat thawing in sink, no sanitizer test strips.

headline: Passed; grease on hood and cold-holding unit
summary: Passed. Residue on the interior and door of a cook-line cold-holding unit needs cleaning. Grease buildup on the ventilation hood filters and system also needs cleaning.

headline: Conditional pass; no health policy or cleanup plan
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy on site. No procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea, with chemicals and supplies. Employees worked without food handler certificates (30-day grace for new hires). Certified managers lacked allergen training. No citations issued.

headline: Passed; food debris on equipment and floors
summary: Passed. Food debris is on the inside and outside of coolers, freezers, shelving, holding units, and prep tables. Debris also on floors under equipment and along walls and corners in prep and storage areas. Must be cleaned.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cooling and handling issues
summary: Passed re-inspection. Handwashing signage missing at coffee station sink. Shellfish and soup stock cooled under container lids; leave loosely covered or uncovered. Coffee grounds and a cutting board sat beside a handwashing sink; must be moved.

headline: Passed; no backflow devices at ice machine lines
summary: Passed. No backflow prevention devices were found on the ice machine water lines. They must be installed where they can be serviced and maintained.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cluttered basement, dirty fryer
summary: Passed re-inspection. Minor food and dust debris inside the fryer must be cleaned. Basement had clutter and items on the floor; inspector told operator to remove extras and raise everything at least 6 inches. Food splatter on prep-area walls must be cleaned.

headline: Passed re-inspection; 4 dead roaches found
summary: Passed re-inspection. Four dead roaches were found in the basement; inspector required removal and sanitizing of the area. Also cited: stained cutting boards with open seams, dirty microwave and deep-freezer lid, and missing floor grout in rear prep.

headline: Failed: rat droppings, live roaches, unsafe food temps
summary: Failed. Over 20 rat droppings, over 15 mouse droppings, 2 live roaches, and over 20 flying insects were found. Premises need pest treatment. Shrimp, eggs, and soup held above 41°F were discarded. Also: undated food, large wall hole.

headline: Liquor boxes stored on walk-in floor
summary: Passed. Liquor boxes were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and must be raised at least 6 inches. Also cited: broken employee restroom faucet handle and no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Passed; storage clutter could attract pests
summary: Passed. Island cooler fan covers have dust buildup to be cleaned. Rear storage closet needs organizing and unnecessary items removed to prevent pest harborage; stock must sit at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Unapproved packaging; no certified manager on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No city-certified food manager was on site while beef and chicken were handled. Unapproved reduced-oxygen packaging equipment was used on cooked barbacoa stored over 48 hours; equipment tagged and about 30 lb discarded. Handwashing problems also cited.

headline: Failed: no valid food sanitation certificate on site
summary: Failed. No valid city food sanitation certificate and no employee health policy on site. Vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure missing. Menu didn't disclose raw or undercooked items. No food thermometer or sanitizer test strips. Pest logbook incomplete. Unused equipment must be removed.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing sign, leaking drain
summary: Passed re-inspection. No handwashing sign at rear dish sink; leaking drainpipe under the four-compartment sink must be repaired. Certified manager lacks valid allergen training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; door opening and rust
summary: Passed re-inspection. Opening at base of west-side front door must be sealed to prevent pests. Rust on shelves and spills inside two one-door cold-holding units need cleaning and repair. No mop-drying rack; one must be installed to prevent pest breeding.

headline: Passed; hair restraint missing; basement storage on floor
summary: Passed. Employee without hair restraint during food prep and service; must wear one at all times. Basement single-use items must be raised off the floor. Also: burnt-out bulbs over syrup machine, dusty washroom vents.

headline: Conditional pass; no vomit cleanup kit or procedure
summary: Pass with conditions. No spill kit for vomit and diarrhea and no cleanup procedure were on site; both must be kept on site. Also cited: no handwashing signs in washroom and no covered sanitary napkin bin in employee washroom.

headline: Passed re-inspection; grease on grill area
summary: Passed re-inspection. Grease must be cleaned from the wheels and shelves of the prep table under the grill and from the exterior of the deep fryer.

headline: Passed; missing cooler thermometers; damaged drain covers
summary: Passed. Several cold-holding units along the main sushi prep line lacked internal air thermometers; at least one per unit is required. Floor drain covers beneath the high-temperature dish machine and ice machine are cracked or sunken and must be repaired.

headline: Passed; loose faucet and food debris buildup
summary: Passed. Loose faucet at the left unisex bathroom handwashing sink must be repaired. Heavy food debris buildup below shelves in the rear dishwashing area and below the cash register counter must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; dirty equipment, floors, and dripping ceiling
summary: Passed. Cutting board has deep cuts and stains. Stove, convection oven, and smoker need cleaning; floors under the three-compartment sink need deep cleaning. Ceiling above the dishroom drips water from a cooling system and stained tiles must be replaced.

headline: Passed re-inspection; slime inside basement ice machine
summary: Passed re-inspection. Slight slime buildup was found inside the basement ice machine; inspector instructed cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food handler certificates missing
summary: Passed re-inspection. No food handler training certificates were on site. Espresso machine lacks a visible backflow device and must have one installed; toilet-room self-closing door must be repaired.

headline: Passed; sink water pressure and handle repairs needed
summary: Passed. Front prep handwashing sink needs stronger water pressure. Rear prep sink handles need repair, and the rear handbowl must be balanced so water does not pool.

headline: Passed re-inspection; greasy kitchen, plastic bags used
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food stored in plastic grocery bags in cooler and freezer must use food-grade bags or containers. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelving must be cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Failed: about 25 live flying insects found
summary: Failed. About 25 live flying insects were found on walls, ceiling tiles, and equipment in rear prep, dishwashing, and dry storage. Pest control service needed; citation issued. Also: unlabeled bulk containers, greasy pipes and fryer, no self-closing washroom door.

headline: Passed; missing sink stoppers and allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Three-compartment sink in the rear warewashing area has no drain stoppers. No covered trash can in the all-gender toilet room. No allergen awareness training certificates on site.

headline: Passed re-inspection; pizza oven outside hood
summary: Passed re-inspection. Pizza oven must be placed under the ventilation hood. Also cited: worn door gaskets on prep and walk-in coolers, greasy fryer cabinets, loose wall bases, unsealed raw wood shelving, and a burnt-out walk-in freezer light.

headline: Passed; no handwashing signs, unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs at hand sinks and bulk containers, including flour and sugar, were unlabeled. Gas oven was not under a hood and must be moved under one or removed.

headline: Food prepped on dining table; no training proof
summary: Pass with conditions. Wontons were prepared on a dining-room table wrapped in plastic wrap; those foods were removed and a citation issued. Cook-line cooler foods were uncovered and not separated. No food handler training proof for employees. Many cleaning items cited.

headline: Cold units too warm; food discarded; tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. Pastrami at 56.9°F was discarded. Two prep coolers held food at 54.3°F and 54.5°F and were tagged; air later reached 39.3°F. Citation issued. Also: food on walk-in floor, loose screen door, leaky faucet, broken AC.

headline: Failed: moldy ice machines; expired food handler certificates
summary: Failed. Black mold-like substance found inside basement ice machines used for human consumption; citation issued. All food handler certificates on site were expired. Certified manager lacked allergen training. Also cited: debris under flat-top grill, cardboard boxes used as floor covering.

headline: Passed re-inspection; greasy floors need cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food debris and grease buildup on the floors between cooking and frying equipment must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Passed; clutter and debris could attract pests
summary: Passed. Rear boiler room and outside areas near grease dumpster have clutter and debris that must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Women's restroom door must self-close. One certified manager lacked allergen training. Ice machine lower panel needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; unlabeled cut fruit and desserts
summary: Passed. Chopped watermelon and desserts in the front prep display cooler were not labeled; the operator was instructed to add labels.

headline: Passed; greasy fryers, dirty floors and racks
summary: Passed. Deep fryers had grease and dirt buildup. Walk-in and prep storage racks had food, dirt, and dust. Women's restroom hot-water faucet leaks. Pitted floors by the pit and a cracked wall tile need repair.

headline: Passed re-inspection; floor grime and hood light out
summary: Passed re-inspection. Grime and residue built up on the rear prep floor and must be cleaned. A light in the hood system is blown out and must be replaced.

headline: Passed re-inspection; basement clutter on floor
summary: Passed re-inspection. Basement floor along the east wall is cluttered; items must be raised off the floor or removed.

headline: Dish machine tagged out; sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: Pass with conditions. Bar dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm (minimum 50). Tagged; do not use until city health department re-inspects. Also: fly trap over prep area must move; damaged cutting boards and floor tiles.

headline: Passed; uncovered restroom trash and dirty drains
summary: Passed. Women's restroom garbage receptacles lack lids; must be provided and maintained. Floor drains in rear prep and dishwashing areas need cleaning.

headline: Passed; scoop in sugar, personal items near food
summary: Passed. Scoop handle left inside bulk sugar must be removed and stored above food between uses. Employee personal care items stored above microwave and near single-service articles must be moved. Also: missing handwashing signs; foil lining in walk-in.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet at 3-compartment sink
summary: Passed. A leak at the base of the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Passed; unlabeled water spray bottles
summary: Passed. Water spray bottles were not labeled; the operator was instructed to label them.

headline: Passed; slow sink drain and greasy hood
summary: Passed. Slow drainage at the front exposed handwashing sink must be repaired. Grease buildup on the ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment must be repaired and cleaned at all times.

headline: Passed; missing cooler thermometer; clutter and syrup spills
summary: Passed. No thermometer inside the prep line cooler. Dried food debris in the prep line cooler and spilled beverage syrup on the floor must be cleaned. Also: dirty floor drains, missing ceiling attachments, floor clutter in outdoor storage.

headline: Failed: leaking three-compartment sink, no signage
summary: Failed. Three-compartment sink at the taqueria leaks when drained; citation issued. Upstairs timed faucet works improperly, and handwashing signs are missing. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, heavily stained cutting boards, broken meat-cooler doors, burnt bulbs, and missing allergen training.

headline: Passed; leaking three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink leaks from its middle and last basins, and the second-floor bar sink faucet sprays from the sides. Both must be repaired.

headline: Failed: about 40 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. About 40 or more mouse droppings found in storage, walk-in cooler, and display areas; inspector required removal, cleaning, and pest control service. Front door gap, toilet missing flush handle, and uncorrected prior violations also cited.

headline: Passed; greasy equipment, leaking sink, floor drains dirty
summary: Passed. Deep fryers, cooking equipment, and coolers had grease, food, and dirt buildup. A leak under the three-compartment sink middle compartment must be fixed. Floor drains and hood filters need cleaning. Unlabeled bulk containers and wiping cloths also cited.

headline: Failed: no pest logbook, no food thermometers
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook with recent service reports was on site; citation issued. Coolers lacked internal air thermometers; no probe thermometer capable of checking food temperatures was available; citation issued. Single-service containers stored on floor. Washroom lighting insufficient.

headline: Passed; copper pipe on floor
summary: Passed. Copper pipe installed on the floor at the coffee station; inspector instructed the operator to raise it off the floor for easier cleaning.

headline: Passed; scoops on ice, missing backflow device
summary: Passed. Ice scoops sat on top of the ice bin and plates were stored upright; both need proper storage. Espresso machine lacks a backflow device. Also cited: rusty walk-in shelving, weak water pressure, slow drains, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Passed; no handwashing sign at washroom sink
