summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the women's washroom sink; the operator was instructed to post clearly visible signs at all employee handwashing sinks.

headline: Passed; one-inch door gap, no mop sink
summary: Passed. A one-inch gap under the front door must be sealed to keep pests out. No mop sink on site; one must be installed. Broken mechanical vent in restroom must be replaced.

headline: Passed; drain leak and greasy hood
summary: Passed. Leaking drain pipe under the one-compartment sink in the rear dish area must be repaired. Food debris and buildup in a drain at the hot line should be cleaned often to avoid attracting insects. Grease on the hood must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; handwashing signs and washroom fixes needed
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs were posted near the front prep sink. Unisex washroom lacks a covered waste bin and self-closing door, and has heavy dust on its ceiling vent.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no mop sink on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. No mop sink on the premises; one with running hot and cold water must be provided.

headline: Passed; faucet leak and expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. A leak at the base of the three-compartment sink faucet must be fixed. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate on site had expired and must be renewed.

headline: Conditional pass; no signed employee health policies
summary: Pass with conditions. No signed employee health policies were on site; operator must provide and maintain them.

headline: Passed; worn door seals, ice buildup, leaks
summary: Passed. Worn weatherstripping on front and rear doors must be replaced. Ice buildup on ice cream and walk-in freezers must be cleared. Leaks under rear sink and at a faucet need repair. Garbage area and drains need cleaning.

headline: Passed; greasy hood and dirty floors
summary: Passed. Hood ventilation needs cleaning to remove grease and dust. Rear prep floors need detail cleaning to remove buildup. Drip tray at the water heater needs detail cleaning.

headline: Rear doors not rodent-proofed; unlabeled containers
summary: Both rear exit doors were not rodent-proof and need door sweeps. Some basement containers were unlabeled. Frozen food was stored in plastic grocery bags. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer, and some equipment exteriors were dirty.

headline: Several expired food handler cards on site
summary: Several food handler cards on site had expired. Employees must complete food handler training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Knives stored improperly; milk crates as shelves
summary: Knives were stored between a prep table and a cooler, and must be stored properly. Milk crates were used as walk-in shelving; stock must be kept 6 inches off the floor on proper shelves.

headline: Missing food handler training; dirty sinks and drains
summary: A food handler and the certified manager lacked required training. Sink basins and a floor drain had debris. Rust was on prep table bases. A toilet room trash can lacked a cover, and a toilet room door was not self-closing.

headline: Cardboard clutter in meat prep area
summary: Cardboard boxes were stacked on a table in the rear meat prep area. Unnecessary clutter must be removed from the premises.

headline: No employee health policy; hand sink disconnected
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises; citation issued. The hot water line to a second-floor washroom hand sink must be reconnected.

headline: No food handler certificates; items stored on floor
summary: No food handler training certificates were provided. Cardboard was used as shelf liner, and rust was on walk-in shelving. Boxes and containers were on floors throughout. A utility sink backflow device leaked, and hood interior had grease.

headline: Hand sink water too hot; another sink clogged
summary: Rear prep hand sink water measured 133.2–135.7°F; it must be 100–120°F. Citation issued. A front prep hand sink was clogged and not draining. The sanitation manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: No food handler training proof; basement clutter
summary: No proof of food handler training was on site for any food handler. Clutter was stored on the floor in the basement furnace room and must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Missing food handler proof; greasy fryers; dirty drains
summary: The pest item was marked corrected on site. A male food handler lacked food handler training proof. A female worker had no hair restraint in prep. Fryers were greasy, floor drains dirty, and debris sat outside the dumpster.

headline: No backflow device at espresso machine
summary: No backflow prevention device was provided at the espresso machine. A broken basement ceiling and a broken cement floor by an A/C unit needed repair.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; no dish machine gauge
summary: Several food handlers had expired food handler certificates. The high-heat dish machine had no maximum temperature gauge. Some items were stored on floors. A cooler had no thermometer, and a hand sink handle was loose.

headline: Linens touching produce; unlabeled containers
summary: Linens were stored in direct contact with leafy greens and vegetables in the salad cooler. Dish racks were stored on the floor. Dry storage containers such as flour and sugar needed common-name labels.

headline: Food too warm; slimy ice machine; sinks removed
summary: Food was held at 46–50°F and coolers at 50°F and 52°F; about $100 of food was discarded. Black and pink slime was inside the ice machine. Hand sinks in the prep area had been removed and were reinstalled. Citations issued.

headline: Expired manager certificate; blocked hand sink
summary: An expired certified manager certificate was on site while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. A dish-area hand sink was blocked by utensils and a bag. A dumpster for waste pickup was not on site.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup supplies
summary: No employee health policy was on site; citation issued. No written procedure or adequate supplies were available for responding to vomiting and diarrhea events. Citation issued.

headline: Mold-like buildup in produce cooler; dirty fan covers
summary: Restroom trash receptacle must have a cover. Light shields inside the produce walk-in had debris and green mold-like buildup. Dust covered a condenser fan cover in the deli holding cooler. Floor tiles by the fryer need regrouting.

headline: About 25 live flying insects; no hand soap
summary: About 25 live small flying insects were found on walls, ceilings, and equipment in the bar and dining room. The front kitchen hand sink lacked soap and paper towels while food was prepared. Citations issued.

headline: Bare hands on bagels; slimy ice machine
summary: A male food handler touched toasted bagels with bare hands; product was discarded. The beverage-area hand sink had no running water, so the dump sink was used for handwashing. The ice machine had yellowish and pinkish slime; ice must be discarded.

headline: Restroom sink water too hot; milk crates used
summary: Women's restroom handwash sink water measured 121.2–125.6°F; it must be 100–120°F. Citation issued. Wiping cloths were on prep tables, milk crates were used as shelving, and floor drains under sinks had old debris.

headline: No sneeze guard at sushi bar; missing signs
summary: No sneeze guard or other food protection was at the sushi bar prep area where customers sit, a priority violation. No handwashing signs were at the sushi bar sinks. The toilet rooms had no covered receptacle.

headline: About 15 live cockroaches found on premises
summary: About 15 live cockroaches were found on walls, in cracks, and on floors in bar, kitchen prep, and basement areas. Additional pest control service is needed. The menu raw-food advisory was incomplete, and floors and equipment were greasy.

headline: About 25 live flies; slimy ice machine
summary: About 25 live small flies were on walls and ceilings in the bar and dining room; additional pest control is needed. Black slime in the ice machine was dripping into ice used for consumption. Ice must be discarded. Citations issued.

headline: Rear door gap; leaky sink pipe; dirty floors
summary: Some bulk containers lacked product names. The rear exit door had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom, a possible pest entry. A pipe under the three-compartment sink leaked. Floors, walls, and cooking equipment needed detail cleaning.

headline: No pest control logbook on site
summary: No pest control logbook was on site; the manager was instructed to provide one. Cooler interior had debris buildup. No citation was issued for the missing logbook.

headline: Food spills on equipment; leaking faucets
summary: Food spills and debris covered cooking equipment, prep tables, and shelving. Faucets on a two-compartment sink and a utility sink leaked in the rear storage area. Debris was on floors under equipment and along walls.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; dirty floors and cutting boards
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet and pipes leaked. Floors and corners had loose debris, dirt, and dust. Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains. A freezer had a torn door gasket.

headline: Repeat violations not corrected; training proof missing
summary: Repeat violations from a prior report were not corrected: missing thermometers, broken gaskets, missing drain stoppers, and dirty sinks and coolers. Plastic and milk crates were used as shelving. Food handlers lacked training certificates.

headline: No mop sink; restroom lacks ventilation
summary: The facility had no service or utility sink for disposing of dirty mop water. The employee restroom had no mechanical ventilation. A certified manager lacked allergen training. Rear outside area had clutter.

headline: Rice held too warm; about 3 lbs discarded
summary: Rice in a cold holding unit measured 52.3°F, above the 41°F limit. About 3 lbs were discarded. Priority violation, no citation issued. The garbage vehicle lacked a lid.

headline: Clutter behind store near walk-in freezer
summary: Clutter sat in front of the rear walk-in freezer and outside behind the store. Staff must clear and keep the area clean and unobstructed to prevent potential pest harborage.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; packaged foods unlabeled
summary: A reach-in cooler near the meat display had no thermometer. Damaged gaskets were on a sales display cooler, and the ice freezer had buildup. Packaged seasonings, salsa, and guacamole were not properly labeled.

headline: Manager missing allergen training certificate
summary: The food service sanitation manager did not have an allergen training certificate. The inspector instructed the operator to meet this requirement.

headline: Rice scoops stored in still water
summary: Scoops for rice were stored in still water. Utensils must be stored in continuously running water.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; 58 lbs discarded
summary: Pork, chorizo, chicken, eggs, tamales, and flautas were 47–50°F in service coolers; about 58 lbs were discarded. A cold unit at 49.7°F must not be used until fixed. The dish sink had 0 ppm sanitizer and was set up right away.

headline: Storage rooms packed with old equipment
summary: Storage rooms were packed with old equipment. Clutter must be removed, and remaining items placed 6 inches off the floor and away from walls for cleaning and pest control. A certified manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine soiled
summary: No certified manager was present while shrimp and rice (TCS foods) were handled. The ice machine chute had a heavy black substance; ice was to be discarded. Menu lacks raw-food advisory. Prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Prep table made of raw wood
summary: A prep table is raw wood and is not smooth or easy to clean. It must be replaced or made smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Unplugged coolers; sinks lack soap and towels
summary: Two coolers at the Starbucks front prep area were not plugged in and must stay at or below 41°F. Exposed hand sinks lacked soap, paper towels, and handwashing signs. No garbage service contract was on site.

headline: No visible thermometer in slide coolers
summary: No visible thermometer was inside the two-door slide coolers. The operator was instructed to provide one.

headline: Repeat violations: missing sink stoppers, dirty floors
summary: Repeat violations from a prior report were not corrected: three-compartment sink stoppers were missing, food debris and spills covered kitchen floors, and vent hood filters had grease. Rusted freezer racks and foil liners with food debris were found. Citation issued.

headline: No food handler training for employees
summary: No employees handling food had valid food handler training. Other issues: no covered trash receptacle in the washroom, damaged floor tiles, a broken washroom fan, and single-service items not inverted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged out
summary: The low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm sanitizer, below the 50 ppm minimum. The unit was tagged and must not be used until reinspected by the Chicago Department of Public Health. Sink water backed up; some cooks lacked hair restraints.

headline: Trash on ground outside; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Excessive trash lay on the ground under outside refuse receptacles and must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage. A certified food manager did not have allergen training proof.

headline: Live roach in soap dispenser; no certified manager
summary: One live roach was found inside a soap dispenser by the kitchen hand sink, plus about 10 small flies. No certified manager was on site during food prep. Cooked corn and potatoes were held at 63°F; about $30 discarded. Dish machine tagged.

headline: Missing ceiling panels and broken wall tile
summary: Ceiling tile panels were missing in the rear prep area and in the walk-in cooler and freezer areas. A coved floor tile at a hall wall base was broken. Staff were instructed to repair both.

headline: Front door gap; cups stored on floor
summary: A 1/4-inch gap was at the bottom and left corner of the front entrance door; no pests were recorded. Disposable cups were stored on the floor and utensils were not inverted. Mop water was soiled, and wall and ceiling openings needed sealing.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents
summary: Ceiling vents had light dust. Staff were instructed to clean them where needed.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer fixed on site
summary: Dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm at first; a technician fixed it during inspection, and it read 50 ppm by the end. Citation issued. Cold units had no thermometers, no test strip kit was on site, and clutter was heavy.

headline: Expired allergen training certificates on site
summary: Allergen training certificates on site were expired; all certified food managers must provide valid ones. Milk crates were used for elevation, ice built up in a reach-in freezer, and ceiling fans were dusty.

headline: Walk-in cooler food too warm; discarded
summary: Rice at 47°F, cooked beef tongue at 46.5°F, and shrimp at 49.5°F were held above the 41°F limit. The manager immediately and voluntarily discarded about 70 lbs (about $1,100) of product. Citation issued.

headline: Employee didn't wash hands; milk held too warm
summary: Employee scratched her back, handled a freezer and food, then made sandwiches without changing gloves or washing hands. Milk at 46°F in a prep cooler; about 1.64 gallons discarded. Manager cleared the blocked hand sink during inspection.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no sanitizer test kit
summary: No policy or supplies were on site for vomiting events; citation issued. No chemical test kit was present for sanitizer. Restroom sink and toilet had buildup, and floor tiles and walls were damaged. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Suspension sign removed from front door
summary: A license suspension sign was removed from the front entry door by someone not authorized to do so. The person in charge was warned not to cover, deface, or remove signage. Citation issued.

headline: Leaking pipes and sinks; rear door gap
summary: Three-compartment and toilet-room sinks leaked heavily; pipes leaked greasy slime. The grease trap was rusted with a broken lid. A rear exit door had a 1/4-inch gap. Mold was near the water heater, and clutter was outside the rear exit.

headline: Black slime dripping into ice; discard all ice
summary: The ice machine interior was heavily soiled with black slime actively dripping onto ice used for human consumption. The manager was instructed to discard all ice, clean and sanitize the machine. Citation issued.

headline: Leaking drainpipes; no handwash signs; missing tiles
summary: Drainpipes under the rear hand sink and three-compartment sink leaked. Handwash signs were missing, and a covered washroom receptacle was needed. Floor tiles and grout were missing in the rear prep area, and light shields were missing.

headline: Rusty prep table base; missing sink stoppers
summary: Inspection status: Not Ready. The prep table base was rusty and not cleanable. Sink stoppers were needed at the three-compartment sink. Grease needed removing from the floor under the stoves.

headline: Dirty ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for human consumption. All ice was voluntarily discarded. The interior must be cleaned by the reinspection date. A ceiling tile above the prep hand sink has peeling paint.

headline: Soiled equipment and floors; faulty sink drain plug
summary: The ice machine exterior had dust and debris; cooking equipment exteriors had dried food and grease. Floors under equipment were soiled. The three-compartment sink drain plug lever was in poor repair and did not seal fully.

headline: Sink too small for dispensers; dirty floors
summary: Multi-use equipment such as beverage dispensers and a slushie machine could not be submerged in the three-compartment sink basins. The operator must install larger basins. Floors throughout the facility were dirty.

headline: Dirty floor drain and debris under counters
summary: Heavy food debris and a slime-like substance were found in the floor drain under the rear dish sink. Debris was also under the front service counter equipment. Staff were told to clean both to prevent possible insect activity.

headline: Gap under garbage room outer doors
summary: A 1/4-inch gap was at the bottom of the outer doors to the garbage room. A tight-fitting seal is required to prevent pest entry. No pests were recorded.

headline: No proof of food handler training on site
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels. Wet wiping cloths were on several prep surfaces. No proof of food handler training was available for any food handler; records must be kept on site.

headline: Employees without hair restraints; missing handwash signs
summary: Employees preparing and serving food had no hair restraints. Handwash signs were missing in prep, dish, and washroom areas. Wiping cloths were on prep tables, ice scoops were stored inside the ice machine, and washroom ceiling tiles were water-damaged.

headline: Gaps and damaged screen; unlabeled food containers
summary: A rear exit door had a 1/4-inch gap at the top. A window screen in the hot food prep area had a large opening. Food containers lacked labels, deep freezers had excess ice, and floor tiles were missing or damaged.

headline: Multiple employees lack food handler training
summary: Multiple food employees did not have food handler training. All employees must complete it, and records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Greasy fryers and grill; loose wall bases
summary: Unlabeled food containers were found, and a splash guard was needed at a hand sink. Fryer cabinets and grill had grease and debris. Loose wall bases and chipping paint needed repair. Shatter-proof bulbs were required in front prep.

headline: No food handler training certificates on site
summary: No food handler training certificates were on site at the time of reinspection. The operator must provide them.

headline: Ready-to-eat foods not date-marked; greasy equipment
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods such as cooked pork and corn in the walk-in cooler were not date-marked; a priority violation. Employees had open drinks in prep. Greasy cooking equipment, a torn freezer gasket, and a non-self-closing washroom door were found.

headline: Deli meat too warm; about 35 live flies
summary: About 12 lbs of deli meat held at 50–57°F were voluntarily discarded. About 35 or more small black live flies were found in prep, storage, and dining areas. Pest control service required. Citation issued.

headline: No food handler training proof; drain cover missing
summary: No proof of food handler training or certificates was available for employees. The certified food manager lacked allergen training proof. A floor drain cover under the ice machine was missing. Basement clutter must be removed.

headline: Dirty shelves and floors; loose toilet faucet
summary: Shelving under the meat slicer had dirt and food debris. Floors under and behind equipment had grease and dirt. The toilet room faucet was loose. Dust covered the A/C vents. A toilet room handwash sign was missing.

headline: Multiple cleaning and storage issues; no milk cooler thermometer
summary: The milk cooler had no thermometer. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and single-service items were not inverted. Cooler gaskets and handles were damaged. Food debris was on equipment and floors. Clutter and boxes were by the rear door.

headline: Food stored on cooler floor; greasy equipment
summary: No handwashing signage at the rear prep hand sink. Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Cutting boards had deep scratches and stains. Cooking equipment, prep tables, and shelving had grease and debris. A light shield was missing.

headline: Handwash sink too cool; ice machine slimy
summary: An exposed handwash sink measured 74.5°F; hot water must be 100–120°F. Heavy black slime was inside the ice machine used for ice. Citation issued. No inspection summary was posted; a new summary was left for posting.

headline: Food in plastic bag; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Food was stored improperly in a plastic grocery bag in the employee refrigerator; the operator was instructed to correct it. A burned-out bulb was above the grill and fryer. The open ceiling in the mop closet needed sealing.

headline: One of two toilets not working
summary: One of the two toilets was not in proper working order. The manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: Slicer and ice maker interior not clean
summary: The meat slicer was not cleaned behind the blade housing, and food debris was present. The bar ice maker interior had gray film. A backflow device for the shared ice and coffee maker could not be located. An ice bin lacked a cover.

headline: Missing handwash signs; rusty shelving; no allergen proof
summary: Handwash signs were missing at bar-area hand sinks. Some food containers were unlabeled. Basement walk-in shelving was rusty. A chemical room wall base was missing. Ventilation vents were dusty, and some managers lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Various TCS foods were held at 45–50°F. About $70 of eggrolls, shrimp, and rice was discarded. A cooler measured 49°F ambient air and was tagged. Citations issued.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints; unlabeled containers
summary: Food handlers in the prep area had no hair restraints. Storage containers lacked common-name labels. Scoops were stored inside dry containers. The washroom door was not self-closing, and exhaust vents had dirt buildup.

headline: No sanitizer test strips; missing sink stoppers
summary: No chemical test strips were on site to check sanitizer strength in the rear three-compartment sink. Sink stoppers were missing. Dining tables were preset with uncovered chopsticks and glassware not inverted. Citation issued.

headline: Summary not posted; dish machine lacks test strips
summary: No inspection summary was posted; citation issued. The high-temperature dish machine had no surface test strips or thermometer. Handwash signage was missing. Rear and front doors need rodent-proofing. Floors and an ice machine needed cleaning.

headline: Leaking freezer pipe and greasy floors
summary: A condenser pipe inside a one-door freezer was leaking. Walk-in cooler shelves were rusty. Grease and debris were on walls and floors behind the cooking line. The garbage enclosure gate was broken. Extra food handler and allergen certificates are required.

headline: No certified manager on duty during food prep
summary: No valid City of Chicago certified manager was on duty while TCS foods (eggs and sausage breakfast sandwiches) were prepared and served. Citation issued. Floors and the coffee counter need cleaning.

headline: Mouse droppings found; food held too warm
summary: About 100 or more mouse droppings were found on floors, lower wall bases, and dish storage. Pest control service was recommended. Italian beef at 48.7°F and raw chicken at 57.4°F were held too warm; about 15 lbs discarded. Health policies were not signed.

headline: No certified manager; no toilet tissue on site
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager certificate was on site while tamales (TCS food) were handled. Citation issued. No toilet tissue was in the restroom or on the premises; an employee left to buy it. Sauce containers sat on the floor.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site; the manager was told to comply. A minor leak was under the three-compartment sink. Debris was around the dumpster and on floors. The sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Heavy grease buildup and dirty ice machine interior
summary: The ice machine interior needed detail cleaning. Cooking equipment, coolers, and walk-ins had heavy food and grease buildup. Floors were slippery from grease. A leak above the mop sink needed correcting. Hood vents and ceilings were dusty.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cold foods discarded
summary: Dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm and must not be used until it reaches 50 ppm. Sausage, marinara, green peppers, cheese, and salami were held too warm; about 15 lbs discarded. The manager called maintenance right away.

headline: Soiled walls; manager told to clean
summary: Walls had soil buildup. The manager was instructed to clean them.

headline: No health policies; missing raw-food menu advisory
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site; citation issued. The menu did not asterisk raw or undercooked items, a priority violation. A gap at the patio door and grease-encrusted outside grease container lid were found.

headline: Door gaps, uncovered food, no hair restraints
summary: Gaps at the base of exterior doors and damaged screens could let pests in; no pests were recorded. Uncovered shrimp, unwrapped dessert, and condiments were found. Two cooks had no hair restraints. Boxes sat on floors.

headline: Broken hand sink; open drink above food prep
summary: A hand sink at the bar area had both handles stripped and was not usable; it is a priority violation. An employee's open drink was above food prep. A shelf above food prep was dusty with unneeded items.

headline: Chicken and perch held at unsafe temperatures
summary: About 20 lbs of cooked chicken at 86.7–104°F under a heat lamp (must be 135°F+) and 30 lbs of raw perch at 47°F were discarded. No employee health policy or vomit cleanup procedure was present. Many prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Gap under side door; missing floor tile
summary: A side exit door had at least a 1/4-inch gap at the floor, a pest entry risk; no pests were recorded. A women's restroom trash receptacle lacked a cover. Floor tile by the three-compartment sink was missing. Several bulbs were burned out.

headline: Torn walk-in gasket; dusty display cooler vents
summary: A walk-in cooler and freezer in the bakery had a torn rubber gasket. Ventilation along the display cooler rails was dirty and dusty. Staff were instructed to repair and clean.

headline: Leaking pipe under prep sink; no walk-in thermometer
summary: A pipe under the front prep handwash sink was leaking. No ambient air thermometer was inside the basement walk-in cooler. Food baskets were not inverted, and a fork was on a drying rack.

headline: Employees drinking at prep area; unlabeled food
summary: Employees were drinking and preparing food at the prep area and must use a designated break area. Food inside refrigeration was unlabeled. Cardboard and foil lined walk-in shelves, and the coffee station used unfinished wood shelving.

headline: Pink buildup in soda ice machine; dusty walls
summary: Passed. Slight pink buildup inside the soda ice machine must be cleaned. Dust and food debris on walls at prep and bar areas must be cleaned.

headline: Non-food-grade bags and cardboard shelf liners
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Frozen beef and chicken were stored in non-food-grade bags. Cardboard shelf liners must be removed. Ice bin, cooler interiors and dry storage floors need cleaning, and wall and hand sink repairs were requested.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water briefly
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and fish were handled. Hot water heater was broken until a plumber fixed it at the end of inspection. A walk-in cooler fan cover needs cleaning.

headline: Dusty greasy hood; missing food handler certificates
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed with conditions. The hood and ventilation system are dusty and greasy. Staff lack food handler certificates, and the person in charge lacks an allergen certificate.

headline: No certified manager while pizza served; no health policy
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was present while pizza at 135°F was prepared and served; citation issued. No written employee health policy or vomit cleanup supplies were on site. Two employees lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Cooler lacks thermometer; greasy hood; repairs needed
summary: Passed. The 1-door cooler had no thermometer inside. The hood and filters had grease and food buildup and must be cleaned. Also needed: covered trash in employee restroom, self-closing restroom door, and a tight-fitting cracked light cover.

headline: Spillage in cabinet under hand sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. Spillage was found in the cabinet under the front assembly prep hand sink. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; eggs held too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine during inspection; the manager fixed it to 50–75 ppm. About 3 dozen eggs at 50–55°F and liquid eggs at 48.9°F were discarded.

headline: Dirty microwaves; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed. Microwave interiors have accumulated food debris and must be cleaned. No food handler certificates were on premises. All food handlers must be certified, with names on file.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs; milk crates as shelves
summary: Passed. Basement employee restrooms lack hand-washing signs. Milk crates are used for shelving in the kitchen, dishwashing and dry storage areas. Crates can hide pests and must be replaced with proper shelving.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; scratched boards; warped gear
summary: Pass with conditions. An employee handled bacon and toast with bare hands; citation issued. Cups are used as scoops, and cloths are on counters. Cutting boards are severely scratched, and milk crates store clean dishes. Fly traps are above food prep.

headline: Clean racks, shelves, and food prep floors
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Wire racks, stainless shelves and prep tables in food prep areas need cleaning. Floors in food prep areas also need cleaning.

headline: Many cold foods too warm; cooling units too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Many cold foods were held at 46.2–66.9°F, and about 40 lbs ($110) was discarded. Two small cold units ran at 52.7–59.0°F; one was repaired to 40.1°F before inspection ended. Leaks and missing ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: Mold-like buildup in beer cooler racks
summary: Passed. Storage racks in the basement beer walk-in cooler have mold-like buildup and must be detail cleaned. The bar's beer cooler and three-compartment sink interior also need cleaning. A leaky drain under the bar hand sink needs repair.

headline: Hand-washing lapses; expired food handler certificate
summary: Pass with conditions. An employee handled food after using a phone without washing hands; citation issued. Hair restraints were missing, and wiping cloths were not in sanitizer. A food handler certificate expired, and ceiling tiles are water-stained.

headline: Rice cooled at room temperature; missing thermometers
summary: Failed. Bulk yellow rice was cooling at room temperature, though food temperature was within limits. Walk-in cooler, prep cooler and display cooler lacked thermometers. An ashtray with 10–15 cigarettes was in the office; citation issued.

headline: Hair restraints lacking; expired food handler certificates
summary: Passed. Food prep staff with long hair and beards lacked hair or beard restraints. Two food handler training certificates had expired.

headline: Missing splash guard; leaking faucets; greasy hood
summary: Re-inspection passed. A washable splash guard must be installed between the front hand sink and a compartment sink. The rear three-compartment sink and hand sink leak. Hood, filters and pipes need detail cleaning.

headline: Slow-draining sink basin at dish sink
summary: Passed. Water drained slowly from the second basin of the three-compartment dish sink. Staff were instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: No certified food manager while steaming milk
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while milk, a food that must stay cold or hot, was being steamed. The manager was instructed to obtain one.

headline: Food sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Re-inspection passed. The food service sanitation manager had no food allergen training certificate on site. Staff were instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificate posted
summary: Pass with conditions. No valid city food sanitation certificate was provided. A certified manager must be on premises whenever milk or ice cream is prepared or served. Citation issued.

headline: Faded labels; dirty beverage nozzles and vents
summary: Passed. Faded labels on bulk containers need replacing. Beverage machine nozzles, the floor under the three-compartment sink, the wall above the hand sink and a vent above the sink need cleaning.

headline: Cardboard liner; greasy fryers; expired allergen training
summary: Passed. Cardboard lines shelves near cooking equipment and must be removed. Grease inside fryers must be cleaned. Expired allergen training certificates were seen for certified managers.

headline: Cooked eel held too warm; discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked eel held at 72.4–74.5°F in a countertop oven at the sushi prep area. About 5 lbs ($100) was voluntarily discarded. Spice containers lacked labels, and the manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing restroom receptacle; debris under equipment
summary: Re-inspection passed. The south restroom lacks a covered receptacle. Food debris is under equipment, along walls and in corners, and in floor drains and cabinets. Manager was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Failed: flies, warm rice, undated shellfish tags
summary: Failed. Over 30 small flies were in prep, dish and bar areas; citation issued. Rice was held at 116.3°F, below the 135°F minimum, and was discarded. Hummus and tomatoes at 51.6–53.6°F were discarded. Shellfish tags were undated.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; low cold water pressure
summary: Pass with conditions. The bar low-temperature dish machine read 0.0 ppm and was held until repaired; it later reached 50 ppm. Both prep hand sinks have low cold water pressure. A handwashing sign is missing, and a bar cooler gasket is worn.

headline: Wiping cloths on cooler; dirty floor drains
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths stored on a prep cooler must be kept in sanitizer. Dirt and debris are on floor drains in food prep and rear dishwashing areas and must be cleaned.

headline: Heavy ice inside freezers; standing water
summary: Passed. Heavy ice is inside a two-door refrigeration unit and a prep chest freezer. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Standing water is behind cooking equipment, and floor cracks need repair.

headline: Failed: no vomit kit; damaged freezers and walls
summary: Failed license inspection. Vomit and diarrhea supplies were not on premises. No barrier kept customers from touching food on scales or entering seafood prep. Damaged gaskets, cracked freezer glass, rust, and ice and exposed insulation need repair.

headline: Failed: mold-like buildup; dead flies on traps
summary: Failed. Mold-like buildup was inside the ice machine (not used for drinks). Sticky fly traps with dead flies were in rear storage. A deli hot-hold unit lacked a thermometer. Previous violations, including the ice machine hinges, were not fixed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; flies; poor hygiene
summary: Failed complaint inspection. No certified manager was on duty; citations issued. Workers handled money and food without washing hands. No vomit cleanup kit or health policies were on site. About 12–15 live flies were found, and ice dispensers had slimy buildup.

headline: Line cooler too warm; tagged out of use
summary: Pass with conditions. The front service line cooler is in poor repair and reads 50.5°F inside. It was tagged, not to be used until repaired. Clean equipment must be separated from the hand sink, and floors need cleaning.

headline: Food stored on floor; clutter and spills
summary: Passed. Food was stored on the floor in rear dry storage and must be raised six inches. Clutter and floor debris were found throughout. Rear warewashing hand sink lacks handwashing signage.

headline: Failed: rat droppings and dead roaches throughout
summary: Failed. Over 50 rat droppings were found along walls and corridors, dead roaches were on floors and equipment, and gaps were under front and rear doors. Unlabeled bulk containers and soiled wiping cloths were also found.

headline: Food handler and allergen certificates missing
summary: Complaint inspection passed. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. The floor under the three-compartment sink needs cleaning.

headline: Single-use items on floor; leaking faucet
summary: Licensed, passed. Single-service items stored on the floor must be raised six inches. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Dust is on the washroom ventilation fan and needs cleaning.

headline: Rusty dirty cooler shelving; clutter throughout
summary: Passed. Cooler shelving is rusty and dirty and must be cleaned. Clutter throughout the premises must be organized or removed to prevent hiding places for pests.

headline: Stained cutting boards; cluttered basement storage
summary: Passed. Stained and cut cutting boards in kitchen prep need refinishing or replacement. Basement liquor storage is cluttered and items must be six inches off the floor. Certified managers lack allergen proof.

headline: Failed: over 50 flies; prior pest violation unfixed
summary: Failed re-inspection. A previous pest violation was not corrected. More than 50 small flies were in the kitchen, dining room and hallway. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: no hot running water on site
summary: Failed re-inspection. Hand sinks measured 77.7–78.2°F and the warewashing unit 100°F. Hand sinks must be 100–120°F and warewashing at least 120°F. Citation issued.

headline: Rodent glue trap on floor; greasy fryers
summary: Passed. A rodent glue trap was visible on the sales-floor floor under storage racks; pest control was to treat the premises. Charred fryers need detail cleaning. Mop sink lacks a backflow device. Restroom and signage issues noted.

headline: Failed: no hot running water on premises
summary: Failed. No hot running water was on premises; water measured 74.3–76.1°F. Hot water must be above 110°F at the three-compartment sink and above 100°F at hand sinks. Two employees lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Clutter in basement storage
summary: Re-inspection passed. Unused articles and equipment are stored in basement storage areas and must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Residue inside reach-in coolers; greasy floors
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Residue and food debris are inside reach-in coolers and the bar storage cabinet. Kitchen, bar, dry storage and chemical storage floors have excessive debris and grease, and the person in charge was told to clean.

headline: No certificate posted; allergen training missing
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No valid food manager certificate was posted on the premises; citation issued. Food sanitation managers have no allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled spice containers; minor debris
summary: Passed. Spices held outside original packaging near the wok station lacked name labels. Minor debris was under the wok station.

headline: No certified manager on duty; backflow device missing
summary: Pass with conditions. No valid certified manager was on duty while chicken and steak were prepared and served; citation issued. The rear mop sink lacks a required backflow device. The employee washroom door needs a self-closing device.

headline: Dish machine leak; missing ice machine hose
summary: Re-inspection passed. A leak in the pipe under the dish machine must be repaired. A hose is missing from the basement ice machine and must be reattached. Clutter in the basement must be removed to avoid rodent hiding places.

headline: Milk crates and cardboard used; freezer spills
summary: Passed. Walk-in freezer foods must be raised off the floor on proper shelving, not on milk crates or cardboard. Food spills are in the freezer and rear hallway. A rusted metal shelf must be repaired.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; rodent droppings; failed
summary: Failed. Staff touched ready-to-eat ceviche, chips and sopes with bare hands; that food was discarded. About 50 rodent droppings were on prep shelves and about 100 under dry storage shelves. Live flies were also present.

headline: Leaking pipes and faucets; food debris on floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Basement wastewater pipes leak, and the three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Food debris and spills are under shelving and throughout. A hole behind the sink must be sealed, and bar cooler interiors need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; greasy, dirty cooler
summary: Passed. Bulk dry ingredient containers in rear storage are unlabeled. A two-door cooler's interior and gaskets have food splatter. A broken cardboard box on the floor by the three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Failed: raw food stored over ready-to-eat food
summary: Failed. Raw eggs, beef, chicken and shrimp were stored above or on ready-to-eat foods; the manager removed them. A hand sink became a drinking-water filter and is blocked by a freezer. A thermometer is missing, and a rear door has a 1/2-inch gap.

headline: Failed: no health policy, no vomit cleanup, no hot water
summary: Failed license inspection. No signed employee health policies and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup items were on site. The toilet-room sink had no hot water (72°F). Ventilation above the grill is inadequate. No grease trap was on site.

headline: No certified manager; no soap or towels at sink
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was present while TCS foods were prepared or served. The dish-area hand sink had no soap or paper towels. Two bug zappers in food prep were ordered removed.

headline: Failed: rat droppings, unsafe holding temps, hot water
summary: Failed. Fifteen rat droppings were found in the basement. Cold foods ranged 45.7–63.1°F, and about 12 lbs was discarded. Dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine. Bar hand sink water reached 141.3°F, above the 120°F maximum.

headline: Greasy fryer, walls, and hood
summary: Passed. Grease and debris are inside the fryer cabinet. Hand sink caulk is peeling near the prep table. Grease, splatter and debris are on walls and floors by the dish machine, and the exhaust hood and filters are greasy.

headline: Unlabeled containers; deep cuts in cutting board
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bulk containers and shakers lack labels. Wiping cloths were not in sanitizer. A cutting board has deep cuts and stains. Items are on the storage floor, and ceiling tiles and wall panels need repair.

headline: No food handler certificates; allergen training missing
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates were on site, and the manager was instructed to follow the state food handler requirement. The food sanitation manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Failed: three live cockroaches on kitchen walls
summary: Failed. Three live cockroaches were found on kitchen walls. Staff were instructed to eliminate insects in all affected areas. Pest control service was recommended. This was a serious violation.

headline: Failed: unsafe cold food; 70+ mouse droppings
summary: Failed. About 20 lbs of pork, beef and chicken held at 51.7–54°F were ordered discarded; the unit was off. Over 70 mouse droppings were in the kitchen and storage. Pest control was required, and several food handlers lacked training.

headline: Splash guard needed at hand sink
summary: Passed. The hand sink next to the three-compartment sink drainboard needs a splash guard installed and maintained.

headline: Greasy fryer lower compartment
summary: Passed. The rear lower compartment of the deep fryers has grease and food buildup and needs a deep clean.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; not in use
summary: Pass with conditions. The basement low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine and was ordered out of use until it reaches 50 ppm. Backflow devices are missing at the ice machine, and a sprayer hangs below the sink rim.

headline: No health policy; no vomit kit; no backflow device
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy was on site, and no vomit or diarrhea kit was available. Hand-washing signs are missing in three restrooms, and the mop sink has no backflow preventer. Two burnt-out bulbs need replacing.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at hand sink
summary: Passed. The hand sink has no handwashing sign. A sign must be provided.

headline: Food spills and grease on floors
summary: Passed. Food spills and grease are on floors under cooking equipment and prep tables and must be cleaned.

headline: Missing vomit cleanup items; missing backflow devices
summary: Pass with conditions. Some vomit and diarrhea cleanup items were missing. Backflow devices are missing at the mop sink and ice machine water line. The front door has a 1/4-inch gap to seal. A ceiling bulb is out, and a food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Labels, splash guard, and crates to fix
summary: Re-inspection passed. Shakers and squeeze bottles need common-name labels. A splash guard is needed at the dish-area hand sink. Crates must be removed for food storage, and worn cutting boards need repair.

headline: Failed: roaches, flies, and no vomit cleanup kit
summary: Failed. Three live cockroaches were on a wall, ceiling and refrigerator door, and live small flying insects were in food prep. A hand sink was blocked and had no soap. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site.

headline: Greasy equipment, debris, and dirty hood filters
summary: Passed. Inspector found grease splatter on cooking equipment, factory protective covering still on equipment, food debris on floors near prep and dishwashing, and greasy hood filters. Staff were told to clean to prevent pests.

headline: Food held too warm; no towels at hand sinks
summary: Pass with conditions. Refrigerated food ranged up to 61.5°F, including eggs, hot dogs and cheese; about 110 lbs ($700) was held above 41°F. Walk-in cooler air was 64°F. Hand sinks lacked paper towels; staff provided drying supplies on site.

headline: Failed re-inspection: cooler defects and unfixed violations
summary: Failed. The walk-in cooler's inside release knob is broken, so the door cannot be opened from inside. Freezer gasket is broken and condenser has excess ice. Earlier violations, including missing backflow devices, were not corrected.

headline: Rusting freezers and shelves; detail cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Reach-in freezers are rusting and in poor repair, and walk-in shelves are rusting. Prep tables, sinks and dish machine need detail cleaning. Standing water is on floors, and a hand sink drains slowly.

headline: Dirty microwave interior; allergen certificates missing
summary: Passed. The microwave and prep cooler interiors need cleaning. No allergen training certificates were on the premises, and managers must show proof.

headline: Pipe under sink repaired with tape
summary: Re-inspection passed. Piping under the three-compartment sink was repaired with tape and must be properly repaired.

headline: Cut melon and pineapple held too warm; discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. About 10 lbs of cut melon and pineapple at 62–68°F and about 7 lbs of watermelon at 65–68°F were discarded. The front door has a 1/2-inch gap to seal. Male food handlers with beards need beard guards.

headline: Missing signage; leaking faucet; no toilet receptacle
summary: Re-inspection passed. The toilet room lacks a handwashing sign and a covered receptacle. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be repaired.

headline: Public summary not posted; citation issued
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. The previous inspection's summary was not posted for public view. A new summary was left and must be posted. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: missing thermometers; old violation unfixed
summary: Failed. Cook-line reach-in coolers lack visible thermometers. No splash guard at the cook-line hand sink. Shelving is rusted, and grease covers cooking equipment. A previous violation for a missing coffee-bar hand sink was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Failed: unapproved food, slimy ice machine, no approved plan
summary: Failed. About 100 lbs of unlabeled meat from an unapproved source was found and discarded. Shellfish tags were not kept for 90 days. The ice machine had black and pink slime dripping onto ice. No approved plan for special processes.

headline: Missing signage; greasy kitchen; napkin bin needed
summary: Passed. Hand sink signage is missing, and the ice bin needs cleaning. Single-service items are stored on the floor. Grease covers cooking equipment and walls, and an employee washroom needs a covered receptacle.

headline: Door gap; sticky hot-water knee paddle
summary: Passed. A half-inch gap is at the east door threshold and needs a rodent-proof strip. The rear hand sink's hot-water knee paddle sticks and doesn't turn off. No allergen certificates for certified managers.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and fly in prep
summary: Failed. About 50 rodent droppings were found in the rear dry storage closet and about 10 under the front customer counter. One large fly was in the food prep area. Staff were told to eliminate pests and call pest control.

headline: Failed: no certified manager until 3:25 PM
summary: Failed. No valid certified manager was on site until 3:25 PM; citation issued. Cold foods at 47.7–59.5°F were discarded ($82). A small cold unit at 51.6°F was tagged. An exit door gap must be sealed, and a missing dish-area splash guard must be installed.

headline: Ice machine buildup touching ice; hair restraint missing
summary: Pass with conditions. The boba prep ice machine has brown and pink buildup on its top interior, touching ice used for drinks. Ice must be removed and the machine cleaned and sanitized. A food handler lacked a hair restraint; citation issued.

headline: Failed: live roaches and mouse droppings
summary: Failed. About 15 live cockroaches were under the counter and behind coolers, and about 20 mouse droppings were at the wall base in the rear dish room. Numerous roaches were trapped on glue boards. No sanitizer was available at the sink.

headline: Splash guard needed; floors and vents need cleaning
summary: Passed. A splash guard is needed at the deli hand sink next to chicken prep. Floors need detailed cleaning in the walk-in freezer, under fryers, in the seafood cooler and bakery, and fan vents in meat production need cleaning.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, live roaches, non-rodent-proof door
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 25–30 mouse droppings were found in several areas, including dish storage and under prep tables. Four live roaches were present, and a dead roach was on wrapped food in a freezer. The rear door is not rodent-proof.

headline: Hot water handle hard to turn
summary: Passed. The hot water handle is hard to turn off and needs repair.

headline: Floors need cleaning; food handler certificate needed
summary: Passed. Floors behind and around kitchen and storage equipment need cleaning of spills, debris and grease. A line cook's food handler training certificate must be provided.

headline: Missing hand sink signage and restroom covers
summary: Complaint inspection passed. The basement dish hand sink lacks handwashing signage. Restrooms are missing covered waste receptacles. Both were ordered fixed.

headline: No soap at hand sink; dirty walk-in floors
summary: Short complaint form, passed with conditions. The rear hand sink had no soap; citation issued. Walk-in floors and shelves have dirt and food debris. Greasy hood filters over the wok station need cleaning.

headline: Food debris in drains near sinks
summary: Passed. A rear drain next to a compartment sink had food debris, and the drain under the front prep hand sink also had debris.

headline: Failed: two live roaches; dead roaches on trap
summary: Failed. Two live roaches were found, one on a door and one by a shrine. A sticky trap in the basement held dead roaches. Rice was uncovered under the dishwashing drainboard, and a thermometer is missing from a prep cooler.

headline: Failed: blocked hand sink, slimy ice machine, warm cold food
summary: Failed. Two buckets blocked the rear hand sink. The ice machine had pink and black slime. Deli meat at 46.5°F and beef at 50.9–51.9°F were held too warm, and about 5 lbs ($50) was discarded.

headline: Food too warm, bare-hand contact, no food handler proof
summary: Pass with conditions. Eggs at 74°F, pork at 54°F and other cold foods were held too warm. A worker used bare hands on ready-to-eat food. A hand sink was blocked by coconut milk and had no soap. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was present while TCS foods (foods that must stay hot or cold) were prepared. About 28 small rodent droppings were found in storage. About 50 lbs of unapproved sauerkraut was discarded.

headline: Ice machine residue, beards, reused cardboard
summary: Slight white substance inside the ice machine; staff told to clean and sanitize. Male food handlers had beards without beard guards. Cardboard reused as a shelf liner; staff told to stop.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were handled and served. Food handler touched bread, tomatoes, and lettuce with bare hands. Food handler not wearing hair restraint; disposable cups used as scoops.

headline: Flypaper present; rear door gap; basement clutter
summary: Flypaper on premises must be removed and a licensed pest technician told about the need for service. Rear door has a 1/2-inch gap at the bottom; repair needed. Basement clutter and unneeded items to remove; broken basement wall.

headline: Unlabeled bulk; cardboard liners; rusty racks
summary: Bulk flour and sugar lacked labels. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces. Cardboard used as liner on food prep equipment and tables; cutting boards with open seams and stains; rusty walk-in racks; frozen chicken stored in plastic bags.

headline: Cold-held foods too warm; refrigerator unit unusable
summary: Foods above 41F: egg wash 57F, sliced tomatoes 52F, raw eggs 53F, cooked pork 54F. Manager voluntarily discarded 35 lbs. A refrigerator at 60.5F must not be used until reinspected. Utensils stored by sink must be re-washed.

headline: Hand sinks lack 15 seconds of running water
summary: Hand sinks in prep and dish areas could not run water for at least 15 seconds; repair the metered faucets. Spilled food debris on the bottom of reach-in coolers for fries and beef patties must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled desserts; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Prepackaged desserts at the front counter lacked business name, address, and ingredient labels. Manager on site lacked an allergen training certificate; must meet the requirement.

headline: Mouse-gnawed chips; over 100 mouse droppings
summary: Chips gnawed by mice were on display and manager told to discard them. Over 100 mouse droppings and a live mouse found in many areas; exterminator required. Previous violation not corrected. Bulk containers unlabeled; front door gap.

headline: Expired allergen certificate; leaks and cracked tiles
summary: Fly strip hung in rear prep area; must be removed. Front hand sink leaks from pipe below; tube draining into a container in walk-in cooler. Cutting board grooved and stained. Restrooms need cleaning, and manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Ice machine chute and cooking equipment need cleaning
summary: Minor buildup at the ice machine chute needs detail cleaning. Oil and food cooking equipment need detail cleaning; outdoor toilet rooms and floors around the ice cream machine need cleaning. Air vents dusty.

headline: Dishwasher lacks sanitizer; unsafe food temperatures
summary: Dishwasher final rinse had no chlorine while in use; must maintain 100 ppm. Hot foods held at 118-131F, below 135F. Cold foods too warm, including eggs at 48-60F and chopped liver at 59F. Walk-in foods exceeded the seven-day date limit; citation issued.

headline: Leaking dish machine; hood dust and debris
summary: High-temperature dish machine in the bar leaks; repair or replace it. Heavy dust and debris on the hood over the cook line in the rear prep and dish area; clean and maintain.

headline: Hair restraint missing; leaking hot-water handle
summary: One food handler was not wearing a hair restraint; manager told all handlers must wear one. Hot-water handle on the dishwashing one-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Heavy grease and food debris throughout kitchen
summary: Grease and food debris inside the deep fryer oil filtering unit and on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving. Heavy dirt, grease, and splatter on walls and floors along the hot food line.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: Person in charge lacked a City of Chicago food sanitation certificate. No certified manager present while milk and ham sandwiches were prepared; citation issued. Dust on washroom vent and light shields above food storage must be cleaned.

headline: Blocked hand sink; water off during service
summary: Front prep hand sink was blocked by a stored cup and wiping cloth, and its hot water was turned off during service; must be fixed. Two hand sinks lacked soap. Overflowing dumpster and 1/4-inch rear door gap; citation issued.

headline: Hair restraint, wiping cloth, and cleaning issues
summary: Food handlers not wearing hair restraints. Soiled wiping cloths stored improperly. Food spills and debris on coolers, fryers, and prep tables. Leaking drain under hand sink and leaking three-compartment sink faucets. Manager told to fix and clean.

headline: Heavy grease and debris on wok line
summary: Excessive food debris and grease on the entire wok line, including drip trays, fryers, prep tables, sinks, and shelving. Floor under and behind the cooking line has heavy grease and debris; clean and maintain.

headline: Freezer door insulation exposed
summary: Double-door freezer has no cover on the inside of the door, exposing insulation. Must be covered with a smooth surface.

headline: Mouse droppings; blank health policy; food on floor
summary: About 200 mouse droppings on floors and shelves in several areas; pest control needed; citation issued. Blank employee health policy copies on site. Food stored on floor; wood and cardboard liners; cement wall breaking apart; grease container needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe food and utensil practices
summary: No certified manager when raw chicken was cooked and served; manager arrived about 10:45 AM; citation issued. About 55 lbs of food discarded. Brisket at 48.5F. Shellstock sale dates missing; oysters served in reused shells.

headline: Moldy ice machine; multiple leaks; grease buildup
summary: Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine; ice to be destroyed and machine cleaned and sanitized. No splash guard at the three-compartment sink. Leaks at sink drain, faucet, and backflow device. Food debris, grease, and black buildup on floors and equipment.

headline: 50+ mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: 50 or more mouse droppings on electrical panel, pipes, and under shelving; pest control recommended; citation issued. No certified manager certificate and no employee health policies. Cooked eggs at 82.9F and raw chicken at 56.1-57.2F discarded.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Certified managers were missing allergen training. Staff were instructed to complete training and keep verification on site.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; trash and damaged ceilings
summary: Hand sinks lacked handwashing signs. An insect and rodent item was corrected on site; no pests described. Trash and debris around dumpsters and pumps. Water-stained ceiling tiles and dirty floors need repair and cleaning.

headline: Mouse droppings; cold foods too warm; hand sink
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings in rear pastry prep and near powdered sugar; citation issued. Milk at 48F, oat milk at 72F, and other items discarded; prep cooler at 71F. Hand sink at 81F with no paper towels; leaks under sink. Missing shellstock tags on oysters and mussels.

headline: Openings around rear door and sink pipes
summary: Openings around the top and side of the rear door and around pipes under the sink must be sealed to prevent possible pest entry points. No pests were recorded.

headline: Front door gaps; dirty can opener and bar gun
summary: Both front door sets have 1/4-inch gaps in the middle and at the bottom; must be rodent- and insect-proofed. Can opener has food buildup; bar gun has pink and brown residue. Trash containers in women's and unisex toilet rooms lack lids.

headline: Cold foods too warm; expired food handler card
summary: Eggs, milk, and pastry cream held at 45.6-47.3F in an upright refrigerator; all discarded (15 lbs). Reach-in cooler door gaskets ripped and must be repaired. One food handler certificate expired.

headline: Debris and dirt under bar equipment
summary: Debris and dirt built up on the main bar floor under equipment, along walls, and in corners. Must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Ice machine interior needs cleaning
summary: Ice machine interior in the prep area must be cleaned and maintained. Certified manager on duty must provide and maintain allergen training.

headline: Rat droppings found; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Over 20 rat droppings along wall bases inside and outside the bar; pest control recommended; citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine; ice machine has slimy buildup; mussels lacked tags and 10 lbs were discarded. Employees ate and drank at the prep area.

headline: Torn gaskets; no test kit; food debris
summary: Two-door cooler in rear prep has torn gaskets on both doors. No chemical test kit for three-compartment sink sanitizer; citation issued. Food debris inside cooling units and under heavy equipment; clean to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No hand sink in lower-level prep area
summary: No hand sink in lower-level preparation areas; citation issued. Packaged food shelving sits under drainage pipes in basement storage and must be moved. Food containers not stored inverted on shelves.

headline: Hood ventilation lights not working
summary: Hood ventilation lights over cooking equipment not working. Must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Standing water from walk-in cooler fan leak
summary: Re-inspection found standing water on the floor from a leak inside the walk-in cooler caused by the fan. Repair and maintenance required.

headline: Dumpster lid missing; hair restraint and certificate issues
summary: Outside dumpster lacked a lid and was not maintained; citation issued. Employee in food prep lacked hair restraint. No thermometer in hot holding unit. Stained cutting boards. Prior food handler training violation not corrected; allergen certificate missing.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificate posted
summary: No valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted on the premises. A certified food manager with a valid certificate must be present whenever TCS foods are prepared or served; citation issued.

headline: No health policy, vomit kit, or service-counter sink
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or spill kit. No hand sink at service counters. No undercooked-food consumer advisory. Restroom doors not self-closing; restroom exhaust vents not working.

headline: Dish machine missing manufacturer data plate
summary: Low-temperature warewashing machine in the main kitchen lacks a manufacturer data plate. Plate must be provided and kept readable for food employees.

headline: Ice machine mold; egg patties too warm
summary: Black mold-like substance on an ice machine panel touching ice; machine to be cleaned and sanitized. Egg patties at 66.9-68.6F were discarded. Hand sink lacked soap, which was obtained during inspection. Exposed sewage pipes above basement food storage.

headline: Low hot water; rear door gap; prior violations
summary: Rear door has a 1/2-inch gap at the bottom; manager to seal it. Three-compartment sink reached only 105F hot water; manager turned up the water heater, which must stay at 110F. Prior core violations not corrected: cutting boards, food handler certificates, allergen training.

headline: Pizza-area cooler too warm; repeat violation
summary: Pepperoni at 47.5F and sausage at 46.7F held in cooler near pizza oven; about 5 lbs discarded. Cooler at 55.1F tagged and torn gaskets. No employee health policy on site; no soap at washroom sink; repeat food handler certificate violation.

headline: Emergency exit gap; leaking backflow; gaskets
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the east emergency exit door must be rodent-proofed. Grill and milk reach-in cooler gaskets ripped and must be replaced. Backflow leaking under dish sink; floor tiles low on grout in dish area.

headline: Worn door seal, dusty ceiling, leaky pipe
summary: Worn rear door weather strip could let pests in; repair required. Remove cardboard from walk-in cooler shelving. Fix leaky pipe under rear hand sink. Replace damaged dining ceiling tiles, clean greasy hood, and replace burnt-out walk-in cooler lights.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Certified food manager had no proof of allergen training certificate. All certified managers instructed to obtain the certificate.

headline: No hair restraint; sink drainboard; broken vent
summary: Food handler not wearing a hair restraint; told to wear one. Three-compartment sink drainboard does not drain; must tilt toward the basin. Broken vent in employee restroom needs replacing.

headline: Broken thermometer at hot holding unit
summary: Non-functional thermometer at the hot holding unit. Must be repaired and kept functional.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; ice machine buildup
summary: Bulk containers in the rear kitchen lack labels; manager to label them with common food names. Calcium buildup inside the ice machine; manager told to clean it.

headline: Line cooler in poor repair; mops on floor
summary: Two-door line cooler measured 59F; food removed before inspection and cooler tagged until repaired or replaced. Two-door freezer doors and handles dented, cracked, or missing. Mop heads stored on walk-in cooler floor; must relocate to utility sink.

headline: Pots not sanitized; unsafe food temperatures
summary: Pots washed in a sink set up only for washing, with no sanitizing rinse; all unsanitized dishes must be rewashed; citation issued. Cooked rib tips held at 118.9-129.5F and dressing at 52.5F were discarded. Several foods unlabeled; no training proof.

headline: Front door gap; dusty ventilation fans
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door could allow rodent entry; staff told to adjust the door sweep and threshold. Light dust on ventilation fans in both washrooms must be cleaned.

headline: Dirt and grime on floors throughout facility
summary: Build-up of dirt and grime on floors throughout the facility. Must be detail cleaned and kept in good condition.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; plumbing leaks
summary: Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; tagged and held until repaired. Rear exit door worn with gaps. Low water pressure at men's restroom sink; leaks under rear sink and employee toilet. Employee restroom vent not working. Allergen training still missing.

headline: Plastic forks not inverted; no sink stoppers
summary: Plastic forks were not inverted in the food prep area or at the venue bar; told to invert them. No sink stoppers were on site for the three-compartment sink; told to provide them.

headline: No hand sink in new prep area; unlabeled ice cream
summary: New rear prep area for ice cream and shakes lacks a handwashing sink with hot and cold water; citation issued. Self-serve hand-packed ice cream in the freezer lacks required labels, including ingredients, net quantity, business name, and allergens.

headline: No paper towels at hand sink; dirty floors
summary: No paper towels at a hand-washing sink; management told to always supply soap and paper towels. Citation issued. Floors along wall bases and under the bar need cleaning.

headline: House flies and gnats found; citation issued
summary: About 10-15 house flies seen, including 8-10 in the back produce area. Dead gnats in deli light shield. Pest control consultation required; citation issued. Also cracked cake cooler glass, greasy fryer, and a leaking produce sink.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; food on floor
summary: Tomatoes, raw chicken, shrimp, beef, and salsa held 47.7-49.4F in a prep cooler; about 20 lbs discarded. Prep cooler at 52F tagged. Raw beef thawed at room temperature; food stored on floor. Hair restraint missing; no sink stoppers.

headline: Expired hummus and sauce; beef thawed on counter
summary: Hummus and garlic sauce stored past the 7-day use date; must use or discard. Frozen beef steak thawed at room temperature. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates; certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No hot water; dish machine lacks temperature indicator
summary: No hot water on arrival; maximum water temperature 65F. Hand sinks must reach 100F and other sinks 110F. Plumber called; citation issued. Dish machine lacks an irreversible temperature indicator for utensil surfaces.

headline: Grease and debris; soiled mop heads
summary: Accumulated grease and food debris on interior and exterior surfaces of cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and freezers; must be cleaned. Soiled mop heads not stored properly; hang them to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Live roaches found; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: About 3-5 live roaches found in prep area; pest control recommended and citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine; unit tagged. Hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels. Chicken at 50.8F and turkey at 49.4F discarded.

headline: Dirty freezers, washrooms, and damaged floors
summary: Ice buildup and spills inside the rear deep freezer and front prep cooler must be cleaned. Washroom fixtures are dirty and a lidded garbage can is needed. Walls and floors have food splatter and grease; broken dishwashing-area floor tiles need repair.

headline: Missing toilet room lid and self-closing door
summary: Washroom receptacle has no lid; toilet room door has no self-closing device. Both must be provided.

headline: Manager on duty lacks allergen training
summary: Manager on duty had no food allergen training certificate; must obtain one. Floors, light shields, and walls under and around equipment need cleaning, and refrigerator interiors need cleaning where needed.

headline: Potato cutter on raw wood; grease behind fryer
summary: Potato cutter mounted on raw wood wall; paint or seal it with food-grade paint so it is cleanable. Food debris and grease spills behind the deep fryer; clean and maintain.

headline: No handwashing signs; bulk foods unlabeled
summary: No handwashing signs at sinks in dishwashing areas. Bulk sugar and flour containers lacked labels; must be provided.

headline: Crates for storage; freezer frost; broken tiles
summary: Crates used for storage must be removed and replaced with adequate shelving. Ice buildup in freezers must be defrosted; dust on display shelves and reach-in coolers. Damaged, broken, or missing floor tiles throughout must be repaired.

headline: No certified person in charge; no training proof
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate; citation issued. Leaking drainpipe from three-compartment sink in dish area. No proof of food handler training for any handler; no allergen certificate for one manager.

headline: Rear door gap; dirty shelves and floors
summary: About 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door and an opening at the door knob must be sealed to prevent pests. Front prep shelving, walk-in shelves, and fan guard need detail cleaning. Floors under equipment and in storage areas need cleaning. Allergen certificate missing for one employee.

headline: No soap or paper towels; food stored on floor
summary: Prep hand sink lacked soap and paper towels or hand dryers; citation issued. Food stored on floor in prep and storage areas; elevate six inches. Styrofoam cups used for seasoning and single-service items on floor.

headline: Freezer gaps, ice buildup, and training proof missing
summary: Opening at outside walk-in freezer door must be sealed against pests. Crates stored on floors and pallets; ice buildup on condenser lines; peeling storage-room ceiling; unused ice machine in dining area. Missing food handler and allergen training proof.

headline: No hair restraints; ice machine residue; leak
summary: Black, slime-like substance on ice machine panel must be cleaned. Food prep employees not wearing hair or beard restraints. Fryers have dust and grease. Pipe under middle sink leaks; men's restroom needs cleaning. Food handlers lacked proof of training.

headline: Moldy pork belly; food over 7 days discarded
summary: Pork belly with white and blue mold discarded (3 lbs). Three-compartment sink sanitizer read 0 ppm and manager was told to manually add sanitizer. About 70 lbs of TCS food discarded for date marking; no food handler training proof; citation issued.

headline: Ants found; dish machine sanitizing too cool
summary: About 30 ants crawling under the three-compartment sink; pest control recommended and citation issued. Dish machine fresh hot-water sanitizing rinse at 130F; tagged and corrected on site. Eye-wash attached to hand sink; greasy floors.

headline: Towel dispenser fixed on site; trash outside
summary: Hand-towel dispenser in poor repair with no towels at the sink; corrected on site. Outside receptacle left open with trash on the ground; citation issued. Counters, sinks, and equipment need detail cleaning. Rear hand sink drains very slowly.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; no certificate posted
summary: Low-temperature dishwasher had 0 ppm chlorine; tagged and not to be used until reinspected. Also no valid certificate posted, an inaccessible bar hand sink, no vomit cleanup kit, missing shellfish tag dates, and no allergen training.

headline: Debris on office and storage floor
summary: Debris on the floor of the office and storage area. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Rodent droppings; no health policy; citation
summary: About 50 rodent droppings under rear prep hand sink and about 30 on a shelf outside the toilet room; pest control recommended; citation issued. No employee health policy or vomit cleanup kit. Raw meats unlabeled; no test strips; wall cracks.

headline: Missing bar handwashing sign; leaking bar sink
summary: No handwashing sign at the bar hand sink; must be posted. Three-part bar sink leaks from the middle and last drains; repair required.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths, debris, leaking faucet
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables; keep them in sanitizer between uses. Food debris on coolers, freezers, prep tables, and cooking equipment. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet. Debris on floors in prep, storage, and washroom areas.

headline: Basement door gap; missing handwashing signs
summary: Basement exterior door has a gap greater than 1/4 inch at the bottom; install a sweep or repair to prevent pest entry. Missing handwashing signs at basement sink. Rust and dust on large ice machine exterior need cleaning.

headline: Leaking basement hand sink; dusty fans
summary: Basement hand sink leaks at the drain pipe; repair required. Possible food splatter on the wall under basement prep tables needs cleaning. Dust on fans in the basement walk-in cooler must be cleaned.

headline: Scratched cutting boards; standing water
summary: Multiple cutting boards with deep scratches and stains. Rust on meat walk-in cooler shelving. Food debris and spills throughout walk-in coolers and freezers; standing water near the high-temperature dish machine can breed insects.

headline: Leaks; dirty walk-in cooler and cooking equipment
summary: Leaky pipe under front hand sink and leaking three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Walk-in cooler interior has spills and debris; cooking equipment exterior needs cleaning. Floors, walls, and rear POP storage area need detail cleaning.

headline: No health policy; no sandwich prep cooler
summary: No signed employee health policy. No prep cooler for sandwiches; must provide one at 41F. Missing splash guard, drainboard, and self-closing toilet door. Door gaps, unlabeled repackaged dessert, personal belongings stored near food, and cluttered yard.

headline: Dusty ceiling and vents above prep line
