summary: Dust buildup on the ceiling and vents over the front prep line and dish area. Must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Rear door gap; grease buildup; allergen certificate
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear door to the dumpster must be sealed against pests. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, and shelves must be cleaned. Floor debris and dust at rear door needs detail cleaning. Manager lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: Dirty ovens; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Ovens in the food prep area have charred food, grease, and dirt; clean and maintain. Women's restroom toilet needs recaulking; mop not hung to dry. Certified manager on duty lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Live roaches found in basement food storage
summary: Two live roaches found at basement food storage shelving; citation issued and pest control required. Bulk flour and sugar lacked labels. Basement clutter and dirty floors behind sushi prep equipment.

headline: Torn gasket on two-door freezer
summary: Torn gasket inside the two-door freezer. Must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Cold foods too warm; repeat core violation
summary: Cold foods held at 47-63F, including cheese slices, cheesecake, coleslaw, and shredded lettuce. Manager discarded 10 lbs. Two cold holding units too warm and tagged. No hand-wash signs; prior allergen-training violation not corrected; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; missing thermometer, test kit
summary: No certified manager on site while milk and soft-serve mix were handled; citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies. No food thermometer or sanitizer test kit. Open ice cream mix stored on walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Moldy seitan discarded; small flies found
summary: Moldy seitan found in walk-in cooler and discarded. About 25 small flies in dish area and hall to walk-in cooler; pest control consultation required and citation issued. Undated cooked seitan; about 17 lbs discarded.

headline: Moldy wall caulking near dishwashing area
summary: Blackened, moldy wall caulking at the dishwashing machine area. Manager told to replace it and keep it maintained.

headline: Floor tile gauge causes standing water
summary: Deep gauge in utility room floor tile causes standing water under the utility sink. Person in charge must repair and maintain the floor.

headline: No person in charge; employees eating at prep
summary: No person in charge present, and no certified food manager on duty while sandwiches were prepared and served; citation issued. Employees drank and prepared food at the prep area; a designated eating area is required.

headline: Missing pest log; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Cracked wooden spoons in prep area must be replaced. Stainless surfaces behind bars need cleaning; broken floor tiles and chipped ceiling paint need repair. Pest control log book missing from premises; summary report not posted; citations issued.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; no summary posted
summary: No proof of food handler training for employees. No inspection summary posted for the public; citation issued. Green mold-like buildup on storage racks in walk-in cooler. Thermometers missing in coolers; floors and drains need cleaning.

headline: Handwashing sink blocked; food stored on floor
summary: A handwashing sink was blocked by a freezer and filled with rubber gloves; the manager was told to clear it. Food was stored on the cooler floor, and soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Grease, leaks, and cracks were also noted.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit, no soap, no sanitizer
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. The food prep sink had no soap or handwashing signs. The ice machine had black buildup, and the three-compartment sink had no sanitizer, test strips, or stoppers. No food thermometer was on site.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dirty shelves and cooler
summary: Handwashing signs were needed at the front prep hand sink and inside the washroom. Storage shelves had dried food spillage, and the interior of a refrigerator and reach-in cooler had grease buildup.

headline: No covered trash can in employee restroom
summary: The employee restroom had no covered trash can. The inspector instructed the facility to provide one.

headline: Hair restraints missing; wiping cloth on cutting board
summary: Food handlers were not wearing proper hair restraints. A green wiping cloth was on a smoothie prep cooler cutting board. Staff were instructed to store cloths in sanitizing solution between uses.

headline: Soda crates used as shelving; restroom repairs
summary: Soda crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas. The all-gender restroom lacked a covered sanitary napkin receptacle, and the staff toilet door did not close. The certified manager had no allergen training proof.

headline: No hair restraints; greasy floors and corners
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Grease, food debris, and dirt were on the floor under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners of the kitchen prep areas.

headline: Cardboard on shelves; holes in basement walls
summary: Cardboard covered shelves in the basement dry storage area. Cold-hold units had spills and residue inside. The restroom lacked a covered receptacle. Holes were found in the basement prep baseboards and furnace room floor.

headline: Dusty cooler fans; leaking hot water handle
summary: Dust covered the exterior fans of two basement walk-in coolers. The hot water handle of a front bar hand sink leaked from its base when turned on. Staff were instructed to clean and repair.

headline: Blocked hand sink; sanitizer missing; prior violations
summary: A rear prep hand sink was blocked by plastic gloves and a hammer, which were removed during inspection. Utensils were washed and rinsed without sanitizing. Prior core violations included frozen meat in plastic bags and missing food handler proof.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food on freezer floor
summary: Bulk containers lacked labels, and food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and an ice scoop rested on top of the ice machine. Food was kept in plastic grocery bags in a hot holding unit.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager on site
summary: No person in charge or city-certified food manager was on site while eggs and milk were handled. No vomit cleanup supplies, food thermometer, pest logbook, or food handler certificates were available. Front door screening and sink leaks were also noted.

headline: Ice machine debris; ventilation not working
summary: Debris was encrusted inside the ice machine and must be removed. A backflow device was not located at the bar ice maker. The women's washroom ventilation was not working. A food handler lacked a certificate, and the certified manager had no allergen certificate.

headline: Crates, foil liners, and missing beard restraints
summary: Food handlers with facial hair must wear beard restraints. Wood and plastic crates were used for elevation, and foil and duct tape covered shelving. Bathroom ceiling holes and certified manager allergen proof were also needed.

headline: No manager certificate posted; no hot water at bar sink
summary: No city food manager certificate was posted on site. An eyewash station was hooked up to a hand sink and must be removed. A black substance was found in the rear ice machine and soda dispenser. The bar sink had no hot water.

headline: No certified manager on site; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: The person in charge had no food safety training proof. No city-certified manager was on site when grilled chicken and milk were handled. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site, and food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Unapproved food discarded; more than 15 flies
summary: Vacuum-packed fish, stew, and meatballs from an unlocated source were discarded, about $300 worth. More than 15 small flies were found in the bar, kitchen, and basement prep area. An outside grease bin lid would not close.

headline: Burgers held at 45F; hot water too hot
summary: Raw burgers were held at 45°F in a prep cooler, above the 41°F limit. About 15 pounds were discarded. The staff restroom hand sink measured 150°F, above the 120°F maximum. Soap was missing at the cook line sink, but staff replenished it during inspection.

headline: Ice machine mold; 30 live flies; unapproved vacuum packing
summary: The ice machine lid had pink slime and mold dripping onto ice for people to eat. About 30 live flies were found in the prep and dish area. Vacuum-sealed meats were discarded (about $150) and the machine must stop until approved.

headline: 10 live flies; cold water leak; no allergen proof
summary: Ten live small flies were found at the front bar, and the manager must remove all fly activity by reinspection. A prep area hand sink had a cold water leak. Bulk containers lacked labels, and no allergen certificate was on site.

headline: Leaks under hand sink and soda machine
summary: A leak was found under the dish area hand sink, and the self-serve soda machine was also leaking. Front prep coolers needed interior cleaning. The women's restroom fixture and floors, rear vents, and floors around heavy equipment need cleaning.

headline: Three-compartment sink hot water too unstable
summary: The three-compartment sink could not keep hot water at 110°F. Temperature rose to 119°F, then dropped to 77°F. No quat test strips were on site for the quat sanitizer used, and the manager was instructed to provide them.

headline: Prior allergen training violation not corrected
summary: A prior core violation was not corrected, because the certified manager on duty had no valid allergen training. A cooler gasket was damaged. Food debris was on cooler, freezer, and prep surfaces, and light shields had dust and debris.

headline: Dish machine rinse too cool; machine held
summary: The second-floor dish machine final rinse was 85°F, but it must reach 180°F. The machine was tagged and held, and must not be used until the equipment reaches 180°F and is reinspected by the health department.

headline: Torn gasket on upright cooler
summary: A torn gasket was found on the cooler door of a three-door upright cooler in the rear prep area. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; no health policy
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site when inspection began, and one arrived about an hour later. No employee health policy was on site. Foil covered shelving, and floors had soil and debris.

headline: Grocery bags in freezer; dead insects in light shields
summary: Grocery and garbage bags were stored inside a reach-in freezer and must be replaced with food grade bags. Rusty storage racks needed repair. Light shields above the prep and dishwashing area had dead insects and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; taquitos held too cool
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site while chicken, pizza, and taquitos were prepared and served. Taquitos were held at 111.4 to 121.2°F, below the 135°F minimum. About 3 pounds were discarded, worth about $50.

headline: No certified manager; no paper towels at hand sink
summary: The person in charge had no proof of food safety training. Food handlers prepared time and temperature control foods without a certified manager on site. No paper towels were at the prep hand sink, but a handler obtained one during inspection. Floors had dust and debris.

headline: Items on floor; no food handler training proof
summary: Stored items in the office and storage room must be raised off the floor. A reach-in cooler door handle was missing metal, exposing insulation. Unused cooking equipment must be removed from outdoor storage. No food handler training proof was provided for employees.

headline: Fly traps above prep area; floor and food storage issues
summary: Fly sticky traps were stored on the ceiling above the food prep area near the ice machine and must be removed before reinspection. A prior insect violation was not corrected. Food was stored on the walk-in floor, and no handwashing signs were posted.

headline: No certified manager on duty while food prepared
summary: The person in charge had no city food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while food was prepared and served. Light grease was on fryer bottoms, and food handlers and managers need required training.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths, slow sink drain, allergen training gaps
summary: Wiping cloths were left damp outside sanitizer on counters. The front handwashing sink drains slowly. Certified food managers lacked allergen training certificates on site. No pests noted.

headline: Ice bin interior needs cleaning
summary: The interior of the ice bin was dirty. Staff were instructed to remove the ice, clean the bin, and keep it clean at all times.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at the handwashing sinks. The certified manager on site had no allergen training. Staff were instructed to get training and keep verification on site.

headline: Dirty cooling units and debris behind equipment
summary: Inside surfaces of cooling units and prep shelving near ovens were dirty and needed cleaning. Organic matter was found in floor corners behind heavy equipment and shelving.

headline: Unlabeled cooked food; about 100 pounds discarded
summary: About 60 pounds of cooked chicken and 40 pounds of cooked steak in the walk-in cooler had no discard dates. The person in charge voluntarily discarded them. A cold-holding unit lacked a thermometer, and cooler gaskets were torn.

headline: Low water pressure at front hand sink
summary: The front exposed hand sink in the front prep area had low water pressure and must be repaired. Dust was on ceiling vents in the unisex washrooms and must be cleaned.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings; no vomit cleanup plan
summary: About 100 or more mouse droppings were found in storage, on sales floor shelves, and near the cashier. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were on site. Hot water at hand sinks measured about 57°F, below the required 100°F.

headline: About 50 live flying insects; prior pest violation uncorrected
summary: About 50 live small flying insects were found near sinks, in prep areas, and on shelves and walls. A previous pest violation was not corrected. More pest control service is needed. Dish machine interior and missing allergen certificate also noted.

headline: Band saw and meat grinder need cleaning
summary: The band saw and meat grinder had food debris and must be cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Dirty walls in prep area; missing trash lid
summary: The toilet room trash can had no cover. Walls in the rear prep and warewashing area were dirty with debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Open coffee cup; expired food handler and allergen training
summary: An open coffee cup was found on a prep table, and employees must use closed-lid containers. Food handler training and allergen training for certified managers were expired. Stained ceiling tiles also need replacing.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; soiled mop heads
summary: Food and spices were kept outside original containers without product name labels. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly, and staff were told to hang them to prevent insect breeding. The reinspection passed.

headline: No certified manager on site; no health policy
summary: No certified food manager was on site while fish, chicken, and beef were handled. No employee health policy, vomit cleanup kit, or food handler certificates were on site. Hood filters were greasy. Some bulk containers lacked labels.

headline: Dead roaches in basement; cardboard under mats
summary: Dead roaches were found on the wall and floor in the basement near the ice machine and must be removed and cleaned. Cardboard boxes were under floor mats near the three-compartment sink and cooking equipment and must be removed.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about 560 pounds discarded
summary: Cut tomatoes, onions, chicken, beef, cheese, and sour cream in the walk-in cooler were held at 45.7 to 51.4°F, above the 41°F limit. About 560 pounds, worth about $2,500, were discarded. The walk-in cooler itself measured 48°F and must be serviced.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; faucet too short
summary: The three-compartment sink was missing stoppers. The faucet did not reach all compartments, and the facility was instructed to install a faucet neck.

headline: No certified manager; past-date food discarded
summary: No city-certified manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled. About 30 pounds of past-date foods were discarded, worth about $100. An ice scoop was stored improperly, and multi-use pots were stored under an open stairwell.

headline: Reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning
summary: Reach-in cooler interiors were in need of cleaning. This was reported during a suspected food poisoning complaint inspection. The inspector instructed the staff to detail clean them.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and ice buildup in freezer
summary: A reach-in cooler gasket was torn and needs service. The dough room freezer had excessive ice buildup. One of four hood lights above the prep oven was not working.

headline: Unlabeled kimchi jars; torn cooler gasket
summary: Kimchi jars sold to go lacked labels with contact information and ingredients. A two-door cooler in the rear prep area had a torn gasket. An unused ice machine in the basement must be removed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; torn gaskets; slow hand sink
summary: Beans, rice, and flour containers in the rear prep area were unlabeled. A splash guard was needed on a wait station hand sink. Dessert cooler gaskets were torn, and a front hand sink drained slowly. Managers lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Raw chicken above lettuce; unapproved vacuum packing
summary: Raw chicken was stored directly above ready-to-eat lettuce, and about 10 pounds of lettuce were discarded. A vacuum-packaging machine was used on marinated meats without approval and was tagged. A three-compartment sink faucet leaked.

headline: Live rat, live roaches, and flies; no certified manager
summary: About 75 or more rat droppings, a live rat, and 10 live roaches were found, plus flies. No certified food manager was on duty while foods requiring temperature control were handled. A pest control operator must service the premises.

headline: About 30 rat droppings; no certified manager on site
summary: About 30 rat droppings were found in basement storage and under the staircase. No city-certified food manager was on site while beef and chicken were handled. No probe food thermometer was available. Trash and grease were behind the cook line.

headline: No certified manager until 11:30 AM; food discarded
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served. The manager arrived at 11:30 AM. About 3 gallons of food held over 7 days were discarded. Vacuum-packed raw fish without approval was discarded, and the ice machine had an unknown substance.

headline: Hand sink blocked during food prep
summary: A basement prep kitchen hand sink was blocked by a high chair and equipment during full food production. Staff were told to keep it accessible. A rice scoop was kept in standing water at room temperature.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager during prep
summary: No person in charge was present during inspection. No certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served. Coolers lacked thermometers, and bulk containers were unlabeled.

headline: No pest control contract, no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No licensed pest control operator was under contract, and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure was on site. Employee washrooms lacked handwashing signs. Mops were stored in a bucket of water. Some lights were out.

headline: Greasy floors, dusty ceilings, dirty hood filters
summary: Floors under fryers were greasy, and the floor drain needed cleaning to prevent pests. Ceiling tiles above the prep area were dusty. Filters above cooking equipment need grease and dust removed.

headline: Items on floor and milk crate shelving
summary: Items were stored on the floor in front prep and rear storage. Milk crates were used as shelving. A rear dishwashing area hand sink drained slowly and must be repaired. A working thermometer is needed in the prep cooler.

headline: No handwashing signs; damaged floors and ceilings
summary: Handwashing signs were missing in the unisex washrooms. Some ceiling tiles above the three-compartment sink were missing, and floor tiles were broken. Dirt and dust were found on walls and floors, and a restroom had no working ventilation.

headline: Expired personal food in customer cooler
summary: Out-of-date personal food was stored in a customer reach-in unit and was removed during inspection. Raw wood shelving needs sealing, and the rear utility sink lacks a backflow device. Floors under shelving were dirty.

headline: Worn cutting boards and food splatter
summary: Front prep line cutting boards were worn with deep cuts and must be replaced. The toaster oven interior needed minor cleaning, and the rear prep wall had food splatter that needed detail cleaning.

headline: Hand sinks blocked by bottles and containers
summary: A hand sink in the front prep area was blocked by a bottle, and a dish area hand sink was blocked by red containers. Staff were instructed to keep sinks accessible. A freezer gasket was torn, and food was stored in plastic grocery bags.

headline: Unwrapped straws stored improperly
summary: Unwrapped single-use beverage straws were stored improperly in the lower level at the ramen area. Straws must be wrapped or come from an approved dispenser.

headline: Leak in dishroom sink
summary: The middle basin of the three-compartment sink in the dishroom was leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Women's restroom trash can lacks lid
summary: The trash receptacle in the women's restroom had no lid or cover. The establishment was instructed to provide and maintain lidded receptacles.

headline: Cold holding units lack thermometers; washroom leak
summary: Two cold-holding units had no thermometers. Water leaked from the washroom hand sink cabinet drain. The employee restroom had no covered receptacle, and floor tiles near the rear door need repair.

headline: Hair restraints missing; washroom sink leaking heavily
summary: An employee in the prep area was not wearing a hair restraint. The toilet room sink leaked heavily from underneath. Some certified managers had no or expired allergen certificates. Vent cover, ceiling tiles, and wall panel need repair.

headline: Hand sink blocked; cold foods discarded
summary: A front prep hand sink was blocked by a rack, which the person in charge removed during inspection. Breakfast items in a display cooler (46.6 to 52.3°F) were discarded, about 9 pounds worth $50. The three-compartment sink faucet sprayed water to the side.

headline: Handwashing sinks too cold; corrected on site
summary: Handwashing sinks in the employee washrooms had water between 70.5 and 95.5°F, below the 100°F minimum. The sinks were repaired on site, and water reached 101.3 to 108.1°F afterward. Signs and other cleaning and repair items were also needed.

headline: No food handler or allergen certificates on site
summary: No food handler training certificates were on site for employees. No allergen training certificates were on site for certified food service managers. Staff were instructed to provide them.

headline: Employees without hair restraints; no food handler certificates
summary: Food handlers in the prep area did not wear hair restraints. No food handler certificates were on site, and the certified manager lacked allergen training. Floors, walls, and vents needed cleaning.

headline: Live and dead roaches found in rear prep
summary: Two live roaches were seen behind a cold-holding unit by the rear hand sink, and about four dead roaches were found. A pest control operator must service the premises on or after 2/20/26. Cardboard liners and greasy hoods also needed correction.

headline: Dirt and debris in rear prep area
summary: Light dirt and small debris were found under shelving, under the three-compartment sink, and behind the oven. The manager was told to clean these areas to prevent pests.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; discarded
summary: Cooked chicken at 50°F, cooked pork at 49°F, diced tomato at 48°F, and guacamole at 50°F were held above the 41°F limit. All were voluntarily discarded, including about 25 pounds of chicken and 30 pounds of pork.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No city-certified food manager was on duty while foods requiring temperature control were prepared, stored, and served. Food residue was on large equipment, and food splatter was on prep and dish area walls. A working metal stem thermometer was missing, a prior uncorrected violation.

headline: Hand sink panels held together with tape
summary: Front panels of a hand sink in the rear dishwash prep area were held together with blue tape. Staff were instructed to repair and maintain them.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: A food service sanitation manager did not have an allergen training certificate. Staff were instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Crates for shelving; missing sink stoppers; floor damage
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced. Three-compartment sink stoppers were missing. Floor tiles were missing or damaged near the rear exit, and some burned-out lights in the front prep area needed replacement.

headline: No certified manager; roaches and rodent droppings
summary: No city-certified manager with a valid certificate was on site while burgers, pizza, and sauce were prepared. About 22 rodent droppings and two large live roaches were noted, along with uncorrected prior violations. Floors, hood, and lighting need work.

headline: 50 to 60 live flies; no health policy or food handler certificates
summary: About 50 to 60 live small flies were found in the rear dry storage and washroom areas. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and no food handler certificates were available. Some sinks leaked during use, and cooked rice was not date marked.

headline: Unused items stored in basement
summary: Unused articles and equipment were in the basement. The manager was instructed to remove all unnecessary items to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Leaking sink drain; unlabeled container; spilled spices
summary: A three-compartment sink basin drain was leaking near the rear exit. A large storage container lacked a label. Excess seasoning spills and food debris were on the floor under the rear spice rack.

headline: Scratched cutting boards and leaking drainpipe
summary: Several cutting boards had deep scratches and stains. A drainpipe under the rear handwashing sink was leaking. Food debris was on rear prep floors, and the rear storage area was cluttered with items on the floor.

headline: Pots not inverted; exhaust hood not working
summary: Kitchen pots and pans were not stored inverted, and the walk-in cooler storage rack and deep fryer had buildup. The kitchen exhaust hood system was not working properly and must be repaired.

headline: Unapproved homemade food discarded; no food thermometer
summary: About 8 unlabeled containers of homemade Kuba from an unapproved source were discarded during the inspection. No metal stem thermometer was on site for cold foods. Cutting boards were deeply cut and no chlorine test kit was available.

headline: No certified manager while food was prepared
summary: No certified food manager was on site when the inspector arrived, while food requiring temperature control was being prepared. The ice machine at the bar had a black slimy buildup inside. Both issues were cited.

headline: Heavy ice buildup and torn cooler gasket
summary: Heavy ice buildup was found inside a service prep cooler, and it must be defrosted and cleaned. A refrigeration unit had a torn door gasket that needs repair or replacement.

headline: Expired allergen training; wet mop on floor
summary: Some certified food managers had expired allergen training. A wet mop was stored on the floor in the rear utility area and must be hung to dry.

headline: Heavy dust above food prep area
summary: Heavy dust covered the ceiling fixture and conduits above the food prep area. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Milk products too warm; about $15 discarded
summary: Milk, heavy cream, and half and half were at 44.6°F in a two-door cooler, above the 41°F limit. The manager voluntarily discarded 3 pounds. A three-compartment sink leaked from its first basin, and a hand sink drained slowly.

headline: Refrigerator interior needs cleaning
summary: The interior of a refrigerator had spills and debris that must be cleaned and kept clean.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: No allergen training certificate was found for the sanitation manager. The inspector noted the manager must provide proof.

headline: Person in charge lacks city sanitation certificate
summary: The person in charge did not have a city sanitation certificate. No valid original certificate was posted or provided for the manager on duty. At least one certified food manager must be on site when food is handled.

headline: About 80 mouse droppings found throughout facility
summary: About 80 mouse droppings were scattered in the utility room, dry storage, and hot holding area. Hood filters had grease buildup. Prior uncorrected violations included ice machine residue and debris under equipment and in corners.

headline: Person in charge lacks allergen training proof
summary: The person in charge did not have proof of allergen training during inspection. Staff were instructed to meet this requirement for all certified managers.

headline: Raw chicken wings too warm; thawed in sink
summary: About 20 pounds of raw chicken wings were at 49°F in a three-compartment sink and were discarded. Chicken was being thawed in hot water in the sink. The exterior screen door did not fit tightly. Grime and debris were on floors and walls.

headline: Ice machine debris; rust and floor repairs
summary: Ice machine interior had debris. Rusty shelves near the wok line and greasy fryer cabinets need cleaning. Floors have missing tiles, worn grout, and standing water. Floor drains under the wok line have heavy debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; food stored on floors
summary: No handwashing signs were posted near food prep sinks. Food containers were on floors and need elevating six inches. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Scoops were stored inside sugar containers. Heavy grease and debris were found on equipment and floors.

headline: Gap under rear exit door; gray water leak
summary: A gap of about 2 inches at the bottom of the rear exit door must be repaired. A leak from a gray water tank was also noted, and the operator was advised to repair it.

headline: Handwashing lapse; hot water at 66.9°F
summary: A food handler wiped his hands with a paper towel and then handled food utensils without washing, and a dishwasher touched her head before handling clean dishes. Citation issued. Restroom hand sink hot water measured 66.9°F, but 100°F is required.

headline: About 20 small flies found; door gap
summary: About 20 small flies were found throughout the facility, including near the walk-in cooler and in the garbage storage room. Priority citation issued; pest control recommended. An opening at the base of the front double doors must be sealed. Floor and ice buildup need cleaning.

headline: Knife storage, rodent-proofing, and trash cover needed
summary: The bottom of the front bar-area door must be rodent-proofed. Knives stored behind the bar sink need a rack or magnetic strip. The soda gun holder needs detail cleaning to prevent pest harborage. Washroom trash bins need lids.

headline: Toilet room door not self-closing; floors need cleaning
summary: The toilet room door at the rear of the food prep area does not self-close and needs a self-closing device. Floors around cold holding units, prep tables, and cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Gap under rear door; soiled cloths and mops
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pests. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and mops were not hung to dry. No valid food handler training was available for employees.

headline: Beard not restrained; utensils not air-dried
summary: A food handler with a long beard was not wearing a beard restraint. Multi-use deli cups were not air-dried after washing. A hand sink at the juicing station lacks a splash guard next to a clean dish rack.

headline: No manager certificate posted; handler lacks card
summary: No certified food manager certificate was posted, though chicken, beef tacos, and nachos are served. Boxed food was stored on the floor in dry storage. Foil was used as a liner on cooking equipment. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate.

headline: Slime in ice machine; gaps; grease and grime
summary: Black and pink slime was found in the ice machine's water reservoir and ice chute; priority citation issued. The rear exit door has 1-inch gaps. The outside grease container overflowed and was cited. Floors and walls are grimy, and allergen certificates were missing.

headline: Prepackaged desserts and salads lack labels
summary: Prepackaged desserts and salads in the display cooler were not properly labeled. Management was told to label all items with ingredient list, net contents, and manufacturer name and address.

headline: Mouse droppings found in donut prep room
summary: About 20 small mouse droppings were found on a hallway window ledge and in the northeast corner of the donut prep room. Staff must remove them and clean and sanitize the area. Priority citation issued. Bulk dry ingredients also lacked labels.

headline: No manager at start; sanitizer at 0 ppm; cold food
summary: No manager was on site at the start, and no City-certified food manager was present while sausage and eggs were served. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged for CDPH. Cold foods held at 47–54°F were discarded. Hand sinks lack towels and one runs at 77–83°F.

headline: No certified manager most of inspection; sink blocked
summary: No certified food manager was on site for most of the inspection. One arrived shortly after it began but left before it ended. A rear prep hand sink was blocked by a giant dish; an employee removed it on site. Broken wall tiles under the sink need repair.

headline: Ice scoop stored unsafely; allergen certificates missing
summary: An ice scoop was stored on a wall with its food-contact surface exposed; staff were shown proper storage. Certified food managers on site had no proof of allergen training certificate. They were told to obtain it.

headline: Improper temperatures; food discarded; dead roaches
summary: Hot food at 65–111°F and cold food at 52–59°F were held unsafely; the person in charge discarded them, and the cold unit was tagged. Dead roaches were on the floor behind two cooling units and must be removed. Other issues include inadequate hot water pressure at a hand sink.

headline: Dishwasher too cool; vacuum packing without variance
summary: The high-temperature dishwasher reached only 135°F; 160°F is required. It was tagged and must not be used until the Chicago Department of Public Health reinspects it. Vacuum-packed foods were made without an approved variance. Machine tagged; about 20 lbs of food discarded.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; hair restraint missing
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine. Citation issued, and the machine was tagged. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint and must wear one.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: Black mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine, which is used for customer drinks; priority citation issued. The prep cooler lacks an air thermometer. Three salad garnishes were left uncovered next to the pizza oven.

headline: No valid manager certificate; no vomit procedure
summary: No person in charge held a valid City food manager certificate while chicken, beans, and deli meat were prepared and served. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or equipment was on site. Bulk flour and rice were unlabeled. Floors and corners were dirty.

headline: Soda dispenser and floors need detailed cleaning
summary: The soda dispenser left of the bar needs detailed cleaning. Floors in the rear kitchen, storage, bar, and soda/coffee areas under and around equipment also need detailed cleaning.

headline: Food service manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: A food service sanitation manager did not have a food allergen training certificate. The operator was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: No handwashing signs; ice scoops stored in bins
summary: No handwashing signs or posters were near sinks in employee washrooms. Ice scoops were stored inside ice bins in the front bar and must be kept in a clean container. No proof of food handler training was provided for required employees.

headline: No covered feminine hygiene receptacles
summary: No covered receptacles for feminine hygiene products were in the women's and staff restroom. A food service sanitation manager lacked a food allergen training certificate. The manager was instructed to meet both requirements.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: One certified food service manager did not have allergen awareness training at the time of inspection. The person in charge was told to make sure all managers obtain it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; dirty floors
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. Loose debris, dirt, and dust were on floors and corners. Burned-out light bulbs were in the fruit and vegetable prep area.

headline: Damaged floor base coving near dish area
summary: Damaged base coving on the dish area floor, near the hand-washing sink, was noted. The manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: Six live roaches; bait stations hold dead roaches
summary: About 6 live roaches were on walls by a rear prep hand sink and behind the front juice dispenser. Bait stations under the rear three-compartment sink held dead roaches. Priority citation issued. Also no paper towels at sinks and overflowing dumpster.

headline: Food debris on equipment and floors; training gaps
summary: Food debris was on exterior cooking equipment and accumulated on prep-area floors. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate. Several certified food managers lacked allergen training certificates. The person in charge was told to correct these.

headline: Over 30 rat droppings in basement; door gaps
summary: Over 30 rat droppings were under basement storage shelving and in a basement corner. Additional pest control service is needed; priority citation issued. The revolving front door has open gaps at the bottom. Ice scoops were stored on ice in the front bar.

headline: Broken floor tiles; several handlers untrained
summary: Broken and missing floor tiles in the front coffee prep area and rear prep and dish area must be replaced. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates. Management was instructed that all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: 35 live flies found; pest control required
summary: About 35 small live flies were found on walls and ceiling tiles in the rear storage and dishwashing area. Staff must remove them, detail clean affected areas, and call pest control. Priority citation issued. Coolers also lack thermometers.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings found in basement
summary: Over 10 rat droppings were on a ledge near containers on the basement stairway, and over 20 mouse droppings were on the floor and pallets in basement storage. Manager must call an exterminator and clean all areas. Priority citation issued.

headline: 100+ live flies in basement; epoxy floor peeling
summary: About 100 or more live small flies were crawling on and inside a dirty towel storage cabinet and flying in the basement. Pest control service recommended; priority citation issued. Epoxy flooring is peeling on the first-floor cook serving line.

headline: Personal belongings stored with utensils; raw wood
summary: Employees' personal belongings were stored with single-service and multi-use utensils and must be kept in a designated area. Raw wood on the front counter and support beams must be sealed so it is non-porous and cleanable.

headline: About 6 dead roaches found near entrance and register
summary: About 6 dead roaches were found near the front entrance, in a corner by the front prep hand sink, and in the cabinet below the cash register. Staff must remove them and clean and sanitize the areas. Also: ice buildup in freezers and a damaged backflow device.

headline: Food debris in coolers; dusty vents
summary: Reach-in coolers and freezer had food debris and spillage inside. Weather stripping on the rear side door is torn, and a small leak was found at the three-compartment sink. Employee restroom door lacks a self-closing device. Fan vents are heavily dusted.

headline: Cake cooler too warm; hair restraints missing
summary: The two-door cake cooler ran at 46°F. Cheese, chicken sausage, and cooked egg measured 44.9–46.8°F, above the 41°F limit (about 4.5 lbs, valued at $49). Priority citation issued. Employees were handling food without hair restraints.

headline: Dirty ice bin; foam-like caulk; dusty pipes
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning and was ordered emptied and cleaned. Refuse area was littered with crates and trash. Foam-like caulk on walls and around pipes must be resurfaced. Dust on pipes, fans, and light shields needs cleaning.

headline: No hair restraints; expired allergen certificate
summary: Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution. Fryers had thick grease and charred food, and the ice cream freezer had thick ice. The manager's allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Front prep cooler missing thermometer
summary: The front prep cooler had no thermometer. The operator was instructed to provide one.

headline: Half-inch door gaps; no test strips; training missing
summary: Both dining room doors and the kitchen rear door have half-inch gaps at the bottom that need tight-fitting seals. No test strips for sanitizer or temperature indicators for the dish machine. No food handler training proof for required employees. Citation issued.

headline: Cold food held too warm; walk-in cooler too warm
summary: Many cold foods, including ham, beans, goat, chicken, beef, shrimp, and salsa, were held at 46–58.3°F, above the 41°F limit. The walk-in measured 49.8°F. Corrected on site: about 120 lbs ($1,500) was discarded. Citations issued. Also unlabeled self-serve empanadas.

headline: Live roach in spill kit; flies; no 3-compartment sink
summary: A live cockroach was crawling in the bodily fluid spill kit in the rear prep area. About 7 small live flies were in the front prep area, and 5 large flies were in the restroom, hallway, and rear prep. No test strips or three-compartment sink. Pest control required; citations issued.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the prep and storage areas. They must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor that is easy to clean.

headline: Dusty plates and heavy grease found in kitchen
summary: Serving plates on kitchen shelves were not inverted, risking dust. Heavy grease and dirt were found inside the exhaust hood, on pipes, and on filters above cooking equipment. Floors along walls and under equipment need cleaning.

headline: Oil uncovered; bowls submerged in flour
summary: Plastic bowls were submerged in a flour storage container, and an oil container was uncovered. Prep coolers lack ambient thermometers. A door has a small opening at the lower left and needs rodent-proofing. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: No sanitation-trained manager; certificate missing
summary: No person in charge had food service sanitation training, and no original City sanitation certificate was on site; citation issued. Previous priority violations were not corrected, including no test kit, expired food handler certificates, and no allergen training. Toilet room ceiling tiles are stained.

headline: Wet cloths on sushi boards; plates facing up
summary: Wet wiping cloths were stored on sushi cutting boards and must go in sanitizing solution. Residue built up inside the ice machine, and an ice scoop was stored in the ice. Plates on sushi bar shelves must be inverted. Employee jackets were stored on food racks.

headline: No health policy or vomit procedure; sneeze guard missing
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea procedure was on site; both priority violations, no citation issued. A sneeze guard is missing at the front coffee counter and a splashguard at the front prep sink. Test strips for quaternary sanitizer are missing.

headline: No manager; sanitizer at 0 ppm; fruit flies found
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and burgers were prepared. Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine. Over 30 fruit flies were in the dishwashing area; priority citation issued. Allergen training certificate was also missing.

headline: Floors need detail cleaning
summary: Floor in the rear storage area under shelving and in the front prep area under the lower reach-in coolers needs detail cleaning to prevent possible pest or insect activity.

headline: Knives left on prep table; grease and drain debris
summary: Knives were stored on top of a prep table instead of in proper storage. Deep fryer openings had grease and food debris. Drains had dirt and debris. Cooking equipment sides had heavy grease. Damaged wall coving needs repair.

headline: About 50 rodent droppings found; no certificates
summary: About 50 rodent droppings were found under the bar and in the storage area. Staff must remove and sanitize them; priority citation issued. The person in charge lacks a City sanitation certificate. Food handler and allergen certificates were not on site.

headline: No food handler certificates; one-compartment sink needed
summary: No food handler certificates were on site; one-month grace period noted for new hires. Bulk food was unlabeled and some food was stored in tin cans. A one-compartment sink is needed for drinks. Greasy hood and filters, and a blown bulb above the stove, need attention.

headline: Leaking faucet; damaged floor tiles
summary: A leaking faucet at the first-floor three-compartment sink must be repaired. Damaged floor tiles in front of the cook line and under the sink must be replaced or smoothly repaired for cleanability.

headline: Faded labels; shelving debris; no restroom lid
summary: Bulk ingredient containers in the rear storage area had faded labels. Cooler shelving had a buildup of food debris. The restroom had no covered receptacle. Staff were instructed to correct these items.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; fryer grease; floor grout
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the men's room sink. Grease buildup was found inside and outside fryer cabinets. Floor tiles in prep and dish areas need grout and maintenance.

headline: Grease on floors; summary report not posted
summary: Grease and black buildup were on floors near fryers, under the flat-top grill, and under cold holding units. A damaged wall panel and chipped paint near the mop sink need repair. The sanitation manager lacks allergen training proof. Summary report was posted on site.

headline: Mouse and rat droppings found; pest control needed
summary: About 15 mouse droppings were under shelving at the front counter, and about 8 rat droppings were under the basement staircase. Cat feces and an open cat food can were also found. Staff must clean and sanitize. Pest control recommended. Priority citation issued.

headline: No certified manager present; drain leaking
summary: No City-certified food manager was present while chicken at 168°F was prepared and served; priority citation issued. Several food handlers had expired training certificates. The three-compartment sink drain is leaking behind the bar. Torn gaskets are on a prep cooler.

headline: No handwashing signage; repeat violations noted
summary: No handwashing signage at the exposed rear prep sink. Rusty walk-in basement racks must be cleaned. Repeat violations include milk crates for shelving, unfinished wood, clutter that can hide pests, and managers without allergen certificates. Priority citation issued.

headline: Dirt on walk-in floors; light dirt in chip area
summary: Walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer floors had a buildup of dirt and debris. The floor by the chips near the front window had light dirt and small debris. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Dirty can opener; allergen training missing for all
summary: A large can opener needs cleaning or a new blade. All sanitation certificate holders lacked allergen certificates. The operator was instructed to obtain and maintain them.

headline: Bulk food containers not labeled
summary: Some bulk food, such as flour and sugar, was not labeled. The operator must provide labels.

headline: Missing thermometers; hair restraint and utensil issues
summary: Thermometers were missing at the front hot-holding unit and rear prep cooler. A male food handler lacked a hair restraint. Small cups were used as dispensing utensils and multi-use utensils were not stored inverted. Walk-in wire racks were dirty.

headline: No hand soap; hot water off; undercooked egg advisory missing
summary: No handwashing cleanser at the rear prep sink or employee restroom; priority citation issued. Hot water did not run at two hand sinks. Some raw or undercooked egg items lacked a consumer advisory. Stock pots too large for the sink lack a written washing procedure.

headline: Food stored on floors; ceiling and wall repairs needed
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, prep, and storage areas; manager was told to elevate them at least six inches. Broken ceiling tiles, foam-like caulk around pipes, and a missing light shield were also noted.

headline: Grease buildup on equipment; floor clutter
summary: Excessive grease and food debris must be cleaned from fryers, wheel bases, coolers, service counter shelving, rolling carts, and prep tables. Articles on the floor and against walls in the hallway storage closet must be elevated or organized.

headline: Dirty floors; food handlers lack certificates
summary: Floors in corners, under storage racks, cooking equipment, and in the drive-thru were dirty with debris. Food handlers on site had no food handler certificates. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: No food manager on site during TCS food prep
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while cheese, milk, and ice cream were being prepared. A manager must be present at all times with a posted certificate. One employee lacked a food handler certificate. No allergen training was on site. Citation issued.

headline: Food handler and allergen training proof missing
summary: No proof of food handler training was on site for any food handler. No City-certified food service manager had proof of allergen training. Operator must obtain these and keep physical records on site at all times.

headline: No manager on site; hot food too cool
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were handled. Hot-held foods at 106.8–122.8°F were discarded (about 15 lbs, $200). A bakery hand sink was blocked by cleaning equipment; priority citation issued. Rear door gap and unlabeled uncovered items also noted.

headline: Incomplete vomit cleanup kit; leaking dish-area sink
summary: The vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit and written procedure were incomplete. The dishwashing area handwashing sink leaks during use and must be repaired. No utility sink was on site. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Multiple repairs; leaks; training gaps
summary: Repairs are needed for leaking pipes at the bar hand sink and under the coffee dump sink. Handwashing signs are missing in restroom stalls. Worn gaskets, pitted cutting boards, rusty shelves, and crates used for storage must be fixed. Food handler training is missing for new employees.

headline: Frozen chicken thawed improperly; heavy grease buildup
summary: About 60 lbs of frozen chicken was thawing improperly on a rolling cart and must thaw under refrigeration or running water. Cooking equipment, prep tables, and bulk bins were heavily encrusted with food and grease. Cooling units lack thermometers.

headline: Two handwashing sinks missing; restroom issues
summary: Two handwashing sinks were missing in the common washroom area, a priority violation. Openings at the base of the front entrance door need sealing against pests. Restroom stall doors lack self-closing devices and the washroom has no mechanical ventilation.

headline: Damaged sales-floor ceiling and unsealed outlet holes
summary: The sales-floor ceiling is damaged, and there are holes around outlets. The person in charge must repair the ceiling to be smooth and cleanable and cap or cover all utility holes.

headline: Dish machine display error; food stored on floors
summary: The high-temperature dish machine display read ERROR and did not show wash water temperature; priority citation issued. Food was stored on floors and presets were exposed. Three employees lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Rice held out of temperature without required proof
summary: Rice for poke bowls was held out of temperature with no sushi rice letter or pH meter on site. Operator must provide a food lab letter showing pH 4.6 or less, dated within 5 years, or a pH meter. Priority citation issued.

headline: Sanitizer at 0 ppm; sink not set up
summary: The three-compartment sink was not set up correctly, and sanitizer measured 0 ppm while dishes were being washed. Staff switched to chlorine sanitizer because the dispensing machine needs service. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: No handwashing signs; handler lacked training proof
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at the front or rear hand sinks. A female food handler lacked proof of food handler training. The operator must provide signs and training proof for all food handlers.

headline: Food on floors and soda crates; missing fan cover
summary: Food was stored on floors in retail and walk-in areas and on soda crates. Shelving at least six inches off the floor is required throughout the facility. A washroom ceiling fan cover is missing and must be replaced.

headline: Crates used as shelving in kitchen
summary: Black and red crates were used as shelving throughout the kitchen prep and storage areas. They must be replaced with non-porous, easy-to-clean shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No person in charge; handwashing sink blocked
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was present while sandwiches and tuna were prepared and served; priority citation issued. A front prep hand sink was blocked by mixing cups, and paper towels were missing at prep and dish sinks. About 4 lbs of mislabeled food ($111) was discarded.

headline: Dirty gaskets, unlabeled bulk, and kitchen grime
summary: Bulk ingredient containers were unlabeled. Gaskets on prep coolers, the walk-in, and freezers were torn and dirty. A pipe leak under a hand sink and a non-working washbowl in the women's restroom need repair. Heavy grime was found in several areas.

headline: No handwashing signs; uncovered fryer with grease
summary: Handwashing sinks in the prep area and toilet rooms lacked signage. Bulk dry ingredients in the basement were not labeled with food names. An uncovered deep fryer with grease was noted while the facility was not operating; staff were told to cover it.

headline: Hard-to-turn hot water knob in women's restroom
summary: The hot water knob on the east-side handwashing sink in the women's restroom is hard to turn on and off and needs adjustment. No proof of allergen training was provided for employees holding sanitation certificates.

headline: No sanitation certificate; several required plans missing
summary: The person in charge lacks a City of Chicago sanitation certificate. Also missing: an employee health policy, a vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure with spill kit, food thermometers, and test strips for the three-compartment sink. All must be provided.

headline: No handwashing signs; debris under dish machine
summary: No handwashing signage was posted at the front prep and dishwashing sinks. Buildup and debris were found under the high-temperature dish machine and under a hallway shelving unit. Both areas must be cleaned.

headline: Light grease in fryer; dusty vents
summary: A small amount of grease was at the bottom of the fryer, and light dust was on some ceiling vents and the washroom ceiling vent. Staff were instructed to clean these areas.

headline: Door gaps and missing lid; training needed
summary: A gap along the bottom of the front and rear doors must be made tight-fitting to prevent insect and pest entry. A lid is needed on the basement sump pump. All employees must have food handler training.

headline: Brisket and beef held above safe cold temperature
summary: Brisket at 48.0°F and cheesesteak beef at 55°F were held above the 41°F cold-holding limit. The manager discarded about 40 lbs of brisket and 5 lbs of beef (about $225). Citation issued. No handwashing signs, test strips, or food handler training.

headline: Grease under counter; corrected on site
summary: Grease and debris were found under the front serving counter at the ramen station. Staff were told to clean it, and this was corrected on site.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: A food service sanitation manager did not have a food allergen training certificate. The operator was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings; priority pest violation
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were found along the wall base in the kitchen and in the water heater closet. Pest control is inadequate. The manager was told to eliminate rodent activity in all affected areas; pest control service recommended. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Cold food and display cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: Cold foods were held too warm: eggs at 50.5°F, raw chicken at 47.5°F, and dairy at 48.2°F. The walk-in measured 48.9°F and the display cooler 45.5°F; both were tagged. About 245 lbs of food, valued at $3,000, was discarded.

headline: No service sink on premises
summary: No service sink was found on the premises. The operator must provide a service sink with a backflow prevention device and maintain it.

headline: Unused equipment and clutter; restroom doors lack closers
summary: Unused equipment and a walk-in cooler packed with bagged items must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Neither restroom door has a fully installed self-closing device. Broken food prep floor tiles need replacing. A certified manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Rusty walk-in racks; expired manager allergen training
summary: Wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler have chipped paint and rust and must be repainted or replaced. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Black mold-like residue in ice machine
summary: A mold-like black substance was found on the bottom of the ice machine. The ice is not for human consumption. Broken and cracked floor tiles along the dishwashing room wall must be repaired.

headline: Thawed fish labeled frozen; plumbing repairs needed
summary: Reduced-oxygen packaged tilapia labeled to stay frozen until use was stored thawed. The operator was told to keep it frozen or remove it from packaging before thawing. A hand sink faucet leaks, and a men's toilet flush handle needs repair.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings found on floors
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were on the floor of the rear storage area and near the front prep chest freezer, a priority citation. Additional pest control service is needed. Food containers were stored on the walk-in floor, and food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Pink substance in ice machine; missing training certificates
summary: A pink substance is starting inside the ice machine near the ice bin, and ice is for human consumption. A cutting board was stored on the sink backsplash. No food handler or allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: No health policy, probe thermometer, or training records
summary: No signed employee health policy or pest control logbook was on site, and no probe thermometer was available for food temperatures. No food handler training was provided. A prior allergen training violation was not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: Equipment sides need dust and grease cleaning
summary: The sides of cooking and non-cooking equipment need detail cleaning to remove dust and grease. The operator was told to clean all areas.

headline: Rodent droppings found; eggs held too warm
summary: About 15–30 rodent droppings were found behind the stoves in the food prep area, a priority citation. Four dozen eggs held at 61.1–67.1°F outside were discarded. Hot water was out until the manager replaced the pilot.

headline: Dirty produce crates; items on toilet room floor
summary: Produce crates stored inside cooling units have dirt and debris on exterior surfaces and must be cleaned or replaced. Excess items on the toilet room floor must be removed, with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Crates, rusty racks, and bicycles must be removed
summary: Plastic crates cannot be used to elevate food in the walk-in cooler. Rusty shelving in the small coleslaw cooler must be replaced, and employees must not store bicycles in the rear dry food storage room.

headline: About 60 live flying insects; prior violation uncorrected
summary: About 60 live small flying insects were found across the bar, food prep, restrooms, and dining areas. A prior priority violation for pests was not corrected, and additional pest control is needed. Dish machine, walls, and floors also need cleaning.

headline: Non-food ice machine shares garage with vehicle
summary: A non-consumption ice machine is stored in the same garage as a vehicle. Food and related items must be protected from contamination. The backflow device on its water intake line is inadequate and must be installed and maintained.

headline: Undated shellfish tags; door openings; test kit fixed
summary: Shellstock tags from May through August 2024 lacked the date when the last shellfish was sold or served. Doors have openings at the base that must be sealed. A missing sanitizer test kit was delivered and corrected during inspection.

headline: Syrup spill inside soda machine cabinet
summary: Syrup spilled inside the cabinet under the soda machine. The person in charge must clean and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and soup, foods that need temperature control, were handled, and the person in charge lacked a certificate. A citation was issued. Prior violations were not fixed: no covered restroom bin and a broken washroom vent.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; dirty walk-in floor
summary: The two-door front prep cooler needs a visible, working thermometer. Dirt and food debris under shelving in the walk-in cooler must be cleaned, and dust on a ceiling vent above the soft drink cooler needs cleaning.

headline: Meat in grocery bags; door gap; leaking drain
summary: Meat was stored in plastic grocery bags in freezers, which is not food-grade. A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door must be rodent-proofed. A prep hand sink drain leaks, and the outside grease container is dirty.

headline: No food handler or allergen training certificates
summary: No food handler training certificates were on site. Certified food managers had no allergen training on site. The operator was instructed to provide and maintain both.

headline: Rust and black residue in lobby soda machine
summary: Rust and black residue inside the lobby soda machine need deep cleaning. Basement storage sits under waste pipes, and a drain hose sits directly in a floor drain below flood line, requiring an air gap. Holes and gaps in basement walls and ceiling need sealing.

headline: Hand sink water too cold; pest log outdated
summary: Hot water at a bar hand sink measured 73.0°F; the required minimum is 100°F, a priority citation. The pest control log had no reports since January 2024, so a citation was issued. The ice bin and dirty vent also need cleaning.

headline: Open wall in dry storage; allergen certificate missing
summary: An open wall in the rear dry storage area must be closed to prevent pest harborage. No allergen certificate for the certified manager was on site. The person in charge must provide one and keep it on site.

headline: Rodent-proofing and handwashing signs needed
summary: Handwashing signs are needed at all hand sinks. The rear exit door needs its bottom sealed for rodent-proofing, and the kitchen window needs a screen or must be kept closed. Sink stoppers are missing, and hood filters need detail cleaning.

headline: No certified manager on site; no soap; no pest logbook
summary: No certified food manager with an original certificate was on site while open. The food prep hand sink had no soap, and no pest control logbook was on site. Debris was found in cabinets and on floors. No citation was issued.

headline: Missing hand sink signage; no food handler training
summary: The prep and warewashing hand sink lacked handwashing signage. The three-compartment sink drain leaks and needs repair. A food handler had no food handler training or certificate on site.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler training records
summary: No certified food manager was on premises while TCS foods were handled, a priority citation. No proof of food handler training was provided, and the ice bin was not clean. Clutter, a shared refuse area with boxes, and deeply cut cutting boards were also noted.

headline: Raw wood surfaces; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Raw wood surfaces at the front counter and prep area must be sealed smooth. Debris was on the floor and equipment in the furnace room. A prior violation for missing allergen training for the food manager was not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: Cardboard and foil liners; standing basement water
summary: Cardboard and foil above a microwave and under small fryers must be removed to avoid giving insects hiding places. Standing water in the basement near the deep freezer must be cleaned up.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at restroom sink
summary: The hand sink in the toilet room had no handwashing signage. The operator must provide and maintain it.

headline: Over 100 rodent droppings found in basement
summary: Over 100 rodent droppings were found in the basement, including under stairs and behind a storage door, a priority citation. Prior core violations were not fixed: ice machine calcium buildup, a broken freezer lid, frost, and clutter. The certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No backflow devices; basement walls not smooth
summary: No backflow prevention devices were found at the ice machine water line or mop sink faucet, and they must be provided where they can be serviced. Basement food storage walls must be sealed to be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Cooler at 55°F; no pest control logbook
summary: A 3-door cooler measured 55°F ambient air, above the 41°F limit. All TCS food was removed and the cooler was tagged. No pest control logbook was on site, and expired food handler certificates from earlier reports were not corrected.

headline: Dirty walk-in floors; broken wall tile
summary: Walk-in refrigerator and freezer floors have dirt and debris under shelving and in corners. A broken wall tile in the dish area and a loose seal at the three-compartment sink need repair. Floors under sinks and behind cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Hand sink turned off; no soap or paper towels
summary: A rear dishwashing hand sink was turned off and inaccessible, a priority citation. The prep hand sink had no soap, and exposed sinks lacked paper towels. Food was stored on the walk-in floor, and milk crates were used for elevation.

headline: Missing hair restraints; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Food handlers were preparing food without hair restraints. Milk crates used as shelving in the walk-in freezer must be removed and replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Drains into hand sink; no grease trap; wall holes
summary: Two drain lines empty into the rear bar hand sink and must be moved to a floor drain. The basement three-compartment sink lacks a grease trap. Holes in the first-floor dishwashing area walls need smooth repair.

headline: Basement storage, restroom door, and ceiling repairs needed
summary: Dry storage items must be raised off the floor. The restroom door needs a self-closing device. Basement openings above refrigeration and shelving must be sealed, and peeling paint and water-damaged ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: Greasy fryers, rusting ceiling, greasy ventilation filters
summary: Heavy grease covers the sides of the deep fryers. Rusting ceiling and peeling paint above the meat slicing area must be repaired to prevent contamination. Grease buildup on the ventilation system and filters must be cleaned.

headline: No valid certificate; food on floor; missing date labels
summary: No valid city food sanitation manager certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. Prepared TCS foods lacked date labels, and food was stored on the floor and uncovered. Refrigerators lacked thermometers, and a 1/4-inch gap is at the rear exit door.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; two handlers lack training
summary: Employee restrooms had no handwashing signs. Two food handlers had no food handler training, and sanitation managers lacked proof of allergen training. A hood light was out and floor grout was missing.

headline: Unlabeled containers; dusty floors throughout
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels with common food names. Loose debris, dirt, and dust buildup on floors and corners throughout the facility need detail cleaning, and cleaning frequency must increase.

headline: Unprotected utensils; food on floor; sink too small
summary: Food was stored on the floor in a small closet and the walk-in cooler. Table linens touched pasta in the prep cooler, and clean utensils at customer tables were unprotected. The consumer advisory was posted during inspection.

headline: No certified manager on duty; improper thawing
summary: No certified food manager was on duty when TCS foods were handled, a citation was issued; the manager arrived about 20 minutes later. Mango ice cream was improperly thawed, and food was stored on the floor. A repeat splash guard violation was cited.

headline: Door gap and ceiling hole could let pests in
summary: A 1/4-inch gap on the right side of the rear exit door must be sealed. A hole in the ceiling above back storage must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Unused milk crates on floors must be removed.

headline: Loose hand sink faucet; no accessible utility sink
summary: The front prep hand sink faucet is loose. Chipping paint above the three-compartment sink must be fixed. The utility sink is inaccessible because of construction, so a new utility service sink must be installed.

headline: Rusty walk-in shelves; leak; dirty restroom
summary: Rusty shelves inside the walk-in cooler must have rust removed or be repainted. A pipe under the dishwashing hand sink is leaking and needs repair. The employee washroom on the pizza prep side needs cleaning.

headline: Stained ceiling tiles over dining tables
summary: Several badly stained ceiling tiles above customer tables must be replaced. Dirt and debris behind a front freezer need cleaning, and greasy hood filters must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled containers; grease buildup; no allergen training
summary: Food and spices removed from original containers lacked name labels. Grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, coolers, and shelving, and floors along the hot food line were heavily soiled. The certified manager had no allergen training on site.

headline: Old violations uncorrected; oven lacks hood
summary: Core violations from a 2022 report were not corrected. The espresso machine has no backflow prevention device. A large electric oven has no hood and must be given one or removed. A citation was issued.

headline: No employee health policy; no vomit cleanup plan
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. No written procedure or adequate supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events in the mobile food vehicle were available. Both were priority issues, and the operator was told to provide them.

headline: Rotting wood prep tables in butcher area
summary: Damaged, discolored, rotted, and unsealed wooden prep tables in the butcher area must be replaced with smooth, easily cleaned surfaces for meat preparation.

headline: Mouse droppings and dead mice found throughout
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were in rear storage, about 75 along basement walls, and more in the boiler room and stairs. Seven dead mice were on basement glue boards. No valid city food sanitation certificate was on site.

headline: Dead roaches and unsafe food temperatures found
summary: Dead roaches were on floors behind dining room coolers. A pork roast held at 71.2°F in an unturned rotisserie was discarded. The far rear prep room has no hand sink, and the cook-line sink had no soap. Garbage overflowed into the alley.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners and dirty floors
summary: Cardboard boxes line the walk-in cooler shelves and must be removed. Floors throughout need detail cleaning, especially along wall bases, under greasy cooking equipment, and near the three-compartment sink.

headline: Cut cutting board; greasy hood filters
summary: A cutting board stored above the three-compartment sink has deep cuts and stains and must be restored or replaced. Dust and grease are on the hood filters and need cleaning.

headline: Storage clutter; sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Unused equipment and unnecessary articles were stored in the storage area and must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. The food service sanitation manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Pest service only yearly; plumbing gaps found
summary: Pest control was done only once a year, with the latest reports dated 2023, and a citation was issued. The utility sink and water dispenser lack backflow devices, and there is no grease trap. A wiping cloth was left on the sink edge.

headline: Uncovered ice, floor-stored dish racks, freezer buildup
summary: Ice in the bar bins was uncovered and must be covered. Dish racks were stored on the floor. Pink residue was found in the basement ice machine, excess ice covered the basement walk-in freezer, and cooler gaskets are torn.

headline: No employee health policy; missing filters and lighting
summary: No employee health policy was on site, a priority violation. A rear hand sink lacked handwashing signage. The walk-in freezer has inadequate light and a missing light shield, and the ventilation hood is missing filters.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; door and wall gaps
summary: Handwashing signs are needed at the front bar hand sink and in the rear washrooms. The bottom of a side door leading to the washrooms must be rodent-proofed. Holes in the wall around the rear prep area must be sealed.

headline: Roaches and flying insects found in prep areas
summary: Several roaches were crawling on walls, floors, and inside a rodenticide bag in prep and storage areas, a priority citation. Numerous flying insects were in restrooms, prep, and storage, and dead roaches were on an office glue board. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Loose toilet-room faucet; peeling baseboards
summary: A toilet room faucet is loose and must be secured. Baseboards are peeling in rear storage near the rear exit door and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No employee health policy or food handler training
summary: No written employee health policy and no food handler training certificates were on site. Wiping cloths were stored improperly in the dishwashing area. Old equipment must be removed and light bulb covers provided.

headline: No certified manager while chicken served; food on floor
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served to the public, a priority citation. Soy sauce buckets and a variety of meat were stored on floors, which must be 6 inches up. Heavy grease and food debris are under cooking equipment and coolers.

headline: Deep freezer needs defrosting and cleaning
summary: The interior of the deep freezer has ice buildup and debris. The operator must defrost and clean it.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; dirty sinks and equipment
summary: Bulk flour, sugar, and other food had no labels. Food containers were not stored inverted. The shelf above the hand sink, cooking equipment, and sinks were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Front door gap, missing dumpster lid, dirty floors
summary: Front door weatherstripping is worn at the bottom and must be replaced to prevent pest entry. The outside dumpster is missing its lid, a priority citation. Ice buildup in the ice cream freezer, dirty restroom fixtures, and sticky floors need cleaning.

headline: Unsealed wood shelving in purchasing area
summary: Raw, unsealed wood shelving in the purchasing area must be sealed to make it smooth and cleanable.

headline: Spills and debris on coolers and floors
summary: Spills and debris were found on interior and exterior cooler surfaces and a washroom vanity cabinet. Floors in prep, storage, dishwashing, and washroom areas also had spills and debris, and the manager was told to clean them.

headline: Splattered food on walls behind equipment
summary: Splattered food debris on the wall behind cooking equipment and the rear three-compartment sink must be cleaned.

headline: Live roaches and unsafe food temperatures found
summary: Five live cockroaches were in grease trays at the grill line. Chicken held at 109.0°F and sushi at 51.7–54.4°F were discarded, along with raw chicken at 54.0°F. The dish machine had 0.0 ppm chlorine and was tagged out of use.

headline: Clean cooking equipment surfaces where needed
