summary: The inspector instructed the operator to clean cooking equipment surfaces where needed.

headline: Exposed concrete wall near sinks
summary: An exposed concrete wall beside the handwashing and three-compartment sinks must be sealed so it is smooth, easily cleanable, and nonabsorbent.

headline: Unlabeled bulk flour; no food handler training proof
summary: Bulk flour and sugar in rear dry storage were unlabeled. Cardboard lined the chest freezer storing frozen beef and must be removed. A mop stored in a rear closet was not drying properly, and no proof of food handler training was provided.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; cups used as scoops
summary: Food was stored on the floor inside the walk-in cooler. Plastic and paper cups were used as scoops for coleslaw, sugar, and salt. Grocery bags were used for food storage, and bulk containers lacked labels.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving throughout
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No certificate posted; no food handler training
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was posted, and no food handler training was on site. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, and the food service manager had no allergen training. The pest control logbook was missing, and the front door has a gap.

headline: Walk-in cooler floors need cleaning
summary: Walk-in cooler floors need cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: No certified manager on site; no food handler training
summary: No certified person in charge was present, and no certified manager was on site when TCS foods were served. Food was stored on the floor, and there was no pest control logbook. Door gaps and milk crates used as shelving were also noted.

headline: No certified manager; sanitizer machine out of use
summary: No certified food manager was present while chicken, potatoes, and burgers were prepared. The bar dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged out of use. Hand sinks were blocked and lacked towels and soap; some items were removed during the inspection.

headline: Hands not washed between tasks; faucets run too briefly
summary: A food employee wiped a prep table, returned the cloth to sanitizer, and put on new gloves without washing hands, a priority citation. Timed faucets in the rear prep area must run at least 15 seconds. A female food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Missing handwashing signs, uninverted dishes, torn gasket
summary: No handwashing signs at hand sinks. Plates and bowls were not inverted after sanitizing and air drying. A torn door gasket on the rear walk-in freezer must be replaced.

headline: Beans held at 45°F; ice machine black slime
summary: Cooked refried beans were held at 45.1–46°F in a reach-in cooler and discarded; cold food must be 41°F or below. Black slime dripped from the ice machine into the ice. No valid city food sanitation certificate was posted for the manager on duty.

headline: Can opener needs cleaning; washroom faucet leaks
summary: The can opener blade at the prep table must be cleaned. The women's washroom faucet leaks when hot water runs, and the operator was told to repair it.

headline: Missing food handler training; greasy grill hood
summary: A male food handler had no food handler training on site and must provide proof. Grease buildup on the grill-area hood must be cleaned. Personal care items were stored above food prep, and plates were not stored inverted.

headline: 20 or more live flies in dish and dining areas
summary: About 20 or more live small flies were found in the dishwashing area, bar, and dining area, a priority citation. Food and paper goods were stored on the floor of the outside walk-in, and cups and bowls were stored inside bulk food containers.

headline: Missing thermometers and drainboard; broken backflow
summary: Two coolers lack hanging thermometers. The three-compartment sink has no drainboard. The mop sink backflow device is not working and must be repaired. Basement food storage walls and ceiling need sealing or drywall.

headline: About 50 live flying insects in both prep areas
summary: About 50 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings of both food prep areas, a priority citation requiring more pest control. No valid city sanitation certificate was posted, and no inspection summary was displayed to the public.

headline: No certified manager on site; no valid certificate
summary: No person in charge with a valid city food sanitation certificate was designated, a priority violation. No certified manager was on site, and no valid certificate was posted, so a citation was issued.

headline: Live flies found; outdoor beef prep discarded
summary: About 20 live small and large flies were found in the rear prep area near the water heater. About 10 pounds of beef was being prepared and held outdoors on an open-flame grill and was discarded. A citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager; food stored on floor
summary: No person in charge had a valid city sanitation certificate, and none was posted. Boxes of candy and disposable cups and plates were stored on the floor behind the counter. Soiled wiping cloths were left on sinks and prep tables, and a food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Slow hand sink drain; no manager allergen training
summary: The front hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired. The food service manager had no allergen training certificate on hand, and the operator was told to obtain one.

headline: Missing signage and thermometers; knives misplaced
summary: Employee washrooms lacked handwashing signs. The break room refrigerator and freezer lacked ambient air thermometers. Knives were stored on prep surfaces, and overhead vents throughout the facility have dust buildup.

headline: No backflow devices on coffee and ice machines
summary: Backflow prevention devices were not found on the espresso machine, drip coffee machine, or ice machine. They must be provided where they can be located and serviced.

headline: Gap under front door could let pests in
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front door is a possible entry point for pests. The operator must repair it and keep it maintained.

headline: Clutter on basement prep floor
summary: Clutter is stored on the floor in the basement prep area. Unused articles and equipment must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Dirty floor drain; moldy caulking; no allergen proof
summary: The front prep hand sink splash guard is unattached. An extremely dirty floor drain under the soda system and blackened, moldy caulking at the three-compartment sink must be cleaned or replaced. No allergen training proof was provided for the certified manager.

headline: Food on floor, missing hair restraint, expired certificate
summary: Food was stored on the floor in prep and dishwashing areas. A food handler in prep lacked a hair restraint. The certified manager's allergen training certificate had expired. Grease and debris were found on equipment, floors, and the hood.

headline: Hand sink water too cold; moldlike ice machine buildup
summary: Hand sink water measured 84.6°F and 82.4°F, below the required 100°F minimum; a priority citation was issued. Splash guards are missing at the bar hand sink. A pink and black mold-like buildup was found inside a large ice machine bin.

headline: Food handler skipped handwashing before handling food
summary: A male food handler scratched his head, rubbed his nose, put on gloves, and took frozen food from the freezer without washing hands. This was a priority citation. Gloves were used improperly, and a splash guard and sink repairs are needed.

headline: Black residue touching ice; no hot water at sink
summary: Black substance was found inside a rear ice machine in direct contact with ice for human consumption, a priority citation. The kitchen hand sink had no hot or cold water because its drainpipe was broken, and repair was requested.

headline: Ice machine residue and missing sink stopper
summary: Slight residue was found inside the ice machine panel. The three-compartment sink is missing a proper stopper. Loose wall tiles in the toilet room and a burned-out light there also need fixing.

headline: Food residue in coolers; broken floor tile
summary: Food residue built up on cooler gaskets and must be detail cleaned. A broken floor tile in the utility room needs repair.

headline: Food on floors; no proof of food handler training
summary: Food containers and items were stored on floors in prep areas, under the three-compartment sink, and throughout the basement. Food was not labeled, and no proof of food handler training was provided. A certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; cooler dust
summary: The rear prep handwashing sink needs a sign. Cutting gloves are stored on the soap dispenser. The rear prep cooler's interior and fan are dusty. The person in charge lacks allergen training.

headline: Grease trap, walls, and allergen proof needed
summary: Re-inspection found the grease trap under the three-compartment sink needs cleaning and food prep walls need cleaning. No allergen training certificates were on site for the certified food manager.

headline: Dirty floors, walls, and drains in prep area
summary: Foil lining under the dishwashing machine was removed to prevent insect harborage. The rear prep floor had dirt and food debris, floor drains had grime, and walls had grease and dark buildup. No pests were observed.

headline: Torn gaskets, leak, and missing food handler certificate
summary: A torn door gasket, a leak under the mop sink, and dirty wiping cloths were noted. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate. A certified manager lacked allergen training, a repeat violation. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager certificate; no food handler proof
summary: No certified food manager certificate was posted on the premises, and no food handler certificates were present. Ice buildup in a milk cooler must be removed. A mop sink lacks a visible backflow device.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; repaired on site
summary: Low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing, with a final rinse at 0 ppm. Ecolab repaired it during inspection, and it reached 100 ppm afterward. Citation issued.

headline: Oysters without tags discarded; cold food too warm
summary: Oysters without shellstock tags were voluntarily discarded on site, about 50 lbs valued at $200. Roasted tomatillos held at 46 F were discarded. Front door openings need sealing, and expired food handler certificates were noted.

headline: No metal stem thermometer on site; citation
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on site to check internal temperatures of cooked, delivered, and served TCS foods. The facility must obtain and maintain proper thermometers; a citation was issued.

headline: Ice cream spills and wall hole noted
summary: Ice cream spillage was found on the side of the machine and on the floor. A hole in the wall under a prep table could allow pests in, though none were observed. Dirt and food debris were also noted in several areas.

headline: Leak at dish machine; low ice machine lighting
summary: A leak was found at the pipe on top of the high-temperature dish machine. Lighting at the ice machine area was very low, making it hard to clean. Both were ordered fixed.

headline: Failed: no food handler or allergen certificates
summary: No certified manager was on site while beef and chicken were prepared. Several foods were held too warm and were discarded, and a prep cooler at 48.7 F was tagged. No employees had food handler or allergen certificates on site.

headline: Failed: rat droppings and hot food too cool
summary: About 40 rat droppings were found in a corner by the dock door, and about 10 small flies in the first-floor prep area. Salisbury steak held at 117.3 F was discarded. Citation issued for pest activity.

headline: No posted sanitation certificate; ice issues
summary: No person on site had an original city sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. Small black spots were found inside the ice machine. An ice scoop was stored directly in ice.

headline: Equipment on floor; allergen proof missing
summary: Equipment was stored on the floor in the dishwashing area and must be raised at least six inches. No proof of allergen awareness training was provided for three certified sanitation managers.

headline: Improper storage and unsealed wood shelves
summary: Re-inspection found equipment stored on the floor and maintenance tools kept with food items. Raw wood shelving must be sealed. Owner instructed to elevate items, store tools separately, and seal the wood.

headline: Chipped paint, ceiling gap, and dirty floors
summary: Inspector found chipped paint on a wall where clean dishware is stored, a missing ceiling attachment in the hallway to toilet rooms, and dirty floors behind freezer and storage racks. Owner instructed to repair and clean.

headline: Hair restraint, sanitizer, and cleaning issues
summary: Food handlers in pizza prep were not wearing hair restraints, and wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer. Fryers, reach-in coolers, and walls were dirty. Expired food handler certificate and a certified manager without allergen training.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; food storage issues
summary: Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm final rinse; repair required under citation. Coffee was stored under a hand sink. Cup lids were not inverted in the customer area.

headline: Failed inspection: ice machine and drain problems
summary: Pink buildup was found inside the ice machine. A floor drain drains slowly and a sink pipe leaks. Previous violations were not corrected: an ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine, and floors need cleaning.

headline: Torn gaskets; no food handler certificates
summary: Torn gaskets were found on a reach-in cooler, and spilled food residue was in cooler bottoms and drawers. No food handler certificates were on site, and no allergen training for food managers was on site.

headline: Failed: over 30 mouse droppings found
summary: Inspector counted over 30 mouse droppings under stairs and beneath a prep table in the rear prep area. Owner instructed to call an exterminator and clean. Dumpster overflowing, attracting flies, with loose lids; citation issued.

headline: Cold food held too warm; discarded
summary: Various cold TCS foods were held at 44 to 49 F, above the required 41 F. The manager discarded about $50 of food. A display cooler measured 46 F and was tagged. Citation issued.

headline: Door sweep and floor cleaning needed
summary: No pests found. Inspector noted a worn front door sweep that could allow pests in, and dirt and dust under shelving and equipment. Owner instructed to repair the sweep and deep clean.

headline: Leaking faucet and mold-like buildup above sink
summary: A faucet at the three-compartment sink leaks. Rust and a black, mold-like substance were found on the ceiling and caulking above it. No allergen training proof was provided for multiple certified employees.

headline: Debris, leaks, and missing allergen training
summary: Debris was found on cooking and prep equipment, and a faucet leaked. Spills, dust, and debris were on ceiling tiles and floors. Openings around outlets need sealing. Certified managers have no allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on site while cooking
summary: Certified food manager was absent while chicken and other TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared; citation issued. Also found food on floors, soiled wiping cloths, and greasy, debris-covered equipment and walls.

headline: Bulk food unlabeled; no hand sink splash guard
summary: Bulk flour, sugar, and similar foods were not labeled with their names. A splash guard was missing at the hand sink in the rear preparation area. Both must be fixed.

headline: Missing food handler training and plumbing fixes
summary: Employees lack required food handler training, and citation-level gaps were noted. Also found a missing drainboard, a missing backflow device, rusted cooler shelves, clutter, and a non-self-closing bathroom door.

headline: Failed: repeat violations, pooling water, unposted report
summary: Tin foil was used to repair a cooler, and a freezer door gasket is torn. Basement floors have pooling water. Multiple prior violations were not corrected, including hand sink and backflow issues. The inspection summary was not posted; citation issued.

headline: Gasket, ice buildup, and sprayer leak
summary: The front hand sink needs a splash guard next to the prep station. A low-reach prep station gasket is broken and worn. Ice builds up around the walk-in freezer door, and fan covers need cleaning. A three-compartment sink sprayer leaks.

headline: No food handler certification on site
summary: No certified food handler was on site. The owner was instructed to obtain and keep a record of certification on site.

headline: No health policy; hand sink signs missing
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises; a signed policy is required for each employee. Hand washing signs are missing at sinks in the bar, kitchen, dishwashing area, server station, and restrooms. No citation issued.

headline: Failed: overflowing dumpsters and food storage gaps
summary: Rear door has a 1/2-inch gap at the bottom. Items were stored on floors and milk crates used as shelves. The three-compartment sink drained slowly and backed up but was repaired during inspection. Dumpsters overflowed; citation issued.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedures or supplies
summary: No procedures or supplies were available for responding to vomiting and diarrhea events. Raw wood surfaces must be sealed. The utility sink lacks a backflow device, and floor tiles in sales and counter areas are damaged.

headline: Failed: black dirt in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black dirt buildup dripped into ice used for drinks. All ice was discarded. Missing thermometers in prep coolers, torn gaskets, and food debris on the dish machine exterior. Grease and food spills near the outside grease container.

headline: Failed: no hair restraints; repeat gasket violation
summary: Employees in the coffee prep area were not wearing hair restraints while food was prepared and served. Wiping cloths were stored on sinks and prep tables. Dirt under refrigeration units. Broken gasket and milk crate use were a repeat violation.

headline: No certified manager during chicken handling
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and other TCS foods were handled; priority citation issued. A food handler lacked hair restraints, and cooks lacked food handler training certificates.

headline: Gaps at front doors; floor and wall tile damage
summary: Gaps along the bottom and sides of front and revolving doors must be sealed to prevent insect entry. Wall tiles at cooking equipment, damaged floor tiles in the rear prep and dish areas, and floor drain debris need fixing. No insects were observed.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; shrimp too warm
summary: Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm final rinse and was tagged. Cooked shrimp at 49.1 to 50 F were held in the walk-in cooler; about 40 pounds ($700) were discarded. The certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Ice machine, shelving rust, and leaks
summary: Ice machine rim and sides need cleaning. Walk-in cooler and two-door cooler shelving is rusting and peeling. A leak at the walk-in condenser must be repaired. Floors need cleaning throughout, especially near cooking equipment.

headline: Dirty tables, floors, and hood vents
summary: Dining tables need cleaning and sanitizing after customer use. Floors need detail cleaning to remove spills and buildup. The wall and ceiling above the hand sink, and the hood vents, need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no hand sinks; pico de gallo too warm
summary: No handwashing at the dish room, kitchen, and bar hand sinks. Pico de gallo at 55.7 F was discarded. Gaps at exit doors, milk crates used as shelving, no test strips for the dish machine, and ice buildup in the walk-in freezer.

headline: Cleaning supplies stored above hand sink
summary: Cleaning supplies were stored above the hand sink and must be moved away from prep areas. A leak at the rear three-compartment sink must be fixed. Floors in corners and behind coolers need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; ice contamination
summary: No certified food manager was on site while rice, chicken, and other TCS foods were prepared; priority citation issued. Black dirt buildup in the ice machine dripped into ice used for drinks. All ice was discarded.

headline: Failed: raw chicken and rice held too warm
summary: Raw chicken at 51 F and cooked rice at 52 F were held in a refrigerator. About 10 pounds ($50) were discarded; citation issued. The outdoor beverage bar must be fully enclosed. Cardboard boxes and crates stored near the dumpster need removal.

headline: No grease trap at three-compartment sink
summary: No grease trap was installed at the three-compartment sink. The owner must install and maintain one.

headline: Grease spills outside oil container
summary: Inspector observed grease spills on the outside of the oil container. The owner must clean and maintain the area.

headline: Mold-like buildup inside ice machine
summary: Ice machine has excessive mold-like buildup. The ice is not used for human consumption. The person in charge must clean and sanitize the machine.

headline: Handwashing signage missing at ice cream prep sinks
summary: Handwashing signs are required at the handwashing sinks in the front ice cream prep area. Signage is the only issue noted.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; cold food too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site while turkey salad, eggs, and deli meat were prepared; citation issued. Turkey stuffing and mashed potatoes held at 48 to 52.5 F were discarded. Also found flooring, walls, and dishwasher drain problems.

headline: Uncovered ice bin; leaking booster tank
summary: The drive-thru ice bin was uncovered and needs a cover. A hand sink lacks a splash guard. Lids were not inverted, and a beverage booster tank leaks. Floors, walls, and corners need cleaning.

headline: Small rear door gap; ice machine door repair
summary: A small opening was found at the bottom of the rear exit door and must be rodent-proofed. The ice machine door is in poor repair and must be fixed. No pests were observed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; dumpster problems
summary: No certified food manager was on site while pizza and wings were prepared and served. The outside dumpster was overflowing and had no tight-fitting lid. Expired food handler certificates were a repeat violation. Citations issued.

headline: Ice buildup and rear sink leak
summary: Ice buildup was found in the front prep freezer and walk-in freezer and must be defrosted. A leak under the rear hand sink must be repaired. Floors around cooking equipment and rear storage racks need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no certified manager during beef prep
summary: No certified manager was on site for 22 minutes while beef was prepared; citation issued. Food was stored on floors, and cardboard and milk crates were used as shelving. A prior priority violation was not corrected.

headline: Utensils stored in water; leaking pipe
summary: Utensils were stored in water and must be kept in sanitizing solution. The three-compartment sinks lack wash, rinse, and sanitize labels, and a pipe leaks below one sink. A certified manager lacks allergen training, a repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: Missing baseboard coving in prep area
summary: Baseboard coving is missing throughout the rear prep and dishwashing area. It must be installed.

headline: Items stored in utility sink
summary: Items were stored inside the rear utility sink. Inspector instructed the owner to remove them and keep the sink clear for use.

headline: Melon held too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Sliced watermelon and cantaloupe held at 60.2 to 64.1 F were discarded (58 containers). A display cooler at 58.1 F was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints; a 1/2-inch door gap was noted.

headline: Failed: repeat violations; no hand sink signs
summary: Prior violations were not corrected: no hand sink signs, no thermometer in the deli cooler, food debris on floors, and a certified manager without allergen training. Peeling paint in the deli cooler and ice buildup in the walk-in freezer.

headline: Cooling units and prep tables need cleaning
summary: Interior and exterior cooling units and all prep tables need cleaning. A garbage can in the women's restroom has no cover. Re-inspection found these items still needed attention.

headline: Stained cutting boards; expired allergen certificate
summary: Cutting boards are stained and scratched and must be resurfaced or replaced. The employee toilet seat is chipped, and a restroom receptacle is uncovered. A certified food manager has an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Cup used to scoop food
summary: A drinking cup with no handle was used to scoop food at service prep coolers. Owner must provide tongs, serving spoons, or a ladle.

headline: Food handler lacks training; allergen proof missing
summary: A food handler had no food handler training certificate; management must provide proof. A certified manager lacked allergen training, a repeat violation from a prior report. Citation issued.

headline: Cold food too warm; vacuum packaging problems
summary: Milk, cream, cooked oatmeal, and gravy held at 44 to 55 F were discarded ($120). Vacuum packaging was done without an approved HACCP plan or variance; 20 lbs of fish and chicken were discarded. A cooler at 47 F was tagged.

headline: Vacuum packaging without approval; machine tagged
summary: Vacuum packaging machine was used for pizzas without prior approval from the city health department. The machine was tagged and must not be used until approved. A pipe leaks under the bar hand sink.

headline: Failed: no certified manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while meatballs, hummus, and corn were prepared; citation issued. The person in charge lacks a certificate. Also found a gap under the front doors, a broken urinal, and grease buildup.

headline: No health policies or food handler certificates
summary: No employee health policies or food handler certificates were on site. The vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was incomplete. The stem thermometer needs calibration. All employees with a sanitation certificate need allergen certificates.

headline: Failed: no hand sink; manager lacks allergen training
summary: No hand sink was found in the pasta prep area; this is a priority violation that must be corrected. The sanitation manager has no allergen training.

headline: Gasket, clogged drain, and leaking faucets
summary: A reach-in cooler door gasket needs repair. A clogged floor drain by the dishwasher must be cleared to prevent backflow. The walk-in floor has dirt, and grease on cooking equipment. Two hand sink faucets leak.

headline: Gap at bottom of front entrance door
summary: A 1/4-inch gap was found at the bottom of the front entrance door. A tight-fitting seal is required to keep pests out. No pests were observed.

headline: Food debris in coolers; light bulbs out
summary: Food debris and buildup were found inside prep area coolers. Damaged wall tiles near the two-compartment sink need repair or sealing. Walk-in cooler and freezer light bulbs were not working.

headline: Failed: pest entry gap and garbage problems
summary: A 1/4-inch gap was found under front entry doors; food was stored on the floor; and an overflowing dumpster had loose lids. Core violations from a prior report were not corrected: no hair restraints, a leaky pipe, and a missing self-closing door.

headline: No splash guards; rusted shelves; clutter
summary: Splash guards are needed between drainboards and hand sinks at the front, middle, and rear bars. Walk-in cooler shelves are rusted. Clutter and unused equipment are in the basement and storage areas and must be removed.

headline: Failed: three live roaches found
summary: Three live roaches were observed on the floor under cooking equipment with heavy grease buildup, and roach activity was seen on lower walls behind equipment. Owner must eliminate pests, deep clean, then contact pest control. Citation issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; serviced during visit
summary: The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer at inspection. It was serviced by Ecolab during the visit. A citation was issued. Also found a 1/4-inch gap at the rear door and wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces.

headline: Cleaning needed; water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Fryers, grill, vent system, and shelves in the walk-in cooler need cleaning. Items are stored inside the mop sink. Water-stained ceiling tiles should be replaced, and floors under equipment need cleaning.

headline: Damaged gaskets, water-damaged ceilings, wood floor
summary: Torn cooler gasket and a freezer lid repaired with duct tape need replacing. Cloth towels were used as shelf liners. Water-damaged ceiling tiles, a wood cook-line floor, and pooled water in the basement need fixing.

headline: Damaged stairway floor tiles
summary: Missing and damaged floor tiles were found on the stairway to the lower-level prep area. They must be repaired to create a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Damaged cutting boards and cooler gasket
summary: Two cutting boards in the front prep area have deep grooves and dark stains and must be repaired or replaced. A two-door prep cooler has a torn interior gasket.

headline: Missing and cracked ceiling tiles
summary: Missing and cracked ceiling tiles were found in the kitchen prep and rear storage areas. A hole was found in the baseboard near the rear side door. The person in charge must repair them.

headline: Roach droppings found near hand sink
summary: Roach droppings were found on the wall in the light switch crevices above the hand sink in the main prep area. The owner was told to clean, sanitize, and maintain the area. A cutting board was also stored on the floor.

headline: Missing backflow device at laundry sink
summary: The service sink in the laundry room has no backflow prevention device. Owner must install one that can be located, serviced, and maintained.

headline: Failed: no paper towels; hand sink water problems
summary: Paper towels were missing at the bar hand sink; a food handler obtained one during inspection. The bar hand sink had no hot or cold water. Water backs up at the three-compartment sink, and a pipe drips into a hand sink. Citations issued.

headline: Failed: 40 live flies found in bakery
summary: Inspector observed 40 live small flies on walls around the bakery prep area near the tray and dish machine. Manager must remove them before reinspection. Also found a loose handwash faucet and water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Debris around dumpsters; floors need cleaning
summary: Leaves and debris were found around the dumpsters and must be cleaned. Floors in corners and under heavy equipment have dirt and debris. The certified manager on site lacks allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food debris
summary: Bulk containers in dry storage were not labeled. Open tortillas were stored under the front counter. Food debris was found on shelves and floors, and dust on ceilings and light shields.

headline: Cleaning needed; allergen certificate still missing
summary: Cooler interiors, floors, ceiling tiles, and vents need cleaning. Allergen training for the certified manager was not corrected from an earlier inspection; citation issued.

headline: Torn gasket on prep cooler
summary: A torn door gasket was found inside a two-door prep cooler in the main kitchen. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Dirty microwave, cooler debris, water-damaged tiles
summary: Food debris and buildup were found inside the rear storage microwave and debris inside a two-door cold holding unit. Multiple water-damaged ceiling tiles in the rear storage area need replacing.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, dead mouse, handwashing lapses
summary: About 20 or more mouse droppings and a dead mouse were found. A male employee sanitized at 0.0 ppm and used a cutting board for meat after rinsing. Employees lacked health policies and food handler training. Multiple citations issued.

headline: Failed: black slime dripping onto ice
summary: Black slime buildup inside the rear prep ice machine dripped onto ice used for drinks. Citation issued. The three-compartment sink also backed up into other basins and must be repaired.

headline: Ground chicken held too warm; discarded
summary: Ground chicken in a reach-in cooler held at 48 to 48.6 F and was discarded. Citation issued. Food containers were stored on the floor, and grease and debris were found under cooking equipment and along walls.

headline: Failed: no paper towels; no cold storage equipment
summary: No paper towels were available in the employee restroom. No cooling equipment was on site for milk, eggs, juice, and pop. A small gap was found at the front door, and a light lacks a shield in the front lobby.

headline: Low hand sink pressure; leaking hose
summary: The front hand sink has low pressure from a blocked aerator, though it works with the aerator removed. Price tags cover expiration dates on pudding cups. An ice scoop sits on a cardboard box, and a restroom hose leaks.

headline: Unlabeled dry storage; leaking pipe
summary: Dry storage containers were not labeled. A multi-use bowl and styrofoam cups were used to scoop dry goods. The fryer door hinge is in poor repair. A pipe leaks under the two-compartment sink, and a rear freezer light is out.

headline: Failed: health policies, pest, and sanitation gaps
summary: Employee health policies and a vomit cleanup kit were missing. Front and rear doors are not rodent-proofed, and no pest control log was on premises. Dumpsters were overflowing; citation issued. No pests were observed.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers and food handler certificates
summary: Two-door reach-in coolers lacked working air thermometers. Frozen meats were stored in plastic grocery bags. Food handlers must show training certificates. Also noted: dirty cooler bottoms and wet mops not hung to dry.

headline: Cutting boards grooved and stained
summary: Rear prep cutting boards had deep grooves and dark stains. Staff instructed to refinish or replace damaged or stained cutting boards and keep them maintained.

headline: Handwashing sinks lacked soap and towels
summary: Main kitchen and bar hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels while staff served customers (priority). Bar sink was blocked by utensils. Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine, tagged out of use. Ten pounds of on-site vacuum-packed salmon discarded.

headline: Six-inch hole in basement foundation
summary: A six-inch hole in the brick basement foundation near the front exit sign. Staff instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Ice on freezer condenser; grease on hood
summary: Ice buildup on middle walk-in freezer condenser must be removed. Grease and food buildup on ventilation hood must be cleaned. One light bulb cover missing above dish machine.

headline: Leaking sink pipe; pink buildup in ice machine
summary: Right compartment pipe of cookline three-compartment sink is leaking; must be repaired. Slight pink buildup in upper ice machine; must be cleaned. Food allergen training certificate expired; manager must update it.

headline: Employee drinks in prep area; lead-risk cups
summary: Employee had open beverages in prep area; told to use closed containers. Clay or ceramic drinking cups on site must be lead-safe or removed. Rusty bottom shelf of rear prep table must have rust removed.

headline: Missing hand sink; no food handler training proof
summary: No hand sink in front prep and serving area (priority violation; no citation issued). No proof of food handler training for any food handlers. Staff instructed to provide and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Food debris by fryers; slow hand sink
summary: Wiping cloth air-drying on table instead of in sanitizer. Excessive food debris between deep fryers and cooling units; must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage. Slow-draining rear prep hand sink. Only one of three managers had allergen certificates.

headline: No handwashing sign; clutter on shelves
summary: No handwashing sign at restroom sink; must be provided. Pencils, pens, and other clutter stored on shelving units must be cleaned and organized.

headline: Cutting boards worn or discolored
summary: Cutting boards are worn or discolored. Staff instructed to replace them and keep them maintained.

headline: Dirty cooler, restrooms, and floors; missing training
summary: Food debris on top inside reach-in prep cooler. Restroom fixtures and floors need cleaning. Floors in prep and rear storage need debris removed. Food handler on duty lacked required food handler training; must be provided.

headline: Front doors not rodent-proof; utensil and board issues
summary: Front double doors had a half-inch gap and were not rodent or insect proof. Also noted: improperly stored ice scoop, grooved cutting board, slow-draining washbowls, and stained dishwashing-area walls and ceiling tiles.

headline: Outdoor insect killer over prep table removed
summary: Outdoor-use electric insect killer hung above prep table; staff told to remove it and use only pest-company devices. Also: hair restraint missing, torn cooler gaskets, frozen meat in plastic bag, peeling ceiling paint, no self-closing bathroom door.

headline: Overflowing garbage area; lids not tight
summary: Trash, food, boxes, and debris overflowing onto ground at garbage area; lids not tight-fitting. Priority violation; no citation issued. Trash area must be provided and maintained at all times.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; plants over dish area
summary: No handwashing sign in employee restroom; must be posted. Live potted plants above dishwashing area; staff instructed to remove them.

headline: Dusty shelving in walk-in cooler
summary: Dust and debris buildup on shelving in the walk-in cooler. Manager instructed to clean.

headline: Cold food too warm; refrigerator tagged out
summary: Egg rolls at 47.2°F and eggs at 53.8°F in kitchen refrigerator; 12 lbs discarded. Kitchen refrigerator at 48.1°F tagged, not to be used until reinspected. No paper towels at hand sinks (citation issued). Hair restraints missing.

headline: Hair restraints missing; item stored on floor
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints; person in charge told all must wear them. Single-service article stored on furnace room floor; manager told to move it and elevate it six inches.

headline: Heavy grease and food buildup on equipment
summary: Ice machine interior needs detail cleaning. Fryers, flat top, prep tables, shelves, and reach-in coolers and freezers have food and grease buildup. Floors in prep and storage areas and hood filters also need detail cleaning.

headline: No paper towels at sinks; untrained food handlers
summary: No paper towels at exposed hand sinks in food prep, men's restroom, and rear dish area (priority violation, citation issued). Two of three employees worked without food handler training. Also dirty microwave, two burnt-out hood bulbs, no summary posted.

headline: No certified manager; missing hand sink
summary: No certified manager on site while chicken, steak, and taquitos were prepared (citation issued). No written employee health policy. No hand sink beside three-compartment sink; citation issued. Food handler training not found on site.

headline: Dried food debris under rear shelving
summary: Floors under shelving racks in rear prep had dried food debris and miscellaneous items on the floor. Staff instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Unlabeled food and floor storage; clutter
summary: Food stored in coolers, walk-in, and dry storage lacked name labels. Food containers stored on floor in walk-in and prep areas; must be elevated six inches. Clutter throughout, especially basement, must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Three-compartment sink overflows; unlabeled cake
summary: Three-compartment sink not draining; water overflowed onto floor (priority violation, citation issued). Cake slices were unlabeled. Cardboard liners on prep equipment, encrusted can opener, dirty reach-in cooler interiors, and rainwater leaking through basement walls.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; bar ice bins need lids
summary: Torn rubber door gasket on far-left two-door cooler at cook line must be replaced. Lids must be on bar ice bins when they are not in constant use.

headline: Missing sink stopper; grease and debris buildup
summary: One stopper missing for three-compartment sink. Debris on prep cooler top, grease on deep fryers, and dirty floors under cooking equipment. Inadequate lighting in rear prep area. No allergen certificate for certified food manager on site.

headline: No certified manager during meat curing
summary: No certified manager present during meat smoking and curing (priority, citation issued). Date labels missing on foods held over 24 hours; no production logs; no approved yogurt variance, so drinkable yogurt was removed from self-serve. Rear door not rodent-proof.

headline: Dirty ice machine; leaking drain pipe
summary: Ice machine interior not clean, with early mineral buildup on front ice bin panel. Ice is used for human consumption. Also: fryer and cooler grease, unlabeled dry containers, and a leaking drain pipe at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Dirty floor corners; no hood vent
summary: Floor corners in prep and storage areas need detail cleaning. No hood vent on site to remove smoke and food smells; staff instructed to eliminate smoke.

headline: Cold foods above safe temperature; discarded
summary: Ham, turkey, chicken, beef, tuna held at 47.1–54.4°F; meatballs at 126.8°F. All 20 lbs discarded (priority, citation issued). Certified manager's allergen certificate expired. Light switch in walk-in cooler hard to turn on.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; stained cutting boards
summary: Outside dumpster overflowing with trash and boxes; lid must stay closed to prevent pest harborage (priority violation, citation issued). Stained cutting boards on prep line coolers. Microwave, prep coolers, and grease-coated floors need cleaning.

headline: Dirty pot holders and dead pigeon outside
summary: Extremely dirty pot holders in food prep area. Tape used as knife designation must be removed. Outside waste area had debris, cardboard, grill, and a dead pigeon; must be cleared to prevent rodent harborage. Floors and walls need cleaning and repair.

headline: Food covered while cooling; items stored on floor
summary: Pasta and cooked vegetables were tightly covered with plastic wrap while cooling in walk-in cooler; staff told to cover loosely. Single-service plastic bowls and lids were stored directly on dry storage floor; must be six inches up.

headline: Outdoor bar sink needs cover; drip onto floor
summary: Outdoor bar hand sink and three-compartment sink need durable covers when not in use. Ice bin drained directly onto floor; must drain into bucket or floor drain. Chipping basement ceiling near water boiler must be repaired and sealed.

headline: Cold foods up to 63°F; 100 lbs discarded
summary: Rice, pork, milk, chicken, beef, cheese, beans, and lettuce held at 45.1–63.1°F; 100 lbs discarded (priority, citation issued). Rice and beef stored in grocery bags in hot holder. Utility sink lacks backflow device. Only one food handler had training proof.

headline: Uncovered food on walk-in floor; soiled wipes
summary: Uncovered food stored on floor in walk-in coolers; must be covered and elevated six inches. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables. Loose door handles on reach-in coolers, grease buildup, no waste receptacle at hand sinks, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on site while beef and chicken were prepared and served (priority violation, citation issued). Metering faucet in men's restroom must run 15 seconds. Chipped paint and rust on walk-in cooler wire racks.

headline: No manager certificate; missing hand-wash supplies
summary: No City of Chicago food service manager certificate; only a ServSafe certificate was shown. Two of three hand sinks lacked soap, and three hand sinks had no paper towels or hand dryer. No sanitizer test strips. Smoking evidence cited.

headline: Rat droppings found; no certified manager
summary: Over 30 rat droppings in rear prep under shelves, near food, behind cooking equipment, and under three-compartment sink; priority violation, citation issued. Person in charge lacked sanitation certificate. No food handler or allergen certificates provided.

headline: Debris on floors; no allergen certificate
summary: Debris along walls and corners in utility and storage areas, and prep area floors, need cleaning. No food service manager allergen training certificate on site; manager instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Wastewater backs up at three-compartment sink
summary: Water from middle compartment backed up into other compartments; grease trap must be serviced. Priority violation, citation issued. Also: 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door, slow women's restroom sink, and food debris on carpet in dry storage.

headline: No handwashing signs; missing backflow devices
summary: No handwashing signs at bar sinks. No backflow prevention devices on espresso and drip coffee machine water lines. Basement storage was cluttered and must be cleaned and organized.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; sink leak
summary: Wiping cloths must be kept in a clean sanitizer bucket when not in use. Leak at three-compartment sink must be corrected and maintained.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit (both priority). Bar hand sink lacked soap and paper towels, and handwashing signs were missing. No adequate sanitizer or test strips, and no covered toilet-room waste container.

headline: Quarter-inch door gap; leaking prep faucet
summary: Quarter-inch opening at bottom right of rear exit door could let insects or pests in. Leak at front food prep station faucet. Both items must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; allergen certificates missing
summary: Food containers stored on walk-in cooler floor in rear prep; person in charge told to elevate food six inches. Multiple food service managers lacked allergen awareness training certificates on site; they must obtain and keep them.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; storage and ceiling repairs
summary: No handwashing signs in toilet rooms. Hooking system needed to hang wet mops. Items in fire pump room and storage must be elevated or organized off the floor. Stained dining area ceiling tiles must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Rodent droppings found; cooler inoperable
summary: About 12 large rodent droppings on floor by water heater (priority violation); pest activity must be eliminated. Two-door cooler inoperable. No employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea procedure posted. No mop sink on site.

headline: Certified manager lacked allergen training certificate
summary: The certified food manager did not have an allergen training certificate. Management was instructed that all certified food managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: Damaged data plate; debris in produce hallway
summary: Damaged data plate on high-temperature dish machine must be replaced. Ice buildup on two walk-in freezer condensers must be removed. Food debris under shelving in produce hallway; clean floors and wall bases.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no health policy
summary: No proof staff were informed of their duty to report illness. No vomiting/diarrhea response plan. Dishwasher had 0 ppm chlorine in final rinse; tagged and not to be used until repaired. Also missing prep sink and kitchen hood filter.

headline: Door not rodent-proof; leaks and small hole found
summary: Center of front entrance door not fully rodent proof. Leaks from utility sink and three-compartment sink faucet. Utility sink lacked backflow device. Also: no lid on washroom waste can, dirty toilet, small wall hole, water-stained ceiling tile.

headline: Dirty ice machine; many cold foods too warm
summary: Black dirt inside ice machine was dripping into ice; all ice discarded, and machine must be cleaned by re-inspection. Many cold-held foods at 44.6–48.0°F; 79 lbs discarded. Three-door prep cooler ran at 52.0°F with ripped gaskets.

headline: Cooler gasket debris; worn restroom sink handles
summary: Food debris and residue on gaskets of front prep line cooler drawers. Restroom washbowl sink handles in poor repair. Wall near office area has missing paint that must be repaired.

headline: Dead roaches found in several areas
summary: Dead roaches found on floor near rear exit, on cart with clean pans, and on lower wall under three-compartment sink drainboard. Must be removed, area cleaned, and maintained. Shelves under cooking equipment need cleaning; no allergen course on site.

headline: No food handler training certificates provided
summary: Complaint inspection found no food handler training certificates for food handling employees. Management was told all employees must show proof. Ice machine interior also needs cleaning.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold food temperatures; wrong buckets
summary: Cooked potatoes and onions at 97°F, below the 135°F hot-holding minimum. Eggs at 45°F, beef at 64°F, and yogurt at 85°F in cold holding; limit is 41°F. Yogurt and garlic puree stored in buckets previously used for soap. Priority violations; citation issued.

headline: No written employee health policy; improper storage
summary: No written employee health policy on site (priority violation, citation issued). Food stored on walk-in cooler floor, wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer, and food stored in plastic grocery bags. All must be corrected.

headline: Foil lining and food debris need removal
summary: Foil and paper lining on prep area storage shelves must be removed. Fryer cabinet interiors, hot-holding unit, and shelves under prep tables had food debris. Walls behind sinks and next to fryers had grease and debris.

headline: No certified food manager while eggs prepared
summary: No certified food manager on site while milk and eggs were prepared and served (priority violation, citation issued). Instructed to have a certified food manager on site at all times.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and a minor leak
summary: Three-compartment sink is missing stoppers; must be obtained. Minor leak at bottom of three-compartment sink; must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Spillage under coolers needs cleaning
summary: Floor base of two-door reach-in cooler in rear and lower reach-in coolers in front service area had built-up spillage. Staff instructed to clean and maintain all of them.

headline: Leak under hand sink; missing sink stoppers
summary: Leak found under the hand wash sink. No stoppers available for the three-compartment sink. Debris noted inside the three-compartment sink. Staff instructed to fix the leak, obtain stoppers, and clean.

headline: No certified manager on site; training gaps
summary: No certified manager present while chicken was prepared (priority violation, citation issued). Several employees lacked food handler training. Repeat allergen training violation. No summary posted. Floor drains and used cooking oil container also need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; hot food too cool
summary: No certified food manager while chicken, beef, and potatoes were prepared (priority, citation issued). Baked chicken held at 84.7°F and 91.2°F in deli hot holder, below 135°F minimum; discarded. Three-compartment sink backs up. Food handler certificates missing.

headline: Hair restraints missing; milk crates misused
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints; all must wear them. Single-service articles stored on floor and not inverted; bulk containers unlabeled. Milk crates used for elevation; proper shelving must be provided.

headline: Burnt-out bulbs; expired allergen certificate
summary: Burnt-out light bulbs in rear dish area must be replaced. Certified food manager had an expired allergen training certificate; must obtain and maintain a current one.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and food labels
summary: No handwashing signs in restrooms or at front hand sink. Unlabeled food containers, uncovered food in prep coolers, scoops stored inside containers, cardboard in walk-in cooler, and dirty employee washroom exhaust vent. Instructed to correct each item.

headline: Pest entry gaps, overflowing dumpster, leaks
summary: Front door has a 1/4-inch bottom gap, a possible pest entry. Overloaded dumpster with weeds and debris (priority violation). Also: leaking sink pipes, low mop-sink pressure, no lidded trash can, damaged ceiling tiles, dirty floors, and no working cooler thermometer.

headline: Cold foods too warm; four-door cooler repaired
summary: Cold foods at 46.8–54.1°F, including pork and cheeses, discarded (23 lbs, priority, citation issued). Four-door cooler at 52.7°F was repaired and later measured at 38.3°F. Openings at front entrance and rear doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: No pest control log; no sneeze guard
summary: No pest control log on site (priority violation). No sneeze guard at hot-holding self-serve area (priority violation). Washroom doors not self-closing; must install devices on both doors.

headline: No norovirus disinfectant; door openings found
summary: No disinfectant effective against norovirus was on site (priority violation). Openings at doors could let pests in. No visible thermometers in cold units, moldlike growth and spills in coolers, low hot water pressure, and no ventilation in both restrooms.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; loose bar sink faucet
summary: Torn gasket inside coffee prep cooler must be repaired or replaced. Loose faucet at exposed bar hand sink must be repaired. Both items must be kept in good condition.

headline: No handwashing sink inside washroom
summary: No handwashing sink inside washroom (priority violation). Manager must install one with hot and cold water, soap, and paper towels. Also raw wood shelving, dust on cooler bases, dumpster debris, missing ceiling tiles, and no washroom fan.

headline: Door gaps, torn gasket, burned-out bulb
summary: Two front double doors had 1/4-inch gaps at sweeps that must be rodent-proofed. Reach-in cooler door gasket in prep area is ripped and must be replaced. Burned-out ceiling light above prep area must be replaced.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; fan and debris issues
summary: No thermometer in two-door glass cooler in rear storage; one must be provided. Single-service items stored on basement floor. Oven interior greasy and lined with cardboard. Restroom fan not working. Loose debris on basement floor.

headline: Front door gap; greasy grill table
summary: Gap along bottom and left side of double front entry door; door must be tight-fitting. Grease and food debris buildup on grill table must be cleaned.

headline: Wet mop stored in bucket; floor debris
summary: Wet mop stored in bucket in utility area; staff instructed to hang mops to dry when not in use. Food and dirt debris under dish machine and around grease trap must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager, no hot water
summary: No valid food sanitation certificate on site while chicken and eggs were served (priority, citation issued). No current pest control report. Hot water absent at several sinks, restored during inspection. Broken and cracked floor tiles near rear door.

headline: Front door gap; rust on prep table
summary: Front door had about a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom and was not protected; must be repaired to be tight-fitting. Rust on bottom shelf of prep table must be removed so surface is smooth.

headline: Missing handwashing signs, slow drain, no mop sink
summary: Inspector found no handwashing signs at basement sink, a slow-draining hand sink, and no mop sink. Repeat violations were not corrected, including restroom trash cans without lids and ceiling holes that could let pests in. Citation issued.

headline: Uncontrolled dogs inside; sink plumbing problems
summary: Two dogs inside not acting as service animals; one large dog jumped on employees and howled at customers. Priority violation, citation issued. Also: slow prep sink, leaking three-compartment faucet, missing stoppers, and liquor boxes in washroom.

headline: Missing food handler training; missing thermometers
summary: Expired or missing food handler training for employees; must be provided. Missing thermometers for coolers on cook and prep lines. Missing handwashing sign at staff restroom sink. Worn cutting boards; food boxes on walk-in floor must be elevated.

headline: Dusty walls; allergen training incomplete
summary: Dust and dirt built up on walls in rear dish and prep area; must be cleaned. Only one of two certified food managers had allergen training certification; must obtain it for both.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: Bar low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine (50–100 ppm required); tagged, may not be used until inspected. Also missing hand sink splash guard and ice bin covers, black slime on bar caulk, and debris by dumpster.

headline: Restroom sinks lack hot water; no test kit
summary: Restroom washbowl sinks had no hot water (66–70°F); must reach at least 100°F. Priority violation, citation issued. No chemical test kit for sanitizer during inspection. Missing ceiling tiles in storage room. Freezer interior with food debris where shrimp is stored.

headline: Hair restraint lacking; cooler and floors dirty
summary: Food handler in front prep lacked a hair restraint. Rack holding marinating chicken and beef skewers and walk-in cooler shelves need cleaning. Floors at cook line, behind water heater, and walk-in cooler walls need deep cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; bare-hand food contact
summary: No certified manager on site while eggs, bacon, and sausage were cooked. Employee touched a ready-to-eat egg sandwich bare-handed, then raw sausage, then ready-to-eat food again. Citations issued. Also missing allergen training, grease on hood, dust on ice scoop.

headline: Over 300 drain flies swarming bar drain
summary: About 300 small drain flies swarmed the bar floor drain and three-compartment sink area. Priority violation, citation issued; flies must be eliminated and pest service recommended. Also missing hair restraint, dirty floors, and heavy basement clutter.

headline: Missing employee health policy and allergen course
summary: No proof of employee health policy; one must be provided with signed employee acknowledgments (priority, no citation). Also: no thermometer near pickup-window refrigerator, mixer stored in closet, no written clean-in-place procedure, and no allergen course for certified manager.

headline: Mouse droppings found in food prep area
summary: About 30 mouse droppings found in hot food/deli prep station behind ovens and coolers along wall base. Priority violation; told to eliminate rodent activity, and pest control was recommended. Upper surfaces of fresh meat coolers were also dirty.

headline: Restroom doors not self-closing; no allergen certificates
summary: Restroom doors lacked self-closing devices; must be installed and maintained. No allergen training certificates on site for certified managers; must obtain and keep them on site.

headline: Cardboard used as storage inside cold units
summary: Cardboard was being used for storage inside cold-hold units. Staff instructed to remove it and use food-grade containers instead.

headline: Cold foods too warm; shellfish records missing
summary: Foods held above safe cold temperature: tomatoes 56.8°F, salmon 58.7°F, boiled eggs 56.4°F, cucumbers 60.3°F; 25 lbs discarded. A cold unit at 58.6°F was tagged. Also: shellfish tag dates missing, no inspection summary posted, missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tile; dusty restroom vents
summary: Water-stained ceiling tile in rear staff restroom must be replaced. Dirt and dust on restroom ceiling tiles and vents must be cleaned.

headline: Utensils stored improperly; cold units had residue
summary: Knives and spatulas were stored between wall and sink; person in charge told to store them properly to prevent contamination. Food residue inside cold-hold units; person in charge told to clean.

headline: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies on site
summary: No cleanup supplies on premises for vomit or diarrhea events. Priority foundation violation; citation issued. Management instructed to provide supplies.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; allergen certificates missing
summary: Some prep area cooler door rubber gaskets were ripped or in poor repair; must be repaired or replaced. Some food managers lacked allergen training certificates; all certified managers must have valid ones.

headline: Black slime on caulk; burnt-out hood bulbs
summary: Flour and other bulk containers not labeled. Black slime buildup on caulk around dish rack near high-temperature dish machine. Burnt-out hood bulbs in front and rear prep, and grease on hood filters. Staff instructed to fix and maintain.

headline: Unlabeled bins; food stored on walk-in floor
summary: Salt and sugar were in unlabeled plastic bins in rear dry storage. Boxed food sat on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches.

headline: Splash guard and cardboard shelving need fixing
summary: An upstairs handwash sink near wine and food storage needs a splash guard. Cardboard is used as shelving and must be replaced. The large dish machine's exterior needs cleaning, and the downstairs staff bathroom needs a covered receptacle.

headline: Dirty water bucket in walk-in; repeat violations
summary: A bucket of dirty water with green foam was connected to a discharge tube in the walk-in cooler. No chlorine sanitizer test devices were on site. Repeat violations uncorrected, including food handler training for three employees. Cigarette butts and beer bottle ashtrays were found indoors.

headline: Loose baseboard; debris in lunch room
summary: A baseboard in the lunch room was unglued and needs fixing. Debris had built up on the floor and along wall bases there and must be cleaned.

headline: Clogged handsink; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: A kitchen prep handwash sink was clogged, with water not draining at all, and must stay accessible. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and cutting boards had open seams and stains. A two-compartment sink faucet drips.

headline: No utility sink; nonworking sink must be removed
summary: No utility sink was on site; one must be installed and maintained. A nonworking three-compartment sink was also on site and must be removed.

headline: Live roaches in cooler; food in non-food buckets
summary: About 7 live adult and baby roaches were found inside a two-door reach-in cooler, at hinges and gaskets. Cooked chicken and broth stored in non-food-grade buckets; a 30-lb batch was discarded. Prior violations were not corrected.

headline: No certified manager on site; cleaning needed
summary: No person in charge had foodservice manager training, and no valid certificate was on site; a citation was issued. Ice machine door had residue, undercounter cold units had spills, and the women's restroom lacked a covered receptacle.

headline: Vehicle license number and refrigerator securing
summary: The vehicle's business license number was not printed at least 2 inches tall on both sides. A two-door refrigerator was not secured and must be secured while the vehicle is in motion.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings found; chicken too warm
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were in the rear storage area and both furnace/boiler rooms; additional pest control service is needed. 30 lbs of chicken held at 53.1°F were discarded ($250). Food was stored on floors. Manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No certified manager until 1:40 PM
summary: No certified manager was on premises until 1:40 PM, when one arrived and the issue was corrected on site. Ice machine interior had rust. Two food handlers had expired training proof. Rear door has an opening to seal.

headline: Handsinks blocked; dish machine repaired on site
summary: Kitchen and bar handsinks were blocked with pots and food strainers; the manager cleared them during inspection. The low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer; a technician repaired it on site. Grease, debris, dirt and burned-out bulbs were also noted.

headline: No certified manager; pizza left out too long
summary: No certified manager on site; person in charge lacked training. Pizza sat at 70°F; 45 lbs discarded ($650). Soap and paper towels were missing but supplied during inspection. Pest logbook lacked service reports.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup plan; no pest log
summary: No written procedure or supplies for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea; sanitizer must kill norovirus. No current pest-control logbook or contract was on the premises.

headline: Reach-in cooler lacks thermometer
summary: The reach-in cooler had no thermometer. One must be provided.

headline: No food handler certificates on premises
summary: No food handler certificates were on the premises. Meat and cheese slicers had food debris, and a walk-in condenser had dust. The three-compartment sink needs two stoppers, and the deli handsink is leaking.

headline: Cracked sink, missing backflow cover, faucet issues
summary: A basement utility sink has a cracked basin and a missing backflow cover. The deli three-compartment sink's hot-water faucet handle is in poor repair and can't be shut off. A knife rack beside a handwash sink needs a splash guard or relocation.

headline: Manager's allergen training expired; must renew
summary: One of two certified managers had expired allergen training. Staff must complete allergen training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; rust, gasket and clutter issues
summary: No handwashing signs at any sink. Other fixes: rust on ice machine exterior, a damaged cooler door gasket, a missing splash guard, uncovered restroom bin, and clutter and dirty floors (pest-harborage risk).

headline: Dirty floor drain and kitchen floors need cleaning
summary: The floor drain under the three-compartment sink had dirt, food debris and heavy stains. Floors under and around kitchen and front service equipment also need detail cleaning.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; drains dirty
summary: No paper towels were at the basement prep handsink; staff provided one during inspection. Floor drains in rear prep and basement were full of food debris. Food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Missing floor tiles at cooking line
summary: Floor tiles are missing at the cooking line in the front prep area. They must be replaced to keep the floor smooth and cleanable.

headline: Handsink blocked by meatballs; no soap
summary: A package of meatballs was stored inside a prep-area handwash sink, making it inaccessible. The restroom sink had no soap and wasn't draining. Cups and lids under a handsink were not inverted. A three-compartment faucet leaks.

headline: Food debris under cooking equipment; clean floors
summary: Food debris was on the floor behind and under cooking equipment in the rear prep area. Staff must clean these floors.

headline: Dead mouse found; no certified manager on site
summary: A dead mouse was found on the storage-room floor; front and rear doors have 1/4-inch gaps. No certified manager was on site. Also missing: pest logbook, vomit cleanup procedures, employee health policy, dumpster, and cooking ventilation.

headline: Wiping cloths improperly stored; no sink stoppers
summary: Wiping cloths were lying on several prep surfaces instead of sitting in sanitizing solution between uses. The three-compartment sinks had no stoppers; staff must provide and maintain them.

headline: Missing health policy and vomit cleanup procedures
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies. Menu lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory. The person in charge lacked allergen training. Soiled mops were stored improperly.

headline: Slow-draining three-compartment sink
summary: The middle compartment of the three-compartment sink drains slowly. The manager was told the pipe must drain quickly.

headline: Moldy cooler walls; no pest-control records
summary: Black and gray mold-like buildup covered walls behind shelving in the walk-in cooler. The rear patio door is not rodent-proof, and no pest-control records were on site. No sanitizer test kit was available.

headline: Dish area: debris, leak, and dusty walls
summary: Food debris was on the lower side of dish machine drainboards. The right compartment of the three-compartment sink has a leaking drain pipe. Dust and dirt covered dish room walls.

headline: Restroom door must self-close
summary: The toilet room door near the prep kitchen does not close by itself. A self-closing device must be installed.

headline: Floors under shelving need detail cleaning
summary: Floors under shelving had dust, dirt and debris and need a detail cleaning.

headline: Food stored under stairwell; linens on floor
summary: Tortilla chips were stored beneath a stairwell, which is prohibited, and must be moved. Clean linens were on the second-floor storage floor and must be raised at least 6 inches. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; sausage too warm
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; it was serviced during inspection and must reach 50–100 ppm. About 5 lbs of ground pork sausage at 52.4°F was discarded ($35).

headline: Mold in ice machine; no sanitizer test kit
summary: Pink and beige mold-like substance found inside the ice machine; staff must discard ice and clean it. Also: no chlorine test kit, missing splash guard, live plants above a cold unit, leaks, and grease on hood filters.

headline: Cold food too warm; no signed health policies
summary: Chicken, steak, tomatoes and chile rellenos were held at 44.4–47.1°F; about 8 lbs ($200) was discarded. The cooler measured 44.7°F and refrigeration service was notified. No signed employee health policies were on site.

headline: No allergen training certificates on site
summary: No allergen training certificates were on site. All employees holding a City of Chicago foodservice manager certificate must complete allergen training and keep records on site.

headline: Missing backflow device; unused equipment to remove
summary: The rear dishwashing utility sink lacks a backflow prevention device. Unused coolers, grill and a nonworking oven along the dining area walls should be removed.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or spill kit was found. Both must be provided.

headline: Torn rear screen; ice machine needs cleaning
summary: The rear exit kitchen door has a torn mesh screen that must be repaired or replaced to keep flies out. Upper interior of the ice machine needs cleaning. A walk-in cooler door lining is rusty and torn, a repeat violation.

headline: Small leak under three-compartment sink
summary: A small leak was found at a pipe under the middle basin of the three-compartment sink. It must be repaired.

headline: Leaking sink pipe; no valid allergen training
summary: A three-compartment sink pipe leaks excessively. A cooler's door handle is broken. Items on bar and utility room floors must be raised six inches. Hood filters are greasy, and allergen training was not valid.

headline: Food on floors; hair restraints and signs missing
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor, and some food handlers lacked hair restraints. Handwashing signs were missing in several areas, and packaged desserts were unlabeled. Other items: rusty prep table, spills and debris, and a leaking faucet.

headline: Missing thermometer and splash guard; worn gaskets
summary: No splash guard at the prep-line handwash sink. A utensil-temperature thermometer was missing. Gaskets on a two-door refrigerator and a front prep freezer need repair. A certified manager lacked allergen training, and a mop was improperly stored.

headline: Hair restraint missing; storage clutter to fix
summary: A food handler on the cookline had no hair restraint. Mops and brooms were stored in a corner and need a rack; the office between the kitchen and dry storage is cluttered and must be cleared and shelved off the floor.

headline: Leaking faucet at three-compartment sink
summary: The faucet on the three-compartment sink leaks and must be corrected and maintained.

headline: Hand sinks lack 100°F hot water
summary: Hot water at third-floor men's hand sinks measured 93–96°F, below the required 100°F, and was dropping. Other issues: a loose hand sink, unlabeled containers, a light out at the hood, and grease and debris in several areas.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: More than 80 mouse droppings were found across prep, waiting, and basement storage areas, and a dead mouse was on a glue board. Dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; it is tagged and must not be used until reinspected.

headline: Unlabeled containers; cardboard liners; dim cooler
summary: Cornstarch and flour storage containers in the rear dry storage closet must be labeled. Cardboard is being used as a liner on prep carts and must be removed. The walk-in cooler lighting is insufficient.

headline: About 20 flies; cold foods too warm
summary: About 20 small flies were found in the dishwashing, rear prep and front prep areas; pest control service was recommended. Noodles held at 46.6°F were discarded on site (10 lbs, $4). A small cold-holding unit at 52.2°F was tagged.

headline: Milk held too warm; oysters lacked tags
summary: Milk and half-and-half were held at 46.9–49.1°F, above the 41°F limit; 36 lbs were discarded. Oysters without tags were discarded (5 lbs). Dish machine wash solution measured 136°F; 155°F is required. The barista cooler (47.1°F) is held.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; beard restraint needed
summary: A handwashing sink in the kitchen prep area lacked a handwashing sign. A food handler was not wearing a beard restraint while preparing food.

headline: No raw-food advisory; customers can enter prep
summary: Menu lacked asterisks and a disclosure for animal foods served undercooked or to order. No barrier kept customers out of the rear prep area. Front entrance gap and open mailbox need sealing to keep pests out.

headline: Open window lacks screen; sprayer leaking
summary: The window above the first three-compartment sink was open with no screen to keep pests out. Keep it closed or add a screen. The sprayer on that sink is leaking and must be fixed.

headline: 50–70 live flies; cold and hot food unsafe
summary: About 50–70 live flying insects were found at the loading dock, service hallway, and rear kitchen. Cold food was held too warm; about 100 lbs ($900) was discarded. Hot food also discarded. No certified manager was on site at first.

headline: No certified manager on duty; trash overflowing
summary: The person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and none was posted for the manager on duty. Outdoor garbage containers overflowed, with lids that would not close. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Pushcart lacks required license number
summary: The pushcart did not show its license number on both sides. Staff must add the number, at least 2 inches tall, along with the business name.

headline: Dusty walk-in cooler fan covers need cleaning
summary: Inspectors found dust on the fan covers inside one walk-in cooler and instructed staff to clean them. This was the only issue noted.

headline: Cold food held too warm; cooler needs repair
summary: Cod, calamari, fries and chicken held at 48–49°F in a prep cooler, above the 41°F limit. Staff discarded them (21 lbs). Cooler must be repaired. Rear door has a 1/4-inch gap to seal against rodents.

headline: Live flies and roaches; no certified manager
summary: Over 30 live flies and live roaches were found in display and prep areas, with many dead roaches on the floor. No certified manager was on site while food was handled. Handwash soap was missing but provided during inspection.

headline: Weak water pressure; dim walk-in cooler light
summary: Water pressure at the bar hand sink was weak and must be brought up to city pressure. The walk-in cooler lighting was inadequate and must be increased.

headline: No certified manager; hamburgers, chicken too warm
summary: No certified manager on site during food prep. Hamburgers (51.4°F) and chicken (55.5°F) were held too warm; about 20 lbs discarded ($100). Ice machine had pink-and-black slime. No food handler training certificates were on site.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; 44 lbs discarded
summary: Tofu, ham, heavy cream and cheeses held at 44.1–44.9°F in a one-door prep cooler; staff discarded all 44 lbs ($275). Cooler air measured 41°F. A rear door gap must be rodent-proofed, and basement boxes need to be raised or removed.

headline: Live flies and bees in food prep area
summary: About 20 small and 10 large flies, plus 5 bees, were in toilet and prep areas. Dead insects were on window ledges. Front handsink lacked soap, supplied during inspection. Rear handsink was blocked with metal crates.

headline: No certified manager; brisket too warm
summary: No valid food sanitation certificate was posted, and no certified manager was on site. Cooked beef brisket at 52.8–58.4°F was discarded (40 lbs, $350). Ice machine had black mold-like buildup. Soap and paper towels were missing but supplied during inspection.

headline: No signed employee health policies on site
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site. Staff must provide a signed health policy for each employee.

headline: Dish machine gauge broken; switched to chlorine
summary: The high-temperature dish machine's rinse gauge was broken. A technician switched it to low-temperature chlorine sanitizing on site, pending a part order. Test strips showed proper temperature, though the gauge read 150°F.

headline: Worker coughed, prepared food without washing hands
summary: Worker coughed repeatedly and prepared food without washing hands. Restroom hot water measured 49°F, below the required 100°F. Dishes were washed in a mop sink; staff switched during inspection. Pest service reports missing. Customers could reach food-holding units.

headline: Drive-through door needs insect screen
summary: The drive-through door was open and not insect-proof. Staff must use a 16-mesh screen to keep insects and pests out.

headline: Live flies and mouse droppings found on premises
