summary: About 20 live small flies were on walls, ceiling and equipment in the front sushi prep area. About 40 mouse droppings were in rear dry storage. Additional pest control service is needed.

headline: Moldy caulking and cracked floor tiles need repair
summary: Moldy, blackened caulking in the dishwashing room must be replaced. Some floor tiles in front of handwashing sinks need repair and regrouting.

headline: Food handler lacked hair net
summary: A food handler in the prep area was not wearing a hair net. Staff must provide and use one.

headline: About 55 rodent droppings and live flies found
summary: About 55 small rodent droppings were found in bakery prep, behind equipment, and in rear storage. About 35 live black flies flew through rear prep. Dock and rear exit doors aren't rodent-proof. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Ice scoop stored in ice machine; buildup present
summary: The ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine and needs a clean container. Light calcium buildup must be cleaned from inside the ice machine. Dust covered prep cooler condensers, and grease covered hood filters.

headline: Sink overflowing onto floor; no health policies
summary: The three-compartment sink overflows at its J-trap, pooling water on the floor. No signed employee health policies were on site, and the menu lacked a raw-food advisory. A front door gap and broken urinal flush also need repair.

headline: Oysters lacked tags; vacuum packer not approved
summary: Oysters in the walk-in cooler had no identification tags; 3 lbs were voluntarily discarded ($60). A vacuum packaging machine has no approved HACCP plan or variance and must not be used until approved. Rusty shelves and milk crates also need fixing.

headline: Grease buildup at dish prep grease trap
summary: Grease had built up on the grease trap in the dish prep area. Staff must detail-clean it and clean it more often.

headline: Staff skipped handwashing; cold food too warm
summary: Employees used phones and put on gloves to handle food without washing hands between tasks. About 80 lbs of cold food at 47–51°F was discarded ($248.25); the cooler was tagged and held. Mixed shellfish was separated. Coolers lacked thermometers.

headline: No covered trash bins in restrooms
summary: Restrooms on the first, second and third floors had no covered receptacles. Staff must provide covered receptacles in all of them.

headline: Food handlers skipped handwashing; ice machine dirty
summary: Food handlers handled a lime squeezer and prepared TCS foods without washing hands. Blue buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice. A dumpster was missing, and grease piled outside. Several prior violations were not corrected.

headline: No certified manager on site; handwashing lapse
summary: No certified manager until 1:35 PM. An employee took clean dishes from the dish machine without washing hands; corrected on site and dishes rewashed. Restroom sinks measured 74.3°F, below the 100°F minimum. Mold on ice machine.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; do not use
summary: The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer and must not be used until it reaches at least 50 ppm. The sushi lab analysis letter had expired. Refrigerators lacked thermometers, and cheese was scooped with handleless containers.

headline: Mobile unit lacks water; no health policy
summary: The mobile food unit had no adequate hot or cold water, and its wastewater tank could not be verified. No employee health policy or vomit-cleanup procedure was on site. The unprotected water inlet was fixed on site.

headline: Rodent poison on floor; about 100 mouse droppings
summary: About 100 mouse droppings were on the dry storage floor and around nonworking walk-in coolers used for storage; this repeat violation needs more pest control. Rodent poison bags were on the floor and must be in covered, tamper-resistant containers.

headline: Worn gaskets, sink caulk, faucet, and ceiling repairs
summary: The pizza prep cooler has worn door gaskets to replace. Caulking inside the three-compartment sink must be swapped for food-grade caulk. A faucet handle and damaged dining room and restroom ceilings need repair.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cold food too warm
summary: Dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and must not be used. Milk, yogurt and Jell-O held at 46.5–49.5°F; 42 lbs discarded ($80). A 9th-floor unit at 50°F is out of use until it holds 41°F. Hand sinks lacked hot water.

headline: Cold food up to 70.7°F; flies found
summary: Cold foods were held between 45.5°F and 70.7°F; about 50 lbs ($550) was voluntarily discarded. About 30 small flies were found, with pest-control service advised. No certified manager was on site until 2:57 PM.

headline: Mold in walk-in cooler; rusted shelves
summary: Mold growth and buildup were found on the walk-in cooler's compressor, fan covers and drip tray. Rusted shelves need repainting or replacing. Dish room lighting was inadequate, and a baseboard is missing behind the dish machines.

headline: Freezer ice buildup must be removed
summary: Excess ice had built up on the floor, shelves and ceiling of the walk-in freezer; it must be removed and the freezer detail-cleaned. Stained ceiling tiles in the lobby and rear prep area need cleaning or replacement.

headline: Door gap must be rodent-proofed; allergen cert missing
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front entrance door sweep must be sealed to keep rodents out. One food manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: No food handler certificates on site; stove broken
summary: No employees had food handler training certificates on site. A prep-area cooking stove is not working and disconnected and must be repaired. Ventilation in the prep area is not working. Also: debris, mop storage, and a non-self-closing washroom door.

headline: Floor-stored food, leaking cooler, misplaced stove
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in floor and must be raised six inches. A prep cooler's condenser line leaks, and water builds up on the cooler bottom. One burner stove sits outside the ventilation hood and must be moved under it or removed.

headline: No certified manager on site during food service
summary: No valid certified food manager was on site while time- and temperature-controlled (TCS) foods like smoothies and oatmeal were prepared. The manager arrived at the end of the inspection.

headline: Loose faucet at prep sink
summary: The faucet on a one-compartment sink in the front prep area is loose at its base and must be repaired.

headline: Food stored on floor; milk crates, dirty fans
summary: Food was stored on the prep-area floor and must be raised six inches. Milk crates are used for elevation and must be replaced to avoid pest hiding spots. Walk-in fan covers, dumpster area and utility floors need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled packaged foods; cutting boards damaged
summary: Packaged foods in the self-service cooler lacked labels, including seasoned cow stomach, dried meat, and pork and vegetables. The garbage-area door has an opening at its bottom that must be rodent-proofed. Cutting boards are discolored and deeply cut.

headline: Missing sink stopper; dirty equipment and walls
summary: The three-compartment sink is missing one stopper. Cooking equipment, including the microwave and stove burner covers, had food splatter and buildup. Prep-area walls and floors, especially behind equipment, need deep cleaning.

headline: Damaged rear door gaps; floors and vents dirty
summary: Damaged weather stripping on the rear exit door leaves gaps that must be repaired to prevent pests. Food debris and dirt were under and behind cooking equipment, and dust covered restroom ceiling vents.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dirty floors and vents
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at several bar, restroom and prep sinks. Floors under equipment and in corners had grease and debris. Dust covered the walk-in fan, light shields and vents. Kitchen lighting was dim.

headline: Rear floors and cooking filters need cleaning
summary: Rear floors should be cleaned and kept dry to prevent a breeding place for pests. Filters above cooking equipment need cleaning to remove debris.

headline: Greasy walls and equipment; dead insects found
summary: Dirty walls with food splatter behind cook's line and gas stove; greasy proofer rack and wall fan. Cooking equipment, containers, racks, and shelving had buildup of flour, dust, grease, dead insects, and dirt; detail cleaning required.

headline: Rusted cooler shelves; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Rusted and chipped shelves in small cooler must be repaired or replaced. Women's restroom needs covered sanitary napkin receptacles in each stall. Several kitchen ceiling tiles missing and some stained.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; wall holes
summary: No handwashing signage at hand-wash sinks; signage must be posted. Small holes in walls in preparation and dishwashing areas must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager on duty; PIC absent
summary: No person in charge present during inspection. No certified food manager on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served. Employees ate and drank in the prep area. Ice machine lining was not cleaned.

headline: Dead roaches found; thawing in standing water
summary: Two dead roaches in dishwashing area near grease trap; removal instructed. Sauce package thawing submerged in still water, not an approved thawing method. Greasy floors, wet food spills, and a wet mop stored in bucket noted.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; utensils not drying
summary: Bulk containers such as salt and sugar were not labeled. Multi-use utensils, including deli cups and carafes, were not air-dried; use a drying rack. Ice scoop placed on dusty ice maker; store in a clean holder.

headline: Pink and brown residue dripping into ice
summary: Pink and brown substance on ice machine's interior dripped onto ice used for consumption. Staff emptied and cleaned the machine during inspection; priority citation issued. Drains had grease and food debris; prep area floors and walls had debris.

headline: Men's room lacks hot water; wastewater on floor
summary: First-floor men's room hand sink measured 71°F; minimum is 100°F. Bar three-compartment sink wastewater is dumped onto the floor, and the floor drain backs up when water runs. Both are priority violations.

headline: Missing signage, leaking sink, spider webs
summary: Hibachi prep hand-wash sink lacked signage. Ice scoop stored on top of ice machine. Leak under three-compartment sink; spider webs on wok hood filters; blown-out walk-in freezer light; disorganized storage closet.

headline: Grease dripping from sink's grease trap
summary: Excessive grease dripping from the grease trap under the three-compartment sink. Operator instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: No hand sink for pastry prep; overflowing garbage
summary: Front pastry prep area needs a hand-washing sink with hot and cold water, soap, and paper towels. Rear hand sink is blocked by two prep tables. Outside waste receptacle overflowing; no grease receptacle for deep fryer. Priority violations noted.

headline: Front door gap needs tight seal
summary: Front entrance door has a quarter-inch gap at the bottom left side. A tight-fitting seal is required at all outer openings to prevent pest entry.

headline: About 25 live flying insects; pest control needed
summary: About 25 live small flying insects and one house fly in basement prep, beverage station, bar, and dining area; more pest control needed. Several food handlers lacked valid food handler certificates. Fryers, drains, and ceiling tiles also need cleaning.

headline: Meat slicer not cleaned; no allergen certificate
summary: Meat slicer not cleaned properly behind blade and blade housing. Food service manager had no allergen certificate; must obtain one.

headline: Food debris on shelves; broken tile in storage
summary: Spills and dried food debris on shelving, prep tables, and equipment in the used-dish return area. Broken tile or base where bulk containers are stored in the rear must be replaced.

headline: Ice machine residue; food contact practices
summary: Small pink residue in ice machine panel crease; ordered cleaned. Wiping cloth stored in direct contact with basil; bowl used as broth scoop in walk-in cooler. Management told to stop both practices.

headline: Spills on counters and drive-thru floor
summary: Front counter tops must be cleaned to remove spills or debris. Drive-thru area floors need cleaning to remove spills.

headline: No employee health policy or food handler certificates
summary: No employee health policy on site; one must be provided and kept on site. Hand-washing sinks lacked signs. No food handler certificates on site; employees need them, with a 30-day grace period for new hires.

headline: Dirty dicer; damaged floors; no allergen training
summary: Mounted dicer in dishwashing area was not clean. Floors around front prep cooking equipment were damaged and not smooth. Manager lacked allergen training certificate. Summary report was not posted; a new one was posted and a citation issued.

headline: Insect carcasses throughout facility
summary: Insect carcasses found throughout the facility, including the toilet room, storage room, and kitchen. Manager was instructed to remove them. Storage room with water heater is cluttered and must be decluttered.

headline: Front door gap; food handler training missing
summary: Front door has a 1/4-inch gap at bottom and does not close properly; must be sealed to prevent pests. Food handlers lacked hair restraints; an employee had no food handler training. Ashtray with cigarette butts in rear storage must be removed.

headline: Loose hand sink; unused refrigerator in basement
summary: Exposed hand-washing sink in front prep area is loose and coming off the wall; must be secured. Unused white refrigerator in basement storage must be removed from the premises.

headline: Dead cockroaches in dish room; drain problems
summary: Several dead cockroaches on floor along a wall base in dish room; operator told to clean and maintain. Bar hand sink drains slowly. Three-compartment sink stopper in poor repair; nylon sheets used to plug drain. Restroom ventilation broken.

headline: No employee health policies; door gap
summary: No employee health policies on site; must be provided, including documentation that employees report transmissible illness. Front entrance door has a one-inch gap at the bottom; a door sweep is needed. Furnace room needs decluttering and cleaning.

headline: Rat droppings and live flies in storage
summary: Fifteen rat droppings on floor in rear storage area; six live flies in the same area and at the three-compartment sink. Remove and detail clean affected areas; call pest service. Clutter outside washroom must be removed.

headline: Several cold foods above safe temperature; discarded
summary: Raw eggs at 48.6°F, tofu at 47.6°F, cooked corn at 50.0°F, fried tofu at 51.0°F, and cut leafy greens at 46.0°F were held above the 41°F limit. About 15 lbs ($120) discarded on site. Staff skipped rinsing between washing and sanitizing.

headline: Cooler too warm; chlorine at 0 ppm
summary: Cook line cooler at 53.4°F; Italian beef, beef, hot dogs, and cheese were too warm and discarded. Cooler tagged until repaired. Final rinse had 0 ppm chlorine, corrected on site to 100 ppm. No food handler training proof.

headline: Ice machine residue; greasy hood filters
summary: Brown substance on inside opening lip of ice machine; must be cleaned. Dirt and debris under and around equipment in rear prep and front bar floors; clean to prevent pests. Hood filters have grease buildup.

headline: Black mold buildup in ice machine
summary: Excessive black mold-like buildup on ice machine's inside panel above the ice. Operator must remove all ice, clean, and sanitize. Basement prep sink lacked hand-washing signage. Milk, sugar, and dry foods were uncovered. Priority citation issued.

headline: Black mold-like substance in soda ice dispenser
summary: Ice dispenser on the self-service soda machine had black mold-like substance on its food-contact surface. Operator must clean, sanitize, and maintain it. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Bare-hand food handling; 150 mouse droppings
summary: Food handlers cut pork and served it to go with bare hands; product discarded. About 150 mouse droppings and 10 small flies in rear prep and dishwashing area, including on basement shelves and stairs. Pest control recommended.

headline: Missing food handler training; sink stoppers absent
summary: No food handler training for employees; must be provided and records kept. Missing stoppers for three-compartment sink. Dust and debris in walk-in cooler and shelving; damaged floor tiles, stained ceiling tiles, and wall openings noted.

headline: Meats held too warm; 5.5 lbs discarded
summary: Corned beef 46°F, bacon 68.1°F in kitchen fridge; chicken wings 46.2°F, bacon 46°F in walk-in. Cold foods must be 41°F or below. About 5.5 lbs ($80) discarded on site. Ice bin not clean; a prior core violation was not corrected.

headline: Bar hand sink at 74°F; no certificate posted
summary: Bar hand-wash sink measured 74°F; minimum is 100°F. No original City food sanitation certificate posted. Dumpster overflowed and prevented lid closing. Summary report not posted; allergen training proof was also missing.

headline: Dish machine not reaching 160°F
summary: High-temperature dish machine raised utensils to only 152°F; must be repaired to reach at least 160°F. Priority citation issued. Two cutting boards grooved and stained; three hood lightbulbs out; bar freezer heavily iced.

headline: Coolers too warm; no hot water; no training
summary: Prep cooler at 47.2°F and several coolers inoperable; cold foods must stay at 41°F or below. No hot water at multiple sinks, no employee health policy, and no food handler training for employees. Managers lack allergen training.

headline: Ice maker cover off; sink used for storage
summary: Cover panel removed from ice maker around upper coils; replace to prevent ice contamination. A three-compartment sink compartment was used to store clean utensils; keep all three clear and use a drying rack.

headline: Cooling food covered tightly; sink pedals worn
summary: Cooked pasta, brisket, and chili were covered with lids while cooling in walk-in coolers; store loosely covered or uncovered while cooling. Front hand-wash sink foot pedals in poor repair. Outdoor grease receptacle grate heavily soiled.

headline: Truck openings must be sealed against pests
summary: Mobile food truck passenger door has openings along the bottom corner and steel plating under the steering wheel. Operator must seal all outer openings to make the truck pest-proof.

headline: Cleaning fixed on site; allergen training expired
summary: Ice machine interior, can opener blade, and kitchen storage floors were cleaned on site. Floor drains, floor behind ice machine, and dishwasher vent dust still needed cleaning. Expired allergen training certificates were a repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; about $400 discarded
summary: Various cold foods held at 44-50°F, above the 41°F limit. Manager discarded 2 gallons milk, 8 lbs pasta salad, 7 lbs turkey sandwiches, 5 lbs fruit cups, 7 lbs yogurt, and 6 lbs eggs ($400). Soil found behind small walk-in cooler.

headline: Improper thawing and unlabeled dry storage
summary: Improper thawing methods used for some TCS foods (foods that must be kept cold or hot). Cold holding units lacked ambient air thermometers. Dry storage in rear prep unlabeled; leak under three-compartment sink. Food manager lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: Mold-like buildup in dairy coolers and shelves
summary: Green mold-like buildup on dairy walk-in storage racks and shelves; white mold-like buildup inside pre-packaged cheese display cooler. Display cooler vents have dust and dried food debris. Area under rear dumpster needs detail cleaning.

headline: Rodent droppings found; food held too warm
summary: About 65 rodent droppings inside and about 50 outside the rear door. Dead gnat found on sliced cheese; discarded. Cold foods at 44.9-48.1°F discarded; pizza cooling unit at 59.9°F tagged. No certified person in charge; no employee health policy.

headline: No hair restraints; no allergen training for managers
summary: Employees were not wearing hair restraints during food prep and service. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of sanitizer. Certified managers lacked allergen training. Earlier hand-washing signs and water pressure issues not corrected.

headline: Minor ice machine residue; unlabeled flour
summary: Ice machine interior had minor brownish buildup on the panel; ordered cleaned and sanitized. Dry flour containers were not labeled with the product name; ordered labeled.

headline: No soap or paper towels at hand sink
summary: Ice cream and smoothie stand hand sink had no soap or paper towels; this priority violation was merged into one citation. Leaking faucets and ice buildup in prep coolers noted. Heavy grease in exhaust hood; foil lining shelves ordered removed.

headline: Unlabeled desserts; food stored on cooler floor
summary: Packaged desserts in grab-and-go cooler lacked required labels: ingredients, net weight, allergens, and business name and address. Boxed food on walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Rusty walk-in shelves must be cleaned.

headline: Two untrained food employees; missing signage
summary: Two food employees lacked food handler training; training and records must be kept on site. Handwashing signs missing at sinks in 4th-floor catering prep room and event bar. Dust on women's restroom vents needs cleaning.

headline: Sink drain, aerator, and floors need attention
summary: Three-compartment sink drain needs detail cleaning. Aerator at one-compartment sink needs repair. Floors under three-compartment sink and in coffee/storage room need detail cleaning.

headline: Basement prep lacks hand sink; cook untrained
summary: Basement food prep area lacks a hand-washing sink with hot and cold water; must install one or remove prep table, slicer, and food prep materials. Cook had no food handler training. Unused coolers and clutter must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: No sanitizer test devices; expired food handler cards
summary: No chemical sanitizer testing devices on site. Several food handler cards were expired. Meat cutting prep sink lacked hand-washing signage. Hood over cook line had heavy grease. Repeat violation: no covered trash can in rear employee washroom.

headline: Wastewater spilling from sink; ice machine slime
summary: Wastewater spilled onto the floor when draining the three-compartment sink; operator told to drain slowly and clean pipes until the plumber fixed it. Priority citation issued. Slight yellow slime in ice machine; freezer door gasket torn.

headline: Pizza held too cool; no employee health policy
summary: Pizza slices held at 106.5-120.9°F in hot-holding unit; must be 135°F or above, and were discarded. Pizza unit at 109.4°F was adjusted to 172.4°F during inspection. No signed employee health policies; 3-compartment sink backs up.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: No person in charge with valid certificate, and no certified manager on site when chicken was prepared and served. Food debris on equipment, floors, and in corners; litter around dumpster. Missing baseboards and floor tiles; water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Missing restroom signage; expired allergen training
summary: Unisex customer restroom lacked handwashing signage. Food managers had expired allergen training certificates; they must renew them and keep certificates on site.

headline: Missing signs; grease on hood filters
summary: Second-level bar used for private events lacked hand-washing signage. Grime under the three-compartment sink drain; torn gaskets on a cold holding unit; unused cooker used as prep space; greasy hood filters. Operator told to clean and remove unused equipment.

headline: Live roaches on grease trap; food not date-marked
summary: Three live roaches crawled on the grease trap near the three-compartment sink; professional pest control required. Ready-to-eat cold foods held over 24 hours lacked date marks, and stored foods lacked name labels. Utensils stored inside dry food containers.

headline: Food on floor; liners used; sink stoppers missing
summary: Dry food on rear storage floor must be raised 6 inches. Cardboard, foil, and plastic wrap used as liners. Prep handwash sink drains slowly; three-compartment sink lacks stoppers. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food stored on floor
summary: Bulk flour, sugar, and lettuce containers lacked labels. Food was stored on the floor in both walk-in coolers. Milk crates were used as shelving in the hot prep area and walk-in cooler; shelving must be at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; stop using it
summary: Very thick black, slimy substance inside the ice machine lining was dripping onto ice. Management was told not to use the machine until it is cleaned and sanitized. Priority citation issued.

headline: Worn door weather strip; freezer needs cleaning
summary: Worn weather strip at bottom of front door must be replaced to prevent pest entry. Ice cream display freezer interior must be defrosted and cleaned. Washroom needs a lidded garbage can.

headline: Washroom ventilation not working
summary: Washroom ventilation was not working. Operator instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Broken self-closing device on washroom door
summary: Washroom door's self-closing device is broken. Operator must repair and maintain it.

headline: Dim walk-in cooler; no allergen training
summary: Walk-in cooler had insufficient lighting; additional lighting required. No allergen training for City of Chicago food managers; training must be provided and certificates kept on site.

headline: Vacuum packaging machine tagged; rodent-proofing needed
summary: Vacuum packaging machine was tagged and held for health department approval; no citation issued. Rear exit door needs rodent proofing, and a pest control box is damaged. Hood condensation noted; missing allergen training certificates.

headline: Insect traps holding dead insects above prep
summary: Four insect control devices holding dead insects were stored above prep coolers in the rear food prep area; they must be relocated. Only two food handler certificates were on site, and no allergen training certificate was shown.

headline: Expired sushi rice lab letter; no pH meter
summary: Expired lab letter for sushi rice and no pH meter on site; both were required. Heavy grease on cooking equipment, floors, and exhaust filters; some exhaust filters were removed above the fryer and wok. Citation issued.

headline: Dead roaches throughout; sink lacked water pressure
summary: Numerous dead roaches found throughout, including in cold holding units and cabinets. Women's restroom hand sink had no water pressure, and handwashing signs were missing. Ice machine had mold-like buildup; grease and debris noted.

headline: Loose faucet at men's restroom sink
summary: Loose faucet at the men's restroom hand-wash sink. Operator must repair and maintain it.

headline: Food stored on floor; leaking sink; certificates missing
summary: Food stored on walk-in cooler floor; an ice scoop lay on ice at the bar. Three-compartment sink leaks when drained, and water was collected in containers. No food handler certificates on site; manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Live rodent found; bare-hand food handling
summary: Cook handled ready-to-eat cheese with bare hands and was told to discard it. Live rodent near cook's handwashing sink; about 40-50 droppings in flour storage. Also 15-20 mouse droppings by three-compartment sink and 7-10 house flies.

headline: Raw chicken, noodles, and eggs held too warm
summary: Raw chicken at 52.0°F in main kitchen cooler; cooked noodles at 68.7°F and raw eggs at 67.9°F at grill line. About 25 lbs ($80) discarded on site. Two food handlers lacked valid food handler training or certificates on site.

headline: Unmarked bulk containers; leaking faucet
summary: Bulk food containers not marked with commodity name. Glue traps were dusty and need replacing. Leak at three-compartment sink faucet; hand-sink handle in prep needs replacing. Rear toilet lacks self-closing door; unisex toilets need covered waste cans.

headline: Missing backflow devices at ice machine
summary: No backflow prevention devices found at ice machine or mop sink faucet. Operator must provide them where they can be located and serviced.

headline: Mold on ice machine; missing test strips
summary: Black mold-like buildup on ice machine door, not touching ice; must be cleaned. No test device for high-temperature dish machine final rinse; person in charge obtained strips during inspection. Dusty ceiling vents and greasy hood filters.

headline: No garbage service or dumpster on premises
summary: No commercial dumpster or garbage service for the premises; operator must provide one. Backflow prevention device not found on ice machine and must be installed. Priority citation issued for garbage.

headline: 50-60 droppings in storage; fish thawed in packaging
summary: About 50-60 droppings found in storage areas of meat, produce, and prepared foods departments. Clean, sanitize, and call pest control. Fish was thawing in vacuum packaging. Bulk containers unlabeled; no sanitizer test strips at 3-compartment sinks.

headline: Three-compartment sink not working properly
summary: The three-compartment dishwashing sink is not in working order. When one compartment drains, another floods before draining. Manager was instructed to repair it. Priority violation citation issued.

headline: No food handler training proof for employees
summary: No proof of food handler training or certificates for employees. Operator must provide documentation.

headline: Food debris and open wall in rear storage
summary: Equipment surfaces where microwave and drink dispenser sit have food debris; must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Unfinished open wall in rear storage near office must be enclosed to prevent pest entry.

headline: No certified manager during deli meat prep
summary: No certified manager on site while deli meat and other TCS items were prepared; a certified employee must be on site at all times. One of three certified managers lacked allergen training. Repeat violation for missing food handler certificates.

headline: Mouse droppings outside near dumpster
summary: Mouse droppings found on the ground outside near the dumpster area, with numerous milk crates stored there. Unnecessary items must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Outside oil tank had heavy grease and must be cleaned.

headline: Flies in storage; no certified manager on duty
summary: About 15 small flies in basement dry storage; pest control consultation required. No person in charge with valid certificate, and no certified food manager on duty while food was prepared and served. Food handlers lacked hair restraints and training records.

headline: Dead roach above sink; no toilet paper
summary: Dead cockroach on shelf above three-compartment sink; must be cleaned and sanitized. Frozen chicken was thawing on the sink drainboard, not an approved method. No written employee health policy, and no toilet paper was provided.

headline: Missing utility sink and grease trap
summary: No utility sink on site; one with hot and cold water and a backflow device must be installed. No grease trap for three-compartment sink. Washroom door lacks self-closing device; missing baseboards and wall openings near pizza oven must be sealed.

headline: Dead roaches in several areas; ice bin uncovered
summary: Dead roaches found on dry storage floors, behind the stove, inside a prep cooler, and under the POS computer; all must be removed. Ice bin was uncovered while unattended. Hand-wash signage missing. Previous summary report not posted; a new one was posted.

headline: Leaking women's restroom hand sink
summary: Hand sink on the right side of the women's washroom leaks from the bottom. Operator instructed to repair the leak.

headline: Two food employees lacked food handler training
summary: Two food employees on site had no food handler training or certificates; must be trained and certificates kept on site. Heavy grease and condensation on hood filter above deep fryer; fryer and cooler exteriors soiled.

headline: Missing sign; basement ceiling openings
summary: Missing hand-washing sign in upstairs men's toilet room. Openings in basement ceiling near waste pipes must be sealed to prevent pests. Ice machine lip had dark buildup; drains and vent need cleaning; front bar hand sink drains slowly.

headline: Door gap, washroom issues, training required
summary: Front door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that could let pests in; weather stripping required. Washroom lacked a lidded trash can and a self-closing door. Manager told to meet food handler training requirements.

headline: Broken dumpster lid; ice bin needs cleaning
summary: Outside dumpster has broken lid(s); priority citation issued. Ice bin interior and exterior need cleaning. Food storage containers lacked labels, and no proof of food handler training for all handlers was on site. Menu raw-food advisory incomplete.

headline: Rat droppings in basement; refrigerator tagged
summary: About 50 rat droppings found along walls in basement storage. Beef at 50.1°F and chicken at 48.7°F in display cooler were discarded by manager. A refrigerator at 55.1°F was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected.

headline: Greasy equipment and floors; no allergen training
summary: Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and freezers, and on floors under equipment and in corners. Storage area walls and baseboards had cracks. Certified managers lacked valid allergen training. Single-use items not inverted.

headline: No prep sink; door opening and wall gaps
summary: Opening at base of patio service door must be sealed to prevent pests. First-floor prep area lacks a prep/dump sink, which must be installed. Missing grout and holes in ceiling and walls in prep and basement areas must be repaired.

headline: Hot pizza and cheese held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Pizza slices at 115-125°F in carryout hot-holding unit; must stay 135°F or above. Sliced cheese at 44°F in line prep cooler; must stay 41°F or below. Priority citation issued. Cracked crouton containers and slow-draining hand sink noted.

headline: Door openings and no washroom ventilation
summary: Openings at base of front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests. Two wheelchair-accessible stall doors lack self-closing devices. Washroom has no mechanical ventilation; must be installed.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Food scoop stored in a container of room-temperature water; operator told to store in-use utensils properly. Kitchen staff had no food handler certificate. Food service managers had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Slight leak under prep table
summary: Slight leak at a pipe under a prep table against the front wall. Operator instructed to repair or replace it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Expired allergen training for two managers
summary: Two certified food managers had expired allergen training certificates. Operator instructed that anyone holding a City food sanitation certificate must complete current allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled containers; cutting boards need replacing
summary: Food storage containers lacked common-name labels. An ice scoop was stored on the ice machine, and glassware was not inverted. Cutting boards were discolored and cut, and floors along prep-area walls had buildup. Management was told to correct these during the visit.

headline: Grease trap encrusted with food debris
summary: The grease trap in the dish area had encrusted food debris. Management was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Cold foods above safe limits; $20 discarded
summary: Sliced tomatoes at 45.6°F, corned beef at 48.7°F, and pastrami at 47.7°F were held in a cooler above safe temperature. The manager discarded about 15 pounds voluntarily. Cutting boards in the front prep area had deep cuts and stains, and walk-in storage racks were rusted.

headline: Minor debris on meat slicer; basement clutter
summary: Minor food debris was on the meat slicer and needed cleaning. The basement had clutter, and items were stored directly on the ground. Management must remove unnecessary items and raise everything at least six inches.

headline: No certified manager; foods held too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were served, and a citation was issued. Various cold foods held at 48 to 50°F were discarded. An employee had no hair restraint, and sticky debris covered floors in the bar, wine storage, and dish areas.

headline: Handwashing sink used for storage; signage needed
summary: A handwashing sink was used to store clean trays. The manager removed them during the inspection. A handwashing sign was needed in the women's restroom, and the three-compartment sink lacked a drainboard. Minor debris was under sinks in the prep area.

headline: Live roach found; no hot water in restroom
summary: One live roach was observed on site, and pest control was highly recommended. A citation was issued. The employee restroom sink had no hot water, and kitchen sinks lacked paper towels, a citation was issued. Other problems: no soap or handwashing signs at sinks, no chlorine test strips, no toilet tissue, no bodily fluid cleanup kit, and no allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled rice container; allergen certificates incomplete
summary: A bulk rice container had no label and must be labeled with its common name. Heavy grease spills on the floor under the fryers need cleaning. Allergen training certificates for certified food managers were incomplete.

headline: Dumpster overflowing; mold-like ice machine buildup
summary: Black mold-like buildup was found inside the ice machine, and the ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned. A citation was issued. The outside dumpster was overflowing and could not close, and another citation was issued. The basement door was not tight-fitting, restrooms lacked handwashing signs, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Missing license number and garbage can on truck
summary: The business license number was not printed on the driver's side of the mobile food truck. No garbage can was on the truck. Management was instructed to provide both.

headline: Dead insects, clutter, and greasy surfaces
summary: Dead insects were on the basement storage floor and needed cleaning. Frozen meat was stored in a plastic grocery bag. Clutter on the basement floor could create pest hiding places. Greasy floors, walls, and hood filters need cleaning, and a rear prep wall needs repair.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; pest service needed
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found across the front display area, second-floor storage, electrical closet, lunchroom, and rear storage. A citation was issued, and the inspector recommended licensed pest control. Other issues include handwashing signage, a missing meat cooler thermometer, deep cutting board seams, and dirty floors and coolers.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; mouse droppings found
summary: No certified food manager was on site, and no employee health policy or vomit cleanup plan was available. Prep cooler air reached 61.2°F, and food inside reached 56.8 to 59.2°F. Over 100 mouse droppings were found in the bakery and under a sink, with 20 more in a cabinet. Open pastries were uncovered but corrected on site. Prior violations remained uncorrected.

headline: Rusty prep tables; grout and floor drains
summary: Rusted bottoms of rear prep tables must be repainted or replaced. Floor grout in prep, storage, and dishwashing areas must be repaired. Dirt and dust were on floor drains in prep and dishwashing areas.

headline: Display cooler too warm; $250 food discarded
summary: Shrimp at 48.2°F, fish at 49.5°F, and chicken at 45.6°F were in the display cooler. About 50 pounds were discarded voluntarily, and a citation was issued. The meat cooler ran at 52°F and must be repaired. Cutting boards have open seams and stains, and debris and oil were behind the fryers.

headline: No prep sink in pantry area
summary: The pantry areas on floors 30 to 32 have no prep sink. Management was instructed to provide one.

headline: Milk crates used for elevating food
summary: Milk crates were used to elevate products and must be replaced with approved shelving. A ceiling tile was missing in the dishwashing area, and another was water-damaged above a dairy cooler. Dust was on vents, and dirt and debris were on floors in storage and in the produce cooler.

headline: Unlabeled containers; no drainboard; prior violations
summary: Bulk containers in basement dry storage had no labels, a prior violation not corrected. There was no drainboard at the kitchen dish three-compartment sink, and a citation was issued. Basement storage had clutter, including tools and garbage.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; flying insects found
summary: Diced tomatoes, raw eggs, raw chicken, ground beef, Italian beef, and tzatziki were held between 51°F and 53.3°F in the walk-in cooler. About $300 and 150 pounds were discarded. The cooler was tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Numerous flying insects were found, and a 1/4-inch gap was seen at the rear door.

headline: Multiple unlabeled food containers and upkeep issues
summary: Bulk containers lacked labels and some lids were cracked. Single-service items were stored under a handwashing sink, and a freezer gasket was damaged. Debris covered coolers and shelves, and a leak was found under a sink. Clutter, wall and floor damage, dirty ceilings, and missing light shields were also noted.

headline: Cooked chicken held too warm; $100 discarded
summary: Forty pounds of cooked chicken in two buckets were held at 54.4°F in the prep cooler, after being placed there a day earlier. Cold foods must be kept at 41°F or lower. The chicken was discarded, valued at about $100. Also: missing handwashing signs and a missing backflow device for basement ice makers.

headline: Rodent droppings and gnawed food; major discards
summary: About 100 rat and mouse droppings were found in rear storage and the walk-in cooler, with about 20 more by the rear door. Rodent bait was left open in storage. Gnawed and water-damaged food was found, and about $13,000 of food was discarded for temperature or condition. Cooler temperatures ran as high as 55.9°F. No chemical sanitizer was on site. More pest control is needed.

headline: Clutter and debris throughout; prep coolers dirty
summary: Interiors of front reach-in prep coolers and basement deep freezers must be cleaned of spills and debris. Floors throughout the facility need detailed cleaning. Clutter in storage areas must be organized to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: No certified manager; undated cooked chicken
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were handled and served, and a citation was issued. Cooked chicken was held in the walk-in cooler over 24 hours without a discard date. Disposable plastic spoons were used in food production, and sink stoppers were missing. No food handler training was on site for kitchen staff.

headline: Pork thawing unsafely; uncovered bulk containers
summary: Pork was thawing under a prep table, which is not an approved method. Bulk containers were uncovered in the rear prep area, and an open soda bottle was on a prep table. Food spills were on closet doors, and wall openings in the rear prep area must be sealed.

headline: Missing signage, thermometer, and bar sink issues
summary: Handwashing signs were missing in the main kitchen and employee restroom. A dairy cooler lacked an air thermometer. A prior priority violation was not corrected: the bar lacks a handwashing sink, and a one-compartment dump sink has no hot water. A citation was issued.

headline: Dirty walk-in floor; food splatter by flour storage
summary: The walk-in cooler floor under the shelving needs detailed cleaning. Dried food splatter on the wall where flours are stored must be cleaned to prevent possible insect activity.

headline: No certified manager on site; ice slime found
summary: The person in charge lacked proof of food safety training, and no certified manager was on site while TCS foods were handled. A citation was issued. The ice machine interior had black slime, and ice is used for consumption. Paper towels were missing at a handwashing sink, corrected during the inspection, and a 5-inch hole in the walk-in floor needs repair.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No written procedure or supplies for cleaning vomit and diarrhea were available during the inspection. Management was told to provide and keep them on site. No citation was issued. The women's restroom also needs closed waste receptacles.

headline: Ice bin lid and backflow device needed
summary: The ice bin behind the bar needs a tight-fitting lid. The backflow device was not located at the ice machine and must be installed so it can be serviced. Both washroom doors need self-closing devices.

headline: No written health policy; no handler training proof
summary: Written employee health policies were missing for employees, with only two on site. No proof of food handler training was available for any employee. Wiping cloths needed sanitizer storage, and unused equipment outdoors must be removed. Single-service items were stored in a bathroom, a repeat violation, and a citation was issued.

headline: Moldy meat and slime on ice; $23 discarded
summary: Sliced Canadian bacon with mold and tomato sauce stored in a tin with mold were discarded, about 6 pounds. Ice used for consumption had black, pink, and brown slime dripping onto it, and a citation was issued. Ready-to-eat foods lacked date labels. No metal stem thermometer was on site. The pest log had no service reports. Plates and cooking equipment were dirty.

headline: Cold foods too warm; coolers taken out of use
summary: Salsa at 50.7°F, cooked rice at 47.1°F, and raw beef at 45.4°F were discarded and denatured with bleach. Two cook-line coolers held at 50.2°F and 52.0°F were tagged and must stop storing food until repaired and reinspected. A cooler lacked an air thermometer. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and bowls were used as scoops.

headline: Bread stored on floor; floors dusty
summary: Bread containers were stored on the floor in the rear receiving area and must be raised at least six inches. Loose debris and dust were on floors and corners throughout the facility, and floors need detailed cleaning.

headline: Missing thermometers; food stored on floor
summary: Freezers and a display cooler lacked ambient air thermometers. Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor, and food handlers prepped without hair restraints. Scoops were stored inside dry containers, and food was in plastic grocery bags. Dirt and debris were on the exhaust vents.

headline: Food debris on floors; greasy and unfinished walls
summary: Plastic film was left on the outside of a dish machine and a freezer. Food debris was on floors in the rear prep area, including under a freezer, a refrigerator, and behind a hot water tank. Walls behind air fryers were greasy, and a wall behind a stove needs smoothing for cleaning.

headline: Front door gaps and leaking faucet
summary: The front doors had 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom and between doors, which must be repaired to prevent pest entry. The three-compartment sink faucet was wrapped in tape and leaked. The city certified manager on site lacked allergen training.

headline: Dining room door gap at threshold
summary: The dining room exit door to the outdoor patio had an open half-inch gap at the bottom threshold. A tight-fitting seal is required.

headline: Cold foods above safe temperature; $90 discarded
summary: Yogurt, cheese, and chorizo in service coolers were 53.7 to 66.3°F. The manager discarded about 9 pounds voluntarily, a citation was issued. A prep-area cooler at 66.6°F was ordered out of use until fixed. Also: an uncleaned ice machine, employees without hair restraints, and an overloaded dumpster with its lid open.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; unlabeled containers
summary: Handwashing signs were needed at all handsinks in prep, dishwashing, and washrooms. Food storage containers lacked common-name labels. Floors along walls and under equipment in the bar area needed cleaning.

headline: Handwashing sink used for drink rinsing
summary: The bar handwashing sink was also used to rinse cups and glasses, and a rinser was placed directly in front of it. No splash guards were present, and a cooler gasket was dislodged. Aluminum foil lined a prep surface. A scrape-sink faucet handle was stripped and the hot and cold water did not always run.

headline: No certified manager on duty; training gaps
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate was present, and no certified manager was on duty during TCS food prep, handling, and service. A citation was issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces. Floors in the basement storage area had debris and dust.

headline: Grease buildup; six managers lack allergen training
summary: A fryer cabinet next to the oven had grease buildup and must be cleaned. About six certified food service managers lacked allergen training, which must be completed and maintained.

headline: Foods held over 24 hours without discard dates
summary: Cooked rice and beef were held more than 24 hours without discard dates, and a citation was issued. Also noted: a rusty cooler base, cardboard used as flooring liners in basement prep, food stored in plastic grocery bags, and soiled mop heads that were not hung up to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Damaged gaskets, rust, and missing sink fixtures
summary: Damaged gaskets were found on a small cooler, and walk-in shelving was rusty. Cups and bowls needed lead-safety documentation, and a backflow device was not located at a utility sink. The beverage station has no prep sink. Floor tiles are damaged, and washroom ceiling tiles are stained.

headline: Ice machine interior dirty; rear door gap
summary: The interior of the ice machine was not clean and needed to be cleaned. The outermost rear door to the alley had a 1/4-inch gap that must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Dead cockroaches; handwashing sink was blocked
summary: About 10 to 15 dead cockroaches were on the floor beneath and behind equipment in the warewashing area. No live pests were seen. A handwashing sink was blocked by a chest freezer and was cleared during inspection, and a citation was issued. Hand soap was missing at several sinks and was supplied on site. Ice machine parts need repair.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents; four burned-out kitchen lights
summary: Dirt and dust covered ceiling tiles and vent covers above the kitchen prep table. Four ceiling light fixtures in the kitchen had burned-out bulbs. Management was instructed to clean and replace them.

headline: Oversized pots can't be sanitized in sink
summary: Pots too large for the three-compartment sink must be removed or a written alternative cleaning procedure provided. Floors in the dishwashing area are in poor repair and need regrouting.

headline: Flying insects in prep, storage, and dishwashing
summary: Numerous flying insects were found in prep, storage, and dishwashing areas. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas, and a citation was issued. Rear doors lacked mesh protection, and some handwashing signs were missing. Other items included debris, missing tiles, and damaged light shields.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; drains need cleaning
summary: Bulk storage containers had no labels. The inside of the ice machine was cleaned on site, but fryers and burners still needed cleaning. The rear prep handwashing sink drains slowly, and dust was on light shields and vents. Drains under two sinks were dirty. Original food handler certificates were not on site.

headline: Rear door gap allows pest entry; leaking ceiling
summary: The rear outer door had a 1/2-inch gap underneath and was not rodent or insect proof. Floor corners had dirt and debris. A ceiling leak above the rear door must be fixed.

headline: Improper knife storage; dusty prep walls
summary: Knives not in use were stored between the wall and holder instead of in a clean holder. Prep area walls and air vents had dust and debris that need cleaning.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: The right faucet on the three-compartment sink leaked heavily from its base. The operator was instructed to repair it.

headline: Dirty fryers and racks; floor drain soiled
summary: A can opener had food and dirt buildup, and fryer interiors had thick dirt, dust, and grease. Storage racks had dirt and food buildup. A water-stained toilet ceiling tile needs replacement, and the floor drain under the sink and floors under cooking equipment had dirt and grease.

headline: Food stored on floor; hair restraints lacking
summary: Food and oil boxes were stored on floors upstairs and in basement dry storage. One employee with a large beard had no beard restraint. Food and equipment were stored under unshielded sewer lines. Three certified food managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Multiple unlabeled and uncovered items
summary: Food containers lacked common-name labels, and food containers were stored on the floor in prep and storage. Eating utensils were not inverted, and cardboard was used as a liner. A splashguard was needed between a handsink and the coffee area. Grease and debris were under cooking equipment, and a walk-in cooler threshold was broken. A freezer light was burned out, and no certified manager had allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; still-frozen food thawing on counter
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager with a city certificate was on duty while TCS foods were served. A citation was issued. Mini pizzas were thawing on the counter and were still frozen. No sanitizer test strip kit was on site, and a citation was issued. Walls, ceilings, and wall holes need repair.

headline: Mouse and rat droppings; prior violations uncorrected
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were found on the sales floor and motor room, and about 15 rat droppings in rear storage. A citation was issued and pest service is needed. Other issues included a leaking handwashing sink pipe, no food handler training, debris in ice machines, and uncorrected prior violations for missing restroom trash can and floor cleaning.

headline: Dusty cooler fan covers; greasy hood
summary: Dust had built up on cooler fan covers in the prep area. Grease had built up on the ventilation hood. Management must clean both.

headline: Scoops left in dry food; missing light shield
summary: Scoops were stored inside dry storage containers instead of in holders. Two three-compartment sink stoppers were missing, and a light shield was missing in the walk-in freezer.

headline: Missing signage, thermometers, and sink stoppers
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the rear deli handwashing sink. No air thermometers were in the walk-in coolers for dairy and meat. Two three-compartment sink stoppers were missing, and debris, including peanuts, was in the mop sink. Floors under prep tables need cleaning.

headline: Foam caulk exposed in utility closet
summary: Exposed foam-like caulk on walls and around pipes in the utility closet must be resurfaced to a smooth, cleanable finish.

headline: Floor holes under breakroom table
summary: Holes in the floor under a breakroom table in rear storage must be repaired to prevent pest entry. The walk-in cooler also has damaged flooring that needs repair to be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Homemade fruit cups missing ingredient labels
summary: House-made fruit and gelatin cups stored in the prep cooler had no ingredient labels. Management was instructed to add them.

headline: About 35 rodent droppings; citation issued
summary: About 35 large rodent droppings were found along walls, behind freezers, behind an ATM, under a coffee station, and in rear storage. The manager was told to clean them and keep the premises free of rodents, and a citation was issued. Damaged ceiling tiles, floor debris, and uncleaned cooking equipment were also noted.

headline: No valid manager certificate; wall damage
summary: No valid city sanitation manager certificate was on site while chicken and steak were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Damaged wall around a hallway utility box must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Unused equipment cluttering prep kitchen
summary: Unused equipment and unnecessary items were stored in the prep kitchen. Management was instructed to remove them and organize the space.

headline: Cooler at 51°F; food removed; rear door gap
summary: A two-door prep cooler held at 51°F with vegetables and other TCS foods. All food was ordered removed, and a citation was issued. The rear door's weather stripping was worn and must be replaced to prevent pest entry. Walk-in freezer floors, plumbing at the hand sink and dish sink, and the wok hood also need attention.

headline: No food handler certificates at inspection
summary: No food handler certificates were on site at the time of inspection. The person in charge was told to comply with Illinois food handler requirements and keep records.

headline: Ice machine backflow device not located
summary: The inspector could not locate the backflow prevention device on the ice machine. Management was instructed to find it or install one.

headline: Handwashing sinks missing; rodent droppings
summary: Handwashing sinks in the main and rear prep areas were not provided, and a citation was issued. About 70 small droppings were found across prep, storage, and cooking areas, with about 15 flies in the rear prep. The manager was told to eliminate pests. Food debris, water-stained tiles, missing floor tiles, and greasy hood buildup were also found.

headline: Low water pressure; $0 citation; poster missing
summary: Water pressure was too low at the three-compartment sink and a meat department handwashing sink. Ceiling tiles were water-damaged, and floor drains had dirt and food debris. Grease covered the hood and filters. The prior inspection summary was not posted, so a copy was given and a citation issued.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees ate and drank at the food prep area. Management must set up a separate break area. A front prep cooler also had a torn gasket.

headline: Rodent droppings; no pest log; grease buildup
summary: No pest control logbook was on site, and about 10 rodent droppings were behind the hot water heater, a citation was issued. Two outside grease units had buildup, and the container was not covered. A scoop was stored in the handwashing sink. Missing ceiling tiles above prep and prior violations for grease and debris were not corrected.

headline: Food buildup on kitchen ventilation hood
summary: Food buildup was found on the ventilation hood. The manager was instructed to clean it and keep it clean.

headline: Napkins stored against raw fish; corrected on site
summary: Napkins were stored in direct contact with salmon and tuna in the prep cooler. Management was told not to store napkins or linens with food. The employee removed the napkins from the food containers during the inspection.

headline: Grease and food debris on equipment and floors
summary: A rear freezer door gasket was torn. Grease and food debris covered cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and freezers. Food debris was also on floors along the walls.

headline: Mouse droppings throughout; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager was on site, and the sanitation certificate was expired. Over 1,000 mouse droppings were found in storage, prep, and sales areas, and a citation was issued. Also noted: missing handwashing signs, damaged floor and ceiling tiles, and prior violations not corrected.

headline: Handwashing water too cold; corrected on site
summary: Hot water at handwashing sinks measured 66.9 to 83.1°F, below the 100°F required. Service technicians corrected it, and the sinks then held 99 to 104°F. A citation was issued. The women's restroom lacked a covered trash can, and a mop was not stored to dry. No proof of food handler training was available.

headline: No valid manager certificate on site
summary: No valid city sanitation manager certificate was on site while chicken and potatoes were being served. A citation was issued. Food residue was found on a cooler and cold-hold gaskets, and residue was in restroom toilet bases and facility drains.

headline: Outdoor food units; bird droppings; no training proof
summary: Rusty freezers, a cooler holding cooked and thawing raw food, and unused coolers were outdoors in an unenclosed area with bird droppings on the fence and ground. These must move indoors, and food must be removed. Food handler and allergen training certificates were not on site.

headline: Hair restraints missing; leaking sink fixtures
summary: Employees in food prep areas were not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and an ice scoop was left on top of the ice machine. The rear handwashing faucet was held together with plastic, the three-compartment sink leaked, and cooking-area vent filters were greasy.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no certified manager
summary: About 15 small rodent droppings were in a storage closet near the kitchen entry, and five more were under a sink. A citation was issued. The person in charge lacked food safety training, and no valid manager certificate was on site. A handwashing sink had no hot water. Cutting boards had deep cuts and stains.

headline: Loose ice machine cover; cleaning and repairs needed
summary: The ice machine had a loose top and cover. Interior surfaces of prep and reach-in coolers needed detailed cleaning, and peeling paint was found on the ceiling above prep. Floors along walls and under storage racks also needed cleaning.

headline: Foods held too warm; $250 discarded
summary: Sushi, crab, and salmon in a display cooler reached 54.1 to 59.1°F, and about 15 pounds were discarded. A citation was issued. The original manager certificate was posted but the manager was absent, and a copy was delivered after the inspection. Food on floors, uncovered food, grease, and dirty vents also need attention.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: A food handler touched a ready-to-eat steak sandwich and tomatoes with bare hands, and a citation was issued. Handwashing sinks were blocked by cloths and brushes, and one lacked paper towels. About 36 eggs were held at 54 to 75°F and discarded. Steak sandwiches lacked discard dates, and some cutting boards were deeply grooved.

headline: Fly trap found; pest bait rules required
summary: Inspector found a fly trap in the main prep area that the pest control company did not provide. The manager was told bait stations must be installed by a licensed pest technician. Also: cutting boards with open seams and stains, raw wood in the deli, and a ceiling hole above the rear door.

headline: Torn gaskets taped; dirty storage shelving
summary: A two-door refrigerator in the rear prep area had torn gaskets held together with duct tape. Shelving holding microwaves and containers had dried food debris, and a cooler's interior surfaces were also dirty. The front prep area needs more lighting.

headline: Open food counter unprotected; no grease trap
summary: Food prep at the front counter had no barrier between customers and food. Milk crates were used as shelving, and two three-compartment sinks lacked a required grease trap. Plastic hung from an air conditioner above a sink. Not all food handlers had proof of training.

headline: Ice machine buildup; dirty deli walls
summary: A slight buildup was found inside the ice machine, and it must be cleaned. The walls at the rear of the deli prep area were not clean.

headline: Several staff lack food handler certificates
summary: Several food handlers had no food handler certificate, and the certified food manager lacked allergen training. Management was instructed to show proof for all. Also noted: grease on convection oven tops and garbage on the floor of the mezzanine dry storage.

headline: Food stored in standing water; wood and bags used
summary: An employee ate in the prep area. A falafel scoop was stored in standing water at 56.7°F, and raw wooden sticks were used to separate raw meat in a cooler. Plastic bags were used as food containers in a freezer. An unused ice machine must be removed. A dishwasher lacked food handler proof, and certified managers need allergen training.

headline: Dirty cloths and cutting boards; leaking drains
summary: Used wiping cloths were left on prep tables, and milk crates were used for elevation. Some cutting boards had dark stains and deep cuts. The low-temperature dish machine had leaking drain pipes, and a handwashing sink's hot water handle leaked. A light shield was broken, and the cement floor by the mop sink was rough.

headline: Food storage, hygiene, and labeling problems
summary: Employee prepared food without a hair restraint. Wiping cloths were on prep tables, and food was stored on the floor in the rear storage area. Prepackaged sweets lacked ingredient and allergen labels. Also: missing handwashing signs, a non-self-closing restroom door, peeling paint, and clutter that could attract rodents.

headline: Debris under deli prep coolers
summary: Debris was on floors under the deli prep coolers and in the prep area. It must be cleaned and kept clean.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The certified manager on duty did not have allergen training. Management must provide proof and keep it current.

headline: Food stored on floor; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the prep area, and bulk containers were not labeled. Residue was found inside the ice machine, and a food-prep sink faucet leaked. Food debris and spills were on floors under equipment and along walls. Management was instructed to correct each item.

headline: Quarter-inch gap at front entrance doors
summary: A 1/4-inch gap was found between the front entrance door sweeps. The manager must rodent-proof the doors.

headline: Dog in dining area, removed during inspection
summary: The owner had a dog in the customer dining area. The owner removed it during inspection, and a citation was issued. A rear hand sink drains slowly, and backflow devices were missing at the hot water dispenser and coffee machine.

headline: Prep cooler air too warm at 60F
summary: The prep cooler's air temperature was 60.0F. Cold-holding units must stay at 41F or below. A priority violation was cited.

headline: Vacuum packing without approved plan
summary: A vacuum packaging machine was on site without a variance or an approved HACCP (food safety) plan. The food and machine were tagged, and the manager must obtain approval before vacuum packing. The certified manager's allergen training had expired.

headline: Foil on shelves; cardboard under mats
summary: Aluminum foil is on storage shelves and must be removed. Cardboard is under floor mats and must be removed. Debris is on the wall behind the warewashing machine. The certified manager was missing allergen training and must obtain it.

headline: Leaks at three-compartment sink; detail cleaning
summary: The three-compartment sink has multiple leaks and must be repaired. The ice machine and walk-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning. Floors throughout need detail cleaning to remove spills, debris, and grease.

headline: Black mold-like substance inside ice machine
summary: The ice machine interior and chute were heavily soiled with a black mold-like substance. Ice must be discarded, and the machine cleaned and sanitized, since the ice is for people to eat. A food-storage container was on the cooler floor, and the fryer door had plastic lining.

headline: Dirt on floor behind bar
summary: Dirt has built up on the floor behind the bar. The person in charge must detail clean the floor and maintain it.

headline: Food debris on meat slicer and walls
summary: Accumulated food debris was found on the meat slicer. Food stains and debris were on walls at the prep and dishwashing areas. The manager must clean the slicer and walls and keep them clean.

headline: No health policy; coolers off; no pest log
summary: No written employee health policy was on site, a priority violation. Coolers and freezers in prep and dish areas were off and must hold 41F or colder and 0F for frozen food. No metal stem thermometer or pest control log book was available.

headline: Pinkish substance in ice machine; repeat violations
summary: A pinkish substance was found inside the ice machine. Previous core violations were not corrected: hair restraints, wiping cloths on prep surfaces, a loose hot-holding gasket, greasy racks and charred ovens, a leaking sink faucet, dirty walls, blown light bulbs, and dirty hood filters.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing
summary: The toilet room door was not self-closing. The inspector instructed the business to provide a self-closing device. This re-inspection passed.

headline: Three of four restrooms lack hot water
summary: Three of four restrooms had no hot running water (58F reading). Sinks must reach at least 100F. A priority violation was cited. Grease and food buildup was also found on fryers, a microwave, and other equipment.

headline: Ice machine dirty; exit door gap
summary: The ice machine interior needs cleaning. A 1/4-inch gap at the exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. Employees lacked hair restraints, and grease and debris were under three fryers. Clutter is on storage floors.

headline: Bare hands on cakes; mouse droppings and flies
summary: An employee handled cooked cakes with bare hands and no gloves, a priority violation. Over 300 mouse droppings were found in prep and storage areas, and over 30 live flies. Live and dead cockroaches were in glue boards. The sink lacked soap until the manager bought some.

headline: Uncovered dessert; unused equipment stored in washroom
summary: An uncovered prepared dessert was in the reach-in cooler. An electric insect device hangs above the rear prep table and must move away from food. Unused equipment is stored in the employee washroom and must be repaired or removed. Certified managers need allergen proof.

headline: No certified manager; hot unit at 126F
summary: No certified food manager was on premises, corrected when one arrived at 1:50PM. A sales-floor hot-holding unit read 126F and was tagged; it must hold 135F. Cardboard and foil liners, milk crates on the cooler floor, and stained ceiling tiles were also noted.

headline: Drains and equipment need detail cleaning
summary: Basement bar drains have dirt and dark buildup. Upstairs dish machine piping has heavy white buildup. The walk-in cooler floor, cooking equipment sides, and general floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Food debris throughout; no handler training
summary: Food debris and spills are on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and shelving. Storage areas are cluttered and must be organized to prevent pest harborage. Walls, ceiling tiles, and outlet covers need repair. No food handler training was available.

headline: Single-service items not inverted; food debris
summary: Single-service articles were not inverted in prep and wait-station areas. Food debris was on prep tables and equipment. Debris was also on the floor under equipment, along walls, and in corners. The manager was told to correct these.

headline: Employee toilet room lacks ventilation
summary: The employee toilet room had no mechanical ventilation. The business must provide and maintain it at all times.

headline: Ice machine buildup; peeling paint
summary: A slight buildup was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned. Peeling paint is on the wall behind and above the handwashing sink and must be removed.

headline: Quarter-inch rear door gap; no mop sink
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be rodent-proofed. There is no mop sink on premises, and one with hot and cold water must be provided. Peeling paint surrounds the dish machine, and ceiling tiles above prep are water-stained.

headline: Missing handwash signs; several cleaning and storage fixes
summary: Handwashing sinks need signs. Frozen fish must be thawed outside its packaging. Bulk containers need labels, and stored food was on the walk-in cooler floor. The ice machine interior needs cleaning, and an old fly strip must be removed.

headline: Damaged rear screen door; rust on table
summary: There is no screen over the food pass-out window. The rear screen door is in poor repair with holes. Screens must be provided and maintained. Rust was found on a table and must be removed.

headline: Missing handwash sign; spills and exposed brick
summary: The washroom handwashing sink lacks a sign. The cooler thermometer was broken and must be replaced. Raw wood surfaces and unfinished floors and walls need repair. Spills and debris are on floors in sales, storage, and basement areas.

headline: No health policy, cleanup procedure, or sanitizer
summary: There was no employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure. No pest control log book was on site. No sanitizer test kit or sanitizing chemical was available, a priority violation. No citations were issued.

headline: Sewage backup in restroom floors
summary: Feces and urine were pooling on floors in customer and staff toilet rooms, backing up from floor drains. All floors must be cleaned and sanitized, and a citation was issued. Other repairs include missing wall base, stained ceiling tiles, and a worn freezer gasket.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site during the inspection. A certified manager must be on site at all times while the business is open. A priority violation was cited.

headline: Raw meat stored in grocery bags
summary: Raw meats were stored in single-use grocery bags in the rear prep freezer. Management was told to use food-grade containers or bags instead.

headline: Cooler at 66F; no hot water at restroom sink
summary: The walk-in cooler read 66F and the reach-in was off, so cold units must stay at 41F or below. The restroom handwashing sink had no hot water, a priority violation. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies were on site. Pest control license was missing.

headline: Unlabeled containers; soda pops on floor
summary: Display coolers lack ambient air thermometers. Food storage containers lack common-name labels. Soda pops were stored on the dry-storage floor and must be elevated six inches on shelving.

headline: Basement wall holes; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Bulk dry food containers lack common-name labels. Serving utensils were not inverted on the dish storage shelf. Holes in the basement prep-area walls must be sealed to remove hiding spots for pests. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: No mop sink; ice on cooler condenser
summary: The premises have no mop sink, and one must be provided with hot and cold running water. Ice buildup on the walk-in cooler condenser must be removed. The dish sink's middle compartment drains slowly, and an unused cooler must be repaired or removed.

headline: Gap under revolving door; training gaps
summary: A gap along the bottom of the revolving door could let insects in and must be sealed. A splash guard is needed at the one-compartment sink. A burned-out freezer light and food handler and allergen training were also required.

headline: No certified manager; sushi held too warm
summary: No certified manager was on site while raw fish was prepared. The manager arrived at 11:30AM. Sushi was at 48-50F with no time-control records, and the timer was off. Sushi rice pH proof was missing. A citation was issued.

headline: No sanitizer; coolers too warm
summary: No chemical sanitizer was on premises for equipment and utensils, a priority violation. Two cold-holding units in front prep read 61.7-66.4F and were tagged. Menu lacks a raw food advisory. Customers can enter the food prep area. Pipes and faucets leak.

headline: Grease spills under cooking equipment
summary: Grease spills were found under cooking equipment and inside the fryers in the kitchen. The business must clean and maintain them.

headline: Caulk loose; old greasy walls not cleaned
summary: The rear prep handwashing sink pipe caulk is not attached to the wall and must be recaulked. Grease and debris behind the cooking line from a January 2023 inspection were not corrected and must be cleaned by re-inspection.

headline: Handler ate, then gloved without washing hands
summary: A male food handler ate potato chips, then put on gloves to prepare food without washing hands, a priority violation. About 40 live small flies were found across the drink station, prep area, and toilet room. Pest control service was recommended.

headline: Over 20 flies; milk held at 45F
summary: Over 20 small flies were found throughout the facility, and pest control service is recommended. Milk was held at 45F, and the manager discarded 1.5 gallons. No original certified manager certificate was on site. A citation was issued.

headline: Oysters lacked shellstock tags; discarded
summary: Fresh oysters in the walk-in and refrigerator had no shellstock tags. Management voluntarily discarded about 15 pounds ($102), corrected on site. Mold on ice machine parts was cleaned on site. Sink leaks and missing allergen certificates were also found.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; food discarded
summary: The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged. A pasta-station cooler read 53F, and about 90 pounds ($300) of TCS food was discarded. Both were tagged for CDPH inspection. Hand-drying supplies were missing and corrected on site.

headline: Rust inside ice machine; leaking dish sink
summary: Rust was found inside the ice machine near the first-floor dish area, so ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Two leaks under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Floor grout and tiles are missing or damaged.

headline: No health policy; no soap at dish sink
summary: No written employee health policy was on site, a priority violation with a citation. The dish-area handwashing sink lacked soap, but the manager refilled it. Cardboard is used as a shelf liner for fries in the walk-in cooler. A floor drain under the sink is dirty.

headline: No certified manager while tamales prepared
