summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and pork tamales were prepared or handled. The manager must be on site at all times for TCS foods. A citation was issued. Chipped paint and rust are on walk-in cooler wire racks.

headline: Dirty equipment, chipped paint, broken tiles
summary: Prep tables, steam tables, cabinets, the fryer interior, and shelving need cleaning. Walls and floors under cooking equipment need cleaning. Chipped paint, damaged ceiling tiles, and broken floor tiles need repair. Clutter in the rear prep area must be removed.

headline: About 30 live flying insects; handler untrained
summary: About 30 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in food prep and dining areas. More pest control service is needed, and a citation was issued. A food handler lacked a training certificate. Mop sink and floor drain need repair and cleaning.

headline: Leaking prep sink pipe; cluttered storage floor
summary: The prep area handwashing sink pipe is leaking and must be repaired. The storage room floor is cluttered throughout. The manager must raise all items off the floor or remove them.

headline: Handwash water too cool; over 100 flies
summary: Handwashing sink water measured 88F, but it must reach at least 100F, a priority citation. The dumpster door was left wide open. Over 100 small flies were found in the facility, mostly in rear storage and the employee lounge. Pest control service is recommended.

headline: No hand soap or towels at sinks
summary: Hand soap was missing at a prep handwash sink and corrected on site. Paper towels were missing at a front prep sink. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. A freezer gasket and cooler gasket were torn. Grease and debris were on equipment, and a light shield was missing.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy was on premises, a priority violation. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. Handwashing signs were missing and corrected on site. An uncovered trash can was in the unisex washroom, and food handlers must complete training.

headline: Packaged foods unlabeled; chipped rear walls
summary: Packaged foods such as baklava, spices, honey, and olive oil lacked required labels. Rear walls near the one-compartment sink are unfinished with chipped paint and must be repaired and repainted.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The certified manager was missing allergen training. Management must obtain it and keep proof on site.

headline: No cooler thermometers; dust and unlabeled bulk items
summary: Reach-in and display coolers have no air thermometers. Bulk flour, sugar, salt, and matcha are unlabeled. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice. Floors and vents have debris and dust buildup.

headline: No food handler certificates available
summary: No food handler certificates were available for the inspector's review. The business must provide them or meet the requirement.

headline: Knife holder beside handwash sink; peeling shelf
summary: A wall-mounted knife holder is directly beside the cook-line handwashing sink and must be moved to prevent cross-contamination. Prep wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer. The front prep waste bin is dirty, and chemical shelf plastic is peeling.

headline: Dirt and debris under front-area equipment
summary: The front service area floor has dirt and debris under and around equipment. The business was told to clean it to prevent possible pest activity.

headline: Hot water too low; hair restraint violations
summary: Hot water reached only 86F at dish and handwashing sinks. Handwashing sinks must reach 100F and dish sinks 110F. A priority violation was cited. A worker had a beard without a guard, and a worker's hair was not fully restrained.

headline: Personal items stored with utensils; freezer gasket
summary: Employee personal care items were stored on shelves with multi-use utensils and must be moved to a designated area. Large containers lack common names. A rear walk-in freezer door gasket is damaged and causes ice buildup, and must be repaired.

headline: Back door gap; damaged cutting boards and racks
summary: A 1/2-to-3/4-inch gap at the back entry door must be closed tightly to keep pests out. Cutting boards near the grill have open seams and dark stains. Racks in the front prep cold-hold unit are rusted.

headline: About 40 mouse droppings found
summary: About 40 mouse droppings were found in dry storage, near CO2 canisters, and on the kitchen bottom shelf. A priority citation was issued. Rust was also found on cold-holding shelves in the bar.

headline: Dust on ceilings; dead insects on floors
summary: Dust covers ceiling tiles and vents. Dirt and dead insects were on the floor in prep, storage, and washroom areas. The manager must clean and maintain these areas.

headline: No health policy; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policies or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit were on site, both citation-level violations. No soap was in the ladies room, now provided. A P-trap leaks at the front-bar sink, and no current inspection summary was posted for customers.

headline: Food on floor; scoops stored in containers
summary: Boxed food sits on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Scoops were stored inside dry-storage containers. Cold-holding equipment has food debris inside, and rear prep floors have debris. The person in charge must clean and maintain these.

headline: Frozen beef thawed improperly; food on floors
summary: Frozen beef was thawed improperly. It must thaw in the cooler overnight or under cold running water. Bulk dry goods are unlabeled, and boxed food sits on cooler and freezer floors. Dirty wiping cloths were found on prep tables.

headline: No allergen training for managers
summary: No allergen training was on site for City food managers. Management was instructed that all City food managers must complete allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No beard guards; dirty cloths and hood
summary: Employees with long beards preparing food lacked beard guards. Dirty wiping cloths were on prep tables, not stored in sanitizer. Floor drains need cleaning. Hood, filters, and pipes at the front prep area have dirt and grease buildup.

headline: No health policy, thermometers, or pest log
summary: There was no employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit. Handwashing signs, stem thermometers, a sink test kit, and a pest control log book were missing. Espresso and ice machines lacked backflow devices.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: A food handler had expired food handler certificates and must get valid ones. Bulk salt and sugar containers were unlabeled. Disposable containers were used for food, and shelves were lined with foil and cardboard. All must be fixed.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Some food handler certificates have expired and must be updated. Food allergen training certificates have also expired and must be renewed.

headline: Cold food held too warm; no sanitizer
summary: No sanitizer was available at the dish sink. Cold foods that must stay cold were held too warm in prep coolers: eggs 49F, ham 44F, beef 46F, beans 47F, sour cream 53F. Coolers read 55F and 48F. A 1/2-inch gap was under the exit door.

headline: Coolers off at inspection; no pest log
summary: Refrigeration units were not on and holding temperature at inspection, a priority violation. There is no pest control log book. Thermometers are missing, and the rear utility sink has no backflow device. Trash and weeds are by the dumpster.

headline: Food trays in customer hallway; no sink stoppers
summary: Boxes of food trays and containers were stored in a hallway customers can reach. They must be kept out of customer reach. The three-compartment sink had no stoppers, and plastic bags were used instead.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No employee health policy was on premises, a foundation violation with no citation. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or spill kit was on site. Two handwashing sinks lacked signs. Required items must be provided.

headline: No certified manager while chicken was prepped
summary: No certified manager was on site while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared. The certified manager arrived at 12:15PM. A priority citation was issued. One of two exposed handwashing sinks in the first-floor bar lacked a handwashing sign.

headline: No valid certificate; walk-in floors dirty
summary: A manager was on site without a valid City food service manager certificate while TCS foods were prepared, a citation was issued. Walk-in cooler and freezer floors have dirt under shelving. Cooking equipment has grease, and wall coving near the fryers needs repair.

headline: Heavy grease and debris throughout kitchen
summary: Grease buildup, food debris, and spills were found on fryers, prep tables, coolers, and freezers. Baseboards are missing, and there are openings along walls. Debris is under equipment and in corners. The manager must clean and repair.

headline: Dead silverfish along drain; drain buildup
summary: Dead insects, possibly silverfish, were along a drain in the prep kitchen. Walk-in coolers have debris under shelving, and drains have food debris and dark buildup. Hood and filters have grease buildup that must be cleaned.

headline: Leaking sink; cutting boards and floor debris
summary: The handwashing sink in the rear meat prep area has multiple leaks, and the faucet must be fixed. Cutting boards have deep grooves and stains and must be sanded or replaced. Dirt and debris are under and around heavy equipment.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods like cheese and ground beef were prepared or served, a citation was issued. No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure was on site. Sinks lacked soap and paper towels. Wastewater backs up at the dish sink.

headline: About 15 flies under soda bar; grease buildup
summary: About 15 small flies were found under the soda dispensing bar. Pest control service is advised before re-inspection, and a citation was issued. Grease covers cooking equipment, walls, and floors. The soda counter cabinet is heavily soiled with syrup.

headline: Basement clutter must be removed
summary: Excessive clutter and unnecessary items were on shelves and floors throughout the basement. The business must remove clutter, organize the space, and maintain it.

headline: Items on floor; leaking sink handle
summary: Stored items in the storage closet and under the three-compartment sink must be raised off the floor. The hot handle at the three-compartment sink leaks and must be repaired.

headline: Food on floors; missing lids; no hair restraints
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in cooler and freezer floors and must be raised six inches. Bulk containers lacked lids. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and food debris was on equipment.

headline: Soda dispenser spills and mold; no handler certificates
summary: The beverage dispenser interior had excess soda spills, and tubing had mold-like buildup. Floor drains held trash and organic matter. No food handler certificates were available on site.

headline: No health policy or vomit procedure posted
summary: No signed employee health policies or posted vomit and diarrhea procedure were on site, a foundation violation with no citation. Idle equipment had dried debris that must be cleaned to prevent pests. A wall hole, loose base, and dim lighting also need attention.

headline: No food handler or allergen training certificates
summary: No food handler certificates or allergen training certificates were on the premises. Management must provide them for all food handlers and certified managers. The freezer interior and walls behind the grill also need cleaning.

headline: No hot and cold sink at prep area
summary: No handwashing sink with hot and cold running water was at the guacamole and rice prep areas. A citation was issued. Food handlers on site lacked food handler training certificates.

headline: No backflow device; greasy floors; basement clutter
summary: The utility sink in the rear warewashing area has no backflow device. Grease, food debris, and dirt are on floors under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners. Basement storage is cluttered, and items must be kept off the floor.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while gelato and milk were being prepared and served. A certified manager must be present whenever these foods are prepared or served. A citation was issued.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: The City certified food manager had no proof of allergen training on site. The inspector instructed all City certified food managers to get this certificate.

headline: Missing raw food warning; moldlike ice machine shield
summary: The menu lacked a warning about raw or undercooked animal foods. The restaurant corrected this on site, so no citation was issued. A moldlike substance was on the ice machine shield. Gaps at exterior doors must be sealed to block pests.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners; blood stains in cooler
summary: Cardboard is used as shelf liner in pizza prep and must be replaced with smooth, cleanable surfaces. Grease is inside the deep fryers, and blood stains are on the walk-in cooler floor. No food handler certificate or allergen certificate was on site.

headline: Ice machine buildup; side door gap
summary: A slight buildup was found inside the upper ice machine and must be cleaned. A 1/4-inch gap at the side door sweep must be closed to rodent-proof the door.

headline: No grease trap at bar sink
summary: There is no grease trap at the bar three-compartment sink. One must be provided.

headline: Missing handwash signs at employee restrooms
summary: Handwashing signage was missing at the employee restrooms. The business must provide and maintain it.

headline: Peeling epoxy flooring at cook line
summary: Epoxy flooring on the first-floor cook serving line and under equipment is in poor repair and peeling. It must be repaired.

headline: No city sanitation certificate; many repeat violations
summary: The person in charge had no City sanitation certificate on site, and a citation was issued. Core violations from 2023 were not corrected: floor storage, a torn freezer gasket, cardboard liners, and greasy fryer interiors. An expired food handler certificate and allergen training gap were also found.

headline: No health policy; packaged foods lack allergen labels
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. Packaged banana bread, granola bars and brownies in display cases had no allergen labels. The high-temperature dish machine had no temperature measuring device.

headline: Uncovered salad garnishes; missing cooler thermometer
summary: Three salad garnishes were left uncovered beside the pizza oven. The prep cooler had no ambient air thermometer. This was a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Front door gap not rodent-proof; items on floor
summary: The front entrance door had a half-inch gap at the bottom and was not rodent-proof. Items were stored on the floor in a rear storage room and closet. The employee washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Bulk ingredient containers lacked labels
summary: Bulk ingredient containers of flour and other items in the rear prep area had no labels. The inspector instructed staff to label them with common names.

headline: Grease and debris under kitchen equipment
summary: Floors under cooking equipment and the kitchen hand sink were dirty with grease, dirt and food debris. The employee washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle. This was a complaint re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Beans held at 97F; food handler certificates missing
summary: Cooked beans at 97.2F and rice at 47.8F were held in a taco prep cooler. About 25 lbs were discarded, $95. Ready-to-eat beef and rice were not date marked. The three-compartment sink leaks, and no food handler certificates or allergen training were on site.

headline: Prep cooler at 44F; no employee health policy
summary: A two-door prep cooler read 44F and was ordered repaired below 41F, a priority violation. No written employee health policy was on the premises. Only two working sink stoppers were present, and the women's washroom lacked a covered receptacle.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; quiche too warm
summary: The chlorine dish machine's final sanitizer read 0 ppm and was tagged; at least 50 ppm is required. Quiche with cooked eggs was held at 46F, and 3 lbs, $22, were discarded.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site during re-inspection. Unfinished wood shelving was behind the cash register. Washrooms had garbage receptacles without lids, and a citation was not issued.

headline: Five dead cockroaches found in basement
summary: Five dead cockroaches were found beneath equipment and shelves in the basement. Food was covered with plastic wrap while cooling. Single-use plastic bowls were used as scoops in dry food bins. Grease was dripping from the hood.

headline: Food cooled too slowly; hand sink blocked
summary: Pork sausage at 177.2F and shredded jackfruit at 105.4F did not cool within required times. About 25 lbs were discarded, $150. A rear hand sink was blocked by a food container. No certified manager was on site while meat was served.

headline: Hair restraints missing; dirty fryers and floors
summary: Male food handlers were not wearing hair restraints in the prep area. Deep fryers had encrusted dirt and grease, and cooler gaskets and walk-in floors were dirty. A food handler lacked proof of training.

headline: Live cockroaches in basement; food thawed at room temperature
summary: About 5 live adolescent cockroaches were found in a basement vegetable storage bin. Cooked beef was thawing at room temperature on a prep counter. An employee drank from an uncovered container while preparing food.

headline: Dish machine rinse too cool; machine tagged out
summary: The high-temperature dish machine final rinse read 102F, while 180F is required. The machine is tagged and may not be used until repaired. The site also lacked heat strips and a dish machine thermometer.

headline: Wall gap at sink; broken light covers, dusty floor
summary: A pipe opening at the wall under the three-compartment sink could allow pests, so the inspector asked for it sealed. A ceiling tile was missing above the spice rack, and white dust was on the prep floor. Two light covers were broken.

headline: Open holes and moldy caulk in dish room
summary: Open holes in walls, ceilings and around pipes in the dish room must be sealed. Moldy, blackened caulking was at the basement prep sink. Damaged baseboard coving under the prep sink also needed replacing. This was a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Food on floor in freezer; ice bin needs cleaning
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer. The ice bin interior needed cleaning. The manager was instructed to elevate food at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Ready-to-eat foods lacked date labels
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods, including rice and pork, were stored in the refrigerator without date marks. Mop heads were stored unhung, which can attract insects. The inspector explained the 24-hour date-marking rule.

headline: Food held too warm; cooler tagged out
summary: Hand soap was missing at a front hand sink but was supplied on site. Liquid egg, diced ham and eggs were held above 41F and discarded, about $250. The front prep cooler read 63.2F and is tagged out.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; milk crates used as shelves
summary: A handwashing sign was missing at the dish prep hand sink. Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas, which makes floor cleaning difficult.

headline: Food stored on floor; leaking drainpipe; grease buildup
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and prep areas. A broken air thermometer was in the dairy cold-hold unit. Drainpipes leaked under two sinks. Grease, debris and dust needed cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing signs at three sinks
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at the front prep sink, the rear prep and dishwashing sink, and in the rear toilet room. The operator was instructed to provide signs for all sinks.

headline: Door gaps, dishes not inverted, grime
summary: An exterior door by the three-compartment sink had quarter-inch gaps at the top and bottom. Dishes on shelves were not inverted. A large wall hole where tomato sauce is stored needed sealing, and grime was on walls and under shelves.

headline: Old food stickers; loose wires on sifters
summary: Old food stickers were left on utensils during washing. Flour sifters had loose wires. The inspector instructed staff to remove the stickers and use sound utensils.

headline: No certified manager during chicken prep, 9-10:05 AM
summary: No certified food manager was on site from 9:00 to 10:05 AM while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared and served. Food was stored on walk-in floors. Soiled mop heads were not hung. No allergen training was on site.

headline: Handwashing supplies and cold storage issues, some fixed on site
summary: Paper towels were missing at a prep-area hand sink and were provided during inspection. Syrup boxes were stored on the floor. A hand sink and drain pipe leak, a broken towel dispenser, and a dead light in the walk-in cooler were also noted.

headline: No certified manager while handling chicken, milk
summary: The person in charge had no City of Chicago sanitation certificate. No certified sanitation manager was on premises while TCS foods such as chicken and milk were handled. A citation was issued.

headline: Worn sponges; dirty sauce containers and mop room
summary: Worn sponges needed replacement. Large BBQ and sauce containers had run-off buildup needing cleaning. The mop room floor had food debris and water spills needing detail cleaning.

headline: About 37 live flying insects; prior violation uncorrected
summary: About 37 live small flying insects and one house fly were found on walls and ceilings in bar, prep and dishwashing areas. A previous violation was not corrected. Floor and drain under cooking equipment needed cleaning.

headline: Some food handlers lack certificates; grime buildup
summary: Some food handlers had no food handler certificates. One manager lacked allergen training. Ice had built up on a cooler condenser, and grease and grime were on prep and mop room floors and walls.

headline: Pest control logbook lacked current records
summary: The pest control logbook held only 2023 service reports. Logbooks must hold 12 months of service tickets and the company's license number. This is a priority foundation violation. No pest sightings were recorded.

headline: No certified manager; about 40 small flies
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open. About 40 small flies were found on clean containers, shelves, ceilings and cup boxes. An ice container was uncovered, and food handlers had no hair restraints.

headline: Live rats seen at garbage compactor
summary: Live rats were seen crawling in trash on the ground and on the outside garbage compactor. A previous priority violation was not corrected. Missing internal thermometer for a prep cooler, unlabeled containers, and missing food handler training were also noted.

headline: Restroom lacked covered waste receptacle
summary: The unisex employee and customer restroom had no covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products. The operator was instructed to provide one.

headline: Rodent droppings and live flies; no certified manager
summary: About 50 small and large rodent droppings were found under chip racks, in storage and under produce racks. About 25 live black flies were in the prep area. A hot-holding unit lacked its protective barrier, and the person in charge discarded food. No certified manager was present.

headline: Leaking pipe under sink; dusty toilet room vent
summary: A pipe under the three-compartment sink wash basin was leaking. An inoperable two-door soda refrigerator was not in use and needed removal. Dust had built up on a toilet room vent.

headline: Missing hair restraint, allergen certificates, backflow device
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Fryer interiors had grease and food buildup. A rear mop sink had no backflow prevention device. Mops were stored on the floor beside dirty water, and certificates for food handlers and managers were missing.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; restroom trash lids
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at several exposed hand sinks. Two restrooms lacked lidded waste receptacles. Unused equipment was present in the office and behind the bar.

headline: Ice bin interior needs cleaning
summary: The interior of the ice bin needed cleaning. Staff were instructed to remove the ice, clean the bin and maintain it.

headline: Dusty fans, shelving and vents in prep areas
summary: Fan covers and shelving in the rear walk-in cooler had dust buildup. Air vents throughout the rear food prep area needed detail cleaning to prevent contamination of food-contact surfaces.

headline: No employee health policy; unlabeled packaged foods
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. Packaged desserts, pasta, soups and sauces in the prep cooler were not labeled, a previous violation not corrected. The recent summary report was not posted for the public.

headline: Grease buildup at fryers; missing handwash sign
summary: Grease and food debris had built up between and under the fryers. The toilet room had no handwashing sign. No allergen training certificate was provided for review. This was a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Chicken thawed on counter; leaks and slow drains
summary: Frozen chicken was thawed on a countertop, which is not an approved method. Pots were stored on the floor. A handwash sink faucet constantly leaked, and the three-compartment sink drained slowly. A trash receptacle cover was missing.

headline: Hair restraints missing; several dirty equipment items
summary: Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Dirty items included a can opener, a stained cutting board, charred oven interiors, and greasy floors and drains. The certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Chicken held at 47F; two coolers too warm
summary: Chicken held at 47F was discarded, 5 lbs, $10. Two coolers read 44F and 47F and were tagged. The menu lacked a raw or undercooked food consumer advisory. The ice machine interior had pink calcium buildup.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints; no test kit
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on site, and food was stored two inches off the floor in dry storage. Food handlers lacked hair and beard restraints. No chlorine test kit was available. A burned-out light was in the dry storage area.

headline: Several employees lacked food handler certificates
summary: Several food handling employees had no food handler training certificate. The operator must provide third-party certificates for all food handlers, or proof of approved training.

headline: Handwash sink used as prep sink; prior violation
summary: Standing water pooled under a utility sink from a deep floor tile gauge. A previous priority violation remains uncorrected: beverages are prepared in a handwash sink, and no separate prep sink was installed. A citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager and no food handler certificates
summary: No certified food service manager was on duty with a valid certificate on site. No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit, or sanitizer test strips were present. No employees had food handler certificates on site.

headline: Ice machine and can opener need cleaning
summary: The ice machine interior had build-up to remove. A large can opener needed detail cleaning. A restroom receptacle needed a cover, and dust had built up on the walk-in cooler ceiling.

headline: No splash guard at bar hand sink
summary: The bar's exposed hand sink and frozen margarita machine had no washable splash guard. An ice scoop was left lying on the ice bin, and the manager was instructed to store it handle up.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; leaks and dusty fixtures
summary: Ice had built up inside the prep-area deep freezer. A leaky pipe was under the washroom hand sink, and a grease trap odor was noted. Ceiling tiles and the hood were dusty.

headline: About 60 live small flies; prior violation uncorrected
summary: About 60 or more live small flies were on walls, ceilings and glass in prep and dining areas. A previous violation was not corrected, though pest control service was on site, dated 1/15/26. Activity was being minimized at inspection.

headline: Dust and debris in chemical storage room
summary: Loose debris, dirt and dust had built up on the floors and corners of the chemical storage room. The inspector instructed detail cleaning and more frequent floor cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; no sanitizer test strips
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled and served. Brooms and mops were stored too close to clean utensils. No sanitizer test strips were available for the low-temperature dish machine.

headline: No hot water at time of inspection
summary: The facility had no hot water on site during the inspection. The operator was instructed to correct the problem and maintain hot water.

headline: Insect control device removed from prep area
summary: A hanging flying insect control device was stored above a basement prep table. The inspector instructed its removal, and management discarded it. No insects were recorded in these notes.

headline: No food handler certificates on premises
summary: No food handler certificates were on the premises. The certified food manager lacked allergen training. The women's washroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Employee washed hands in three-compartment sink
summary: A food handler was seen washing hands at the three-compartment sink. The employee was instructed to wash hands only at a handwashing sink. Soiled mop heads were not properly stored.

headline: Food debris and wall buildup; no food handler certificates
summary: Food debris was found on the dishmachine and sinks in the rear prep area, and dirt had built up on walls. No food handler certificates were on hand for employees. This was a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Unapproved vacuum packing; food discarded
summary: A vacuum packaging machine was used on food with no HACCP plan or variance approval. About 5 lbs of octopus, salmon, steak, shrimp, tuna and tenderloin were discarded. Plates were not inverted, and an ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink blocked, no towels
summary: No certified food manager was on site while eggs and milk were handled. A main prep hand sink was blocked by carts and an apron. No towels were at prep hand sinks, though towels were provided during inspection.

headline: Cold-held meat too warm; health policy missing
summary: Beef at 45.2F, pork at 70.2F and diced beef at 47.8F were held in the front prep cooler; about 9 lbs were discarded, $95. No written employee health policy was on premises. Frozen meat was thawed in a plastic container in the prep area.

headline: Side door unscreened; plastic bags hold food
summary: A side door was open without proper screening, a possible pest entry point. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags in basement freezers. Basement reach-in freezers need defrosting, and allergen certificates were missing.

headline: No food handler proof; labeling and storage issues
summary: Packaged cookies and sweet breads lacked full labels with business name, ingredients and allergen warnings. Wiping cloths were not held in sanitizer. Items were stored on floors and plastic crates. No food handler training proof was provided.

headline: About 50 live flying insects; dish machine too cool
summary: About 50 live small flying insects were found on walls and ceilings in food, bar and dishwashing areas. The dish machine final rinse was 140F, below 180F. Cooked chicken wings were held at 45F, and several dressings and cooked items were past their 7-day date.

headline: Over 40 mouse droppings in bar area
summary: Over 40 mouse droppings were found throughout the bar area. Staff were instructed to remove all evidence and clean the area. Previous violations were not corrected: heavy grease was in fryers, and an allergen certificate had expired. Food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; minor cleaning needed
summary: A rear exit door was open behind a security gate that is not rodent-proof. A splash guard was needed beside a hand sink next to a hot-hold unit. Walk-in cooler shelving needed detail cleaning.

headline: Rear door gap; leaking faucet; plates not inverted
summary: The rear exit door was not rodent-proof, with about a quarter-inch gap at the bottom. Serving plates were stored upright, a leaking faucet was noted at the three-compartment sink, and floors along walls and under equipment needed cleaning.

headline: Greasy fryer bottoms; water-stained ceiling tile
summary: The bottoms of the fryers needed cleaning to remove grease. A water-stained ceiling tile needed replacing where needed. This was a complaint re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Restroom sink leak; peeling kitchen ceiling paint
summary: The customer restroom hand sink had an excessive leak. The restroom was closed to customers at inspection. Peeling paint was found on the kitchen ceiling near the stove.

headline: Dish room hand sink lacks splash guard
summary: The dish room hand sink had no splash guard. It sits between two drying racks. The inspector instructed installing a splash guard or moving the racks.

headline: Open rear window with torn screen; no thermometer
summary: A rear window was open and its screen had a hole. No insects were noted. The pizza slice hot-holding unit had no ambient air thermometer. A chest freezer handle was damaged. This was a re-inspection with a conditional pass.

headline: Mold-like substance inside ice machine
summary: A black mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine water compartment. The machine supplies ice for customers. The inspector required cleaning and sanitizing. The pest control logbook held only one service report, with a non-matching address.

headline: Grease and debris; prior violations uncorrected
summary: A rear door had a gap along the bottom that was not tight-fitting. Grease and debris were on coolers, prep tables, fryers, walk-in floors and hood filters. Several earlier core violations were not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: Coolers not running; food handler certificates missing
summary: One plugged-in cooler read 65.4F. The other two coolers were not plugged in. A box freezer was the only working refrigeration. The soda gun drained into a handwashing sink. No food handler or allergen certificates were on site.

headline: One food handler lacked training proof
summary: One food handler working during inspection had no proof of food handler training. The manager was instructed to ensure all handlers have proof and that new hires are trained within 30 days.

headline: No paper towels; dish machines not sanitizing
summary: Basement prep hand sink had no paper towels. A bar soap dispenser was empty. Two low-temperature dish machines had 0 ppm chlorine and were not to be used until they reach 50 ppm. The ice machine interior needed cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; rear door gaps
summary: No City of Chicago certified foodservice manager was on premises. A rear exterior door had quarter-inch gaps at the top and bottom. A cooler gasket was damaged, cardboard was on walk-in shelving, and a storage room wall had a hole.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; women's restroom lid
summary: Handwashing signage was missing at an exposed hand sink at the patio beverage station. The women's restroom had no covered trash receptacle.

headline: No certified manager during chicken and egg prep
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and eggs were prepared and served. A pool cafe food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. A splash guard was missing between a hand sink and food shelving.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: No proof of food handler training or certificates was provided for employees handling food. The inspector noted the facility must provide proof for all required employees.

headline: Failed: about 30 live flies in food areas
summary: Around 30 live black flies were found in the prep area, bar, basement and dining area, on food equipment and prep tables. Side exit door not rodent-proof. Food stored under exposed pipes. Food handler without hair restraint. Certificate gaps.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; rodent droppings found
summary: An employee chopped raw green onions by hand, touching ready-to-eat food; the onions were discarded. Reinspection found 10 to 15 rodent droppings in many areas. Management removed them, and pest control treated the building before reinspection.

headline: Wall repair needed near espresso machine
summary: Walls near the espresso machine had damage. The inspector instructed repair and repainting to make the walls sealed, smooth and easily cleaned.

headline: Ice machine panel needs cleaning; expired certificates
summary: The ice machine interior panel needed cleaning. A cold water faucet knob was missing at the mop sink. Expired allergen training certificates were found for food managers.

headline: Missing handwash signs; toilet room fixtures lacking
summary: Handwashing signs were missing in toilet rooms, bar and kitchen prep handwash stations. The women's and upstairs unisex toilet rooms lacked lidded receptacles, and the staff toilet had no self-closing door.

headline: Fryer ventilation inoperable; no garbage cans
summary: Mechanical ventilation over stoves and fryers was not operable. The three-compartment sink had only one sink stopper. Garbage cans were missing from the food prep area, and old equipment was stored outside, which can harbor pests.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; basement clutter; hood grease
summary: A two-door cooler had a torn interior gasket. Basement storage had excess clutter, and grease had built up on hood filters over the cook line. The inspector instructed correction.

headline: Allergen certificate needed
summary: The inspector noted no allergen certificate. The operator was instructed to obtain and keep one.

headline: Mold dripping into stored ice; discard required
summary: Black and pink mold-like buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto stored ice used for customers. The inspector instructed staff to discard the ice and clean the machine. Walk-in cooler items were stored on the floor.

headline: Phone stored on meat slicer; wet mops stored
summary: An employee's cell phone was stored on a wipe cloth on top of a meat slicer. Wet mops were kept in buckets and by the elevator. Torn gaskets and dust on walk-in fan guards were also noted.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; cooler held with tape
summary: Bulk containers in the prep area held working ingredients with no common-name labels. A cooler had excessive black duct tape holding its door in place. Gaskets were in disrepair. No thermometer was in the cooling unit.

headline: Heavy grease on cooking equipment sides
summary: The sides of the cooking equipment had a heavy buildup of grease. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain the equipment.

headline: One manager's allergen training expired
summary: One certified food manager had an expired allergen awareness training certificate. The person in charge was instructed to renew it and keep it on file.

headline: Floor drains need cleaning
summary: The floor drains at the food prep area needed cleaning and maintenance. This was a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Grease buildup; two hood lights out
summary: Cooking equipment sides and the floor under and behind it had a buildup of grease and small debris. The rear toilet room door needed adjusting to self-close. Two lights were out under the hood ventilation system.

headline: No certified manager certificate; no metal thermometer
summary: No person on site had an original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted. No metal stem thermometer was on site. Both were cited as priority foundation violations.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Crates were used for storage in the walk-in freezer. Grease and debris were on fryers, coolers and prep tables. Previous violations were not corrected, including missing covered receptacles, and expired certificates for all food handlers.

headline: No certified manager; food held too warm
summary: No certified food manager or valid sanitation certificate was on site while beans, rice, chicken and steak were prepared. Several cold foods held at 58-60F were discarded, about $100. A cold-hold unit read 61F and is tagged.

headline: About 55 rodent droppings in dry storage
summary: About 55 small rodent droppings in rear storage, under the mop sink, in the bar, and in front prep on grills and steam table. Citation issued; pest control required to eliminate activity. Employee shoes and clothes stored with seasonings.

headline: No valid certified manager; no paper towels
summary: No person in charge with valid Chicago sanitation certificate; citation issued. Restroom handwashing sink had no paper towels; a food handler supplied them during inspection. Coolers need interior cleaning; floors and corners have loose debris, dirt, and dust.

headline: Missing floor tiles, dirty coolers, food debris
summary: Re-inspection passed. Reach-in coolers and gaskets need cleaning. Missing floor tiles, food debris and spills, water-stained ceiling tiles, peeling baseboards, a wall hole under handsink, and a burned-out bulb.

headline: No certified food manager at start of inspection
summary: No certified food manager on site at inspection start while chicken, beef and pork were offered for sale; corrected on site when a manager arrived about 40 minutes in. Missing sanitizer test kit and thermometers; some workers lacked food handler training.

headline: Repeat core violations; no employee health policy
summary: Repeat core violations not corrected: spatula and tongs left in room-temperature water; greasy cook-line equipment; no splashguard by rear hand sink. Sink removed, wastewater bucketed; person in charge reinstalled it on site. No employee health policy or food handler training proof.

headline: Restroom door off hinge; cluttered closet
summary: Restroom door was off its hinge; staff told to repair it. Kitchen closet clutter must be removed; kept items go on smooth, non-porous shelving. Certified managers lacked proof of allergen training.

headline: Wiping cloths, ice scoops, and leaking sink
summary: Wiping cloths left on prep tables and ice scoops stored in the ice bin need proper storage. Items in rear food storage must be elevated. Three-compartment sink faucet base leaks. Ceiling openings above dishwashing and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Around 30 live roaches and flies found
summary: About 30 live German roaches in garbage, water heater, cooler and uniform areas; about 25 small flies in bar and dish areas. Additional pest control service needed. Cold foods too warm, such as sliced tomato at 58.7°F; 35 lbs discarded.

headline: Produce cooler door gaskets ripped
summary: Re-inspection passed. The three-door produce cooler in the prep area has ripped rubber door gaskets (seals). The manager must repair or replace all damaged gaskets inside the cooler.

headline: Burned-out bulbs and damaged brick wall
summary: Brick wall deteriorating in the east rear storage area; repair ordered. Burned-out light bulbs in the deli and grocery walk-in freezers.

headline: Missing thermometer; cabinet debris
summary: Refrigerator in prep area lacked a visible, working thermometer. Interiors of cabinets behind the front counter had debris that must be removed.

headline: Cold foods too warm; no certified manager
summary: Cheese at 48°F and bacon at 50°F in kitchen cold holding unit; 7 lbs ($200) discarded. Refrigerator unit at 45°F must not be used until reinspected. No person in charge or certified food manager on duty; citation issued.

headline: Open drink on prep table; dusty ceilings
summary: Open beverage cup found on prep table and equipment; staff told to use closed lids. Single-service utensils not inverted under front counter. Food debris on floors; dust on walls, ceilings and vents in prep and washroom areas.

headline: Food stored on floor; hair restraints missing
summary: Food and single-service items stored on floor; staff told to elevate them six inches. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Damaged prep cooler gasket; clutter in rear storage. Fly strip near handwashing sink was removed on instruction.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and food debris build-up
summary: Three-compartment sink missing stoppers; manager must provide them. Food debris on rear prep shelves and greasy build-up on the grease trap exterior. Some food handlers lacked certificates; all must be certified with names on premises.

headline: Dirty walk-in cooler walls; peeling prep wall
summary: Build-up on walk-in cooler walls, including beer piping; cooling unit interiors and a small freezer needed cleaning. Red prep wall chipped and peeling; basement storage cluttered; hood and vents greasy; lighting inadequate in prep and basement.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and basement upkeep problems
summary: Re-inspection passed. Missing stoppers on the rear three-compartment sink. Freezer and refrigerator interiors had dirt and food debris. Basement had broken floor tiles, dust, grime behind equipment, water damage, and one burned-out light bulb.

headline: Menu lacks raw-food warning; fish thawed improperly
summary: Menu does not warn that steaks may be served raw or undercooked. Fish thawed on a rear prep table; staff told to use proper thawing methods. Food handlers without hair restraints; rubber gloves used as sink stoppers.

headline: Restroom storage and loose ceiling vent
summary: Items stored in the restroom must be removed unless related to the restroom. Vent hanging from the restroom ceiling must be repaired to fit tightly.

headline: Employee lacked food handler training
summary: Re-inspection passed. One employee had no food handler training; the person in charge must provide and maintain records.

headline: Gap at bottom of exterior door
summary: Inspection passed. A quarter-inch gap was noted at the bottom of an exterior door. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Prepackaged foods lack required labels; cooler interiors dirty
summary: Re-inspection passed. Prepackaged items, including salads and desserts, need labels showing facility name and address, product name, and ingredients. Beverage cooler interiors behind the bar had water and drink spills.

headline: Prepared foods lacked date labels; all discarded
summary: All prepared cooked foods held over 24 hours lacked date labels; all discarded. Torn screen on rear kitchen door with large holes. Badly damaged cutting board. Milk crates and cloth towels used as shelf liners.

headline: Two food handlers lacked certificates
summary: Two food handlers on site had no certificates; manager told to comply with the state food handler requirement.

headline: Rodent droppings in seven storage and prep areas
summary: Rodent droppings found in seven areas, about 10 to 30 at each spot, including storage, beer back-stock, and produce supply areas. Citation issued; pest control report due by 3/24/2025. Also: dirty floors, greasy cooking equipment, damaged walls and floor panels.

headline: No certified food manager on duty during service
summary: No person in charge with valid certificate, and no certified food manager on duty while chicken, pasta, rice and beans were prepared and served; citation issued. Unlabeled containers; clutter stored on floors.

headline: Ice machine buildup; stained cutting boards
summary: Slight build-up inside upper ice machine must be cleaned. Cutting boards are stained and must be replaced. One-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager on duty; handler lacked training
summary: No certified food manager on duty while beef, cheese sauce and Italian beef were prepared and served; citation issued. One food handler lacked training. Ceiling water-damaged and holed; washroom lacks ventilation.

headline: No allergen certificates; worn cutting boards
summary: Worn and discolored cutting boards need replacing; a can opener blade needs replacing. Employees without a city sanitation certificate need food handler certificates; no allergen certificates on site.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; hot-water dial blocked
summary: Dry and prepared food containers lacked labels. Handwashing sink's hot-water dial is blocked by the faucet, though the sink works. No certified manager with allergen training certificate on site. Outdoor waste enclosure had debris.

headline: Construction materials stored in basement
summary: Re-inspection passed. Unused construction materials piled in the rear and basement storage rooms must be removed from the premises. No food handler certificates were on site; proof of training must be shown for all food handlers.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold food temperatures; food discarded
summary: Chicken in warmer at 114–129°F, below the required 135°F; about 5 lbs discarded. Hummus, cooked corn, and cut tomatoes at 46.6–50°F in the line cooler; about 15 lbs discarded. Single-use containers reused for storage; staff told to stop.

headline: Repeat allergen training violation; cutting boards damaged
summary: Allergen training still not completed from a prior inspection; manager told to correct it or more citations will follow. Cutting boards in rear prep had deep dark grooves. Freezer interior and second-floor storage floors need cleaning. Citation issued.

headline: Raw wood splash guard above food shelving
summary: Raw wood board used as a splash guard beside the mop/service sink, next to shelves holding dry food, including whole raw onions. Remove food from those shelves or install a smooth, cleanable splash guard.

headline: Pork too warm in cooler; food not date-marked
summary: 30 lbs of pork held at 61.2–63.6°F in rear prep cold unit; manager discarded 30 lbs ($52.20). Ready-to-eat foods in walk-in cooler lacked date marks. Frozen meat thawed in plastic container; cardboard floor liner, greasy fryers.

headline: Broken cooler gasket; grease and noisy mixer
summary: Broken gaskets on walk-in cooler doors; rusted, grimy can opener blade. Dough mixer makes very loud grinding noise. Grease along walls under prep tables. Staff restroom receptacle needs a cover; damaged light shield.

headline: Rear handwashing sink plumbing failure; citation issued
summary: Rear handwashing sink drained water onto the prep floor; staff told to stop using it and use the dish-area sink instead. Citation issued. Also: grease on cooking equipment, dirty floors and drains, poor wall base, and latest inspection summary not posted.

headline: Rusted, dirty racks and refrigerator bottoms
summary: Rusted and dirty storage racks, plus dirty refrigerator and freezer bottoms. Surfaces must be smooth and easily cleanable; staff instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No backflow devices on coffee, ice, water machines
summary: Drip coffee machine, ice machine and BEVI water dispenser lacked backflow prevention devices, which stop dirty water flowing back into the water supply. Devices must be provided in a location where they can be serviced.

headline: Over 30 small flies found throughout facility
summary: Over 30 small flies on walls and ceiling in rear prep, dishwashing, and expo areas; pest control recommended; citation issued. Menu lacks asterisks and raw-food disclosure; gap between front doors; leaking faucet at three-compartment sink.

headline: Equipment stored under refrigeration; cardboard liner
summary: Clean multi-use equipment was stored directly under refrigeration compressors, exposed to dust and splashes; staff were instructed to move it. Cardboard liner on rear bar storage shelves was to be removed.

headline: Several food handlers lacked certificates
summary: Several food handlers had no food handler certificate. The certified food manager lacked a valid allergen training certificate. Management was told all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: Several cold foods too warm; unapproved yogurt
summary: Eggs at 75.5°F, lamb 47°F, soup 58.4°F, fish 47.1°F, yogurt 48°F in two-door refrigerator; about 20 lbs ($250) discarded. Yogurt made on-site without required food-safety plan (HACCP) or variance; must use commercial yogurt until approved.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; rusted racks
summary: No thermometers inside coolers in rear dry storage room; staff told to provide visible, working ones. Chipped paint and rust on wire racks in two-door stand-up cooler; repaint or replace the shelves.

headline: Rust on walk-in cooler wire racks
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rust on the wire storage rack in the walk-in cooler must be removed, and the shelves repainted or replaced.

headline: Shellfish missing required tags; 20 lbs discarded
summary: Mussels and clams stored in a prep cooler had no identification tags, as required. Manager voluntarily discarded 20 lbs (about $70). Citation issued. Also: sink stoppers in poor repair; serving plates and glasses not stored inverted.

headline: Worn revolving door seal; repeat allergen violation
summary: Revolving door weather strip is worn and an entry point for pests; must be replaced. Leaking pipe under three-compartment sink. Repeat violation: certified manager lacks allergen training certificate; citation issued.

headline: Dish machine tagged out; no hot water
summary: High-temperature dish machine rinsed at 110°F, below the 180°F required; machine tagged out of use. No hot water at several sinks. Vacuum packing without required approval; items tagged and held. About 400 lbs ($3,500) of food discarded.

headline: Dish machine data plate faded and unreadable
summary: Re-inspection passed. The low-temperature dish machine's data plate was faded and unreadable; a readable plate must be affixed. Employee with a certificate lacked proof of allergen training.

headline: About 150 mouse droppings; repeat violation
summary: About 150 mouse droppings found, a repeat violation from a prior inspection; must clean and have a licensed pest control company inspect. Outdoor garbage area had excessive debris and car parts; citation issued. Also missing handsink, grease trap, and training certificates.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and drainboard
summary: Re-inspection passed. Three-compartment sink lacked stoppers for each compartment and an adequate drainboard. Chip rack boxes had grease stains; restroom had no covered receptacle.

headline: Quarter-inch gap under exterior door
summary: Quarter-inch gap at bottom of exterior door to parking area must be repaired. Cutting board in butcher area has deep dark scoring. Splatters inside a cooler; damaged wall at rear door; items on floor in dry storage.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: One certified food service manager lacked an allergen awareness certificate on site; person in charge must ensure all obtain it and keep it on premises. Dirty floor drain under drive-through fountain machine must be cleaned.

headline: Missing thermometers; bulk containers unlabeled
summary: Thermometers were missing inside cooling units throughout prep. Bulk flour, breading and seasoning containers lacked labels. Soiled wiping cloths stored improperly; plastic and cloth used as sink stoppers; missing wall tiles; burned-out light under hood.

headline: Food handlers skipped handwashing; no certified manager
summary: Food handlers handled cooked pork, dirty dishes, and clean plates without handwashing; citation issued. No certified food manager on site while time/temperature-controlled (TCS) foods were served. No handwashing sink in rear prep area; sanitizer test kit missing.

headline: Leaking prep handsink; restroom door not self-closing
summary: Re-inspection passed. Leak at the rear prep handsink lower pipe needs repair. Restroom door lacks a self-closing device. Drains in prep area had heavy grime build-up.

headline: No sanitizer test strips; no covered waste bin
summary: No test strips on premises to measure sanitizer at the three-compartment sinks; citation issued. All-gender washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle. Clean ice machine interior, oven tops, food prep walls, floors, and floor drain.

headline: No covered trash receptacle in women's restroom
summary: Women's restroom lacks a covered trash receptacle; one must be provided.

headline: Labeling and utensil storage issues; no handwashing signs
summary: Men's restroom lacked handwashing signs. A bulk salt container was unlabeled. Large rice spoons were kept in room-temperature water, and deli cups were not air dried. Staff were instructed to correct each item.

headline: Rodent droppings in storage and food prep areas
summary: About 25 rodent droppings in rear dry storage and about 20 under the front counter. Citation issued. Hot water was too cool at the three-compartment sink (94.4°F), reaching 113°F by inspection's end. Male workers had beards without guards; fryers greasy.

headline: Live roaches found; raw chicken over potatoes
summary: About 3 live roaches by a cooler beside a handwashing sink; dead roaches under coolers and sinks. Citation issued. Raw chicken stored over potatoes was corrected on site. Three-compartment sink stoppers don't hold water; dish machine leaking.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles and dirty cooler floor
summary: Water-stained ceiling tiles at the front, above the desk and in the rear dishwashing area need replacing. Walk-in cooler floor had dirt, stains and spills. The mop was not stored to air dry.

headline: Food stored on floor; rusty shelves; cardboard liners
summary: Boxed food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Rusty shelves in the walk-in cooler and cardboard liners in dry storage were flagged. One certified food manager's allergen training certificate had expired.

headline: Foil used as shelf liner
summary: Foil was used as a liner on storage shelves in the rear prep area. Staff were instructed to remove it so surfaces stay smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Live roaches and flies; windows lack screens
summary: About 3 live roaches on the men's restroom floor, under the dish machine and by the reach-in freezer. About 5 large flies in the dining area and 15 small flies in restrooms. Open windows lacked screens. Citation issued.

headline: Outside dumpster area dirty; garbage spillage
summary: Outside dumpster area was not clean, with garbage spillage and pallets. Citation issued. The area must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Large containers lack labels
summary: Large food containers had no labels. Manager was instructed to provide labels.

headline: Cold foods too warm; mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: Many cold foods held at 46.4–60.8°F, including chicken, ham, cheesecake, and sliced cheese; about 100 lbs ($2,000) discarded. Two cold units at 50.2–57.9°F were tagged. Black mold-like substance in ice machine; ice destroyed.

headline: Ice machine interior, leaky pipes, greasy floors
summary: Ice machine interior must be cleaned. Front exterior door has worn weather stripping at the bottom. Leaking pipes under rear three-compartment sink. Floors with spills, debris and grease; hood filters greasy.

headline: Cold foods too warm; no certified manager
summary: Cold foods held too warm, including yogurt at 49.2°F and tomatoes at 46.5°F; about 16 lbs discarded. A 49°F display cooler was ordered out of use. No person in charge or certified food manager was present during food prep.

headline: Food containers stored on floor
summary: Food containers stored on floor in walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas. Manager instructed to elevate them at least six inches on raised shelving.

headline: Expired food handler certificates on site
summary: Expired food handler training certificates were on site. Current food handler training certificates must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Dirty ice machine, cooler, restroom, garbage can
summary: Ice machine interior, reach-in cooler, washroom fixtures and floor, and an interior garbage can were dirty. Walk-in freezer had ice buildup; floors under shelving need cleaning. Cleaning is needed to prevent pest breeding.

headline: Hair restraints and beard guards not used
summary: Some female workers' hair was not restrained under caps; some male workers with beards had no beard guards. Internal food handler and allergen training lacked approved Illinois Department of Public Health (IDPH) letters, which state law requires.

headline: Raw chicken juice spills in prep cooler
summary: Raw chicken juice spilled inside a prep cooler in the meat prep area; staff were instructed to clean it.

headline: Food containers need common-name labels
summary: Food stored in containers rather than its original packaging, such as squeeze bottles and shakers, must be labeled with its common name.

headline: No certified food manager during food service
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken, rice and beans were prepared and served; citation issued. Rear handwashing sink was blocked by spice containers; removed during inspection. Food handlers lacked hair restraints; dirty floors in rear prep.

headline: About 50 rodent droppings in dry storage
summary: About 50 rodent droppings found in rear dry storage; citation issued and pest control recommended. Also: unlabeled flour, cardboard reused as floor liner, dirty fryers and refrigerator interior, old grease buckets, and dirty floors.

headline: Foil used as shelf liner
summary: Aluminum foil was used as a liner on storage shelves. Staff were instructed to remove it so the surfaces stay smooth and easy to clean. Inspection passed.

headline: No certified food manager on premises
summary: No City of Chicago certified food service manager on premises; citation issued. Corrected on site: certified manager arrived at 11:40 AM.

headline: Over 20 mouse droppings in basement furnace room
summary: Over 20 mouse droppings in basement furnace room; citation issued; exterminator needed. Employee ate on prep cooler. No thermometers in basement reach-ins; no sanitizer test kit; three-compartment faucet doesn't reach all basins.

headline: No pest control log; no training proof
summary: No current pest control log book; citation issued. Prep bowls stored soiled after washing; must be rewashed. Grease, food debris and dirt on floors in several areas. No food handler training proof and no certified manager with allergen training.

headline: Floors need cleaning in walk-in and kitchen
summary: Floors in the walk-in cooler, under the three-compartment sink in dishwashing, and in the kitchen need cleaning to remove spills, debris, and grease.

headline: Dish machine failed sanitizing; no certified manager
summary: Dish machines failed sanitizing: 0 and 10 parts per million (50–100 required). No valid certified food manager on site. Handwashing sinks lacked signs. Upkeep: rust, dirty cooler, broken sink, poor lighting, greasy hood.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; hair restraints
summary: Repeat violation: food handler certificates expired for employees; citation issued. Employee without hair restraint in cake decorating area. Torn gasket on a three-door cooler; bulk dry storage racks have food debris.

headline: Washroom door closer broken; food handler lacks certificate
summary: Washroom door lacked a working self-closing device. One food handler had no food handler certificate. Food debris on the wall behind cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Rubber nozzle holder; boxes stored on floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rubber nozzle holder at the front westside bar is not smooth and must be replaced. Boxes stored on floor in rear dry storage; shelving needed to raise items six inches.

headline: Expired food handler certificate
summary: Re-inspection passed. One food handler had an expired food handler certificate. Staff were instructed to obtain and maintain a valid certificate.

headline: Poor kitchen wall repairs needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Walls in kitchen areas have small holes, chipping paint, and cracks or crevices; they must be repaired.

headline: No certified person in charge or posted certificate
summary: Person in charge lacked a city sanitation certificate, and no certified person was posted while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. One food handler lacked training proof; no allergen certificate.

headline: Live roaches found; cold food too warm
summary: Three live roaches found near front prep beverage cabinet; manager killed them before inspection ended. Banana pudding at 52.2–54.1°F and a display cooler at 49.1°F were corrected on site; cooler repaired. About 40 lbs ($1,238) discarded.

headline: Taped faucet leaks; dirty freezer floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Three-compartment sink faucets in the deli and meat area leaked and were taped; they must be repaired with cleanable material. Freezer floor grime, peeling deli cabinet doors, and walls need attention.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; no allergen training
summary: All employees' food handler certificates were expired. Repeat violation: no allergen training for the certified food manager; certificates must be kept on site. Citation issued.

headline: Food containers unlabeled; no splashguard; leaking drain
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food stored in containers in coolers, walk-in cooler and dry storage lacked name labels. No splashguard between rear hand sink and rice bulk container. Water leaking from floor drain in front bar area; repair ordered.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; ice drain into handsink
summary: Bulk sugar and rice lacked labels. Prepackaged cold-case items, such as brownies and flan, lacked ingredients and business name and address. Ice shaving machine drain tube emptied into a handwashing sink; person in charge told to remove it.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Wiping cloths left on prep tables; must be stored in sanitizing solution. Three-compartment sink missing stoppers. Rear handsink drains slowly. Employee washroom lacks covered waste bin and has a missing floor tile.

headline: Food debris inside coffee station cabinets
summary: Food spills and debris were found inside cabinets under the coffee station. Manager must clean the cabinet interiors and keep them clean.

headline: Food on floor, no certified manager, repeat violations
summary: Food stored on floor; employee ate in prep area; unlabeled bulk containers; leaking drainpipe. No person in charge with valid certificate, and no certified manager during pasta and yam service; citation issued. Repeat violations not corrected.

headline: Food spills on prep floors; containers on floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Front prep floors need detail cleaning to remove spills and grease. To-go containers must be off the floor and not stored under shelving. Hood vent filters need cleaning to remove grease.

headline: Debris in cooler; leaking restroom sink
summary: Pink build-up inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Food debris in a reach-in cooler, prep shelves and dish area. Men's restroom handwashing sink leaking; food and grease build-up behind the three-compartment sink.

headline: Hot and cold foods unsafe; products discarded
summary: Chicken tenders (59.7–64.4°F) and pizza (112.6–119.8°F) were held too cool for hot-holding (135°F minimum). Cold foods reached 47–56°F (41°F maximum). About 27 lbs discarded. Grill cooler at 59.9°F was tagged. Several handwashing sinks lacked soap or towels.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan or supplies
summary: No procedure or supplies exist for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; gloves, masks, mops and a norovirus-effective sanitizer are required. A 1/4-inch gap is under the front door, the washroom door does not self-close, and construction materials are stored in closets.

headline: About 70 mouse droppings; sinks blocked
summary: About 70 mouse droppings were found along walls and in corners in the bar, prep and back storage areas; a citation was issued. Front and rear handwashing sinks were blocked by carts and equipment. The menu lacks a raw-food consumer advisory.

headline: Sink drains poorly; wastewater leaks onto floor
summary: The basement three-compartment sink drains slowly, backs up, and leaks onto the floor. A grease trap leaks wastewater onto the food prep floor. No food handler certificates were on site. Unused items are stored in the basement; one bulb is out.

headline: No certified manager; shellfish tags missing
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared. Clams had no shellfish tag, and none were on site; about 8 lbs ($65) discarded. Also: no air thermometers, no sink stoppers, and no handwashing signs.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; leaking faucets
summary: All bulk food containers need product-name labels. Food equipment and reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning. Faucets at handsinks and the three-compartment sink leak. Broken ceiling tiles need replacing. No allergen training proof on site.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 parts per million (ppm) chlorine, so it was not sanitizing. It is tagged held for inspection and may not be used. A citation was issued. The sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings in basement
summary: Over 100 rat droppings were found in the basement storage area, with excessive clutter. A citation was issued and additional pest control service was recommended. The ice machine has black mold-like substance; ice must be removed and the machine cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; greasy fryer areas
summary: Wet and dry bulk ingredients lacked labels at the cook line and prep station. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces. Compartments under fryers have excessive grease. Floors in the dish room, kitchen and dry storage need cleaning. No allergen training proof was provided.

headline: Utensils stored with exposed food surfaces
summary: Scoops, spatulas and spoons were stored with food-contact surfaces exposed; the manager was instructed to invert them. A small reach-in cooler lacks a thermometer. The employee bathroom door is not self-closing. The certified manager had no allergen training proof.

headline: No paper towels; food stored on floor
summary: No paper towels were at the prep and dish area handsink; one was provided during the inspection. A citation was issued. The ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice; cleaning began during the inspection. Food boxes were stored on the floor, and a washroom floor is damaged.

headline: Vacuum-sealed raw beef without approved plan
summary: Raw beef and other TCS foods were packaged in reduced-oxygen packaging without a city-approved food safety plan (HACCP). About 30 lbs ($100) discarded; the equipment was removed. Also: grease buildup, dirty ice machine interior, and more ventilation needed above panini machine.

headline: No covered sanitary napkin disposal
summary: The employee washroom has no covered receptacle for sanitary napkin disposal. The operator was instructed to provide one.

headline: Old equipment cluttering basement
summary: Old equipment is stored in the basement. It must be cleaned and organized.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: The city-certified manager on duty did not have her allergen training certificate. She must provide and keep it on site, or citations will follow.

headline: Cardboard on floor; ice machine debris
summary: Cardboard is on the floor in the main prep area and must be removed so the surface is smooth and easy to clean. There is slight debris inside the ice machine, which needs cleaning.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on counters; floors need cleaning
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on counters and prep tables throughout the kitchen and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Floors in the dish area, produce cooler and main walk-in need cleaning. Women's washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle.

headline: No certified manager while eggs, yogurt served
summary: No verifiable city-certified food manager was on site while eggs, yogurt and pork sausage were prepared and served; a citation was issued. The low-temperature dish machine had over 200 parts per million (ppm) chlorine; it is tagged and may not be used.

headline: Grease, food debris and dirt on floors
summary: Grease buildup, food debris and dirt were found on floors under cooking equipment, along walls and in corners in prep, dish and storage areas. The manager was instructed to clean all of these areas.

headline: Opening near sink pipe to outside
summary: Inspector found an opening leading outdoors around the water pipe under the three-compartment sink. No pests were found. Operator was instructed to seal the hole.

headline: Uncovered serveware near vents; grease buildup
summary: Service plates and saucers near ventilation air vents were uncovered and not inverted. Grease and small debris under cooking equipment and in corners under the dish area must be cleaned to prevent pests or insects.

headline: Blocked handwashing sink; no paper towels
summary: The rear handwashing sink is blocked by boxes and a table, so it is not accessible. Paper towels were missing. Sliced melon and salads in a display cooler lacked use-by dates. Food was stored on the walk-in floor; a citation was issued.

headline: Heavy grease in hood; clutter and dirty floors
summary: Heavy dirt and grease are inside and on the edges of the exhaust hood, filters and pipes above cooking equipment. Clutter along the hallway and kitchen walls could hide pests. Floors under the stove need cleaning; a refrigerator gasket is torn.

headline: Soiled mop heads not stored properly
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly. The manager was instructed to hang them to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Large carnitas pots don't fit sink
summary: Large carnitas pots are too big for the three-compartment sink. The operator must have a written procedure for washing, rinsing and sanitizing large pots in place.

headline: Door gaps, failed dish machine gauge, unlabeled items
summary: Gaps around front, DJ booth, stage and patio doors must be fixed to keep pests out. The high-temperature dish machine's final rinse display is not working; it is tagged held for inspection, and a citation was issued. Boxes sit on the walk-in floor.

headline: Moldy ice machines; missing backflow device
summary: Ice machines at the front serving station had excessive black and brown mold-like substance inside; the ice must be discarded and the machines cleaned. A citation was issued. No visible backflow device was present. Dusty vents and dirty floor drains need attention.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate while chicken served
summary: No valid City sanitation certificate was on site while chicken was being served; a citation was issued. The floor behind the ice machine is very grimy. No allergen training was on site.

headline: Dirty floors, wall holes, missing certificates
summary: Excessive dirt and debris on floors in the food prep area and toilet room must be cleaned. Holes in walls must be sealed. No food handler certificates or allergen training certificates for sanitation managers were shown.

headline: No commercial dumpster; door not self-closing
summary: The premises uses the building's dumpster instead of a commercial garbage dumpster, which is a priority violation. The washroom door is not self-closing. Floors along walls and corners in storage areas have debris, and the washroom fan needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; rodent droppings found
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while dairy, rice and ham were served. About 40 rodent droppings were found in a cabinet, along a wall base and at the rear prep entrance; a citation was issued. Prescription medicine was in the prep area.

headline: No certified manager while sandwiches served
summary: The person in charge lacks a City sanitation certificate. No certified manager or certificate was on site while ham and cheese sandwiches and milk were served; a citation was issued. Also: no employee health policy, a milk cooler needs a visible thermometer, and dusty vents need cleaning.

headline: Dish machines not reaching sanitizing temperature
summary: Two high-temperature dish machines, not in use, rinsed at 154.9–159.0°F; final rinse must reach 180°F. They are tagged held for inspection. Also: 1/4-inch gaps in wall vents need pest-proofing, and bulk containers lack labels.

headline: No City sanitation certificate; ServSafe shown
summary: No City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate was on site. The person in charge presented a ServSafe certificate issued in 2025, which does not meet the requirement. This is a priority foundation violation.

headline: Leaking sink and missing ceiling tiles
summary: A handwashing sink in the rear prep area is leaking and must be repaired. Missing ceiling tiles need replacing. The city-certified manager had no proof of allergen training.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No city-certified food manager was on premises while chicken, tuna, soup and beef were prepared or served; a citation was issued. No food handler certificates were shown, and no allergen certificate was on site. Mop heads were not hung.

headline: Greasy fryer, floors and walls
summary: Grease covers the sides and interior door of the deep fryer and the floor under cooking equipment. Grease is also on the wall behind the grill. Walls and corners in the rear prep area, especially near the mop sink, need sealing.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; unlabeled containers
summary: Men's employee restroom is missing handwashing signage. Food storage containers lack labels showing the common name of the food.

headline: Missing signs; unlabeled containers; gaps in doors
summary: Handwashing signs are missing in food prep areas and washrooms. Bulk containers are unlabeled. Rear exit doors have half-inch openings that must be made rodent-proof. Several dry storage closets are cluttered, and no food handler training proof was provided.

headline: Grease and food debris on floors
