summary: Grease and food debris built up on the floor below the right deep fryer and in the west corner of the front prep area. The manager was instructed to detail clean both areas.

headline: Cooked beans cooled too slowly; discarded
summary: A stock pot of cooked beans placed in the walk-in cooler the night before was at 58.7°F. Cooling must go from 135°F to 70°F within 2 hours, then to 41°F within 4 more hours. About 20 lbs ($35) discarded. Also: ice scoop buried in ice.

headline: Food handler and allergen training required
summary: The manager was instructed to comply with the state food handler training requirement for all kitchen and food handler staff. All City-certified managers must maintain allergen training.

headline: No backflow device at ice machine
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine waterline. No handwashing signs at bar sinks. Food containers were not stored inverted. Floors at the basement stairs were not clean.

headline: Suspension sign removed; citation issued
summary: The posted license suspension sign was taken off the front of the store. It had been posted January 14, 2025 and replaced February 5, 2025. The operator was previously told not to move, remove or conceal it. A citation was issued.

headline: Hole in walk-in cooler wall; grime in coolers
summary: A hole at the back of the walk-in cooler wall must be sealed. Food grime and debris are inside cold-hold units and freezers. The ice machine door has calcium-like buildup. The certified manager's allergen certificate has expired.

headline: Cold foods held at 47–48°F; discarded
summary: Tomatoes and hard-boiled eggs were held at 47°F and 48°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager discarded about 1/8 lb tomatoes and 1/4 lb eggs ($10). A priority citation was issued.

headline: No cooler thermometer; floor buildup
summary: The front cooler has no thermometer for measuring air temperature. Floors under shelving in the rear storage area have buildup that needs cleaning.

headline: Repeat violation: no allergen certificate
summary: A core violation from 2023 was not corrected: no allergen training certificate for certified food managers was on site. This is a priority foundation violation, and a citation was issued.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: The faucet at the three-compartment sink leaks. The operator was instructed to correct the leak and maintain it.

headline: Dead roaches found; pest logbook outdated
summary: Dead roaches were found under the bar three-compartment sink. The pest logbook held reports only from 2017–2022, with none for 2024 or 2025. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were on site. A urinal is out of order.

headline: Rodent droppings found; cheese held at 57°F
summary: About 75 rodent droppings were found around the water heater, under the customer counter and in a toilet-room cabinet. Cheese held at 57°F was discarded. Hot water does not run at the utility sink, and a handwashing sink drains poorly. Citations were issued.

headline: Improperly stored pans; allergen training missing
summary: Metal food containers on the drying rack were stored improperly and must be inverted. A certified manager on site had no allergen training completion.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; dusty walls
summary: A torn door gasket inside the 1st-floor two-door prep cooler must be replaced. Walls above the three-compartment sink area need detail cleaning to remove dust.

headline: Gaps at revolving door; leaking faucets
summary: Openings at the base and corners of the revolving door must be sealed to prevent pests. Both faucets at the three-compartment sink leak. Splash guards are missing at the bar handwashing sink, and dust covers the rear prep ceiling.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site while food was being prepared. Chicken was grilled outdoors in the parking lot; the person in charge discarded it. Also missing: pest control logbook, food handler certificates, and hair restraints for an employee.

headline: Food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Food handlers preparing food at the front counter were not wearing hair restraints. The person in charge was told all food handlers must wear one at all times.

headline: No sanitation-trained person in charge
summary: No person in charge had sanitation manager training, and no valid City certificate was on site. About 8 lbs of beef at 52°F were discarded. A two-door cooler at 60°F was tagged. No current pest control logbook was on site.

headline: Ice machine debris; hair restraints needed
summary: The ice machine interior needs cleaning. Food handlers with long hair must wear hair restraints. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution. A dark cutting board needs cleaning, and deli equipment and floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Metal bowls in cut fruit; mold on walls
summary: Metal bowls were stored inside cut-fruit containers in the walk-in cooler; handled utensils must be used instead. A damaged wall base next to the tilt pot must be sealed to keep insects out. Mold-like substance under the three-compartment sink must be removed.

headline: No written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure
summary: No written cleaning procedure or required equipment exists for vomit or diarrhea events. The operator must provide them. This is a priority foundation violation.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: No employee health policy and no written procedure with supplies for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea were on site. Certified managers lacked allergen training. Blown-out hood light bulbs need replacing. No citation issued today.

headline: No certified manager; raw eggs too warm
summary: No valid City sanitation certificate or certified person was on site while TCS food was prepared; the manager arrived about 40 minutes later. About 40 lbs of raw eggs at 46.9°F (45°F maximum) were discarded. The menu lacks a raw-food disclosure, and the summary report was not posted.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: The walk-in cooler ran at 50–55°F (41°F or below required). Food held at 47–68°F was discarded, about 300 lbs. The cooler was tagged, then read 38°F and was returned to use. The self-serve ice chute had brown and black residue.

headline: No handwashing signs; missing thermometers
summary: Handwashing signs are missing near sinks in the front prep and dish areas. Working thermometers are needed in front prep coolers. The certified manager has no allergen training proof. Previous violations were not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: Ice machine buildup; loose splash guard
summary: Slight buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Food debris is on the lower sides of the dish machine drainboards. A splash guard on the prep handwashing sink is loose and must be reattached.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit kit
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure was on site. No food handler certificates were available. Soiled mop heads were not hung, and the ceiling is water-stained in places.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; unlabeled staples
summary: The rear exit door leading to the dumpsters is not rodent-proof. Salt, flour and sugar are stored in unlabeled containers. Both all-gender washrooms lack covered receptacles, and the basement storage room is cluttered.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; allergen training missing
summary: Rubber gaskets on a two-door reach-in cooler on the cook line are ripped and must be replaced. One food manager lacks a food allergen training certificate.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; leaking drainpipe
summary: Excess ice and debris must be removed from the walk-in freezer floor, walls and ceiling. Food containers stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. A drainpipe under the grill-area sink leaks. Rusted shelving and dusty vents need attention.

headline: No certified manager; corrected on site
summary: No city-certified food manager was on premises; corrected on site when the manager arrived at 12:20 PM. An opening at the rear exit door must be sealed. Paper towel dispenser must move away from prep areas. Hood filters are greasy and hood lights are out.

headline: Food debris, ice buildup, and broken sink
summary: Food debris under cooking equipment, ice buildup in the basement freezers, and greasy hood over fryers need cleaning. A basement handwashing sink is in disrepair. Pink residue is on the ice machine, and unused equipment and low lighting were noted.

headline: Greasy hood filters; dusty restroom vent
summary: Grease buildup was found on hood filters, and a restroom vent has dust buildup. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain both.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; leaking sink
summary: Encrusted grease covers cooking equipment and surrounding walls on the main cook line and must be cleaned. The two-compartment sink leaks when in use. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Dirty ice bin; no allergen certificate
summary: The ice bin interior needs cleaning; ice must be removed and the bin cleaned. The food service sanitation manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Unlabeled containers; tongs stored on paper plate
summary: Food storage containers in the prep area lack labels. Tongs were stored on a paper plate at the front line. Cardboard lines food prep equipment and must be removed. A two-door freezer has broken door handles.

headline: Rodent droppings and dead roaches found
summary: About 15 mouse droppings were found in cabinets under the three-compartment sink and in a storage closet. Dead roaches were in a cabinet under the sink. Additional pest control is needed. Restroom hot water does not run for 15 seconds.

headline: One food manager lacks allergen training
summary: One food manager does not have a food allergen training certificate. The inspector instructed that all City of Chicago certified food managers must have one.

headline: Food stored on floor in walk-in freezer
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer. They must be raised at least six inches on shelving to protect them from contamination.

headline: Single-use items on floor; allergen training missing
summary: Single-service articles were not inverted and were stored on the floor in prep and storage areas; they must be inverted and raised. The certified manager on duty had no allergen training.

headline: Missing coving along walls
summary: Walls have no coving (curved seal at the wall base). The operator was instructed to provide it.

headline: Chipped paint near handsinks
summary: Chipped paint on walls near the front prep handsink and under the three-compartment sink must be repainted. Surfaces should be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: No certified manager; corrected on site
summary: No city-certified food manager was on premises while beef, chicken and rice were prepped, cooked and served. Corrected on site when the manager arrived at 11:40 AM. Also: leaking faucets, damaged refrigerator gaskets, missing ceiling tiles, and fly strips in the juice bar.

headline: No food handler training; unlabeled containers
summary: No food handler training was provided for employees. Food containers are unlabeled, utensils are not inverted, and basement and mop-sink closet need clutter removed. The missing floor tile under the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Food on freezer floor; greasy equipment
summary: Food items were stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer and must be raised six inches. Food debris and grease cover cooking equipment, coolers, prep tables and shelving. Floors, walls and corners in several areas need cleaning.

headline: Uncorrected grease buildup; faucet leaks
summary: Grease buildup on fryers, filters, walls and floors was not corrected from a prior inspection; a citation was issued. Two open bait blocks were removed. Also: leaking faucet, rusty shelving, dirty floors, and no food handler or allergen certificates on site.

headline: Missing thermometer and labels; dirty drains
summary: The hot holding counter unit has no ambient air thermometer. Several grab-and-go items in display coolers lack labels showing name, source and ingredients. Floor drains and troughs have soil buildup and need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted
summary: No city-certified food manager certificate was posted on premises; an original certificate must be on site. The ice machine has slight buildup, and a reach-in cooler has accumulated food debris. Both need cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection: uncovered food, leaking sink
summary: Uncovered trays of egg rolls in the walk-in cooler must be covered. A leak under the three-compartment sink needs repair. Build-up inside the ice machine door and peeling washroom walls also need attention.

headline: Low water pressure; food handler training missing
summary: Low water pressure at the washroom handwashing sink. The drainpipe under the three-compartment sink leaks. One employee lacks food handler training, and all employees handling food must have it.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Expired food handler certificates were on the premises, and the certified manager's allergen training had expired. Also: unlabeled bulk container, pots and pans not stored inverted, a stripped cold-water handle, and equipment needing cleaning.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; unsafe scooping
summary: No valid City sanitation certificate was on site. A bowl was used as a scoop in dry food containers, and an ice scoop was stored in ice. Leaking handwashing sinks, missing handwashing signs, and foil or cardboard shelf liners were also cited.

headline: Torn gaskets on egg cooler
summary: Gaskets inside the egg cooler behind the prep station are torn. The operator was instructed to repair them.

headline: Cooling food covered; staff missing training
summary: Breaded chicken was covered with plastic wrap while cooling in the walk-in. Food should be loosely covered or uncovered while cooling so heat can escape. Several food employees lacked food handler training or certificates on site.

headline: Dish machine too cool to sanitize
summary: Dish machine's final rinse reached only 115°F, below sanitizing level, so use was stopped. A technician repaired it; it later reached 181°F. Ready-to-eat food held over 24 hours lacked date labels. Records for a special packaging process were missing.

headline: Handwashing sinks too cold; no soap
summary: Two exposed handwashing sinks in the kitchen and dish area produced only 73.8°F and 70.9°F water; the required range is 100–120°F. A citation was issued. Upstairs washroom sink lacked soap. A shellfish tag was undated, and two certified managers lack allergen certificates.

headline: No certified manager while hot dogs served
summary: No certified food manager was on the premises while hot dogs (food that must be kept hot or cold, or TCS) were prepared and served. A citation was issued. A hole in the ceiling panel above the three-compartment sink must be sealed.

headline: No hot water; no health or cleanup policy
summary: The facility has no hot water. No employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure were on site. No commercial dumpster was present. Also missing: refrigerator thermometer and sink stoppers.

headline: Staff eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees drank and prepared food at the kitchen prep area; a designated eating area is required. Unlabeled food is in refrigerators, and food containers are stored on floors. A torn gasket and a leaking pipe under the three-compartment sink were also noted.

headline: Frozen chicken thawed in standing water
summary: A food handler thawed frozen chicken in a three-compartment prep sink sitting in standing water. The handler was told to thaw under running water. The facility must meet proper thawing requirements.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold food temperatures; food discarded
summary: Cooked rice at 114.5°F (must stay at 135°F or above) and yogurt raita at 57.7°F (must stay at 41.1°F or below) were found; about 50 lbs discarded. Also: a handwashing sink lacked soap and was blocked, and the outdoor dumpster overflowed.

headline: Rusty shelving, slow drains, and missing trash lids
summary: Rusty shelving in basement storage and liquor cooler must be repainted or replaced. Slow-draining sink in first women's washroom and low water pressure at men's sink need repair. Ice scoops stored in ice bin. Burnt-out light above prep coolers.

headline: No person in charge; dishes washed without sanitizing
summary: No person in charge and no valid sanitation certificate posted during inspection; citation issued. Staff washed dishes in a dump sink without sanitizing, then stored them; told to rewash. Ice machine slime and no written employee health policy.

headline: Live and dead roaches found; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: Live roach on floor near dish machine; several dead roaches in prep, dish, storage and bar areas. Sanitizer at 0 ppm; dish machine tagged and held until reinspected. Gaps under front doors. Food handler training proof missing.

headline: Dead roaches, unsafe cold food temperatures, no health policy
summary: About 20 dead roaches under three-compartment sink and in oven. Chicken at 55.6°F and shrimp at 57.1°F in prep cooler; about 10 lbs discarded. Cooler at 64.4°F tagged and held. No verifiable employee health policy or training certificates.

headline: Dirty floors and walls; one worker lacks food handler card
summary: Accumulated dirt on floors and along walls throughout the prep area; person in charge told to clean. One food handler lacks a food handler certificate and must comply with IDPH requirements.

headline: Storage shelves and floors need detail cleaning
summary: Storage shelves need detail cleaning to remove debris. Floors throughout the facility need detail cleaning to remove debris and buildup. Manager instructed to clean and sanitize all areas.

headline: No certified sanitation manager; fly paper hanging
summary: No valid City sanitation manager certificate on site while nachos and beef were prepared; citation issued. No person in charge with sanitation manager training. Sticky fly paper hanging in prep and storage area must be removed. Dusty fans and debris noted.

headline: Fly strip hanging; no written large-equipment procedure
summary: Fly strip hanging from ceiling in food prep area must be removed; only pest control may install insect devices. No written procedure for washing oversized equipment. Minor hot-water knob leak at three-compartment sink. Closets need organizing.

headline: Food sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The food sanitation manager has no allergen training. The facility must provide it.

headline: Minor hair restraint, wiping cloth and door issues
summary: Pass with minor issues: a worker in the prep and dish area had no hair restraint, wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and both restroom doors do not self-close. Manager instructed to correct all three.

headline: About 5 live roaches found; raw wood shelving
summary: About 5 live roaches on speaker and floor in dining area, wooden seasoning shelves in prep, and a washroom door frame. Pest control needed before reinspection; citation issued. Raw wood shelves near front counter must be sealed. Backflow device missing on mop sink.

headline: High-temperature dish machine not functional
summary: High-temperature dish machine is not functioning and is not in use. Must be repaired so it properly sanitizes utensils. Priority violation; no citation issued.

headline: Employee washroom water too cool; loose faucet
summary: Employee washroom handsink water at 72°F, must be at least 100°F; citation issued. Women's restroom hot water must run at least 15 seconds without reactivating. Loose faucet in family restroom. Grease and syrup inside soda station cabinets. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Flies found; unsafe cold food and sanitizer failures
summary: About 30 live small flies on upper walls near the bar. Cold food held at 46–63°F; about 202 lbs discarded. Dish machine at 0 ppm was repaired on site to 100 ppm. Two prep coolers tagged and held. Restroom hand-sink hot water too cool.

headline: Mold, unsafe food temperatures, and mouse droppings found
summary: Mold on lemon cake for sale. Chicken, beef and egg rolls held at 83.8–101.4°F (must be 135°F or above); cheese at 53.2°F; manager told to discard. Over 50 mouse droppings, three live roaches and flying insects in prep and storage.

headline: Cook prepared eggs without washing hands
summary: A cook moved a garbage can with bare hands, then prepared eggs without washing hands or changing gloves. Manager had the employee wash hands, change gloves, and discard the eggs. Repeat violations include cardboard liners, mop storage, expired food handler certificates, and no allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; dirty floors
summary: Bulk flour, grain and spices are not labeled and must be labeled. Floors behind and under equipment throughout the facility are not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: No drain board for three-compartment sink
summary: No drain board is provided for the three-compartment sink. Manager instructed to install one.

headline: Many cleaning and repair items remain outstanding
summary: Remove foil liners, rusty shelving and crates. Repair worn gaskets and damaged bins. Clean grease from fryers, coolers and prep tables. Repair leaky three-compartment faucet, stained ceiling tiles, and burnt-out lights. Provide food handler training for new employees.

headline: Chicken at 48.5°F; refrigerator at 52°F tagged
summary: Chicken held at 48.5°F; about 40 lbs (around $200) discarded. Refrigerator at 52°F was tagged and must not be used until reinspected. No current pest control log book; citation issued. Refrigeration units, fryers and storage need cleaning.

headline: No certified person in charge; missing handwash sinks
summary: No person in charge with a valid sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate posted for TCS food handling. Handwashing sinks missing in dish prep and bar prep areas. No sanitizer test kit. Ventilation hood not working. No commercial garbage pickup.

headline: No certified manager while eggs were prepared
summary: No certified manager on site while TCS items such as eggs were prepared; citation issued. No verifiable health policy, no vomiting and diarrhea kit or procedure, and several employees lack food handler training. Allergen training certificates missing.

headline: No certified manager; dishes washed without sanitizing
summary: No certified food manager on duty while rice and soups were prepared and served; citation issued. Employee washed dishes without setting up the sink to sanitize; manager had it corrected immediately with chlorine. Torn gasket and no allergen training for managers.

headline: Dumpster area spilled garbage; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Outside dumpster area is not clean, with garbage spillage. Floors at rear mop sink area are not clean. Sanitation manager has no allergen training certificate and must provide it.

headline: Slimy ice machine; ice discarded; sink stoppers broken
summary: Black dirt and slime inside ice machine dripped into ice used for drinks. All ice was voluntarily discarded. Machine must be cleaned by reinspection. Three-compartment sink stoppers not working and must be repaired.

headline: Expired manager certificate; splashguard missing
summary: Expired City of Chicago food manager certificate on site; citation issued. No self-closing device on rear toilet room door. Splashguard missing between handwash and utility sink, a repeat violation not corrected since 2024; citation issued.

headline: Gap under front door; ice buildup in freezer
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Also: ice buildup inside walk-in freezer, and no covered waste receptacles in washrooms.

headline: Openings at revolving door base must be sealed
summary: Openings at the base of the front revolving door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. No other issues are listed in these notes.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training records
summary: No food handler training certificates on site. No allergen training certificates for certified managers. Two prep coolers lack thermometers. Handwashing signs missing at several sinks. Burnt-out lights and dusty ceiling in rear prep area.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tile; missing training certificates
summary: Water-stained ceiling tile above ice cream freezers in front prep area to replace. Additional food handler training certificate must be on site. No allergen training certificates for certified food service managers.

headline: Non-food shelves over food; missing splash guard
summary: Shelves for non-food items installed above open food containers at front prep area; must be removed. Handwashing sink at rear cook line lacks a splash guard. Walk-in cooler needs an additional light fixture.

headline: Doors need rodent-proofing; no thermometers in coolers
summary: Front, rear and basement doors must be rodent-proofed. Thermometers needed in prep and reach-in coolers. Ice scoop stored inside ice machine. Backflow device not accessible at mop sink. Leak under grease box. No food handler or allergen training certificates.

headline: Dirty ice machine chute; no food handler training proof
summary: Upper ice chute inside ice machine needs cleaning. Raw wood shelving in liquor cooler must be sealed; cloth towels may not be used as liners. Raw brick wall in prep kitchen must be sealed. No proof of food handler training for any employees.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; about 60 rat droppings
summary: Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm; repaired on site to 50 ppm; citation issued. About 60 rat droppings on basement floor storage; manager must clean and get additional pest control. Single-service items not inverted or raised. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Hole in dish area wall must be sealed
summary: A hole in the wall in the dish area must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager with allergen training on site
summary: No certified food manager with food allergen training was on site. Manager instructed to comply with the requirement.

headline: Rear door gap; damaged gaskets; several lights out
summary: Gap of at least 1/4 inch at rear exit door; door sweep must be repaired or replaced. Damaged, dirty gaskets on two coolers. Food residue on dish machine. Dust near ceiling vents. Several lights out in prep area and hall. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: No certified food service manager on site while deli meat and hummus were handled and served. Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine on final rinse. Salt bulk container unlabeled. Dust on conduits and walls above food prep and dish areas.

headline: Ice buildup, leaking drains, and wastewater pooling
summary: Damaged or missing vinyl strip doors at most walk-in coolers. Excess ice in bakery freezer. Leaking drainpipes under sinks in meat and hot foods prep. Wastewater pools from hot foods floor drain; three-compartment sink use stopped until repaired.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies or procedure
summary: Not enough supplies on site to respond to vomiting and diarrheal events, and no cleanup procedure; citation issued. Ready-to-eat TCS foods in a cold-hold unit lacked date marks; no citation. Food containers unlabeled and some stored on floor.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; glue boards need replacing
summary: Rear door is not rodent-proofed. All glue boards need replacing, and some are damaged. Worn cutting boards with dark stains and dirty rubber gaskets. Leaking bathroom faucet. Walls, floors, ceilings and hood need cleaning of grease and dust.

headline: Tape used for cooler repairs; unused cooler outside
summary: Tape must not be used as a repair inside coolers or on equipment. Unused cooler on rear outdoor patio must be removed to prevent rodent harboring.

headline: Leaking valve, raw wood surfaces, and debris outside
summary: Leaking valve under prep-area handwashing sink must be repaired. Raw wood under deli cooler must be sealed. Plumber's putty in beverage sink must be removed. Covered receptacle needed in unisex washroom. Outside debris near refuse area to clean.

headline: No bar handwashing sink; food handler training missing
summary: Bar making drinks and handling ice had no handwashing sink. Required: sink with hot and cold water, soap, paper towels. Also no proof of food handler training, no ventilation over fryers and grill, and stored items on floors.

headline: No handwashing signs; no thermometers in display cooler
summary: No handwashing signage in staff restroom. No ambient air thermometers inside large rear display cooler. Thermometers must be provided in all refrigerator units to monitor air temperature.

headline: Dusty display cooler interior and dirty rear floor
summary: Interior of front display cooler has dust and crumb buildup and needs detail cleaning. Heavy dust and coffee bean buildup on floor in rear area of the premises.

headline: No food handler training; no shelving or splash guard
summary: No food handler training for employees. Walk-in cooler and freezer have no shelving; no splash guard between handwashing and prep sinks; no receptacles at handwashing sinks. Debris under equipment; soiled hood filters. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings; dishes not sanitized
summary: About 100 or more mouse droppings along walls and under cooking equipment, freezers, sink and prep tables. Dishes rinsed without sanitizing (0 ppm). Clothing stored on food shelves. No food handler training. Some 2024 core violations uncorrected.

headline: 5–10 dead cockroaches found under equipment
summary: About 5–10 dead cockroaches on floors beneath equipment in the basement and main kitchen. Staff must remove dead roaches and clean affected areas. Single-use paper goods stored on floor must be raised 6 inches. Slow-draining basement handwashing sink.

headline: Flies found; dish machines and cooler not working properly
summary: About 34 live flies (30 small, 4 large) in prep areas, on sinks and equipment. Prep cooler at 55°F (must be 41°F or below). Dish machines sanitizing at 0–5 ppm (50–100 required). Cooler tagged and held.

headline: Cooler too warm, sinks and toilets not working properly
summary: Walk-in cooler at 73.9°F was corrected on site and tagged. Also: missing handwashing signs and splash guards, uncovered ice bins, leaking condenser, low water pressure at sinks, two broken toilets, dim lights, no washroom ventilation.

headline: Oversized pots don't fit sink; floors dirty
summary: Pots too large for the three-compartment sink must be removed or a written alternative washing procedure provided. No handwashing sign at lower-level prep sink. Floors behind freezers in lower-level prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Several food handlers lack food handler certificates
summary: Several food handlers have no food handler certificate; management must show proof of training. Cannoli shells stored in cardboard boxes in basement must move to a cleanable container. No covered waste receptacle in basement employee washroom.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Dumpster overflowing with exposed trash, and lids do not close; citation issued. Dry storage containers missing labels. Excessive ice on walk-in freezer door. Restroom walls have graffiti and debris. Repeat violation: certified manager without allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on site while TCS food served
summary: No person in charge or valid certified sanitation manager on site while TCS food was prepared and served; citation issued. Also: chicken thawing improperly on prep table, food stored on floor, open drink on prep table, and no allergen training.

headline: No raw-food advisory on menu; allergen training missing
summary: Menu lacks the required consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods; must add the required sentence and reminder. Certified food manager lacks a valid allergen training certificate and must show proof.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees were eating and drinking at the kitchen prep area; a designated break area is required. Unlabeled food in walk-in cooler. Some staff in prep area had no hair restraints. Torn walk-in cooler door gasket must be repaired.

headline: Burnt-out hood lights and grease buildup on hoods
summary: Several burnt-out lightbulbs in hoods throughout food prep areas. Grease buildup on hoods in prep areas. Manager instructed to correct both issues and maintain the equipment in good condition.

headline: Toothpaste and toothbrush stored near food sinks
summary: Toothbrush in a handwashing sink and toothpaste stored above three-compartment sink and service sink must be removed. Unlabeled food containers, forks not inverted, discolored cutting board, dusty fans, and black mold-like residue inside ice machine panel.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; equipment needs cleaning
summary: Bulk storage containers are not labeled with the product name and must be labeled. Prep tables, mixers, refrigeration units, ovens, rolling carts and baking pans need cleaning.

headline: About 100 dead flies; sink backs up with foul water
summary: About 100 dead flies in basement storage near sump pump. Large tear in screen on rear exit door. Three-compartment sink drains backward with foul water; priority violation, citation issued. Broken thermometers in prep coolers, missing sink stoppers, and food debris inside microwaves.

headline: About 50 flying insects; more pest service needed
summary: About 50 live small flying insects on walls, ceiling and stock boxes in prep, mop area, manager's office and a washroom. Additional pest control service is needed. Also: clean prep tables, hot-holding units, walls and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Front door gap; clutter; no toilet receptacle
summary: A one-inch gap between front entrance doors must be closed and made rodent-proof. Also: no handwashing sign in employee toilet room, no covered receptacle in toilet rooms, and clutter in rear toilet rooms, storage and front counter.

headline: No certified manager; grease and dusty filters
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS food was prepared and served; citation issued. Grease on and around fryers. No allergen training. Prior violations not corrected: very dusty filters above fryers and griddle, and food handlers lacking training.

headline: Mouse droppings found; no original food certificate
summary: About 30 mouse droppings between bulk containers on basement dry storage shelves; additional pest control recommended. Food prepared without an original certificate or certified manager; only voided photocopy posted; citation issued. Grease and debris on equipment and floors.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food; expired food
summary: Employee handled tortillas with bare hands while making tacos. Pozole soup held past its 7-day use-by date. No written employee health policy. Pest control log lacked recent reports, last one from 2023. Grease on prep table and fryer.

headline: To-go containers used as scoops; plates not inverted
summary: To-go containers and bowls without handles were used to scoop food at service coolers; tongs, spoons or ladles are required. Serving plates on prep shelves were not inverted and risk dust accumulation.

headline: Floors need cleaning around heavy equipment
summary: Floors around and between heavy equipment need cleaning to remove spills, debris and grease.

headline: No handwashing sink in new prep area; cheese discarded
summary: New rear prep area with meat slicer and scales has no handwashing sink; citation issued. Reduced-oxygen packaging used without an approved HACCP plan; cheese discarded and equipment held. Toilet room hot water at 58–60°F, raised to 100°F by end of inspection.

headline: Undated cooked food; about 20 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked beef, chicken, pork, beans and rice in walk-in cooler lacked use-by dates; about 20 lbs (around $100) discarded on site. Food containers stored on floor. Pitted cutting boards, cardboard and foil liners, and a small leak under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Gap under front door; missing splash guards
summary: Gap along bottom of front door must be made tight-fitting. Splash guards needed at front and rear prep hand sinks, plus a loose one at front bar. Worn cutting boards and debris on shelves and floors need correction. Hooks needed for wet mops.

headline: Cold food held at 55–62°F; about $100 discarded
summary: Cold TCS food held at 55–62°F. Manager discarded about $100 of arugula, cooked vegetables, dressing, pastrami and cabbage. Cold foods must stay at 41°F or below. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Stained cutting boards; mop not drying properly
summary: Cutting boards in rear prep area with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. Mop not stored in a position that lets it air-dry, which can harbor pests; it must be mounted for drying.

headline: Cardboard shelf liner, unused oven, and dirty walls
summary: Cardboard must not be used as walk-in cooler shelf liner. Large dirty two-door oven in rear storage must be removed to prevent pest harboring. Food-splattered walls at rear refrigeration unit must be cleaned.

headline: No food handler proof; moldy caulk and water-damaged tile
summary: No proof of food handler training for required employees; must provide. Blackened, moldy caulking at three-compartment sink and water-damaged ceiling tile at rear dish area. Missing light shield in rear refrigeration area. Cloth towels and cardboard not allowed as shelf liners.

headline: Fusion sink not accepted; floor tiles damaged
summary: Fusion sink on second-floor bar is not accepted by the Chicago Department of Health and must be replaced with a single exposed sink. No citation issued. Missing and damaged floor tiles in basement hall need repair.

headline: Debris around washer and dryer area
summary: Debris on the floor around the perimeter of the utility room where the washer and dryer are stored. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings on pallets, floors and along walls in storage, dish and prep areas, plus numerous flying insects. A 1/2-inch gap at rear door. No certified manager on site. Food stored on floor. No food handler training. Exterminator required.

headline: Items stored on floor in storage areas
summary: Miscellaneous items stored on the floor in dry storage near the trash room and in rear storage outside the walk-in cooler. Shelving at least 6 inches off the floor is required to prevent hiding spots for pests.

headline: Greasy hot-holding table and grease-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Hot-holding table near the grill line had grease and dried food on non-food-contact surfaces. Ceiling tiles around the grill hood have grease stains and heat marks. Staff told to clean or replace tiles and maintain the hood.

headline: Dirty walk-in cooler floor; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Floors inside the walk-in cooler are not clean and must be cleaned. The sanitation manager has no allergen training and must provide it.

headline: No certificate posted; no health policy; cardboard liners
summary: No valid food service sanitation certificate posted for food employees; citation issued. No written employee health policy. Cardboard lining on walk-in floor and shelves must be removed. Coolers need detail cleaning, plus foam caulk and chipped paint repairs.

headline: Dirty floor drains and icy walk-in freezer floor
summary: Interior of floor drains is dirty and stained. Walk-in freezer floor has ice buildup. Mop not stored properly; it must be hung to dry when not in use.

headline: Missing thermometer; many cleaning and repair items
summary: No thermometer in small glass reach-in cooler and prep cooler. Previous priority violations not corrected: weatherstripping at rear exit door in poor repair, a pest entry point; dirty floors around cooking equipment; dirty hood filters. Citation issued.

headline: Hand sink water too cool; unsafe hot-held food
summary: Hand sinks had hot water at 72–84°F, below the 100°F minimum; a technician raised them to 102–105°F during inspection. Meat sauce at 110°F and beef at 112°F (must be 135°F or above); about 10 lbs discarded. Citations issued.

headline: Broken wall tiles and greasy floors
summary: Broken wall tiles under the three-compartment sink, a hand sink, and behind a large mixer must be repaired. Minor grease spills on floors behind cooking equipment at the main prep line must be cleaned.

headline: Greasy fryers, ice buildup, and sink leak
summary: Deep fryers have grease, charred food and dirt inside. Ice buildup in walk-in freezer. Leak under front handwashing sink. Floors in corners and around grease container have food and debris. Missing handwashing signage and water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Two glass washers at 0 ppm sanitizer
summary: Both second-floor glass washers were not sanitizing (0 ppm chlorine). They must be repaired and sanitize at 50–100 ppm. Multi-use utensils must be washed, rinsed and sanitized at the three-compartment sink or dish machine. Priority violation.

headline: No covered receptacles; clutter and no training proof
summary: No covered receptacles in washrooms. Trash and debris from garage door to dumpster to clean. Unused office and refrigeration equipment in basement and second floor to remove. No proof of food handler training for any food handlers.

headline: No food handler training; milk crates used as shelves
summary: Employees lack food handler training. Milk crates used as dry storage shelving must be replaced. No handwashing sign at men's washroom sinks, and no high-temperature thermometer for dish machine. Gap under kitchen office exit door to seal.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep; no health policy
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without the original certificate or a certified manager on site; citation issued. No written employee health policy. No manager with allergen training. No inspection summary posted; citation issued.

headline: Food on floor in freezer; crackers stored under sink
summary: Food stored on floor in walk-in freezer must be raised 6 inches. Packaged crackers stored under handwashing sink were removed. Single-service spoons stored behind front prep sink were removed to prevent splash contamination.

headline: Ice scoop improperly stored; missing receptacles
summary: Ice scoop in coffee bar stored in open wire rack touching the wall. Multi-use equipment not inverted. Unisex toilet rooms missing covered receptacles. Dust on ceiling vent in prep area. Manager instructed to correct all items.

headline: Rat droppings and flying insects; no health policy
summary: About 30 rat droppings under storage racks in basement dry storage. About 40 live small flying insects on walls, ceilings and equipment in pastry prep and dishwashing areas. Additional pest control needed. Also: no written health policy, and 1/4-inch gap at rear door.

headline: Black mold in lobby self-serve ice machine
summary: Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine panel, ice shield and nozzle of the lobby self-serve beverage dispenser. Ice removed; machine must be cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. Also: broken receptacle lid, no light in walk-in cooler.

headline: Dust buildup on wall and refrigeration units
summary: Dust has built up on a wall and between refrigeration units. Manager instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Cardboard floor liners; minor sink leak
summary: Cardboard used as floor liner in rear prep area must be removed. Minor leak below rear deli handwashing sink must be repaired. Cracked wall tile at bakery prep area must be repaired, and crumbs on floor cleaned.

headline: Broken cooler, torn gasket, and grease outside
summary: Empty drawer cooler under grill is not working. Lowboy cooler has a torn gasket. Hose connected to exposed sink near dish machine must be removed; hoses only at service sinks. Grease buildup on used cooking oil container in rear alley.

headline: No certified manager; rusty ice machine drips onto ice
summary: No valid sanitation certificate or certified manager on site; citation issued. Rust from ice machine dripped onto ice for customers; staff told to discard ice and clean. Chicken tenders at 120°F in hot-hold unit; 15 lbs discarded. Food debris and rodent-proofing gaps noted.

headline: Unlabeled squeeze bottles; restroom needs upkeep
summary: Two squeeze bottles on coffee prep table are not labeled with food names. No handwashing sign at prep and dish sink. Restroom lacks a covered receptacle and has residue on fixtures. Boxes stored on sales-area floor must be raised 6 inches.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; broken cabinet door
summary: Bulk sugar container was not labeled; ingredients not in original containers must be labeled with their common name. A cabinet door near the hot water tank is broken and loose and must be repaired.

headline: Re-inspection: ice machine residue; reused cardboard
summary: Brownish substance inside the ice machine near the ice maker must be cleaned and sanitized. Cardboard reused as a shelf liner on prep tables must be removed. Backflow device for the ice machine could not be located. Toilet room door lacks a self-closing device. Floors under the three-compartment sink need cleaning.

headline: Gaps around basement exterior door
summary: Re-inspection passed. Gaps existed between the basement exterior door and its frame. The facility must correct the gaps and keep outer openings tight-fitting.

headline: Single-use containers reused; dirty toilets
summary: Single-use sour cream containers were cleaned and reused for food storage; reuse must stop. Exterior surfaces and tanks of toilets were soiled and must be cleaned.

headline: Cardboard grease-trap liner; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Cardboard is used as a liner on grease traps and must be removed. Missing ceiling tiles in the rear prep area must be replaced. The one-compartment sink in the rear prep area leaks from its faucet. Dust on a walk-in cooler fan must be cleaned.

headline: Cooler at 47.7°F; food discarded; cooler tagged
summary: Rear two-door cooler air measured 47.7°F. Soups, eggs, hummus, beef, chicken, lamb, and fish measured 44.2–56.7°F; about 35 pounds ($300) discarded. Cooler was tagged and must not be used until repaired. Citations issued. Certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Re-inspection failed: door gap; unpainted rust; old violations
summary: About a 1-inch gap at the bottom left of the front main door must be closed to prevent pests. Chipped paint and rust on a walk-in cooler rack. Litter under the outside dumpster area. Previous priority violations not corrected: black slime in the ice maker and no allergen-trained certified manager; citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection failed: flies; wiping cloths; cutting boards
summary: About 15 small flies crawling under a dough table and about 10 flying in the bakery and basement; more pest control needed; priority violation; citation issued. Wiping cloths on counters and in a crate, not in sanitizer. Cutting boards with deep cuts and stains. Prior pest violation not corrected.

headline: Handsink blocked; no paper towels; food too warm
summary: The only kitchen handsink was blocked by a cutting board and equipment; citation issued. It had no paper towels and drains very slowly. Cooked chicken held at 60°F; manager discarded 8 pounds ($50); citation issued. Soil buildup in coolers, floors, and clutter.

headline: Not ready: second washroom not installed
summary: The facility is not yet ready: a second washroom has not been installed on site.

headline: Ice machine buildup; cracked dish-area floor tiles
summary: Slight buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned and maintained. Floor tiles in the dish area are in poor repair with low grout and must be repaired and regrouted.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; painted drywall behind prep
summary: The sugar container was not labeled; it must be labeled and kept labeled. Painted drywall behind prep tables should be replaced with a smooth, durable surface that is easy to clean.

headline: Failed: flies, ice machine slime, no certificates
summary: About 30–50 live small flying insects in the third-floor prep and bar areas and garbage area; citation issued. Black and pink slime inside ice machines on several floors, dripping onto ice; citation issued. No valid food sanitation certificate; citation issued. Some food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Failed: no soap, towels, test kits, or food handler cards
summary: No hand soap or paper towels at the prep and dish handsink, which was also clogged and not draining. No chlorine or quat sanitizer test kits and no food handler certificates on site; citations issued. Food debris inside cooling equipment and debris on floors.

headline: Ice scoop stored improperly; black caulking
summary: Ice scoop was stored in an open wire rack touching the wall; it must be stored properly. Black substance on caulking at the top base of the three-compartment sink must be removed and the caulking maintained.

headline: Missing restroom lids; no allergen certificate
summary: Women's restroom receptacles had no lids for disposal of feminine products. The certified food manager on site had no allergen training certificate. The facility must provide the certificate and keep it on site.

headline: Peeling shelf paint; missing baseboard
summary: Wooden basement dry storage shelves have peeling paint in some areas and must be painted and kept smooth and cleanable. A baseboard is missing along a wall in the front counter area and must be repaired.

headline: Re-inspection: missing splash guards and backflow devices
summary: Front bar handsink lacks a splash guard, and the ice bin lacks a lid. Backflow devices could not be located for the basement ice machine and espresso machine. A backflow device at the utility sink leaks. Unused dryer and unsealed basement floor drains and pipes.

headline: Gap at rear screen door; dirty cooler shelves
summary: No pests were found. The rear screen door has a quarter-inch gap at the bottom; a weather strip is required to keep pests out. Walk-in cooler shelving is dirty. Walls, ceilings, and floors behind cooking equipment need cleaning. Fryer hood filters need cleaning. Manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Repeat training violations; wiping cloths, ice machine residue
summary: Violations from October 2024 were not corrected: some food handlers lack training certificates, and a certified food manager lacks allergen training. Citation issued. Wet wiping cloths left out, not in sanitizer. Pink residue in ice machine. Cardboard shelf liner.

headline: Dust, grease, and debris in bakery and deli
summary: Fan guard in the bakery walk-in freezer is soiled with dust and debris. Grease on the deli cookline floor, and garbage under a freezer shelf and under the bakery three-compartment sink. The facility must clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Failed: about 125 mouse droppings in storage
summary: About 125 mouse droppings along the wall base in the rear storage and grocery back rooms; citation issued. Must clean, sanitize, and call pest control. Debris on meat department, freezer, and cooler floors. Standing water in two back-room drains. Ice buildup in the walk-in freezer.

headline: Greasy fryers and missing washroom covers
summary: Fryer bottoms and exteriors, prep tables, and floor mixers need cleaning. Washroom doors need self-closing devices. Women's restroom lacks a toilet bowl cover and a vent cover. Ceiling vents are dusty and rusty. Expired food handler certificates.

headline: Failed: ice machine buildup; personal items in food area
summary: No handwashing signs at the front coffee and rear dish sinks. Ice not protected; black and pink buildup inside the ice machine dripped into ice; citation issued. Wiping cloths on prep tables, missing hair restraints, and scoops stored in ice buckets. Peeling ceiling paint above a prep table; citation issued.

headline: Missing paper towels, signage, and stored items
summary: Paper towels were missing at two handsinks; the person in charge refilled them on site. Citation issued. Packaged items for sale lacked a manufacturer address. A cup without a handle was used as a scoop. Single-service items on floors. No compliance summary posted; citation issued.

headline: Food handlers lack hair restraints; no allergen training
summary: Food handlers were preparing food without hair restraints; all must wear one. The sanitation manager does not have a food allergen training certificate and must meet the requirement.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; stained cabinet
summary: No handwashing sign at the handsink in the rear coffee station prep area; a sign must be provided and kept in place. The cabinet under the front prep dump sink is stained and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Missing signs, unlabeled containers, leaking pipe
summary: No handwashing signs at prep and dish area sinks; a sign must be provided. Storage containers under dry storage shelving were unlabeled; the manager labeled them on site. A leaking pipe under the prep handsink must be repaired.

headline: Improper handwashing; cold food above 41°F
summary: Two employees washed hands for about 5 seconds with minimal friction; one without soap. Both re-washed on site; citation issued. Salami at 50.2°F and ham at 51.4°F in the prep cooler were discarded (about 15 pounds, $40); citation issued. Leaking handsink aerator.

headline: Failed: no food handler training proof
summary: Menu did not state that some asterisked animal-derived foods are served raw or undercooked; the menu must be updated. No proof of food handler training was provided for any handler. Damaged gaskets on a two-door freezer. Missing grout. One employee lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Uninsulated cooler lines; dirty meat slicer
summary: Cooling lines on walk-in coolers lack insulation, which can cause condensation; install insulation. The meat slicer around the blade housing had encrusted food debris. The slicer must be cleaned properly and kept clean.

headline: Failed: 60+ mouse droppings; food too warm
summary: About 60 or more mouse droppings were found in several areas, including dry storage, the dining area, and on canned goods; citation issued. Cooked beef at 93.6°F on a prep table and raw beef at 53.1°F in a refrigerator; about 17 pounds discarded. Citations issued. Front door not rodent-proof.

headline: Rear door needs rodent-proofing; leaking drain pipe
summary: The rear storage door must be rodent-proofed. A foil liner on a prep shelf must be removed. A leaking drain pipe under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Holes in the wall around the prep and dish area must be sealed. Missing allergen certificate.

headline: Mop sink and restroom vent need repair
summary: Mop sink is in poor repair and tilted toward the front, causing water to pool; it must be repaired. A restroom vent is broken and must be repaired.

headline: Dust on cooler condensers and basement walls
summary: Dust buildup on the condensers of prep area coolers must be cleaned and maintained. Dust and debris on basement prep area walls and around the sump pump must also be cleaned.

headline: Person in charge lacks sanitation certificate
summary: Person in charge has no city sanitation certificate; priority foundation violation. No certificate posted or on site while cold sandwiches and deli TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. No vomiting and diarrheal procedure or kit; citation issued. Leaking drain pipe under the three-compartment sink. No allergen certificate.

headline: Failed: no valid certificate posted; no pest logbook
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate was posted for employees. No soap at a handwashing sink. No pests were found, but only one pest service report was on file; a licensed exterminator must service the facility at least twice a year. No citation issued.

headline: Failed: door gaps, unlabeled flour, ventilation issues
summary: Half-inch gaps under the front and rear doors must be made tight to prevent pest entry. Flour was in an unlabeled bin. Rusty shelving, debris in floor drains, an oven not under a vent, and nonworking ventilation in both washrooms. Previous core violations not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Food on floor; debris in oven tray; mop sink handle
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Scoops stored with handles in food or ice. Heavy food debris in the oven catch tray. Mop sink cold-water handle snapped off, though cold water is still available. Three of five hood lights not working.

headline: Deli cups used as bulk food scoops
summary: Deli cups were being used as scoops for bulk food. The inspector instructed the facility to use proper scoops.

headline: Failed: flies, door gap, uncorrected violations
summary: About 25 live small flies in front and rear prep areas, on walls, ceilings, and the ice machine; citation issued. Front entrance door has a half-inch gap at the bottom. Previous violations not corrected: no cooler thermometers, worn gaskets, rust, no covered toilet receptacle; citation issued.

headline: Cold food too warm; soiled wiping cloths
summary: Chicken at 45.2°F and raw beef at 46.6°F in the front prep cold unit; 13 pounds discarded; citation issued. Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Torn cooler gasket. Milk crates used for elevation must be replaced. Unused items in the basement; restroom door not self-closing.

headline: No certified manager on duty while TCS foods served
summary: No certified food manager with a valid certificate was on site at 2:10 PM while TCS foods were prepared, served, and stored. The manager arrived about 2:35 PM; citation issued. Employee without a hair restraint. Food in grocery bags in a cooler. Wall gap in restroom.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; cold food too warm
summary: Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; it must read at least 100 ppm. No sanitizer reading at the bar dish machine. Cooked pasta, sausage, dips, and soups in the walk-in cooler measured 46–48°F; TCS foods must be at 41°F or below. Citations issued.

headline: Re-inspection failed: rat droppings; training gaps
summary: Evidence of continued pest activity: about 30 and 50 rat droppings in cluttered basement areas, with orders to clean and get additional pest control. Front door has gaps. Grease and debris on equipment; leak under the dishwashing sink. Food handlers lacked proof of food handler training and allergen training.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The food service sanitation manager has no food allergen training certificate. The facility must meet the requirement.

headline: No verifiable health policy; food in plastic bags
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; a template was left and signed copies must be kept on site. Torn gasket on a front prep cooler. Food stored in plastic grocery bags in freezers and refrigerators; approved food-grade containers are required. No allergen training on site.

headline: Complaint: no certified manager; cold chicken too warm
summary: No certified manager on site while eggs were prepared, 9:40–10:20 AM; citation issued. Cooked chicken in the walk-in cooler measured 59.5°F, 46.2°F, and 45°F; about 10 pounds ($30) discarded; citation issued. Chicken lacked date marks. Only one food handler card on site. No summary posted.

headline: Failed: no raw-food advisory; missing thermometers
summary: Menu lacked a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods; the person in charge corrected the menu online and reprints were ordered. Citation issued. No temperature indicators for the high-temperature dish machine; citation issued. Leaking bar handsink and an ice machine lacks a backflow device.

headline: Ice machine and filters need cleaning
summary: Interior and chute of the large rear ice machine must be cleaned and maintained. Some storage containers lack labels. Filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned to remove grease and debris.

headline: Dish racks on floor; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Dish racks were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Three-door cooler has torn gaskets. Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced. Spilled food in a freezer, a wet mop in a bucket, a broken paper towel dispenser, and low lighting in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Torn freezer gasket; manager lacks allergen training
summary: A freezer door in the front prep area has a torn gasket and must be repaired or replaced. One certified manager has no allergen training. The facility must complete it and keep records on site.

headline: Re-inspection: no backflow device at mop sink
summary: No backflow prevention device at the mop sink; one must be provided. Clutter in the basement, including old equipment, must be removed.

headline: Failed: about 60 mouse droppings in storage
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were found in rear dry storage under shelving; citation issued. The person in charge must remove them, sanitize all areas, and maintain the space. Residue inside keg coolers in the bar and debris under dry storage shelving must be cleaned.

headline: Failed re-inspection: grease, torn gaskets, leaks
summary: No sushi rice analysis letter or pH test kit on site; citation was already issued under another report. Torn gaskets on a prep cooler and a refrigerator. Grease on cooking equipment, walls, and floors. Loose debris on floors. Rainwater coming through basement bricks must be repaired and sealed.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and live flies found
summary: Over 100 rodent droppings in prep, dish, and dining areas, and about 20 live flies in rear prep and dish areas; citation issued. Two pieces of uncovered rodent bait removed. Handsink blocked by a large pot. Gaps at rear screen door. Missing grout and broken tiles.

headline: Food handlers lack food handler certificates
summary: Dirt inside the ice machine guard must be cleaned. Boxed food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Multiple food handlers lacked food handler certificates; the facility must follow Illinois Department of Public Health requirements.

headline: Failed: food held over 24 hours without dates
summary: Cooked rice, pasta, and chicken were held more than 24 hours without discard dates; citation issued. The three-compartment sink leaks when draining, and wastewater is caught in a bucket; citation issued. Heavy grease and debris on walls, floors, and equipment. Unused equipment in the rear patio area must be removed.

headline: Leaking drain pipes at basement dish area
summary: Drain plumbing under the basement high-temperature dish machine and three-compartment sink is in poor repair and leaks when water runs. The facility must repair or replace it and keep all plumbing fixtures in good repair.

headline: Failed: no hot water at handsink; trickle flow
summary: The back prep handsink had no hot running water; water measured 72.5°F with only a trickle; citation issued. A second-floor handsink also had a trickle, insufficient for peak demand; citation issued. Burned-out lights in the basement storage area must be replaced.

headline: Complaint: no valid certificate; chicken too warm
summary: No valid original city sanitation certificate on site while TCS foods (chicken, beans) were served; citation issued. About 2 pounds of chicken at 54.7°F in the cooler; discarded ($20); citation issued. Loose gasket on a two-door cooler. Dirt and residue under dry storage closet shelves.

headline: No hand soap or paper towels at dish-area sink
summary: The handsink in the rear dish area had no hand soap and no paper towels. Both must be available at all times; citation issued. Bulk walnuts, almonds, and sugar lacked labels. Soiled mop heads were not hung up, which can allow insects to breed.

headline: Refrigerator too warm; 25 pounds of food discarded
summary: Inside the two-door refrigerator, lamb measured 48.5°F, fish 49.5°F, and chicken 45.5°F. The manager voluntarily discarded 25 pounds (about $300). The unit ran at 50°F and was tagged; it must not be used until reinspected. Citation issued.

headline: Hair restraints, wiping cloths, and food handler cards
summary: Employees in the food prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer when not in use. A knife was stored on a wiping cloth. Food handlers lacked certificates, and the certified manager's allergen training certificate had expired.

headline: Rear door gap; mold caulking; missing ceiling tile
summary: Rear exit door has an open quarter-inch gap at the bottom; a tight seal must be provided. Peeling plastic on metal equipment must be removed. A one-compartment food prep sink must be installed. Moldy caulking, a dirty floor drain, and a missing washroom ceiling tile.

headline: Serving plates not inverted
summary: Serving plates on kitchen prep area shelves were not stored inverted; they must be inverted to prevent dust accumulation.

headline: Failed: black buildup in ice machine over ice
summary: Ice machine in the prep area had a black substance building up inside, dripping onto ice stored below; ice is used for people. The machine must be cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. A prep cooler cutting board had discoloration and deep cuts and must be restored or replaced.

headline: Missing sink stopper
summary: The three-compartment sink is missing its stopper. The facility must provide one.

headline: Failed: no pest records; no hot water
summary: No pest control logbook or service proof was available; citation issued. No hot running water: three-compartment sink measured 56°F and handwashing sink 43°F; citation issued. Also a broken hot water nozzle, rusty prep shelving, a non-self-closing restroom door, and burned-out lights.

headline: Failed: no certified food manager during food prep
summary: The person in charge lacks a certified food manager certificate. No certified manager was on duty while time- and temperature-controlled (TCS) foods, such as fish, deli meat, and chicken, were prepared and served. A certified manager must be on site at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Complaint: missing signs; greasy shelving; floors
summary: No handwashing signs in the women's restroom. White dry buildup on the ice machine interior panel must be cleaned. Greasy shelving holding cooking equipment in the rear must be detail cleaned. A women's restroom handsink is in disrepair. Floors under cooking equipment in front and rear prep areas need cleaning.

headline: No covered waste bin; manager lacks allergen training
summary: The all-gender washroom lacks a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins; one must be provided. The sanitation manager has no food allergen training certificate and must meet the requirement.

headline: Re-inspection: no handwashing signs; hair restraints
summary: No handwashing signs at dish and prep handsinks; must be provided. Two to three employees in the prep area had no hair restraint. The previous summary report was only partly posted and was blocked; the entire report must be visible. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: no signed health policy; sink lacks hot water
summary: No employee health policy signed by all employees; priority foundation violation. The three-compartment sink does not provide 110°F hot water; management must repair it. Priority violation.

headline: Failed: rat droppings and overflowing dumpster
summary: About 30 rat droppings found in the second-floor storage area; citation issued. Outside dumpster lids could not close because trash was overflowing; citation issued. Excess boxes and trash in the rear storage area must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No certified manager; food handling and sanitizing issues
summary: No certified manager on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared; citation issued. An employee handled cooked meat without washing hands or wearing gloves, then made a phone call and kept cooking; citation issued. Also no paper towels at a handsink, and a sink was used without sanitizing.

headline: Unlabeled cookies; storage and washroom issues
summary: Pre-packaged cookies and pecan bars made on site lacked business name and address. Knives stored improperly near the grill; cooking utensils not inverted. Frozen raw chicken in a plastic liner; produce in crates. Employee restroom lacks covered receptacle. Basement lighting is inadequate.

headline: Sink leak and water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Large can opener on rear prep table had food and dirt buildup. Leak under the middle compartment of the three-compartment sink. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the rear area and restroom. Instructed to clean, fix the leak, and replace tiles.

headline: No health policy or vomiting-event plan
summary: No employee health policy or training on site; priority violation, citation issued. No procedure or supplies for vomiting and diarrheal events; citation issued. A pipe under the three-compartment sink leaks, the nearby handsink drains slowly, and there is grease, rust, and broken caulking.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The sanitation manager has no allergen training. The facility must provide it.

headline: No pest control logbook; floors need cleaning
summary: No licensed pest control logbook on the premises. It must include the company name, license number, service agreement, service reports, and chemicals used. Priority foundation violation. Floors along walls and corners in prep and dining areas need cleaning, especially behind the refrigerator.

headline: Grease under flat-top; dirt under shelving
summary: Grease and small debris under the flat-top cooking area must be cleaned to prevent pests or insects. Dirt and debris on the floor under the rear black shelving unit must be cleaned. One employee had no allergen training certificate on site and must obtain one.

headline: Torn gasket on two-door cooler
summary: Torn gasket on the interior of the two-door cooler in the rear prep area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Re-inspection: no health policy; dusty vents
summary: No signed employee health policy; it must be provided and kept on site. No citation issued. Slight leak under the three-compartment sink. Dust and dirt on a dishwashing area ceiling vent, with kitchenware stored under it. Vent grates and filters are missing.

headline: Food handlers must complete training
summary: All food handlers must obtain the required food handler training.

headline: Ice scoop in handsink; soiled ice machine chute
summary: Ice scoop was in a handwashing sink, and wiping cloths were soaking in another; only handwashing is allowed there. Ice machine chute had debris and black substance; ice must be discarded and machine cleaned. Citation issued. Also unlabeled containers and improperly stored Styrofoam containers.

headline: Floors and ceiling vents need cleaning
summary: Floors and ceiling vents must be cleaned where needed.

headline: No certified manager for 25 minutes; sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: No certified manager on site from 12:15 to 12:40 PM while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; the manager replaced the sanitizer on site and it reached 100 ppm; citation issued. Food stored on basement floors. Ice machine residue.

headline: Dirty basement ice machines; missing filters
summary: Interiors of both basement ice machines need cleaning and sanitizing. Box freezers stored under waste-water piping must be moved. A basement freezer lid repaired with duct tape must be replaced. Missing hood filters and a missing ceiling tile. Proof of food handler training is required.

headline: Failed: no health policy; no sanitizer; cold storage warm
summary: No written employee health policy and no procedure for vomiting or diarrheal events. No chemical sanitizer, test kit, or licensed pest-control operator. Walk-in cooler #1 measured 52°F and the freezer 69°F; citation issued. Some handsinks lacked soap or paper towels; no thermometers. Floors dirty.

headline: No certified manager while eggs and milk handled
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while TCS foods such as eggs and milk were handled and served. The facility must obtain one. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Complaint: missing signs, dirty ice machine, door gap
summary: No handwashing signs at front bar and washroom sinks. Ice machine inner lining not clean. Rear exit door has a half-inch gap at the bottom. Milk crates used as shelving. Chest freezer has excessive ice. Slow leak at a handsink; dust in light shields and vents; opening in the women's washroom ceiling.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm; sink lacked hot water
summary: Cold food measured too warm: cooked chicken 54.1°F, shrimp 47.1°F, and others; about 100 pounds discarded. Two coolers were tagged and must not be used until repaired and reinspected. The only prep-area handsink lacked hot and cold water until a plumber repaired it on site. Citations issued.

headline: Food on floor; cardboard used as flooring
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the prep area and walk-in cooler; it must be raised six inches. A prep cooler has a torn gasket. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment and shelving. Cardboard is used as kitchen flooring and must be replaced with smooth, cleanable flooring.

headline: Missing hand soap; food stored on floor
summary: The rear prep handsink had no hand soap; food handlers obtained soap during the inspection. Citation issued. Food containers were on floors in the walk-in cooler and prep areas and must be raised six inches. Loose dirt and dust on floors; hood and filters need cleaning.

headline: Failed: beverages on floor; ice machine lid taped
summary: Boxes of beverages were stored on the floor in a dry storage room and must be raised six inches. Ice machine lid is damaged and held with duct tape; must be serviced. Leak at the base of the three-compartment sink faucet even when not in use. Bar cabinet shelves contain trash.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged out of use
summary: Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; the minimum is 50 ppm. Unit was tagged and must not be used until the Chicago Department of Public Health reinspects it. Citation issued. Raw wood shelving in dish area. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed re-inspection: about 75 live flying insects
summary: About 75 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in prep areas, the manager's office, dish area, and dry storage; citation issued. More pest control service is needed. Floors in prep and dish areas must be grouted where standing water occurs, and floor drains and areas under the warming wells and grill must be cleaned.

headline: Complaint: missing signs; moldy ice machine
summary: No handwashing signs at the cookline and dish area sinks. No soap at the second-floor bar handsink; soap was provided on site before the inspection ended; citation issued. Black moldlike spots inside the rear ice machine. Data plate on the high-temperature dish machine is unreadable.

headline: Certified manager absent at start; health policy missing
summary: No certified manager was on site at the start while staff handled deli meat and soup. The manager arrived an hour later. Citations issued. No signed employee health policy on site. Dry food stored on the floor. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing handwash signs; torn cooler gasket
summary: Passed. The main cook line handwash sink lacked a sign. Walk-in cooler door gaskets are torn and separated. A water collection dish under the boiler is clogged, and some handwash sinks drain slowly. A 2nd-floor storage light is out.

headline: No food handler proof; damaged ceiling and wall
summary: Passed. Proof of food handler training was not provided for required employees. Milk crates used for storage must stop. Water-damaged ceiling tiles need replacement, and a wall is missing between the 3-compartment sink and handwash sink.

headline: No certified manager on site; repeat violations
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site at inspection; one arrived about 50 minutes later, a priority citation. Person in charge lacked training proof, and refrigeration units lacked thermometers. Repeat 2021 violations included food and flour buildup on floors and equipment.

headline: No certified manager during egg prep; failed
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site from 8:20 to 8:50 AM while eggs were prepared, a priority citation. No employee health policy or food handler training certificates were found. Repeat violation: deli hand sink lacks a splash guard.

headline: About 70-80 live roaches found; failed
summary: Failed. Inspector saw about 10-15 live roaches under shelving above the 3-compartment sink, another 10-15 at its pipes, and 50 live roaches at a prep counter. Pest control service is required before reinspection.

headline: Two coolers not working; repair or remove
summary: Passed. Re-inspection found two coolers not in proper working order. The manager must repair them or remove them from the premises to avoid clutter.

headline: Rodent droppings throughout; no certified manager
summary: Failed. Roughly 115 rodent droppings were found in six areas, including the water heater, toilet room and under the 3-compartment sink, plus live flies and a dead rodent on a trap. Doors lacked screens. No certified manager or health policy was on site.

headline: Raw meat stored over ready-to-eat food; failed
summary: Failed. Raw chicken, beef, lamb and eggs were stored above and touching ready-to-eat and fresh vegetables in the walk-in cooler. Contaminated food was discarded and the cooler rearranged on site. A cook-line cooler at 65.5F was tagged out of use.

headline: Torn gasket and unreadable dish machine screen
summary: Passed. The outdoor patio bar must be made impermeable or removed. A prep cooler has a torn gasket, and a low-temperature dish machine has an unreadable screen. An unused freezer must be repaired or removed.

headline: Unlabeled foods and soiled cloths on tables
summary: Passed. Foods and spices outside original containers lacked labels. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of sanitizer. Unused equipment in basement storage should be removed. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Grease and food debris throughout kitchen
