summary: The interior of the dairy coolers must be cleaned to remove spills. Floors around cooking equipment, along wall bases and in storage area corners need cleaning to remove spills, debris and grease.

headline: Uncovered toilet room trash receptacles
summary: Receptacles in unisex toilet rooms have no covers. They must be covered.

headline: Fish thawed in vacuum bag; wiping cloths unstored
summary: Prepacked fish thawed in vacuum packaging; staff must remove it from packaging to thaw. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution; cutting boards are worn. Reach-in coolers and toilet need cleaning, and floors need detail cleaning.

headline: No posted sanitation certificate; cooler leaks
summary: No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate was posted onsite; citation issued. Food debris and spills throughout the facility. Walk-in cooler leaks water from its compressor onto the floor. No proof of food handler training.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; torn gasket
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Torn cooler gasket, missing sink stoppers, and dirty freezer and cooler interiors. Stained ceiling tiles and damaged wall near fryer.

headline: Grease and food debris behind cooking equipment
summary: Grease and food debris were found on floors behind cooking equipment. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Menu raw-food disclosure missing; low water pressure
summary: Menu lacked the required disclosure that asterisked animal-derived foods may be raw or undercooked. Hand sink #3 has no hot or cold water pressure; sink #6 drains slowly in women's employee washroom. Bar drain line must be relocated.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; hand sinks cold
summary: Bar dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm because the solution container was empty; manager refilled it to 100 ppm on site. Spinach dip at 45.6°F discarded. Basement restroom hand sinks measured 64–65°F for men and 51–54°F for women; 100°F required.

headline: 40 mouse droppings under steam table
summary: Found 40 or more mouse droppings on the shelf under the steam table in the front serving area; citation issued and staff told to clean. No signed employee health policy. Bulk kitchen containers were unnamed and were labeled on site. Walk-in shelves rusty.

headline: About 100 lbs of cold food too warm; flies found
summary: About 100 lbs of prepared TCS foods held at 47.8–55°F in two display coolers; the PIC voluntarily discarded them, about $320. Both coolers tagged. About 150 or more small live flies found in deli, prep and bakery areas.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; plastic bags hold food
summary: Bulk containers along the basement stairway were unlabeled. A Styrofoam cup was used to dispense salsa. Plastic grocery bags hold food in coolers and freezers. No chemical test kit for sanitizer, and a basement washroom fan is not working.

headline: No certified food manager; many repeat violations
summary: No certified food manager on duty or certificate posted while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Repeat violations include missing food handler training, unlabeled containers, rust, leaking pipes, and grease buildup on equipment.

headline: Uncovered bread on oven; unlabeled containers
summary: Some dry ingredient containers in the rear are not labeled. About four loaves of bread were stored uncovered on top of the oven in the rear prep area and must be covered. Food splatter on outlet covers near the deli prep area needs cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; overflowing dumpsters
summary: Bulk containers for salt, sugar and flour lacked labels. The high-temperature dish machine had no surface temperature strips; citation issued. Overflowing dumpsters were corrected on site. Ceiling vents need cleaning, and two food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: Worn cooler gaskets and greasy fryers
summary: Gaskets on a three-door kitchen cooler are in poor repair and must be replaced to stop air leaks. Fryers and walls need cleaning. A can opener blade was cleaned on site.

headline: Rice held too cool; 200-300 dead flies found
summary: Rice on the stove measured 119.6°F, below the required 135°F; 10 pounds was discarded and a citation issued. Basement dry storage had 200–300 dead small black flies on the floor and food boxes; instructed to remove them.

headline: No certified person in charge; water too cold
summary: No person in charge with a City sanitation certificate was present; citation issued. Hand sinks measured 68–73°F but must reach 100°F. Also missing: metal stem thermometer, handwashing signs, and food handler training proof.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at cook-area sink
summary: A handwashing sink in the main cook area had no sign reminding staff to wash hands. The sign must be installed and maintained. No other violations were listed.

headline: Coolers too warm; $250 food discarded
summary: Two coolers measured 48°F and 53°F and were tagged. TCS foods held at 44–50°F were discarded, valued at $250. Three hand sinks lacked soap, now stocked; ice machines had pink-black buildup. Citations issued.

headline: No hot water at front hand sink
summary: The front prep hand sink had no hot or cold running water; citation issued. Food and single-use items were stored under hand sinks, and cup lids were not inverted. A certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing thermometers and dirty cooling units
summary: Re-inspection found several cooling units in the grocery without thermometers. Torn gaskets, produce and sauces with dried food debris, and water-stained ceiling tiles also need correction.

headline: Live roaches below dishwashing hand sink
summary: Four live roaches were found below the dishwashing-area hand sink; a citation was issued and pest control must eliminate them. Also missing: handwashing signs, a raw-food menu advisory, and backflow devices.

headline: Allergen training still missing for manager
summary: A repeat core violation was not corrected: the on-duty City food service sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate. The manager was instructed to comply; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled oil container; missing coving
summary: A working oil container lacked its common name label. Missing coving on the wall by the basement steps must be repaired.

headline: One light bulb cover missing
summary: A ceiling light bulb cover was missing above the soup prep area and must be replaced.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths and greasy equipment
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables and must be stored in sanitizing solution. Milk crates served as freezer shelving. Grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, and a unisex restroom lacked a covered receptacle.

headline: Ice cream scoops not kept submerged in water
summary: Ice cream scoops in use were stored in the dipper well without being fully submerged in running water between uses. The inspector instructed the operator to keep food-contact parts submerged.

headline: Peeling paint and holes in wall
summary: Peeling paint on a bathroom sink cabinet and a toilet room door that does not self-close need repair. A utility room wall has holes. All must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Door gap, cardboard shelf liners, clutter
summary: A front door had a gap over one inch at the bottom and must be sealed against pests. Cardboard was used as shelf liner, clutter sat on the floor, and no allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; rusty shelves
summary: A stand-up cooler by the dishwashing sink had no thermometer; one must be provided and kept visible. A stained cutting board, rusty and chipped wire racks, and a greasy fryer and grill underside also need attention.

headline: Gasket damaged; basement pipe leaking
summary: A cooler door gasket is damaged and must be repaired. A small pipe leaks onto the basement floor from near the sewer lines. Dust on walk-in condenser covers needs cleaning, and unused stoves and a mixer must be removed.

headline: Rat droppings found; coolers too warm
summary: Rat droppings were on the floor of the outside dumpster area. Service coolers held food at 45–62°F; 15 pounds ($120) was discarded. Utensil surface temperature was 152°F, below the 160°F minimum. Citations issued for several items.

headline: No food handler training on site
summary: No food employees with food handler training or certificates were on site during the license inspection. The operator must provide training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Food handler lacked training certificate
summary: A food handler did not have a food handler training certificate. Management was told all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: Gap under front door; wall debris
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front entrance door sweep must be sealed to keep out rodents. Food debris was on prep area walls and must be cleaned.

headline: Certified manager absent during food preparation
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Allergen training was missing for managers, a new employee lacked food handler training, and a leaky hand sink pipe needs repair.

headline: Greasy floors, missing food handler training
summary: Floors throughout had excessive grease and debris, and food debris on faucets and the wok station needs cleaning. Items on the rear storage floor must be raised. No food handler or allergen training was shown.

headline: Meat-area hand sink cold; no thermometer
summary: Meat-prep hand sink water measured 51.1°F; it must be at least 100°F, and a citation was issued. No food thermometer was on site. The three-compartment sink and meat-area hand sink leak, and milk crates used for elevation can hide pests.

headline: Hair restraints missing; floor debris
summary: Some food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and food debris covered the floor in the rear prep area. The person in charge was told to fix both and maintain.

headline: No hot water at sandwich prep sink
summary: Hand sink in sandwich prep area measured 71.8°F and must reach at least 100°F; citation issued. Hand-washing signs were missing in the dishwashing area and north washroom, and ice machine residue and debris need cleaning.

headline: Egg whites and produce too warm in cooler
summary: Egg whites at 56°F and sliced tomatoes and spinach at 48–56°F were too warm, and the cooler ran at 45°F. About 10 pounds ($20) of food was discarded by staff; citation issued. TCS foods must stay at 41°F or below.

headline: Live flies found; prior pest violations not fixed
summary: About 35 live small flies were seen on walls and produce carts near the rear exit. Earlier pest violations were not corrected. Extra pest control service is required, and a two-day deadline was given.

headline: No certified food manager during food service
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while milk, deli meat, turkey and cheese were prepared and served. A citation was issued, and a certified manager must be present whenever food is prepared and served.

headline: No hand sink in front food area
summary: No handwashing sink was located in the front food preparation and dispensing area; citation issued. Raw sushi menu lacked the required written 'served raw' disclosure. Sushi rice uses vinegar, but no lab report or pH meter verified its acidity.

headline: Utensils washed without sanitizer; sushi too warm
summary: Utensils were washed with only soap and water, no sanitizer; citation issued, corrected after instruction. Sushi handrolls at 60–70°F were discarded (about 20 pounds, $100). A refrigerator at 46.7°F was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected.

headline: Live roaches, rat droppings, no running water
summary: Two live roaches and about 5 small flies were in food prep. 10–20 rat droppings were found in the dining area and hallway toward the kitchen. The only food-prep hand sink had no running water; citations issued.

headline: Greasy floors; no ventilation in washrooms
summary: Floors under grill-line equipment and coolers have food debris and excessive grease and must be cleaned. The family and employee washrooms lack mechanical ventilation. A pending certified manager must obtain allergen training.

headline: No covered waste receptacle; allergen certificate missing
summary: The basement unisex employee washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle. No allergen training certificate was on the premises; each certified food manager must have one.

headline: No backflow device for ice machine
summary: No backflow prevention device was found for the ice machine. One must be provided where it can be serviced and maintained.

headline: Storage boxes on basement floor
summary: Excessive storage boxes were on the floor in a basement corner. Management was told to clear floors to remove conditions that could harbor pests.

headline: Dead mouse found in trap; grease buildup
summary: One small dead mouse was found in a trap in the rear boiler room and must be removed. Grease buildup on equipment, floors, walls, and hood filters must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine buildup; greasy prep-line floors
summary: Pink mineral buildup inside the rear ice machine must be cleaned. Floors along the main prep line had food spillage and grease and need cleaning. No allergen training was shown for certified managers, a repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: Uncovered ice; trash cans without lids
summary: Ice in the bar's ice bin was uncovered and must be covered to prevent contamination. Women's stall trash cans lacked lids and must be covered for feminine hygiene products.

headline: Live bird flying in store; incomplete labels
summary: A live sparrow was flying above retail aisles; management must contact pest control, and a citation was issued. Frozen meat and cheese pies had incomplete ingredient labels. Electric insect killers were placed in prep areas; only approved indoor devices may be used.

headline: Leaky hand sink and dirty floors
summary: A hand sink in the front prep area keeps leaking even when turned off, and a freezer door gasket is torn. Floors along walls and in corners had grease and dirt and need cleaning.

headline: No certified food manager; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Cooler interiors need cleaning, items stored on floors must be raised, and allergen training is required.

headline: Cold food too warm; prep cooler tagged
summary: Cooler held beef, chicken, pork, fish and liver at 52.8–57.1°F, and about 80 pounds ($300) was discarded. A prep cooler reading 55.2°F was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer.

headline: Rusted ice machine and can opener; poor light
summary: The exterior of the rear ice machine and table-mounted can opener are heavily rusted and not easily cleanable; both must be repaired or replaced. A light fixture in the rear warewashing area is in poor repair.

headline: Plastic coating on prep table; cracked faucet
summary: A plastic coating on the bottom of a prep table must be removed so the surface is smooth and cleanable. A bathroom faucet is cracked and damaged and must be replaced.

headline: Raw chicken over cooked; food held too warm
summary: Raw chicken was stored over and next to cooked chicken in the walk-in, risking cross-contamination; citation issued. TCS foods at 46–52°F were discarded (about 50 pounds, $300). Lentil soup and cooked cauliflower lacked date marks; 25 pounds discarded.

headline: Hair restraints missing; drain and lid issues
summary: Several food handlers in prep and dishwashing areas were not wearing hair restraints. A leak from pipes or wall was seen in the basement, floor drains were dirty, and the women's restroom trash can lacked a lid.

headline: Raw chicken held at 61°F; discarded
summary: About 2.5 pounds of raw chicken in a two-door cooler measured 61.3°F; it was discarded, and a citation was issued. Unlabeled flour, cornmeal and sauces were noted, and a grocery bag was used in the cooler.

headline: Cracked spoons, dirty bar surfaces, floor tiles
summary: Cracked wooden spoons hanging in the prep area must be replaced. Stainless steel behind both bars needs cleaning, broken floor tiles behind the second-floor bar need replacing, and chipped ceiling paint and wood beams need repainting.

headline: No certified manager; 402 pounds discarded
summary: No certified food manager was on premises; corrected on site when one arrived. Cold TCS foods were held at 49.3–57.4°F, and about 402 pounds ($1,560) was discarded. The walk-in cooler was tagged. No metal stem thermometer was on site.

headline: Flies, mold-like ice machine, hot water issues
summary: Over 60 small flies were found in the facility, with activity at the rear first floor; citation issued and pest control recommended. Hand sink water ranged 44.8–87.4°F, below the 100°F minimum. Ice machine buildup must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine slime; dish machine too cool
summary: Ice machine had pink and black slime, and the dish machine's final rinse reached only 135°F, not the required 180°F; both drew citations. A dry storage door has a half-inch gap that must be sealed.

headline: Low-temp dish machine not sanitizing; tagged
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine, so it was not sanitizing. It was tagged 'held for inspection' and may not be used until repaired. A missing surface-temperature indicator was corrected on site.

headline: Vomit kit incomplete; wall holes; no backflow
summary: The vomit/diarrhea clean-up kit is incomplete and must include a norovirus-effective sanitizer. Backflow devices are missing for the mop sink and ice machine, and wall holes around washroom plumbing need sealing.

headline: Allergen training certificates needed
summary: Allergen training certificates were not on site for City certified food managers. The operator must provide them and keep them available for review.

headline: Live cockroaches and flying insects found
summary: Two live cockroaches and 10 live small flying insects were found, plus several dead cockroaches. A food handler lacked a certificate. Chest freezers were broken with exposed wiring. Paper towels were missing at sinks, then provided on request.

headline: Leaks at faucet; slow drain
summary: Water leaks from the base of the three-compartment sink faucet, and the rear prep hand sink drains slowly. Both need repair.

headline: Cracked floor tiles; dirty walk-in shelves
summary: Walk-in coolers and freezer shelving need detail cleaning, and prep coolers, counters and storage shelves need cleaning. A leak under the dishwashing-room hand sink must be repaired. Cracked floor tiles in dishwashing and prep areas need repair.

headline: Cooler food too warm; about 48 pounds discarded
summary: Cold food in a rear cooler reached 51–63°F (cold food must stay at 41°F or below). Management discarded about 48 pounds ($400) of food. Handwashing signage was missing, and a basement door had a 1/2-inch gap.

headline: Utensils stored in warm water; shelf liner issues
summary: Cook-line utensils were stored in 92.7°F water, but must stay at 135°F or above. Clean pots hung over the sink, cloth and foil were used as shelf liners, and a hand sink drains slowly.

headline: Repeat violations; drain into hand sink
summary: A food handler wasn't wearing a hair restraint, and walk-in cooler racks are rusty. An air-conditioner drain empties into a hand sink. Repeat violations remain: food handlers lack certificates, managers lack allergen training, and cleaning and repairs are still open.

headline: Handwashing lapses and no certified manager
summary: A food handler went from the walk-in freezer to a sandwich with gloves on, without washing hands; citation issued. The manager's certificate was not posted, no food handler training was shown, and leaks need repair.

headline: Manager certificate missing; mold-like caulking
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid City certified manager certificate on site; citation issued. The original must be kept on site at all times. Black mold-like buildup on caulking near the warewashing unit must be cleaned.

headline: Cardboard liner and greasy hood filters
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner on the floor in front of the three-compartment sink and must be removed. The ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment had grease buildup and need detail cleaning.

headline: No allergen training for food manager
summary: A pipe runs along the floor beside the three-compartment sink and must be raised for cleaning. Mop hangers are missing, and the food service manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Bar hand sink too cold; dumpster overflowed
summary: Bar hand sink measured 74°F; it must reach at least 100°F, and a citation was issued. The original sanitation certificate was not posted, the dumpster overflowed, and an allergen training violation remains uncorrected.

headline: Raw brick walls in new prep area
summary: Re-inspection found raw brick walls in the newly added second-floor prep area. They must be sealed so the surface is smooth, even and easy to clean.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and potatoes were handled and served. Priority violation noted. The operator was told to obtain one.

headline: Crates used for storage; debris along walls
summary: Crates were used for storage and must be replaced. Debris along back walls and under racks needs cleaning, and a restroom has a missing cove base.

headline: Food thawed on prep table improperly
summary: Pizza, chicken and beef were thawing on the prep table and drain rack of the three-compartment sink. Staff were told to thaw in a cooler, under cold running water or in a microwave. Water-stained ceiling tiles need replacing.

headline: Hot holding unit too cool; equipment shutting off
summary: One hot holding unit read 116°F, below the required 135°F. A rice cooker and oven kept shutting off due to the power supply. Wastewater leaked from a holding tank onto the ground. Floors were dirty.

headline: Expired training; summary not posted; ashtrays
summary: A rear prep hand sink lacked a handwashing sign, one of two employees had expired food handler training, and the public inspection summary was not posted. Ashtrays were found in the prep area and office, a clean-air violation; citations issued.

headline: Avocados on floor; wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Avocado boxes were stored on the floor and must be raised. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables. A hand sink drains slowly, and a certified manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Cold toilet-room water; dog removed from dining room
summary: Toilet room hot water measured 66.2°F; it must be at least 100°F. A technician fixed it, and sinks now run 102–105°F. A dog in the dining room was removed during inspection; citation issued. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Greasy fryers and floors; training reminders
summary: Fryer bottoms and floors under fryers have grease and need cleaning. The operator was reminded that all food handlers need food handler training and all managers need allergen training.

headline: Greasy equipment and floors need cleaning
summary: Grease trap exterior, ovens, fryers, stoves and the wall behind cooking equipment have encrusted grease. Floors beneath dry storage shelving and under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Leaking condenser hose; sink stoppers missing
summary: A condenser hose in the walk-in cooler is leaking; no food was under it. Sink stoppers are missing, the floor near the grease trap is rough, and broken ceiling tiles need sealing. Allergen training certificates are also required.

headline: No certified manager; missing pest log
summary: No certified manager was on site. Missing items included a vomit-diarrhea cleanup kit, dish soap, a probe thermometer, and a pest control logbook. The rear exit door was not rodent-proof, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing lapse found
summary: No certified food manager was on site; citation issued. A food handler skipped handwashing between tasks, then dropped food into the deep fryer after sweeping. A sanitizer test kit was improper, and the three-compartment sink sprayer leaked.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty ice bin
summary: Re-inspection found an ice bin needing cleaning, unlabeled flour and sugar containers, and frozen food stored in plastic grocery bags instead of food-grade bags. The operator was instructed to fix each item.

headline: Stained cutting boards; expired allergen training
summary: Stained cutting boards need resurfacing or replacement. A food handler lacked proof of food handler training, and a certified manager's allergen training certificate had expired. The operator was told to provide and maintain them.

headline: Cut fruit in t-shirt bags; clutter
summary: Cut fruit was stored in t-shirt bags in the rear chest freezer; food-grade bags are required. A hand sink drains slowly and the ice machine lacks a backflow device. Clutter sits on the floor, and one food handler lacks training.

headline: No certified food manager; sewage leaks found
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were handled. Food handlers lacked certificates, and backflow devices were missing. A toilet leaked onto a men's restroom floor. Management said it will monitor the restroom.

headline: No certified manager posted; health policy missing
summary: No City sanitation certificate was posted or documented, and a certified manager must be on premises whenever TCS foods are handled; citation issued. No written employee health policy or vomiting-and-diarrhea plan was available.

headline: Sinks blocked; milk too warm; no pest report
summary: Both hand sinks were blocked by pots, utensils and a garbage can; the manager cleared them on site. About 20 pounds of milk at 44.9–48.2°F was discarded, and the cooler was tagged. No current pest control report was available.

headline: Certified manager late; missing health records
summary: No certified food manager was on site at first; one arrived about 20 minutes later. No certificate was posted, and no food handler certification or employee health policy was available. The pest control log was missing.

headline: Cardboard reused; toilet room lacks receptacle
summary: Cardboard was reused by the front cutting boards and must not be used; surfaces must be smooth and cleanable. The toilet room had no covered waste receptacle, which must be provided.

headline: Cooked steak and pork held too warm
summary: Cooked steak at 47.2°F and pork at 46°F were too warm in the prep cooler and were discarded; citation issued. Also: a broken food thermometer, no chlorine test kit, and no allergen training on site.

headline: Leaking sprayer; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Water leaks from the three-compartment sink sprayer and must be repaired. Missing ceiling tiles, grout, and damaged floor tiles near coolers and walk-ins need fixing. Dust on vents and hood needs cleaning. An employee lacks allergen training proof.

headline: No paper towels at bar hand sink
summary: No paper towels were at the bar hand sink; citation issued. An employee supplied towels during inspection, and towels must be kept at all hand sinks at all times. A certified manager lacks an allergen certificate.

headline: Leaking sanitizer dispenser; water pooling
summary: The sanitizer dispenser above the three-compartment sink and a cord under the sink leak, creating a pool of water on the floor. Both must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Damaged donut packages; tongs in tepid water
summary: Donut packages were damaged and did not protect contents; citation issued, and the donuts were discarded ($25). Tongs were stored in tepid water with debris. A bathroom door's self-closing device is in disrepair.

headline: Leaks at sinks; trash under storage racks
summary: Water leaks from the three-compartment sink faucet and a drain below the two-compartment sink must be serviced. Scoops in dry storage bins were not stored properly. Loose plastic, trash and spilled food were under racks in dry storage.

headline: Dirty fryers and floors under equipment
summary: Fryers need cleaning inside the bottom and on the exterior. Floors under, around and behind cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Minor food spills behind fryers
summary: Minor food spills were found behind the fryers and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Missing thermometers and food handler certificates
summary: Thermometers are missing from two coolers, and a cooler gasket is broken. Food handlers lacked training certificates. Debris sits by the dumpster, and clutter and missing ceiling tiles need correction.

headline: Dry storage containers need labels
summary: Re-inspection found dry storage containers not labeled with their common name. The operator was told to label them and keep them labeled.

headline: Hose blocked hand sink; lettuce held too warm
summary: A hose stored in the hand sink blocked it and was removed on site; citation issued. Chopped lettuce at 49°F was discarded (4 pounds). A cooler measured 47°F and was tagged.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths and plates not stored properly
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were left on prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution, and serving plates were stored unprotected, collecting dust. Inspector instructed proper storage. No pests found.

headline: Fly traps over prep tables; utensils stored in standing water
summary: Fly traps are installed above food prep tables; staff were told to remove them. Large spoons and ice scoops were stored in standing water at room temperature, and deli cups were not air-dried. Staff were instructed to correct each item.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat pita bread
summary: A food handler touched ready-to-eat pita bread with bare hands while bagging it; the pita was discarded. Pre-packaged pistachio items lacked allergen labels and were pulled. Deli handwash sinks had no paper towels, and several food handler certificates were expired.

headline: No certified manager while TCS food prepared
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on duty while chicken, pork and eggs were prepared; a citation was issued. A certified manager must be on site whenever TCS food is handled.

headline: Dirty reach-in coolers, floors, and cracked tiles
summary: Interior of the front reach-in coolers, counters and drive-thru prep stations must be cleaned. The walk-in freezer floor under the rack must be defrosted and cleaned. Floor drains are dirty, and tiles are cracked or missing in the rear area.

headline: Free drink samples left open at register
summary: Open, uncovered drinks were offered as free samples at a self-service counter. Staff moved the samples away from customers and began serving them individually during the inspection. Several coolers lack internal thermometers, and a backflow device was blocked by chemicals.

headline: Greasy fryers and oven; light fixture missing end caps
summary: Grease and food debris have built up inside the deep fryers and oven and need cleaning. A basement food prep light fixture lacks end caps on the light shields and must be replaced or capped.

headline: Certified manager certificate not posted on site
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager certificate was posted on the premises; the original updated certificate must be posted. Bulk containers in the basement prep area are unlabeled, and the liquor storage room floor is cluttered. Allergen training certificates were not on site.

headline: No proof of food handler training; wall and floor repairs
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for required employees, and the pending certified manager lacks allergen training proof. Baseboards are taped and damaged, wall cracks are open near the mop sink, a floor drain is dirty, and ceiling tiles are missing.

headline: Peeling ceiling paint and greasy hood; upkeep issues
summary: Paint is chipping from the kitchen ceiling above the refrigeration unit and near a prep table. A ceiling tile around a vent is cracked. Grease has built up on the hood and filters. These are building upkeep and cleaning issues.

headline: No certified manager; grease on floors; prior issues uncorrected
summary: No certified manager was on site while chicken, shrimp, and rice and beans were prepared; a citation was issued. Fryers are leaking grease onto the prep floor, and pipes under a two-compartment sink leak. Previous grease, dirt, and allergen training violations remain uncorrected.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; dirty floors and hood
summary: Milk crates are used for storage in the walk-in cooler and chest freezer, and cardboard lines shelves. Floors are broken and dirty, mold is on the beer cooler ceiling, and staff trash lacks a lid. The hood above the stove is dirty with food debris and must be cleaned or removed.

headline: Ice buildup in meat freezers; ceiling needs repainting
summary: Meat chest freezers in the rear food prep area have excess ice and must be cleaned. The hood above the stove has grease and dirt buildup. Ceilings have peeling paint and stained tiles, and lighting in the rear prep and storage areas must be stronger. This is a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Missing splashguard and trash can cover
summary: A splashguard is missing between the handwash and utility sinks in the rear. Multi-use utensils in storage were not inverted to dry. A trash receptacle cover is missing in the toilet room.

headline: Cooked beans cooled too slowly; about 30 lbs discarded
summary: Two containers of cooked beans at 85.6F failed to cool from 135F to 70F within two hours. Staff discarded about 30 lbs of food (about $75) on site. A citation was issued. A beard restraint was missing, and a mop head was touching a wall.

headline: No person in charge on site; prior violations not corrected
summary: No person in charge was on site, and no sanitation certificate was present while TCS food was handled; a citation was issued. Basement clutter and dirty hoods were found. Earlier ice machine slime and allergen training violations were not corrected.

headline: Debris buildup in rear prep coolers
summary: Debris has built up inside coolers in the rear prep area. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them. This is a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: No valid manager certificate; splash guard seal broken
summary: No valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate was provided for the person in charge; a certified manager must be on premises whenever TCS food is handled. A citation was issued. The splash guard seal is broken, prep area grout is missing, and the staff restroom vent is not working.

headline: Reach-in freezer spills; leak under three-compartment sink
summary: The interior of the reach-in freezer has spills and debris that must be cleaned. A leak at the bottom of the three-compartment sink must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Broken self-closing door; dusty vents and tiles
summary: The self-closing door in the second floor employee washroom is not working. Dust covers basement vents and light shields, and food debris is under storage shelving. Damaged floor tiles are in front of the ice machine on the first floor.

headline: No three-compartment sink at bar prep area
summary: The bar prep area has no three-compartment sink for washing, rinsing and sanitizing equipment. The manager was told that one must be provided. The license inspection was a fail.

headline: About 60 live flies in first floor prep and dining area
summary: About 60 live small flies were on walls, ceiling and storage racks in the first floor prep and dining area; a citation was issued and pest control was required. Employees lacked hair restraints. Grocery bags were used for TCS food in the freezer, and fryers, floors and vents are dirty.

headline: Dirty washroom fixtures; items on floor
summary: Washroom fixtures are dirty and must be cleaned and sanitized. Dirt is on food prep floors along walls and in corners. Some items stored on the floor in the prep and rear areas must be raised at least six inches.

headline: Cold food held too warm; about 10 lbs discarded
summary: Tofu was at 49F, and tuna, salmon and eggs were at 44F to 48F in the rear refrigerator; safe cold-holding is 41F or below. An employee discarded about 10 lbs of food (about $100). A citation was issued.

headline: Freezer blocks handwash sink; unlabeled bulk foods
summary: A reach-in freezer was placed in front of a handwash sink, which was not accessible; a citation was issued. The smoothie station sink lacked a handwashing sign. Bulk flour and sugar were unlabeled, containers were not inverted to dry, and rack clutter must be removed.

headline: Prior priority violations still not corrected
summary: Violations from a September 2025 inspection were not corrected: worn cutting boards, grease and debris on equipment, dust on fan guards and walls, damaged walls and floors, and burnt-out hood lights. A citation was issued for the uncorrected violations.

headline: Washroom handwash sink had no hot water
summary: The washroom handwash sink had no hot water; manager instructed to provide hot water at all sinks. Also noted: debris outside the dumpster, unused items stored in outside and rear areas that could hide pests, and unfinished floors behind the front counter.

headline: Ice machine backflow device not located
summary: The backflow prevention device on the ice machine could not be located. The manager was instructed to locate or provide it.

headline: No covered receptacle in toilet room
summary: The toilet room has no covered receptacle for sanitary products; the person in charge was instructed to provide one. A large unrelated wooden stand in the dining room must be removed.

headline: Leaky line at rear handsink; door gap and worn gaskets
summary: The leaky water line at the rear handsink must be repaired. A gap along the front door bottom must be sealed to prevent insects. The three-door milk cooler gaskets are worn, and tape is used on shelving. Walls, floors, and ceilings need repair.

headline: Wall openings and greasy hood; re-inspection passed
summary: Several openings are in the walls behind the rear three-compartment sink, and paint is peeling behind the prep sink. Grease and food debris have built up on vents and the hood above cooking equipment. This is a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: No cooler thermometer; rear door gap
summary: No thermometer was inside the center prep cooler. Bulk containers in the rear are unlabeled. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear alley door must be closed to prevent pests. Grease needs cleaning, and one food handler lacks a certificate.

headline: Handwash sinks too cool; over 50 small flies
summary: Handwash sink water ranged from 75.6F to 82.8F, below 100F; a citation was issued. Over 50 small flies were found throughout; a citation was issued and pest control was recommended. Dish machine temperatures were corrected on site, and a middle sink in the men's washroom is not working.

headline: No handwash signs; clutter in basement
summary: No handwashing signs were at the rear bar and basement sinks. Ice bin needs cleaning inside, and plates on the drying rack must be inverted. Basement office and floors are cluttered and must be cleared and raised six inches off the floor.

headline: Dish machine had no chlorine; yogurt too warm
summary: The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine; a technician was called to service it. Yogurt was at 59F, and about 20 lbs ($30) was discarded. The dish machine lacked a temperature indicator, the three-compartment sink floods, and restroom hot water pressure was too low.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables; missing handler certificates
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on top of prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Food handlers without City of Chicago sanitation certificates must show proof of food handler training.

headline: Missing and damaged floor tiles in basement hall
summary: Floor tiles are missing or damaged in the basement hall leading to the walk-in and across from the utility sink. Repairs are needed to create a smooth, easily cleaned surface. This is a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Raw wood shelves; broken mop sink backflow device
summary: Raw wood shelves and fixtures near the front counter must be sealed or painted to be smooth and cleanable. The backflow device on the rear storage mop sink is broken or missing and must be installed so it can be serviced.

headline: Cooked meat and vegetables held above safe temperature
summary: Cooked meat in the prep cooler was at 60F, and cooked spinach and mushrooms were at 46.8F; safe cold-holding is 41F or below. A citation was issued. Also noted: a leaking pipe under a dish area sink, no lid on a restroom trash can, and cracked freezer tiles.

headline: Blocked handwash sink, missing hair restraint, no test strips
summary: Exposed handwash sink in rear prep was blocked by boxes; employee removed them during inspection. A food worker prepped without a hair restraint. The warewashing sink had no sanitizer test strips. Dumpster overflowing, food debris on floors, several food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: Dirty drains and floors in dish and food service areas
summary: Drains in the rear dish area have dirt and grime, and floors have debris under shelving and sinks. Food service floor debris was found. Staff were instructed to clean under and around all equipment to prevent pest and insect harborage.

headline: Handwash sinks blocked and unsupplied; broken hood
summary: Handwash sinks were blocked by a container, cleaning equipment and a hose; a citation was issued. Basement and washroom sinks lacked soap. A basement hood is not working and has grease spills. Several previous core violations were not corrected, including ice machine residue and rusty shelves.

headline: Ice scoops on prep table; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Ice scoops were stored on top of the sushi prep table. Handwash sink signs are missing in the basement dish area, and bulk containers are not labeled. Basement shelving is rusty, and light shields and a restroom vent are dusty.

headline: Men's restroom had no toilet tissue
summary: The men's restroom had no toilet tissue; a citation was issued. The outside garbage receptacle was missing its lid. Trash and food debris were on floors in the grocery and rear stock areas, and inside the walk-in cooler and freezer. A thermometer was missing in the walk-in cooler.

headline: No handwash sign; ice buildup in walk-in freezer
summary: The front handwash sink had no handwashing sign. Ice has built up inside the walk-in freezer, and milk crates are used as shelving in the rear storage area. A minor leak was found under the front handwash sink. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Utensils not stored properly; rust and ice buildup
summary: Serving utensils were not stored properly on a cart beside the wok station. Prep table bottoms are rusty, a cooler door gasket is torn, and freezers have excess ice. Drains and ceiling vents are dirty, and food in non-original containers needs labels.

headline: Soda crates used as shelving in walk-in
summary: Soda crates are being used as shelving inside the walk-in cooler. Staff were told not to use them and to use raised shelves six inches off the floor for easier cleaning.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; dusty vents
summary: Expired food handler certificates were found in the folder; employees must obtain valid certificates and remove expired ones. Vents in prep and toilet rooms have dirt and dust buildup. Mops must be hung to air-dry, not stored in buckets.

headline: No food handler or allergen training proof
summary: No proof of food handler training was on site for any food handlers. No proof of allergen training was on site for certified food managers. Staff were instructed to keep records on site at all times.

headline: No written health policy; door gap and washroom repairs
summary: No written employee health policy was on site, and management was told to provide one. A 1/2-inch gap under the front door could let rodents in. Raw wood counter surfaces, a damaged washroom baseboard, and a non-working washroom vent need repair.

headline: Fish thawed in standing water; hair restraint missing
summary: Fish was thawing in standing water in the three-compartment sink; the manager was told to thaw it properly. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, and single-service items were on the floor. The women's washroom handwash sink drains slowly, and hood grease needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; handwash sinks lacked supplies
summary: No certified food manager was present while raw meat, pizza and cut vegetables were handled. Soap and paper towels were missing at handwash sinks but were supplied during inspection. Bulk containers lack labels, and wiping cloths and single-use cups are used improperly.

headline: About 10 live flies found in food prep area
summary: About 10 live small flies were on boxes and the ceiling of the food prep area; a citation was issued and pest control was recommended. Also found: a 1/2-inch gap at side doors, an unlocated ice machine backflow device, no covered toilet receptacle, and food debris under the three-compartment sink.

headline: No pest control service records on site
summary: No current pest control service agreement or inspection receipts were on site. Wet wiping cloths were on prep counters and must be kept in sanitizer. Food debris was under cooking equipment. A citation was issued for missing pest control records.

headline: Front door gap and leaking three-compartment faucets
summary: A 1/4-inch gap between the front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The three-compartment sink faucets are leaking and must be repaired. This is a complaint re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: About 45 rodent droppings in several areas
summary: About 45 rodent droppings were found: about 20 near the water heater in the employee toilet, about 10 under the microwave table, about 5 by the grease trap, and about 10 near soda storage. A citation was issued, and pest control was recommended. No metal stem thermometer was on site.

headline: Handwash sink water far below required 100F
summary: Several restroom handwash sinks lacked hot water at 100F, with readings as low as 39.7F and as high as 88.9F. A citation was issued. Worn cutting boards must be replaced, and the bar floor must be grouted.

headline: No handwash signs; food debris under cooking equipment
summary: The exposed handwash sink in the rear prep area had no handwashing sign. Some food debris was on the floor under cooking equipment in the rear prep area. The person in charge was instructed to correct both issues.

headline: Old sponges and cutting boards; cleaning needed
summary: Sponges need replacing, and cutting boards need replacing. Interior and exterior surfaces of cooking equipment and reach-in coolers need cleaning, and the floors need detail cleaning. This is a license inspection with a pass result.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site. The manager was instructed to comply with Illinois food handler requirements. Unused equipment and articles in storage must be removed to prevent pest hiding.

headline: Live flies and about 100 rodent droppings found
summary: About 12 live small flies and about 100 rodent droppings were found in prep, storage and near the mop sink; a citation was issued. Previous pest violations were not corrected. No certified manager was on site, and test strips and food handler certificates were missing.

headline: Tape repairs, dirty curtains, and water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Wiping cloths in the prep area must be kept in sanitizer. Peeling tape is used as a repair on the sushi cooler, and cardboard lines shelving. Curtains, mop sink, and garbage can are dirty, and water-damaged ceiling tiles need replacing in the rear kitchen.

headline: Handwash signs needed; no covered toilet receptacle
summary: Handwash signs are needed at the front and toilet room handwash sinks. The toilet room has no covered receptacle. The person in charge was instructed to provide each item.

headline: No handwash signs; clutter on locker room floor
summary: No handwashing signs were at the dish area and front prep handwash sinks. Items on the locker room floor must be elevated and organized. The women's restroom has no lidded receptacle for sanitary products.

headline: Vacuum-packed fresh fish outside approved plan
summary: Vacuum-packed fresh fish with 7-day labels was stored in the walk-in cooler, which is not allowed under the approved HACCP plan. The manager was told to exclude fresh fish from vacuum packing. About $50 of fish was discarded.

headline: Slow-draining sink; dirty walk-in cooler floors
summary: The front prep area hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired. Floors inside the walk-in coolers and freezer need cleaning to remove debris and spills. This is a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Dust and grease buildup; cleaning needed
summary: Dust is on the wall above the front prep station and on slushy dispenser nozzles. Walk-in cooler and freezer floors need detail cleaning, and cooking equipment sides have grease spatter. Air vents are dusty. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Over 40 small flies; no handwash signs; uncovered ice bins
summary: Over 40 small flies were found in kitchen and storage areas; a citation was issued and pest control was recommended. Missing handwash signs, no chlorine test kit, uncovered ice bins, no prep sink in the bars, and non-working hood lights were also noted.

headline: Clutter, unused equipment, missing tiles, burnt-out lights
summary: Clutter was on basement and dry storage floors, and unused equipment was in the kitchen and basement. The manager was told to remove it to prevent pest hiding. Some ceiling tiles are missing and several lights are burnt out. This is a re-inspection; the result was a pass.

headline: Meat and deli foods held too warm; about 87 lbs discarded
summary: Meat display case foods reached 46.5F to 59.9F, above the 41F safe limit. Management discarded about 87 lbs ($552) right away. No certified manager was on site during food prep, and a citation was issued. An ice machine with black slime was cleaned during the inspection.

headline: Slow-draining handwash sink at service line
summary: The handwash sink in the front service line drains slowly. The manager was instructed to service it.

headline: Pizza held too cool; no employee health policy
summary: Pizza slices in the hot holding unit were at 90.5F to 97.5F; about 5 lbs ($20) was discarded. No working thermometer was in the unit. No employee health policy or food handler certificates were on site, and the certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up when drained
summary: When the third compartment of the three-compartment sink is drained, wastewater backs up into the middle compartment. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain it. A citation was issued.

headline: No hot water at both prep area handwash sinks
summary: Both prep area handwash sinks had no hot water; water measured 46F. The manager was instructed to provide 100F to 120F water. This is a priority violation.

headline: Handwash sink water too cool; several repairs needed
summary: Handwash sink water measured 65.6F at the prep area and 66.2F in the unisex restroom; the minimum is 100F. A citation was issued. Also noted: a 1/4-inch front door gap, duct tape repairs, broken countertops, and no food handler training certificate.

headline: Fly strips over prep area; grease and trash outside
summary: Fly strips hung over the prep table and equipment were removed on site and must hang away from food areas. Grocery bags were used for food storage, water stood behind cooking equipment, and grease and trash were around the dumpster, which was left open.

headline: Dirty beverage cooler floor; trash lid missing
summary: The walk-in beverage cooler floor has dirt and debris under shelving. The rear employee restroom trash lacks a lid, and the dish area under the three-compartment sink is dirty. The soap dispenser is broken, and unused items need removal.

headline: No certified manager; prep sink water only 88F
summary: No person in charge had a valid sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while chicken, fish and salads were prepared; a citation was issued. Hot water at the prep handwash sink was 88F; hot water must be at least 100F. A citation was issued.

headline: Restroom handwash sink water only 57F
summary: The women's restroom handwash sink water was 57F; it must reach 100F. A citation was issued. Black mold-like caulking is above the three-compartment sink and must be cleaned or replaced.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Grease and food debris built up behind and between cooking equipment and must be cleaned. One manager with a City of Chicago certificate has no allergen training. This is a complaint inspection with a pass result.

headline: No certified manager; unlabeled foods and unprotected pastries
summary: No certified manager was on site while empanadas and creamed pastries were prepared; a citation was issued. Unlabeled, undated foods were found. Pastries were unprotected on display, and about 20 lbs was discarded. No sanitizer test kit and no food handler training records were on site.

headline: No handwash signs; clutter in meat packing area
summary: No handwashing signs were at preparation area sinks. Shoes and other clutter were found in the meat packing area and must be moved. The area must be cleaned and organized.

headline: About 40 rat droppings found throughout premises
summary: About 40 rat droppings were scattered in the rear prep area under shelving, near the three-compartment sink, and in a storage closet. A citation was issued. A 3-inch gap under the garage door, a soiled toilet seat, and missing handwash signs were also noted.

headline: Ice machine interior has pink and black residue
summary: The ice machine interior shows pinkish and blackish substances and must be cleaned. Male food handlers in prep are not wearing beard restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and basement and corner floors have dirt and debris. This is a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Cooked foods held over 24 hours without dates
summary: Grilled chicken, cooked burgers and rib tips were stored over 24 hours without disposition dates; items were dated during the inspection; a citation was issued. No chemical test strips were on site for either sanitizer, and the grill's lower part had grease buildup.

headline: Floors need detail cleaning
summary: Floors throughout the facility need detail cleaning to remove debris and buildup. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Slow-draining three-compartment sink pipe
summary: The three-compartment sink pipe drains slowly. The manager was told it must drain more quickly.

headline: Shellfish tag dates missing; cold beef too warm
summary: Shellfish tags lacked the last-sold dates; corrected on site during inspection. Cuts of beef in a cooler reached 48.3F to 50.1F; about 20 lbs ($200) was discarded. A wet floor near ice machines was fixed, and staff jackets were stored on a prep rack.

headline: Plastic cup used as bulk food scoop
summary: A disposable plastic cup was used as a scoop for bulk food. Staff were instructed to use proper scoops. Kitchen staff have no food handler certificates and were told to obtain them.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; ceiling holes need sealing
summary: The interior of the ice bin needs cleaning. Containers in the coffee display cooler lack labels, and a mop was stored improperly in the mop sink closet. Holes in the ceiling above the prep area and mop sink must be sealed.

headline: Dish machine too hot; food handler certificates missing
summary: The high-temperature dish machine final rinse was above 194F; repair was instructed, and no citation was issued. Several food handlers lack certificates, and the certified manager lacks allergen training. Fryers, floors under equipment, and a wall hole need cleaning or repair.

headline: Food and single-use items stored on floor
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer, and single-service items were on the floor in rear storage. Floor drains in the dishwashing area need cleaning. The certified manager on duty has no allergen training.

headline: Dusty kitchen vent needs cleaning
summary: A dusty vent was found in the kitchen prep area. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain it. No other issues were noted.

headline: Cat feces and droppings found in basement
summary: A litter box filled with cat feces and many cat droppings were found in the basement. Live animals are not allowed on the premises, and a citation was issued. Unused equipment, floor debris, and a missing bathroom light shield were also noted.

headline: Shellfish tags lack dates; raw-food menu disclosure missing
summary: Shellstock tags lacked the date the last shellfish from each container was sold or served. Pink mold-like substance found inside the basement ice machine, which must be cleaned. Menu lacked the raw or undercooked food advisory. Several previous core violations were not corrected.

headline: No certified manager; hot water too cool
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while potatoes, tomatoes and hot dogs were prepared; a citation was issued. A rear prep handwash sink was blocked and had no dryer. Restroom hot water measured 54.3F. Also noted: no probe thermometer and no ice machine backflow device.

headline: No certified manager; no soap or paper towels
summary: No certified food manager was on site while milk and deli foods were handled. Hand soap and paper towels were missing at prep and dish area handwash sinks. A spoiled gallon of milk was discarded, and no food temperature thermometers were on site.

headline: Personal items on shelves; ice machine drain misrouted
summary: Employee personal care items were stored on shelves with multi-use utensils. Shelves and racks were greasy and dirty. The ice machine drain line was draining into the rear three-compartment sink, and plastic wrap was used as sink stoppers.

headline: No certified manager on site; cold food too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS food was prepped, and the posted certificate had expired. Cold TCS food in the front prep unit reached 52.2F; about 10 lbs was discarded. Food handler and allergen training records were missing, and grease and debris were heavy.

headline: Prep handwash sink blocked by container
summary: An exposed handwash sink in the prep area was blocked by a container; a citation was issued. The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap, so it is not rodent-proof. Single-service items were not inverted, and soiled mop heads were not stored to dry.

headline: Walk-in freezer and coolers need cleaning
summary: The walk-in freezer and reach-in coolers need cleaning. Food debris has built up on the stove, which must be degreased and sanitized. A damaged floor in the prep area must be repaired to create an easily cleaned surface.

headline: Scoop on ice machine; burnt-out ceiling lights
summary: Complaint passed. Plastic ice scoop stored on top of ice machine; a clean container is required. Food build-up on prep shelves under bulk containers. Some ceiling light bulbs above cookline prep area are not working and must be replaced.

headline: Boxed food on freezer floor; greasy surfaces
summary: Re-inspection passed. Boxed food on walk-in freezer floor must go on shelving. Worn door gaskets and rust on shelving need repair. Excessive grease and food debris on prep tables, walls and floors throughout prep areas must be cleaned. Cracked light shields.

headline: Leaking faucet; food handlers lack training proof
summary: Complaint passed. Leaking faucet at three-compartment sink must be repaired. Food employees lacked proof of food handler training. A City food service manager lacked proof of allergen training.

headline: Missing splashguards; pots not inverted
summary: Passed. Splashguards missing at handsink and dump sink in first-floor bar. Meat skewers stored in mechanical room. Preset tableware uncovered. Multi-use pots not inverted. Aluminum foil on shelves; debris around handsink faucets.

headline: Cooling food covered; bowls used as scoops
summary: Passed. TCS foods (cooked beans, chicken) were covered with container lids while cooling in walk-in area; they must be loosely covered or uncovered. Multi-use bowls used as scoops in bulk dry storage must be replaced with utensils with handles.

headline: Dirty ice machine, kitchen; expired allergen training
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior must be cleaned, along with prep tables, cooler shelves and refrigeration units. Washroom fixtures dirty. Kitchen floors, walls and ceiling need cleaning; hood and filters need grease removal. Manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Missing thermometers; ice cream stored on floor
summary: Complaint passed. Thermometers missing inside coolers. Ice cream stored on floor of walk-in freezer. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Floor opening near walk-in cooler must be sealed; food debris and spills in prep and storage areas.

headline: Bulk foods, including spices, unlabeled
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Bulk foods that are not in original containers, including spices, must be labeled with the product's common name.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings; untagged live clams
summary: Failed. Live clams in cooler had no shellstock tag; about 10 lbs ($60) discarded; citation issued. About 25 or more mouse droppings under shelving, by the refrigerator and under the sink; pest control recommended. Insect control device placed over food prep area.

headline: Clutter stored on floor at coffee bar
summary: Passed. Clutter stored on floor along front coffee bar wall. The manager was instructed to remove unused articles and equipment to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; unsecured wall base
summary: Passed. Some cooling units lack thermometers. Rear exit door is not rodent-proof and must be enclosed. Restroom door not self-closing. Refuse area has excess trash. Wall base and chip racks detached from wall in grocery area.

headline: Dirty ice machine bin and restroom fixtures
summary: Passed. Internal bin of ice machine is a little dirty and must be cleaned. Plumbing fixtures in toilet room need cleaning.

headline: No test strips; leaking backflow; ceiling tiles
summary: Passed with conditions. No test strips for high-temperature dish machine final rinse. Leaking backflow device at front prep dump sink. No covered sanitary receptacle in women's washroom. Missing and water-damaged ceiling tiles; loose food debris on floors.

headline: Worn-off labels; grocery bags in freezers
summary: Passed. Bulk container names have worn off and must be relabeled. Grocery bags were used for food storage in two freezers; food-grade bags are required. Freezer interiors, shelves, fryers and floors need cleaning. Kitchen vent is dusty.

headline: Failed: no manager; chicken held too warm
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while beef and chicken were handled. Handsink blocked by a bucket and garbage can. 50 lbs cooked chicken held at 57.6-65.4°F. No sanitizer test strips and no food handler certificates for kitchen staff.

headline: No certified manager; oven not under hood
summary: Person in charge has no City sanitation certificate, and none is posted. No hanging thermometer in hot holding unit. Electric oven not under exhaust hood; Buildings Department approval needed. Prior violation uncorrected: no allergen training certificate.

headline: Food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Complaint passed. Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints. The person in charge was told that all food handlers must wear a hair restraint.

headline: Complaint re-inspection: plumbing, floors, ceilings
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. No service sink for mop water. Scrape sink and two-compartment sink lack catch basins. Holes behind water heater and ice machine. Broken floor tiles at rear exit. Missing ceiling panels and wall tiles in women's restroom.

headline: Stained cutting boards; expired allergen training
summary: Passed. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains above prep cooler must be refinished or replaced. Allergen training expired for all City food managers; they must complete it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Failed: mold in ice machine, live pests found
summary: Failed. Black mold-like substance inside ice machine; ice discarded and machine cleaned. Vacuum packaging without a variance or HACCP plan; packages held. Live ants, roaches and flies in prep areas. Wastewater backup at food prep handsink.

headline: Door gap, greasy cooler shelves, dusty vent
summary: Rear exterior door had a 1/2 inch gap at the bottom and side; the person in charge was told to repair it. Build-up was found on cooler shelving and dust on a utility room vent. All were to be cleaned.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; blocked handsinks
summary: Passed with conditions. Thick black slime in ice machine dripping onto ice; citation issued and machine must not be used until cleaned. Handsinks blocked by silverware and plates, with no soap. Employee food stored with customer food.

headline: Failed: leaking handsink; no allergen training
summary: Failed. Handsink in lower-level dishwashing area is not maintained or properly connected, and water leaks onto the floor; citation issued. Sanitation manager has no allergen training.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; overflowing dumpster
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on premises while milk and ham were prepared; citation issued. Dumpster overflowing, with trash on ground that can attract rodents. Missing hair restraints and handwashing signs; water-stained ceiling tiles above sink.

headline: Hair restraint, uninverted pots, damaged ceiling
summary: Passed. A food handler lacked a hair restraint; the person in charge must require them. Large pots were not stored inverted. Damaged women's restroom ceiling tiles and peeling drywall behind kitchen handsink need repair.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and menu disclosures
summary: Handwashing signs were missing in restrooms and bars. Menu lacked asterisks and a disclosure for undercooked animal foods; this was corrected at the 12/18/2024 inspection. An opening in the front entrance doors also needs sealing.

headline: Rusty racks, poor lighting, expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution. Front coolers lack thermometers. Rusty walk-in cooler racks. Dirty grease trap. Uncovered restroom trash, clutter, and dirty floors. Poor lighting in toilet rooms. Allergen certificate expired.

headline: Failed: over 40 mouse droppings in food areas
summary: Failed. Over 40 mouse droppings in prep freezer, cooler, and deli prep area. Exterminator required; citation issued. Food debris and spills on equipment and floors. Leaking drainpipe under tray room handsink.

headline: Food on floor; missing handwash signage
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at basement handsink. Boxed food stored on freezer floor must be raised six inches. Rusted racks in walk-in cooler. No covered trash receptacle in rear women's restroom.

headline: Failed: bare-hand contact; mouse droppings
summary: Failed. Food handler touched a tortilla with bare hands; citation issued. Steak held at 80°F on grill; shrimp, fish and oysters too warm in prep cooler; citation issued. About 100 mouse droppings found in basement; pest service needed.

headline: No certified manager; slimy ice machine
summary: No certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Ice machine had brown and black slime dripping onto ice. It was cleaned and sanitized during inspection. Rear exit door has a 1/2 inch gap, and staff were not wearing hair restraints.

headline: Food on floors, unfinished wood, wall holes
summary: Passed after re-inspection. Food containers stored on floor in prep and rear storage; must be on raised shelving six inches off the floor. Unfinished wood shelving and holes in wall base in dry storage must be sealed. Grease and dirt on hood and filters need detail cleaning.

headline: Undated cooked food; poor cooler lighting
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked rice and chicken in walk-in cooler held over 24 hours without a discard date; priority violation. Inadequate lighting in walk-in cooler. A suspension sign removal item was also noted.

headline: Door gaps, dead insects on light shields
summary: Re-inspection passed. Gaps at bottom of front and rear doors must be tight-fitting. Food storage crates must be replaced with shelving. Dead insects on light shields throughout must be cleaned. Worn gaskets and food debris in walk-in cooler.

headline: Leaking handsink drain; cluttered office
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Handsink next to fountain drink and slushy machine leaks from its drainpipe; instructed to repair. Office in prep area and dishroom is cluttered; items must be decluttered and stored six inches off the ground.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; held for inspection
summary: Walk-in cooler measured 54°F, above the 41°F limit. The cooler is tagged and held for Chicago Department of Public Health inspection. No TCS foods were inside. Do not use it until it holds 41°F or below and is re-inspected.

headline: Ice build-up in freezers; leaking sink faucet
summary: Re-inspection passed. Heavy ice build-up inside box freezers at front coffee prep and rear food prep areas; instructed to defrost. Steady leak from three-compartment sink faucet in rear prep and dish area; instructed to repair.

headline: Unlabeled salt, sugar; missing splash guard
summary: Passed. Salt and sugar kept in unlabeled plastic bins must be labeled. Splash guard missing between handsink and three-compartment sink. Multiple employees not wearing hair restraints. Cardboard shelf liners in cooling units must be removed.

headline: Failed: 80-100 mouse droppings found
summary: Complaint failed. Rodent activity with 80-100 mouse droppings under hot and cold holding units, in furnace room, and under storage shelves. Citation issued. Areas must be cleaned and pest control must service before re-inspection.

headline: Failed: rat droppings, roaches, open bait
summary: Complaint re-inspection failed. Over 30 rat droppings, over 20 mouse droppings, and 12 live roaches throughout. Open bait and boric acid on floors. Gaps at front and rear doors. Prior priority violation uncorrected; exterminator required; citation issued.

headline: Ice machine build-up; holes above basement handsink
summary: Passed. Minor build-up inside basement ice machine must be cleaned. Two holes in ceiling above basement handsink must be sealed and repaired.

headline: Openings, rusted shelving, damaged floors
summary: Passed. Large vent opening in dish room and hole at lower wall by handwash sink must be repaired to prevent pests. Rusted, peeling walk-in shelving must be replaced. Kitchen floors damaged; dish room floor holds standing water.

headline: Frozen beef thawed on counter; training gaps
summary: Passed. Frozen beef was thawing at room temperature; manager moved it to walk-in cooler. A male food handler had a beard without a guard. Two male food handlers lacked proof of food handler training and were told to meet the requirement.

headline: Failed: roaches and flies; grease and debris
summary: Failed. 10-12 roaches under wood ledge in front prep area; pest control required, citation issued. Small flies in employee washroom. Wood in prep area needs replacing. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment and floors under fryers.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers and beard restraint
summary: Bulk food containers were not labeled; the business was told to label them. A fly trap was placed on the clean utensils rack, and staff were told to keep it away from food. A cook with a long beard was told to wear a beard restraint.

headline: Complaint re-inspection: leaks, ice build-up, debris
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Residue inside ice machine; inoperable stoppers and a leaking drainpipe at three-compartment sink; ice build-up in walk-in freezer. Food stored on floors; must be elevated six inches. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Complaint re-inspection: signs, labels, training
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Missing handwashing signage, unlabeled food containers, and worn cutting boards with open seams. Mop stored improperly and exhaust vent dirty. No food employee has proof of allergen training; all were instructed to correct.

headline: Greasy stove; new manager needs allergen training
summary: Re-inspection passed. Stove, refrigeration units, and floors under equipment need cleaning. Vents above cooking equipment need cleaning. New City food service manager must obtain allergen training.

headline: Thawing in standing water; missing labels
summary: Re-inspection passed. TCS foods thawing in standing water in three-compartment sink; must thaw under cold running water. Grab-and-go desserts unlabeled. Pots too large for sink. Backflow device on ice machine not located. Only one manager has allergen training.

headline: Bare-handed glove change; blocked handsink
summary: Passed with conditions. Food handler changed gloves after handling raw beef without washing hands; citation issued. Soap was missing at two handsinks (provided during inspection). A bar handsink was blocked by a beer drain hose, which must be rerouted.

headline: Milk crates used for shelving in dry storage
summary: Milk crates were used to elevate items in rear dry storage. The person in charge was told to stop, since crates can hide pests. Proper shelving is required, and food must be stored 6 inches from the wall.

headline: Grimy drain in front service area
summary: Passed. Drain in front service area has grime and build-up. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Thermometer placed at back of coolers
summary: Passed. A thermometer was placed in the back of coolers. The business was instructed to keep it in the warmest part of the cooler in an easy-to-view place.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan or food handler proof
summary: Priority violation: no written cleanup procedure for vomiting or diarrhea events. No proof of food handler training for employees. Also noted: grease on cooking equipment, debris in basement freezers, and missing wall and floor tiles.

headline: Missing handwash signs, unlabeled dry bins
summary: Passed. Handwash signage missing at handsinks. Large dry storage bins are not labeled with common names. Floor drain near warewashing unit has debris. Business was instructed to fix and maintain each item.

headline: Failed re-inspection: repeat violations, grease, gaps
summary: Failed re-inspection. Priority violations from 4/16/26 not corrected: boxes on floor, food debris and spills in cold units, and utility sink build-up. Also a gap at the rear garbage door and greasy hood. Outside garbage area was corrected on site.

headline: Open gaps under exit doors; loose stone counter
summary: Passed. Rear and side first-floor exit doors have a 1-inch gap at the bottom threshold; must be sealed tight. Box office staff washroom counter is made of loose stones and must be a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Bulk salt and sugar unlabeled
summary: Passed. Bulk salt and sugar were not labeled. The business was instructed to label them.

headline: Dead insects on glue boards; sticky floors
summary: Passed. Glue boards holding dead insects must be removed. Grease on a burner unit in rear storage must be cleaned or removed. Floors throughout the premises are sticky; staff were instructed to mop and keep them clean.

headline: Failed: drain flies, sewage backup, cold food too warm
summary: Failed inspection. About 50-60 drain flies at basement sump pump. Eggs (51.4°F, 44.4°F) and sliced tomatoes (64.2°F) were too warm in the cooler and discarded. Sewage backup on floor. No hot water in men's room.

headline: Restroom doors not self-closing
summary: Passed. Toilet room doors are not self-closing. The business was instructed to provide and maintain self-closing devices.

headline: Worn gaskets, crates for storage, standing liquid
summary: Passed. Missing cooler handle and worn door gasket in prep areas. Tape inside a large ice machine must be removed. Crates used for utensil storage must be replaced with shelving. Standing liquid in coolers must be removed, and ice machine panel cleaned.

headline: Soiled fixtures, wooden shelves, door gap
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Soap and towels at 3-compartment and utility sinks must be removed; handsinks only for handwashing. About 1-inch gap below front door. Packaged food stored on floor. Wooden shelves and damaged can opener need replacing.

headline: Failed: no undercooked-food advisory on menu
summary: Failed. Menu lacked consumer advisory for undercooked steak, eggs and beef; priority violation. Dry storage containers unlabeled and equipment on floor. Torn cooler gaskets, missing sink stoppers and slow drain. Ceramic cups need lead safety documentation.

headline: Leaking faucet at rear three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Faucet base at rear three-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No certified manager while chicken served
summary: No City sanitation manager or valid certificate was on site while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared and served to the public. Priority foundation violation; citation issued. A certified manager must be on site whenever these foods are served.

headline: Hole in wall base; missing grout
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Small hole in lower wall base near hot water tank and missing grout in rear mop sink area must be repaired.

headline: Failed: no mop sink backflow; uncorrected violation
summary: Failed. Mop sink lacks a visible backflow prevention device. Prior core violation from 3/20/23 not corrected: broken rubber gasket on two-door reach-in cooler in kitchen. Must be corrected by re-inspection.

headline: Re-inspection: signage, thermometers, labeling
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Needed: handwashing signage at front prep sink, visible accurate thermometers in all coolers, ingredient information on prepackaged lasagna, rust removed or racks replaced in walk-in cooler, and cooler interiors detail cleaned.

headline: Dirty reach-in coolers, sinks, and floors
summary: Passed. Interiors of reach-in coolers, sinks and tables are not clean and must be cleaned. Floors at main kitchen and bar areas are not clean.
