summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for any food handler. No certified manager had allergen training. The facility must provide documentation for both.

headline: Greasy floor under fryers
summary: Grease was on the floor under cooking fryers. The facility must clean and maintain the area.

headline: Cardboard reused as floor liner
summary: Cardboard was being reused as a floor liner under rubber mats by the cook line. The inspector instructed staff to remove it and not reuse cardboard. Surfaces must be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Dock door openings; boxes stored on ground
summary: Openings at the base of a dock door in the dumpster area must be sealed to prevent pests. Boxes were stored on the ground in the parking garage dry storage area and must be raised six inches. Food handler proof was not provided.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Bulk containers of rice, flour and similar items had no labels. The sanitation manager had no allergen training. The facility must provide both.

headline: Failed cold holding: eggs, fish, chicken above 41F
summary: Eggs at 50.3F, fish at 50F, gyros at 46F, tomatoes at 50F and chicken at 44.8F were held above the 41F safe limit. About 10 lbs worth $200 was disposed of. A prep cooler at 53.6F was ordered out of use until it holds 41F. Staff had no hair restraints.

headline: Failed: no health policy, sanitizer, or hand sink
summary: Failed. No employee health policy, no vomiting or diarrhea cleanup kit, and no sanitizer or food thermometer were on site. Refrigeration was off. A hand sink was missing from the toilet room. Unknown source for paletas and ice cream. Raw brick prep wall was not cleanable.

headline: No certified manager; missing hair restraints and labels
summary: No person in charge with a valid City certificate was on duty while food was served. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Handwashing signs and labels on food containers were missing. Clutter in the mop closet should be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Failed: 7 live roaches and rodent droppings
summary: Failed. About 7 live roaches were at prep areas and 8 rodent droppings were in the fryer cabinet. Grease and dried food debris covered cooking equipment and walls. Microwaves were unclean, and the mop sink was removed and must be reinstalled with hot and cold water.

headline: Both City managers need allergen training
summary: Both City of Chicago food service managers must obtain valid allergen training certificates.

headline: Storage on floor; expired handler certificate
summary: An employee's open coffee cup was in the food prep area and must be replaced with a closed container. Dry food was stored under wastewater lines in the basement. An expired food handler certificate was found, and all certified managers need allergen proof.

headline: No handwashing signs; unlabeled food; gaps in doors
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at multiple sinks, including washrooms and the drive-thru. Openings in the front door and rear exit base must be sealed. A floor drain cover and ceiling tile were missing. The front prep area was dimly lit, and one hood light was out.

headline: Vacuum packing without variance; 50 lbs discarded
summary: Vacuum-packaged foods were in the walk-in cooler without a variance or HACCP plan. The person in charge discarded about 50 lbs worth $1,250, and vacuum packing must stop until approved. Milk crates were used as shelving, and ceiling damage needed repair.

headline: Loose wall ledge and tile; leaking hand sink
summary: A wall ledge behind the soda machine was loose and must be repaired to prevent insects. The walk-in cooler floor had dirt and debris under shelves and in corners. A hand sink leaked at the base of its faucet, and a wall tile was loose.

headline: No certified manager on site; employee health policy missing
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation certificate was posted, and no certified manager was present. No employee health policy or training was on site. Handwashing signs were missing, and a dish machine had torn plastic. Grease was built up, and the three-compartment sink faucet was loose.

headline: Sealing, cleaning and certification gaps
summary: Items to fix included a torn gasket on a cooler, peeling liner, and a missing grease trap. Ceiling tiles were water damaged, and ventilation in the employee washroom was inoperable. No food handler proof was provided, and the pending certified manager lacked allergen proof.

headline: Failed: raw eggs above ready-to-eat food; dead roaches
summary: Raw eggs were stored above ready-to-eat BBQ sauce in the walk-in cooler. Food was stored on the floor and in grocery bags. Floors had grease and dead roaches under the three-compartment sink. Hood and filters were greasy. Citations were issued for several items.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; poor lighting in walk-in
summary: Bulk containers of salt and sugar were not labeled and must be. A pizza peel was wedged between prep coolers, and deli cups were not air dried. Walk-in cooler lighting was inadequate and must be increased.

headline: Missing paper towels and soap corrected on site
summary: Paper towels and hand soap were missing at hand sinks; the food handler obtained both during the inspection. Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer, and no hair restraints were worn while prepping food. Dumpster lids were left open and overflowing.

headline: Torn screen door left open; dirty mop water
summary: A rear screen door had a hole and was left open, which must be repaired to keep pests out. A mop was stored in dirty mop water, which can breed flies. Staff were told to store mops upright and change the water more often.

headline: Pans not inverted; missing ceiling tile; no allergen cert
summary: Pans stored under hot holding units were not inverted. A ceiling tile was missing above the pizza prep cooler. No allergen training certificate was on site from the food manager, and all certified managers must take the course.

headline: Failed: dish machine at 0 ppm; chicken too warm
summary: Failed. The in-use low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was repaired during inspection. Cooked and raw chicken was held at unsafe temperatures. The walk-in cooler at 47F was repaired during inspection. Citations were issued.

headline: Failed: rat droppings, expired manager certificate
summary: Failed. About 25 rat droppings were found: 10 in the side dry storage and 15 in the basement water heater area. Pest control was recommended. The manager's City certificate was expired, and food was stored on the floor. Thermometers and handwashing signs were also missing.

headline: Failed: broken faucets, grease, unfixed prior violations
summary: Failed. Splash guard missing at a hand sink, a two-compartment sink faucet was broken, and the bar hand sink drains slowly. Grease, food debris and dirt were found on floors and walls. Prior violations were not fixed, including missing food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; wrong sanitizer used
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. The hand sink lacked signs. A surface sanitizer not designed for dishware was in use, and test strips could not check strength. A chlorine-based sanitizer was provided, and the storage room needed organizing.

headline: Food stored on freezer floor; dirty drain and utility sink
summary: Food boxes were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Wet wiping cloths sat on prep tables. Aluminum foil lined shelves and a wall. A heavily soiled floor drain and utility sink needed detail cleaning.

headline: Food held over 24 hours without date marking
summary: About 1 lb of ground beef and 12 lbs of pork worth $430 were stored more than 24 hours without date labels. Staff must date-mark ready-to-eat foods with disposal dates. Debris was found around the dumpster and on floors along walls and corners in utility and storage areas.

headline: Failed: live flies at bar and dishwash areas
summary: Failed. About 5 live small flies were at the bar and 10 at the dishwash area. Insect activity must be removed by the reinspection date, and pest control was advised. Food debris covered shelves and coolers, and the basement was cluttered.

headline: Failed cold holding: mini cooler and two-door unit
summary: Half-and-half, ham, sausage and chicken were held at 46-50F. About 17 lbs ($110) were discarded. Two cold-holding units at 48.7F and 50F were tagged. Squirt bottles and bulk butter lacked labels, and the mini fridge lacked a thermometer.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, no vomit kit, no handwashing signs
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while deli meat was prepared, which led to a citation. No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure was on site. Both employees lacked food handler training, and the three-compartment sink stopper and faucet were broken.

headline: No allergen training on site
summary: No allergen training was on site. The facility must provide allergen training certificates for all certified food managers.

headline: Failed: 50+ rat droppings, no health policies
summary: Failed. About 50 or more rat droppings were on the floor near pipes and the hot water tank behind the service counter. Some employees lacked signed health policies, and no food handlers had training. Food debris was under cabinets and coolers, and a sink was in poor repair.

headline: Food stored on floor; no allergen certificate
summary: Food was stored on the basement floor, and frozen chicken was kept in plastic grocery bags. Manager was told to elevate food and use food-grade containers. Grease and debris were found on floors and walls. Sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Failed: no certified manager on site; cooler lighting
summary: Failed. No City-certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared, which led to a citation. A three-compartment sink faucet leaked. Walk-in cooler lighting was inadequate. Previous core violations included a broken hand sink knob and unclean washroom fixtures.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs in prep and bar
summary: No hand-washing signs were posted at the preparation areas or the second-floor bar. The facility must provide them.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: No certified food manager or valid documents were on site while TCS foods such as milk shakes and eggs-based waffles were prepared and served. The person in charge was told a certified manager must be present at all times. Utility shelves needed cleaning and clearing to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Failed: cold food held at 51-54F, about 70 lbs discarded
summary: Failed. TCS foods in a prep cooler ranged from 51-54F, including salmon, cream cheese, and ham. Cooler air was 58F. Manager discarded about 70 lbs worth $1,000. Gaskets on a beverage cooler were torn, and cutting boards had stains.

headline: Milk crates used as egg shelving; greasy hood
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving for eggs in the walk-in cooler, which must stop. Appropriate shelving is required. A broken tile was behind cooking equipment racks, and grease had built up on the hood and filters above cooking equipment.

headline: Rust in ice machine; drain not connected at bar sink
summary: Rust was found on interior surfaces of the rear ice machine, which must be removed to prevent ice contamination. The bar hand sink drainpipe was disconnected, so water collected on the floor. Staff must reconnect it. Food handler proof was also missing.

headline: Dirty floor drains and floor under sink
summary: Floor drains needed detail cleaning to remove buildup. The floor under the three-compartment sink and ice machine also needed detail cleaning.

headline: Food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints. The person in charge was instructed that all food handlers must wear one.

headline: Failed: no hand-washing supplies, 80F cooler
summary: Failed. Some hand sinks lacked soap, paper towels or dryers. A front serving cooler ran at 80F and must be repaired. Dump sink had no hot or cold water, and the cappuccino machine lacked backflow prevention. Ceiling tiles were porous and must be replaced.

headline: Failed: no hot water at hand sink, no thermometer
summary: Failed. The hot water knob at a hand sink did not work. No metal-stem thermometer was on the truck for cooked foods. No chemical test kit for sanitizer was available. The truck lacked a grease trap, a trash can, and a visible license number.

headline: Poor wall repair in men's restroom
summary: The walls in the men's restroom were in poor repair and must be fixed.

headline: Food debris on sushi prep floor
summary: Food debris was found on the floor throughout the sushi prep area. The person in charge was instructed to detail clean the floor and keep it maintained.

headline: Leaking faucet; greasy walls and equipment areas
summary: Leak at the base of the three-compartment sink faucet; manager told to repair it. Grease, spills and dried food debris along walls, in corners, and under and around cooking and cooling equipment. Cleaning ordered.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine mold; rear door gap
summary: No certified food manager on site while employees prepared food; citation issued. Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine panel, which is used for ice. Rear exit door is not rodent-proof at the bottom. Powder left on floor and food handlers without hair restraints.

headline: Broken cooler handle; foil and plastic shelf liners
summary: Broken door handle on the kitchen tall reach-in cooler must be replaced. Tin foil shelf liners and peeling plastic on a prep table must be removed. Unused construction shelving on the rear walkway removed to prevent pest harboring. No allergen proof for managers.

headline: Cardboard shelf liner removed during inspection
summary: Cardboard lined the shelves of a reach-in cooler. Manager removed it during inspection and was told to use a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: No thermometer; unlabeled ingredients; duct tape repairs
summary: Re-inspection: no thermometer inside the 2-door cold-hold cooler in front prep. Unlabeled flour, batter and seasonings. Sliding door on a cooler is inoperable, and several chest freezers are mended with duct tape. Repair ordered.

headline: No certified manager; entrance gap; food on floor
summary: No City-certified manager on site while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. Small gap under entrance door; food containers stored on floor in rear; dirty prep-area exhaust; food handlers without hair restraints. Containers unlabeled and thermometer missing.

headline: Flies, rat droppings, and cold food found
summary: About 35 small flies near bars, server stations and prep areas, and about 5 rat droppings in 2nd-floor dry storage. Black slime in ice machine dripping onto ice. Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm. Chicken wings at 51.8°F and smoked pork at 68.7°F; 30 lbs discarded. Citations issued.

headline: Corn cut on wiping cloth; grease on walls
summary: Employee cut corn on top of a wiping cloth; food must not touch linens. Grease buildup on walls and under the ventilation hood at the cook line. Staff instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Front door propped open; long sanitizer hose
summary: Complaint: front door propped open with no screen, which risks pest entry. Soap and sanitizer hose on the three-compartment sink reaches past the fill line; must be shortened. Food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: No signed health policies; leaky hand sink; allergen training missing
summary: Re-inspection: no signed employee health policies; citation issued. Leaky pipe at the rear dishwashing hand sink must be repaired. A food manager has no allergen training.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; standing liquid
summary: Complaint: wiping cloths in prep areas must be held in sanitizing solution between uses. Spillage in deep freezer and dairy cooler. Standing waste liquid at mop sink and basement. Soiled mop heads and walk-in floor spillage also need fixing.

headline: Food stored on floor; uncovered sauce; dirty ovens
summary: Re-inspection: pots of cooked and raw food on the floor; must store food only on food-contact surfaces. Bulk sauce uncovered in dry storage. Lower openings of cooking equipment, shelves and hot-holding equipment have debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Damaged gaskets, spills, litter and wall openings
summary: Re-inspection: damaged gaskets on prep cooler doors, ice buildup in rear freezer, and food spills on coolers, shelves and equipment. Litter around dumpsters, openings in walk-in storage walls, loose baseboards, and dusty vents. Manager told to fix each.

headline: Torn sushi cooler gaskets; uncovered restroom trash can
summary: Torn gaskets on the inside of both sushi prep coolers in the front sushi area must be repaired. The unisex restroom on the right has a trash can without a cover that must be provided.

headline: Fries stored on freezer floor; debris in freezer
summary: Re-inspection: fries stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer. Fries must be raised at least six inches. Food debris at the bottom of the reach-in freezer in rear prep must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; raw burgers at 50–55°F
summary: No City-certified manager on premises while chili, hamburgers and chicken were served; citation issued. Raw hamburgers at 50.2–55.5°F; about 10 lbs discarded. Menu lacks raw-food advisory. No employee health policy, food handler certificates, or metal-stem thermometer.

headline: No health policy or vomit procedure; manager lacks allergen training
summary: No signed employee health policies on site and no written vomit and diarrhea procedure posted. Soiled mops drying on the floor; must hang to dry. Person in charge lacks allergen training. No citation issued.

headline: Ice machine buildup; dirty floor drains; burnt bulb
summary: Slight buildup on ice machine chutes and pink buildup in bar gun holders. No covered trash in employee washroom. Dirt in bar and prep floor drains. One burned-out ceiling bulb above the dish machine. Cleaning ordered.

headline: No employee health policy; hand sinks lacked soap
summary: No written employee health policy on site; citation issued. No hand soap at both bar hand sinks; soap supplied during inspection; citation issued. Ice scoops stored in the ice bin, no covered waste bin in washrooms, dust on vents, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Gap under front door; missing ceiling panels
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front entrance door; a tight seal is needed at all outer openings. Hand sinks in prep and dish areas lack waste bins. Mop improperly stored. Missing ceiling panels near mop sink and hot water tank; vent dirt buildup.

headline: Raw wood shelving and cardboard in storage
summary: Raw wood shelving in rear storage should be painted or stained to be easy to clean. Cardboard lining soda crates could hide insects and was ordered removed. Dirt under walk-in cooler shelving and soda crates used as shelves also need fixing.

headline: No splash guard at prep hand sink; allergen training missing
summary: No splash guard at the hand sink near pizza prep; one must be provided. Sanitation managers lack allergen training certificates; must be provided.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods too warm; flies found
summary: No City-certified manager during food prep. Chicken, fish, beef and potatoes held at 58.9–62.4°F; 12 lbs discarded. Prep cooler at 61°F tagged. Warewash sanitizer at 0 ppm, machine tagged. About 15 small flies found.

headline: Missing health policy, thermometers and pest log
summary: No employee health policy on site. No metal-stem thermometer, no thermometer inside the prep cooler, and no chemical test kit. No pest control log on site. No allergen training certificate and no lid in the restroom.

headline: Dumpster overfilled; no food handler training proof
summary: Complaint: outside dumpster overfilled and could not close; citation issued. Recommended extra trash pickup day. No proof of food handler training for any food handler; records must be kept on site.

headline: Shrimp thawed without running water; leaking faucet
summary: Shrimp thawing in a bin without cold running water; cold running water must be available at all times. Food court ice machine needs detail cleaning. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet, dusty walk-in cooler ceiling and vents, and a dirty floor drain.

headline: Torn gaskets on prep and walk-in coolers
summary: Re-inspection: torn gaskets on the 2-door prep cooler and walk-in cooler. Staff instructed to repair or replace and maintain them.

headline: Unprotected tableware; broken dumpster lid
summary: Customer tableware stored without protection in the serving area. Grease and food debris inside the fryer; dirt on lower prep shelves and floors. Previous violation not corrected. Missing or broken dumpster lid; citation issued.

headline: Food stored on floor and uncovered; leaking drain
summary: Re-inspection: food stored on walk-in floor and uncovered in prep and walk-in coolers; utensils left inside food containers; grease on cooking equipment; leaking drainpipe under dish-area sink; dusty vents. No certified manager with allergen training on duty.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; cold foods discarded
summary: No certified manager on arrival; one came 15+ minutes later. No sanitizer on site at first; employee got it elsewhere. Foods at 46–67°F, about 10 lbs discarded. Two coolers tagged. No metal-stem thermometer until one was obtained. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager on duty; sink leak
summary: No City-certified food manager on duty; citation issued. Leak from the bottom of the first compartment of the three-compartment sink; repair ordered and a work order was submitted. Managers must obtain food allergen training.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of range; logs incomplete
summary: Meatballs at 124.8°F, vegetable soup 114.6°F and cheese sauce 110.8°F in steam table; all discarded and temperature raised. Alfredo sauce at 49.5°F discarded. Temperature logs incomplete; a calzone at 66.9°F was not logged. Broken cold water handle at prep sink.

headline: Gap under front door; stained ceiling tiles
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under front entrance doors; manager told to seal outer openings to keep pests out. Milk crates used as shelving, a loose washroom faucet, and stained ceiling tiles in prep and sales areas. Manager told to fix each.

headline: Loose faucet, stained tile, and a dead freezer light
summary: Loose faucet at the main kitchen three-compartment sink. Stained ceiling tile behind the walk-in cooler and damaged floor tiles at the walk-in freezer. Non-working light in freezer O. Staff instructed to repair each.

headline: Person in charge lacks City manager certificate
summary: Person in charge has no City of Chicago food service manager certificate; citation issued. Prep tables and refrigeration units need cleaning. Floors and walls around and behind kitchen equipment have dirt, particles and grease.

headline: Spills around bar refrigerators
summary: Spillage on the bar floor and walls next to and between compact refrigerators. Staff instructed to clean to prevent pest activity.

headline: Leaking pipe under sink; expired food handler cards
summary: Steady leak from a pipe under a hand-washing sink in the rear food prep area. Several employees had expired food handler cards. Owner told to repair the leak and complete training with records on site.

headline: Oven lacks mechanical ventilation; allergen training missing
summary: Re-inspection: oven in the front prep area is not under mechanical ventilation; must be provided. No allergen training certificate on premises. All City-certified managers must complete allergen training and keep records on site.

headline: No health policy; no sushi-bar hand sink; no advisory
summary: No employee health policy on site; no citation today. No hand sink at the front sushi bar; one must be added with hot and cold water. Undercooked sushi served without a consumer advisory on the menu. No sushi rice analysis letter or pH test kit.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; flies and house flies found
summary: Black slime on ice machine interior dripping onto ice. Dish machine final rinse at 0 ppm chlorine. About 25 live small flying insects and 3 large house flies found; pest control needed. Moldy caulking and a broken light shield also noted.

headline: Gap between floor and wall in break room
summary: Re-inspection: 1/2-inch gap between floor and wall in break room. Management instructed to seal gaps to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No hand sink in dish area; missing supplies
summary: No exposed hand-washing sink in the bar dishwashing area; one must be installed with hot and cold water. No paper towels at restroom sinks, no sanitizer test kit, no service sink, and no covered waste bin in the women's restroom.

headline: Floors and floor drains need cleaning
summary: Complaint visit: staff instructed to clean and maintain floors and floor drains in the dishwashing area and the seafood and meat prep area.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water at prep sink
summary: No City-certified manager on site while potatoes, steak, milk, shrimp and nacho cheese were prepared. Prep area had no hand sink at first. The prep and dishwashing sink has no hot water; citation issued. Rear door was propped wide open. Leaking plumbing at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Hand dryer above utility sink
summary: Re-inspection: hand-drying device above the rear utility sink must be removed. Hand dryers may only be at handwashing sinks.

headline: Cooks without hair restraints; grease and dirt buildup
summary: Complaint: cooks without proper hair restraints; bulk containers unlabeled. Prep cooler, walk-in freezer and shelving need detail cleaning. Washroom fixtures and floors need cleaning. Dusty vents and ceiling tiles. Grease in hood and filter.

headline: Live plants above pastry cases; spray bottles unlabeled
summary: Live potted plants stored above pastry display cases; staff instructed to remove them. Spray bottles in prep kitchen are not labeled; staff instructed to label them.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; ice machine slime; eggs too warm
summary: Food handler touched French toast with bare hands. Black and pink slime dripping from ice machine onto ice. Eggs and chorizo held above 41°F; discarded. Leaking hand sink and a rear door with a gap at the bottom that is not rodent-proof.

headline: Ice bin interior needs cleaning
summary: Ice bin interior needs cleaning. Staff instructed to remove the ice, clean the bin and keep it clean.

headline: Missing thermometer; low water pressure at hand sinks
summary: Needs a working thermometer in rear 2-door refrigerator. Grab-and-go packaged foods need full labels. Stored items in rear food storage must be raised off the floor. Front hand sink needs more water pressure; slow drain in rear dishwashing area.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no handwashing sign
summary: No bodily-fluid cleanup kit on site for vomit or diarrhea events; manager told to provide one. No handwashing sign at the prep-area hand sink; manager told to post one. No citation issued.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; food over 52°F discarded
summary: Steak, pork, cut tomatoes, cheese and eggs at 52–62°F in the prep cooler; about 20 lbs discarded. Cooler air at 52°F; tagged and must be repaired and re-inspected before use. Dry storage containers lack common-name labels.

headline: Restroom hand sink at 56°F; citation issued
summary: Women's employee and customer restroom hand sink water measured 56°F; minimum is 100°F. Citation issued. Sink was serviced during inspection and now reads 100°F.

headline: No soap at sinks; cold foods up to 53°F discarded
summary: Several hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels; soap was supplied on request. Rice, empanadas, mussels and half-and-half held at 48–53°F; about 25 lbs discarded. Menu lacks undercooked-food advisory. Previous violations not corrected.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; reused containers
summary: Re-inspection: handwashing signs missing; sour cream containers reused to store food; a heavily stained cutting board; dirty door handles; loose faucet handles; debris in bar and prep sinks; wet and standing water on bar floor. Each item ordered fixed.

headline: Low water and hot-rinse temperatures; food discarded
summary: Restroom hand sink water at 83°F; minimum is 100°F. Dish machine final rinse at 162°F; hot-water sanitizing needs 180°F or higher. Potato salad at 46°F and chickpea stew at 49°F discarded, about 10 lbs. Citation issued.

headline: Dish machine too cool; cold foods discarded; repaired
summary: Dish machine final rinse at 150°F; 180°F is required. A technician repaired it on site and it now reads 180°F. Cucumber, tomato, cheese and mayonnaise sauces at 47.8–54.8°F; 15 lbs discarded. Citation issued.

headline: No sanitizer test kit on site; citation issued
summary: No sanitizer test strip kit on site to check dishwashing sanitizer strength. Staff must keep a test kit on site at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled packaged desserts; no covered trash
summary: Packaged desserts in grab-and-go cooler lack ingredient, allergen and business-name labels. Employee restroom lacks a covered trash receptacle. Dirt on floor and along walls throughout rear prep area.

headline: No certified manager with ice cream; no vomit kit
summary: No City-certified manager on site while ice cream was prepared and served; citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit. No food handler training certificate from an employee. No managers with allergen training.

headline: Torn reach-in gasket; greasy fryer and stove
summary: Gasket seal and handle on a reach-in cooler need repair. Grease spillage and splatter on the deep fryer and stove. Trash receptacle lid missing in the basement staff toilet room. Staff instructed to repair and clean.

headline: Hand sink blocked by grease and utensils; citation issued
summary: Kitchen hand sink blocked by a pot of grease, oil containers and utensils; the manager had staff clear it immediately. Citation issued. Dirty wiping cloths, heavy ice buildup in chest freezer, greasy floors, and cluttered bar storage also noted.

headline: Burnt-out light fixture in dishwashing area
summary: Burnt-out light fixture in the lower-level dishwashing area must be repaired.

headline: No towels at prep sink; ice machine slime
summary: No paper towels at prep-area hand sink; citation issued. Thick black slime inside ice machine dripping onto ice; machine must not be used until cleaned. Missing floor tiles, spills in ice cream freezer, and managers lacking allergen certificates.

headline: Items on floor; dusty hood; greasy floors
summary: Re-inspection: items throughout must be raised off the floor; plastic pallets and crates may not be used for elevation. Dust on dish-area hood. Greasy floors under wok line and food spillage under boxes in basement; cleaning ordered.

headline: Crates used for storage; unlabeled containers; allergen training lapsed
summary: Food containers not labeled. Crates used for storage in walk-in cooler and prep area. Worn cutting boards, food debris under and along walls, cracked light shields, and cluttered rear storage. Managers' food allergen training missing or expired.

headline: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer
summary: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer buckets near hand sinks. Ice bin lid has white buildup; not touching ice. Corroded scoop holders on ice cream coolers, food residue on walk-in shelves, and a loose, damaged wall plug in the restroom.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint; items on floor
summary: Food handler prepared food without a hair restraint; all handlers must wear one. Single-service items stored on floor in prep and storage areas must be raised off the floor. Food debris and spills on rear storage floors need cleaning.

headline: Greasy floors, dust and dirty hood filters
summary: Grease, food debris and dirt under cooking equipment, along walls and in corners in prep, dishwashing and storage areas. Dust on the walk-in fan, light shields and vents. Hood and filters need detail cleaning. Staff instructed to clean all.

headline: Rusted shelves; no drainboard; allergen training missing
summary: Rusted, peeling shelves in the front prep refrigerator must be replaced or repainted. No drainboard at the three-compartment sink. Certified food managers on duty lack food allergen training certificates; managers told to obtain them.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink blocked; no soap
summary: No certified food manager on duty while sandwiches, ground beef and cheese sauce were prepared; citation issued. Rear hand sink blocked by bottles and tools; no soap or hand drying at front or rear hand sinks. No food handler training; many cleaning items noted.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; incomplete food handler certificates
summary: Re-inspection: multiple wet wiping cloths left on prep counters; must be stored in sanitizing solution. Food handler certificates incomplete; only one valid of at least five handlers present. Records must be provided for all employees.

headline: Over 200 live cockroaches; ice machine slime
summary: Over 200 live cockroaches across prep, fryer, grill, storage and dish areas; dead roaches under racks. Pest control and cleaning required. Black slime in ice machine dripping onto ice. Multiple sink and dish-area leaks. Milk crates used as shelving. Citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice machine; duct tape and plastic bags in cooler
summary: Ice machine compartments not clean; ice is for human consumption. Duct tape used on butcher display cooler door; plastic grocery bags and milk crates used for storage. No food handler training certificate provided on site.

headline: Hand sinks blocked by dishes; prep sink missing
summary: Front and rear hand sinks blocked by dishes; front sink used as a dump sink and must be kept free for handwashing. Citation issued. Unlabeled bulk containers and pooled water under utility sink. Previous violation not corrected: missing prep sink in front area.

headline: Trash and food debris under service line
summary: Trash and food debris found under the front service line. Staff instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Missing labels, no splash guard, and unrestrained hair
summary: Re-inspection: no thermometer in front serving cooler; missing labels on flour, sugar, salt and sauces; no splash guard at dish-area hand sink; bread stored in plastic grocery bags; employee without hair restraint; broken or missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Dish machine out of order; walk-in light out
summary: Out-of-use high-temperature dish machine cannot function; must be repaired or removed. Walk-in cooler light not working; must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Mop sink lacks backflow device; allergen certificates missing
summary: Re-inspection: the utility mop sink has no backflow prevention device; one must be provided and kept in place. Certified food managers had no food allergen training certificates; managers told to comply.

headline: No handwashing sink in rear dishwashing area
summary: Re-inspection failed: no exposed hand-washing sink in the rear dishwashing area where the three-compartment sink is. Management instructed to install one. Priority violation.

headline: No valid City certificate; 35 live insects found
summary: No valid City sanitation certificate or manager on duty while pizza and salads were prepared; citation issued. About 35 small live insects on racks, walls, boxes and ceiling tiles; pest control required. Food handlers lacked training and hair restraints.

headline: Reach-in cabinet door falling off
summary: Two-door reach-in cabinet has a broken door panel, hinges broken, and the door is falling off. Staff instructed to repair the door and hinges and maintain equipment in good repair.

headline: Cold foods above safe temperature; about 20 lbs discarded
summary: Grape leaves, couscous, hummus, chickpea salad and spinach held at 46.5–55.5°F on the front cold line, above the 41°F limit. All discarded. Black waste water found on basement floor, where single-use items are stored. Citation issued.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer; tagged
summary: Low-temperature dish machine final rinse at 0 ppm chlorine; tagged and not to be used until repaired. Citation issued. Debris inside ice machine. Dirty wiping cloths, frozen foods in plastic grocery bags, and greasy floors, walls and hood filters.

headline: No city-certified food manager; dead insects in dining area
summary: No City-certified food manager on site while milk, a food that must be kept cold, was being served. Dead insects found on the ledge by the dining area windows; cleaning ordered. Citation issued.

headline: Sink leak; debris under sink; allergen training missing
summary: Re-inspection: leak at the wash compartment of the three-compartment sink; debris on floors and drains under it. Manager on site had no allergen training certificate. Certified managers must take the allergen course and keep records on site.

headline: Blank health policy copies; items under stairway
summary: Re-inspection: blank employee health policy copies on site; signed copies needed for all food employees. Items stored on the floor under the stairway; shelving at least 6 inches off the floor is required.

headline: Live rat and about 50 rat droppings found
summary: One live rat in the proofer, another ran under a mixer, and about 50 rat droppings in prep and storage areas. No certified manager during food prep. No written employee health or vomit cleanup policy. Food stored on floor. Pest control needed.

headline: Sanitizer and cold-food problems; some corrected on site
summary: No chlorine sanitizer on site; delivered before inspection ended. Cold foods at 53–54°F discarded; a cooler at 51.4°F tagged. Rice cooled improperly at 77.4°F and discarded. Leaking sink faucet, dirty ceiling vents, and one food handler with expired certificate.

headline: No vomit kit; no hand sink in rear washroom
summary: License re-inspection: no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies on premises. No hand sink in rear washroom with utility sink. Northside door has a gap to frame and must be rodent-proof. Broken floor tiles, ceiling opening and non-working ventilation.

headline: No undercooked-food advisory on menu
summary: Menu lacks a consumer advisory for items that can be ordered raw or undercooked, such as tuna tartare and wagyu smash burger. Food and dirt debris between wall and cooking equipment and under prep-area shelves; cleaning ordered.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure or supplies; no allergen certificate
summary: No written procedure or adequate supplies for vomit and diarrhea cleanup on site. Citation issued. No allergen training certificate on site. Staff instructed to provide both and have allergen training for all City-certified managers.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods too warm; sink issues
summary: No certified food manager on duty during TCS food prep. Chicken, cheese and butter at 67.8–70.4°F; 8 lbs discarded. Dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine, tagged. Hand sink lacked soap; hot water at 128–137°F, told to keep 100–120°F. Citation issued.

headline: Chicken above 41°F; milk crates; repeat violations
summary: Chicken at 50.5°F in rear prep cooler; 10 lbs discarded. Prep cooler at 51.5°F tagged. Milk crates used as shelving; clutter on floors; grease and dirt under equipment. Staff without hair restraints and torn gaskets, unfixed since 2023; citation issued.

headline: Greasy pie oven
summary: Grease buildup on pie oven. Staff instructed to degrease, sanitize and maintain it.

headline: Cutting boards deeply cut and stained
summary: All cutting boards on site have deep cuts and stains. Staff instructed to sand, reseal or replace them so surfaces are smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Cold foods too warm; roaches and rat droppings found
summary: Chicken, shrimp, beef, eggs, noodles, egg rolls and gyros at 45.5–52.1°F; 70 lbs discarded. Service prep cooler at 52.5°F, told not to use. Over 5 live roaches on a prep counter; 20+ rat droppings in an electrical unit and 10 in basement storage. Citation issued.

headline: Expired City certificate; ice machine pink substance
summary: Person in charge lacks a valid City sanitation certificate; posted certificate expired April 2024; citation issued. Pink substance inside ice machine compartments, which are used for ice. Broken backflow device at hot water tank; standing water in tank pan.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; dripping mop sink
summary: Low-temperature dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine; staff told to use the three-compartment sink until it is fixed; priority violation. No handwashing sign at bar hand sink. Water dripping from mop sink faucet; repair needed.

headline: Rodent droppings found in several storage areas
summary: About 75 droppings in rear storage, 75 in the electrical room and 30 in the porter's closet. Also a leaking sink in produce prep, dusty bakery and cooler surfaces, and gaps at doors where pests could enter. Pest control required.

headline: Failed; dish machine temperature corrected on site
summary: Failed. The high-temperature dish machine was at 142°F and was repaired on site to 160°F. Shellstock tags lacked sold-by dates, and the front door base has an opening to seal. Ice machine shields have mold-like residue. Repeat violations were noted.

headline: Passed; cutting boards cannot be cleaned
summary: Passed. Cutting boards in the front prep area have dark grooves that cannot be cleaned. They must be replaced.

headline: Passed; hot holding unit needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Food debris and slight grease are inside the hot holding unit and must be cleaned.

headline: Pass with conditions; shake mix too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Shake mix in the ice cream hopper was at 47°F and must be held at 41°F or below. About 2 gallons, worth $10, were discarded, and a citation was issued. Black substance on caulking at the three-compartment sink must be removed.

headline: Failed; sewage backup in basement prep area
summary: Failed. Black sewage with a foul odor backed up from a floor drain by the basement handsink. Open food preparation in that area must stop until it is repaired, sanitized, and re-inspected. A citation was issued. Other items include missing handwashing signs and a missing ceiling tile.

headline: Pass with conditions; cold foods too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked and raw foods in the walk-in cooler were 45 to 47°F, and about $289 of food was discarded. The walk-in air was 46°F and was tagged, do not use, because frozen condenser pipes could not be repaired. A citation was issued. Other problems were also noted.

headline: Passed; front door gap; unused equipment outside
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom left corner of the front entrance door must be sealed. The washroom door lacks a self-closing device, and unused equipment outside along the east wall must be removed.

headline: Failed; about 25 rodent droppings; hot holding unit too cool
summary: Failed. About 25 rodent droppings were in the main cooking area under a cooler, and a citation was issued. A hot holding unit could not keep food at 135°F. Other issues include unshielded sewer-line storage, no splash guard, standing water, and missing food handler training proof.

headline: Failed; rodent droppings in several areas
summary: Failed. Rodent droppings were found in the basement, food prep area, and behind the two-door refrigerator, roughly 20 in total. A citation was issued and pest control service recommended. Floors are greasy and dirty, and clutter is on the floor.

headline: Passed; greasy hood filters over grill
summary: Passed. Grease and grime were on the filters in the hood over the grill. Management was told to clean them.

headline: Passed; food containers unlabeled; grease buildup
summary: Passed. Sugar and flour containers were unlabeled. A food employee lacked a hair restraint. Soda gun has mineral buildup, and fryer sides have grease. Two burnt-out lights are above the basement prep hood.

headline: Passed; dusty condensers; spills on shelves
summary: Passed. Dust has built up on prep cooler condensers, and food spills are on prep area shelves. The equipment must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Passed; leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Passed. Inspector observed a leak at the three-compartment sink faucet and instructed the owner to repair it.

headline: Failed; no certified manager on site
summary: Failed. No certified food manager with the original certificate was on site, as a priority violation. Hot water was missing at prep sinks but was adjusted on site to comply. No health policy was on site. No covered receptacle was in the all-gender restroom, and no outside dumpster service agreement was shown.

headline: Passed; dish racks on floor; no allergen proof
summary: Passed. A handwashing sign is missing at the basement prep sink. Dish racks were stored on the floor and must be raised. Employees ate in the upstairs food prep area. No allergen training proof was on site for city food managers.

headline: Passed re-inspection; grime and leaking handsink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food debris and grime were on cooking equipment, tables, floors, and walls. A handsink pipe leaked onto the floor. Restrooms lacked a covered sanitary-product receptacle, and hood filters were greasy.

headline: Passed; expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Passed. The fryer exterior has grease that must be cleaned. The hot water faucet knob at the three-compartment sink leaks. An expired food handler certificate and an expired allergen training certificate were found.

headline: Failed; live roaches found, pest control needed
summary: Failed. Two live small roaches were found in the basement and one on a wall by the first-floor dishwasher. A citation was issued, and additional pest control is needed. Bulk containers are unlabeled, and floors, drains, and washroom ventilation need work.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cleaning and signage needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. The washroom lacks handwashing signs. The deli slicer is dirty and must be detail-cleaned and sanitized. Debris is on the floors throughout prep, storage, dishwashing, and the sales floor. Soiled mop heads must be hung up.

headline: Failed; live fruit flies; slime in ice machine; raw fish too warm
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared. Over 25 live fruit flies were in the basement storage. Slime was dripping into ice used for consumption. Raw fish was held at 66.9°F and about $45 was discarded. Hand soap and paper towels were missing. Several repeat violations were noted.

headline: Passed; missing splash guards and ice bin covers
summary: Passed. Seasonings and breadcrumbs were in unlabeled containers. A washable splash guard is needed at the rear hand sink and dry storage, and ice bins need covers. Residue inside the ice machine and a dirty walk-in fan need cleaning.

headline: Pass with conditions; soap and paper towels issues
summary: Pass with conditions. The rear staff washroom lacked soap and paper towels. Soap was provided by the next visit, and a citation was issued. Dry food containers need labels, and the splash guard and sink stoppers need repair. The staff washroom door lacks a closing device.

headline: Passed; dead roach found, food stored on floor
summary: Passed. A dead roach was found in the front service area and in open pipes and must be removed and sanitized. Food boxes and bottles were stored on the floor throughout and must be raised at least six inches.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler or allergen certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food containers need labels, and wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizer. Cutting boards are worn, and shelves, floors, and the restroom need cleaning. No food handler or allergen certificates were on site.

headline: Pass with conditions; paper towels missing in washroom
summary: Pass with conditions. No paper towels were at the employee washroom sink. The food handler supplied one during the inspection, and a citation was issued. The certified food manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rust on freezer shelves
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rust is on three walk-in freezer shelving units and must be removed or the units replaced. No allergen awareness training proof was shown for employees holding city certificates.

headline: Passed; labeling, gaskets, grease, and light repairs
summary: Passed. Squeeze bottles and shakers must be labeled. Crates in the walk-in freezer must be replaced with shelving. Worn gaskets, food and grease buildup, damaged floor tiles, and a burnt-out hood light need attention.

headline: Passed; peeling black substance under hood
summary: Passed. Peeling black substance under the hood ventilation system must be removed. Grease and small debris are on the left wall of the rear prep hot line.

headline: Passed; uncovered scoops and wall opening
summary: Passed. Scoops were stored uncovered on steam tables. A large opening under the three-compartment sink must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Food debris behind cooling units must be removed.

headline: Passed; scoops stored in food; sink lacks backflow device
summary: Passed. Scoops were stored with handles in contact with food in dry storage bins. The basement hand sink is heavily soiled and slow-draining. The utility sink lacks a backflow device, and the walk-in cooler floor has spills and crushed vegetables.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet and drain; floors soiled
summary: Passed. Scoops were stored inside dry storage containers and must be stored between uses. A faucet at the deli three-compartment sink and a drainpipe in the produce prep area are leaking. Floors, walls, and corners have food debris and spills.

headline: Passed; rear door gap; leaking drain
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed. A water leak is under the basement bar handsink. The storage room near the rear door needs cleaning and organizing to avoid pest harborage.

headline: Passed; food on floor; handler lacked hair restraint
summary: Passed. A missing handwashing sign at the rear prep sink must be provided. Food containers were on the floor in rear storage and must be raised six inches. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and boxes and debris are outside the rear exit.

headline: Passed; front door gap; dirty coolers and floors
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap under the front door is not rodent or insect proof and must be fixed. An employee lacked a hair restraint. Coolers, freezers, and floors have food, dirt, and debris. Ceiling tiles with water stains must be replaced.

headline: Passed; rear door not rodent-proof; training proof missing
summary: Passed. The rear kitchen door screen is not tight-fitting or rodent-proof at the bottom and must be replaced. No food handler training proof was shown for required employees. Stored items, floors, and a water-damaged washroom ceiling tile also need attention.

headline: Pass with conditions; cold foods too warm; coolers tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. Several cold foods were above 41°F. The person in charge discarded them, and a citation was issued. Two coolers were too warm, so food was removed and they were tagged. Utensils were left in standing water.

headline: Passed; expired allergen training; cleaning needed
summary: Passed. A large bulk storage container must be labeled. Storage shelving, coolers, freezers, and kitchen fans need cleaning. Walls and floors need detail cleaning. The certified manager's allergen training has expired and must be renewed.

headline: Failed; no certified manager; garbage overflowing
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was present while chicken wings were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. No signed employee health policy was on site. Garbage piled over dumpster lids and onto the ground. A food handler lacked training proof.

headline: Pass with conditions; cold foods too warm; refrigerator tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. Eight cold items were held at 47 to 50°F, and about 25 pounds were discarded. One refrigerator was at 50.8°F and must not be used until re-inspected. Torn gaskets, milk crates used as shelving, and grease and dirt on floors also need attention.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager during food service
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while eggs and sausage were handled and served. An ice scoop was left inside the ice bin. Outside dumpsters were left open with excess trash and food debris.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no training proof for any employee
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food debris and spills were on shelves inside a one-door refrigerator. No food handler training proof was shown for any employee. No allergen training proof was shown for the employee holding a city certificate.

headline: Failed; about 100 rat droppings; mold in ice machine
summary: Failed. About 100 rat droppings were under the basement stairs, under basement shelving, and in the bar corners. A citation was issued. Pink and black mold-like buildup in the ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks, and a citation was issued. A door has a half-inch gap.

headline: Failed; no certified manager; no pest log
summary: Failed. No city certified food service manager was on premises, and a citation was issued. No pest control logbook was on site. An opening at the front entrance door must be sealed. No chlorine test kit was found, and the washroom door lacks a self-closing device.

headline: Pass with conditions; rat droppings outside; allergen certificate missing
summary: Pass with conditions. Pink buildup is inside the coffee bar ice machine and must be cleaned. Retail refrigerated goods are missing label information. Rat droppings and clutter are outside the rear door. The certified food manager lacked allergen training proof, and a citation was issued.

headline: Passed; damaged walk-in cooler floor
summary: Passed. A damaged section of the main walk-in cooler floor needs repair and maintenance.

headline: Failed; no certified manager; no raw food disclosure
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was present while beans at 148°F were prepared or served, and a citation was issued. Menus lacked the required disclosure for raw or undercooked foods. Several food handlers lacked valid food handler certificates.

headline: Passed; missing signs, self-closing door, debris
summary: Passed. Basement handsink lacks handwashing signs. A prep table is rusty. The unisex washroom has no self-closing door device. Floor drains in the basement walk-in and light shields above the basement sink need cleaning.

headline: Failed; overflowing dumpster; repeat violation
summary: Failed. Privately produced honey was for sale and was removed. The quaternary ammonium sanitizer test strips were missing, and a citation was issued. The outdoor dumpster was overflowing with a lid that could not close. A repeat freezer ice buildup violation was not corrected.

headline: Failed; no backflow device; dumpster area dirty
summary: Failed. No backflow prevention device was at the espresso machine water line. Outside dumpster areas had garbage spillage and pileup, and a citation was issued. A food handler lacked a training certificate.

headline: Failed; no hot water; trash overflowing
summary: Failed. No hot water was available, and sink water ran at 45 to 50°F. A priority citation was issued. Trash overflowed at the outside dumpster, and a citation was also issued for the missing trash-can lid.

headline: Pass with conditions; cold foods too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. Eggs, ham, and beef were held at 45 to 48°F, and 5 pounds were discarded. A citation was issued. A prep cooler at 51.9°F was tagged. Food was stored on a stairway, and milk crates are used as shelving.

headline: Passed; dead rodent found in trap
summary: Passed. A dead rodent caught in a trap was found in the basement corner and was removed by the manager before the inspection ended. Ice and buckets were stored on a walk-in freezer floor. Cooler gaskets are heavily soiled.

headline: Passed re-inspection; gaps and missing grout
summary: Passed re-inspection. Openings at the base of the rear exit door and garage door must be sealed. Rust is on the outside walk-in cooler shelving. Missing grout between basement dishwashing floor tiles must be replaced.

headline: Failed; no certified food manager; dish machine problems
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while chicken, hamburgers, and chili were prepared. A citation was issued. The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing and was tagged and held. A leak pools water on the rear prep floor.

headline: Passed; dirt behind bread unit; allergen certificates missing
summary: Passed. Dirt and debris were behind the bread storage unit and must be cleaned. No allergen training certificates were on site for the two listed city food service managers.

headline: Passed; paper towel dispenser battery
summary: Passed. The battery in the paper towel dispenser next to the exposed handsink needs to be changed.

headline: Passed; door gaps, worn gaskets, grease
summary: Passed. Weather stripping at the rear exit door has gaps and must be repaired. Three reach-in units have torn or worn gaskets. Grease and debris are on equipment and shelving, and floors and walls need detail cleaning. Allergen training was missing for two managers.

headline: Pass with conditions; unsanitized wash bowl
summary: Pass with conditions. An employee wash-and-rinse bowl was used without sanitizing, and a citation was issued. The manager set up a sanitizer compartment. Walk-in shelving is rusted, and fryers and floors around the griddle need cleaning.

headline: Passed; food manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. A food service manager lacked an allergen training certificate. The inspector instructed the owner to meet this requirement.

headline: Failed; rodent droppings, dead mouse, dead roaches
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was present while eggs and pork were prepared. The rear prep hot water was broken, and the hand sink lacked soap. About 5 mouse droppings, a dead mouse, and about 10 dead cockroaches were in basement storage. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. The floor along the wall base, in corners, and under heavy equipment is not clean and has debris buildup. It must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Failed; about 130 rodent droppings; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Failed. About 120 small rodent droppings were in the rear storage area and about 11 in the front dining area. A citation was issued and pest control is required. The low-temperature dish machine was at 0 ppm and was tagged and held. A garbage lid is missing.

headline: Pass with conditions; cold foods too warm; cooler failed
summary: Pass with conditions. Several time/temperature-controlled foods were held at 46 to 50°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager discarded about $70 of food. The deli top cooler was at 57°F and was tagged. A citation was issued.

headline: Failed; no certified manager; water too cool
summary: Failed. No certified food service manager was on the premises, and a citation was issued. Handwashing sink water measured 72°F and 90°F, but 100°F is required. Several faucets run too briefly. No pest control logbook was provided, and no proof of food handler or allergen training was shown.

headline: Passed; foil lining and basement wall hole
summary: Passed. Aluminum foil lines nonfood surfaces of basement cooking equipment and must be removed. The floor under and behind the oven is greasy, and a hole in the basement dry storage wall must be repaired.

headline: Pass with conditions; cold foods too warm; dead roach
summary: Pass with conditions. Tofu, cream cheese, eggs, and noodles were held at 49 to 54°F in the refrigerator, and about 100 pounds were discarded. The refrigerator's air was 57°F, and a citation was issued. A dead cockroach next to the refrigerator must be removed. Grease spills need cleaning.

headline: Passed; leaking sink faucet and poor toilet ventilation
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink faucet is leaking and wrapped in plastic. Ventilation in the toilet room is in poor repair. Both must be repaired.

headline: Failed; cold foods too warm; date marking missing
summary: Failed. Beef, chicken, and butter were held above 41°F, and about 11 pounds were discarded. Ready-to-eat foods in the refrigerator were not date-marked. The three-compartment sink leaks when drained, and a citation was issued. Food is stored in plastic grocery bags.

headline: Passed re-inspection; broken temperature display
summary: Passed re-inspection. The walk-in cooler's external temperature display is not working. The internal thermometer read under 41°F. Missing and damaged floor and ceiling tiles must be repaired.

headline: Passed; damaged cooler gasket; restroom door
summary: Passed. A cooler door gasket is damaged and must be replaced. The restroom next to the kitchen lacks a self-closing door device and must be repaired.

headline: Failed; dumpster overflowing; no training proof
summary: Failed. Utensils were left exposed on a hot holding unit, and single-use items were improperly stored. Food was in a plastic grocery bag in a cold unit. The dumpster lids would not close because of overflowing trash. No food handler training proof was shown.

headline: Passed; cooler lacks thermometer; restrooms need covered bins
summary: Passed. The customer-accessible drink and milk cooler has no thermometer. Both unisex restrooms lack covered trash receptacles. Mops are stored in a sink, and employee bags and clothes are stored with food.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rusty storage racks
summary: Passed re-inspection. Wire storage racks inside the walk-in cooler have chipped paint and rust. They must be cleaned and repainted or replaced.

headline: Passed re-inspection; light shields and training proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. Several light fixtures in rear storage are missing shields. No valid food handler certificates were posted on site, and the manager was instructed to provide them for all food handlers.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet needs repair
summary: Passed. Inspector saw a leak at the faucet left of the three-compartment sink and instructed the owner to repair and maintain it.

headline: Failed; about 70 mouse droppings; allergen certificates missing
summary: Failed. About 30 mouse droppings were on dry food shelving, and 40 to 50 were behind bulk containers. A citation was issued and pest control is needed. Plastic buckets are used for food storage, and food handler and allergen certificates are missing. A repeat violation was not corrected.

headline: Failed; over 200 mouse droppings throughout
summary: Failed. Over 200 mouse droppings were found in storage, the selling floor, cooking area, butcher area, boiler room, washroom, and dry walk-in storage. A dead mouse on a glue board was removed on site. Pest control is required before re-inspection, and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed; about 100 mouse droppings; cold foods too warm
summary: Failed. About 100 mouse droppings were found in dry storage and the food prep area, and a citation was issued. Eggs, pork, beef, and other cold foods were held above 41°F, and the prep cooler was at 48°F. A bare-hand food contact violation and missing food handler certificates were also noted.

headline: Passed; bulk food unlabeled, floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Bulk food in basement prep and dry storage was not labeled with its name. Floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Passed; deep grooves on cutting board
summary: Passed. A large cutting board in the rear kitchen has deep grooves and stains and must be repaired or replaced. The DJ booth floor needs a detail cleaning.

headline: Pass with conditions; health policy and cleanup plan missing
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy was on site, and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure with a spill kit was found. A sanitation manager lacked allergen training proof. The owner must provide all three items.

headline: Failed; mouse droppings and flies found
summary: Failed. Over 30 mouse droppings were found in a storage closet and under a prep table. Several fruit flies and house flies were in the dishwashing area. A citation was issued for pest activity.

headline: Passed re-inspection; several upkeep items
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food storage containers must be labeled. A gap at the front door must be repaired, and crates must be replaced with shelving. Worn gaskets on a prep cooler and allergen training for food managers are required.

headline: Passed; torn cooler gasket; floor drain caulk
summary: Passed. A cooler gasket under the grill is torn and must be repaired. Flooring around the floor drain near the three-compartment sink needs re-caulking.

headline: Passed re-inspection; small flies minimized
summary: Passed re-inspection. The violation was corrected, and small fly activity was minimized.

headline: Passed; walk-in cooler floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Floors along the wall base and in the corners inside the walk-in cooler must be cleaned to remove spills and debris.

headline: Passed; thermometer added; mops stored wet
summary: Passed. The three-door glass cooler had no thermometer, and one was placed by the end of the inspection. Floors behind the rotisserie are heavily soiled. Mops were stored submerged in buckets and must be hung to dry.

headline: Passed; cardboard liners and missing allergen training
summary: Passed. Cardboard is used as a liner on the grease trap and cook area floors and must be removed. Walls and floors need cleaning, and clutter is in dry storage. No allergen training certificate was on site for the city food manager.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager; door gap
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was on duty while chicken and beef were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front side door must be repaired to prevent pest entry.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager; greasy oven
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager or original certificate was on site, and no certified employee was present while eggs and sausage were handled. Wiping cloths for equipment were stored in plain water. A turbo oven is encrusted with grease, and floors and drains are soiled.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rice bin near handsink
summary: Passed re-inspection. A rice storage bin and cutting board are next to the dish room handsink without a splash guard. They must be moved or a splash guard installed.

headline: Failed; hot water missing; food cooled too slowly
summary: Failed. Several handwashing sinks had inadequate hot water, below 100°F, and a citation was issued. About 29 pounds of cooked chicken cooled improperly and was discarded. Corned beef was too warm and was discarded. Menus lacked required consumer advisories, and a sink leaks.

headline: Failed; over 100 rodent droppings throughout
summary: Failed. Over 100 rodent droppings were on shelves, carts, prep tables, and floors in prep, storage, furnace, and dishwashing areas. A citation was issued, and an exterminator was required. Grease, food debris, dirt, rusty racks, and an expired food handler certificate were also noted.

headline: Failed; no handsink in kitchen prep area
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink was in the kitchen prep area. A priority violation was cited, and a handsink must be provided.

headline: Failed re-inspection; still no hot water at restroom sinks
summary: Failed re-inspection. Still no signed employee health policies were shown, as a priority violation. Customer restroom handsinks still lack hot and cold running water. A gap around the revolving kitchen door must be repaired.

headline: Failed; no hand soap; expired foods past use-by date
summary: Failed. The exposed handsink behind the front counter had no hand soap, and a citation was issued. Several refrigerated foods were past the seven-day use-by date and had to be used or discarded. Test strips were missing, and the women's washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Failed; repeat violations; greasy fryers; clogged mop sink
summary: Failed. Scoops were stored inside ingredient containers. Prep cooler gaskets are damaged, and fryers and coolers have thick grease and food buildup. The mop sink is clogged. Repeat violations include the faucet not reaching all compartments and rusted shelving. An employee lacked food handler proof.

headline: Passed re-inspection; floors need cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. A dusty grayish-black buildup is on the floors between cooking equipment and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed; no health policy; no test strips; no fan
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. No test strips were available for the three-compartment sink sanitizer. The rear washroom fan does not work. Several food handlers lack training certificates.

headline: Passed re-inspection; gaps allow rodent entry
summary: Passed re-inspection. Gaps at the bottom of the rear screen door and front door must be sealed. Gaskets and shelving need repair, and a large bin does not fit in the sink. Walls, floors, and damaged windows need repair.

headline: Passed; missing thermometer, broken stall lock
summary: Passed re-inspection. Required: a prep cooler thermometer; repairs to a broken men's stall lock, loose soap dispenser, leaking mop-closet sink, and a men's washbowl sink whose hot water reached only 56.1°F; replace a burnt-out hood bulb.

headline: Live mouse and about 200 droppings found
summary: A live mouse and about 200 mouse droppings found throughout, including in the walk-in cooler and meat/seafood prep areas. Three-compartment sink (70°F) and hand sinks lacked hot water; a sink pipe leaks. Toilet rooms measured 46.5°F.

headline: No certified manager; flies found; sanitizer at zero
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) on duty while TCS food (kept hot or cold) was handled; manager arrived at 11:23 a.m. 30 or more live small flies found in prep, dining and dish areas. Sanitizer read 0.0 ppm on utensils.

headline: Cold-held meats too warm; 14 lb discarded
summary: Cold-held food was above 41°F: hamburgers 52.2°F, chicken 53.4°F, hot dogs 49.9°F. Manager discarded 14 lb ($100). A cold-holding unit at 50.1°F was tagged for repair or replacement. Also: unlabeled containers and no covered sanitary waste receptacle.

headline: Passed; openings to seal and clutter to clear
summary: Passed. Required: seal openings around the air duct and large openings beside the basement stairs, clean the walk-in floor and dust under the grill, add a trash can lid in the customer restroom, and clear basement clutter.

headline: Passed; personal items stored in business cooler
summary: Passed. Personal items were stored in a business cooler; a fly strip was in the prep area; a food handler had no hair restraint; the three-compartment sink faucet leaked; and the certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: About 75 rodent droppings; handwashing lapse found
summary: About 75 rodent droppings across several areas, plus a dead mouse on a glue board. A food handler prepared food without washing hands between tasks. Missing soap and towels were supplied on site. No employee health policy was on site.

headline: Passed; food on floor; one handler uncertified
summary: Passed. Food was on the floor in the rear prep area and the storage room was cluttered. One food handler lacked a food handler training certificate; the person in charge was told to comply with state health rules.

headline: Passed; microwave debris and blown hood bulb
summary: Passed. Required: clean food debris from inside the microwave, and replace a blown bulb in the hood system.

headline: Passed; unlabeled food storage containers
summary: Passed. Food storage containers lacked labels with common food names; inspector instructed the operator to provide them.

headline: Passed; handwashing signs and labels needed
summary: Passed. Required: handwashing signs at both wash bowl sinks, labels on food containers in coolers, walk-in and dry storage, and detail cleaning behind cooking and heavy equipment.

headline: No handwashing sink in tea and ice prep area
summary: No handwashing sink in the rear prep area where the ice machine and tea prep will be. Splashguards needed at a hand sink and the three-compartment sink; no sanitizer test strips on site.

headline: Passed; torn gasket and loose faucet noted
summary: Passed. Required: replace a torn door gasket on the four-door prep cooler, repair a loose faucet base at the three-compartment sink in the prep area, and replace burnt-out bulbs in rear prep and side storage areas.

headline: Dumpster area not clean; garbage spilled
summary: Outside dumpster areas were not clean, with garbage spillage and old equipment. Priority citation issued; operator must clean and maintain the area.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; ice machine on hold
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings found behind the meat counter, under sinks, in dry storage and at the front display. Ice machine has black mold-like substance; management told not to use it until detail-cleaned. No employee health policy was on site.

headline: About 50 live fruit flies at guacamole station
summary: About 50 live fruit flies were found at the guacamole prep station. A dust pan blocked a handwashing sink, and a drain hose ran into a guacamole-station hand sink. Long hair was not contained, and bulk containers were unlabeled.

headline: Raw eggs, beef, chicken too warm; discarded
summary: Raw eggs (68–70°F), beef (68°F) and chicken (69.4°F) were too warm; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Manager discarded them. No HACCP food-safety plan for about 20 lb vacuum-packed cooked pork; that food was tagged and held.

headline: Passed; ice maker debris and missing allergen proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. Required: remove debris inside the ice maker and have it serviced, replace stained cutting boards, and show proof of allergen training for the certified food manager.

headline: Passed; ice machine and hood filters need cleaning
summary: Passed. Required: clean the upper inside of the ice machine, clean grease and food build-up from hood filters, replace a cracked prep-area ceiling light cover, and renew expired food allergen training certificates.

headline: Over 500 rat droppings; black slime in ice
summary: Over 500 rat droppings found throughout kitchen prep, dish and dining areas; pest elimination and cleaning required. Black slime was dripping onto ice from the ice machine; a sanitizer test kit was missing and food handler training certificates were incomplete.

headline: Cooked rice held at 81°F; discarded
summary: Cooked rice in a container measured 81°F; hot food must be held at 135°F or above. About 5 lb (valued at $20) was discarded voluntarily. Sushi lacked a raw-food disclosure statement, and no allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: No employee health policy or pest logbook
summary: No written employee health policy and no pest control logbook were on the premises. No metal stem food thermometer was available, and a cold-water handle at the three-compartment sink leaked.

headline: Passed; toilet room needs mechanical ventilation
summary: Passed. The toilet room is not vented; inspector instructed installation of mechanical ventilation.

headline: Over 60 mouse droppings and live roaches found
summary: Over 60 mouse droppings were scattered under dry storage shelves and near unused equipment, with live roach activity and numerous flying insects in prep and storage areas. Management was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No one with a City food sanitation certificate was on site while food that must be kept hot or cold was cooked, prepped, served or held. Drain in bakery closet was full of water; broken floor tiles let wastewater collect.

headline: Passed; fryer grease and allergen training gaps
summary: Passed. Heavy grease was inside the cooking fryers and must be cleaned. Some certified food managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: No health policy or vomit-cleanup kit on site
summary: No verifiable employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea clean-up kit or procedure on site. Menu lacked raw or undercooked food warnings, the metal food thermometer was broken, and no allergen training was on site.

headline: Passed; missing signage and leaking backflow devices
summary: Passed. Required: add handwashing signage at deli preparation-area sinks, and repair leaking backflow prevention devices in the deli and bakery areas.

headline: Passed; missing backflow device and sealing needed
summary: Passed. Required: install a backflow device on the utility sink, seal openings around pipes at the ceiling, clean floor corners and behind equipment, and train all food handlers as required.

headline: Passed; water valve leak fixed on site
summary: Passed. Leaking water valve behind the large cooking kettles was repaired on site. Also required: cleaning fryer and grill exteriors and bottoms, cleaning floor by stove and fryers, and venting a stove near the proofers.

headline: Passed; fryers, grill and carts need cleaning
summary: Passed. Required: clean fryers and grill needing cleaning, exterior of bulk storage containers and rolling carts, floors under and around kitchen equipment, floor drains at the three- and two-compartment sinks, and walls around sinks.

headline: No certified food manager on site during food service
summary: No City-certified food manager with a valid original certificate was on site while cheeseburgers, deli sandwiches and milk were being prepared and served. Also found loose wall base held up with pin tacks, and floors needing cleaning.

headline: No certified manager while steak and rice handled
summary: The person in charge lacked a City certified manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while steak, rice and beans were handled. Handwashing sinks lacked hand-drying supplies; paper towels were provided by inspection's end. Dry containers unlabeled.

headline: No certified manager on site; no health policy
summary: No certified food manager was on site with the original certificate, and no employee health policy was on site. Handwashing sinks in prep and dish areas lacked hand-drying supplies. No pest control logbook was on site; no probe thermometer.

headline: Pest entry openings; prior violation uncorrected
