summary: Openings at base of dumpster-area double doors could let pests in. A previous priority violation was not corrected. Prepackaged foods lack required labels, and food and drink containers are stored on the floor throughout.

headline: No valid certified manager during food prep
summary: No valid City certified manager was on duty while deli meats, tuna and chicken were handled and served. Also: three-compartment sink stoppers don't hold water, a leaking rear hand sink, water under the rear ice machine, and dirty floors.

headline: Passed; food on floor and no allergen training
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the floor throughout, utensils were stored inside a food container, and cutting boards had open seams and stains. A certified food manager lacked allergen training; backyard clutter must be cleared.

headline: Re-inspection passed; several cleaning and repair items
summary: Passed re-inspection. Required fixes include a splash guard between the vegetable-wash and dish sinks, inverting dish utensils, cleaning grease from coolers, fixing a urinal, and cleaning floors and hood filters.

headline: Passed; freezer and floor cleaning required
summary: Passed. Required: clean reach-in freezer interior of spills and debris, and clean floors along walls, behind the freezer, under the three-compartment sink, around the grease trap and inside the walk-in freezer.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager
summary: No person in charge was on site, and no certified food manager was on site while chicken and deli meat were prepared and served. Both metal food thermometers were not turning on. Battery replacement instructed.

headline: Passed; floor drain and oven vent need cleaning
summary: Passed. The floor drain under the three-compartment sink needs cleaning, and dust inside the vent above the oven must be removed.

headline: Passed; thermometers and sink seals needed
summary: Passed. Required: air thermometers in cold-holding units along main kitchen line; labels on bulk dry containers; relocate open food away from a handwashing sink; reseal sinks to walls; store mops so heads don't touch walls.

headline: Passed; food on basement floor; grease spill outside
summary: Passed. Food stored on basement and prep floors must be raised six inches; sink stoppers are missing; grease spilled outside near the grease container drew a citation. Also: exposed breaking brick walls and food debris throughout.

headline: Passed; door gap and debris under equipment
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear delivery door needs repair, and debris on the counter under equipment at the Starbucks area must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; front door gap and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. A gap at the bottom of the front door must be closed to prevent pest entry. Also: clean the ice machine's interior top, clean debris from the reach-in freezer, and clean floors around cooking equipment.

headline: Passed; bulk containers need food-name labels
summary: Passed. Required: label all food storage containers with common food names (such as sugar, flour, cornmeal) in the prep area under the prep sink.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, dirty coolers
summary: Passed. Required: label two bulk storage containers, clean inside all coolers and freezers of spills or debris, clean floors around fryers and under the three-compartment sink, and repair lights under the hood.

headline: Passed; backflow device and several repairs needed
summary: Passed. Required: a backflow device on the coffee and hot water machine, a women's restroom hand sink repair, a new lid for a cracked bulk container, ice machine panel cleaning, and grouting the dish area floor.

headline: Passed; apron on raw meat board; leaks
summary: Passed. An apron was stored on a cutting board with raw meat in the rear prep area. Minor leaks below the rear hand sink and at the three-compartment sink faucet base must be repaired.

headline: About 25 flies; no certified manager on site
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS food (kept hot or cold) with no certified food manager on site. About 25 small black flies were seen throughout the bar. Sinks leak; water is dripping onto attic paper products. Prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Passed; grease, vents, and rusted walk-in floor
summary: Passed. Required: clean fryer interiors and exteriors and wheels, clean refrigeration interiors, replace a missing toilet bowl cover and water-stained ceiling tiles, clean vents, and paint or replace the rusted walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Passed; uncovered trash in restrooms
summary: Passed. Unisex restrooms had no covered trash receptacles; inspector instructed the operator to provide them.

headline: No certified manager; no handler certificates on site
summary: No City-certified food manager on site while chicken was being prepped. No health policies, no food handler certificates, and no allergen training on site. Wastewater spills from a floor drain when the three-compartment sink drains. Restroom sink lacks paper towels.

headline: Food debris on floor in rear dry storage
summary: Passed. Inspector found excessive food debris built up on the floor in the rear dry storage area and instructed the person in charge to detail clean and maintain it.

headline: Passed; worn door strips and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Both front entry door weather strips are worn and need replacing to help keep pests out. Also: detail-clean freezer floor, dishwasher sides and underside, rear prep floor, and hood filters greasy from deep fryers.

headline: Food items stored in mechanical room
summary: Passed. Bottled water and to-go containers were stored in the mechanical room alongside tools; inspector required removal of all food and food-related items from that room.

headline: Re-inspection passed; door gap and leaks noted
summary: Passed re-inspection. Gap under main kitchen exterior door needs sealing to block pest access; handwashing sign missing; leaking prep sink drain and faulty sink drain plug; no backflow devices on ice machine and coffee machine; basement cooler light shield missing.

headline: About 10 rat droppings found in storage closet
summary: About 10 rat droppings were found on the floor of the rear cluttered storage closet; additional pest control service is needed. Also: debris inside the ice maker, rusted walk-in racks, grease on cooking equipment, and clutter.

headline: No certified food manager while chicken served
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while chicken was being served. A certified food manager must be on site whenever TCS food (must be kept hot or cold) is prepared and served. Citation issued.

headline: Passed; thermometers, labels, and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Required: thermometers in all refrigeration units; labels on bulk sugar; remove scoop resting in sugar; replace stained cutting boards; clear floor clutter; clean floors and wall bases.

headline: Missing signs, dirty ice machine, prior violations
summary: Handwashing signs missing at two sinks; ice machine exterior and upper parts need cleaning; ice scoops stored in ice bin; excess ice in basement walk-in freezer. Missing ceiling tiles. Previous violations, including dishwasher dirt, were not corrected.

headline: No certified manager on duty while food prepared
summary: No person in charge had a valid certificate, and no certified food manager was on duty while chicken, steaks and clams were prepared and served. Broken women's restroom hand sink sensor; wiping cloths left on prep surfaces; no allergen training.

headline: Passed; allergen training still needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. No certified food manager with allergen training was found. Person holding the City food sanitation certificate must complete training and provide documentation.

headline: Missing manager certificate; provided before inspection ended
summary: No valid City food sanitation manager certificate was posted during the inspection. The owner produced an original, valid certificate by the end of the inspection.

headline: Passed; food stored on floor
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the floor in the basement walk-in cooler and basement storage area; inspector instructed the manager to elevate them at least six inches on raised shelving.

headline: Passed; leak repair and handler certificates needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. Required: repair water leak under the far-right compartment of the three-compartment sink, and several food handlers must show proof of food handler training.

headline: Passed; fire-damaged ceiling needs repair
summary: Passed. Ceiling damaged in a fire must be repaired and made smooth and easily cleanable. Walls under the service counter need debris removed.

headline: Live flies and roaches found; undated cooked food
summary: About 30 live black flies flew through pizza prep, storage and beverage dispensers, and about 5 live roaches crawled in pizza prep. Cooked ribs, pasta, sausage, lasagna and cheese lacked discard dates and were voluntarily discarded.

headline: Passed; missing thermometer and torn gasket
summary: Passed. The rear storage refrigerator lacked a thermometer, and a torn door gasket on the right door of the two-door prep cooler needs replacing.

headline: Passed; stove, fryer and floor cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Required: clean build-up on the stove and fryer exteriors and inside bottom of the fryer, and clean the floor under and behind the cooking equipment.

headline: Passed; fryer exterior and vent cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Required: clean fryer exteriors to remove grease, and clean hood vents over cooking equipment that need cleaning.

headline: Live flies found throughout food areas
summary: Evidence of 25 or more live small flies on upper walls, ceilings and boxes in the garage, dish, prep, and dry storage areas; pest control service recommended. Garage and man door gaps need sealing; a garbage can lid is missing.

headline: About 80 rodent droppings and a dead cockroach
summary: About 45 rat and 35 mouse droppings were found in basement, bar, dining, and food prep areas, plus a dead cockroach on a basement prep table shelf. Wall gaps where rodents could enter must be sealed. Pest control is needed.

headline: Passed; several cleaning and repair items
summary: Passed. Required: handwashing signs, sealing openings at the base of the garage-style patio door, replacing damaged cooler gaskets, and cleaning fryer wheels and a floor drain. Also: covered sanitary receptacle, allergen training proof, and cleaner hood filters.

headline: No garbage service or outside receptacles
summary: No outside waste receptacles and no waste contract with a garbage provider; this is a priority violation. Gaps of 1/4 inch at the front doors and 2 inches at the rear alley doors need tight seals. Floor drain covers missing.

headline: Passed; signage, service sink, and door fixes needed
summary: Passed. Required fixes: handwashing signs at both washroom sinks, food raised six inches off dry storage floor, a service sink installed, and self-closing doors on both all-gender washrooms.

headline: Passed; torn cooler gaskets and mop sink hose
summary: Passed re-inspection. Required: replace torn door gaskets on the cook-line cooler, and install a backflow prevention device on the utility mop sink, where a hose is attached.

headline: No certified food manager during chicken prep
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) was on site while chicken was prepared and served. Repeat violations: expired allergen training, and a food handler lacked a training certificate. Also food debris in prep and walk-in areas, plus several repairs.

headline: No hot water at bar handwashing sink
summary: The hot water valve at an exposed handwashing sink is stripped, so no hot water is available; a priority citation was issued. Also: unsealed wood under the bar sink and a leaking, loose faucet.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates were on site; manager instructed to obtain them. Also: label large bulk food items, store wiping cloths in sanitizing solution, and clean prep tables and reach-in cooler interiors.

headline: No valid certified manager while chicken prepared
summary: No valid City certified food service manager was on duty while TCS food (kept hot or cold), such as chicken, was prepared and served. A front door gap of 1/4 inch and a grease trap odor were also found.

headline: Cooked ribs held too cool; about 30 lb discarded
summary: Cooked rib tips in a barbecue pit held at 100.2–122.3°F; hot-held food must stay at 135°F or above. About 30 lb (valued at $500) was discarded. Also noted: rust, damaged walls, and dust and debris on vents and hood filters.

headline: Passed; labeling, thermometers, and rotting wood
summary: Passed. Required: replace stained handwashing signs, add cooler thermometers, label containers, remove foil liners and grocery bags, and repair rotting wood behind the three-compartment sink. Some handlers had expired food handler certificates. Two managers had expired allergen training.

headline: Passed; signage and storage fixes needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. Required: handwashing signs at all sinks, inverting serving plates to prevent dust, and storing food in approved food-grade containers instead of grocery bags.

headline: Live cockroaches found; past-date food discarded
summary: About 10 live cockroaches found throughout premises, plus dead cockroaches. Pesticide improperly and heavily applied behind sinks and equipment. About 50 lb of past-date refrigerated food discarded. Food was still prepared after the license was suspended in January 2025.

headline: Food date marking missing; no food handler training
summary: Cooked rice, beans and chicken lacked date marks. Food stored on basement cooler floor. Three-compartment sink backs up and leaks. No food handler training on site; no allergen training for certified food managers.

headline: Passed; sugar unlabeled, sink stopper missing
summary: Passed. Bulk sugar container lacked a label; the three-compartment sink was missing a stopper (needs at least two working stoppers). No allergen training certificate was on site for an enrolled manager.

headline: Passed; wall holes and missing light covers
summary: Passed. Holes in the wall behind the three-compartment sink must be sealed, and missing ceiling light covers above both prep areas must be provided.

headline: Prior leaking drain pipe not repaired; several fixes
summary: A drain pipe leaking under the three-compartment sink, cited during a March 2024 inspection, was still not repaired. Also: no thermometers in prep coolers, unlabeled bulk containers, coffee spoons left in still water, and torn cooler gaskets.

headline: Beverage-area handwashing sink not working
summary: Beverage-area handwashing sink not working (faucet sensor broken), so staff could not use it. Also found: gap at dining room door base, no backflow device on ice machine, overflowing recycling dumpsters, damaged freezer light shield.

headline: No certified food manager; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS food (kept hot or cold), like eggs and milk, was handled and served. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit or procedure. Coolers lacked thermometers; a bulk powder container was unlabeled.

headline: Passed; dead flies and insects found on shelf
summary: Passed. Five dead flies and five other dead insects were on a shelf beside and on the microwave behind the butcher display cooler. Also required: removing stove grease, clearing clutter, and drying mops properly.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit or procedure
summary: No bodily fluid spill kit or written vomit and diarrhea clean-up procedure on site. Food containers stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas; single-use articles stored on basement floor. Ice chute dirty; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No hot water found; restored before report finished
summary: Hot water was missing throughout the building and hand and dish sink temperatures were too low; hot water was restored while the report was written. Also: chicken thawing in a box and food stored on walk-in floors.

headline: Passed; rear door needs rodent-proof strip
summary: Passed. A rodent-proof strip must be installed on the bottom of the rear door to prevent a pest entry point.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings found; no raw-food advisory
summary: About 100 mouse droppings were found in front and rear prep areas and basement storage, including inside the deep fryer and on the steam table shelf. Menu lacked a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods such as over-easy eggs.

headline: Passed; sanitation and repair items noted
summary: Passed re-inspection. Required: splashguard between bar hand sink and dump sink, inverting multi-use utensils, repairing the male employee toilet, cleaning black buildup near the warewashing unit, and replacing missing light shields.

headline: Person in charge lacks valid certified manager certificate
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid certified food manager's certificate; none was posted while sauces and pasta were prepared and served. Also: food on shed floor, door gaps, grease and mold. Table-top fryer must go under the hood.

headline: No certified person in charge; expired handler certificates
summary: The person in charge lacks a City food sanitation certificate, and no employee health policies were on site. Several handwashing sinks lacked soap, and food handler certificates were expired. Pest control logbook was not updated; last entry April 29, 2023.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs and dusty vents
summary: Passed. Required: add handwashing signs at exposed sinks in bars and toilet rooms, clean an unused slicer in the basement covered in debris, and clean dust from the ceiling and vents above the dishwashing area.

headline: No certified manager; dead insects and grime found
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. Equipment, containers, and shelves had flour, grease, dead insects, and dirt buildup needing cleaning. Food handlers lacked hair restraints and a hood bulb was out.

headline: Cleaning and lighting issues in cooking areas
summary: Cutting boards, cooking equipment, walls, floors, and hood filters need detail cleaning. Empty reach-in coolers are in poor repair and must be repaired or removed. The prep side needs additional lighting.

headline: No certified manager; over 130 mouse droppings
summary: More than 130 mouse droppings were found in several areas; droppings must be removed and pest control was recommended. No certified food manager, employee health policy, or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. Previous violations were not corrected.

headline: Hair restraints missing; restroom door not self-closing
summary: A food handler in the prep area was not wearing a hair restraint. The washroom door was not self-closing; a self-closing device must be installed.

headline: Leaking drainpipes and faucet at sinks
summary: Drainpipes were leaking under the one-compartment prep sink and the three-compartment dish-area sink. The faucet at the one-compartment sink was also loose and leaking. Repairs were ordered.

headline: Rust on prep table; restroom repairs needed
summary: Inspector found rust on a prep table in the dishwashing area and asked for removal. Restroom lacked a covered trash container, had peeling ceiling and wall paint, and a broken floor tile. Repairs were ordered.

headline: No certified manager during chicken prep
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was being prepared; a citation was issued. Also: a torn seafood walk-in freezer gasket, a loose handwashing sink faucet, and no public inspection summary posted.

headline: Mold-like substance dripping into ice
summary: Mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine and dripped onto ice for human consumption. The ice must be discarded, and the machine cleaned and sanitized; a citation was issued.

headline: Soap missing; ice machine slime; sanitizer failed
summary: Soap and paper towels were missing at several sinks; a citation was issued. Thick black slime in the ice machine dripped onto ice and was cleaned at once. Dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm and was not to be used.

headline: Staff drinking at prep; food stored on floor
summary: Employees were drinking and eating at kitchen prep areas; management must provide a designated area. Food containers were on floors in prep, storage, and walk-in areas and must be raised six inches. Unlabeled food was found in refrigerators.

headline: Food handler lacked certificate; cleaning items noted
summary: A food handler without a food handler certificate was found; management was told all handlers must show proof. Re-inspection also noted cleaning needs for prep equipment, a drain leak under the 3-compartment sink, and grease on the hood.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager was present while food was prepared and served; citation issued. No verifiable employee health policy was on site. Upkeep items: fix a sink stopper and seal a basement wall corner.

headline: Dead insects on floors; 1/4-inch door gap
summary: Dead insects and debris were on floors in prep, sales, storage, and basement areas, and must be cleaned. A 1/4-inch gap between front doors must be sealed. Food stored on the walk-in floor must be raised six inches.

headline: Missing restroom handwashing sign; labels left on
summary: The employee restroom had no handwashing sign, which must be posted. Food labels were left on containers during washing and must be removed.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan or kit
summary: No written procedure or supplies existed for vomit or diarrhea cleanup; a kit with norovirus-effective spray was required. Previous core (higher-priority) violations were not corrected, including dusty display-cooler vents and floors. No inspection summary was posted.

headline: Expired food discarded; health policy incomplete
summary: Ready-to-eat foods were past expiration in the prep cooler. Lasagna stored longer than 7 days was discarded (about 15 lbs, $300). A priority citation was issued for an incomplete employee health policy and for a food handler lacking a certificate.

headline: No employee health policy or allergen certificates
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; priority violation noted. Soap and paper towels were stored above a sink and must be moved. No allergen training certificates were provided for certified food service managers.

headline: Ice machine residue; unlabeled spices
summary: A brownish substance was found inside the basement ice machine and must be cleaned and sanitized. Spices stored outside their containers lacked labels. Also noted: fryer debris, no covered restroom receptacle, and missing allergen certificate.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site; all employees must complete training. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with proper shelving to avoid pest hiding spots. Upkeep: missing ceiling covers, dusty vents, soiled mop heads.

headline: Articles not inverted; damaged light shields
summary: Single-service articles were not inverted and must be inverted to prevent contamination. Damaged light shields in prep and dishwashing areas must be replaced.

headline: Frozen food uncovered; several cleaning issues
summary: Some food in the deep freezer was uncovered, risking freezer burn; manager must use food-grade containers or bags. Also: ice machine water tray debris, a dirty deli slicer, grease and debris under the grill, and a dirty hood.

headline: Mold-like seal and dirty bar drains
summary: Dark, possibly moldy buildup on the seal at the rear 3-compartment sink must be resealed. Bar drains and floors under bar equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: No written employee health policy on site
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises. Management must provide a signed health policy for each employee. No citation was issued.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about 215 lbs discarded
summary: Refried beans, pork, beef tongue, and rice were held above 41°F, and a refrigerator read 49.5°F. About 215 lbs, worth $388, was discarded, and the refrigerator was repaired on site. Sinks needed stoppers, and a gasket needs replacing.

headline: Dirt and debris in dish and food areas
summary: Heavy dirt, dust, and debris had built up under metal shelving in the rear dish area and around equipment in the front food service area. Inspector instructed cleaning of all areas.

headline: Pork and beef held too warm; food discarded
summary: Pork at 50.7°F and beef at 48.6°F were held above the 41°F safe limit. Manager voluntarily discarded about 5 pounds, valued at $200. Other issues: menu lacks undercooked-food disclosure, items stored on floor, and utensils stored improperly.

headline: Food stored on floor; handwashing signs missing
summary: Food items were on the floor under rear storage shelves and must be raised six inches. Handwashing signs were missing at exposed sinks. Also: food debris on prep-area floors and a certified manager lacking allergen training certificate.

headline: Over 25 flies; restroom hot water too low
summary: Over 25 small flies were found throughout the facility; pest control service was recommended and a citation was issued. Restroom sinks had hot water only 80–82°F, below the required 100°F, and an outside grease receptacle was heavily soiled.

headline: Cooler too warm; replaced on site
summary: Cooler measured 54.1°F, too warm to keep food safe; it was tagged and taken out of use. The manager replaced it on site, and the new unit read 36.7°F. Damaged shelving under the 3-compartment sink was also noted.

headline: Handwashing water too cold; corrected on site
summary: Restroom handwashing sinks ran only 54–60°F; a minimum of 100°F is required. Staff raised the water heater temperature to 165°F, and water now reaches 100°F or higher. A citation was issued. Hair restraints were also missing.

headline: Cooked foods held too warm; 75 lbs discarded
summary: Several cooked foods in walk-in cooler 2 measured above 41°F, up to 72°F (chorizo). Person in charge discarded about 75 lbs worth $150. Also noted: dirty ice scoop, improper scoop storage, stained cutting boards, and greasy fryer areas.

headline: No working refrigeration on premises
summary: The premises had no working equipment to keep food cold, and no working refrigeration. All refrigeration must be on and keep food at 41°F or below; a priority violation was issued.

headline: Non-service dogs inside; no certified manager
summary: No certified manager was on duty while food was prepared and served; citation issued. Non-service dogs were inside, and employees were feeding one; a citation was issued. Pest control log and sanitizer test kit were also missing.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and worn cutting boards
summary: A handwashing sink in the lobby bar lacked signage. A bread cooler had a torn gasket, and two cutting boards on the cook line were deeply grooved and stained. All must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Hot-holding equipment off; no vomit cleanup plan
summary: Main hot-holding equipment was off because no electrical outlet was connected at front prep; it must hold 135°F or hotter. Also: no employee health policy, no vomit and diarrhea procedure, and dry food stored under wastewater pipes.

headline: Blocked handwashing sink; ice machine slime found
summary: Front handwashing sink was blocked by stored items; the person in charge removed them. Black slime dripped from the ice maker into ice for human consumption; ice must be removed and machine cleaned. No employee health policy was on site.

headline: No soap in men's washroom; citation issued
summary: Men's washroom had no soap; a citation was issued. Black substance was starting inside an ice machine bin. Also: milk crates used for elevation, a broken cooler gasket, and a flexible tube on a sink drainboard.

headline: Hair restraint missing; drainage and rust issues
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Condensation in the walk-in cooler was dripping into a pan and must be drained outside the cooler. A rusty wall behind the rear prep table needs a rust-free surface.

headline: Unlabeled salt and rice; expired allergen training
summary: Salt and rice stored outside their original containers had no labels and must be labeled. A manager's food allergen training certificate was expired. Also noted: dirt on a walk-in cooler fan and soiled mop heads that must be hung.

headline: Heavy grease and debris; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and shelving had grease and food debris, and the hood and filters need cleaning. Previous core violations were not corrected, including can opener debris and freezer ice. One food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Floor debris under and behind equipment
summary: Dirt, dust, and food debris had built up on the floor under, around, and behind prep-area equipment. Cleaning was ordered to prevent possible pest activity.

headline: Blocked handwashing sink; no sanitizer at dish machine
summary: Sanitizer buckets were stored in handwashing sinks; manager removed them and a citation was issued. Bar dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer and was repaired on site. Also: a large immovable kettle needs a written clean-in-place procedure.

headline: Menu lacks raw-food warning; doors not rodent-proof
summary: Menu did not disclose which items were raw or undercooked, or the risks, such as eggs and beef; a citation was issued. Front and side doors had roughly 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom and must be made rodent-proof.

headline: Missing floor grout and drain buildup
summary: Floor tiles in rear prep and dishwashing areas are missing grout, which must be filled for easy cleaning. Floor drains under the 3-compartment sink and high-temperature dish machine had buildup that must be cleaned.

headline: Buffet plate sign missing; repairs ordered
summary: No sign told buffet customers to use a clean plate for each trip; a sign must be posted. Repairs ordered: chipped paint, missing or stained ceiling tiles, damaged floor tiles and grout, and a missing light bulb.

headline: Leaking drainpipe under three-compartment sink
summary: A drainpipe leaked under the rinse compartment of the three-compartment sink in the fourth-floor dishwashing area. Repair was instructed.

headline: Stained cutting boards in rear prep
summary: Cutting boards in the rear prep area had open seams and dark stains. They must be refinished or replaced and kept in good condition.

headline: Several food handlers lack valid certificates
summary: Several food handlers did not have valid food handler training certificates; management must provide proof. Also: repair holes in the basement prep-area ceiling and clean the floor under the main bar.

headline: Wiping cloths and cutting boards need fixing
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on counters, cutting boards, and a crate; sanitizing buckets with solution are required. Meat department cutting boards had deep cuts and stains and must be resealed or replaced.

headline: Dish machine not hot enough; repaired on site
summary: The high-temperature dish machine did not reach 180°F at final rinse. It was repaired during inspection. The facility was not operating, and the machine was not in use; no citation was issued.

headline: Improper thawing and uncovered sauces found
summary: Two packages of steak were thawing in standing water; inspector instructed proper thawing methods. Sauces were left uncovered, and exam gloves were used for food handling instead of food-grade gloves. Also: missing sink stoppers and an ice machine buildup.

headline: No hot water; waste line not working
summary: There was no hot water on site, and the waste line was not functioning properly; both must be fixed, and no citation was issued. Cutting boards, reach-in cooler interiors, floors, walls, and ceilings also need cleaning.

headline: Stained cutting boards and broken floor
summary: Stained cutting boards stored in the dishwashing rack area must be resurfaced or replaced. A broken floor section near the three-compartment sink must be repaired to a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures and unapproved drying
summary: Cooked pork was held below safe hot temperature, and raw pork read 56–58°F in the display cooler; about 40 lbs was discarded. Chorizo drying at room temperature without approval must stop. An insect trap full of insects was stored above onions.

headline: Fryer cleaning and allergen certificate needed
summary: The inside of the deep fryers must be cleaned. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate and must show proof.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food and improper scoops
summary: Bulk sugar and salt were not labeled, and deli cups were used as scoops for bulk food. Ice scoops were placed on top of ice at the bar, and the inspector told staff to keep them off.

headline: Truck lacked garbage receptacle
summary: The truck had no garbage receptacle. Management was instructed to provide one.

headline: Food handler and allergen training needed
summary: A potato dicer on the wall needs cleaning. Food handlers must obtain required food handler training, and food service managers must complete required food allergen training.

headline: Oversized equipment and missing backflow device
summary: Large multi-use equipment didn't fit in the 3-compartment sink, so an alternative way to wash, rinse, and sanitize was required. The utility sink had no backflow device, which must be provided and maintained.

headline: Chicken held too warm; menu disclosure corrected
summary: Chicken measured 51.4°F, above the 41°F limit; manager discarded about 3 lbs, valued at $8, and a citation was issued. The menu's raw-or-undercooked food notice was corrected on site. Openings at the revolving door base must be sealed.

headline: Flies found; coolers and dish machine failed
summary: 21 flies were found in kitchen, bar, and banquet areas; pest control was recommended. Two coolers measured 50°F air temperature, and some food held at 44–58°F was discarded. Hot-water dish machine reached 153°F, below the 160°F minimum; it was tagged.

headline: Dish machine had no sanitizer; repaired on site
summary: Sanitizer measured 0 ppm at both deli dish machines; they were tagged and repaired on site. Frozen raw fish was thawed while still in sealed packaging, which must be removed first. Upkeep: dusty cooler ceilings and fan guards.

headline: Mold-like residue in ice machine; sanitizer missing
summary: Mold-like substance inside the basement ice machine dripped into ice for human consumption; ice must be discarded. Basement dish machine had no final-rinse sanitizer and was tagged out. Other problems: improper food date marking and missing handwashing signs.

headline: No health policy, pest logbook, or thermometer
summary: No written employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies, metal-stem thermometer, or sanitizer test strips were on site. No pest control logbook was available, and a citation was issued.

headline: Handwashing lapses, unsafe food temperatures, pests
summary: Staff handled food and dishes without washing hands after touching their nose and neck; citation issued. Hot and cold foods were outside safe temperature ranges; about 110 lbs ($400) was discarded. Over 100 live flies and dead roaches were found.

headline: Front door gap and light cover need fixing
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front entrance door sweep must be closed to keep rodents out. A ceiling light cover outside the walk-in cooler was not working and needs a working bulb.

headline: Live roaches found on food and equipment
summary: Over 30 live roaches and several adults were found on walls, a wok pan, a rice cooker, a steam table, and inside rice. Roach droppings were also present. The rice was discarded; updated pest control service proof is required.

headline: Heavy cleaning needed in prep and restroom
summary: Pizza oven, cooling units, and hot-holding units need cleaning of dried food debris. A handwashing sink's single handle doesn't work; restroom fixtures need cleaning. Floors and floor drains had heavy food debris, which must be removed.

headline: Clogged drains in prep areas; repaired on site
summary: Three-compartment sinks and floor drains in meat, seafood, and produce prep areas were not draining properly. A citation was issued; a plumber cleared the clogs, and drains were working by the end of the inspection.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; hood heavily greasy
summary: Food containers on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Exhaust hood, filters, and pipes had heavy grease and dirt. A washable splashguard is needed at the front hand sink, and butcher paper lining shelves must be removed.

headline: About 300 mouse droppings and rodent infestation
summary: About 300 mouse droppings, 3 rat droppings, and 5 dead mice were found in storage areas; more pest control is needed and a citation was issued. Rodent poison was on the floor. The premises had no hot water.

headline: Walk-in shelving dirty; no backflow devices
summary: Shelving inside the walk-in cooler needs cleaning. The ICW machine, drip coffee maker, and fruit juice machine lacked backflow prevention devices, which must be provided where they can be serviced and seen.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings; prior violation uncorrected
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were found in the beverage storage room, inside boxes, and under the front counter; a previous violation was not corrected. Management must remove droppings and get a licensed pest inspection. Outside garbage area needs cleaning.

headline: Expired food handler certificate; allergen training missing
summary: One food handler had an expired food handler certificate, and one certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Two cooler door gaskets were torn and must be replaced.

headline: Unlabeled containers; expired allergen training
summary: Food storage containers such as flour, sugar, and salt must be labeled. Some certified managers lacked a current allergen training certificate. Also: crates used for elevation, rusty walk-in racks, dumpster debris, and dirty kitchen floor corners.

headline: Worn door seal and leaky hand sink
summary: Working thermometers are needed inside all coolers. Worn weather stripping at the front door's bottom must be replaced to prevent a possible pest entry point. The rear hand sink has a leaky pipe. Cleaning is needed throughout, including the hood.

headline: No certified manager during food service
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while roast beef, turkey, ham, and potato salad were prepared and served; a citation was issued. A handwashing sink was blocked by stored water, and no signed employee health policies were on site.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; cleaning needed
summary: Several food handlers had expired certificates and must show current proof. Grease and dried food need clearing in rear prep areas, and a mop sink has black mold-like buildup. Coolers also need visible thermometers.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine tagged out
summary: No certified manager or person in charge was on site while pizza was prepared; citation issued. The low-temperature dish machine has a severe leak, is out of use, and is tagged until repaired. No working food thermometer was available.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; 15 lbs discarded
summary: Eggs at 55–57°F, cut lettuce and dumplings at 46°F, and hot dog skewers at 50°F were too warm; manager discarded about 15 lbs. A prep cooler at 50.2°F was repaired on site. Exposed sewage pipes above food areas need covering.

headline: Ice machine buildup; restroom trash needs lid
summary: A small amount of white buildup was inside the ice machine and must be cleaned. The employee restroom needs a lidded trash can for feminine hygiene products.

headline: Black and pink slime found in ice machine
summary: Ice machine used for human consumption had black and pink slime inside; citation issued, and inspector instructed removal of ice and cleaning. Also: certified manager lacks allergen training; torn cooler gasket; grease buildup in fryer area.

headline: No certified manager during egg and sausage prep
summary: No certified food manager was on premises while eggs, cheese, and pork sausage were prepared and served; citation issued. The customer washroom also lacked a covered trash receptacle.

headline: Excess grease; previous core violations uncorrected
summary: Excess grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, coolers, shelving, and tables. Previous core violations were not corrected, including fryer and cart debris and floor debris; a citation was issued. Lobby and prep-area vents and walls also need cleaning.

headline: Missing lids on bar ice bins
summary: Ice bins behind the bar were missing covers. Tight-fitting lids or covers must be provided.

headline: Shrimp pan blocked handwashing sink; citation
summary: A handwashing sink was blocked by a small pan of shrimp, which the person in charge removed; a citation was issued. The dish room had clutter, standing water, food debris, and grease on walls and floors.

headline: Freezer ice, sink water pressure, and hood grease
summary: A rear reach-in freezer had excessive ice and must be defrosted and cleaned. The three-compartment sink faucet needs better water pressure, and the hood vent needs grease and debris removed.

headline: Walk-in door latch broken; sinks need waste bins
summary: The main kitchen walk-in cooler's door latch was in poor repair and kept the door from fully closing; the cooler still held 37.1°F. Handwashing sinks lacked waste receptacles for used paper towels and must have them.

headline: Unsealed wood and drywall; no drainboard
summary: Raw wood in the front prep area must be sealed, and unfinished drywall must be finished or sealed. The three-compartment sink has no drainboard and one must be added.

headline: Customer dogs inside; several certificates missing
summary: Customer dogs were allowed inside, which is not permitted except for service animals; a citation was issued. No city sanitation certificate was posted during food preparation; no signed health policy or valid food handler certificates were on site.

headline: No Chicago sanitation certificate on premises
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was on the premises or posted. A certified manager must be on site during all operating hours; a citation was issued.

headline: Cutting boards, freezer, and clutter need attention
summary: Rear prep cutting boards have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Freezer has ice and debris buildup. Floor clutter must go to prevent pest harborage. Upkeep: stained ceiling tiles, open walls, missing light shields.

headline: Person in charge lacked sanitation certificate
summary: The person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate was posted or provided. At least one certified food manager must be on site when food is handled; a citation was issued.

headline: Food handler certificates not verified on site
summary: Inspector could not find or verify food handler certificates; certified managers must keep certificates on site. Bulk flour, rice and sugar containers in the prep area need common-name labels.

headline: Tape repair, unlabeled sinks, items on floor
summary: Tape was used to repair the front cooler and must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable fix. Three-compartment sinks lacked wash-rinse-sanitize labels. Cooler interiors need cleaning, and items on the floor must be raised six inches.

headline: Ice contaminated, warm food, and handwashing lapses
summary: Ice was contaminated by a stored scoop and cloth; it was removed. Cooked rice at 62.9°F and fried chicken nuggets at 60.2°F were discarded (about 35 lbs). An employee handled food after rinsing gloved hands.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings; pest control needed
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were on the floor of a cluttered rear storage room; pest control service is needed and a citation was issued. Also: no thermometer in a prep cooler, unlabeled desserts, and no sink for juice preparation.

headline: Broken dumpster lid; unlabeled food containers
summary: The outside dumpster had broken lids, which must be replaced; a citation was issued. Food storage containers lacked labels, prep cooler items were uncovered, and handwashing signs were missing in restrooms and the front line.

headline: Grease trap and sink area need cleaning
summary: Only cleaning items were noted. Inspector asked for cleaning of the grease trap exterior, pipes under the 3-compartment sink, and the wall beneath that sink.

headline: Basement clutter and sink repairs ordered
summary: Wood props and shelving under the 3-compartment sink, plus floor holes there, must be sealed. Ice and espresso machines need visible backflow devices. Basement clutter, including piled wood, must be removed. Food handler proof also required.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, ice machine slime
summary: Failed inspection. No valid city sanitation certificate was posted or provided, while deli meat and eggs were handled. Ice machine had gray-brown slimy substance dripping onto ice used for people. Ordered cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Open floor holes and no food handler certificates
summary: Inspector found open holes in kitchen and dry storage floors that must be sealed. No food handler certificates were on site for food employees. No allergen training certificates were on site for certified food managers.

headline: No cooler thermometer; unlabeled food containers
summary: No thermometer was in the front display cooler. Large white containers with ingredients were not labeled. A male employee in food prep was not wearing a hair restraint. Cutting boards with deep stains and grooves must be sanded or replaced.

headline: Failed: hand-sink water too hot; minor leak
summary: Failed inspection. Hot water at handwashing sinks measured 122.3-125.2F, above the required 100-120F range; this was a priority violation. A minor leak was found at the three-compartment sink. Soiled mop heads were hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Missing floor grout and broken tiles in prep
summary: Missing floor grout and damaged or broken floor tiles in the prep area must be repaired to create a smooth, easily cleaned surface.

headline: Oversized dishes; raw wood surfaces; wall smoothness
summary: Rice pots, cutting boards and metal containers are too large for the three-compartment sink; they must be removed or a written alternative washing procedure provided. Raw wood throughout the prep area must be sealed. Walls near the mop sink and prep area are not smooth and cleanable.

headline: Failed: dishmachine not sanitizing; cooler at 58.5F
summary: Failed inspection. Dishmachine had 0 ppm chlorine in its final rinse and was tagged do not use. A prep cooler held air at 58.5F and was tagged do not use until repaired. Entrance door openings, leaks, and burnt-out bulbs also noted.

headline: Failed: no hot water in facility
summary: Failed license inspection. No hot water throughout the facility; maximum hot water measured 70F. Hand sinks must reach 100F and other sinks 110F. No visible backflow prevention device on the ice machine.

headline: Failed: no vomit procedure, missing pest log
summary: Failed inspection. No procedure existed for vomit and diarrhea cleanup, and no current pest control log was on site. Repeat violations from a prior inspection were not fixed, including a missing food thermometer and a gap under the entrance door.

headline: Worn cooler gasket; expired allergen certificate
summary: A prep cooler gasket was in disrepair with residue buildup. Debris was on the floor in a rear corner near the restroom. The certified manager's allergen certificate was expired and must be renewed.

headline: Dead roaches and insects on floors
summary: Dead roaches and insects were found on the floor in the rear warewashing area, an adjacent storage area and the basement. Food containers were on the floor in the walk-in cooler and storage. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls and floors needs degreasing.

headline: No employee health policy; stained cutting boards
summary: Conditional pass. No employee health policies were on site; employees must sign acknowledgments. Stained cutting boards in the front coffee prep area must be resurfaced or replaced. No covered waste receptacle in the unisex washroom.

headline: Moldy caulking; upper ice machine needs cleaning
summary: Some interior areas of the upper ice machine need cleaning. Inverted metal pans used as shelving for bulk vegetables must stop; floors must be accessible. Blackened, moldy caulking at the three-compartment sink must be replaced. No allergen training proof for certified managers.

headline: Failed: roaches throughout facility
summary: Failed license re-inspection. About 9 live roaches were found in storage, dining room, washroom, and near the freezer. Many dead roaches were also found in dining, prep and storage areas. Pest control service was recommended.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; hand-wash sign missing
summary: Bulk flour and sugar in the basement storage area were unlabeled. A hand sink in the first-floor kitchen lacked a hand-washing sign. Torn cooler gaskets, missing backflow device on mop sink, and non-smooth basement walls and floors were also noted.

headline: Failed: no posted certificate, no metal thermometer
summary: Failed inspection. No original, valid city sanitation manager's certificate was posted. No metal stem thermometer was on site to take cold and hot food temperatures. Both were marked as priority violations with citations issued.

headline: Dirty ice machine; broken cold-holding thermometers
summary: Ice machine interior had slight residue and must be cleaned. Display thermometers at cold-hold prep cooler and drawers were not working and must be replaced. Black substance on caulking at the three-compartment sink needs removal.

headline: Facial hair without beard guards; dirty ice machine
summary: Male employees with facial hair were not wearing beard guards or restraints in food prep areas. Ice machine interior had grayish and blackish buildup and must be detail cleaned. Floor drains and floors under the front serving line need cleaning.

headline: Gap under rear door; no mop sink
summary: Half-inch gap under the rear exterior door must be sealed. No mop sink on premises; one must be installed. Restroom door was not self-closing, and the restroom wall and ceiling had damage and open holes.

headline: No hand-washing signs; workers without hair restraints
summary: No hand-washing signs or posters were near the customer restroom sink. Employees in food preparation were not wearing hair restraints. Inspector required restraints at all times during food prep and service.

headline: Door gaps; dirty floors; no mop sink backflow
summary: License inspection passed. A half-inch gap under the front and rear doors is not rodent or insect proof. No backflow prevention device on the rear mop sink. Damaged floor tiles and dirt and debris under coolers, sinks and racks need attention.

headline: No certified manager present; food handlers untrained
summary: Conditional pass. No valid city sanitation certificate was posted while TCS foods were prepared and served. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates. Pizza oven surfaces, prep area walls and dishwashing area walls need cleaning.

headline: No self-closing washroom door; broken floor tiles
summary: Front washroom door lacked a self-closing device. Broken floor tiles under a cooler behind the front bar and missing baseboard need replacing.

headline: Unstored serving plates; drain and leaking faucet
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Serving plates on kitchen shelves were not stored inverted and must be to prevent dust. Exposed prep hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired. Three-compartment sink faucet base is leaking.

headline: Failed: leaking drain pipe, broken floor tiles
summary: Failed inspection. A drain pipe leading into the grease trap next to the ice machine is leaking, a priority violation with a citation. Floor tiles under the grease trap are missing and broken and must be replaced.

headline: Hair restraints missing; cutting boards scratched
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Cutting boards have deep scratches and stains and must be resurfaced or replaced. Leak at a three-compartment sink faucet base, and grease and food debris on prep area floors.

headline: No employee health policy; food handler proof missing
summary: Conditional pass. No written employee health policy was on premises. Food containers lacked labels, ice scoops were stored on the ice machine, and an employee prepared food without a hair restraint. Some food handlers lacked training proof.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food debris throughout
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Bulk containers in the rear lacked common-name labels. Wiping cloths were not in sanitizer, cutting boards were stained, and a door gasket was torn. Food debris and spills were found across floors and surfaces.

headline: Failed: no ice scoop holder, faucet doesn't reach all bays
summary: Failed license inspection. No dipper well or hot holding unit kept ice cream scoops in water above 135F. Three-compartment sink faucet does not reach left and right compartments, a priority violation.

headline: Leaking faucet on three-compartment sink
summary: Inspector found a leak at the faucet on the three-compartment sink and instructed the operator to repair it.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment and floors need cleaning
summary: Shelves and undercounters at the pop station need detail cleaning to remove spills and buildup. All cooking equipment needs detail cleaning for grease and food spills. Floors, hood vents and filters also need cleaning. Waste wood and equipment must be removed.

headline: Failed: trash overflow and unlabeled bulk food
summary: Failed inspection. Outside trash receptacles overflowed, lids would not close, and ground was littered, inviting rodents and insects. Also missing food labels, knives stored improperly, broken cooler gaskets, stained cutting boards, and no food handler certificate on site.

headline: Cooler thermometer placement, labels, sink stopper
summary: Prep cooler thermometer was kept at the back, not the warmest part, of the cooler. Bulk flour and sugar containers lacked labels. An ice scoop was stored in standing water. The three-compartment sink stopper did not hold water.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; dirty prep floors
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. A cutting board at the main prep station needs replacing. Food debris in the cooking area and food spills on prep area floors need cleaning.

headline: Dirty food rack, floor drains and light shield
summary: Food rack in the rear must be cleaned to remove debris and spills. Floors and floor drains need cleaning, and dishwashing area floors should be kept dry. Walk-in cooler light shield is missing and must be replaced.

headline: Unlabeled food containers and floors stored on
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels showing the common food name. Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and prep areas. Milk crates were used as shelves. A burned-out hood light and floor debris were also noted.

headline: Broken chest freezers; dirty equipment; broken floor tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Chest freezers have duct-taped door plastic and exposed insulation and wiring; management must replace them. Food debris in several sinks, fryers, and coolers needs cleaning. Broken floor tiles and greasy walls need repair.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: Conditional pass. No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served during business hours. Dust on shelving where to-go containers are kept and a missing restroom ceiling tile were also noted.

headline: No hair restraints; rusted racks; no manager allergen training
summary: A food handler did not wear a hair restraint. Walk-in cooler storage racks are rusted and must be repaired or replaced. Water-stained ceiling tiles in prep need replacing. Some food handlers lacked certificates, and the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; food on walk-in floor
summary: Bulk food in basement prep and dry storage lacked name labels. Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised 6 inches. Serving plates were not inverted. Food stored in grocery bags and tin cans must go into food-grade containers.

headline: Leaking drain pipe under cashier hand sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. Drain pipe leaking under the hand sink in the cashier prep area must be repaired.

headline: Failed: no health policy, cooler off, no dumpster
summary: Failed license inspection. No employee health policy or vomit spill kit on premises. A low-temperature dishmachine was not sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine. A reach-in cooler was turned off. No outside dumpster was found. Pizza oven was not under a hood.

headline: Small floor debris; missing manager allergen certificate
summary: Small debris was on the floor in the prep area and must be cleaned. No allergen training certificate was on site for one employee; the operator was instructed to obtain and provide it.

headline: No splash guard near front prep hand sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. A washable splash guard must be installed between the exposed hand sink and prep table at the front prep line. The three-compartment sink sprayer hangs below the rim and needs a holder.

headline: Failed: stuck walk-in door knob, hot water leak
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed with conditions. Walk-in cooler release knob is broken, so the door cannot be opened from inside. Ice buildup at freezer condenser and broken freezer gasket. Extremely loose hot water handle. Repeat violations for backflow devices.

headline: Failed: multiple temperature violations; no hot water
summary: Chicken wings held at 92.1F were discarded. Walk-in cooler held raw fish, chicken, salmon and other TCS foods at 45.7-52.9F; about 193 pounds ($1,500) discarded. Cooler at 49.5F later reached 33.3F. No hot water at hand sinks until plumber repaired it on site.

headline: Failed: repeat violations, no vomit kit
summary: Failed re-inspection. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. A cutting board by pizza ovens has deep cuts and stains. Repeat core violations: no backflow device on utility sink, no food handler training, and no allergen training for certified manager.

headline: Espresso wiping cloth stored improperly
summary: Wiping cloth for the espresso machine was not stored properly; inspector instructed the operator to keep it in a sanitizer bucket.

headline: Hot food discarded; no paper towels at restroom
summary: Conditional pass. About 5 pounds of cooked flautas held at 106.5F were discarded; hot food must stay at 135F or above. Manager discarded them. No hand-drying towels in the employee restroom; manager supplied paper towels during the inspection. No allergen certificate for manager.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and stained cutting boards
summary: A torn rubber gasket on a prep cooler door needs repair. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. A kitchen hand sink faucet leaks with a continuous drip.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; no allergen-trained manager
summary: Food stored in containers in coolers, walk-in cooler and dry storage lacked name labels. Raw wood shelves need sealing. An reach-in freezer had excess ice and debris. No certified food manager had allergen training; documentation is required.

headline: No hair restraints; wet wiping cloths; no allergen training
summary: Food handlers prepped food without hair restraints. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution. No certified food manager had allergen training; documentation is required.

headline: Unlabeled containers; no hair restraints
summary: Bulk containers in the rear prep area lacked labels. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. A knob was missing from the three-compartment sink right faucet. Baseboards under the rear hand sink were missing.

headline: Dusty walk-in cooler fans
summary: Dust buildup on walk-in cooler fans must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Disposable bowl in dry ingredient bin; tableware not inverted
summary: Re-inspection passed. A clear disposable bowl was stored inside bulk dry storage bins. Operator was instructed to use handled utensils to transfer dry ingredients. Clean tableware was not inverted on the three-compartment sink drainboard.

headline: Gaps under doors; no vomit cleanup policy
summary: Conditional pass. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup policy or items on site. Large gap under front, rear and basement doors must be closed. Damaged reach-in cooler handle and gaskets, rusted shelves, and burnt-out lights also noted.

headline: No hand-wash signs; utensils stored improperly
summary: Women's and men's washrooms lacked hand-washing signage. Ambient air thermometers were missing from prep coolers and freezer. Food containers lacked labels. Wiping cloths and in-use utensils were stored improperly on prep surfaces. Plates were not inverted.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine water line
summary: No backflow prevention device was found on the ice machine waterline. Inspector required one be installed where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Missing vomit cleanup kit and toilet room items
summary: Conditional license. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. The toilet room lacked a hand-washing sign, a covered waste receptacle, and cove molding. Debris was on rear and customer service area floors.

headline: Dirty dishmachine; damaged ceiling tiles and door
summary: Interior and exterior of the kitchen dishmachine had dirt and excessive buildup. Ceiling tiles throughout the kitchen above pizza ovens are stained, greasy and missing and must be replaced. The employee washroom door is badly damaged and must be replaced.

headline: Gaps under entrance doors; missing hand-wash sign
summary: A quarter-inch gap under the front entrance doors needs sealing to prevent pest entry. A washroom hand sink lacked a hand-washing sign and had a loose faucet. Raw wood floor surfaces need sealing, and shelving needs cleaning.

headline: Clutter and items on floor in basement storage
summary: Basement storage areas need detail cleaning and organizing. Unnecessary items and unused broken bicycles and equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage. All stock items must be elevated at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Iced-up deep freezer; greasy floors behind equipment
summary: A reach-in deep freezer must be defrosted and cleaned to remove ice buildup and debris. Floors behind cooking equipment need cleaning to remove spills, debris and grease.

headline: Ceiling hole dripping water; debris under chip racks
summary: A large hole in the ceiling over cooling and freezing units drips water into a box in the grocery store and must be repaired. Cardboard liners on flour and sugar shelving must be removed. Chips debris under racks needs removing.

headline: Torn gasket; dirty fryer; cluttered basement
summary: Re-inspection passed. Torn door gasket on a prep cooler must be replaced. Grease and food debris in the deep fryer and walls around the cook line need cleaning. Basement storage clutter should be removed, and items elevated 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No soap at prep sink; burgers held too cool
summary: Conditional pass. No soap was available at the prep-area hand sink while serving an immunocompromised population; the dispenser was broken, and maintenance fixed it on site. Burgers held at 113F were discarded (about 5 pounds, $50).

headline: Hair not restrained; dirty gaskets, floors and hood
summary: Long hair must be tied back and hair restraints used. Reach-in cooler gaskets, floors and the hood vent need cleaning to remove food spills and grease buildup. Inspector ordered detail cleaning.

headline: No grease trap; brick wall hard to clean
summary: No grease trap was provided under the three-compartment sink or on site; operator must install one or confirm location. A brick wall between prep cabinets is not easily cleanable and must be made so.

headline: No certified manager or health policy; no hand sink
summary: Conditional pass. No valid city sanitation certificate was posted while coffee, milk and bagel items were served. No written employee health policy. No exposed hand sink in the basement near the three-compartment sink. No metal stem thermometer.

headline: Hot chicken dishes held too cool; discarded
summary: Conditional pass. 8 pounds of enchiladas held at 96.4F and 6 pounds of burritos at 122.4-125.1F were in the hot holding buffet. Manager discarded all, a priority violation. Grease and food debris were found along a wall and behind the donut fryer.

headline: Milk held at 50F; cutting boards and rusted racks
summary: Milk held at 50F was discarded (half gallon), a priority violation with a citation. Cutting boards have stains and deep scratches. An oversized kettle needs a written clean-in-place procedure. Rusted dry storage racks need repainting. Repeat ice machine cleaning was done on site.

headline: Dirty curtains near washrooms
summary: Curtains hanging leading to the washrooms need cleaning and maintenance.

headline: One certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: License inspection passed. One certified food manager was missing allergen training. Operator was instructed to provide allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: No certified manager 8:15-8:45 AM; cooler held too warm
summary: Conditional pass. No certified manager was present from 8:15 to 8:45 AM while eggs and rice were prepared. Tuna salad and gyro meat in a prep cooler held at 49-50.5F; about 5 pounds ($40) discarded. Rice and noodles lacked labels.

headline: Dirty cooking equipment; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Lower shelves and sides of cooking equipment need detail cleaning. Floors under and around equipment in the rear prep area need cleaning. Hood had grease buildup. One manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; raw wood shelving
summary: Bulk containers in the rear prep area were not labeled with the food's common name. Raw wood shelving under a prep table must be sealed so it is smooth and easily cleaned.

headline: Damaged cooler gaskets; no allergen certificate
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Damaged gaskets were found on a front deli prep cooler and sliding two-door cooler. Three-compartment sink lacked wash-rinse-sanitize labels. No allergen certificate was on site for the certified manager.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs and leaking sink faucet
summary: Hand-washing signs were missing at prep-area sinks. A three-compartment sink faucet leaked. Raw wood shelving needs sealing. Ceiling and outlet cover repairs and food spills on walls and dirty floors were also noted.

headline: No certified manager; trash and grease under equipment
summary: Conditional re-inspection. No certified food manager with an original certificate was on site while preparing fish and chicken. Bulk containers lacked labels. Floors under fryers and walk-in cooler had grease, chicken blood and debris. Food handler certificates required.

headline: Raw wood, no waste receptacle, broken floor tiles
summary: License re-inspection passed. Raw wood 2x4s at the front counter must be painted or sealed. No covered waste receptacle in the washroom. Broken floor tiles under the one-door freezer must be replaced.

headline: Stored items on floor; dusty restroom vent
summary: All stored items in the rear equipment storage and freezer room must be raised off the floor. Excessive dust covers the ceiling vent fan in the men's washroom and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: mice droppings and warm cooler held food
summary: Failed inspection. About 40 or more mouse droppings were found in the rear prep area, employee toilet room, dining area and under a prep table. A walk-in cooler tagged earlier held beef at 46.2-48.7F; about 215 pounds ($300) of food was discarded.

headline: Failed-free complaint: ice buildup; two managers untrained
summary: Ice buildup inside a two-door freezer in the rear prep area must be thawed. Two of four certified managers lacked allergen training; all certified managers must complete it and keep records on site.

headline: Fly strip above food prep; dishwashing rinse issue
summary: A fly strip insect control device was hung above a cold-holding unit and a hand sink in the rear prep area. Inspector ordered it removed and replaced with devices that pose no contamination risk. An employee skipped the rinse step at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and wastewater leaks
summary: Failed inspection. About 5 rodent droppings were found under basement dry storage shelves and about 10 in a first-floor utility closet. Wastewater leaked from a basement wall and pipe. Dumpsters overflowed. No metal stem thermometer on site.

headline: Unlabeled stored food; fly traps in prep area
summary: Food removed from packaging was stored without name labels. Sticky fly traps in the prep area were not from pest control; inspector ordered them discarded. Also milk crates used as shelving, dirty floors, dusty vents, and a damaged ceiling tile.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, pest and sanitation violations
summary: Failed inspection. No certified food manager was on site while open. Sticky traps filled with dead bugs hung over prep tables and fish tanks. Pest control log was missing and out of date. Ice machine had black mold-like residue. No hand-drying towels at sinks.

headline: Rusted walk-in cooler racks
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Rusted storage racks in the walk-in cooler must be repaired so surfaces are smooth and easily cleaned.

headline: Failed: repeat sink stopper violation
summary: Failed inspection. A repeat core violation was noted: the three-compartment sink stopper cannot hold water. Prior core violations were not corrected. Manager was instructed to comply and must correct them.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no pest log
summary: Failed inspection. No certified food manager was on site while open. Food from an unapproved source, including cookies and cakes, was voluntarily discarded (about 15 pounds). No pest control logbook, no probe thermometer, and no food handler certificate.

headline: Failed: no hand soap, inadequate refrigeration
summary: Failed license inspection. No hand cleanser at the toilet room wash basin. Refrigeration on premises was inadequate for daily operation, a priority violation. Toilet room door was not self-closing.

headline: Failed: ripped cooler gasket, cluttered basement
summary: Failed canvass. Ripped rubber gasket on cook-line cheese cooler door must be replaced. Accumulated food debris on spice shelf needs cleaning. Basement floor clutter must be elevated or removed. Three-compartment sink stoppers not working; previous core violation not corrected.

headline: Failed: dead mosquitoes on rotting tomatoes
summary: Failed inspection. Two dead mosquitoes were found on rotting tomatoes in a cook line cooler. Product was discarded. Cold TCS foods were held too warm, and the kitchen ice machine had black and pink slime dripping onto ice used by customers.

headline: Bracelets on hands; floors and walls dirty
summary: Employee wore bracelets while working with exposed food; only a plain wedding band is allowed. Ice buildup on walk-in freezer floor needs repair. Floors, walls, and equipment bases throughout are dirty with grease and food debris and need detail cleaning.

headline: Uncovered pastries at checkout; posted summary missing
summary: About 5 pounds of pastries were displayed uncovered at the checkout counter and discarded. Peeling plastic on ice and dish machines must be removed. Employee belongings were stored in the food prep area. Inspection summary was not posted for public view.

headline: Incomplete vomit cleanup kit; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Conditional pass. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was incomplete, with only deodorizing cleaner and a scoop on site. A written cleanup procedure is required; manager ordered a kit. A sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Certified food manager lacked allergen training
summary: A certified food manager on site had no food allergen training. Inspector instructed the manager to comply with the requirement.

headline: Dirty restroom fixtures and kitchen floors
summary: Restroom fixtures were dirty and must be cleaned. Floors along wall bases and corners in the rear kitchen and walk-in cooler need cleaning. Filters above cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no paper towels, sewage backing up
summary: Failed inspection. No paper towels at the rear prep hand sink. Wastewater backed up with dirt, grease and food into three-compartment sinks, a priority violation. Dumpster overloaded so the lid would not close. Sink stopper and leaks also noted.

headline: No certified sanitation certificate on site
summary: Conditional pass. No one on site had a City of Chicago sanitation certificate while handling TCS foods such as deli meat and chicken. Bulk containers need labels, hair restraints are needed in prep areas, and prep area clutter must be organized.

headline: Pass: debris at floor drain under dish unit
summary: Excessive debris was found at the floor drain under the warewashing unit. The facility was instructed to detail clean and maintain the area.

headline: Pass: cold-hold gasket worn, spills, room damage
summary: A cold-hold unit gasket is in poor repair, and the inside of all cold-hold units had spills and residue. Floor tile was damaged in the front prep area, a ceiling tile was water-damaged, and a rear storage wall had a hole. No allergen training was held by the manager.

headline: Pass: grease and food debris on equipment
summary: Grease and food debris were on the interior and exterior of cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving. Debris was also found on floors along walls and in corners in utility and prep areas. The manager was told to clean.

headline: Pass: certified manager's allergen training expired
summary: The certified food manager's allergen training had expired. The manager was told to renew it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Fail: about 30 mouse droppings, raw chicken too warm
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found behind cold-holding units, in the office, toilet room, and behind cooking equipment. Raw chicken measured 53.8F; about 20 pounds were discarded. A citation was issued. Thawing and handwashing signs also failed.

headline: Pass: no splash guard, unsafe improvised utensil
summary: No splash guard was at the front prep handsink, next to exposed food and to-go containers. A Styrofoam cup was used as a scoop in hot-holding au jus above 190F. Foil and cardboard lined cooking equipment and a slicer was soiled.

headline: Pass: dust and dirt on floors
summary: Dust and dirt had built up on the floor along walls and corners in the side storage room and behind the front counter. The facility must clean the floor throughout and maintain it.

headline: Fail: live cockroaches and rat droppings found
summary: Two live cockroaches were found behind a refrigeration unit, and five rat droppings were under the dish sink area. The facility must clean, remove evidence, and get additional pest control; a citation was issued. Thermometers were missing from coolers.

headline: Fail: blocked handsink, unsafe food temperatures, dish machine held
summary: A handsink was blocked by stacked frying oil boxes and bulk containers. Dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged held. Raw beef at 50.9F, cooked chicken at 88.0F, and green beans at 79.1F; about 20 pounds discarded.

headline: Pass: raw wood crates, large pots, no food handler training
summary: Raw wood crates were used as shelving in prep and dish areas and must be sealed. Pots and pans were too large for the three-compartment sink. No food handler training was found for employees.

headline: Fail: no health policy, no outside dumpster, dead insects
summary: Signed employee health policies were missing; this is a priority violation. Dead insects were found on the floor of a toilet room and on a light shield in the front prep area. No outside dumpster was provided. Frozen food from an adjacent restaurant was stored in the walk-in freezer.

headline: Fail: three-compartment sink floods when drained
summary: When water drains from one compartment of the three-compartment sink, another compartment floods before draining. The manager was instructed to service the sink. A priority violation was issued with a citation.

headline: Fail: no certified manager while cooling TCS foods
summary: The person in charge had no certificate while soup and beef were cooled; a citation was issued. Hot soup in a large container was cooled inadequately in the walk-in cooler. No pest control logbook was provided, and the three-compartment sink cannot fit all equipment.

headline: Pass: insect control device over sink, filters greasy
summary: An insect control device was above the three-compartment sink and was ordered removed. Grease and debris were on the filters above the griddle and must be cleaned.

headline: Pass: business license number missing from label
summary: The business license number was not printed on the lateral sides of the packaged food label at the required size. The facility was instructed to add it.

headline: Pass: opening in wall under mop sink
summary: An opening was found in the lower wall under the mop sink in the rear prep area. The facility was instructed to seal it to prevent potential pest entry. No pests were observed.

headline: Fail: no certified manager, walk-in cooler off
summary: No certified manager certificate was on site. The walk-in cooler was not running and must hold 41F or below. No hot or cold running water under city pressure, and the toilet was inoperable. Missing thermometer, pest logbook, and test strips.

headline: Fail: most hand sinks lack hot water
summary: Hot water was missing at several handsinks, including near hot-holding units and the drink fountain, and in both restroom washbowls. This is a priority violation; a citation was issued. Floor tiles were missing near fryers, and debris and dust needed cleaning.

headline: Pass: reusing thank-you bags for food storage
summary: Single-use thank-you bags were being reused to store bread and vegetables in the reach-in cooler. Staff were told not to reuse them and to store food in food-grade bags or containers.
