headline: Pass: sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: At this re-inspection, the sanitation manager had no allergen training certificate. The facility must provide one.

headline: Fail: hot water 89.4F, bar sink misused, dirty vents
summary: Hot water at the south washroom handsink reached only 89.4F; minimum is 100F, citation issued. The bar handsink was used as a slop sink; management removed the strainer on site. Door gaps and milk crates need fixing. Ventilation in both washrooms is not working.

headline: Fail: previous fly violation uncorrected, no allergen training
summary: A prior report recorded about 20 live flies in the front and rear prep areas; the inspector found this violation still not corrected. Other issues include missing handwashing signs, soiled milk crates, unclean floors, poor lighting, and no allergen certificate for the certified manager.

headline: Fail: front handsink hot water too cold
summary: Hot water at the front-line handsink measured 67F. The minimum required is 100F. The person in charge was told to restore it, and a citation was issued.

headline: Pass: wiping cloths corrected on site; expired certificates
summary: Wiping cloths on a prep table were not stored in sanitizer; this was corrected on site. The rear exit door sweep was in poor repair. Floors, freezer interior, and vents need cleaning. Several food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Pass: slow sink, leaks, heavy grease, soiled floor
summary: The kitchen handsink drains slowly, and leaks were found under the handsink and the three-compartment sink. Heavy grease and food debris were on the floor and the wok and stove area. Mops were stored in a bucket, and the bathroom fan was not working.

headline: Pass: missing signs, unlicensed handler, unused items in basement
summary: No handwashing sign was at the front prep sink. Wiping cloths were dirty, and frozen food was stored in plastic grocery bags. A washroom door closer was broken and two ceiling tiles were missing. One food handler lacked a certificate; the manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Fail: flies found; dish machine fixed on site
summary: At least 20 small live flies were in the bar area; pest control was recommended, and a citation was issued. The rear dish machine read 10 ppm chlorine but was repaired and set to 50 ppm on site. Rust was in the ice machine, and a handsink drain leaked.

headline: Fail: no certified manager, no dumpster, no mop sink
summary: No one on site held an original city food manager certificate. Also missing: an employee health policy, vomit cleanup kit, pest control log, sanitizer test strips, a mop sink, and a dumpster or proof of contract.

headline: Pass: no splash guard, mop storage
summary: No splash guard was between the front handsink, prep table, and prep cooler. An all-gender washroom lacked a covered sanitary napkin receptacle. A mop was not stored in a way that lets it air dry, which can attract pests.

headline: Pass: unlabeled prepackaged meals, entrance gaps
summary: Prepackaged meals in a self-service cooler lacked manufacturer or distributor name. Openings were found at the front entrance doors, which must be sealed to keep pests out; no pests were observed. Coffee and sugar were stored under a sewer line.

headline: Pass: many repairs needed; no pests found
summary: Repairs were ordered for handsinks, a worn entry door gap, utensil and container storage, cutting boards, grease buildup, leaks, damaged walls and floors, dust, and burnt-out lights. No pests were observed.

headline: Conditions: no employee health policy or training
summary: No employee health policy or training was found on site. A priority violation was issued with a citation. The facility must establish a health policy and training system and keep verifiable documents on site.

headline: Pass: retail packaged foods lack labels
summary: Retail packaged foods in a stand-up refrigerator, such as flan and gelatin, had no label. Labels must show business name and address, food name, ingredients, net quantity, and allergens if applicable.

headline: Pass: broken faucet, signs, and food handler gaps
summary: A timed faucet at an upstairs handsink did not run correctly. Handwashing signs were missing in two areas. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, cutting boards were stained, and three bulbs were burnt out. A manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Conditions: person in charge lacked valid certificate
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid, original sanitation manager certificate; a citation was issued. No allergen training certificate was provided for managers, and the facility was instructed to provide one.

headline: Pass: damaged wall tile near outlet
summary: Damaged or broken wall tile was found in the front prep and ice cream area near an electrical outlet. The facility was told to repair it so the surface is smooth and easily cleaned.

headline: Fail: three-compartment sink floods when drained
summary: When water drains from one compartment of the three-compartment sink, another compartment floods before draining. The manager was instructed to service the sink. A priority violation was issued with a citation.

headline: Pass: certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: A certified food manager did not have a valid allergen training certificate. Management was told all certified food managers must show valid proof of allergen training.

headline: Pass: missing food handler training, debris, damaged surfaces
summary: Food handler training was missing for employees. Items included no handwashing sign, no splash guard, soiled wiping cloths, single-service items stored on the floor, and no stoppers in the three-compartment sink. Grease, debris, damaged baseboards, and ceiling tiles were also noted.

headline: Fail: no soap or paper towels; ice machines slimy
summary: Bar handwashing sinks lacked soap and paper towels; a priority violation with citation. Black and pink slime was inside the ice machines and dripping onto ice. The rear door was not rodent-proofed, and no chlorine test devices were on site. Food handler certificates were missing.

headline: Fail: mouse droppings, gaps under doors, no food handler training
summary: Gaps under front and rear doors allow rodent entry. Over 15 mouse droppings were found near the walk-in freezer and on rear shelving; a prior pest violation was not corrected and pest control service is required. Cardboard and rust were on shelving. No food handler training was found.

headline: Pass: leaks, worn cutting boards, missing training
summary: A leaky supply line was at the front prep handsink, and a women's toilet leaked. Cutting boards were worn, and rust was on walk-in shelving. Gaskets were missing on a hot-holding unit. Food handler training was missing or expired, and no food allergen training was held by managers.

headline: Pass: grease and food debris, missing floor tiles
summary: Accumulated food debris and grease was on walls, floors, and in corners throughout. Multiple floor tiles were missing or damaged in the prep area near the fryers. Dust was on fans, light shields, and vents.

headline: Pass: front door gap, bathrooms need repairs
summary: The front door had a gap over 1/4 inch at the bottom, which must be sealed to keep pests out; no pests were observed. Bathrooms lacked self-closing doors and covered trash cans. Missing coving, unfinished walls, and no ventilation in a bathroom.

headline: Pass: cold water handle broken at coffee-bar sink
summary: The cold water handle at the handsink behind the coffee bar was in disrepair. Management was instructed to repair it.

headline: Fail: unlabeled spices, prior violations not corrected
summary: Spice containers on a front shelf were unlabeled. Grocery bags were used in a reach-in freezer, and the furnace room had clutter that could harbor pests. One certified manager lacked allergen training. Prior core violations were not corrected by the deadline.

headline: Pass: rusty shelving, excessive ice, dirty floors
summary: Wiping cloths were on prep tables instead of sanitizer, and food containers were unlabeled. Rusty shelving was in the basement walk-in and a chest freezer had excess ice. Dirt and debris were under cooking equipment. Employees stored belongings in food prep areas.

headline: Pass: ice bin needs cleaning
summary: The interior of the ice bin needed cleaning. The facility was told to remove the ice, clean it, and maintain it at all times.

headline: Pass: food handler training required
summary: The inspector instructed that all food handlers must obtain the required food handler training. No other issues were recorded.

headline: Pass: unused dish machine and cooler on site
summary: An unused high-temperature dish machine and a two-door cooler on the 43rd floor were found. The facility must repair and maintain them, remove them, or label them out of order.

headline: Fail: no certified manager posted; tableware exposed
summary: The person in charge lacked a certified manager certificate, and the original certificate was posted at another facility. Customer tableware was unprotected. A dumpster lid was broken and not tight-fitting, and a citation was issued.

headline: Fail: no soap or paper towels, ice machine slime
summary: Exposed handsinks in the bar and prep area lacked soap, and the bar sink lacked paper towels; citation issued. Black slime was found inside the ice machine used for ice. A cook and bartender lacked food handler training.

headline: Conditions: 0 ppm dish machine, no allergen training
summary: A first-floor bar dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged held; a citation was issued. Gaskets were broken on a drawer cooler, and a faucet leaked near the basement dish machine. An unused dish machine was in the basement bar. No allergen certificates were on site.

headline: Pass: plates not inverted, employee belongings with food
summary: Serving plates on prep-area shelves were not inverted and must be turned over to prevent dust. Employee belongings were stored on shelves with food in the rear dry storage area. A designated area for belongings is required.

headline: Pass: unlabeled bulk food, missing food guard
summary: Some bulk foods such as oats and pasta had no labels. No food guard was present between the hand sink and the breakfast bar. The sanitation manager had no allergen training.

headline: Fail: about 15 rodent droppings in food prep area
summary: About 15 rodent droppings were found in the dry storage closet in the food prep area. The facility was told to eliminate the activity, clean and sanitize, and contact pest control; this is a priority violation.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager, unscreened side doors
summary: The person in charge had no valid sanitation certificate and none was posted; a citation was issued. Side doors were open without screening. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and fryers and floors needed cleaning. The most recent inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Fail: over 30 small flies, bare-hand contact with food
summary: More than 30 small flies were found in toilet rooms, dining, prep, and dish areas; citation issued and pest control recommended. A worker touched ready-to-eat chicken with bare hands; one pound was discarded. Certificates, health policy, and clean-up kit were missing.

headline: Pass: greasy floors and missing allergen certificate
summary: Grease buildup, food debris, and dirt were on the floor under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners in prep, dish, and storage areas. The manager was told to clean all areas. The sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Pass: residue in ice machine, cutting boards marked
summary: Residue was found on the interior door of the ice machine. A film was on a prep table where juice is stored. Red cutting boards had deep dark markings. The person in charge was told to clean and replace them.

headline: Pass: frozen chicken on floor, floors greasy
summary: Forty pounds of frozen chicken were stored on the floor in the rear prep area and must be elevated. Bulk containers had excessive dried debris. Floors had built-up grease and spills. Only one of two food handler certificates was on site.

headline: Pass: handwashing signs and covered waste cans needed
summary: Handwashing signs were needed at both handsinks and in both washrooms. A sprayer is needed at the three-compartment sink for clean-in-place procedures. Toilet rooms need covered waste cans.

headline: Fail: dead mouse found; pest log not maintained
summary: A dead mouse was on the floor of the large basement storage area and must be removed. The pest control log book had no inspection reports from the past year; this prior priority violation was not corrected and a citation was issued. Fryer, hood, and filters need cleaning.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager, cooler at 68.8F
summary: No certified manager was present while pizza, chicken, and hot dogs were handled; a citation was issued. The customer display cooler measured 68.8F and was tagged held for repair. No employee health policy was provided. Food debris and dim lighting were noted.

headline: Pass: missing signs, thermometers, allergen certificate
summary: No handwashing sign was posted behind the bar, and walk-in coolers lacked ambient air thermometers. Floors and walls upstairs and near the dish machine need cleaning. No allergen training certificate was shown.

headline: Pass: no food handler training, debris, holes in walls
summary: Employees had no food handler training. Holes were in drywall in the rear storage area, and floor tiles in the brewing area needed repair. Debris was on prep tables, a cart, and walls, and there was no backflow device on the ice machine.

headline: Pass: large pots too big for sink, popcorn on floors
summary: Pots and bowls were too large to fully submerge in the three-compartment sink, so an alternative washing method is required. Popcorn was on the floor behind shelving and food storage equipment and must be cleaned.

headline: Fail: no handwashing sink in alcohol prep area
summary: No handwashing sink was in the front alcoholic beverage preparation area. The facility must provide one with soap and paper towels and maintain it. No citation was issued.

headline: Conditions: no sanitation manager, no vomit cleanup kit
summary: The person in charge had no sanitation manager certificate, and no certified manager was present while lamb and chicken were handled. A citation was issued. No vomit cleanup kit was found, and the restroom door was not self-closing.

headline: Fail: no certified manager, sanitizer and hot water too low
summary: No certified manager was on duty while milk and ice cream were handled, and a citation was issued. Sanitizer read 0.0 ppm and prep-sink hot water was 74.5F, below the 100F minimum. Missing health policies, pest log, and thermometer; dumpster overflowing.

headline: Pass: no thermometer in deli cooler
summary: No thermometer was in the deli cooler where sliced melon and onion mix is held. The person in charge was told to provide one. The certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Fail: rat and mouse droppings, flying insects found
summary: Over 30 rat droppings and over 30 mouse droppings were found in several areas, plus several flying insects. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas. Dumpster lacked lids; a washroom had no light or ventilation.

headline: Pass: no food handler certificates on site
summary: A broken, unused dish machine must be removed. No food handler certificates were on site, and one of two certified managers had expired allergen training. Records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Conditions: unsafe food temperatures, glove and hand-washing lapses
summary: Ready-to-eat foods such as pico de gallo at 55.8F and guacamole at 60.8F were above 41F; about 12 pounds, citation issued. A food handler touched ready-to-eat food after handling a cutting board without changing gloves or washing hands. Hair restraints were missing.

headline: Fail: eggs held too warm; 4 pounds discarded
summary: Eggs in a prep-area cold-holding unit measured between 48.4 and 51.6F. The manager voluntarily discarded 4 pounds. Food handlers prepped without hair restraints. A citation was issued, and several prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: Fail: no certified manager, soap missing, dish machine 0 ppm
summary: No certified manager certificate was posted. Restrooms lacked soap and a handsink lacked paper towels. The dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine and was held. Heavy black slime was in the ice machine. Several employees lacked food handler training.

headline: Pass: dirty walk-in cooler floor
summary: The floor under the shelving in the walk-in cooler needed cleaning. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Fail: live flies, no health policy, pest log incomplete
summary: About 25 small live flies were found on walls, ceilings, and floor drains in the prep and dishwashing areas. Additional pest control is required. The employee health policy and a complete pest logbook were missing; several food handlers lacked training.

headline: Pass: boxes and totes stored on floor
summary: Boxes and totes were stored on the floor in the rear prep area and sales floor. The person in charge was told to raise all items at least six inches off the floor at all times.

headline: Fail: no handwashing sink in front prep area
summary: No handwashing sink was in the front prep area, where most food is prepared. A sink must be installed there. No citation was issued.

headline: Fail: repeat cleaning violations, greasy hood
summary: Inspector found dirty floors under prep tables, heavy grease on the hood and filters, and earlier cleaning violations still not fixed. A citation was issued. No pests were noted.

headline: Fail: about 40 live fruit flies, handwashing lapse
summary: A dishwasher wiped hands with a soiled towel after handling soiled dishes, then handled clean dishes; this is a priority violation. About 40 live fruit flies were found in the second-floor kitchen. Ice scoop left in ice, wet dishes stacked, and bulk food unlabeled.

headline: Pass: ramen bowls not inverted, rust on shelving
summary: Ramen bowls on shelves were not inverted. Prep table shelving had rust and must be resurfaced. Large pastry equipment cannot be washed in the sink, so an alternative method is needed. Debris under the dish machine should be removed.

headline: Pass: leaking drain, dirty floors, no allergen training
summary: Food debris and spills were on equipment and surfaces. A drainpipe under the rear handsink and three-compartment sink was leaking. A mop was not stored to dry, which can attract insects. Missing ceiling tiles, no washroom ventilation, and no valid allergen training.

headline: Pass: boxes on floor, holes in walls, missing ceiling tile
summary: Food and non-food boxes were stored on the floor and must be six inches off the floor. Dust was on the condenser fan cover in the walk-in cooler. Openings around the mop sink and in walls must be sealed, and a ceiling tile is missing.

headline: Fail: unsafe cold holding temperatures, food discarded
summary: Prepackaged sushi at 52.7F and salads with meat at 49.8F were discarded, along with cut squash and greens; about 10 pounds, citation issued. Three coolers measured 48-52F air temperature during defrost. Leaks, dirty prep tables, and floors also needed attention.

headline: Pass: slow drain, clutter, food handler proof missing
summary: A toilet room handsink drained slowly. Clutter was on the floor in the toilet room and office, and floors had dirt and food debris. Two food handlers lacked proof of food handler training and must meet it within 30 days of hire.

headline: Fail: over 40 mouse droppings, food on floor
summary: Over 40 mouse droppings were found on a pallet, front counter ledges, and chip shelves. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas. Food was stored on the floor behind the front counter; a citation was issued.

headline: Fail: expired allergen certificate, prior coolers not cleaned
summary: A ceiling light cover at the dish area was loose and must be reattached. One food manager's allergen training certificate had expired. Previous core violations were not corrected: reach-in and walk-in cooler interiors need cleaning, and rear prep ceiling tiles are stained.

headline: Fail: unlabeled food, no hair restraints, leaks
summary: Issues include an open coffee cup in the prep area, unlabeled bulk containers, missing hair and beard restraints, and stored items on floors or milk crates. Sinks leaked, and a prior core violation was not corrected. No food handler training proof was on site.

headline: Pass: rusted sinks, no mop sink, no allergen training
summary: Non-functional, rusted basement sinks must be removed. No utility or mop sink was found. Grease and condensation were on the hood and ceiling. Restrooms lacked mechanical ventilation. Certified managers had no allergen training.

headline: Fail: no food handler certificates, no raw food advisory
summary: The menu lacked a consumer advisory about raw and undercooked foods, a priority violation. Storage containers were not labeled, and fryers were uncovered while closed. Togo containers and tableware were not inverted. No food handler training certificates were on site.

headline: Pass: food stored in grocery bags, splattered walls
summary: Food items were stored inside grocery bags in coolers and refrigeration. Food splatter was found on walls in the sushi prep area. The facility was told to store food in food-grade containers and clean the walls.

headline: Conditions: no person in charge or certified manager on site
summary: No person in charge was on site during inspection, and no certified food manager was present while eggs were being prepared and served. Both are priority violations; a citation was issued.

headline: Fail: overflowing trash, milk crates, greasy floors
summary: Milk crates were used for elevation. An outside waste lid could not close due to overflowing trash; a citation was issued. Grease and burnt debris were under the grill, and cardboard was used for food storage. A basement grease trap and refrigerator must be removed.

headline: Pass: mop sink, self-closing door, training needed
summary: A mop sink with backflow protection and hot and cold water is required. The kitchen washroom needs a self-closing door. The manager was told to meet food handler training rules and allergen training requirements.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food on floor, no training
summary: Food stored on floors and excessive clutter were found, and the manager was told to fix both. No food handler training was available on site; all food employees must complete it.

headline: Pass: hair restraints, wiping cloths, lights and training
summary: Female employees in the prep area lacked hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer when not in use. A chest freezer was in poor repair, a toilet was damaged, and dishwashing area lights were out. Employees lacked proof of food handler training.

headline: Conditions: grease, missing tile, no prep or grease trap
summary: No employee health policy was on premises; no citation. No prep sink was in the sushi area, and no utility sink is installed. Grease and dirt were on the floor under cooking equipment and walls, and a floor tile is missing.

headline: Fail: hot water tank has hole, no hot water
summary: The hot water tank has a hole and must be repaired to supply hot and cold water to sinks; this is a priority violation. The rear screen door is in poor repair and must be fixed to keep pests out. Floors and mats need debris removed.

headline: Pass: rust on walk-in cooler shelves
summary: Passed. Basement walk-in cooler shelves had rust. The person in charge was instructed to remove it and keep nonfood-contact surfaces smooth and cleanable.

headline: Fail: roaches and flies found; prior violation uncorrected
summary: 10 roaches and more than 20 small flies were found throughout the facility, including the dish, prep and dining areas. A prior pest violation was not corrected. Pest control service was required. Manager also lacked an original certificate.

headline: Pass: dirty walk-in cooler and greasy hood
summary: Passed. Walk-in cooler interior, shelving and fan vents were dirty. Rear prep area had grease, food debris and splatter; heavy grease covered the hood and filters. Employee toilet room door closer was broken.

headline: Fail: overflowing outdoor dumpsters and greasy fryer unit
summary: Outdoor dumpsters overflowed and could not close; citation issued. Trash must be stored inside receptacles to keep out insects and rodents. Deep fryer oil filter unit and rear prep area had grease and food debris.

headline: Conditions: menu disclosure fixed on site
summary: Menu lacked an asterisk and disclosure for animal-derived foods served cooked to order; corrected on site before inspection ended, no citation. Exposed wood on a bar shelf must be sealed, and kitchen hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Pass: missing splashguard, dirty cooler interiors, floors
summary: Passed. A washable splashguard is required at the hand sink, scoops were stored inside dry-storage containers, and a cooler door gasket is damaged. Food debris, grease and dirt were found in coolers, floors and hood filters.

headline: Pass: damaged cutting boards, chipping paint, broken lid
summary: Passed. Cutting boards had open seams and stains and must be refinished or replaced. Ceiling paint was chipping in basement prep and dish storage, and a cold-holding unit lid was broken.

headline: Fail: no certified manager, no hot handwash water
summary: No certified manager was on duty while pizza and sausage were handled. No employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure was on site. Hand sink lacked hot water (72.7°F). Food handler certificates were missing. Prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Pass: ice machine buildup, scoop stored improperly
summary: Passed. Slight buildup was found inside the upper ice machine, which the manager must clean. An ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine; a clean container is required.

headline: Pass: backflow device, dumpster area, mop drying
summary: Passed re-inspection. The utility sink lacked a backflow device, trash and debris were on the ground around the dumpster, and there was no system for hanging mops to dry.

headline: Fail: front door gap, uncorrected food debris violation
summary: A 1/2-inch gap under the front entrance door must be sealed to keep out rodents. A prior violation for food debris and spills throughout the facility was not corrected and must be fixed by the re-inspection date.

headline: Fail: hair restraints, floor storage, dirty surfaces
summary: Employees lacked hair restraints during food prep. Items stored on floors, wiping cloths left on prep tables, dirty coolers and walls. Previous violations, including improperly stored utensils and a damaged wall, were not corrected.

headline: Fail: restroom hand sink hot water only 61°F
summary: Hot water at the employee toilet-room hand sink reached only 61°F; at least 100°F is required (citation issued). Food prep hand sinks lacked signs, the ice cream and slushy machines lacked a written procedure, and the manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Pass: door gaps, missing signs, no allergen training
summary: Passed. Some hand sinks lacked signage. Gaps of about 1/4 inch at the front entrance and rear exit doors must be made rodent-proof. No food allergen training certificate was on site for certified managers.

headline: Pass: inadequate lighting in walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. Lighting in the walk-in cooler was inadequate; the inspector instructed the facility to provide better lighting.

headline: Conditions: no health policy or food handler certificates
summary: No employee health policy and no food handler certificates were on site. Management was told to keep a signed policy for each employee and certificates on site at all times. New hires have a 30-day grace period. No citation issued today.

headline: Conditions: dead flies on sticky strips
summary: Sticky insect strips filled with dead small and large flies hung above food prep and warewashing equipment. Strips must be replaced and relocated. No certified food manager was on site while open; citation issued. Leaks at the 3-compartment sink need repair.

headline: Fail: live flies and rodent droppings found
summary: At least 25 live small black flies were found near floor drains and in several prep and storage areas, and about 7 large rodent droppings were in the bar prep area. Cold food at 48.9–54°F was discarded. Health policies were missing.

headline: Pass: dirty beverage cooler racks; no allergen proof
summary: Beverage cooler racks had excessive debris and black, blue and white substance; deep cleaning and sanitizing required. No proof of allergen training was provided for certified food managers; documentation must be kept on site.

headline: Fail: 30+ live flies; unsafe hot-holding temperatures
summary: At least 30 live small flies were found near the mop sink and grease trap. Hot-holding cabinet read 82.4°F with TCS foods inside, and cooked rice at 113–118°F was discarded. No certified manager was on duty. Pest-control service was recommended.

headline: Fail: cold foods too warm; no certified manager
summary: Milk, whipping cream and mayo were held at 46.7–51.4°F; 25 lbs were discarded on site. A small cold unit ran at 52.5°F and was tagged. No certified manager was on premises. No pest-control logbook was kept.

headline: Pass: soiled wiping cloths, dirty coolers, clutter
summary: Passed. Soiled wiping cloths were on a prep table and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Debris and spills were on bulk containers, coolers and freezers. Front counter, prep and storage areas were cluttered.

headline: Pass: soiled floors, drains and cooler interior
summary: Passed. Sandwich-line cooler, storage-shelf floor and a rear floor drain were heavily soiled. A toilet handle leaked onto the floor, a unisex restroom lacked a covered trash can, and a storage area light was out.

headline: Pass: detailed cleaning needed throughout kitchen
summary: Passed. Inspector instructed detailed cleaning of refrigerator interiors, cooking equipment exteriors, bulk containers, floors, walls, vents, and light covers. Dust and food spills were noted throughout, including above the fryers.

headline: Fail: greasy equipment, buckled floors, repeat violations
summary: Sink basins, prep tables and potato slicer were stained, greasy or encrusted. Flooring was buckled in several areas. Walls near the hot-holding unit had grease. Prior violations from 4/23/24 on fryers and floors were not corrected.

headline: Fail: live roaches and mouse droppings still present
summary: Pest activity persisted: 3 live roaches (freezer doors, basement) and mouse droppings (2nd floor, basement). Pest control service was recommended. Severe grease buildup near fryers and cooking equipment was also noted.

headline: Pass: missing splashguard at prep handwash sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. The front prep hand sink lacked a splashguard next to the slicer; the inspector instructed the facility to install a washable, durable one.

headline: Pass: wiping cloths and floor debris
summary: Passed. Sushi prep wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution between uses. Spilled rice debris under storage racks needed detail cleaning.

headline: Pass: no food handler certificate on site
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificate was provided on site during inspection; the facility was instructed to provide one.

headline: Fail: mouse droppings too many to count
summary: Mouse droppings, too numerous to count, were found in the rear prep area and restroom. About 100 lbs raw chicken held at 45–56.6°F was denatured. Unlabeled TCS foods were also discarded; food handler certificates were missing.

headline: Pass: moldy wall, ice bin, bulk container labels
summary: Passed. Blackened, moldy wall at the dish sink must be cleaned. Upper ice bin needs cleaning, bulk containers need common-name labels, and a food handler lacked an effective hair restraint. Basement stored items must be raised off the floor.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. PIC could not provide a vomit/diarrhea procedure. Employees lacked food handler certificates. Front door had a 1/2-inch gap that must be rodent-proofed.

headline: Fail: rat droppings and flies found
summary: About 20–30 rat droppings were in the rear basement, with more at the DJ booth and dart machine. Over 30 flies swarmed soiled linens. Pest control was recommended. Missing bar hand sink, door gap, and uncorrected trash-lid violation also cited.

headline: Pass: clutter, greasy hood, dirty floors and cobwebs
summary: Passed. Small deep freezer needs defrosting and cleaning, and cooking equipment exteriors need degreasing. Kitchen clutter must be removed, floors need cleaning, cobwebs must be removed, and the hood and filters need grease cleaning.

headline: Pass: leaks at prep cooler and sink
summary: Passed. A condenser was leaking in a prep cooler, and a small leak was found at the pipe under the 3-compartment sink. Both must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Pass: dirty floors, equipment and hood filters
summary: Passed. Dairy walk-in floor under shelving, equipment sides with dust, bar-area and dish-area floors, and hood filters all need detail cleaning.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager; hand sink blocked
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while sandwiches and nachos were prepared; citation issued. Rear prep handsink was blocked by utensils, a food container, and soda pallet. Food stored on walk-in floors must be raised six inches.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager on duty
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods such as hummus, rice and chicken were prepared and served; citation issued. Several employees' health policies were missing. A gap at the rear door must be sealed to keep out insects.

headline: Fail: rear door gaps, sink backup, uncovered food
summary: Gaps around the rear exterior door create a pest-entry risk. Food in the freezer was uncovered. Wastewater backed up at the 3-compartment sink (citation issued). Cardboard was used on table bottoms and equipment tops. PIC lacked allergen training.

headline: Pass: manager lacks allergen training
summary: The certified manager on duty had no allergen training. Inspector instructed all certificate holders to complete allergen training and keep records on site.

headline: Pass: dead insects found; training proof missing
summary: Dead insects were found behind a 2-door refrigerator in the first-floor prep area and on basement prep floors; the inspector instructed cleaning and sanitizing. A male food handler lacked proof of food handler training. A hand-washing sign was missing.

headline: Pass: ice machine debris, unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior had encrusted debris and must be cleaned and serviced. Bulk containers lacked common-name labels. Grease, debris and dust needed cleaning, and the unisex washroom door lacked a self-closing device.

headline: Pass: gap at bottom of front door
summary: Passed. A small gap under the front entry door should be closed with a sweep to prevent pest entry.

headline: Pass: food on floor, ice machine residue
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food stored on the floor in the rear area must be raised six inches. Residue was found inside the front ice machine and must be cleaned.

headline: Conditions: no certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site, and no certificate was posted, while deli meat and chicken were handled and served. Facility was instructed to obtain one.

headline: Pass: grease buildup and damaged floor tiles
summary: Passed re-inspection. Grease and food debris must be cleaned from grill tables, fryer cabinets and coolers. Also needed: rust removal, peeling paint repair, broken floor tiles fixed, and hood filters cleaned.

headline: Conditions: warm foods discarded; failing prep cooler
summary: Salmon, cut tomatoes, chicken salad and eggs at 59–64°F were discarded (about 20 lbs). Front prep cooler could not hold 41°F or below. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. A basement refrigerator had a puddle of blood on it.

headline: Fail: dirty ice machine dripping into ice
summary: Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for human consumption. All ice was voluntarily discarded; the interior must be cleaned by re-inspection. Grease and food buildup on hood filters also needs cleaning.

headline: Pass: milk crates as shelving, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Floors and corners had loose debris and dust; more frequent cleaning was instructed.

headline: Pass: missing backflow devices, ceiling and vent repairs
summary: Passed. Utility sink, ice machine, espresso and coffee machines lacked backflow preventers. A ceiling hole, damaged ceiling tiles, and a non-working toilet-room ventilation fan also need repair.

headline: Pass: unlabeled containers, food on floor
summary: Passed. Food storage containers lacked common-name labels and were stored on the prep-area floor. Food in plastic grocery bags was in the refrigerator and freezer. Milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced.

headline: Conditions: warm food discarded; prep cooler tagged
summary: Egg and sausage patties at 53.4°F and 58.3°F were discarded. Prep cooler read 62.4°F and is tagged; the health department must be contacted to remove the tag. Thermometer was inaccurate, ice maker had grime, and women's restroom lacked a covered receptacle.

headline: Fail: no certified manager; no pest service log
summary: PIC lacked a valid city food manager certificate. Caesar salad made with raw eggs had no consumer advisory. No licensed pest-control logbook; rear door had a 1/4-inch gap. Also noted: no metal stem thermometer, missing backflow device, and clutter.

headline: Pass: food on freezer floor, debris on shelves
summary: Passed. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Food debris was on prep-table shelves, bin exteriors and cooler shelves. Floor behind the cooking line needed cleaning.

headline: Conditions: non-service dog at meat counter
summary: A customer's dog was at the meat counter; the customer claimed it was a service dog but would not say what work it does. Customer left voluntarily after correction. Citation issued.

headline: Conditions: no vomit cleanup kit or procedure
summary: No vomit and diarrheal spill kit or cleanup procedure was on site. Rear coolers lacked ambient air thermometers. Soda, water and bananas were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Washroom trash can lacked a cover.

headline: Pass: new employee needs food handler training
summary: Passed re-inspection. A new employee must complete food handler training.

headline: Pass: signage, cooler gasket, restroom lid needed
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs are needed in customer restrooms, a torn gasket on a two-door prep cooler must be repaired, and the employee unisex restroom needs a lidded trash can.

headline: Pass: milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed re-inspection. Milk crates were still used as shelving in prep and storage areas. Shelving must be replaced with units at least 6 inches off the floor for cleaning access.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager until 2:20 PM
summary: No certified food manager was on site when inspection began at 1:45 PM while TCS foods were being handled; the certified manager arrived at 2:20 PM. Citation issued. Also noted unlabeled condiment bottles, no hair restraint, and missing allergen training certificates.

headline: Pass: no trash lid; cluttered storage room
summary: Passed re-inspection. Employee washroom lacked a covered trash receptacle. Electrical box storage room floor was cluttered; items must be raised off the floor or removed.

headline: Conditions: no health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No verifiable employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea kit and procedure was on site. Food handler and allergen training certificates were not on site. Walk-in cooler door gasket is torn. Bulbs in both cook-line hoods are burnt out.

headline: Pass: expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Several food handler certificates were expired, and expired allergen training certificates were on site. Cold-holding unit gaskets had grime. Staff were told to renew certificates and keep them on site.

headline: Fail: rodent droppings found again, not corrected
summary: Prior rodent violation not corrected. About 35 small rodent droppings were on shelving where tobacco is stored, plus droppings in the toilet room and behind the cleaning-products wall. Soda crates must be replaced with proper shelving.

headline: Pass: milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Conditions: no employee health policy
summary: No employee health policy was in place. The person in charge must provide documentation that employees must report illnesses transmissible through food. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Pass: items on floor, uncovered trash in toilet room
summary: Passed. Boxed single-service items were stored on the floor in the rear prep area and must be raised off the floor. The employee toilet room lacked a covered trash receptacle, and floors and walls needed cleaning.

headline: Fail: no certified manager, bare-hand food contact
summary: No original sanitation certificate on site during inspection. Employee handled ranch dressing with bare hands; 30 cups discarded. Rear prep sink lacked soap, corrected on site. Pest control logbook was incomplete. Overflowing dumpsters were also noted.

headline: Pass: no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates were on site for working food employees. Employees who are not certified food managers must get basic food handler training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Pass: dirty floors, ice buildup in freezer
summary: Passed re-inspection. Floors in several prep, storage and office areas needed cleaning. Built-up ice on the walk-in freezer floor must be removed, and items must be raised at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Fail: cold foods too warm; sanitizer not working
summary: Cold ready-to-eat foods at 48–53°F were discarded (about 11.7 lbs). Dish sanitizer read 0.0 ppm and dishes were not properly sanitized. Restroom hand sinks reached only 75.7–76.5°F, below 100°F. Also noted: missing beard guard, rust, worn cutting boards.

headline: Pass: employee toilet trash lid missing
summary: Passed. The employee toilet room trash receptacle was missing a lid; the inspector instructed the facility to provide one.

headline: Fail: rodent droppings and chicken held too warm
summary: About 30–40 rodent droppings were found on the floor behind the pet food storage area. About 5 lbs of chicken bake items held at 60.1°F were discarded. Pest control service was recommended. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: items on floor, hair restraints, dirty equipment
summary: Passed, with several corrections required. Items were stored on floors, wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces, and an employee prepared food without a hair restraint. Cooking equipment, floors, and a hand sink with low water pressure also need attention.

headline: Pass: uncovered raw meat, garbage bag liners
summary: Passed. Raw chicken and beef in a storage unit needed covers. A garbage bag lined a container of raw meat in the walk-in cooler and must be removed. Cardboard used as floor mats in rear storage must be removed too.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: No certified manager was on site at inspection start, and none was present while raw eggs, deli meats and sandwiches were handled. Main prep hand sink had no hot or cold water; it was repaired on site.

headline: Pass: fly strips hung in prep area
summary: Passed. Fly strips hung in prep must be removed. Packaged melon was improperly labeled, and debris was on coolers and shelving. Leaking utility faucet, broken floor tiles, and mold-like wall substance need repair.

headline: Pass: unlabeled food, dirty freezers and hood
summary: Passed. Food removed from original packaging in coolers needs product-name labels. Freezers need detail cleaning or defrosting, floors and walls need cleaning, and the hood, filters and light shields need detail cleaning.

headline: Fail: no certified manager; washroom water 65.9°F
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Employee washroom sink had no hot water (65.9°F); repaired during inspection. Food stored on floor; wiping cloths on prep tables.

headline: Fail: no health policy; dripping ice machine buildup
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. Rear ice machine had black, brown and pink buildup dripping onto ice used for human consumption. Ice scoop and juice stored in bar ice bin; plastic stuffed in sink drain.

headline: Pass: missing signage, food debris, crate shelving
summary: Passed. A hand-washing sign was missing at the washroom sink. Single-service utensils were not inverted, milk crates were used as shelving, and food debris and spills were found on equipment and coolers. Vent cover and basement paint also need repair.

headline: Fail: no hand-sink water, unsafe food temperatures
summary: Two bar hand sinks had no water. Cold foods held at 45–63°F were discarded, including yogurt, sliced deli meats and chicken sandwiches. Oatmeal held at 124°F was discarded. Dish machine lacked a temperature indicator.

headline: Conditions: improper sanitizing and unsafe bean temperatures
summary: Utensils were sanitized at 0.0 ppm in a one-compartment sink; citation issued. Cooked beans were held at 118.9°F (hot) and 51.8°F (cold) and discarded. Also required: food handler training for all employees and allergen training for the food manager.

headline: Conditions: no employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site. A 1/4-inch gap between the wall and floor under the 3-compartment sink must be sealed. Ventilation vents above cooking equipment were missing, and the food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Conditions: oysters lacked required shellfish tags
summary: Fresh oysters sold on site lacked the required 90-day shellfish tags; about 3 lbs were voluntarily discarded. Women's washroom had no covered trash receptacle, and damaged floor tiles at the meat prep area need repair.

headline: Conditions: no health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy, vomit/diarrhea procedure or kit was on site. Food lacked common-name labels, plastic crates were used for storage, and the outdoor grease container needed cleaning. New employee needs a food handler certificate within 30 days.

headline: Pass: missing backflow devices, clutter, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Mop sink, ice machine and coffee machine lacked backflow prevention devices. Toilet-room trash can had no lid. Storage area was cluttered, floors had dirt and debris, and mops were not stored properly.

headline: Pass: no lidded trash can; floor repairs needed
summary: Passed. Staff women's toilet room had no lidded garbage can. Floor near the ice machine needs grouting, and spilled liquid on the floor must be cleaned and kept dry.

headline: Pass: unlabeled toppings and scoops corrected on site
summary: Passed. Ice cream toppings were out of packaging without labels; the employee labeled them during inspection. Ice scoops and tongs sat in standing water; the employee corrected this on site.

headline: Fail: no pest log; food stored on floor
summary: No pest control logbook with service receipts was on site; citation issued. Food stored on floors in walk-in cooler and basement; knives stored improperly. Employees lacked food handler training, and managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Pass: unlabeled food containers, dirty floors and vents
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food removed from packaging was not labeled with its name in coolers, walk-in cooler and dry storage. Floors, walls and vents had grease, debris and dust that needed cleaning.

headline: Pass: grocery bags used for food storage
summary: Passed. Plates were stored facing up and must be inverted. Grocery bags were used for food storage in the walk-in freezer; food-grade containers are required.

headline: Fail: cooler too warm; pest service log outdated
summary: A cold-holding unit could not keep food at 41°F or lower; ambient air was 50.4°F. Inspector instructed that it be serviced. Pest control logbook was not maintained; last service report was February 2024. No citation issued.

headline: Fail: live rat found under fryer
summary: One live rat was found under the kitchen fryer compartment. Additional pest control service is needed; citation issued. Bar hand sinks lacked splashguards, and holes were found in walls near the floor pipe and ice machine.

headline: Pass: dead insect buildup in basement storage
summary: Significant buildup of dead ants, gnats and flies was found in the basement liquor dry storage area and must be removed regularly. Handwashing sinks in the basement and corner bar lacked signage, and a bulk bin was greasy.

headline: Pass: rear door gap, dirty coolers and vents
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door should be sealed to prevent possible pest entry. Reach-in cooler interiors, floors under equipment, and fan vents need cleaning.

headline: Pass: missing thermometers, dirty coolers and floors
summary: Passed. Cooling units lacked thermometers; food was stored on the floor in the rear prep area; reach-in coolers had food debris; grease and dirt on floors and walls; employee belongings in prep area.

headline: Conditions: untagged shellfish discarded; prior violations uncorrected
summary: About 8 lbs of shellstock lacked tags and was discarded ($80). Food handlers ate in the prep area and lacked hair restraints. Noodles and stock were stored on the floor. Prior food handler and allergen training violations were not corrected.

headline: Pass: leaky pipe under front prep hand sink
summary: Passed. A leaky pipe under the front prep area hand sink must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Fail: handwash water too cool; moldy ice machine
summary: Handwashing sinks in the women's washroom reached only 91.2°F and 95.5°F; at least 100°F is required (citation issued). Mold-like substance was found inside the kitchen ice machine. Menu lacked required disclosure for undercooked-to-order steak.

headline: Conditions: no hand soap at prep station
summary: No hand soap was at the front oyster and raw fish prep station; a priority violation. The prep cooler thermometer must be moved to the front. Fly traps above second-floor prep areas and brooms near clean utensils must be moved.

headline: Passed; floor debris and missing coving
summary: Floor drains and floors in the produce cooler and hallway had food debris and must be cleaned. Ceramic coving is missing at the deli cooler, and plastic coving is peeling in the deli storage room. Milk crates and rubber hoses are prohibited.

headline: Passed; rear door gap needs rodent proofing
summary: A 1/2 inch gap was found between the rear exit double doors and must be rodent proofed. Food debris was on second-floor prep shelves, dust was on first-floor walls, and the first-floor ventilation hood needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; no allergen training proof for managers
summary: Certified food managers had no proof of allergen training on site. They must obtain the certificate and keep it on site at all times.

headline: Passed; fly strips and worn cooler gaskets
summary: Fly strips were in the rear prep area and must be removed from food prep areas. A reach-in cooler has worn gaskets with food buildup and rusted shelving. Cooking equipment and air vent ceilings need cleaning.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on the premises, and management must keep them on site. The food manager also lacks allergen training proof. Pink buildup and peeling ceiling paint were noted.

headline: Passed; missing allergen training for managers
summary: Certified managers were missing allergen training. Management must provide verification on site and maintain it.

headline: Passed; grease trap not located on site
summary: The person in charge could not locate the grease trap on the premises. The restroom garbage receptacle lacks a cover. Wall base and ceiling paint are damaged in prep and restroom areas.

headline: Passed; employees eating in food prep area
summary: Employees were seen eating in the front food prep area while TCS food was being prepared. Management must stop this and provide a separate eating area. Ice machine non-food surfaces had rust debris.

headline: Passed; cleaning needs and a faucet leak
summary: Nozzles and cooking equipment need detail cleaning. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution. The front handwash sink faucet leaks, and coving at the prep line needs repair.

headline: Passed; leaking sink and dirty outdoor enclosure
summary: Food liquid had built up on pipes under the 3-compartment sink, and the faucet and pipe leak. The outdoor enclosure around garbage and oil containers is not clean and must have debris and leaves removed.

headline: Passed; single-use items stored on floor
summary: Single-service articles were stored on the floor in the basement storage areas. The manager was told to invert and elevate them off the floor.

headline: Failed: potatoes held at 54°F, discarded
summary: Failed. Twice-baked potatoes were held at 54°F, a priority violation; the manager discarded 10 lbs, valued at $30. A citation was issued. The 3-compartment sink drains slowly, and walk-in shelving is rusted.

headline: Passed; employee items stored above food
summary: Employee personal items were stored in the walk-in cooler above covered greens and must be moved to a designated area. The basement two-door cooler interior was soiled with rust and food debris.

headline: Passed; leaking sink faucet and greasy fryer
summary: The left 3-compartment sink faucet leaks at its base, and the right sprayer is not attached; both must be fixed. The fryer interior has thick grease and dirt. Cutting boards are stained and need sanding or replacement.

headline: Passed; cardboard used as basement shelving
summary: Cardboard was being used as shelving in the basement. The manager was told to remove it.

headline: Passed; unlabeled packaged cookies, front door gap
summary: Packaged cookies containing walnuts were not properly labeled. A small gap at the front door must be sealed tightly to prevent pests. Water-stained ceiling tiles should be replaced.

headline: Conditions: no employee health policy or cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy was on premises, a priority violation. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit was on site; a priority violation was also cited. Food handlers must obtain the required food handler training.

headline: Passed; grime inside two sinks
summary: Grime had built up inside the handwash sink and the 3-compartment sink. Management must clean the interior of both sinks.

headline: Passed; light shield in poor repair
summary: The light shield above the fryers is in poor repair. The person in charge was told to replace it and keep it maintained.

headline: Passed; expired food handler certificates
summary: Food handler certificates on site were expired and must be renewed. The back screen door is not rodent or insect proof, so the inner door must stay closed. Cooler racks have rust, and walls and vents are dirty.

headline: Conditions: cold food above safe temperature
summary: Cold food in a prep cooler was above 41°F: deli meat 49.4°F, chicken 51.5°F and 47.3°F, sliced tomatoes 47.6°F. About 50 lbs were discarded. The cooler was tagged and held for inspection.

headline: Passed; equipment stored in mechanical room
summary: Multi-use equipment was stored in the basement mechanical room, which is prohibited. A small refrigeration unit lacks a thermometer. Single-service items were stored under a handwash sink, and a main handwash sink cold faucet leaks.

headline: Passed; dust, grease, and vent cleaning needed
summary: Dust was on walk-in cooler fan covers in the dairy and deli kitchens. Floors by the sushi fryer and under deli cooking equipment need cleaning. Vents above several cooking areas need cleaning.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS food was prepared; a citation was issued. No food handler training was available. Food stored on floors, leaks, soiled wiping cloths, and debris were also noted.

headline: Passed; small leak at sink drain
summary: A small leak was found at the 3-compartment sink drainpipe in the rear prep area. Management must repair and maintain it.

headline: Conditions: no employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and one must be provided in writing for each employee. A handwash sign is missing in the customer restroom, and the 3-compartment sink faucet base leaks. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed: untagged clams discarded on site
summary: Failed. Fresh clams in the display cooler had no shellstock tag. Management voluntarily discarded them on site (about 3 lbs, $20). No barrier protects the food prep area from customers, and backflow devices were missing on two units.

headline: Passed; employee belongings stored improperly
summary: Employee personal belongings were stored improperly and must be moved to designated areas. Low water pressure was found at the prep area handwash sink, which must be repaired.

headline: Passed; heavy grease and food buildup
summary: Reach-in cooler gaskets, a can opener, cooking equipment, fry cart, and prep tables need detail cleaning. Cutting boards are worn and need cleaning or replacing. Floors and hood filters have grease buildup.

headline: Failed: repeat violations not corrected
summary: Failed. Violations from October 2023 were not corrected. Items included food on floors in the walk-in and freezer, damaged gaskets, rust, grease buildup, openings in walls, stained ceiling tiles, and water on the basement floor.

headline: Passed; food truck missing license number
summary: The food truck is missing license numbering on its left side. Management was told to install it.

headline: Passed; hair restraint and utensil storage issues
summary: A food handler at the front prep area lacked a hair restraint. In-use knives were kept in sanitizer, which is not allowed. Disposable spoons were used in food production, and employee bags were kept in food prep areas.

headline: Failed: about 50 live flies; handwashing lapses
summary: Failed. Over 50 live small flies were in the dining, prep, and storage areas, plus 5-7 large flies. No valid manager certificate was posted while food was prepared. A worker made a sandwich without washing hands, and the only prep-area handsink was blocked.

headline: Conditions: no manager on site; bare-hand food contact
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open; a citation was issued. A worker assembled a breakfast sandwich with bare hands, and about $8 of food was discarded. Two handwashing sinks were blocked and were cleared when instructed.

headline: Re-inspection passed; expired food handler certificates
summary: Food handlers had expired certificates and must update them and keep records on site. A disposable cup was used as a scoop; handled utensils must be provided instead.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and 25 live flies
summary: Failed. About 30 mouse droppings were in the utility closet, 10 under a washroom crate, and 15 in rear corners. About 25 live flies were in storage, washroom, and dish areas. Pest control was called for; citation issued.

headline: Passed; missing cooler thermometers, cardboard liners
summary: Working thermometers must be provided inside coolers. A rear cooler gasket is coming off. Cardboard was used as shelf liners and must be removed. Floors and walls in the rear prep area need cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection passed; dusty vent covers
summary: Dust had built up on the ceiling vent covers above the dishwashing area. Management was told to detail clean them and keep them maintained.

headline: Passed; no light in walk-in cooler
summary: The walk-in cooler had no light and must have adequate lighting. An oven thermometer was stored in the walk-in cooler and freezer and must be replaced with a refrigerator thermometer. The outdoor lid has a hole.

headline: Passed; no allergen training for manager on duty
summary: The certified manager on duty had no allergen training. Other items included a missing handwashing sign, single-service items not inverted in the basement, and food debris on equipment and in the cooler.

headline: Re-inspection passed; no food handler training proof
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided, and all food handlers must provide it. No allergen training certificates were on site. Gaskets, shelving, floors, and a floor drain need cleaning or repair.

headline: Passed; front door gap and missing ice cream procedure
summary: The front door has a 1/2 inch gap and is not rodent or insect proof; it must be sealed. No written cleaning procedure for the ice cream machine was on site. Reach-in freezers have ice buildup and spills.

headline: Re-inspection passed; dirty floors
summary: Dirt and debris were on the floor in the rear dishwashing room and basement dry storage. Management must keep floors clean and dry at all times.

headline: Failed; repeat violation: no grease trap
summary: Failed. A violation from January 2025 was not fixed: there is no grease trap at the 3-compartment sink. It must be installed and maintained by the reinspection date.

headline: Passed; small leak under prep sink
summary: A small leak was found in the pipe under the hand sink in the front prep line. Water also drains very slowly. Management must repair it.

headline: Conditions: no soap, expired food handler training
summary: Hand soap was missing at a handwashing sink; corrected on site when the manager provided soap. Also found: expired food handler training (repeat), meat thawing at room temperature, undated food, and food on floors.

headline: Passed; greasy fryers and cardboard liner
summary: Cardboard was used as a counter liner and must be removed. Grease had built up inside the fryers and behind cooking equipment. Management was told to degrease, clean, and sanitize.

headline: Conditions: dead roaches found; sanitizer corrected
summary: Dish machine sanitizer was at 0 ppm and was corrected on site to 100 ppm. About 10 dead roaches were under the dish machine, about 10 along the bar, and about 15 in a corner storage room. Manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Failed: about 30 rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. About 30 rodent droppings were found in the rear corner by dry storage shelves. Management must eliminate pests, clean, and call pest control. A dumpster overflow was also cited.

headline: Passed; peeling walls and grimy ice machine
summary: Grime was on the ice machine door and sides. The microwave interior is peeling and damaged. Black grime is behind the 3-compartment sink, and the walls near the hot holding table are peeling. A restroom sink is pulling away from the wall.

headline: Conditions: no written employee health policy
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. Management must set one up and keep signed copies on site for all food employees. No citation was issued.

headline: Passed; heavy ice in walk-in freezer
summary: The walk-in freezer ceiling has heavy ice buildup and must be defrosted. Mineral buildup was found inside the soda gun at the coffee bar. Minor food spills near the prep mixer must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; loose wall coving in storage
summary: Wall coving is loose in the rear storage area across from the utility sink. Management was told to reattach it where needed.

headline: Re-inspection passed; hood grease buildup
summary: Grease had built up on the ventilation hood and filters. Management was told to clean them.

headline: Passed; utensils in room temperature water
summary: Large spoons were kept in room-temperature water and must be stored according to the health code. Cardboard was used to cover a prep table and must not be used on food contact surfaces.

headline: Re-inspection passed; unlabeled containers, stained cutting board
summary: Bulk dry ingredients and seasonings above the 3-compartment sink were stored in unlabeled containers. A cutting board at the prep cooler has deep stains and must be cleaned or replaced.

headline: Passed; food stored on freezer floor
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer. They must be at least 6 inches above the ground. The ice machine drip plate was slightly soiled and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: about 30 live flying insects found
summary: Failed. About 30 live small flying insects were seen on walls and ceilings in food prep, dining, and restrooms. More pest control service is needed. Litter outside the dumpsters was also cited.

headline: Re-inspection passed; food on floor, scoop in ice
summary: Food containers were on the walk-in and prep floors and must be elevated. The ice scoop was stored with its handle in the ice. The ice bin and chest freezer need cleaning. A hood light bulb was burned out.

headline: Passed; grill partly outside vent hood
summary: The 3-compartment sink has no stoppers. The women's restroom has no covered receptacle. Unused equipment in rear storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Part of the grill was not under the ventilation hood.

headline: Passed; food debris and mold-like wall damage
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Food spills and debris were on sinks, coolers, and freezers. Water damage with a mold-like substance was found on walls in the rear storage and office area.

headline: Passed; unlabeled dry storage containers
summary: Dry storage containers were missing labels with the common name. The 3-compartment sink has improper stoppers, the toilet room receptacle has no cover, and the walk-in cooler light lacks a shield.

headline: Passed; single-use items stored on floor
summary: Single-service articles were stored on the floor in the basement storage closet. The manager was told to elevate them off the floor.

headline: Failed: handwashing sinks blocked or missing supplies
summary: Failed. A basement handwashing sink is missing its drainpipe, and a bar handwash sink was used to store items. Soap and paper towels were missing at sinks, and reach-in coolers had no thermometers. Food was stored on the floor.

headline: Passed; leak under dishwashing handwash sink
summary: A leak was found in the piping under the handwashing sink in the dishwashing area. Management must repair and maintain it.

headline: Passed; leaking sink and grease buildup
summary: Food containers in the east storage area lack common-name labels. A reach-in cooler has a broken gasket, the microwave has encrusted debris, and cardboard is used as shelf liner. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks.

headline: Failed: over 50 rat droppings, flying insects
summary: Failed. Over 50 rat droppings were found behind cooking equipment, along the walk-in, and under the 3-compartment sink. Numerous flying insects were seen in several areas. An exterminator was ordered. Hand drying, food labels, and sink faucet reach were also cited.

headline: Re-inspection passed; leaking sprayer, mold-like buildup
summary: Food handlers lacked hair restraints. The sanitizer test strip kit was improper, and a citation was issued. The 3-compartment sink sprayer leaks heavily, and a handsink runs when unused. Mold-like buildup was above the sink.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, no handsink in prep
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while Italian beef was prepared and served. Prep and dish areas had no handwashing sink. No employee health policy or food handler training was available. Food was stored on the floor.

headline: Re-inspection passed; food handler training required
summary: All food handlers must obtain the required food handler training. Refrigerators, fryers, prep tables, and walk-in cooler shelves need cleaning, including shelves to reduce an odor.

headline: Passed; slight buildup inside ice machines
summary: Slight buildup was found inside the ice machines. The manager was told to clean the interior and maintain it.

headline: Passed; debris on floors
summary: Debris was on floors along walls and in corners in the prep, storage, and dish areas. The manager was told to clean and maintain them.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: No person in charge or certified manager certificate was on site while cooked chicken and pork were prepared; a citation was issued. A plastic tub was used as a scoop and utensils were stored improperly. Employee washrooms lack mechanical ventilation.

headline: Passed; torn cooler gasket, milk crates in use
summary: A prep service cooler has a torn gasket that must be repaired or replaced. Milk crates were used for elevation and must not be used, to prevent pest hiding places. Floors along the wall base need cleaning.

headline: Passed; no allergen training certificates on site
summary: An employee with a beard did not wear a beard restraint in the prep area. Grease was in the deep fryer, and debris was in the crawl space. An additional food handler certificate is required on site, and no allergen certificates were on site.

headline: Conditions: ground pork held at 56.8°F, discarded
summary: Seven pounds of ground pork measured 56.8°F in a two-door refrigerator, though the unit and other food were at 39°F. The pork was discarded on site, about $40. One food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; greasy griddle and debris-filled floors
summary: The griddle area had heavy grease and debris buildup. Floors throughout the kitchen had debris buildup. The manager was told to clean both.

headline: Passed; stained cutting boards and rust
summary: Cutting boards had deep, dark grooves and stains and must be repaired or replaced. A bottom shelf on the prep tables had rust that must be removed so the surface is smooth and cleanable.

headline: Passed; no proof of food handler training
summary: Food handlers had no proof of training, and management must keep records on site. Food containers were stored on floors, a pink substance was in the ice bin, and wet wiping cloths were left out. Food manager allergen training proof is also missing.

headline: Passed; hair restraint and cleaning issues
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint and was told to wear one. Rusty racks, a broken toilet top, dirty storage racks, and food debris on freezer floors were also noted.

headline: Passed; grease trap and cooler repairs needed
summary: Grease built up on the outside of the grease trap. The walk-in cooler door sweep is broken and the walk-in condenser unit is leaking. Management was told to clean and repair.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and live fruit flies
summary: Failed. Over 20 mouse droppings were in prep walls and corners, over 15 under the dishwasher, and about 20 in second-floor storage. Over 20 live fruit flies were near the mop sink. Pest control was recommended. No employee health policy was available.

headline: Passed; front door gaps need sealing
summary: A 1/4 inch gap was found at both front entrance double door sweeps. The doors must be rodent proofed.

headline: Passed; worn cooler gasket at salad station
summary: The gasket seal on the lower reach-in cooler at the salad station is worn and needs repair. The manager was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Passed; food handler training required
summary: All food handlers must obtain the required food handler training. Management was told to clean fryers, the stove, prep tables, refrigeration, floors under cooking equipment, walk-in interiors, and vents above cooking areas.

headline: Passed; no food handler training on site
summary: Employees had no food handler training. The certified manager had no allergen training. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks, and there is no waste receptacle at the handwashing sink.

headline: Conditions: rat droppings found; repeat violation
summary: Ten rat droppings were found in the tool storage room, a repeat violation from an April 2026 inspection; a citation was issued. Inspector removed them during inspection. Bulk containers lack labels, and a sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and wiping cloth storage
summary: Food handlers were preparing food without hair restraints and must wear them. Wet wiping cloths were stored on counters. Plastic salad trays were stored facing up and must be inverted.

headline: Re-inspection passed; openings near rear door
summary: An opening was found on the right side of the rear exit door and must be sealed. A cooler gasket is damaged, and a chest freezer lid has holes and cracks. The ice machine backflow device could not be located, and washroom ceiling tiles are stained.

headline: Passed; stained walkway to trash
summary: Stains were found on the walkway from the rear door to the trash receptacles. The manager was told to clean them.

headline: Failed: 3-compartment sink not working properly
summary: Failed. The 3-compartment sink floods when water is drained from one compartment. A priority violation was cited. A food handler also had an expired food handler certificate.

headline: Passed; openings near dumpster need sealing
summary: Openings were found at the base and corners of an exterior garage-like door in the dumpster area. Management was told to seal them to prevent pest entry. No pests were found.

headline: Failed: restroom handwash water too hot
summary: Failed. Employee restroom handwashing sinks reached 125°F to 130°F when in use. Water must be between 100°F and 120°F. A priority violation was cited.

headline: Conditions: over 20 flying insects at bar
summary: Over 20 flying insects were seen on walls, shelves, ceilings, and equipment at the bar. Management must clean, sanitize, and consult a pest control company. Cutting boards and a sink faucet also need attention.

headline: Passed; three restroom sinks too cool
summary: Three second-floor restroom handwashing sinks measured below the required 100°F minimum water temperature: 86.9°F, 76.8°F, and 90.1°F. Five other sinks in those restrooms were working properly.

headline: Conditions: chili held at 59.4°F, discarded
summary: About 20 lbs of chili beans held at 59.4°F were stored overnight in the walk-in cooler and discarded, valued at $30. Hot chili was cooled in a large covered tub instead of shallow containers. A soda gun was not clean inside.

headline: Passed; wiping cloth storage and leaking faucet
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were not stored properly, and serving plates were not stored correctly. A leaking faucet at the 3-compartment sink was noted. Cardboard and foil liners and dirty floors need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no sanitizer test kit
summary: Failed. No city-certified food manager with a valid certificate was on site while milk, chicken, and beef were prepared; a citation was issued. No sanitizer test kit was available, and floors and shelving had food debris.

headline: Conditions: no sanitizer in bar dish machine
summary: The bar low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer and tested at 0 ppm while in use. The manager was told to provide proper concentration. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, and utensils were dried on cloth towels.

headline: Scored cutting boards; cardboard filters; grease
summary: Cutting boards have severe scoring and must be resurfaced or replaced. The deep fryer interior and surfaces under the griddle are soiled, and some cold units need cleaning. Cardboard was used as hood filters and must be replaced with proper filters.

headline: Worn gaskets; grease buildup; damaged storage bins
summary: Worn gaskets on the walk-in cooler and freezer doors must be repaired. Damaged bins and shelves need replacing, and cardboard must be removed from prep tables. Grease and debris must be cleaned from fryers, floors, walls and hood filters.

headline: Dirty basement floors; food handler certification missing
summary: Floors near the basement soda dispenser were dirty and must be cleaned. Food handler certification was not provided on site; the facility must ensure all food employees hold valid certification and keep it on site.

headline: No health policy; cutting boards and gaskets damaged
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; a priority violation was issued. Some cutting boards have dark stains and deep cuts. Reach-in coolers have a broken gasket, and the deep fryer cabinet has grease buildup. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Hand sink misused; raw chicken over eggs; spoiled chicken
summary: Staff used a hand sink to wash a towel and fill a pitcher. Raw chicken was stored over ready-to-eat eggs and was removed. Chicken feet at 76°F were discarded (6 lbs). Vacuum-packed meat lacked a HACCP plan or variance.

headline: Food on floor; uncorrected prior violations
summary: Onions, potatoes and other food were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Only one of two food handler certificates was shown. Prior violations were not corrected: chipped paint, peeling wall base, and a dumpster lid with a large hole.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy; no vomit kit
summary: The person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while TCS food was prepared. No written employee health policy or vomit cleanup supplies were on site. Test strips and a stem thermometer were missing.

headline: Heavy grease in kitchen; chipped paint
summary: Grease buildup was found on cooking equipment, inside and behind the deep fryer, and on walls, floors and shelves; it must be degreased and sanitized. Debris and spills around the dish area need more frequent cleaning. Chipped paint near the handsink must be repainted.

headline: Food on floors; unshielded sewer lines above storage
summary: Food boxes and oil were stored on floors in dry storage and must be raised six inches. Food was stored under unshielded wastewater lines and must be shielded or moved. An employee with a large beard lacked a beard restraint.

headline: Floor corners and wall bases need detail cleaning
