summary: Floors along wall bases and in corners in the dishwashing and prep areas must be detail cleaned and maintained.

headline: Utensils in stagnant water; wet mop in dish area
summary: A scoop and spoon were stored in stagnant water at the salad station and must be kept in running water. A handwashing sign is missing at the grill-line sink. A wet mop was stored in the dishwashing area and must be hung to dry.

headline: Food handler lacked training certificate
summary: One food handler had no food handler training certificate. The facility must provide it.

headline: Hot food held too cool; coolers dirty
summary: TCS food in a cardboard box was below 135°F: egg rolls 59.3°F, chicken 57.5°F, crab rangoon 68.1°F. About 29 lbs ($125) were discarded and denatured. Coolers and freezers, plus floors, walls and ceilings, need detail cleaning.

headline: No restroom handwashing sign; ceiling openings
summary: No handwashing sign was posted near the sink in the unisex restroom. Openings in the ceiling and walls of that restroom must be sealed with smooth, cleanable surfaces. Lighting in the front food prep area is inadequate and must be improved.

headline: Trays face up; cardboard liner; grease buildup
summary: Aluminum trays were stored face up on prep tables and must be inverted. Cardboard was used as a prep table liner and must be replaced. Grease was under the steam table and debris was on floors behind coolers and fryers. No allergen training proof.

headline: Corner floors need cleaning
summary: Floors in the corner areas need cleaning where needed.

headline: No sanitizer on site; pest log book not kept
summary: No chemical sanitizer was on premises; it was delivered and corrected before the end of inspection. The pest control log book was not kept on site; the last entry was dated 6/20/2025. An opening at the front door base must be sealed.

headline: Food debris in coolers and walls; torn gasket
summary: Food debris inside the 4-door prep cooler in the rear must be cleaned. A 2-door refrigerator has a torn gasket that must be repaired. Food debris on walls in the main prep, rear prep and mop sink areas must be cleaned.

headline: No beard restraints; milk crates; low water flow
summary: Employees with beards lacked beard restraints. Milk crates must not be used for elevating stored items. The three-compartment sink needs stoppers, and the rear handwashing sink has low water flow. Debris under the low-temp dish machine must be cleaned.

headline: Expired food handler certificate
summary: One food handler had an expired food handler certificate. The manager must ensure all food handlers have current certificates.

headline: Torn gaskets; broken lids; grease and debris
summary: Four-door cold unit gaskets are torn and must be replaced. Two-door cold unit doors are falling off and its lid is broken. Plates were not inverted and scoops were stored inside dry containers. Grease and food debris need cleaning.

headline: Employee eating in prep area; rust in ice machine
summary: An employee was eating in the prep area and was told to use designated areas. Small rust patches were found inside the ice machine, and ice must be removed and cleaned. Food handlers lacked proper hair restraints.

headline: No certified manager for 45 minutes; bare-hand garnish
summary: No certified food manager was verifiable on site while TCS food was cooked and served; one arrived about 45 minutes later. Employees used bare hands to sprinkle garnish on ready-to-eat food. Vacuum packaging machine was tagged.

headline: No allergen training proof for certified managers
summary: No proof of allergen training was provided for certified food managers. Anyone holding a City of Chicago sanitation certificate must complete the training, and documentation must be on site.

headline: Mouse droppings found throughout; uncorrected violation
summary: About 200 or more mouse droppings were found on floors, shelves, pipes and inside equipment; they must be removed and a pest control operator must service the premises. This prior violation was not corrected. Also: slow drain, leaking pipe, and missing food handler training.

headline: Boxes and eggs on dairy cooler floor; soiled cooler
summary: Food boxes and eggs were on the dairy cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Scoop handles were in contact with frozen fruit. The pizza prep cooler had liquid spillage on its bottom shelf. A sandwich-area faucet is loose and the restroom door is not self-closing.

headline: Dirty ice machine tubes; ripped gaskets
summary: Plastic tubes inside the ice machines are not clean and must be cleaned or replaced. Ripped gaskets on prep and walk-in cooler doors must be repaired. No high-temperature dish thermometer or test strips were on site, a priority violation.

headline: Hard-boiled eggs too warm; small door opening
summary: Prepackaged hard-boiled eggs at 50.1–53.4°F were in the display cooler; the manager discarded about 9 lbs ($50). A citation was issued. A small opening in the front double doors must be sealed. A stacked disposable container needs inverting.

headline: Door gap; no food handler certificates on premises
summary: A 1/4-inch gap between the front double doors must be rodent-proofed. No food handler certificates were on premises. The food manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Protective lining on equipment; detail cleaning needed
summary: Protective lining remains on some equipment in the main kitchen and bar and must be removed. The rear dish area floor and 3-compartment sink, plus the front bar service area, need detail cleaning.

headline: Fruit flies near mop sink; drip under sink
summary: About 20 fruit flies were found by the mop sink areas. A citation was issued, and the manager must notify the pest control operator and eliminate the flies. A small drip below the 3-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Ice machine door buildup; boxes on floor
summary: Buildup was found on the interior door of the ice machine and must be cleaned. Boxes were stored on the floor in the storage area and must be raised at least six inches.

headline: Two fryers not under exhaust hood
summary: Two small deep fryers were not under the exhaust hood. They must be moved under the hood.

headline: Pink buildup in ice machine; door gap; debris on walls
summary: Slight pink buildup was inside the upper ice machine; the interior and plastic tubes must be cleaned. A 1/4-inch gap between the front double doors must be rodent-proofed. Debris on prep and dishwashing area walls must be cleaned.

headline: No food handler certificates; wiping cloth storage
summary: No food handler certificates were on site and must be obtained. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. In-use utensils must be kept clean and stored in a clean, sanitized area.

headline: Pink and black mold in ice machine
summary: The ice machine internal panel had pink and black mold-like buildup dripping into the ice bin. The facility must clean and sanitize it; a priority violation was issued. The basement cooler and bar need cleaning, and a toilet room door does not latch fully.

headline: Dead roaches and flies; full fly trap; leaking drain
summary: Dead roaches and flies were found on the floor in basement dry storage and below the 3-compartment sink. A fly trap on the ceiling was full of dead flies. Also: leaking sink drain, heavily soiled freezer and gaskets.

headline: No manager certificate; can opener cleaned on site
summary: The person in charge has no City of Chicago food service manager certificate; a citation was issued. The can opener blade was cleaned on site. Floors under cooking equipment and floor drains need cleaning. Certified managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Dish machines not hot or strong enough
summary: High-temperature dish machine final rinse reached only 130°F; it must be at least 180°F. Low-temp machine chlorine was 10 ppm; it must be 100 ppm. Both are priority violations. The previous inspection summary report was not posted.

headline: Cooler buildup, box soda leak, dirty floors
summary: Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning to remove spills and buildup. A leak at the box soda station must be corrected. The outside waste area and floors under the soda station need cleaning.

headline: No valid manager certificate; no hot water at prep sink
summary: No person in charge with a valid Chicago sanitation certificate was on site; a citation was issued. The prep-area handwashing sink had no hot water (74.8°F). Hair restraints were missing and no food handler training was available.

headline: Containers not inverted; food handler training missing
summary: Containers were not stored inverted on drying racks. Food handlers had no food handler training and must provide proof.

headline: Front door gap; no hair restraint; leaking sink
summary: The front door has a 1/4-inch gap underneath and is not rodent or insect proof. A female food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The 3-compartment sink cold-water knob leaks, the hand sink drains slowly, and floors need cleaning.

headline: Labeling gaps, rust, and mold-like buildup in cooler
summary: Food storage containers need visible common-name labels. A cutting board with deep seams and a rusty prep shelf need fixing. Storage racks in the walk-in cooler had grease and white mold-like buildup. Some food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: No certified manager; mold-like buildup in ice machine
summary: No person in charge had sanitation manager training, and no sanitation certificate was posted while TCS food was handled. Black mold-like buildup dripped onto ice for consumption. The person in charge was told to clean and sanitize it.

headline: Excess ice in basement freezers; low water pressure
summary: Excess ice in basement chest freezers must be removed and the freezers cleaned. The exposed prep sink needs more water pressure. Ceiling openings in the rear basement must be repaired and dusty light shields cleaned.

headline: Boxes on floor; torn gasket; rusty racks
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor in the rear prep area and must be elevated six inches. A two-door prep cooler has a torn gasket, and rust is inside the walk-in racks. Basement dry storage is cluttered, and walls and corners need cleaning.

headline: Sewage overflow; cups used as scoops; scored boards
summary: Sewage overflowed from a floor drain while the 1-compartment prep sink was in use. Equipment was tagged and must not be used until the drain is repaired and reinspected. Single-use cups were used as scoops, and cutting boards are deeply scored.

headline: Cluttered refuse area; cracked floors; exposed caulk
summary: The refuse enclosure was littered with unused equipment and trash. Food debris and spills are on floors and under equipment and need detail cleaning. Cracked flooring in prep and warewashing areas and exposed foam-like caulk need repair.

headline: Broken ice machine door; dish area needs cleaning
summary: The ice machine door is broken and must be repaired. The floor and wall under the dish machine need detail cleaning.

headline: No food handler training; old backflow violation unfixed
summary: Food handlers had no food handler training and must provide it. A core violation from 2023 was not corrected: the ice machine water line has no visible backflow prevention device. A citation was issued.

headline: Soiled mop heads; no allergen training on site
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly; the manager was told to hang them to prevent insect breeding. No allergen training was on site. Certified managers must complete it and keep records on site.

headline: Leaking drainpipes; no hair restraints; damaged tiles
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints in prep and bar areas. Leaking drainpipes under the bar 3-compartment sink and near the rear handwashing sink must be repaired. Handwashing sign and splash guard were missing; floor tiles are damaged.

headline: No cooler thermometer; food handler certificates missing
summary: No thermometer was inside the cooler holding deli meat, cheese and condiments; one must be provided. No food handler certificates were on site. Prep cooler debris, toilet fixtures and walk-in cooler floor need cleaning.

headline: Food containers on floor; hole around restroom pipes
summary: Food containers and cutting boards were stored on the floor in the prep areas and must be stored six inches up on raised shelving. A large hole around pipes in the customer restroom must be repaired.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan; cooler at 65°F
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was on site; supplies and a written plan must be kept on site. A prep cooler measured 65°F and needs repair. The low-temp dish machine did not meet rinse requirements. No food handler training proof was provided.

headline: Missing pest log; soiled drain; leaking water heater pipe
summary: No pest control log was on site. The manager printed the missing service records and added them to a new log book during the inspection. Also: soiled sink drain, water heater pipe discharging onto the floor, greasy floors under grill equipment.

headline: Dumpster lid won't close; allergen certificate missing
summary: The outside dumpster lid could not close because trash was overflowing. The certified food manager on duty had no allergen training certificate, and the facility must provide one.

headline: No health policy; ice machine slime; chicken too warm
summary: No employee health policy with signed acknowledgments was on site; a citation was issued. Black and pink slime was inside the ice machine and dripping onto ice. Chicken at 46.6°F and 66.0°F was too warm. No licensed pest control operator was on site.

headline: Loose bar sink; allergen training missing
summary: The handwashing sink at the first-floor bar is loose and must be repaired or replaced. No allergen training certificates were on site; certified managers must complete training and keep records on site.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; one sink too cool
summary: Foods and spices moved out of original containers lacked product-name labels and must be labeled. One of four handwashing sinks was not holding the proper water temperature and must be repaired.

headline: Two burnt-out light bulbs over cook line
summary: Two light bulbs in the hood over the cook line were burnt out. They must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Heavy floor soil and broken glass in bar
summary: Bar floors around equipment and the 3-compartment sink had heavy soil, food debris and broken glass; the manager was told to clean. A partly used cigarette was on top of a cooler and must be removed.

headline: Door openings; milk crates; non-working kitchen lights
summary: Openings in the front double doors and at the base of the rear exit door must be sealed. Milk and soda crates were used for elevation in the walk-in freezer and must be replaced with shelving. A basement restroom sink is not working, and kitchen walkway lights are out.

headline: No handwashing sink at tortilla station
summary: The front tortilla prep area needs a handwashing sink. This is a priority violation, and the facility must provide one.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables; dusty ceiling vent
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Excess dust on the ceiling vent above the dishwashing area must be cleaned.

headline: Leaking drainpipe; loose baseboards
summary: A drainpipe under the rear handwashing sink is leaking and must be repaired. The baseboards under the front handwashing sink are loose and must be repaired.

headline: Door gaps, mold in coolers, dust, mops not hung
summary: Front and rear doors must be tight-fitting. Mold-like buildup in reach-in coolers must be cleaned. The damaged wall base near the rear door must be repaired, mops must be hung to dry, and rear storage items must be raised off the floor.

headline: No certified manager on site; cold food too warm
summary: No certified food service manager was on premises. Cold food at 47.7–50.5°F was discarded (about 5 lbs). A small cold unit at 54.2°F was tagged. Entrance door gaps and missing hair restraints were also noted.

headline: Milk crates used for elevation; floors need cleaning
summary: Pop and milk crates are not acceptable for elevating items; the facility must use easy-to-clean shelving. Interiors of coolers, freezers and counters must be cleaned. Floors along walls and corners and prep-area ledges need detail cleaning.

headline: Mold in ice machines; about 30 small flies found
summary: Mold-like substance was found on both basement ice machine shields; ice must be destroyed and machines cleaned. About 30 small flies were seen on the first floor, and a pest control service was recommended. A citation was issued.

headline: Hole in drywall above oven
summary: A hole in the drywall above the oven on the lowest floor must be repaired.

headline: Wood baskets; no backflow device; no allergen certificates
summary: Wood wicker bread baskets in the rear prep area must be removed; wood cannot be used as a food-contact surface. The utility sink lacks a backflow device. Rear prep floors and walls are dirty. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Damaged ventilation hood grates
summary: The ventilation hood has damaged grates with dust and grease buildup. The facility must repair, clean and maintain the system.

headline: Damaged light shields in prep areas
summary: Light shields in the front and rear prep areas were damaged. The manager must replace them and keep them in good condition.

headline: Cooking equipment buildup; clutter under counter
summary: The side of the cooking equipment needs cleaning to remove buildup. Unnecessary items stored under the counter must be removed. These are upkeep items only.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; grease on oil container
summary: Ice buildup in the walk-in freezer must be corrected. A loose toilet handle in the employee restroom must be repaired. Grease is on the used cooking oil container, and oil buildup is inside the fryer cabinet and on the floor near the handwashing sink.

headline: Chicken wings too warm; slow drain; door gaps
summary: Cooked chicken wings at 46.6–47.5°F were in the reach-in cooler; the manager discarded about 15 lbs ($30). A citation was issued. A slow drain at the basement bar sink must be repaired. Gaps along front doors and the rolling door must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy; leaking pipe
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS food was stored, prepared and served; a citation was issued. Blank employee health policy copies were posted, and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. Chicken was thawed in standing water.

headline: No deli hand sink; no walk-in thermometers
summary: The deli slicing area needs a handwashing sink with soap and paper towels. All walk-in coolers need visible thermometers. The facility must install and maintain them.

headline: Spoons in standing water; ice maker backflow missing
summary: Large spoons were kept in standing water at room temperature and must be stored per the health code. The backflow prevention device for the ice maker could not be located; it must be installed in an easy-to-spot area.

headline: No allergen training for certified managers
summary: No proof of allergen training was provided for certified food managers. They must obtain the certificate and keep a copy on site.

headline: No handwashing sign at prep sink
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the hand sink in the preparation area. The facility must provide one.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; no health policy
summary: No certified manager was on site while chicken, soup and deli meat were prepared and served; the manager arrived at 9:50 AM, and a citation was issued. No employee health policy was on site. Missing and damaged floor tiles in the main prep area must be repaired.

headline: Boxes on walk-in freezer floor; tape on faucet
summary: Food boxes on the walk-in freezer floor must be stored six inches off the floor. Scotch tape was around the 3-compartment sink faucet and must be fixed. Also: dusty cooler fan cover, mop sink cleaning, thermometers needed.

headline: Doors not rodent-proof; food on floors; no hair restraint
summary: Front and rear doors have about 1/2-inch openings at the bottom and must be rodent-proofed. Food on plastic on the floor in several coolers and storage areas must be raised. An employee was not wearing a hair restraint while food was being prepared.

headline: Food stored on floor; cardboard shelf liners
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Cardboard was used as a shelf liner in the walk-in cooler and must be removed.

headline: Black residue in ice machine; damaged freezer gaskets
summary: A small amount of black residue was in the corner of the ice machine; it must be cleaned. The two-door reach-in freezer at the cook line has damaged gaskets that must be repaired.

headline: No sushi rice letter; debris under cookline
summary: No sushi rice letter was on file for specialized food processing; the facility must obtain and keep one. Food debris and water under the cookline and bar sink must be cleaned. Hood filters have debris buildup.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; vomit procedure missing
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was on site; a citation was issued. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit, and no soap, hand drying or handwashing sign at the front sink. Smoked salmon at 50.1°F was discarded; no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Leaky sink gasket; no dumpster on site
summary: A leaky gasket at the middle compartment of the 3-compartment sink must be repaired or replaced. No outside garbage dumpster was on site; the facility must provide and maintain one. A citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager until afternoon; sinks lacked water
summary: Food was handled before a certified food manager arrived at 12:10 PM; the business opened at 7 AM. Two hand sinks lacked hot or cold water; an employee turned a shutoff valve on during the inspection. No splash guard at coffee station.

headline: Bare-hand food contact, missing dates, HACCP records absent
summary: A cook handled french fries with bare hands; staff were told to use gloves or utensils. Prepared food lacked date marks, and about 195.5 lbs was condemned. Required HACCP records were not on site. Also: missing packaged-food address, dusty walk-in fan guard.

headline: Dead flies; no pest license; no health policy
summary: About 200–300 dead small flies were found under and behind cooking and dry storage equipment and on a pan shelf. No Illinois pest control license was on site. No employee health policy or vomit cleanup materials were on site. Mold-like buildup was found in shelves and walk-in cooler.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; backflow device not found
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at the food prep sink and in the toilet rooms. The backflow prevention device on the ice and coffee machine could not be located and must be provided.

headline: Oven not under stationary hood
summary: An electric oven is not under a stationary exhaust hood; it has an attached ventless hood. The facility must notify the Department of Buildings for inspection and approval of the ventless hood.

headline: Restroom trash lacks lids; wall holes; dish gauge low
summary: Women's and unisex restrooms need trash cans with lids. Holes in the walls of the second- and fourth-floor prep areas must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. The dish machine gauge read 150°F while the internal gauge read 161.5°F; a citation was issued.

headline: Cooked shrimp and chicken cooled too slowly
summary: Cooked shrimp at 93°F and chicken at 84°F were in the walk-in cooler while still cooling at 2:20 PM; both were cooked at noon. This is a priority violation; about 5 lbs ($25) was discarded. Sauce bottles lacked labels; hood light is very dim.

headline: Hot rice held too cool; food past discard dates
summary: Hot rice was held at 83.3–94.5°F, below the required 135°F; the manager discarded 25 lbs (about $40). Roasted corn and two yogurt dips were past their discard dates; 11 lbs were discarded. A citation was issued.

headline: Dish machine too weak to sanitize; cold food discarded
summary: Dish machine sanitizer was too weak (10 ppm); use stopped until repaired. Salmon, cheese, greens and melon were too warm; the manager discarded them on site. Two coolers were too warm and emptied. Also: soiled linens, leaking faucet, split walk-in floor.

headline: Failed: 25 to 30 flies; unlabeled storage containers
summary: Complaint inspection failed. About 25 to 30 live large flies were flying around the grease container, the prep area, and dry storage boxes. Pest elimination, cleaning, and pest control service are required, a citation was issued. Also noted: no handwashing signs, unlabeled containers, cardboard shelf liner, and no covered toilet room trash.

headline: Foil shelf liners; grease and debris buildup
summary: Re-inspection passed. Foil is used as a shelf liner in prep and storage areas and must be removed; surfaces must be smooth and cleanable. Grease and food debris cover cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and shelving. Basement floors need cleaning. Two bulbs on the prep line are burnt out.

headline: Cooler too warm; tagged out of use
summary: Passed with conditions. A cooler measured 50F ambient air and was tagged. No TCS food was found inside. All cold holding units must hold 41F or below.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup kit; cooler temperature low
summary: License inspection failed. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure was on site, a priority violation. Hand sinks lack handwashing signs. Refrigeration read 46F and must be available for testing. Trash containers were overflowing, and the BBQ hood needs cleaning.

headline: Roaches on traps and floors; droppings near outlet
summary: Re-inspection passed. Live and dead roaches were on the sticky trap under the service counter, and dead roaches were on floors and in a hallway storage unit. The trap must be replaced, and affected surfaces cleaned. Roach droppings near a wall outlet must be cleaned. Cups were splashed at the hand sink.

headline: Failed: over 50 mouse droppings; dead mouse
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Over 50 mouse droppings were found under the three-compartment sink, behind the grease trap, and under the dry food cabinet. Insulation was gnawed, and a dead mouse must be removed. The pest control logbook was not on site, a priority violation.

headline: Missing food handler training; slow drains; door gap
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Some food handler training is expired or missing. Hand sinks drain slowly, and the garbage door has a gap that must be sealed to keep out insects. Food containers need labels. Also noted: cooking oil on the floor, crates in storage, and greasy equipment.

headline: Food debris on floors; Starbucks area needs cleaning
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Food debris covers floors, wall bases, and corners in the Starbucks area, including under counters and inside cabinets. The area must be cleaned.

headline: Clean wiping cloths used to dry equipment; floor drain leaks
summary: Re-inspection passed. An employee used a wiping cloth to dry equipment; utensils must air dry. Rear prep table surfaces have dried food debris. A one-compartment sink drain leaks and must be repaired. A mop head rests on the floor next to the utility sink.

headline: Missing thermometers; heavy grease on floors
summary: Passed with conditions. Thermometers could not be found inside equipment and must be provided for coolers in front and rear prep. Stored equipment had dried food debris. Heavy grease and food debris cover floors in prep, walk-in, and storage areas and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: coolers off; undercooked food not disclosed
summary: License inspection failed. The menu lacked a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked items, a priority violation. The walk-in cooler and a prep cooler were off and not holding cold temperatures. A hot holding unit was off. Pots stored outdoors must be moved inside. No allergen training certificate was provided.

headline: Failed: beef thawed in standing water; door gaps
summary: Failed. Beef was thawing in standing water in the three-compartment sink. A quarter-inch gap at the front door must be sealed to prevent pests. Food was stored on the floor, bags were used to store food in a freezer, and debris and grease were found. Several prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Leaking pipe under sink; open water cup near chicken
summary: Passed. Water drips from a pipe below the three-compartment sink when it drains and must be repaired. An open cup of water was stored next to the chicken prep area and must be covered and moved. Minor spills under the fryers must be cleaned.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; drive-through dispenser buildup
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Soiled wiping cloths were stored improperly in the coffee and ice cream prep area. The drive-through beverage dispenser has heavy splatter and buildup. Floor drains, and grease and dried food behind fryers near the ice machines, need cleaning.

headline: Failed: hand sink removed; no barrier to customers
summary: License re-inspection failed. A prep-area hand sink was removed and must be reinstalled, a priority violation. A splash guard and a barrier between the customer lobby and rear prep area are required. Also: missing lidded trash can and light shield in the employee washroom.

headline: Burnt-out dishwashing area light fixture
summary: Passed. A light fixture in the dishwashing area is burnt out and must be repaired.

headline: Failed: no hot water; yogurt and melon too warm
summary: Failed. Staff sinks had no hot water, measuring 59.8F to 75.9F; they must reach 100F. Yogurt at 64.8F and melon at 58F to 60.3F were discarded. A prep cooler at 60.7F to 70F was tagged do not use. Ice buildup and food inside the ice cream chest must be cleared.

headline: Food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Passed. Some food handlers did not have training certificates. Those employees must provide proof of training unless they hold the City of Chicago sanitation certificate.

headline: Broken wall base in rear prep area
summary: Passed. The wall base in the rear prep area is broken or missing and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Bar dish machine broken and tagged out of use
summary: Passed with conditions. The dish machine in the bar area was not working and was disconnected and tagged. The manager said a repair technician had been scheduled. The facility was not open during inspection. The manager was told to repair it.

headline: No certified manager on duty; prior violation left
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was present while deli sandwiches and soups were prepared and served, a priority violation with a citation. Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced with shelves six inches off the floor. Allergen training was not obtained from a prior report.

headline: Food debris and spills throughout facility
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Food debris and spills cover floors and surfaces throughout the facility. The manager was told to detail clean under shelving, inside prep and dish areas, around the dish machine, and on cooking equipment, and to increase cleaning frequency.

headline: No manager, unsafe cooler temps, slimy ice machine
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. No person in charge was present, and TCS foods were prepared without a certified manager. A cooler held food at 65F and was tagged. Slime dripped into ice; about 75 lbs of unlabeled oysters were discarded. Food handler training is expired or missing.

headline: Failed: no raw food advisory; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Canvass inspection failed. No reminder disclosure statements were written for raw food sold on the premises, a priority violation. Bulk containers of sugar and flour have no labels and must be labeled.

headline: Dead roaches under prep table; grease and debris buildup
summary: Re-inspection passed. Multiple dead roaches were found under a rear prep table and must be removed and cleaned. Also noted: heavily soiled waffle iron, grease and food debris on cooking equipment and coolers, a small faucet leak, and dirty floors and walls.

headline: Torn gasket on cooler storing bacon
summary: Passed. A torn gasket on the inside of a cooler in the rear dish area is used to store bacon. It must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Leaking hand sink; ribs thawed in standing water
summary: Short complaint inspection passed. A hand sink leaks heavily from its drain trap and must be fixed. Ribs were thawing in standing water in the sink and must be thawed under cold running water. Also noted: a damaged rear door strip, missing hair restraints, and greasy fryers and floors.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; allergen training missing
summary: Passed. Milk crates are used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. The food service sanitation manager has no allergen training certificate and must meet the requirement.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; food discarded; citations issued
summary: Failed. Hot food held below 135F included chicken at 99.1F and Italian beef at 121.3F; about 11 lbs was discarded. Cold food held at 82.8F was discarded, about 10 lbs. Also noted: a leaking hand sink, dirty grease traps, food stored on floors, and prior violations not corrected.

headline: No certified manager; many cold foods above 41F
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were handled, a priority violation. Many cold foods in the front cooler were above 41F, including tuna at 54.6F and chicken at 54.5F. The manager discarded about 18 lbs of food worth $550.

headline: Rusty shelving; broken tile; no hand sink sign
summary: Passed. Rusty shelving in the walk-in cooler must be repainted and replaced. A basement ice machine needs cleaning. A front hand sink drains slowly and has no handwashing sign. Peeling paint is on ceiling tiles, and a floor tile by the three-compartment sink is broken.

headline: Missing undercooked-food notice fixed on site
summary: Passed with conditions. The menu lacked a notice about undercooked or raw animal foods. The manager added the disclosure before the inspection ended, so no citation was issued. One employee's allergen training certificate was expired and must be renewed.

headline: Food stored on walk-in floor; mop heads unstored
summary: Passed. Food in the walk-in cooler was on the floor and must be raised six inches. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Both were noted for correction.

headline: Uncovered food and missing hair restraints; corrected on request
summary: Re-inspection passed. Inspector asked staff to cover display food and wear hair restraints in prep. Also noted: chipped container lids, two missing sink stoppers, debris under prep tables, and a missing toilet room trash lid. No pests were seen.

headline: Failed: three-compartment sink leaks between basins
summary: License inspection failed. The three-compartment sink leaks from the middle compartment into the left compartment when water runs. It is a priority violation that must be repaired.

headline: Damaged cooler door gaskets need repair
summary: Re-inspection passed. Several prep cooler door rubber gaskets are ripped or damaged. The manager must repair or replace all of them.

headline: Bathroom door must self-close
summary: Re-inspection passed. The bathroom door does not self-close. The manager must install a self-closing door.

headline: Hand sink blocked and soap missing; food display unprotected
summary: Passed with conditions. Soap was missing at a deli hand sink and a panini press blocked another; the manager fixed both on site. Food on display near the entrance was unprotected, and soup was moved after the manager turned off a hot unit. Also: no food handler certificates on site, dry food on basement floor, and broken plumbing.

headline: Dirty floor drains; burnt-out kitchen light bulbs
summary: Re-inspection passed. Floor drains in the rear food prep area have dirt and food debris and must stay clean. A basement floor drain cover must be replaced. Several burnt-out bulbs in the rear prep area must be replaced.

headline: Gaps around rear door; sinks not sealed to walls
summary: License inspection passed. The rear exterior door has gaps larger than a quarter inch and must be repaired. Several hand sinks are not sealed to walls, allowing seepage behind equipment. Walk-in cooler and freezer interiors have rust and soil. A women's restroom lacks a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Ice machine interior needs regular cleaning
summary: Passed. The interior surfaces of the ice machine must be cleaned and maintained to prevent buildup.

headline: Failed: leaking sink, unfixed prior violations
summary: Failed. Excessive grime was on walk-in shelving, and the three-compartment sink leaks into pans. Items were stored on the floor inside a non-working walk-in cooler. Several violations from April 2025 were not corrected, including rusty prep table bottoms and no allergen training for the certified manager.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; brooms too close to food
summary: Passed. Several prep coolers are missing thermometers and must be provided. Brooms are hung too close to food containers at the sushi prep station and must be moved away.

headline: Rice unlabeled; cutting boards and floors need work
summary: Passed. Bulk rice must be labeled with its common name. Stored items must be raised off the floor. A pan handle was repaired with string and must be replaced. Cutting boards are extremely dirty and must be replaced. A backflow device is broken and must be fixed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; uncovered toilet trash bins
summary: Passed. Food storage containers, such as turmeric and sugar, must be labeled with their common names. Three toilet room trash bins must be covered. Loose floor tile by the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Coolers locked; ice machine pink buildup cleaned
summary: Passed. Two coolers in the customer area near the restroom hallway were ordered locked to prevent tampering. Pink buildup on the inside of the ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager 8:10 to 8:50 AM; leaking sink
summary: Failed. No certified manager was present while chicken was prepared and served; a priority citation was issued. The front prep hand sink leaks onto the rear prep area. Cold food held above 41F was discarded, about 14 lbs. Food on the floor must be raised, and frozen meat was thawing in prep.

headline: No allergen training certificate for manager
summary: License inspection passed. The food service manager had no allergen training certificate and must obtain one.

headline: No certified manager on site with tuna, chicken
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while tuna and chicken were prepared and served. The manager must be present at all times. A priority citation was issued.

headline: Side door gap; no self-closing washroom door
summary: License re-inspection passed. A side exterior door has a quarter-inch gap at the bottom and must be repaired to keep out pests. The washroom door lacks a self-closing device. The certified manager has no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: No employee health policy; managers lack allergen proof
summary: License re-inspection passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on the premises, a priority violation. Several certified food managers had no allergen training certificate and must show proof.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without an original certificate, and a voided photocopy was posted, a citation. No written procedure or supplies for vomit or diarrhea events were found, a citation. No food handler training proof was on site, and no certified manager had allergen training.

headline: Cutting boards need replacing; drains need cleaning
summary: License inspection passed. Three cutting boards on the cook line prep stations must be replaced. Drains at the bar and kitchen three-compartment sink need detail cleaning. The main bar floor needs detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: employee restroom sinks lack hot water
summary: Failed. Employee bathroom hand sinks had no hot running water, measuring 91.5F to 95.0F. They must provide water at least 100F. This is a priority violation, but no citation was issued.

headline: Toilet room ventilation must be repaired
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. The mechanical ventilation in the toilet room must be repaired so it works.

headline: Deep-grooved cutting boards; unused equipment
summary: Passed. Front prep cutting boards have deep grooves and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Unused equipment near the three-compartment sink must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No hand sink sign; clutter inside restroom
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign was posted at the rear hand sink and must be provided. An old microwave is stored inside the restroom and must be removed.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings, live roach, pest activity
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Live insects and rodent activity were found. About 15 rat droppings were on the floor by the dishwashing area, behind the freezer, and in basement storage. One live cockroach was behind the front counter. Droppings must be removed, and additional pest control is needed.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; food residue inside units
summary: Passed. Cold hold unit gaskets are torn and must be repaired. Food residue is built up inside the cold hold units and doors. Grease covers the hood filters in the front prep area. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Failed: flies in prep area; sink will not turn on
summary: Failed. About five large flies were flying around the rear produce prep area and must be eliminated, with pest control recommended. The raw meat prep sink does not turn on and must be repaired. Stained cutting boards must be replaced, and the wall by the sink needs cleaning.

headline: Splash guards needed; sink faucet leaking
summary: Short complaint inspection passed. Splash guards are needed at both hand sinks in the food prep area. A small leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired.

headline: Live roaches on walls; prior violation not fixed
summary: Passed with conditions and a citation. Two live cockroaches were on food prep walls. A prior pest violation from October 2025 was not corrected, and additional pest control service is needed. Also noted: unused equipment to remove, dirty floors and walls, and missing light shields.

headline: Minor sink leak; drain board does not drain
summary: License inspection passed. A minor leak at the bottom of the kitchen hand sink must be repaired. The drain board for the three-compartment sink is not self-draining and must be pitched toward the sink.

headline: Food on floor, raw beef in grocery bags
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Condiments and straws were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Raw beef was stored in grocery bags in coolers and freezers. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Also noted: a slow-draining hand sink, water-damaged washroom ceiling, and no allergen training for the manager.

headline: Missing sink stopper; dirty basement walk-in
summary: License inspection passed. The left compartment of the dish area sink is missing a stopper. The basement walk-in cooler walls and ceiling have food debris and dirt, and its lighting is inadequate. Dish room floor tiles are missing. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training; cleaning needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. No food handler training for employees and no allergen training for food managers was shown. Also noted: ice machine debris, chest freezer needs defrosting, dining area duct grease, and a missing hand sink splash guard.

headline: Ice machine backflow device not located
summary: Passed. The backflow prevention device on the second-floor bar ice machine could not be found. The manager must locate it or provide one.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; items stored on floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Handwashing signs are missing in both washrooms and at the prep-bar hand sink. An ice scoop must be stored in a clean container, not on the ice machine. Items under the bar and in the basement must be raised off the floor.

headline: Failed: no metal stem thermometer; no food handler proof
summary: Failed. No metal stem thermometer was on site to check food temperatures, a priority violation. A pizza preparer had no food handler training proof, and the manager had no allergen training certificate. Also: beard restraints needed, chemicals stored on the mop closet floor, and cloth towels used as shelf liner.

headline: Deeply cut and stained cutting boards
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Kitchen cutting boards have deep cuts and stains. They must be sanded and sealed to be smooth and cleanable, or replaced.

headline: Missing soap and towels; food held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Hand soap and paper towels were missing at hand sinks and were supplied during the inspection, both priority violations. Chicken, shrimp, and beef held at 49.4F to 50.8F were discarded, about 30 lbs ($300). A refrigerator at 60F must not be used until CDPH reinspects it.

headline: Rusty cooler racks; ice machine lacks backflow device
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler have chipped paint and rust and must be repainted or replaced. A newly installed ice machine has no backflow prevention device in an accessible location and must have one installed.

headline: Hair and beard restraints missing; cloths not stored
summary: Passed. A male food handler and dishwasher were not wearing hair or beard restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution. Hand sinks lack handwashing signs. The walk-in cooler/freezer floor is dirty and slippery.

headline: Grocery bags in freezers; grease buildup near fryer
summary: License inspection passed. Food was stored in grocery bags in both freezers and must use food-grade bags. Staff must repair a damaged walk-in cooler door gasket, remove rust from shelving, and clean grease from walls, floors, and the hood. Utensils were stored handle-down.

headline: Leaking faucet base at baking sink
summary: Passed. The faucet base at the two-compartment sink in the baking kitchen leaks and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Failed: over 100 rodent droppings; moldy ice machine
summary: Failed. Over 100 rodent droppings were found throughout the facility, and contaminated ice must be discarded. The ice machine interior had black mildew-like substance and must be cleaned. Recent pest control service is required, and the storage room needs clutter removed.

headline: Unused equipment stored by dumpster area
summary: Re-inspection passed. Unused equipment is stored by the garbage dumpster area and must be removed, and the area must be maintained.

headline: Stained cutting boards and dirty ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Staff must refinish or replace stained cutting boards and clean the soda dispenser cabinet. Ceiling tiles above the dining area have mold-like buildup and must be replaced. Also noted: debris around the dumpster, greasy floors under cooking equipment, and no allergen training certificate.

headline: Cold foods above 41F discarded; cooler not used
summary: Passed with conditions. Pasta, shrimp, fish, and other service-cooler TCS foods were above 41F, with some as high as 64F, and 23 lbs ($63) were discarded. A service cooler at 63.6F must not be used until it holds 41F or below. Also noted: a leaking faucet and cracked wall.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners and grime on shelving
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Cardboard is used as shelf liner in the deli walk-in cooler and must be removed. Grime covers shelving in the deli, bakery, and meat areas. Rear storage has grime and trash. A restroom wall has holes, and a bakery cooler door pull is cracked.

headline: Oversized pots don't fit dish machine; no lids on trash
summary: Short complaint inspection passed. Serving plates on prep shelves were not stored properly and must be inverted. Large pots do not fit the dish machine and need a washing procedure or removal. Some washrooms have trash cans without lids.

headline: No certified food manager; priority violation
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while yogurt and other TCS foods were handled. The inspector instructed the facility to obtain one. The issue is a priority foundation violation. The person-in-charge item had no comments.

headline: Failed: no paper towels; no undercooked-food notice
summary: Failed. No paper towels were at the kitchen hand sink, a priority violation with a citation; a food handler supplied them during inspection. Menus lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory, including eggs. Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in and prep areas.

headline: Damaged cooler gaskets; stained cutting boards
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Several prep cooler door rubber gaskets are ripped or damaged and must be repaired or replaced. Cutting boards are stained and pitted and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Hand sink blocked by pastry tray; prior summary not posted
summary: Passed with conditions. A full pastry tray blocked a front prep hand sink during food prep; the manager removed it on site. Also noted: broken or missing cooler thermometers, a food handler without a hair restraint, no allergen training for the manager, and an inspection summary not posted for the public.

headline: Dusty walk-in cooler walls; faucet leaks at sink
summary: Passed. Walk-in cooler walls, ceilings, and fan covers need dust and debris removed. A faucet at the dishwashing three-compartment sink leaks at the base and must be repaired. Front and rear prep floors need cleaning of spills and debris.

headline: Failed: doors not rodent-proof; prior violations left
summary: Re-inspection failed. The front and rear doors each have a one-inch gap at the bottom and must be made rodent-proof. Prior violations from January 2024 were not corrected, and the manager was ordered to comply. A citation was issued.

headline: Failed: slimy ice machine panel; no food training proof
summary: Re-inspection failed. Black and pink slime built up inside the ice machine and dripped onto ice. It was cleaned on site. Also noted: no hand washing signs, no hair restraint, rusty shelving, a grease container not maintained, and no food handler training proof. Prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Invalid food handler certificates; floors and drains dirty
summary: Passed. Numerous food handler certificates are invalid and must be updated. Bulk foods must be labeled, and stored items must be raised off the floor. Floor drains and floors need cleaning. Unused equipment on the patio must be removed to prevent rodent harboring.

headline: Greasy equipment and floors need detail cleaning
summary: Passed. Cooking equipment exteriors, prep tables, and the area under the grill need cleaning. Refrigeration interiors need cleaning where needed. Floors around and under cooking equipment need detail cleaning, and the walls and grease receptor need cleaning.

headline: Pet dogs brought inside; no health policy
summary: Short complaint inspection passed with conditions. Non-service dogs were brought into the food establishment, and a citation was issued. No written employee health policy was on site. Also noted: missing backflow devices on three machines, a hand sink leak, and unfinished walls.

headline: Wastewater draining into bucket in beer cooler
summary: Re-inspection passed. Liquid was draining into a filled bucket in the rear beer tap coolers. The inspector noted that liquid must be drained from the point of discharge to disposal according to law.

headline: Failed: cardboard floor liner; no food handler proof
summary: Re-inspection failed. Cardboard lines the floor throughout the facility and must be replaced with a cleanable material. Microwave interior is heavily soiled. Food handlers lacked training proof. A missing outdoor trash lid and rusted racks were prior violations; a utility sink must be installed.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings; cold food too warm; no water
summary: Complaint re-inspection failed. About 30 mouse and rat droppings were found in the retail area, behind the freezer, and outside the rear door; more pest control is needed. Eggs and milk were held at 61F, and a prep cooler at 46F was previously tagged. Hot and cold water were missing at the three-compartment sink and a hand sink.

headline: Dirty storage cabinets and debris on floors
summary: Passed. Storage cabinet interiors need cleaning to remove spills and debris. Floors in the rear storage room need debris removed.

headline: Hair restraints missing; all food handler certificates expired
summary: Passed. Food handlers in prep were not wearing hair restraints. Walk-in cooler racks are rusted, and grime covers storage racks, cooking equipment, and counter shelves. Toilet rooms need cleaning, floor tiles are damaged, and all food handler certificates have expired.

headline: No certified manager for TCS foods; no handler cards
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. The person in charge has no City certified manager certificate. No certified manager was on site while corn, melon, yogurt, and ice cream were prepared and served, a priority citation. Wet wiping cloths were left on the prep table, and no food handler certificate was on site.

headline: Beard guard needed; sink leak and dirty floors
summary: Passed. A food handler needs a beard guard. The three-compartment sink leaks under the sanitizing compartment, and one restroom sink has no running water to its third basin. Floor corners and areas under equipment need cleaning.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; cheese and beef held unsafely
summary: Passed with conditions. Mozzarella at 52.1F, marinara at 54.2F, and cooked ground beef at 64.6F were held above safe temperatures and discarded, about $20 worth. The pizza prep cooler was tagged and cannot be used until CDPH clears it. Several food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Hot water too low at all sinks; now restored
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. Two female food handlers lacked adequate hair restraints. Hot water measured 70F to 71F at all sinks at the start. A citation was issued. By the end of the inspection, hot water was restored to all sinks.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: A food handler's certificate and the certified manager's allergen training certificate are expired. Stained cutting boards on prep coolers must be resurfaced or replaced. Prep cooler interiors and gaskets need cleaning, plus walk-in walls, ceiling and condenser.

headline: Warm cold foods; dead cockroaches found
summary: Ham, roast beef, cut tomatoes and raw bacon held at 45–50°F in a prep cooler; about 15 lb discarded on site. Raw beef was thawing at room temperature. About 10 dead adult cockroaches were on the floor of the rear water heater closet.

headline: Utensils held at 120°F; cooked shrimp covered
summary: Spatulas and ladles were stored in 120°F water; must be at least 135°F. Cooked shrimp was tightly covered while cooling. Oyster bar cooler lacks a thermometer. Ice bin is uncovered beside a handwashing sink. Insect device hangs above sushi prep equipment.

headline: Dish machine not reaching 180°F; tagged
summary: Dish machine final rinse did not reach 180°F; tag remains. Dishwashers lack a nearby handwashing sink; extension pending. Plastic cutting boards have dark grooves to sanitize or replace.

headline: Slimy ice machine; no soap at bar sinks
summary: Black slimy substance found inside basement ice maker, dripping into ice for consumption; machine ordered off and cleaned. Bar handwashing sinks lacked soap and paper towels. Certified manager lacked allergen training. Previous violations were corrected on site.

headline: Hair restraint needed; debris under sink
summary: Food handler needed an effective hair restraint while preparing food. Dried food debris was under the three-compartment sink and around prep tables and ice cream cooling units in front prep; instructed to clean.

headline: Food handler lacked valid certificate
summary: On re-inspection, a food handler lacked a valid food handler certificate. Management was told all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: Missing floor tiles at cooking line
summary: Floor tiles are missing at the cooking line in the front prep area. Operator instructed to replace them and keep the floor in good repair.

headline: About 14 live cockroaches found; failed
summary: Continued cockroach activity: about 13 live cockroaches in the kitchen, including inside the dish machine, and 1 by the dining room steps. Additional pest control service is needed. Cooking equipment, shelves and bar equipment also need detail cleaning.

headline: Thermometer in coldest spot; unlabeled sugar
summary: Prep cooler thermometer is in the coldest part; move it to the warmest part where it is easy to see. Bulk sugar container lacks a label.

headline: Loose rubber inside ice machine; unlabeled sugar
summary: Ice machine has loose rubber insulation inside; operator must repair it. Bulk sugar container lacked a label. Drains throughout the establishment have buildup that needs cleaning.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and cracked faucet
summary: Three-compartment sink stoppers are missing; manager must provide working ones. Cooler interiors need detail cleaning. Faucet at the three-compartment sink is cracked and sprays water; repair required.

headline: Drainboard needed for air-drying dishes
summary: Kitchen lacks a drainboard for air-drying utensils and dishware. The operator must provide one.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation
summary: No certified food manager with the original City certificate was on site while open; citation issued. Deep fryer exteriors have grease, floor behind the beverage dispenser has trash, and broken cardboard boxes are stored by the rear wall.

headline: Manager lacked food sanitation certificate
summary: Manager on duty lacked a valid City food sanitation certificate while eggs, chicken and hamburgers were prepared; citation issued. Two employees lacked hair restraints. Reach-in cooler interiors, coffee counters, floors, and the dumpster area need cleaning.

headline: 20 rat droppings in basement; failed
summary: About 20 rat droppings on the east basement floor by an unused walk-in cooler; must be removed by reinspection, and pest control is advised. Food handlers lacked hair restraints and training certificates. Standing water on west basement floor.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; greasy floors
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving throughout prep and storage; operator must replace them with shelving six inches off the floor. Grease, food debris, and dirt under cooking equipment and in corners. Dust on walk-in fan and vents.

headline: Unlabeled sour cream; citation issued
summary: A gallon of sour cream lacked a commercial label; manager voluntarily disposed of it (about $20); citation issued. Cooler shelving had food residue that must be cleaned.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; sink water backs up
summary: No chemical test kit to check sanitizer strength; citation issued. Water backs up into the three-compartment sink basins; repair required. Food stored on floor; food handlers lacked hair restraints. Walk-in freezer has excessive ice buildup.

headline: Boxed food on floor; debris in rear prep
summary: Boxed food items were stored on the floor in the rear prep area near the brewery; must be raised six inches. Food debris accumulated on the floor and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Missing container lid; greasy fryers, prep tables
summary: Bulk starch container in storage is missing a lid. Plastic wrap used to tie items at the cook line. Heavy grease on fryer rear and pipes; soiled prep table legs and shelves. Mop head stored against wall.

headline: Wiping cloths on cutting boards; mops misstored
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on cutting boards in the first-floor prep area. Cutting boards have deep cuts and dark stains. Mops were stored inside buckets with soiled water; operator told to hang them to dry.

headline: Milk crates used to elevate stored items
summary: Milk crates must not be used to elevate stored items. Excess coffee beans were removed from the floor under the front counter during inspection. Debris on the basement floor must be cleaned, and items there elevated.

headline: Expired allergen training; broken door handle
summary: Expired allergen training for both City certified managers. Broken right side door handle has a sharp edge and must be repaired. Badly stained cutting board with deep grooves must be replaced. Hood and area under grill need grease cleaning.

headline: Handle-less containers used to scoop food
summary: Handle-less to-go containers were used to scoop food at prep coolers; tongs or ladles required. Dirty wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Handwashing signs missing. Ice buildup in basement freezer, stained cutting boards, and dirty shelves behind coolers.

headline: Food on floor; wet cloths; expired certificate
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor in rear storage; must be raised six inches. Wet wiping cloths sat on prep stations rather than in sanitizer. An employee had an expired food handler certificate. Cooling equipment interiors and counters need cleaning.

headline: Seafood on ice; rear door left open
summary: Seafood was stored in direct contact with ice in the fish prep cooler; instructed not to. Rear exit door was found open and must stay closed. Women's employee sink leaks and drains slowly. Cutting boards have open seams and stains.

headline: No food handler certificate on site
summary: On re-inspection, no food handler training certificate was on site. Inspector instructed the operator to provide one.

headline: Uncovered food; walk-in freezer ice buildup
summary: Uncovered food items in the walk-in cooler and freezer must be covered. Walk-in freezer has ice buildup to defrost. Women's washroom lacks mechanical ventilation; operator must provide it.

headline: Mouse droppings and flies found; failed
summary: About 30 mouse droppings found along walls and floors in several areas, plus small and large flies in dry storage and prep. Pest control recommended. No sanitizer test kit on site; kits were provided during inspection.

headline: Unnecessary items in basement; remove
summary: Unnecessary items were stored in the basement. Inspector instructed removal to avoid clutter.

headline: Bar on 57th floor lacks hand sink
summary: Bar counter on the 57th floor has no hand sink with hot and cold running water, soap and towels; priority violation. No dump sink for waste either. Operator must install both before serving open liquor.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler training certificates were on site; all employees must complete training and keep records there. Also missing handwashing signage at rear prep sink, broken men's room soap dispenser, and debris by the garbage area.

headline: No vomit clean-up kit; menu advisory missing
summary: No clean-up kit for vomiting or diarrhea events was on premises. Raw or undercooked menu items were not asterisked. Several food handlers lacked training certificates. Certified manager lacked allergen training, a repeat violation.

headline: No certified manager during hamburger service
summary: No certified food manager was present while hamburgers were prepared and served; citation issued. Grease needs cleaning from floors and walls behind cooking equipment and the dishwashing area, plus coolers, freezers, fryers and prep tables.

headline: Expired handler and manager allergen certificates
summary: Expired food handler certificate and expired allergen training certificates for both certified managers. Bulk flour container lacks a label. Greasy cooking equipment, floors, walls and hood need detail cleaning.

headline: To-go packaged items lack required labels
summary: Prepackaged to-go items, including bottled juices, fruit and deli sandwiches, lacked the business name and address. Some lacked ingredient lists. Operator instructed to label all prepackaged items.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The certified manager on duty did not have allergen training. Inspector instructed the operator to obtain it.

headline: Live rat, droppings; no certified manager
summary: One live rat was found in a basement utility closet and about 12 droppings in a crawl space. Food was handled without a certified food manager on site. No employee health policy, vomit cleanup procedure, or food handler certificates.

headline: No certified manager on duty; citation
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while eggs, ice cream, ham and milk were prepared and served; citation issued. Person in charge lacks certificate. Handwashing sink faucet leaks; ice cream line sink drains slowly. No summary report was displayed; a new one was posted.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate during food service
summary: No person in charge had a valid City sanitation certificate, and none was present while tortas and baked goods were prepared and served; citation issued. Rear kitchen floors have uneven areas and missing boards that need repair.

headline: Hot and cold foods too warm; corrected on site
summary: Hot shrimp (110.3°F), chicken (105.1–128.3°F) and fries (119.8°F) were below 135°F, and cold sliced cheese was at 52°F. Food was discarded on site. Lower hot-holding unit tagged. Only one food handler had training proof.

headline: No employee health policy; ice machine dirty
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; priority violation. Ice machine interior top is dirty, and the ice is for consumption. No stem thermometer was on site, but the manager provided one during inspection. Washed utensils hang above sinks.

headline: Greasy hood filters and hood
summary: Grease has built up on the hood filters and hood. Operator instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Basement dry storage poorly lit; bulbs out
summary: Basement dry storage has inadequate lighting, and several light bulbs are not working. Operator must provide adequate lighting.

headline: Live flies; unsafe cold food; no manager
summary: Over 7 live house flies found throughout the facility. Raw fish at 64°F and other cold foods at 46–69°F; about 100 lb discarded. Prep coolers ran too warm. No person in charge or certified manager was on site.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training; basement clutter
summary: New manager lacks food allergen training certification. Basement floor has dirt and spoiling onions; clutter and unused equipment should be cleared to prevent pests. Walk-in freezer floor has debris. Open wall under front hand sink must be sealed.

headline: Hand hygiene lapses; slime; flies found
summary: Food handlers touched their faces and phones, then handled food without washing hands. About 30 or more live small flies were seen in the dish area. Black slime in a soda machine's ice chute; machine tagged held for inspection. Citations issued.

headline: Cold foods at 46–48°F; coolers tagged
summary: Several cold foods were stored at 46–48°F and must be kept at 41°F or below. Manager discarded about $500 of food; citation issued. Two coolers, including a walk-in, ran at 46°F and were tagged.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit kit
summary: No verifiable employee health policy and no procedure or kit for vomiting and diarrhea events were on site; citations issued. Bar handwashing sink lacks signage. Torn cooler gasket; broken unused cooler must be repaired or removed.

headline: Manager lacked City certification; citation
summary: Food service manager on site lacked City of Chicago certification while salads, cookies and other ready-to-eat foods were prepared; citation issued. Cooking equipment sides, underside and gas grill grates have grease, dust and food buildup.

headline: Floor storage under sink; no handler certificates
summary: Items were stored on the floor under the three-compartment sink; they must be kept six inches up. No food handler certificates were on site; the person in charge must direct all food handlers to get training.

headline: Tongs on food container; missing light shields
summary: In-use tongs were stored directly on top of a food container in the prep area. A mop was stored improperly in the mop sink area. Light shields are missing in the dishwashing and storage area.

headline: Gaps at entrance doors; rust on freezer shelves
summary: Openings at the base of both front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Rust on walk-in freezer shelving must be removed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; corrected on site
summary: Exposed hand sinks lacked handwashing signs; signs were provided during inspection. Debris in a corner behind the bar was cleaned during inspection. Both issues were corrected on site.

headline: Stained cutting boards; burned-out bulbs
summary: Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Kitchen clutter must be removed and stock elevated six inches. Two burned-out bulbs above cooking equipment need replacement.

headline: No allergen training certificates on premises
summary: On re-inspection, no food allergen training certificates were on premises. All City-certified food managers must have one.

headline: Missing handwashing signs, thermometers, certificates
summary: Missing handwashing sign and cooler thermometers. Knives and scissors stored improperly; milk crates used as shelving. Employee washroom bulbs out. Food handler certificates not posted; certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Live plant over food prep; poor stoppers
summary: Staff coffee cups were placed on a prep table; keep them off food-contact surfaces. A live potted plant was placed in the kitchen above the food prep area. Three-compartment sink stoppers are in poor repair and do not hold water; working stoppers required.

headline: Chicken thawed in sink water; missing signs
summary: Chicken was thawing in water on the sink drainboard; approved thawing methods required. Missing handwashing sign, display cooler thermometer, and two sink stoppers. Summary report was not visible to the public; citation issued.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; loose gaskets
summary: Some sandwich prep coolers lack thermometers; working thermometers are required for all coolers. Reach-in cooler door gaskets are not tight-fitting. Dust has built up on prep-area cooler condensers and must be cleaned.

headline: No handwash sign; hole in men's wall
summary: No handwashing sign at the kitchen hand sink. Utensils were not stored properly and must be inverted. Men's washroom wall has a hole near the urinal. Vents in both washrooms are dirty.

headline: Uninverted plates; torn cooler gasket
summary: Serving plates on shelves in prep, dry storage and dining areas were not inverted; operator told to invert them to prevent dust. A two-door refrigerator has a torn gasket, and a service cooler lid has loose knobs. Walls and ceiling need cleaning.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings found; failed
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings found on the rear storage room floor and sales floor. Area must be cleaned and pest control service completed before the reinspection next week. Citation issued. Clutter and water-stained ceiling tiles also noted.

headline: Blocked hand sink; cold foods too warm
summary: Front coffee prep hand sink had no paper towels and was blocked by almond milk containers; citation issued. Almond milk held at 50.1°F; about 4 lb discarded. Refrigerators lack thermometers. Dumpster has broken or missing lids.

headline: Expired handler certificates; some fixes on site
summary: Some food handler certificates are expired and must be renewed. Heavy grease under steamer and fryers must be cleaned. A leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink and utility sink were corrected on site, as was washroom fan dust.

headline: No handwash soap at bar and prep sinks
summary: Bar and prep-area handwashing sinks had no soap; soap was provided during the inspection, and a citation was issued. Handwashing signs missing in toilet rooms. Dry storage containers lack common-name labels. Rear storage is cluttered.

headline: Hot foods below 135°F; no sanitizer
summary: Pasta at 110°F, chicken at 104°F and vegetable pizza at 126°F were below 135°F in hot holding; 9 lb discarded. Three-compartment sink had no sanitizer; citation issued. No certified manager on duty while food was served. Managers lack allergen training.

headline: Ice machine buildup; missing sink stopper
summary: Slight buildup in the upper portion of the ice machine must be cleaned and maintained. The three-compartment sink is missing a stopper.

headline: Leaking hand sink; missing ceiling panels
summary: Staff men's toilet room hand sink leaks from pipes; repair required. Missing ceiling tile panels in the rear prep and dish area must be replaced, or stained tiles replaced.

headline: Live mice, rat, and over 350 droppings
summary: Live mice and a rat; over 350 droppings in dining room, prep areas, basement and on stored food. Pest control required. Food held too warm, including al pastor at 109.4°F. Ice machine slime and missing paper towels also cited.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; allergen training gap
summary: Washrooms lacked handwashing signage. A ceiling tile is missing near the ice maker. Light bulbs in the pizza prep area need protective shielding or shatterproof bulbs. Certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Mouse droppings and live roach; failed reinspection
summary: Previous violation not corrected: 38 mouse droppings found in oven, behind cooking line, under dining booths, and on shelves. A live baby roach was found on a cutting board. Updated pest control receipt required. Food handler and allergen certificates were missing.

headline: Rusty shelving; dusty covers; poor lighting
summary: Rusty food storage shelving in the rear storage area must be repainted or replaced. Light shield covers above front refrigeration units are dusty. Rear food storage area has inadequate lighting.

headline: Three-compartment sink stoppers not working
summary: Drain stoppers for the three-compartment sink are not in working order. Manager instructed to repair them or buy stoppers that fit over the drain.

headline: No handwashing sink in basement prep area
summary: Basement prep area has food prep and storage but no handwashing sink; one must be installed by 3/20. Waste pipes run above the three-compartment sink and prep tables and must be encased. No food handler certificates on premises.

headline: Cold unit at 46.6°F; tagged
summary: Small cold-holding unit in the rear prep area measured 46.6°F, above 41°F, and was tagged on site. Front prep area lacks barriers, or they are too short, to keep customers from touching food and equipment.

headline: Coolers off while traveling; no advisory
summary: Coolers were not operating while the vehicle was moving because the generator was off. Priority violation. No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods such as steak. License number must appear on both sides of the truck.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 64°F; meats discarded
summary: Walk-in cooler measured 64.2°F, too warm for raw and cooked meats; cooler tagged and must not be used. Cooked sausage (54.1°F), raw chicken wings (64.2°F) and pork ribs (63.5°F) were too warm; about $70 discarded.

headline: Unlabeled sauce; no food handler certificates
summary: Sauce in the prep cooler near the oven lacked ingredient labels. Basement storage is cluttered and needs items raised six inches off the floor. Food handlers lacked training certificates on site; the certified manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Live cockroaches again; boric acid misuse
summary: Over 10 live cockroaches again seen in prep areas, stairwell, ceiling and basement; additional pest control needed. Heavy boric acid use along walls must be removed; pest control operator must apply pesticides. Grease and food debris remain on equipment.

headline: Soiled bowls stored for use; no training proof
summary: Clear prep bowls with food debris were stored ready to use; staff told to rewash and sanitize. Floors, walls and corners had grease and dirt. No proof of food handler training was shown; no manager had allergen training documentation.

headline: Undated food held over 24 hours; citation
summary: Ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours were not date marked, including cooked chicken wings and General Tso's chicken; citation issued. Ice machine has encrusted debris. Two employees lacked hair restraints. Insect device hung over prep area must be moved.

headline: Uncovered ice bin; greasy fryers and walls
summary: Ice bin at the bar has no lid and must be covered. Fryer interiors have grease and dirt buildup. Rear prep floors, corners, and the wall behind cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Toilet room door not self-closing
summary: Toilet room door does not close itself. Operator instructed to add a self-closing device and maintain it.

headline: Ice machine residue; plates not inverted
summary: Residue inside the rear ice machine must be cleaned. Plates in the kitchen were facing up and must be stored inverted. Heavy grease on the outside oil container. Floors throughout prep areas need cleaning.

headline: Food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Food handlers had no training certificates on site. Must provide proof of training.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site. Operator must keep verification for each employee on site at all times; no citation issued today. Ice machine upper lining is not clean; floor drains under the three-compartment sink need cleaning.

headline: Disposable items on floor; summary not posted
summary: Single-use items were stored directly on the basement floor; they must be at least 6 inches up. Ventilation cover in the basement walk-in freezer is dusty. Prior inspection summary was not visible to the public; a current report was posted and a citation issued.

headline: No sanitizer in three-compartment sink; citation
summary: Sanitizing basin had no sanitizing solution when inspected; citation issued. A food handler had an improper hair restraint around exposed food. Leak under the three-compartment sink. Dust and debris under equipment; soiled mop stored in bucket.

headline: Stained cutting boards; greasy fryer cabinets
