summary: Failed. Women's restroom handsink had 86.5-87.3F water; at least 100F required. Waste water spilled from a floor drain while draining the 3-compartment sink; citation issued. Outside dumpsters overflowing with lids unable to close; citation issued.

headline: Passed; food debris in coolers and behind bins
summary: Passed. Food debris in two-door reach-in coolers in front prep must be removed and the units cleaned after each use. Excess food debris behind the garbage bins in front prep must be cleaned.

headline: Failed; about 25 small flies, low hot water
summary: Failed. About 25 small flies seen near the dish machine, sinks, and storage racks; citation issued. A front hand sink had 83.4F water; a technician brought sinks to 102-105F during inspection. Food debris and spills on floors also noted.

headline: Passed; door opening, leaks, missing grease traps
summary: Passed. An opening at the base of the rear exit door could let pests in and must be sealed. Also noted rust on walk-in shelving, leaks onto basement floors, and no verifiable grease traps at two basement sinks.

headline: Passed; repairs needed, allergen proof pending
summary: Passed. Repairs needed: seal a raw wood sill, remove a peeling cooler sticker, fix a damaged HVAC closet floor and walls, replace a plastic floor drain lid, and add missing baseboard coving. The certified food manager must provide allergen proof.

headline: Passed; kitchen grease, dirt, and storage issues
summary: Passed. Heavy grease and dirt under kitchen equipment and at dish-area floor drains. Foil lining shelves and pipes must be removed to avoid pest hiding spots. Serving plates to be stored upside down; torn freezer gasket to be repaired.

headline: Passed; soda nozzles need cleaning
summary: Passed. Soda nozzles have syrup splatter and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Failed; overfilled trash, expired allergen certificate
summary: Failed. Outside garbage receptacles were overfilled with lids unable to close; priority citation issued. The certified food manager had an expired allergen certificate, and the manager was told to comply.

headline: Conditions; uncertified employee, repeat allergen violation
summary: Pass with conditions. An employee lacked a food handler certificate. A repeat violation from an October 2023 inspection, missing valid allergen training for managers, was not corrected; citation issued. Grease on oven, fryer, and stove must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; signage, trash lid, old equipment, lighting
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs in restrooms. Women's restroom needs a lidded receptacle. Unused old equipment in the kitchen must be removed. Walk-in cooler needs additional lighting.

headline: Passed; open drink on prep table
summary: Passed. An open cup of coffee sat on a kitchen prep table. It must be stored with a lid in a separate area away from food prep. Grease spills inside the fryer must be cleaned. Staff toilet trash can lacks a lid.

headline: Failed; repeat violations, no food handler training
summary: Failed. Several violations from an August 2025 inspection remain uncorrected, including missing handwashing signs, unlabeled bulk containers, fly strips over prep areas, and grime on walls, floors, and hood filters. Employees lack food handler training; citation issued.

headline: Passed; prep cooler needs thermometer
summary: Passed. An ambient air thermometer must be provided inside the drawer prep cooler.

headline: Failed; over 50 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings found throughout, including by dry storage in the dining area, the smoothie bar, and under the dish machine. Citation issued. Also a leak under a prep handsink, wet floors, and personal items stored beside dry food.

headline: Conditions; prep cooler at 60F, tagged out
summary: Pass with conditions. Reach-in cooler in the prep area measured 60F and food was stored with ice on top. Tagged and held for inspection by the Chicago Department of Public Health (CDPH). Must not be used until it holds 41F.

headline: Failed; about 80 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. About 80 mouse droppings found in rear dry storage, between and on pallets. Citation issued; staff must remove droppings and sanitize. Also a leak at the meat prep handsink and no covered receptacle in the women's restroom.

headline: Conditions; walk-in cooler too warm, food discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Walk-in cooler air measured 49.4F; ham at 48.0F and cheese at 49.4F were discarded (30 lbs, $100). Citation issued. Also ice buildup on condenser, dirty floor drain and ice machine, and a burned-out freezer bulb.

headline: Failed; roaches seen, no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Failed. About 10 roaches seen during inspection, including small roaches on the cashier's register, with activity near the rear hot water closet. Citation issued. Cleanup kit present but no written vomit and diarrhea procedure. Advisory signage was provided.

headline: Passed; ice machine, dish machine, trash lid
summary: Passed. Clean the ice machine interior and delime the low-temperature dish machine behind the bar. The women's washroom needs a covered waste receptacle. Clean the floor and walls under the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Passed; no covered trash in employee toilet
summary: Passed. The employee toilet room has no covered receptacle. The business was instructed to provide one.

headline: Failed; inoperable cooler, leaking wastewater
summary: Failed. Large deli cooler was inoperable and must hold 41F or below. Waste water leaks in the basement, no routine pest control or log, no barrier between food prep and public areas, and no signed employee health policy forms.

headline: Failed; slime in ice machine, no certified manager
summary: Failed. Self-serve ice machine had black and white slime, with ice used for consumption; citation issued. No certified food manager while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. No written employee health policy or food handler training proof. Three-compartment faucet too short; citation issued.

headline: Conditions; no health policies, missing training
summary: Pass with conditions. No signed employee health policies; citation issued. Missing or expired food handler training. No previous summary report was posted; a new one was given, citation issued. Also front door gaps, grease, debris, and damaged tiles and ceilings.

headline: Passed; certified manager lacked allergen certificate
summary: Passed. The certified food manager lacked a valid allergen training certificate. Management was told that all food handling employees must show valid proof of training.

headline: Conditions; blocked handsink, no soap or towels
summary: Pass with conditions. Rear dish-area handsink was blocked by beverage cartons; citation issued. Handsinks in the rear dish area and front beverage station lacked soap and paper towels. Also torn cooler gaskets, a wet mop in a bucket, and clutter in storage.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign, allergen certificate
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the rear handsink. The manager on duty lacked a state allergen certificate; all managers must meet requirements.

headline: Passed; ice buildup in walk-in freezer
summary: Passed. Ice buildup on the condenser line and the walk-in freezer floor must be defrosted and maintained.

headline: Failed; mouse droppings, hot food too cool, oysters
summary: Failed. About 100 mouse droppings found in bakery prep, rear dry storage, and under a self-service unit; citation issued. Hot food held at 120-130.2F, below 135F. Fresh oysters lacked shellstock tags. Discarded on site; citation issued.

headline: Passed; food on floor, no training proof
summary: Passed. Carrots stored on the walk-in floor must be raised six inches. Personal food stored in the cooler must move. Frozen chicken in plastic grocery bags must use food-grade containers. No proof of food handler training; one of two managers lacks allergen proof.

headline: Conditions; no certified manager, long fingernails
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food service manager on site, and no certificate posted, while deli meat and eggs were handled. Priority violation. A food handler had long fingernails and was instructed to trim them; priority violation.

headline: Passed; wall holes, cabinet debris, grease
summary: Passed. Holes in walls under cabinets and sunken shelving must be sealed to prevent pests. Coffee grounds and debris inside cabinets, grease and dust on equipment, a coming-apart counter siding, and dirty floors must be cleaned or repaired.

headline: Passed; sticky residue inside ice machine
summary: Passed. A black, sticky substance was found in the middle of the ice machine at the end of the hot cook line. The business was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Passed; cutting boards, leak, spills, trash lid
summary: Passed. Cutting boards need replacing. Sides of cooking equipment need cleaning of food spills. A bar three-compartment faucet leaks. The ladies room needs a covered trash can. Main prep floors need cleaning of spills and debris.

headline: Failed; cooler at 52.2F, no paper towels
summary: Failed. Four-door cooler held 52.2F and must be repaired to 41F or below. Employee washroom handsink had no paper towels. Washroom door lacks a working self-closing device. Unisex toilet room needs covered receptacles.

headline: Passed; floor storage, leaks, no splashguard
summary: Passed. Boxed items stored on the dry storage floor must be corrected. A splashguard is needed between the handsink and 3-compartment sink. Ice on the walk-in freezer threshold must be removed. A drain pipe leaks under the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Passed; soap dispenser location, missing ceiling tile
summary: Passed. Hand soap dispenser near the bread ovens must be relocated or removed; soap belongs only at designated handwashing sinks. Single-service items under a dripping sink must be moved. A missing ceiling tile in dry storage must be replaced.

headline: Passed; no beard restraint, no allergen certificates
summary: Passed. An employee with a beard was not wearing a beard restraint. Grease inside the deep fryer must be cleaned. Debris in the crawl space and under the dish machine must be cleaned. An additional food handler certificate and allergen certificates for managers are required on site.

headline: Passed; raw wood shelving, ice machine backflow
summary: Passed. Raw wood shelving in the basement must be sealed or painted to be cleanable. Inspector saw no backflow device on the ice machine and required one.

headline: Passed; floors need cleaning under equipment
summary: Passed. Floors along wall bases and under equipment, especially around the dish area and storage room, must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Failed; ice machine dirty, menu advisory missing
summary: Failed. Menu lacked a reminder about undercooked eggs; priority citation. Ice machine interior needs cleaning. A leak under the 3-compartment sink drips into a bucket. Items stored on floors, cardboard liners, and duct tape repairs must be corrected.

headline: Conditions; no certified manager, no handsink soap
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site on arrival; priority violation and citation issued. The only front prep handsink had no soap; the manager stocked it. Priority violation and citation issued.

headline: Passed; broken freezer handle, heavy grease
summary: Passed. Broken upright freezer door handle exposes sharp metal, a safety hazard, and must be repaired. Heavy grease and food debris on cooking equipment, plus dirt under equipment, must be cleaned. A floor tile is missing.

headline: Passed; food on floor, no backflow device
summary: Passed. Food items were stored on the floor in prep and storage areas and must be raised six inches. The utility sink lacks a backflow device, which the manager must provide and maintain.

headline: Passed; two employees lacked food handler training
summary: Passed. Two employees on duty did not have food handler training as required. The manager was told to comply, or a citation will follow.

headline: Passed; broken thermometer, grease buildup
summary: Passed. The ambient air thermometer inside the two-door reach-in cooler is not working and must be replaced. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, floors, and the exhaust hood must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; repairs, leaks, clutter in basement
summary: Passed. Items must be raised off floors in rear storage, basement, and walk-in cooler. Repairs needed for a leaking sink faucet, water-damaged and missing ceiling tiles, broken front dining floor tiles, and an open basement washroom wall. Remove clutter to prevent rodent hiding.

headline: Conditions; no vomit cleanup kit, no mop sink backflow
summary: Pass with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit with spill kit; must be provided. No mop sink with a vacuum breaker at the faucet; must be provided. No citation for the vomit kit item.

headline: Conditions; no certified food manager on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge with certified food manager training on site. No certified food employee on site while TCS beverages and sandwiches were prepared; citation issued. Clean linens stored under the soap dispenser; no waste receptacle at rear warewashing handsink.

headline: Passed; door gap, expired food handler training
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear garage and exit doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Also a damaged reach-in cooler gasket, an unsuitable plastic sink stopper, and one employee with expired food handler training.

headline: Passed; meat slicer not clean behind blade
summary: Passed. The meat slicer in the basement prep kitchen was not clean behind the blade. The business was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Passed; door gap and dusty vents
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front carry-out door must be sealed. Clean walk-in shelving, floors under equipment, the walk-in floor, rear prep ceiling vent, and light shields. The oven vent is dusty.

headline: Passed; missing ceiling tiles to replace
summary: Passed. Inspector noted missing ceiling tiles in the rear and instructed the business to replace them and keep the area maintained.

headline: Failed; no soap, sink backs up, citation issued
summary: Failed. Bar handsink had no soap; corrected on site. Water backs up from the third basin into the first two of the 3-compartment sink, a citation item. Stained cutting boards, damaged floor tiles, and leaking pipes also noted.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet, wall hole, misplaced items
summary: Passed. A metal scoop was buried in flour in basement dry storage and must be removed. Bulk paper towels in employee washrooms must be relocated. A basement sink faucet leaks, a wall hole needs repair, and a washroom waste receptacle needs a cover.

headline: Passed; no mop hangers provided
summary: Passed. No mop hangers were provided. The business was instructed to install them.

headline: Conditions; dish machine not sanitizing, citation
summary: Pass with conditions. High-temperature dish machine reached only 135F, not the required 180F; citation issued and staff told to use the 3-compartment sinks. Aprons, towels, and linens stored on the shed floor must be raised off the floor.

headline: Passed; missing cooler thermometers, several repairs
summary: Passed. No thermometers in bar coolers or the standing one-door cooler. Other items: slight ice machine buildup, a ripped sushi cooler gasket, condensation from the walk-in condenser, and low grout around the dish machine.

headline: Passed; stained cutting boards, wall residue
summary: Passed. Stained cutting boards in the prep area must be stained-free or replaced. A black and pinkish substance on the wall by the rear 3-compartment sink must be cleaned. Dusty vents in the meat prep area must be cleaned.

headline: No health policy, vomit kit or pest log
summary: Fail. No employee health policy, no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit, and no pest control logbook on site; instructed to provide and maintain each. No citations issued.

headline: Ice machine, freezers, washroom doors need work
summary: Pass. Interior of ice machine must be cleaned. Grocery bags used for food storage in freezer; must use food-grade bags. Two small refrigerators have ice buildup; washroom doors not self-closing. Floors near cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled containers; no drain stoppers
summary: Pass. Some food containers (flour, sugar, cornmeal) need common-name labels. Three drain stoppers needed for three-compartment sink. Employee restroom bin lid needed; dust on ceiling above rear prep; expired allergen training certificate.

headline: Chicken too warm; no hand-wash signs
summary: Fail. Fresh chicken (49.9°F) and egg rolls (48.5°F) too warm in rear walk-in cooler; about 40 lbs ($280) discarded. Ready-to-eat foods lacked date labels; about 30 lbs ($60) discarded. No handwashing signs near sinks.

headline: Hand hygiene lapse; chicken too warm
summary: Fail. Employee handled customers' orders without changing gloves or washing hands; cited. Chicken in display cooler at 46.6–47.4°F; 3.5 lbs ($18) discarded. Grab-and-go foods lacked allergen labels and were removed from self-service. Wine stored in restroom.

headline: Three-compartment sink stoppers broken
summary: Pass. All three built-in stoppers at the three-compartment sink are inoperable and cannot hold water; must repair and maintain.

headline: No certified manager while serving TCS food
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on premises and no original certificate posted while foods that must be kept hot or cold (TCS), like breakfast sandwiches and milk, were prepared or served. Priority citation issued.

headline: Utility sink nozzle; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Pass. Utility sink hot water nozzle needs repair. Certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate; must obtain and keep one on site.

headline: Food stored in grocery bags in coolers
summary: Pass. Food items in coolers and refrigeration units stored in grocery bags; instructed to use approved food-grade containers.

headline: Torn gaskets; stained cutting boards
summary: Pass. Torn gaskets on prep cooler at cook line and pastry cooler next to walk-in; must repair or replace. Deeply stained cutting boards on rear cook line must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; no test strips
summary: Pass with conditions. Bulk salt and sugar containers unlabeled. Some food handlers lack hair restraints. Deli cups not air-dried after washing. No chlorine test strips at bar low-temp dishwashing (cited).

headline: Rear door gaps; leaking pipe; dirty hood
summary: Pass. Rear exit door is not tight-fitting on sides, top or bottom, allowing possible pest entry. Leaking pipe under middle three-compartment sink. Floors need cleaning; hood above cooking equipment needs grease removed.

headline: Hair restraints, leaks, rusty racks
summary: Pass. Employees in prep area not wearing hair restraints; instructed to wear them. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution. Rust on walk-in storage racks. Leaks under prep sink and under middle basin of basement three-compartment sink.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; greasy floors; filters
summary: Pass. Condenser leaking and ice buildup in reach-in freezer; second-floor walk-in freezer must be defrosted and cleaned. Floors around main kitchen cooking equipment need cleaning. Filters in bagel kitchen hood need cleaning.

headline: Food handler hair restraint missing
summary: Pass. Food handler not wearing a hair restraint; must provide one and wear it.

headline: Fly traps over prep tables; hair restraints
summary: Pass. Fly traps mounted above food prep tables must be removed; insect control devices cannot be placed above open food or clean utensils. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints; instructed to wear them.

headline: Employee restroom garbage can lacks lid
summary: Pass. Garbage can in employee washroom has no lid; must provide and maintain one.

headline: Unlabeled containers; soiled wiping cloths
summary: Pass. Some food and spices out of original containers lack product-name labels. Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables; instructed to store them in sanitizing solution between uses.

headline: Unlabeled containers; bowl stored in flour
summary: Pass. Dry ingredients and squirt bottles lack common-name labels. Plastic bowl stored inside flour container; instructed to transfer food with handled utensils. Ice machine guard has black and pink residue; wall under dishwasher has openings.

headline: Rear dry storage containers need labels
summary: Pass. Food storage containers on the rear dry storage shelf must be labeled with the common name of the food, and kept labeled.

headline: No certified sanitation manager on premises
summary: Pass with conditions. No City-certified sanitation manager on premises while chicken and deli meat (TCS foods) were handled; cited. Person in charge (PIC) also lacks the certificate and must provide one.

headline: Leaking faucet; allergen training needed
summary: Pass. Leak at base of right faucet on basement three-compartment sink. Water-stained, missing ceiling tile in hall near toilets; pitted floor under basement sink; dirty storage and basement floors. Managers must take allergen training.

headline: Leaking pipe under rear handwash sink
summary: Pass. Leak at bottom pipe of rear handwashing sink next to three-compartment sink; person in charge must repair and maintain.

headline: Dishmachine lacks sanitizer; unit tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. Low-temp dishmachine had no sanitizer during sanitizing cycle; unit tagged, must not be used until reinspected. Food stored on walk-in floor corrected on site. Slow drains and leaking pipes at several sinks; expired food handler certificates.

headline: Clean water inlet cover missing
summary: Pass. Cover is missing over the clean water inlet; must provide one to prevent possible contamination.

headline: Bare hands on snow peas; bin on floor
summary: Pass with conditions. Employee put snow peas on a plate with bare hands to serve a dine-in customer; about 2 lbs ($5) discarded (cited). Avocados stored on floor under prep table; ice machine has black buildup.

headline: Faucet leaking onto floor and wall
summary: Pass. Handwashing sink next to three-compartment sink has a leaning faucet neck spraying water onto floor and back wall, with inadequate wall seal. Must reseal and repair.

headline: Missing handwashing and warewashing sinks
summary: Fail. No handwashing sink at front prep area (cited). No three-compartment sink or grease trap with drainboard (cited). Mop sink lacks backflow device. One food handler lacks training. Raw wood prep table must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager; bare-hand sandwich handling
summary: Fail. No City-certified food manager on site. Employee used bare hands on a ready-to-eat sandwich; manager discarded it. Ice machine had black-pink buildup, cleaned on site. Three-compartment sink floods when drained; garbage outside dumpster.

headline: Multiple leaks; managers lack allergen training
summary: Pass. Significant leak from front bar handsink drain pipe onto floor; sink still works. Leaking faucet base at scrape sink by dish machine; four-compartment bar sink leaks from both handles. Both managers lack valid allergen training.

headline: Food on floor; milk crates; leaking sink
summary: Pass. Food containers stored on floor in utility sink area must be elevated six inches. Milk crates used as shelving must be removed. Middle basin of three-compartment sink leaks from drain pipe; must repair.

headline: Rat droppings found in kitchen areas
summary: Rat droppings found: about 10 in the hot water tank room and 30 under rear pizza ovens. Must be removed by reinspection; pest control advised. Food buildup on rear coolers. Employee washroom lacks covered trash can and fan ventilation.

headline: Mouse droppings found; many violations
summary: Fail. About 60 or more mouse droppings found under meat slicer, rear prep floor and office desk; must remove and sanitize, with pest control service recommended (cited). Dumpsters overflowing with lids open. Multiple repeat violations.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; 75 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Walk-in cooler air 48.2°F; many foods held above 41°F (cooked rigatoni 45°F, ricotta 45°F, mozzarella 47°F). About 75 lbs ($350) discarded; cited.

headline: Basement clutter must be cleaned
summary: Pass. Basement contains clutter, including old equipment and chemicals; must clean and organize.

headline: Cold foods too warm; door gap; upkeep issues
summary: Many cold foods above 41°F (e.g., garlic mayo 57.6°F); about 40 lbs ($950) discarded. Coolers ran 49–50°F; no working thermometer inside cold holding. Quarter-inch gap at rear door could admit pests. Also cleaning, labeling, lighting fixes.

headline: Food thermometer off by 12 degrees
summary: Pass with conditions. Food probe thermometer was off by 12 degrees; manager instructed to obtain an accurate one (cited). Grocery bags used to store frozen food in basement chest freezers. Live pottery plant stored in food prep area.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty fans, floors
summary: Pass. Bulk flour, sugar, coffee and rice containers lack common-name labels. Pans and bowls in warewashing area not inverted. Floors, drains and walk-in cooler walls need detail cleaning; dust on fans, light shields and vents.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler training
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager or certificate on site while burgers, coleslaw and hot dogs were prepared and served (cited). Food handlers lack training certificates. Cutting boards stained; ice machine has black buildup.

headline: Drinking from open cup near prep line
summary: Pass with conditions. Employee drank from an uncovered cup on the main prep line; must drink only in designated areas or from closed containers. Front prep cooler at 49°F, not in use and tagged. Leaking ice machine water line; base coving missing.

headline: Basement storage door not rodent-proof
summary: Pass. Basement storage room door is not rodent-proof; instructed to install a door sweep. Food service managers must also obtain the required food allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager; meat stored on floor
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site upon arrival; person in charge must ensure one is present at all times (cited). Rack of meat on sheet pan on floor; rust on walk-in racks; hole in dry storage wall; grease and dust near griddle.

headline: No certified manager while serving chicken
summary: Fail. No person in charge or certified manager on site while chicken was prepared and served; cited. Rust on cooler storage racks. Hot water at three-compartment sink runs when turned off. Repeat violations: expired food handler certificate and allergen training.

headline: Missing self-closing door; no basement light
summary: Pass with conditions. Basement washroom door lacks a working self-closing device. Basement walk-in freezer has no working light. Core violation from 11/16/23 not corrected: no allergen training certificates on site; citation issued.

headline: Food labels and handler certificates needed
summary: Pass. Must label all dry storage containers (flour, sugar) with common names. Loose handwashing sink faucet behind coffee bar. Missing light shield on walk-in cooler light. Food handler certificates could not be verified; must keep on site.

headline: Multiple violations; cold food too warm
summary: Fail. No certified food manager on site; no employee health policies; no basement handwashing station. Cooler food reached 70.3°F (rice); management discarded about 50 lbs. Cooler air 48.2°F, tagged and held from use.

headline: Unapproved food source; shellfish tags missing
summary: Pass with conditions. Unlabeled vacuum-packed seafood and risotto from unapproved source, with no invoices; about 10 lbs ($100) discarded. Shellfish container lacked a tag; 8 lbs ($85) discarded. Black buildup inside both ice machines.

headline: Unapproved insect devices; no splash guard
summary: Pass. Unapproved insect control devices hang from ceiling in basement dry storage; instructed to remove. Handwashing sink in basement prep kitchen needs a splash guard. Torn cooler gaskets and stained cutting boards need repair.

headline: Loose wall base next to lockers
summary: Pass. Loose wall base next to lockers must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water on site
summary: Fail. No certified manager on site while chicken was prepared and served; cited. Quarter-inch gap under outside entrance door could let pests in. Water heater leaking. No hot water on site; three-compartment sink measured 84°F (cited).

headline: Chicken thawed in stagnant water
summary: Pass. Food handler thawed frozen chicken in a container sitting in stagnant water; inspector explained running-water thawing. Milk crates used as shelving in rear storage. Leaking two-compartment sink faucet; burnt-out bulbs in storage.

headline: Pushcart missing license number
summary: Pass. Pushcart has no license number on either side. Instructed to place the license number on both lateral sides, 2 inches high, including the business name.

headline: Cold holding unit at 46°F; no sign
summary: Fail. Cold holding unit could not keep 41°F or lower; ambient air 46°F, must be serviced (critical violation, no citation). No handwashing sign; stained, grooved cutting board; leak at three-compartment sink base; peeling paint near electrical box.

headline: Handwashing sinks blocked with cups
summary: Pass with conditions. Front and rear handwashing sinks were filled with cups and inaccessible; manager removed items during inspection (cited). Heavy grease on can opener and hood filters. Missing drywall in kitchen ceiling near electrical panel.

headline: Live roach in kitchen; shellfish tag issue
summary: Fail. Live roach found in main kitchen; roaches must be eliminated (cited). Shellfish container lacked its required tag; about 0.5 lbs discarded. Mac and cheese at 46°F discarded (about 5 lbs). Broken thermometers at banquet walk-in.

headline: Cold foods too warm; greasy container
summary: Fail. Cooked pork, raw chicken, cheese and other cold foods held above 41°F in prep cooler; about 49 lbs ($146) discarded. Outside grease container heavily encrusted, a food source for rodents and pests (cited). Employee lacked hair restraint.

headline: Wiping cloths, rusty prep table bottom
summary: Pass. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables; must store in sanitizing solution. Rust on bottom of rear prep table must be repainted or replaced. Second restroom lacks covered waste receptacle; floors and walls need cleaning.

headline: Dishes not inverted; dirty shelving and floors
summary: Pass. Dishes on front serving line must be inverted to prevent contamination. Dry storage shelving, racks and shelves under cooking equipment need cleaning. Rear storage floors need debris removed and kept dry to avoid pest breeding.

headline: Leaking four-compartment sink; wiping cloths
summary: Pass. Two leaks at the pipe and under the sanitizing compartment of the four-compartment sink; must fix. Wiping cloths not stored properly when not in use; must be kept in sanitizing solution.

headline: Cold food too warm; unapproved vacuum packing
summary: Fail. Cold foods held 44.8–50.2°F; 15 lbs ($250) discarded. Vacuum-packed food lacked required approval; 90 lbs ($2,250) discarded. Dishwasher final rinse too cool, tagged. Hot water at a handwashing sink was 63°F, since fixed.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No City of Chicago certified food manager on site while rice and chicken were handled and served; instructed to obtain one. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint; instructed to wear one.

headline: Greasy floors and truck surfaces
summary: Pass. Food grease stains on floors and surfaces of the truck; instructed to increase cleaning frequency and maintain at all times.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; clutter; dirty floors
summary: Pass. Rear handwashing sink has no handwashing sign. Clutter and unused equipment in rear prep area. Floors throughout facility have accumulated dirt and debris; instructed to clean all.

headline: No handwashing signs; ice buildup, leak
summary: Pass. No handwashing signs at any sink or in public restrooms; must provide. Ice buildup on walk-in freezer floor, walls and ceiling; must detail clean. Minor drain leak under beverage station handwashing sink.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Pass. Certified food managers are missing allergen training. Instructed to obtain it and keep it on record.

headline: Rice cooled poorly; sink faucets leak
summary: Pass. Large container of cooked rice stored in a way that blocks heat transfer; instructed to divide into smaller containers. Both three-compartment sink faucets leak; instructed to repair. Dried food debris under basement shelving.

headline: Rear door gap; debris; unused fryer stored
summary: Pass. Rear exit door not fully rodent-proofed; 1/4-inch gap at bottom must be sealed. Food debris on floors throughout prep areas. Unused deep fryer stored in rear prep area; must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: No hot water at restroom handwashing sinks
summary: Fail. Employee and customer restroom handwashing sinks had no hot running water; temperature 76.5–77.7°F. Must provide at least 100°F at all handwashing sinks (cited). Three-compartment sink leaks when drained; waste water caught in bus pan.

headline: Front doors need sealing; dumpster area dirty
summary: Pass. A 1/4-inch gap under the front double doors must be made rodent-proof. Indoor dumpster area walls and floor have food and dirt buildup. Dumpster area room has no working ceiling light bulbs.

headline: No hot water on site; grease buildup
summary: Pass with conditions. No hot water: sinks measured 80–85°F; hot water restored during inspection (cited). Standing water behind water heater, dirt under fountain machine, grease on hood vent, a burnt-out light, and no allergen training certificate.

headline: Missing handwash sign; dirty exhaust vent
summary: Pass. Basement handwashing sink lacks a handwashing sign. Dining room exhaust ventilation has dirt and debris buildup; must detail clean and maintain.

headline: Front door gap; bakery labels needed
summary: Pass. Gap along top and bottom of front double doors allows insect entry; must be made tight-fitting. Repackaged bakery goods on display need proper labels. Worn gaskets on two coolers; basement ice machine lacks backflow device.

headline: Tuna/egg sandwiches too warm; 5 lbs discarded
summary: Fail. Tuna/egg sandwiches in deli cooler measured 50.1°F, above 41°F limit; about 5 lbs ($85) discarded. Some equipment too large for three-compartment sink. Dishwasher lacks temperature test strips. Single-use items stored on basement floor.

headline: Missing thermometers and labels
summary: Pass. Reach-in, walk-in and refrigerator lack ambient air thermometers; food containers unlabeled, and some uncovered in rear and basement coolers. Exposed caulk on floor, missing light shield, and manager's expired allergen training.

headline: Hot food below safe temperature; discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Ready-to-eat hot foods (chicken nuggets, pulled pork, corn dogs) held below 135°F in display units and discarded (about 5.5 lbs, $45). Two hot holding units too cool; one tagged. Door gaps and missing handwashing signs.

headline: Expired allergen training for managers
summary: Pass. Allergen training for all certified food managers is expired; instructed to update and maintain it.

headline: Cold foods too warm; thawing in sink
summary: Pass with conditions. Turkey (48.7°F), ham (58.6°F) and cheese held too warm in service coolers; 4 lbs ($19) discarded (cited). Food thawing in water in three-compartment sink; approved methods discussed. Leaking faucet; sprayer hangs below sink rim.

headline: Cold food too warm; hot water too cool
summary: Shrimp, potatoes, shumai and eggs held above the 41°F cold limit; manager discarded them (about $50). Hot water at sinks too cool (45–51°F, versus 100–110°F required). Grease and food debris on equipment sides.

headline: Dishmachine too cool; food held too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Dishmachine final rinse reached only 140°F, below 180°F minimum (cited). Cold foods held at 47–49°F in three coolers; about 88 lbs ($488) discarded. Coolers tagged by health department. Cooler door gaskets torn.

headline: Gaps let pests in; rust, leaks, broken doors
summary: Pass. Gaps at front, exit and walk-in cooler doors must be sealed against pests. Rust in ice machine: ice must be destroyed and interior cleaned. Also milk crates, foil liners, missing hot-holding door, leaking faucet.

headline: Rear prep floors need cleaning
summary: Pass. Floors in rear prep area need cleaning; instructed to remove dried food debris.

headline: No certified food manager on premises
summary: Pass with conditions. No City of Chicago food service manager certificate on premises; must provide and maintain it. Cited as a priority foundation violation.

headline: No certified manager; outdated pest logbook
summary: Fail. No certified manager with an up-to-date original certificate on site; certificate must be posted and manager present (cited). No handwashing signage at food kitchen sink. Pest logbook holds only a 2021 service report; must update (cited).

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; dirty floors
summary: Pass. Bulk flour and sugar unlabeled; must label. Floors in basement and garage storage not clean. Sanitation managers lack allergen training.

headline: Splash guard needed near meat slicer
summary: Pass. Splash guard required at the front hand sink next to the meat slicer, or the slicer must be moved out of that area. Also instructed to clean floor corners around and under equipment.

headline: Leaks, loose wall base, debris buildup
summary: Pass. Leaks at three-compartment sink faucet base and men's restroom handwashing sink drain. Loose wall base near sink and washer could let insects in. Dust and food debris under shelving and cooking equipment; must clean to prevent pest harboring.

headline: 30 live flies by rear exit door
summary: Fail. About 30 live small flies on walls near rear exit door; manager must remove all fly activity by reinspection (cited). Advised to call pest control. No food allergen training certificates for food managers.

headline: Peeling cooler door metal; ceiling paint
summary: Pass. Peeling and broken metal on walk-in cooler door must be repaired or replaced. Peeling paint on prep area ceiling must be repaired.

headline: No pest control log on site
summary: Fail. No pest control log on premises; must provide it with current service reports, licenses and monitoring station map (cited). A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint; must provide one.

headline: About 40 live flies; no certified manager
summary: Fail. About 40 small live flies in rear prep, dishwashing and storage areas, on boxes and walls; cited. No certified manager on site while chicken, rice and mac and cheese were served. No signed employee health policies.

headline: Missing handwash sign; food on floor
summary: Pass. Rear hand sink lacks handwashing signage. Food stored on floors of walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer; instructed to elevate six inches and maintain.

headline: Leaking sinks; chipped floor paint
summary: Pass. Front prep handsink drain leaks; three-compartment sink leaks from faucet lever. Rear prep and dish floor paint chipping; must resurface and repaint to keep floors smooth and cleanable.

headline: Splash guard, rust, grease, leaks needed
summary: Pass. Splash guard needed between one- and three-compartment sinks to prevent cross-contamination. Rust on freezer shelves; worn biscuit cooler gaskets; heavy grease and food debris on cooking equipment and floors. Cracked sink seams; leaking stopper.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; dirty fryers, floors
summary: Pass. Rear restroom lacks handwashing signage. Family toilet room sink needs recaulking. Fryers in rear deli have grease and dirt; storage floors have dirt and debris under shelving. Walls, vents and ceiling tiles need cleaning.

headline: Dead roaches, door gaps, unlabeled containers
summary: Pass. Dead roaches on floor and equipment in rear prep area; must remove all. 1/4-inch gaps at front and rear doors must be sealed. Bulk containers unlabeled; soiled wiping cloths; food debris on equipment and coolers.

headline: Prep sink lacks cold water; no training
summary: Fail. Prep handwashing sink has no cold water. A front-prep sink, removed and disconnected, sits on the floor while food is served; instructed to stop selling food and reinstall it. Front door gap; no food handler training.

headline: Obstructed handsink; milk crates; no signs
summary: Pass with conditions. Milk crates and a jacket blocked a kitchen handwashing sink; instructed to keep it clear (cited). Missing handwashing signs in employee restrooms. No drainboards at three-compartment sink; no allergen training certificate for manager.

headline: Beverages stored in toilet rooms
summary: Pass with conditions. Repeat finding from a 2022 inspection: wine, beer and other beverages stored in toilet rooms. Manager instructed to remove them.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; no trash can
summary: Pass. Two bulk ingredient containers in dry storage lack common-name labels. Employee restroom has no covered trash receptacle.

headline: No certified manager on duty
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager on duty; person in charge lacks City food sanitation certificate; instructed to obtain (cited). Grocery bags used for food storage in walk-in freezer. No covered waste receptacle in women's washroom.

headline: About 30 flies; uncovered kitchenware; raw wood wall
summary: About 30 small flies flew through the bar, pantry and main kitchen areas; citation issued and pest activity must be eliminated. Kitchenware was uncovered, a raw wood wall was in prep, and soiled crates were used for storage.

headline: Employees without hair restraints during food prep
summary: Food employees were seen without hair restraints while preparing and serving food. Staff were told to wear them. This was the only issue noted.

headline: Floors cleaned on site; drains need cleaning
summary: Floors around and behind kitchen equipment were cleaned during inspection. Floor drains at sinks must also be cleaned where needed.

headline: Dead roaches in sticky traps; no food handler cards
summary: Sticky traps in the mop sink closet were filled with dead roaches; traps must be replaced to monitor activity. Food handlers lacked hair restraints and certificates, the manager had no allergen certificate, and the women's restroom trash can had no lid.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; no service sink
summary: The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap that must be sealed to be fully rodent-proof. No service sink was available for disposing of mop water. Holes in ceiling panels near the hot water tank and a dirty restroom must be repaired and cleaned.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; no toilet ventilation
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and management could not provide a procedure for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea. Men's and women's toilets lacked working ventilation. Items were to be corrected; no citation was issued.

headline: Raw wood surfaces; backflow and door closer missing
summary: Raw wood surfaces in the front service area must be sealed or painted. No backflow device was located at the utility mop sink. The washroom door lacks a self-closing device and must be fitted with one.

headline: Debris buildup on floors and drains
summary: Debris buildup on floors and drains under, around and along wall bases in the dry food and paper storage area and bar must be cleaned.

headline: Missing light shields; no allergen proof on site
summary: Two light shields were missing above food prep and one in front of the ice machine; they must be provided. A City food service manager had no proof of allergen training on site when inspected.

headline: Mouse droppings, live roaches and flies found
summary: About 30 mouse droppings, 2 live roaches and 30 live small flies were found in rear prep and dry storage. Pests must be removed by reinspection. Leaking handsink drain, grease buildup, cracked floor tiles and an uncorrected hood violation were also noted.

headline: Walk-in freezer interior needs cleaning
summary: The walk-in freezer interior needed cleaning. The operator was instructed to detail clean it.

headline: Torn gasket; cutting boards; floor grout
summary: A torn gasket on a basement standing cooler must be replaced. Cutting boards with deep seams and stains in front prep must be refinished or replaced. Missing grout near the oven and ice cream freezer must be repaired; basement floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Leaking handsinks; cold foods too warm; citation
summary: Two handwashing sinks in the prep and dishwashing areas were leaking and inaccessible. Cooked rice and lamb in the cold unit were at 49–57°F and discarded. Ready-to-eat foods lacked date marks, and food was stored in plastic grocery bags.

headline: Sink blocked by platters; hair restraint lapses
summary: Stacked platters blocked a handwashing sink at the cook line; citation issued, and an employee removed them during inspection. Several workers lacked hair restraints. Cold-holding units had food debris, and a handwashing sink drained slowly.

headline: Regrout under sink; mop closet bulbs out
summary: Low floor tile grout under and around the three-compartment sink must be regrouted. Ceiling light bulbs in the mop sink closet were not working and must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager during sandwich prep
summary: No certified food manager with a City certificate was on duty while sandwiches and deli meats were prepared and served; citation issued. Washrooms lacked covered trash cans, and a floor drain under the three-compartment sink had dirt buildup.

headline: Insect control device over food; dirty fridge and sink
summary: An insect control device hung above the coffee maker and must not be stored over food. Refrigerator and reach-in cooler interiors had minor debris, the rear handsink leaked into a bucket, and prep floors had dirt.

headline: Cups and plates not inverted; drink on prep surface
summary: To-go containers, plates and bowls were facing up and must be stored inverted. An employee's covered beverage sat on food prep surfaces in the kitchen and must be moved to a designated drink area.

headline: No thermometer or dish machine temperature indicator
summary: No probe food thermometer was on site, and the high-temperature dish machine lacked a temperature indicator; the manager obtained an invoice for one by the end. Fly glue traps hang above open food and must be kept away. A food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Torn freezer gasket; grease and debris buildup
summary: A torn gasket on the freezer door must be repaired or replaced. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, coolers and freezers, and debris on utility and storage floors, need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager while chicken and pizza served
summary: No person in charge held a valid certificate. No City certified food manager was on duty while chicken, pizza and fries were prepared, handled and served; citation issued. A certified manager must be on site at all times.

headline: Hole under handsink; peeling paint
summary: A hole in the wall under the prep-area handsink must be repaired to prevent a possible pest entry point. Peeling paint above the three-compartment sink must be repainted.

headline: Mouse droppings and live flies; grease buildup
summary: About 25 or more mouse droppings and 50 or more live small flies were found in the soda station, restrooms and lobby. Citation issued; pest control service recommended. Grease, debris, and a 140-calorie kids' chocolate milk need to be 130 calories or less.

headline: Entry door gaps; missing signs and restroom cans
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Handwashing signs were missing, bulk containers were unlabeled, and debris was on cooking equipment. Leaking faucets, a missing restroom receptacle and damaged ceiling tiles also need correction.

headline: Microwave splatter; employee items on food shelves
summary: Food splatter in the microwave must be cleaned. Employees' purses, water bottles and a jacket were on basement food storage shelves and must be stored away from food.

headline: No vomit kit; cold eggs discarded; expired cards
summary: No kit for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea was on site; citation issued. Eggs at 52–58°F were discarded. Some food handler certificates were expired, and the certified manager lacked allergen training. Soiled mop heads must be hung to dry.

headline: Soap dispenser at dish sink; no restroom waste can
summary: A wall-mounted soap dispenser sits at the three-compartment sink and must be moved to a handwashing sink. Unsealed wood counter, sinks not sealed to walls, and no waste receptacle in the washroom. Grease and food debris on hood filters, walls and ceilings.

headline: No mop sink backflow device; no restroom exhaust fan
summary: No mop sink with a vacuum breaker was on the premises, and the restroom had no exhaust fan. Both must be provided.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings in dry storage trailer
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were scattered on the floor and pallets inside the dry food storage trailer. Citation issued; an exterminator was requested. Food was stored on floor in outside coolers, and single-service items were not inverted.

headline: Hair restraint lapse; missing coffee-machine backflow
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The bottom of a reach-in cooler in rear storage was not clean. No backflow prevention device was at the coffee machine waterline; it must be provided where it can be serviced.

headline: Overfilled dumpster; summary report not posted
summary: An outside dumpster could not close because it was overfilled, and a prior violation was not corrected; it is now a priority item. The latest inspection summary was not posted; today's summary was given to the operator.

headline: No sanitizer temperature test strips for dish machine
summary: No temperature test strips or indicators were provided for the high-temperature dish machine. A food handler had an expired certificate. Old core violations were not corrected, including food stored under waste pipes and restrooms with uncovered trash cans. Floors were dirty.

headline: Inadequate hot water at handsink and dish sink
summary: Hot water reached only 68°F at the handwashing and three-compartment sinks. The minimum is 100°F and 110°F, respectively; priority violation. The business license number was also not printed on the vehicle sides at least two inches tall.

headline: Unlabeled three-compartment sink; missing restroom tile
summary: The three-compartment sink basins were not labeled wash, rinse and sanitize. A floor tile was missing in the men's restroom near the toilet. The person in charge was told to correct both items.

headline: Unlabeled flour and sugar; no allergen training
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers had no labels; all bulk and working ingredient containers must be labeled. The person in charge had no proof of valid allergen training on site.

headline: Handsink in poor repair; restroom items missing
summary: The handsink is in poor repair; water cannot be turned on or off without a shutoff valve. Priority violation, no citation. The unisex restroom needs a covered waste can and a self-closing door. Some staff lack food handler or allergen certificates.

headline: Stained cutting board; cabinet and floor cleaning
summary: A cutting board at the front prep station had deep grooves and stains and must be replaced. Inside of lower cabinets needs detail cleaning, and the floor under and around equipment in the front food area needs dirt and stain removal.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; boxes on floor
summary: No thermometers were in cold-holding equipment at the front bar and rear prep areas; these must be provided. Boxed single-service items were stored on the basement floor and must be elevated.

headline: Dirty side storage floors and clutter
summary: Floors in the side storage area need cleaning to remove buildup. Unnecessary clutter must be removed to eliminate harborage areas for pests.

headline: No handwashing signage near dish sink
summary: No handwashing signage was posted at the hand sink by the dishwashing area. Signage must be provided.

headline: Dirty floors and debris in café kitchen
summary: Loose debris, dirt and dust were on floors and corners in the café kitchen. Staff were told to detail clean the floors and increase cleaning frequency.

headline: Greasy ventilation hood and filters
summary: Grease was found on the ventilation hood and filters. They must be cleaned.

headline: Business license number missing from vehicle
summary: The business license number was missing from the driver's side of the vehicle. The operator was told to provide it.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; grimy coolers and drains
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at sinks in the front prep and rear dishwashing areas. Food spills were on coolers, prep tables and shelving. Floor drains and floors under equipment had debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Vacuum packaging machine tagged; no food safety plan
summary: A vacuum packaging machine lacks an approved HACCP (food safety) plan and is tagged not to be used until approved; citation issued. A side door needs rodent-proofing. Ice bin lid, cracked light shields and missing ceiling tiles also need correction.

headline: Ice buildup inside ice cream freezer
summary: Excessive debris and ice buildup were inside the ice cream storage freezer. The excess ice must be removed, the freezer detail cleaned and maintained.

headline: Women's restroom needs covered trash can
summary: A covered waste can with a lid must be provided in the women's restroom.

headline: Entry door gaps; dish machine leak and no data plate
summary: Openings at the base of the front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The high-temperature dish machine lacked a data plate and was leaking water onto the booster heater; both must be corrected.

headline: No food handler certificates; no sanitizer testing
summary: No City certificate was posted for food employees, and no employee health policy was on site. No thermometer, sanitizer test device or sink stoppers were available. No food handler certificates or pest control logbook were on hand.

headline: Grooved cutting board; low sink water pressure
summary: A cutting board in the two-door prep cooler had deep grooves and stains and must be sanded or replaced. The three-compartment sink had no drainboard and low water pressure; both must be corrected.

headline: Leaking handsink faucet; gaskets; restroom vents
summary: Gaskets inside the sauce cooler next to the front handsink must be repaired. The handsink faucet leaks and must be repaired. Ventilation in employee and customer restrooms is in disrepair and must be fixed.

headline: No certified manager while rice at 159.4°F served
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was on site. No City food sanitation manager was on site while rice at 159.4°F was prepared and served; citation issued. The person in charge must be certified and a manager must be present at all times.

headline: Mislabeled salad containers; rough brick wall
summary: Salad containers were not labeled properly and must follow labeling rules. A rough brick wall behind the front food prep area must be made smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Raw wood surfaces; missing backflow device and closer
summary: Raw wood at the front counter and behind it must be sealed or painted to be smooth and cleanable. No backflow device was at the utility sink. The washroom door lacked a self-closing device. Staff were told to correct each item.

headline: Over 1,000 rodent droppings; cooler at 53°F
summary: More than 1,000 small rodent droppings were found throughout prep, storage and restroom areas, plus 7 live flies. Walk-in cooler at 50–55°F held chicken; unit held for inspection. Citation issued. Rear door is not rodent-proof, and grease and debris were heavy.

headline: Disposable spoons and unsafe wash setup
summary: Disposable plastic spoons were used in food production; durable material was requested. A soap-filled bucket sat in the three-compartment sink. The setup was to be corrected; no washing was happening during inspection.

headline: Handsink lacked soap and towels; food on floor
summary: The bar handsink had no soap; corrected on site when the manager supplied it. No paper towels at the bar handsink; citation issued. Food was stored on floors in the freezer and dry storage, and the high-temp dish machine had no working gauge.

headline: No certified manager on duty; dogs inside
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared. Non-service dogs were lying in the customer seating area. Oysters lacked required tags. Dish machine sanitizing reached 171°F, below the 180°F minimum.

headline: Basement clutter; food handlers lack certificates
summary: Basement clutter and unneeded items must be organized and kept at least 6 inches off the floor. Non-managerial food handlers lacked food handler certificates; the person in charge must have them obtain training and keep certificates on site.

headline: No certified manager; no person in charge certificate
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was on site, and no sanitation manager or certificate was posted while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Ice machine residue was also noted and must be cleaned.

headline: Raw wood and carpet floors behind counter
summary: Raw wood and carpet floors behind the service counter must be made smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Over 60 rat droppings; no certified manager on duty
summary: Over 60 rat droppings were found in prep, dishwashing and storage areas. No certified food manager was on site while TCS (must-be-kept-hot-or-cold) foods were prepared. Manager was told to call an exterminator.

headline: No certified manager while hamburgers prepared
summary: No certified manager was on site while hamburgers and other TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. An employee with a valid City certificate must be on site at all times. Fryer cabinets had heavy grease and grime buildup.

headline: Dirty drains; stained boards; greasy fryers
summary: Rear drains had dirt and a black slime-like substance and must be cleaned. Deeply grooved cutting boards in rear prep must be replaced. Fryer sides and walk-in cooler floors need cleaning; a stained ceiling tile must be replaced.

headline: Rusty shelving, dirty drains and loose wall panels
summary: Shelving over the produce sinks was rusted, and drains in the produce and butcher rooms need detail cleaning. Dairy room wall panels are loose from freezer ice buildup and must be repaired. Rear storage floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Worn license number on push cart
summary: The license number on one side of the push cart was worn. It must be provided and maintained on both lateral sides.

headline: Minor repairs; coffee grounds behind machines
summary: Weather stripping on the exit door and a restroom soap dispenser need repair. Coffee grounds and stains behind the coffee machines must be cleaned. Floor under rear shelving needs detail cleaning, and a fan vent over a reach-in cooler was dusty.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; heavy hood grease
summary: The three-compartment sink lacked proper stoppers. Ventilation above the hot-holding line, fryers, grill and pizza oven had heavy dust, grease and debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Employees eating at prep; coolers too warm
summary: Employees were drinking and preparing food at the prep area. Service cooler food reached 48–53°F; about 26 lbs were discarded. Prep coolers read 50.6°F and 46°F and were not to be used until 41°F or below. Handsink was repaired on site.

headline: Unlabeled cooked foods; cutting board and clutter issues
summary: Cooked shrimp, rice and chicken lacked date labels; about 20 lbs were discarded. Wiping cloths were left on surfaces, a cutting board had deep cuts, and handwashing signs were missing. Basement clutter and a wall hole were also noted.

headline: Mouse droppings in store; bait box near bread
summary: About 20–30 mouse droppings were in the bread and chip aisles, rear storage and along the perimeter. A bait box on a shelf behind bread was moved and corrected on site. Pest control was recommended before reinspection; citation issued. Restrooms were unsanitary.

headline: Unfinished wood shelves; sink stoppers missing
summary: Unfinished wood shelving in the beverage area must be finished so it is easy to clean. The rear three-compartment sink lacked drain stoppers. Holes around pipes above the hot water tank and near the rear exit must be sealed.

headline: Gloves put on without handwashing; citation issued
summary: A food handler put on gloves to make a sandwich without washing hands; citation issued and he was told to wash before and after glove use. The front handsink needs a splash guard, and the certified manager's allergen certificate had expired.

headline: Blocked handsink; hot and cold foods too warm
summary: A bakery handsink was blocked by containers; citation issued. Soups held at 100–108°F were discarded (about 30 lbs). Beef at 50–52°F and eggs at 60°F were discarded too, 65 lbs total. Frozen meat was thawing on counters.

headline: Storage opening near restrooms; no drain plugs
summary: A storage room with a cooler and freezer opens to the customer walkway; a physical barrier such as a swinging door must be installed. The three-compartment sink lacked drain plugs, and the toilet and kitchen floors needed cleaning. Women's restroom needs a covered receptacle.

headline: Unlabeled storage; plates not inverted; trash outside
summary: The beverage cooler had no air thermometer, and shelved food containers lacked labels. Wiping cloths were stored improperly, plates were not inverted at the bar, and milk crates were used as shelving. Trash littered the dumpster enclosure.

headline: Low hot-water pressure at meat-area handsink
summary: Low hot-water pressure was noted at the handwashing sink in the meat and seafood area. Management raised the pressure during inspection; the owner was told to repair and maintain it.

headline: Broken ice machine door; drains with buildup
summary: The ice machine door is broken and must be repaired. Two drains in the rear dishwashing area had debris and buildup that must be cleaned to prevent insects from breeding or harboring.

headline: No sanitation manager while pizza and pasta handled
summary: No City sanitation manager was present while pizza and pasta were handled; citation issued. The person in charge had no manager certificate. Some food handlers lacked hair restraints until the end of inspection, and managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Expired manager card; flies and hygiene issues
summary: No valid certified manager certificate was posted while chicken and mashed potatoes were prepared; citation issued. A food handler did not wash hands before handling food. About 8–10 small flies and 2–4 large flies were seen, and 2.5 lbs of chicken tenders were discarded.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; cold food too warm
summary: A low-temperature dishwasher behind the bar read 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged out of use. The walk-in cooler at 47°F was repaired on site. Two-door cooler at 45°F was tagged; about 40 lbs ($385) of food was discarded.

headline: Prep-area floor drains need detail cleaning
summary: Floor drains in the prep area need detail cleaning to remove buildup. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Food debris on sausage machine; rusted shelves
summary: The pizza sausage prep machine had food debris and must be washed and sanitized regularly. Prep coolers and freezers need detail cleaning; rusted shelving in the rear walk-in cooler must be replaced. Floors and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine residue; rust; leaks; wall holes
summary: White buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Rust on shelving, food debris in cold-holding gaskets, and grime under tables need cleaning. A leaking handsink faucet, gaps near the rear exit, and holes in walls and ceilings need repair.

headline: Dirty ice machine lip; no beard restraint
summary: A dirty plastic lip was inside the middle ice machine. A food preparer had a full beard without a restraint. A bar ice bin lid was missing. Oil, mop heads and brooms stored on the rear patio must be moved into enclosed storage.

headline: Over 55 mouse droppings; one dead mouse
summary: Over 40 mouse droppings lined walls and corners in rear storage near the mop sink, plus over 15 behind coolers. One dead mouse was under the three-compartment sink. Citation issued; licensed pest control recommended. Milk crates were used as shelving.

headline: Two-door fridge too warm; about 35 lbs affected
summary: Upper compartments of a two-door refrigerator held cheese at 52.2°F, raw chicken at 68.2°F, cooked chicken at 65.7°F and greens at 51.8°F. About 35 lbs, worth $161, were affected; citation issued. Other items also noted.

headline: Milk at 52–56°F discarded; no thermometers
summary: Opened coffee, almond and oat milks under the espresso machine were at 52–56°F and were discarded; citation issued. Reach-in coolers need thermometers. Bulk sugar was unlabeled, and trash lay on the ground by the outside receptacle.

headline: Slow-draining rear handsink
summary: The rear handsink next to the dishwashing area drains slowly. The person in charge must repair and maintain it.

headline: Rodent droppings; no thermometers or sanitizer tests
summary: About 20 large rodent droppings were found in the rear storage area near bait boxes and flour shelves. Uncovered baked goods on outside display were moved inside. No probe thermometers or sanitizer test strips were on site; citation issued.

headline: Tamales at 101°F; coffee cups on prep table
summary: Pork tamales and chicken for sale were held at 101.3°F in an insulated box; hot TCS foods must be kept at 135°F or higher. Items were discarded, about $50. Open staff coffee cups were placed on the prep table and must be kept off food surfaces.

headline: Basement clutter; items too close to floor
summary: Basement storage needs detail cleaning and organizing to remove unneeded items that could harbor pests. Supplies and equipment must be elevated at least 6 inches off the floor to allow cleaning.

headline: Missing backflow device, dirty restroom, light shields
summary: The utility sink in the closet had no backflow prevention device. The all-gender employee restroom lacked a covered trash receptacle, and its sink and toilet were soiled. Light shields were missing throughout the facility.

headline: Dusty cooler bases; damaged sales-area ceiling
summary: Dust was on the bases of coolers and shelving in the sales, storage and walk-in cooler areas. Damaged ceiling surfaces in the sales area must be repaired and tiles replaced. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: No certified manager while hamburgers prepared
summary: No City certified food manager was on site while hamburgers and other TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Food guards were missing at the sushi and front counters, the ice machine had black slimy buildup, and a prior restroom trash-lid violation remained.

headline: No sanitation manager; unlabeled bulk food
summary: No City sanitation manager was present while raw chicken and cole slaw were handled; citation issued. Flour and sugar were unlabeled. Food handlers lacked hair or beard restraints and training certificates, and the three-compartment sink had no test kits.

headline: About 30 mouse droppings; thawing and handler issues
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found on floors, food prep tables and under the service counter; citation issued. Frozen chicken and Italian beef were thawing in sink water and on counters. Some workers lacked hair restraints or food handler certificates.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings; eggrolls too cool
summary: About 10 or more live roaches crawled near the wok stations, and 15 or more mouse droppings were by a toilet-room water tank. Eggrolls at 109°F were below the 135°F hot-holding minimum; about 5 lbs were discarded.

headline: Hole in dock door; leaking sink; storage issues
summary: A hole at the base of a dumpster-area door could allow pest entry and must be sealed. Also noted: boxes stored in a restroom, items on the floor, a leaking three-compartment faucet, drain buildup, and missing wall and vent covers.

headline: Chicken at 80°F on grill; cold foods too warm
summary: Cooked chicken held at 80°F on the grill, below the 135°F minimum, was discarded. Beef at 62°F and cheese at 60°F were on the prep table and discarded. About 15 lbs ($80) lost. No consumer advisory for raw eggs; previous violations uncorrected.

headline: Failed: cold foods too warm, flies found
summary: Cold foods held above 41F and two coolers too warm; about 40.6 lbs discarded. About 30 live small flies seen near walls and flying around. Pest control recommended. Food handler training missing.

headline: Black slime in ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Black slime in the ice machine was dripping onto ice for human consumption; it must be cleaned and sanitized. Also: food in plastic grocery bags, unlabeled sugar and salt, soiled wiping cloths, and greasy cooking equipment.

headline: No certified manager on site while cooking
summary: No valid certified food manager was on site while salsa, pork, eggs and dairy were prepared and served (citation). Walk-in and front prep coolers lacked thermometers, and food handlers lacked training proof.

headline: Ice cream machine cleaning procedure needed
summary: A written cleaning and sanitizing procedure is required for the ice cream machine, which cannot be submerged in the three-compartment sink. Food spillage on the walk-in cooler floor must be cleaned, and mop heads stored inverted.

headline: No certified manager; leaking, inaccessible hand sink
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site while tuna was prepared and served (citation). Dish-area hand sink was inaccessible and leaked heavily when used. Food on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer must be raised six inches.

headline: Door sweep, drains and ceiling dust need attention
summary: The door sweep at receiving door 3 is in poor repair and must be repaired or replaced. Some floor drains need cleaning, and dust on washroom ceilings near the ventilation fan must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine debris, broken cooler, dim lighting
summary: Debris inside a second-floor ice machine must be removed. A broken, unused basement cooler must be removed to prevent possible pest hiding spots. Stained cutting boards, missing sink stoppers and dim walk-in lighting were also noted.

headline: Leaks under kitchen sink; hood light out
summary: Water leaks at the faucet base and drain pipe under the kitchen three-compartment sink must be repaired. The prep line cooler needs gasket replacement. Floors and bar walls need cleaning, and the interior hood light is out.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; dish machine dirty
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site on arrival, and an original certificate must be kept on site at all times (citation). The exterior of the dish machine was heavily soiled and must be cleaned.

headline: Repeat issues: scoop, soap, water, summary report
summary: Ice scoop still stored improperly, women's restroom soap dispenser missing, cooking equipment soiled, and water pooled in the prep area from the three-compartment sink drain. The public summary report was not posted (citation).

headline: Second-floor hand sink not working
summary: A handwashing sink in the second-floor all-gender washroom is not working and must be repaired. Also: a faded dish machine data plate, and damaged floor tiles and grout outside the chef's office.

headline: Rust, unused equipment, and clutter to remove
summary: Rust on walk-in cooler shelving must be removed or replaced. Unused coolers, an ice machine and construction materials must leave the premises. Also needed: a prep sink, splash guards, and outdoor debris removal.

headline: Unlabeled spices and sugar; soiled cloths
summary: Garlic powder, black pepper, salt and sugar were out of original containers without product-name labels. Soiled wiping cloths sat on prep tables, and a main cook line cutting board had deep grooves and dark stains.

headline: Floors need deep cleaning
summary: Floors throughout need deep cleaning under and behind cooking and cold-holding equipment. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain the floors.

headline: Non-service dogs brought inside; citation issued
summary: Non-service dogs were brought inside during the inspection, which is not allowed; a citation was issued. Also: a leaking three-compartment sink pipe, and clutter and dirty floors in basement dry storage.

headline: Grab-and-go unlabeled; walk-in lighting dim
summary: Packaged grab-and-go food was not labeled per code. The walk-in cooler needs more lighting, and the food service manager has no allergen training certificate and must obtain one.

headline: No certified manager; hot water above 120F
summary: No certified food manager was present while coffee and sandwiches were prepared and served (citation). Two handwashing sinks had water above 120F with stripped cold handles; one cold valve was off. Repairs needed to allow 100-120F water.

headline: No certified manager during opening; private cake
summary: No certified manager on site 9:40-10:15 AM while open (citation). Cake from a private home was discarded; the store was told to buy only from approved sources. To-go guacamole and pico de gallo lacked ingredient information.

headline: Ice scoops stored on machine; no drainboard
summary: Ice scoops were stored on top of the ice machine and must be kept in a clean bin or container, or with the handle up. The three-compartment sink lacked a drainboard for air-drying utensils.

headline: Missing signage, unlabeled containers, entry gap
summary: Exposed hand sinks lacked required handwashing signage. Storage containers in prep areas and closets lacked common-name labels. A small opening in the front entrance door must be rodent-proofed; no pests were noted.

headline: No certified manager; hot pastries; ice machine slime
summary: No city-certified manager was on site while milk and ham were handled (citation). Pastries held at 72.9-77.5F in the display case were discarded. Ice machine heavily soiled with slime; a hand sink was blocked by a prep table.

headline: Dirty ice machine, washrooms, and freezer floor
summary: Residue was seen inside the ice machine, and toilets and sinks in the washrooms needed cleaning. Clutter in the rear and storage areas should be removed. Heavy ice buildup on the walk-in freezer floor must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water; leaks
summary: No certified food manager was on site during food prep; the manager arrived 40 minutes after being called (citation). Women's washroom had no hot water (49.4F). A leaking drain pipe flooded the dish area. Written employee health policies were missing.

headline: Dirty cooler bottom; manager lacks allergen training
summary: The bottom of a reach-in cooler inside the storage room was not clean and must be cleaned. A sanitation manager has no allergen training and must provide it.

headline: Health policy and food handler records missing
summary: No employee health policy or food handler training certificates were on site. Also missing: a utility sink, handwashing signs, and a covered trash can. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks. A coffee cup was used as an ashtray.

headline: Scoops stored in containers; plates not inverted
summary: Bowls were being used as scoops and left inside dry storage containers. Plates and pans were not inverted after sanitizing. Cutting boards in the rear prep area had open seams and dark stains and need repair or replacement.

headline: Drainboard, service sink, and toilet room fixes
summary: Soap dispenser above the three-compartment sink must be removed; hands must be washed only at designated sinks. Also needed: drainboard, service sink for mop water, covered trash can, and self-closing restroom door.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No valid city-certified food manager was on duty while chicken, pizza and beef tacos were handled. Also: a dirty self-serve counter, damaged ceiling tiles, wall-base openings that need sealing, dirty floors, and one food handler without required training.

headline: Containers on floor; allergen training missing
summary: Multi-use containers were stored on the floor under a shelf rack and must be raised at least 6 inches. A city-certified manager lacks allergen training; verification must be kept on site.

headline: Dumpster, grease trap, and floor cleaning needed
summary: Slight odor from the grease trap needs cleaning and maintenance. Dirty ground around the dumpster must be cleaned to prevent possible pest hiding spots. Also: gasket on the two-door cooler needs repair, air vent and floors need cleaning.

headline: Food on floor in walk-in; torn gasket
summary: Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be on shelving 6 inches off the floor. A torn gasket on the dry-storage refrigeration unit needs repair, and food in grocery bags must move to food-grade containers.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; items on floor
summary: No handwashing signage is posted at any of the exposed handwashing sinks in the front and rear prep areas. Single-service articles stored on the basement storage floor must be elevated.

headline: Dead insects in basement storage
summary: Dead insects were found on the basement storage floor and behind the chest freezers, and management was told to clean and remove them. The basement washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle, and wall corners and holes need sealing.

headline: No handwashing signs; consumer advisory missing
summary: Handwashing sinks in bar, prep and dish areas lacked signs. Menu lacked the required raw or undercooked food disclosure. Splash guards needed at the server-alley sink, and preset knives were left exposed on tables.

headline: Food handlers not washing hands between tasks
summary: Handlers handled money, wiped tables, then prepared sandwiches without washing hands, changing only gloves (priority violation; citation). Thermometer could not take temperatures at inspection; ice scoop improperly stored; soap dispenser missing in women's restroom.

headline: Utensils not inverted; foil and cardboard on shelves
