summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the floor in the rear prep area and must be raised at least six inches. Loose debris and dust were found on floors and corners. The food service sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; open soda, uncovered bulk containers
summary: Passed. An open soda can was stored in a display cooler. Bulk lemon pepper and sugar were uncovered, and soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Single-service items were not inverted, and the walk-in freezer had no light.

headline: Passed; sink leak and ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink leaks from the middle basin and must be repaired. Missing and stained ceiling tile panels in the dining room must be replaced or repaired.

headline: Cockroaches, sewage backup, no certified manager
summary: Failed. About 10 dead cockroaches were found, plus open bait in a cooler. Sewage was backing up at the deli's three-compartment sink. No certified manager was on site, and some deli meats were too warm (turkey 46.0F, ham 44.8F).

headline: Passed; floor cleaning and fridge thermometer
summary: Passed. The small bar fridge had no thermometer. Boxes were stored on the floor by the ice machine and must be raised six inches. The ice machine lid is broken, and the rear dishwashing floor was heavily soiled.

headline: Passed; hair restraint and sink sealing
summary: Passed. A food handler had no hair restraint. The employee restroom handwashing sink was not sealed or attached properly. A mop was stored improperly in dry storage, and dish and washroom areas need light shields.

headline: About 8 live roaches found; failed
summary: Failed. About 8 live roaches were found on the wall behind a handwashing sink and on a shelf in the cash register area. Pest control service was required. Restroom doors must self-close, and mops must be stored to air-dry.

headline: Passed; sink drainboard needed
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink had no drainboard, and the facility was told to provide one.

headline: No raw-food advisory on menu; grease container open
summary: Failed. The menu lacked the consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods, a priority violation. The outside grease container was wide open, encrusted, with grease pans on the ground. Also needed: container labels, a clean ice scoop holder, and overgrown shrubs cut back.

headline: Walk-in cooler warm; no manager; several fixes
summary: Passed with conditions. A walk-in cooler ran at 69.4F and was tagged; it held only sodas and canned drinks. Room-temperature thawing of fish was stopped. No valid certified manager was on site. Hot water was restored during inspection.

headline: Passed; clay serving pots and torn gasket
summary: Passed. Clay pots were used to serve salsa and guacamole, and only food-grade containers are allowed. A torn gasket on the walk-in cooler door must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed; door gap and leaks need repair
summary: Passed. A quarter-inch gap between the front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pests. A rear three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Also noted spills, debris, dust, and openings along walls that need repair.

headline: Passed; counters and floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Front counters and service stations are dirty and must be cleaned. Floors in the serving and front prep station need cleaning along wall bases and around cooking equipment.

headline: Unlabeled sauces; produce stored under pipes
summary: Passed. Several sauces lacked labels. A large bag of onions and carrots was stored on the floor of an unfinished basement under unfinished ceiling and wastewater pipes; items were moved during inspection.

headline: Cardboard liners; milk crates; torn gasket
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cardboard used as floor liners in hot food prep must be removed. Milk crates used for elevation must be replaced with shelving. Torn freezer gasket; ice buildup in meat freezer; dirty floor drains.

headline: Raw shrimp and other foods held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Raw shrimp at 62.3F, plus pork belly, tofu and shrimp at 49.9-53F, were found; about 10 lbs ($78) discarded. A prep cooler at 53.3F was tagged and may not be used until reinspected.

headline: Live dog in dining area; sinks lacked paper towels
summary: Passed with conditions. A live non-service dog was in the customer dining area; the person in charge escorted the dog and owner out (priority citation). Paper towels and soap were supplied at sinks during inspection. Plumbing leaks noted.

headline: Ice machine debris; propane grill; food on floor
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior not clean, slight debris. Food stored on floor must be elevated six inches. Propane tank used for flat-top grill must be removed. Grill, two fryers and stove lacked required ventilation; provide or remove.

headline: Dirty vent covers; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Air vent covers in the rear dishwashing area were dirty and must be cleaned. The manager on duty did not have required allergen training; inspector instructed compliance or citations would follow.

headline: Complaint: flies on donuts; cold unit at 51F
summary: Failed. No City sanitation manager or certificate on site. Cooked eggs, cheese, sausage and cream cheese held at 48-51F, discarded. About 40 live flies in prep areas; about 20 landed on display donuts, which were discarded.

headline: Complaint: 30+ live flies; sticky stairs
summary: Failed. About 30 or more live small flies in dry storage, dishwashing, prep, dining room, and swimming in a floor drain; pest control recommended, citation issued. Sticky stairs and pooling water in prep and dishwashing areas.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; eggs at 69.3F
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager on site until about 1:10 PM while eggs, chicken and beef were being prepared (citation). About 2-3 dozen eggs at 69.3F discarded. Drinks stored in prep cooler; plastic bags used for storage.

headline: Metered sinks run under 15 seconds
summary: Passed. Metered handwashing sinks in women's restroom ran less than 15 seconds; must provide running water for at least 15 seconds. Wet mops stored in bucket in dishwashing area; instructed to hang them to dry.

headline: No food safety training proof; no vomit plan
summary: Passed with conditions. Person in charge lacked proof of food safety management training. No valid certificate posted for food employees (citation). No written procedure or cleanup kit for vomiting or diarrheal events; sink drain has grease.

headline: Re-inspection passed; grill bricks, sink stoppers
summary: Re-inspection passed. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Bricks holding up grill had excessive grease and must be removed. Three-compartment sink must have stoppers.

headline: Sinks lacked paper towels; foods lacked date labels
summary: Passed with conditions. Hand sinks lacked paper towels; one was supplied during inspection. Ready-to-eat foods lacked date marking (priority citation). A 1/4-inch gap around the rear exit door must be sealed. Grease on cooking equipment noted.

headline: Leaks under sink; floors need detail cleaning
summary: Passed. Walk-in cooler floor under shelving needs detail cleaning. A leak at the base of the cold prep handwashing sink must be repaired. Bar-area floor under equipment needs detail cleaning.

headline: Slimy ice machine; urinal out of order
summary: Re-inspection passed. Slight brownish slimy substance on ice machine interior; instructed to clean and sanitize. Unlabeled food containers in rear and bar; stove burners and fryers have debris; men's urinal out of order.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; rear door gap
summary: Passed. Bulk food must be labeled with its common name. Rear exit door has a 1-inch gap at the bottom needing a tight seal. Piled wooden boards in rear garbage area must be removed to prevent pest harboring. Food handlers lacked valid certificates.

headline: Leak at rear handwashing sink
summary: Complaint passed. Leak found at handwashing sink in rear prep area; management instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; gasket torn
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid City sanitation certificate on site. A certified manager and original certificate must be present whenever chicken, fish or beef is prepared (citation issued). Torn gasket, debris on walk-in shelves and floor drains.

headline: No food handler certificate; dusty vents
summary: Passed. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate; management told all handlers must show valid proof. Dust on ceiling tiles and light shields in food prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Rear door gap; leaks; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed. Leaks at three-compartment sink faucet neck. Washroom door not self-closing. Missing ceiling tiles and gaps between wall and floor in prep area.

headline: Handwashing sinks too cool; dusty hood filters
summary: Re-inspection passed. Several handwashing sinks measured 77.5-90.5F; they must provide water at least 100F. Other sinks in those areas worked properly. Dust covered all hood filters in the large prep area and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager present; corrected on site
summary: Complaint failed. No certified manager on premises; corrected on site when manager arrived at 2:26 PM (priority citation). Two employees had expired allergen certificates. Prior uncorrected violations include drain and wall repairs.

headline: Re-inspection failed: food stored on floor
summary: Re-inspection failed. Food containers stored on walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Reach-in display cooler lacks an ambient air thermometer. Certified manager's allergen certificate not posted. Dumpster broken lids uncorrected, priority citation.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. No certified food sanitation manager or valid certificate on site, a priority citation. About 45-50 mouse droppings in rear storage and front prep area; no pest log on site. Thermometer and food handler certificates also missing.

headline: Grease spills near outside oil tank
summary: Passed. Grease spills were found on the front end of the outside oil tank and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Floor under three-compartment sink needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Floor along the wall base under the three-compartment sink must be cleaned to remove debris or spills.

headline: Wall, floor seal and lighting problems
summary: Passed. Utility sink wall and floor seal incomplete. Two small holes at wall base in water heater room. Rear storage area lighting insufficient; fixture must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No sanitizer at dish machine final rinse
summary: Passed with conditions. No sanitizer was detected at the final rinse of the low-temperature dish machine (priority violation); manager instructed to repair and provide 100 ppm chlorine. Washroom ventilation fan not working.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; soap dispenser broken
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at exposed sink next to pizza oven; operator instructed to provide. Automatic soap dispenser in toilet room does not work. Unisex toilet rooms lack covered trash receptacles.

headline: Missing thermometers in prep coolers
summary: Passed. Prep coolers lacked thermometers; operator instructed to provide them.

headline: Previously tagged cooler still too warm
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. Meatballs at 52F, chicken at 48.9F and tzatziki at 46F in previously tagged prep cooler; manager discarded about 40 lbs (about $1,000). Cooler at 49.8F was tagged; citation issued.

headline: Hands not washed between tasks; timed faucets
summary: Passed with conditions. Food handler wiped salad cooler wearing gloves, then prepared a salad without washing hands; manager notified (priority citation). Timed faucets in chicken preparation area must run 15 seconds before reactivating.

headline: Failed: hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Failed. Several food handlers did not wash hands between tasks. A cook handled buns bare-handed; product discarded. Gloves used improperly. Dead insects on basement floor; boxes stored on floor, a repeat violation. Cutting boards deeply grooved.

headline: Eating in prep; no cold water at handsink
summary: Passed with conditions. Employees drank and ate in prep area; designated area required. Cardboard lining shelves must be removed (pest hiding places). Dishwashing handsink had no cold water and flooded the kitchen when opened; manager immediately repaired it.

headline: Failed: leaking sink; chicken thawed at room temp
summary: Failed. Front counter handwashing sink was inaccessible due to a severe leak and spray (priority citation). Raw chicken thawed at room temperature; approved methods required. Paper towels stored in rear toilet room. Heavy grease under main cook line.

headline: Dish machine below 180F; cloths on floor
summary: Passed with conditions. High-temperature dish machine did not reach 180F final rinse (priority citation); a technician arrived to repair it. Wiping cloths on floor; stained ceiling tiles; broken basement floor tiles; no allergen training proof.

headline: No thermometer in cooler; gap at rear door
summary: Passed. No working thermometer inside one-door reach-in cooler by bar. 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door sweep must be sealed. Food debris on prep shelves. Employee washroom lacks covered trash receptacle; hood has grease buildup.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on prep tables; no allergen certificate
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Several wet wiping cloths were stored on food prep tables; they must be kept in a sanitizer container when not in use. The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: New establishment lacks utility sink
summary: License re-inspection passed. No utility sink on premises. Operator must install a utility sink with hot and cold running water and a backflow prevention device.

headline: AC water drains into handwashing sink
summary: Passed. Ice scoop holder dirty at bottom. AC unit waste water line drains into the dish room handwashing sink; must be rerouted to a floor drain away from the sink.

headline: No vomiting and diarrhea response plan
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training on site (priority violation). No procedure or supplies for vomiting and diarrheal events. Handwashing signs needed; washroom receptacles must be covered; doors must self-close.

headline: Failed: no employee health policy; ice buildup
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy on premises (priority citation). Ice buildup in meat chest freezers; three-compartment sink faucet leaks; unisex washroom lacks self-closing door. Certified managers lack allergen training; prior violations uncorrected.

headline: Complaint: pink slime in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Failed. Pink slime and black dirt buildup inside ice machine dripped into ice used for consumption (priority citation). Management discarded all ice; interior must be cleaned by reinspection. Dust on basement floor and prep wall.

headline: Failed: about 45 rodent droppings in prep areas
summary: Failed. About 45 small rodent droppings found in rear and front prep areas, storage near toilets, under the three-compartment sink and near the ice machine. Pest control recommended; citation issued. Steam table shelf needs cleaning.

headline: Deeply cut cutting boards; wiping cloths misused
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were left on cutting boards; they must be kept in sanitizing solution. Deeply cut, stained cutting boards must be restored or replaced. Butcher case door frames were held with tape. No food handler training proof on site.

headline: No certified manager during egg service
summary: Passed with conditions. No City certified food manager on site while eggs were prepared and served (citation issued). Dead insects, grease and dirt build-up throughout; rusted two-door cooler racks. Prior allergen training violation uncorrected.

headline: Failed: cold unit at 56.3F; restroom issues
summary: License re-inspection failed. A cold-holding unit kept cold foods at 56.3F; all units must stay at 41F or below. No backflow device on utility sink. Employee washroom lacked covered receptacle and clean sink; light shields missing.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; sink lacked paper towels
summary: Failed. No City certified manager or posted certificate while foods like chicken soup, pork and beef were served. Rear handsink lacked paper towels and soap, supplied during inspection. Prior violations uncorrected: thermometers, boxed food on floor, rust.

headline: No employee health policy; handlers lack certificates
summary: License re-inspection passed with conditions. No employee health policy on site (priority violation; no citation issued). Employees working without food handler certificates; 30-day grace period for new hires. Certified manager on duty lacks allergen training.

headline: Dead cockroaches on glue boards in basement
summary: Passed. About 20 to 25 dead cockroaches on glue boards under basement equipment; boards must be replaced and dead insects removed. Single-use items stored on floor of rear stairway and basement; must be raised six inches.

headline: No utility sink on site
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. No utility sink on site. Operator instructed to install and maintain one.

headline: Broken dumpster lid; sink missing handwashing sign
summary: Failed canvass. Outside dumpster had a broken, missing lid, a priority violation with citation issued. A basement employee handwashing sink lacked a handwashing sign; operator instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Failed: black mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: Failed. Smoothie-station ice machine had black mold-like substance where ice forms; tagged for no use until inspection complete (priority citation). Dusty walk-in shelves, food debris, grease in hood system; allergen certificates expired.

headline: No certified manager on site; backflow leak
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago food service manager on site; valid certificate must be posted at all times (citation issued). Backflow device leaks under self-serve soda machine, which also has excessive black substance underneath.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; re-inspection passed
summary: Re-inspection passed. A torn gasket inside the dessert and shake cooler must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No hair restraints worn by food handlers
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints; the operator must provide them.

headline: Failed: rear handsink water only 50.1F
summary: Failed. Rear handwashing sink had only 50.1F water; at least 100F required (priority citation). Low water pressure at that sink. No light in rear prep and storage area. Hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Complaint: 300+ mouse droppings; no pest log
summary: Failed. Rodent infestation: 300 or more mouse droppings on floors in walk-in cooler, under sinks, cooking equipment, and storage areas. No pest control logbook. Hot water reached only 93F; corrected on site to 100F and 112F.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings; food held above 41F
summary: Failed. About 4.5 lbs of spinach and sliced tomato held at 47.8-50F were discarded (priority citation). 20 or more mouse droppings on holding unit shelves and at the register; pest service recommended. Front door has a gap.

headline: Failed: walk-in cooler too warm; sink leaks
summary: License re-inspection failed. Walk-in cooler and freezer at 57.2-66.7F; prep cooler tagged and held. Three-compartment sink leaks when drained (priority citation). No food handler certificates on site; women's restroom lacks covered receptacles.

headline: Unlabeled seasonings; grease buildup; duct tape
summary: Re-inspection passed. Seasonings outside original containers lacked name labels. Duct tape was used on the walk-in cooler door and must not be used. Grease and debris on cooking equipment, coolers and shelves; hood filters dusty.

headline: Food stored on floor; tin can storage
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on floors in prep, storage and walk-in cooler must be raised six inches. Assorted food items stored in tin cans in coolers and refrigeration units must move to approved food-grade containers.

headline: Hot water only 58F in restroom
summary: Failed. Women's restroom hot water reached only 58F; must reach at least 100F (priority citation). Calcium buildup inside ice machine. Three-compartment sink drain splashes water on floor. Certified manager has no allergen training.

headline: Dish machine lacked sanitizer; 390 lbs rice discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Rice at 50.5-52.4F in basement prep cooler; manager discarded 390 lbs ($520). Multiple leaks, dust, broken light cover; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: About 50 live flies in several areas
summary: Failed. About 50 live small flies at the bar, dishwashing and bakery prep areas; more pest control needed, citation issued. A handwashing sink was blocked by a display placard. Soap dispenser batteries were replaced on site.

headline: Complaint: live flies in prep and storage
summary: Failed. About 25 live small flying insects on walls, ceiling and menu boards in prep, dishwashing and dry storage; more pest control needed, citation issued. Prior no food handler certificates and allergen training violations uncorrected.

headline: Broken stopper in three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. The stopper in the central compartment of the three-compartment sink does not work. Operator was instructed to repair or replace it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; ice machine calcium
summary: Passed. Basement handwashing sink needs a handwashing sign. Ice machine interior has calcium buildup. Washroom receptacle must have a cover. Missing baseboard by ice machine; basement prep floors and corners need cleaning.

headline: Low water pressure at front handsink
summary: Passed. Front exposed handwashing sink needs more water pressure and must be repaired. Front customer washroom lacks covered waste receptacles; employee unisex door not self-closing. Food containers need labels.

headline: No employee health policy; no vomiting plan
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training on site (priority violation). No procedure or kit for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events; facility must develop and maintain one.

headline: Expired handler certificates; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Several food handlers had expired certificates and must obtain valid ones. Food service manager had no allergen training certificate. Floors under cooking equipment and in the basement walk-in need cleaning; cooking vents need cleaning.

headline: Drink nozzles and breading table need cleaning
summary: Passed. Drink dispenser nozzles have buildup and must be cleaned. Breading table needs detail cleaning. Front handwashing sink nozzle needs repair. Floors throughout need detail cleaning of spills and buildup.

headline: Debris on cabinets, coolers and equipment
summary: Passed. Debris was found on interior and exterior surfaces of cabinets, coolers, shelving, cooking equipment, freezers and holding units. Manager was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Scoops without handles; cardboard; no training proof
summary: Re-inspection passed. Wiping cloths in prep area need sanitizing solution. Food scoops without handles stored in cooler containers. Cardboard under cook-line equipment; torn cooler gasket; no proof of food handler training.

headline: Ice machine door buildup; rusty shelves
summary: Passed. Build-up on the interior side of the ice machine door must be cleaned. Rust on green shelving in walk-in cooler must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Ice maker slime; rice left at 72.3F
summary: Passed with conditions. No paper towels at main kitchen handsink. Ice maker interior has black and orange slime buildup. Five lbs cooked rice at 72.3F on counter discarded ($20). No food probe thermometer; hair restraints missing.

headline: Complaint: stained cutting boards; no thermometer
summary: Failed. No metal stem thermometer on site (citation). Handwashing signs needed at prep and toilet sinks. Stained, deeply grooved cutting boards in butcher area. Dumpster missing lid (citation). Meat slicers have debris; walls not coved.

headline: Failed: food on floors, unclean ice bin
summary: Failed. Food containers stored on floors and ice bin top not clean. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Outside dumpsters with open lids overflowing, a priority violation with citation. Storage closet full. No allergen training proof for certified managers.

headline: Food on floor; grease; no handler training
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food stored on prep and dishwashing floors must be raised six inches. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Grease and debris on equipment, walls and coolers. No food handler training available for employees.

headline: Bar equipment and ice bins need cleaning
summary: Re-inspection passed. Mixing equipment stored on prep table. Internal and external surfaces of ice storage bins, cooling units and liquor racks in the bar need cleaning to remove food debris buildup.

headline: Dead ants in basement; condensate water on floor
summary: Passed. About 30-40 dead ants beneath basement dry storage equipment. Insect control device hung above open wiping-cloth bucket at bar. Building condensate line dumps water onto basement floor. Grease and dust build-up in hood system.

headline: License failed: no bar handsink; no allergen training
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink in bar area. No raw-food advisory on online menu. No food probe thermometer or pest control logbook; no outside dumpster found. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Spills in coolers; allergen violation repeated
summary: Passed with conditions. Second-floor reach-in coolers need spills cleaned; front serving and storage floors need cleaning; first-floor kitchen vent covers are dusty. Certified manager lacks allergen training, uncorrected from prior report (citation).

headline: Leaky pipes under sinks; hood filters
summary: Passed. Leaky pipes under the front three-compartment sink and rear hand sink must be repaired. Filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Failed: 50+ mouse droppings; pest service needed
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings on floor and pallets in rear storage; manager instructed to call an exterminator (citation issued). Also missing basement handwashing sign, uncovered condiments, and dumpster lids not tight.

headline: Dripping hot-water knob; food debris on floors
summary: Passed. Hot water knob in toilet room leaks when turned on. Restroom trash receptacle lacks lid. Floors in corners, walk-in freezer and under equipment have food, dirt and debris. Food handlers lacked proof of required training.

headline: Loose faucets; leaking three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Faucet at exposed front prep handwashing sink is loose and must be corrected. Both faucets at the three-compartment sink are leaking and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: License passed. The sanitation manager has no allergen training certificate and must provide one.

headline: Milk crates used for elevation; torn gasket
summary: Passed. Milk crates must not be used for elevation in dry storage and refrigeration room. Torn rubber door gasket on food cooler must be replaced.

headline: Complaint: black substance dripping onto ice
summary: Failed. Rear ice machine had black substance build-up dripping onto ice used for consumption (priority citation); ice to be removed and machine cleaned. Excess ice in rear chest freezer. Slow drain at three-compartment sink. No allergen proof.

headline: Cold handwashing water; expired allergen certificates
summary: Failed. Handwashing sinks measured 69-73F, below the required 100F, at front prep, restrooms and dishwashing room (priority citation). Allergen training certificates have expired. Bulk containers unlabeled; no hot and cold water at mop sink.

headline: Re-inspection passed; many repairs listed
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. Repairs needed: slow hand sink drain, leaky stoppers, worn cutting boards, loose wall and floor panels, chipping paint, dusty walls and a cracked light shield. Food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Burned-out ceiling lights in prep area
summary: Re-inspection passed. Some burned-out ceiling light bulbs above the first-floor prep and dishwashing areas must be replaced with working bulbs.

headline: Handler drinking over meat; wall opening
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food handler drank from open glass jar above meat in prep area; must drink in designated areas. Handler lacked hair restraint. Opening in side wall near prep door must be sealed; standing water in furnace closet.

headline: Uncovered bulk containers; cup used as scoop
summary: Complaint passed. Bulk food containers uncovered in prep area; a cup was used as a dispensing utensil in sauce containers. Grease, food debris and spills on cooking equipment, coolers and shelving; ceiling vents dusty.

headline: Person in charge lacked allergen training
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. The person in charge during inspection did not have an allergen training certificate. Management was told all certified food managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; items stored above equipment
summary: Passed. Handwashing sinks lacked signage. Employee personal care items were stored above clean equipment. Cooked rice cooling was covered tightly instead of loosely. Bulk dry containers lacked labels; paper towels stored in toilet room.

headline: Ice machine contamination; hot water knob broken
summary: Re-inspection passed. Ice scoop stored inside ice machine; tea container submerged in ice machine; cup stored in ice bin. Yellow wiping cloths used in prep areas. Front handwashing sink hot water knob did not work; must be repaired.

headline: Re-inspection passed; sink and filter buildup
summary: Re-inspection passed. Buildup found on interior of all compartments of three-compartment sink; instructed to detail clean. One hood filter was missing and must be replaced.

headline: Labeling, wiping cloths, and slow drain
summary: Passed. Food storage containers lacked labels. Wiping cloths on prep tables must be stored in sanitizing solution. Handsink beside three-compartment sink drains slowly. Dust on employee washroom ceiling vent must be cleaned.

headline: No cleanup supplies, thermometer, or test strips
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies, metal stem thermometer, or sanitizer test strips were on the premises, all required. No written employee health policy was on site. These were marked as priority violations. The men's washroom wall opening needs repair.

headline: Live roaches and flies; no certified manager
summary: Four live roaches and about 25 or more small flies were in the basement; pest control service was recommended. No certified manager was on duty while food was prepared; citation issued. Dishes were not properly sanitized.

headline: Leaks, unlabeled bulk containers, dirty equipment
summary: Bulk ingredient containers were unlabeled, and wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer. Leaks at a three-compartment sink faucet and a two-compartment sink base must be fixed. The pit, can opener, and storage racks need cleaning.

headline: Rear door gap is not rodent-proof
summary: The rear door has a 1/4-inch gap underneath and is not rodent- or insect-proofed. Staff were instructed to proof the door and keep it that way. No pests were recorded.

headline: Glove misuse; handwashing sink lacked soap, towels
summary: An employee came from rear prep and removed tortillas from the grill in the same gloves, without washing hands; citation issued. The main prep handwashing sink lacked soap and paper towels, both supplied during inspection.

headline: Dirty ice machine; food handlers lack certificates
summary: Ice machine interior needs debris cleaning, and all food handlers need food handler certificates. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Cooking equipment, the oven, and prep floors and walls need cleaning. Bar drain boards need proper drain lines.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; unlabeled seasonings
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced with smooth shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Bulk seasonings lacked labels. Greasy floors under KC Grill equipment and stained ceiling tiles indicating a leak also need attention.

headline: Hot water too cool at 3-compartment sink
summary: Hot water at the three-compartment sink reached only 102°F; it must stay at least 110°F. A citation was issued. Hot water was restored before the inspection ended. Fixtures near the sink had soil and debris to clean.

headline: No certified manager; food on floor
summary: No City certified food manager was on site while eggs were prepped and served; citation issued. Food was stored on the walk-in floor and must be raised 6 inches. Grease and debris covered equipment and coolers.

headline: No manager certificate on site; dumpster issues
summary: No original City sanitation manager certificate was on site or posted; citation issued. Vomit cleanup procedures and supplies were missing. The dumpster area had garbage and pallets, and its lid was missing. The front door does not close properly.

headline: Hair restraints missing; broken freezer lid
summary: Food handlers were not wearing effective hair or beard restraints. A rear box freezer lid is broken and must be replaced. Grease spillage on floors around the rear oil tanks must be cleaned. Allergen training proof was missing.

headline: Plastic grocery bags used for food storage
summary: Food was stored in plastic grocery bags inside chest freezers; only food-grade bags are allowed. The ice machine had no backflow device, and the mop sink and a prep handsink leaked. Grease spilled in the alley was cited.

headline: Dish machine exterior dirty; allergen certificates
summary: Food buildup was on the outside of the dish machine and must be cleaned. Food managers had no allergen training certificates; all City certified managers must have them.

headline: Bare-hand toast contact; hot water too low
summary: An employee removed toast with bare hands for room service; citation issued. Hand-washing lapses were also seen. Hot water at several hand sinks measured 65–96°F instead of 100°F; restored during inspection. Dish sanitizer was reset during inspection.

headline: Dripping pipes above prep; no hair restraints
summary: Basement pipes were sweating and dripping above the prep area and must be wrapped in insulation. Food handlers prepped food without hair restraints; the person in charge gave one a hat. A two-door cooler had torn gaskets to replace.

headline: Wet wiping cloth left on cutting board
summary: A wet wiping cloth was placed on a cutting board. Staff were told to keep wiping cloths in a sanitizer bucket when not in use.

headline: No certified manager; no sink stoppers
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while beef and chicken were handled and served; priority violation. The three-compartment sink had no stoppers and was being plugged with a small cup; proper stoppers are required.

headline: Five live cockroaches; insecticide near dishes
summary: Five live cockroaches crawled on the kitchen wall behind the ice maker and prep tables; pest control service recommended. Fogging insecticide cans sat near the clean dish rack and must be removed. Soup and salsa lacked discard dates.

headline: Faucet leak; food handler certificates not found
summary: A compartment sink faucet was leaking and must be repaired. A wet mop was stored in its bucket and should be hung up. Food handler certificates could not be located or verified, and must be kept on site.

headline: No certified manager; bare-hand contact; warm food
summary: No certified manager was on site while raw chicken was cooked and served; citation issued. An employee touched lettuce with bare hands. Cooked eggs at 52.2°F and noodles at 75.4°F were discarded. Expired food handler and allergen certificates were on file.

headline: Open basement windows; foil on grill shelves
summary: Basement windows had large screen openings; provide 1/16-inch mesh screens or keep windows shut and tight-fitting. Aluminum foil on shelves under the flat-top grill must be removed for smooth, cleanable surfaces.

headline: Tape and plastic wrap on drain pipes
summary: Soiled plastic tape joined discharge pipes at the coffee area floor drain, and plastic wrap joined pipes under the dish machine. Both must be removed and replaced with smooth, easily cleanable fixtures.

headline: No food handler training; no allergen training
summary: Employees had no food handler training and the food manager had no allergen training; both must be provided. A leaky faucet handle, chipping paint, and ice buildup in a chest freezer also need attention.

headline: Covered trash, regrouting, and wall cleaning needed
summary: The women's washroom needs a covered trash receptacle. Some prep-area floor tiles near the coffee and drive-thru area need regrouting. Food debris and dust on dining-area walls around and behind soda machines must be cleaned.

headline: Black slime in ice maker; warm cold foods
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared; citation issued. Black slime dripped from the ice maker into ice. Chicken, tuna, steak, cheese, and deli meats at 47.8–54.5°F were discarded, and a cooler at 47.9°F was tagged.

headline: Mop must be stored to air-dry
summary: A mop was stored in a position that prevented proper drying, which can encourage pests. It must be stored mounted so it can air-dry without soiling.

headline: Basement clutter and ceiling need correction
summary: All clutter stored in the basement must be removed to prevent pest hiding places, and remaining items stored elevated. A smooth, cleanable ceiling must be installed above the basement ice machine.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; no handler certificates
summary: Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were missing; they are needed to eliminate norovirus. A hand sink is needed in the rear dish area, and no food handler certificates were on site. A 1/4-inch front door gap needs sealing.

headline: About 15 live flying insects; citation issued
summary: About 15 live small flying insects were on walls, ceilings, and stock boxes in dry storage and rear prep. A citation was issued. More pest control service is needed to eliminate the activity.

headline: Missing health policy; door gaps
summary: The person in charge could not provide a written employee health policy; a citation was issued. Signed policies were provided on 02/07/25. Front and rear doors had gaps needing tight seals, and food containers lacked labels.

headline: Slime in ice machine; cold food too warm
summary: Black and pink slime was dripping from the ice machine into ice; citation issued. Cold foods at 46.2–57.4°F were discarded, about 32 lbs. A salad cooler at 57.6°F was tagged and must not be used until re-inspected.

headline: Floor cleaning needed under equipment and shelves
summary: Inspector asked staff to clean floor corners under and around equipment where needed, and the floor inside the walk-in cooler under shelves. No other violations were listed.

headline: Cold food too warm; soap missing; improper thawing
summary: Cooked steak at 53.4°F, cooked chicken at 52.5°F, and raw chicken tenders at 50.1°F were discarded, about 28 lbs; citation issued. Soap was missing at the prep handsink; citation issued. Frozen foods were thawed improperly in sink water and on the counter.

headline: Dead insect found; food stored in toilet room
summary: A dead insect was in light shields that must be cleaned. Food and paper goods were stored on toilet room shelving and on the walk-in freezer floor. Also: wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer and a damaged cutting board.

headline: Single-use items on floor; no covered receptacle
summary: Single-service articles were stored on the storage area floor and must be elevated. The unisex staff restroom had no covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products.

headline: About 40 rat droppings; no certified manager
summary: About 40 rat droppings were found in basement corners near stairs and rear storage; citation issued. No valid City sanitation certificate was on site while food was prepared. Fly paper and a fly zapper were found; pest service was requested.

headline: Greasy cooking oil container outdoors
summary: Grease had built up on the outside of a used cooking oil container in the outdoor rear garbage area. Staff were instructed to clean it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners; debris throughout
summary: Cardboard lining on storage shelves must be removed for smooth, cleanable surfaces. Storage shelves, bins, ice machine exterior, coolers, floors, walls, and outlet covers had excessive debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles; training needed
summary: Water-stained ceiling tiles were found in several areas and should be replaced where needed. Food handlers who are not City-certified food service managers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Dirt, grease, and missing ceiling cover
summary: Dirt and debris built up along walls under equipment, and grease covered the front prep floor and walls. A ceiling covering is missing under the hood ventilation motor and must be restored; hood filters have light grease.

headline: Door gaps and plastic-wrap repairs need fixing
summary: Half-inch gaps under outdoor doors need rodent-proof seals; no pests were found. Toilet pipes repaired with plastic wrap must be properly fixed. Also: soap dispenser to be removed from a prep sink, wiping cloths need sanitizer buckets.

headline: Missing air thermometer and sink stoppers
summary: A refrigerator next to the double-deck ovens had no ambient air thermometer. The three-compartment sink was missing two stoppers. Management was told to provide and maintain both.

headline: Milk and cheese too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Milk at 48.8–50.0°F, cream cheese at 50.5°F, and sausage at 49.5°F were discarded, about 30 lbs. A stand-up cooler at 55.5°F was tagged out of use. An employee had no hair restraint, and floors need deep cleaning.

headline: Allergen training missing for certified managers
summary: No allergen awareness training was on site during inspection. The person in charge was told to ensure all certified food service managers obtain it and keep certificates on site.

headline: Grimy three-compartment sink drain; concrete repair
summary: Grime and a mold-like substance were inside the three-compartment sink drain; staff must clean and sanitize it. Concrete behind the mop sink was in poor repair and must be fixed.

headline: Training proof missing; food stored on floor
summary: A female food handler lacked proof of food handler training; staff must meet requirements within 30 days of hire. Onion and bean bags sat on the basement floor and must be raised 6 inches. Gloves were used improperly.

headline: Torn freezer gasket; leaking basement ceiling
summary: A freezer in the upstairs prep area has a torn gasket to repair or replace. Water leaks from a water-damaged basement ceiling between the restrooms and must be repaired.

headline: Warm meats discarded; blocked handsink; no health policy
summary: Burgers at 50.2°F, turkey links at 45.6–52.8°F, and 35 lbs of pork ribs were discarded; citation issued. A cart blocked a handwashing sink; no employee health policy was on site. Garbage bags were used for food storage.

headline: No hot water; coolers not cold enough
summary: All cooling units were not holding 41°F or below during inspection, and there was no hot running water. Missing: employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea procedure, raw-food consumer advisory, pest control agreement, thermometer, and sanitizer test kit. No citations issued.

headline: Rust, dirt, peeling paint; allergen training missing
summary: Rusty shelving in the basement walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced. Dirt, peeling paint, missing ceiling tiles, and dirty floors were noted. The certified food manager lacked allergen training, which management was told to obtain.

headline: No certified manager on duty during chicken service
summary: No valid City certified manager was on duty while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. A worn front weather strip must be replaced to keep pests out. Two-door freezer needs interior cleaning, and the manager needs an allergen certificate.

headline: No certified manager; no allergen training
summary: No valid City certified food service sanitation manager was on site while chicken and beef were prepared and served; citation issued. A women's restroom faucet handle was loose. Certified managers had no allergen training on site.

headline: Grease, vent dust, and stained tiles need cleaning
summary: Staff were told to clean fryer bottoms and exteriors, ceiling vents and light shields, and hood vents over cooking equipment. Water-stained washroom ceiling tiles should be replaced. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Pizza held too cool; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: Two pans of pizza were held at 95°F in a display case; hot food must stay at 135°F or above. About 10 lbs were discarded. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure was on site; citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice machine bin; food handler lacked certificate
summary: Ice machine bin and interior guard had dirt and must be detail cleaned. One food handler lacked the required food handler certificate. A leaking drain under the three-compartment sink and unfinished wood shelving were also noted.

headline: Handwashing signs missing; openings need sealing
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at hand sinks behind bars and in washrooms. Openings under the front bar sink and in a basement wall must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Unused equipment and clutter in the basement must be removed.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training
summary: The food sanitation manager had no allergen training. The establishment must provide it.

headline: Glove and hand-washing lapses; produce too warm
summary: An employee cleaned a knife with a dirty cloth and plated food for customers without changing gloves or washing hands; citation issued. Sliced tomatoes at 51°F and cucumbers, beans, and cheese at 44.6–47°F were discarded, about 8 lbs.

headline: Slime in ice maker; food handler untrained
summary: Black slimy substance was on interior water parts of the ice maker, dripping into ice used for customers; citation issued. A food handler lacked a food handler certificate; proof of training was required.

headline: Food on floor; mold-like growth in walk-in cooler
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and storage areas; they must be raised 6 inches. The walk-in cooler had white mold-like growth on walls and splintering wood inside. Grease, dust, and damaged basement ceilings need repair.

headline: Thawing, rust, and sink leak; citation issued
summary: Frozen food was thawed in a three-compartment sink basin without running water. A front handsink had a severe leak, and another handsink could not drain; citation issued. Two prep tables had rust on tops and must be replaced.

headline: Manager lacked allergen training certificate
summary: The City food service sanitation manager had no allergen training certificate on record. Inspector said all City sanitation managers must meet this requirement.

headline: Allergen training missing; course taken on site
summary: The certified food manager had no food allergen training. Inspector told the manager to comply, and the manager took the course during the inspection.

headline: Overflowing grease bins and open garbage
summary: Outside garbage and grease containers were not maintained; grease overflowed and garbage was open, and a citation was issued. Fryers needed detail cleaning, and cooler shelves were worn with buildup. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer.

headline: No certified manager on site during food service
summary: The person in charge did not have a City certificate on site. No certified food manager was present while ready-to-eat foods such as chorizo, eggs, and breakfast sandwiches were prepared and served; citation issued.

headline: Rust, residue, peeling paint; allergen certificate missing
summary: Rust and food debris on walk-in cooler and freezer shelving must be cleaned or replaced. Floors under the bar and in rear storage had residue. Peeling paint near the mop sink and washroom entry must be repaired. Certified manager had no allergen certificate.

headline: Unlocked food storage room; hair restraint lapse
summary: The dry food storage room, on the lower level of a public garage, had no lock on its door; staff were told to lock it to prevent food tampering. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint.

headline: Spiders and webs found; allergen certificate missing
summary: Spiders and spider webs were found in the bar, restrooms, and dry storage; staff must remove them. The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Dirty prep walls; cracked dish-area light cover
summary: Food and dirt built up on prep walls and under equipment and must be cleaned. In the dishwashing area, a ceiling light cover is cracked and bulbs are not working; both must be replaced.

headline: Standing water, missing hood filters, unlabeled bottles
summary: Standing water on the basement floor must be removed. Missing hood filters must be replaced. Pre-cooked chicken was stored in a raw chicken box; use a clean container. Label squeeze bottles, add a prep-sink splash guard, and repair a cooler door.

headline: Rusty shelving; missing covered trash; dirty floors
summary: Rust on dry storage shelving in the basement walk-in cooler must be removed. Both women's toilet rooms need covered trash receptacles. Dirt on floors under equipment, along walls, and in corners needs cleaning. The certified manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Employee items stored on food shelves
summary: Employees' personal items were stored on shelves holding food. Inspector instructed staff to separate them.

headline: Live flies and rodent droppings; dish machine unsafe
summary: About 75 live small flies and about 10 rodent droppings were found; pest control was recommended. The bakery high-temperature dish machine rinsed at 90°F instead of 180°F and was tagged out of use. Raw sushi at 50–55°F was discarded.

headline: Unlabeled containers and utensils dried on cloth
summary: Food containers such as salt and flour were unlabeled. Clean utensils were drying on cloth towels, which is not allowed. The three-compartment sink faucet did not reach all compartments, and kitchen light fixtures lacked shields.

headline: Floors and walls need cleaning
summary: Floors and walls behind cooking equipment and throughout prep areas need cleaning to remove spills, debris, and grease.

headline: Mouse droppings found; 440 lbs of food discarded
summary: About 50–60 mouse droppings were found along walls in prep and storage areas; pest control was requested. About 440 lbs of fish and chicken at 46.5–53.8°F were discarded. Missing health policy and vomit cleanup kit were also cited.

headline: Broken cooler thermometer; loose door gasket
summary: A two-door reach-in cooler at the front prep area had a broken thermometer that must be replaced. A prep meat cooler's door gasket was loose. Dust and food debris were on walls and ceiling tiles in the dish area.

headline: Cups on floor; leaking storage-room sink handle
summary: Single-service cups and bowls stored on the dry storage floor must be raised 6 inches. A storage-area handwashing sink's hot water handle leaks and needs repair. Floors under the dish machine had heavy dried debris.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager
summary: No person in charge was present during inspection; a priority violation with no citation. No certified food manager was on duty while pastries and sandwiches were prepared and served; citation issued.

headline: Leaking washroom drainpipe; allergen certificate missing
summary: A drainpipe leaked under the customer washroom hand sink and must be repaired. The City certified food manager had no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: No certified manager on duty during meat prep
summary: The person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate. No certified manager was on duty while cooked ground beef and Italian beef were prepared; citation issued. A new employee had no food handler training, and food containers sat on the walk-in floor.

headline: Expired handler training; inaccurate dish gauge
summary: Several food handlers had expired food handler training certificates. The high-temperature dish machine's rinse gauge was off by over 10°F; citation issued. Soup cooled while covered, and reach-in cooler gaskets were in poor repair or missing.

headline: Items on floor; missing sink stoppers; broken tiles
summary: Items stored on the floor under the front bar's three-compartment sink must be raised. Stoppers were missing from that sink, and a prep cooler has a torn door gasket. Rear dishwashing floor tiles are broken.

headline: Unlabeled condiments; utensils stored improperly
summary: Food in condiment containers lacked labels with common food names. In-use utensils were stored inside food containers and on prep surfaces. Both washroom exhaust vents had dirt and debris buildup.

headline: Slime in ice machine; rice held too warm
summary: Pink and black slime was inside the ice machine; citation issued. Rice in the walk-in cooler measured 49.3–57.2°F, above the 41°F limit; about 20 lbs were discarded. Broken thermometers and low water pressure at a handwashing sink were noted.

headline: Food on floor; leaks; hair restraints missing
summary: Food was stored on the rear storage floor and must be raised six inches. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Leaking drainpipes, rust, grease, damaged ceiling and floor tiles, and wall openings also need repair. No pests were noted.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; food debris, dust
summary: Milk crates were used to elevate items, which can hide pests, so staff must use proper shelving and keep food 6 inches from walls. Food debris was behind cooking equipment, and dust covered ceilings, fans, and the hood.

headline: Missing dump sink and ice machine backflow device
summary: The alcoholic drink preparation area has no dump sink with hot and cold running water; one must be installed. The ice machine water line has no backflow prevention device; one must be installed and maintained.

headline: Low hot water; self-service contamination risk
summary: Hot water at the bar hand sink and self-service area reached only 76°F; it must reach at least 100°F. Self-service station was not protected from customer contamination. Bar sink lacks splash guard. Certified manager had no allergen training.

headline: Six dead roaches; insecticide cans in prep
summary: Six dead roaches were in the rear prep hot water tank area; staff must remove them. Insecticide fogger cans were there too and must be removed. No certified manager was on site while chicken and eggs were prepared; citation issued.

headline: No cold water at prep sink; items on floor
summary: The front prep handwashing sink had no cold water and must be fixed. Single-use items and dishes stored on floors or under the three-compartment sink must be elevated or removed. Greasy floors, walls, and cabinets need cleaning.

headline: Dead roach found in damaged sink pipe casing
summary: One dead roach was found in a damaged pipe enclosure under the three-compartment sink. Also noted: bread cooling uncovered while unattended, deeply cut seafood cutting boards, floor debris, and missing handwashing signs. Staff were told to fix each.

headline: Live roaches found under three-compartment sink
summary: Two live roaches were found under the three-compartment sink area; citation issued, and pest control must be notified. No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine. Restroom doors were not self-closing.

headline: Grease on cooler doors; spills on prep floors
summary: Dirt and grease had built up on refrigeration unit doors and must be cleaned. Food spills on prep area floors under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners must also be cleaned.

headline: Uninverted single-use utensils; dusty cabinets
summary: Single-service spoons and lids were not inverted to protect them from contamination. Dust, spills, and debris were inside beverage-area cabinets and on the bottoms of prep and display coolers and must be cleaned.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles and debris
summary: Water-damaged ceiling tiles on the sales floor and rear storage must be replaced. A wall near the rear door needs repair. Debris was in rear storage, and a restroom vent was dusty.

headline: No certified manager during bagel sandwich prep
summary: No certified manager was on site while time/temperature-controlled bagel sandwiches were prepared; citation issued. Only 1 of 6 employees had food handler training. Also broken cooler thermometers, a leaking faucet, and items stored on the floor.

headline: Non-licensed fly traps; food stored on floors
summary: Fly traps were not from the pest control company; staff must remove them and contact pest control. Food containers sat on floors in the walk-in freezer and attic and must be raised 6 inches. Greasy floors were noted.

headline: About 100 rat droppings; food held too warm
summary: About 100 rat droppings were under dry storage shelves, in a hallway, and under the bar; citation issued. A dried food package also had 4 droppings. Food at 51–70°F was discarded; a 52°F cooler was tagged.

headline: Rust on cooler shelves; no covered trash
summary: Rust on walk-in cooler shelves must be removed. The two west-side toilet rooms had no covered receptacles; one is required for each restroom.

headline: Minor dust inside fryer
summary: Passed. Minor dust debris was found inside the fryer. Staff were instructed to clean it.

headline: Cooler at 70°F and no handwashing signs
summary: Failed. The 3-door tall cooler measured 70.0°F; 41°F or below is required. The chest freezer measured 25.0°F. Handwashing signs are missing at the front counter and employee washroom, and the washroom has no covered trash container.

headline: Over 100 flies; slime in ice machine; no paper towels
summary: Failed. Over 100 small flies were found in the first-floor bar, including inside floor drains. Black and brown slime was in the ice machine ice chute. About 3 lbs of cooked chicken with improper date marking was discarded. Some sinks lacked paper towels.

headline: Cold foods too warm; five live cockroaches found
summary: Failed. Milk, eggs, yogurt, cheese and curry held at 44-51°F in the prep cooler; 41°F or below is required. Five live cockroaches were found on a prep table and inside the oven. Extra pest control is needed. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager while cooking
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while chicken and other foods were prepared, so a citation was issued. A walk-in cooler door gasket is torn, two hood lights are burnt out, and proof of allergen training is missing.

headline: Dumpster area littered; dirty floor drains
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The dumpster area had spills, debris and litter that must be cleaned to avoid attracting pests. Floor drains were dirty and must be detail cleaned. Air vent covers in the serving line and prep area were dusty.

headline: Broken washroom fan; no food handler training
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The washroom ventilation fan does not work and must be repaired. No food handler training was shown for employees. All food handlers must complete it.

headline: Ice machine, grease spills and minor leak
summary: Passed. The ice machine interior needs minor cleaning. Grease was spilled on the outside of the oil tank container. A minor leak at a pipe below the main prep line handsink must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager; over 20 flies found
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on premises, and no verifiable employee health policy was on site. Over 20 small flies were found, mostly in the rear washroom and near the utility sink; a citation was issued. Soap was corrected on site.

headline: Employees eating and drinking near food
summary: Passed. Employee drinks were left uncovered on a prep table, and an employee was eating near bread storage and a hot-holding unit. Management was told to set aside a break area away from food.

headline: Missing handwash signs; many repairs needed
summary: Failed. Bar handsinks lack signs and raw wood is used behind a sink. Foil lines cooking equipment, and a faucet leaks. Washrooms lack covered trash containers. Ceiling and floor tiles are damaged. Prior rodent-proofing and cleaning items remain unfixed.

headline: Hot rice and cold eggs out of range; no manager
summary: Failed. Rice held at 98.6-114.6°F in a hot-holding unit; 135°F is required. Eggs at 49.5°F and sweet potatoes at 49.1°F were found. A hot cabinet at 75.2°F was tagged. The certified manager arrived at 3:33 p.m. Food was discarded.

headline: Rodent droppings near equipment; chicken thawed in water
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Chicken was thawing in water in a sink compartment. Inspector noted rodent droppings, grease and dirt around equipment and walls. Some food handlers lacked certificates and were not wearing hair restraints.

headline: Rice stored in grocery bags
summary: Passed. Rice was stored in grocery bags inside a 3-door cold holding unit. Management was told to use only food-grade storage bags or containers.

headline: Door gaps, cold handsink, and missing prep sink
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Several outer doors have gaps that must be sealed. A men's washroom handsink was 76.8°F (100°F minimum). The beverage station has no prep sink. Floor tiles, ceiling tiles and hood lights need repair.

headline: Missing signage, torn gasket, ceiling panels
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Handwashing signs are needed at all sinks. A chest freezer in the kitchen has a torn gasket. Two ceiling panels are missing in rear storage. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. A certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. This is a repeat violation from 2023. Management must show proof of training, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; about 20 live flies
summary: Failed. The high-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing at 180°F, so staff washed at the 3-compartment sink. The manager switched to low temperature and it was corrected by the end. About 20 live small flies were found near the bar handsink.

headline: Food on floor; cardboard shelf liners
summary: Passed. Food stored on the floor in the walk-in and prep area must be raised 6 inches. Wet wiping cloths sat on cutting boards, cardboard lined dry storage shelves, and unisex restrooms lacked covered receptacles.

headline: Gap under trash door; milk crate shelving
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the trash exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. Milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced. The food service sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Dirty ice machine; no allergen training proof
summary: Failed. A basement ice machine had black and brown buildup dripping onto ice stored below the bin; a citation was issued. Debris and spills were on the floor around cooking equipment, and no allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Shrimp thawed improperly; door gaps need sealing
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Frozen shrimp was thawed on a shelf under a prep table. Small openings at the screen door and rear prep door need rodent-proofing. No pests were seen. Missing handwashing signs and food residue inside cold units were also noted.

headline: Dusty light shields in storage
summary: Passed. Dust had built up inside light shield covers in the rear food storage area. Staff must clean and maintain them.

headline: Rusty, chipped wire rack in walk-in
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The wire storage rack inside the walk-in cooler had chipped paint and rust. The manager must remove the rust and repaint or replace the shelves.

headline: No certified manager; utensils stored improperly
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled and served. Staff were instructed to obtain one. An ice scoop was left on a dusty ice maker, and spoons were stored in standing water.

headline: Milk crates, missing certificates, no backflow device
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Milk crates were used as shelving and cardboard as floor mats. Chest freezers had heavy ice. No backflow device, no food handler certificates and no allergen training were on site.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; grime, damage and burnt lights
summary: Failed. No test kit was available to check sanitizer strength at the 3-compartment sink. Food debris was found on the stove, oven and ice machine. Several earlier items remain unfixed, including low hot-water pressure and damaged floors.

headline: No certified manager; no cooling equipment; no pest records
summary: Failed. No valid sanitation certificate was posted, and no certified manager was on site while food was prepared. There was no cooling or cooking equipment, no metal stem thermometer, and no pest control records. A front prep handsink is also missing.

headline: No certified manager; flies throughout; sink floods
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on duty while chicken, shrimp and beef were prepared. About 15 small flies were found in the bar, prep and dish areas; pest control was recommended. A handwashing sink floods when run and cannot be used.

headline: No certified manager; about 40 live flies
summary: Failed. No City-certified manager was on premises while milk and eggs were prepared; a citation was issued. About 40 live small flies were found on walls at the cook-to-order and dish areas and must be removed by re-inspection.

headline: Mop sink backflow missing; restroom door left open
summary: Passed. No backflow device could be found for the mop sink faucet, so the hose must be installed or removed. A restroom door next to the prep kitchen was kept open and must stay closed.

headline: Grease buildup; kids' chocolate milk too many calories
summary: Passed. Inspector ordered cleaning of grease and food debris from counters, fryers, coolers and the dish machine, plus floor and wall cleaning. The kids' menu default chocolate milk at 140 calories must be 130 or fewer.

headline: Hot food below safe temperature; holding unit broken
summary: Failed. Pork, chicken and meatloaf held at 100-118°F; 135°F or above is required. About 50 lbs discarded, valued at $300. The hot-holding unit ran at 123°F and was tagged. An ice machine backflow device from a prior inspection is still missing.

headline: Broken cooler door handle at cookline
summary: Passed. The tall reach-in cooler at the end of the cookline has a broken door handle. Management was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Encrusted can opener blade
summary: Passed. The can opener was encrusted with old food debris. Staff must clean and sanitize the blade or replace it.

headline: No handsink in front prep area
summary: Failed. The front prep area has no handwashing sink; the manager must install one, though no citation was issued. A hood does not cover a gas oven in the griddle area. The 3-compartment sink needs adequate drain plugs.

headline: Hot and cold foods outside safe temperatures
summary: Passed with conditions. Meatballs at 131°F (135°F required). Turkey at 47°F, tomatoes at 46°F and lettuce at 51°F in a sandwich cooler (41°F required). The condiment cooler air was 48°F. No health policy or inspection summary was posted.

headline: No person in charge; manager not certified
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge was present. The manager lacked valid City certification while ice cream and cookies were prepared and served; a citation was issued. The front prep handsink had no soap, and washroom trash cans lacked lids.

headline: About 50 rodent droppings found; unsafe storage
summary: Failed. About 50 rodent droppings were found in the employee restroom, rear area and front area near coolers; a citation was issued. Bottled drinks were stored on the floor. No recent inspection summary was posted for customers.

headline: Dirty fryers; missing food handler and manager certificates
summary: Passed. Fryer interiors had food, grease and charred material. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables and a fry scoop was stored in fries. A food handler lacked a certificate and the manager's allergen certificate had expired.

headline: Patio door needs rodent-proofing; no drainboard
summary: Passed. The exterior door to the outdoor patio needs rodent-proofing at the bottom. The 3-compartment sink lacks a drainboard. Both must be provided and maintained.

headline: Live roaches found; no hot water at first
summary: Failed. Seven live roaches were found, including on chemical bottles and under the front counter. Cold food at 46-57°F was discarded (about 15 lbs, $50). Hot water was missing and was restored on site before inspection ended. A food handler training proof was missing.

headline: Dirty fryer; missing backflow device and drain cover
summary: Passed. The fryer interior had grease and dirt. The rear mop sink lacks a backflow device, and a floor drain by the beverage cooler is missing its cover. A food handler lacked proof of training, and the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Missing splashguard; no food handler proof
summary: Passed. The utility mop sink needs a splashguard. A large carnitas pot does not fit the 3-compartment sink, so an alternate method or smaller pots are required. No food handler certificate was on premises, and the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Meatballs held too cool; dead insects in light shields
summary: Failed. Meatballs at 129.2°F on a hot-holding unit; 135°F is required. About 5 lbs were discarded. Dead insects were found in light shields, gaps under two doors, and trash piled outside. Previous food handler and allergen training records were missing.

headline: No certified manager when food was served
summary: Failed. No person in charge or certified manager with a valid posted certificate was present while food was prepared and served; a citation was issued. Bulk containers were unlabeled, syrup was spilled, and the high-temperature dish machine lacks a test thermometer.

headline: Unlabeled containers; microwave debris
summary: Passed. Containers at the enchilada station had no identifying labels. Food debris was encrusted inside the microwave and on the shelf beneath it. Staff were instructed to label containers and clean the microwave.

headline: High-temperature dish machine below 180°F; tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. The high-temperature dish machine did not reach the 180°F final rinse and was tagged. It may not be used until re-inspected. Also noted: leaks at the 3-compartment sink, missing floor tiles, clutter and a missing oven door.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager
summary: Failed. No person in charge and no manager with a valid City certificate were present while coffee, milk and eggs were handled. No pest control log book was kept, and the bathroom door did not self-close. Citations were issued.

headline: About 50 small flies in bar area
summary: Failed. About 50 small flies were seen in the bar area. Pest control consultation is required and a citation was issued. Milk crates used as shelving, and stained cutting boards with open seams, must be replaced.

headline: Handsink lacks cold water; no splashguard
summary: Failed on re-inspection. The rear dishwashing handsink had no cold running water, which the manager must provide. A handsink beside the 3-compartment sink also lacks a splashguard.

headline: No certified manager with allergen training
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No certified food manager with allergen training was on site. The manager was instructed to comply with the requirements.

headline: Mold on produce; live flies; meat-prep sink without water
summary: Failed. Moldy cauliflower, strawberries and dragon fruit were discarded. About 25 live flies were flying in the bakery, prepared-food and sushi areas. The meat-prep handwashing sink had no water connection; paper towels were supplied on site.

headline: Beef thawed under prep table; no pest log
summary: Failed. Frozen beef was thawing in a plastic bag under a prep table. No metal stem thermometer or current pest control logbook was on site. Cardboard lined shelves, a slow-draining sink was noted, and the food manager lacks allergen training. Citations issued.

headline: Cart lacks license number on both sides
summary: Passed. The license number must appear in 2-inch letters on both lateral sides of the cart. Management was instructed to correct and maintain this.

headline: Beef at 51°F; handsink had no soap
summary: Passed with conditions. Ten lbs of beef held at 51.2°F (41°F required) was discarded, about $100. The prep handsink had no soap until staff obtained some during inspection. Kitchen and storage floors had dust and debris.

headline: Handsinks blocked; no soap or paper towels
summary: Failed. Handwashing sinks were blocked by cookware and tools, and several lacked soap or paper towels. A stove-side sink leaked onto the floor. Heavy clutter, dirty floors and reused bags for greens were also found. Citations were issued.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed. Inspector found no food handler certificates for food employees. Management was instructed to provide certificates for all food handling staff.

headline: Floor drain needs cleaning; walk-in overstacked
summary: Passed. The floor drain under the lobby soda machine needs detail cleaning to prevent possible insects. The basement walk-in was stacked nearly to the ceiling, limiting airflow and room to inspect. Staff must reorganize it.

headline: Missing handwash signs; dirty ice machine guard
summary: Passed. The front prep handsink had no signage, the ice machine guard interior was dirty, and boxed food sat on the floor in rear dry storage. Staff must correct these and maintain them.

headline: Milk crates still used as shelving
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Milk crates were still used as shelving throughout the prep and storage areas. Management must remove them and provide shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager or valid certificate was on site while chicken and fish were served, so a citation was issued. A food handler lacked a certificate, a worker was not wearing a hair restraint, and wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer.

headline: Cold produce and miso above safe temperature
summary: Passed with conditions. Napa cabbage, bean sprouts and cabbage held at 48.9-50.2°F, and fermented miso at 71.4°F, in the prep cooler; 41°F or below is required. The manager discarded them and a citation was issued. Also: unlabeled containers, floor storage and a minor leak.

headline: Wall and sink openings to seal; new employee
summary: Passed. A hole in the drywall and an opening under the rear three-compartment sink must be sealed to prevent pests. Floors had dirt and debris under shelving and equipment. A new employee lacked a food handler certificate.

headline: Microwave, chute and floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. The microwave interior and a garbage chute had food buildup. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks, and floors under and around equipment and prep tables need cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing sign in restroom
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The front restroom had no handwashing sign. The person in charge must install and maintain one.

headline: No certified manager on site; wet mops stored
summary: Passed with conditions. No City-certified food manager with a valid, original certificate was on site, so a citation was issued. Wet mops were stored in a bucket in the dishwashing area and must be hung to dry.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer; tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged. It may not be used until it holds at least 50 ppm and is re-inspected. Other items: an unfinished wood shelf, a dusty exhaust hood, and one food handler certificate for four workers.

headline: No accessible handsink; leak; missing certificate
summary: Failed. The basement warewashing area has no accessible handwashing sink; one must be installed with hot and cold water, soap and paper towels. A large pipe leaks in the sub-basement, and a food employee lacks a food handler certificate.

headline: Cleaning and repairs needed; no pests found
summary: Passed. Inspector ordered cleaning of fryers, fan covers and floors in several prep areas. Repairs were ordered for loose wall coving, a cracked light shield and a stained ceiling tile. No pests were reported.

headline: Raw salmon and chicken held at 56°F; ice machine mold
summary: Failed. Salmon, marinated chicken, sour cream and egg yolk held at 56-58°F; 41°F or below is required. The chef discarded about $300 of food. Black mold-like buildup dripped from the ice machine onto ice. A cooler was tagged.

headline: Dirty cooler shelves and dusty vent noted
summary: Passed. Inspector found a dirty bottom shelf in the reach-in cooler and freezer, and a very dusty air vent above the rear prep table. Management must clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Torn gaskets on prep area cooler doors
summary: Passed. Both prep-area cooler doors had torn or ripped rubber gaskets. The manager was instructed to repair or replace them.

headline: Handsink blocked; expired food handler cards
summary: Passed with conditions. The rear prep handsink was blocked with bowls and cutlery, which were removed during inspection; a citation was issued. Foil and cardboard shelf liners, wood bread baskets, cooler debris and expired food handler certificates were also noted.

headline: Chipped ceiling paint and missing tiles
summary: Passed. Inspector noted chipped paint on the ceiling and missing ceiling tiles. The manager was instructed to repaint the ceiling and replace the missing tiles.

headline: Mouse droppings and live roaches; no certified manager
