summary: No food handler training was provided for employees and must be provided. Shakers lacked labels; scoops were stored inside bulk containers. Other items: worn freezer gasket, stained ceiling tiles, damaged wall trim, and dusty ceiling vents.

headline: Passed; raw brick and broken washroom fan
summary: Raw, porous brick behind the bar at the beer taps must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable. Mechanical ventilation in the south washroom was not working and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Conditional; no certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while handling and serving TCS foods such as beef and chicken; priority violation. Boxes of bananas and potatoes were stored on the floor and must be kept off the floor.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; dead flies found
summary: No city-certified food manager on premises, a priority violation. Over 20 dead flies were on the floor of the rear dry storage area. Openings at garage and entrance doors were found, and one door was left open. No food handler certificates were provided.

headline: Passed; black mold-like caulk, foil on shelves
summary: Multi-use utensils were not stored inverted. Aluminum foil on bottom shelves of prep tables must be removed. Excessive black mold-like substance was found on caulking around the warewashing line and must be removed or recaulked.

headline: Failed: no food handler certificates; repeat allergen violation
summary: Food handler certificates could not be verified and must be kept on site. Wet wiping cloths were stored on prep surfaces. No test strips or temperature indicator for hot-water dish machines. Also, a repeat allergen training violation was not corrected.

headline: Passed; expired food handler certificates; floor storage
summary: Several employees had expired food handler training certificates and must provide valid ones. Items under the three-compartment sink must be elevated; milk crates may not be used for elevation. Floors under the sink had dirt and debris.

headline: Failed: 60-70 fruit flies throughout facility
summary: About 60-70 fruit flies were found in restrooms, the rear mop area, sinks, and floor drains. Person in charge was told to inform the pest control company and remove the flies; citation issued. Also noted: missing floor tiles and unreliable washroom lights.

headline: Passed; greasy racks and broken cooler gasket
summary: Grease and food debris had built up on storage racks inside the basement walk-in cooler and must be detail cleaned. Broken rubber gasket around a two-door reach-in cooler must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were scattered behind the refrigerator, under the front counter, and along walls in prep, storage, and office areas; priority violation with citation. Management must call an exterminator and clean. Also: missing food handler training.

headline: Failed: no proper dish sink; cooking must stop
summary: No three-compartment dish sink; a handsink was used to wash dishes. Inspector ordered cooking of Italian beef and nachos to stop until a proper sink is installed. No procedure for vomit or diarrhea events and no test kit; earlier violations not corrected.

headline: Conditional; unsafe dish machine and cold food
summary: Dish machine sanitizer measured 0 ppm; unit tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Chicken wings at 51.5F, lobster at 66.3F, and hamburger at 61.3F in a prep cooler; 13 lbs discarded. Two coolers were repaired during the inspection.

headline: Failed: warm sausage, 30+ live flies
summary: Cooked sausage links held at 99.1F, above the 135F minimum, were discarded (about 5 lbs). Over 30 live small flies were found on walls, ceiling, and shelving in several areas; a priority violation with citation. Menu lacked undercooked-food disclosure.

headline: Passed; manager's allergen certificate missing
summary: No allergen training certificate was provided for the food service manager. Operator was instructed to obtain allergen training.

headline: Passed; grey film inside ice machine
summary: Inside of the ice machine had a grey film on the upper interior panel. Inspector instructed cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Passed; food stored on floor, freezer floor soiled
summary: Corn husks for tamales in packaging were stored directly on the rear kitchen hallway floor and must be kept at least 6 inches up. Walk-in freezer floor was soiled with dust and dried food debris.

headline: Passed; backflow device not accessible for servicing
summary: Backflow prevention device was not located at the mop sink faucet. Inspector instructed installation in a spot where it can be found, serviced, and maintained.

headline: Passed; heavy grease; one handler lacks certificate
summary: Coolers, cooking equipment, storage containers, walls, and floors had excessive grease and dried food debris and needed detail cleaning. One food handler was observed without a food handler certificate.

headline: Passed; leaking sink pipe, unlabeled bulk container
summary: Pipe under the third compartment of the three-compartment sink was leaking and must be repaired. Bulk storage container lacked a label with the product name. Dust was found inside the walk-in cooler ceiling vent.

headline: Passed; one expired food handler card
summary: Food debris had built up on a wall-mounted potato cutter in the basement prep area and must be cleaned. One food handler card on site was expired; all employees must complete food handler training.

headline: Passed; paper shelf liner and dusty vents
summary: Paper was used as a shelf liner in the first-floor prep area and must be removed. Dust on a ceiling vent cover above a prep table needed cleaning. Mechanical ventilation in the first-floor employee all-gender washroom was not working and must be repaired.

headline: Passed; floors need cleaning under equipment, booths
summary: Floors under and around kitchen equipment needed cleaning where needed. Floors under dining area booths also needed cleaning.

headline: Passed; grease buildup on equipment and hoods
summary: Sides of cooking equipment had buildup needing detail cleaning. Coving in the front bar area needed cleaning, and hood vents needed removal of grease buildup.

headline: Passed; cooler debris, missing allergen certificates
summary: Accumulated food debris was found inside the prep area two-door cooler and must be cleaned. Some allergen training certificates for certified food managers were missing or expired and must be kept on premises.

headline: Conditional; no vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan
summary: No written procedure for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea, and no spill kit, were on site. This is a priority foundation violation; no citation issued, but the facility must provide them.

headline: Failed: overflowing garbage, no certificates, repeat violation
summary: Open 1/2-inch gap at the bottom of the front entrance door must be sealed. Outside garbage receptacles overflowed and lids could not close, a repeat priority violation. Food handler and allergen certificates were not provided.

headline: Failed: cold food held too warm; overflowing trash
summary: About 10 lbs of cooked rice held at 50-51.4F in the prep cooler. Manager discarded 10 lbs. Outside dumpsters overflowed so lids would not close. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings on shelves with food
summary: About 40-50 mouse droppings under a rear storage shelf and 10-12 on a shelf holding product. Management told to clean, sanitize, and call pest control. Outside waste container was open and overflowing.

headline: Failed: hot handsink water, mouse droppings found
summary: Handwash sink water measured 134.5-135.6F, above the 120F limit; priority violation. About 8 mouse droppings found in the facility and prep area. Openings at entrance door base must be sealed. Recommended pest control service.

headline: Passed; dusty floors and fans, plates not inverted
summary: Serving plates on kitchen prep shelves were not stored inverted and must be inverted to prevent dust. Floors throughout the premises, especially along walls and under equipment, needed detail cleaning. Dusty fans near the dish area.

headline: Failed: leaking three-compartment sink, cloths on tables
summary: Three-compartment sink leaked waste water onto the food prep floor; priority violation with citation. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of sanitizer. Cutting board had deep grooves and dark stains. Some food storage was unlabeled.

headline: Dish machine tagged; manager certificate not on site
summary: No physical city sanitation certificate was on site; the manager showed an image. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer, was tagged, and must not be used until it reaches at least 50 ppm and is reinspected.

headline: Failed: 15 live flies; hot handsink water
summary: Handwash sink water measured 130.1F, above the 100-120F range; manager corrected it on site. About 15 live small flying insects were on dish-area ceiling tiles; priority violation and citation. Bulk container unlabeled; burnt-out bulbs, dirty floors.

headline: Passed; foil shelf liners, stained cutting boards
summary: Several prep table shelves, racks, and equipment were lined with aluminum foil and must be removed for smooth, easy-to-clean liners. Cutting boards in prep coolers had deep stains and cuts and must be cleaned, resealed, or replaced.

headline: Conditional; improperly cooled food discarded (90 lbs)
summary: Cooked chicken at 47.6F, beef at 46.6F, and pasta at 54.0F did not cool fast enough in the walk-in cooler. Staff said items were prepared around 10 PM on 11/12/2025. About 90 lbs (about $350) discarded. Also noted: grease and dust on hood filters and cooking surfaces.

headline: Passed; liquor stored on floor, no covered bin
summary: Boxes of liquor were stored on the floor and must be raised at least 6 inches. No covered receptacle was in the toilet room.

headline: Failed: handsink removed; food stored on floor
summary: Front prep area handwashing sink was removed and must be replaced; priority violation with citation. Food containers were stored directly on the floor in the walk-in and warewashing areas and must be raised six inches. Also: a hole behind the water heater and leaks.

headline: Passed; no handler certificate, unclean ice machine
summary: Ice machine interior was not clean; ice is used for human consumption. No food handler training certificate was on site. Also noted a leaking three-compartment sink faucet and a gap at the screen door.

headline: Passed; loose handsink and dirty walk-in floors
summary: Handwash sink next to the ice machine was loose and must be fastened to the wall. Floors inside storage areas and the walk-in cooler were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no cleanup kit, no pest control records
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or cleanup kit was on site, a priority violation. No pest control logbook or service records were on site. Front and rear entry doors had small openings at the bottom that must be rodent-proofed.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers, torn gaskets, floor storage
summary: Cooling units throughout the prep area lacked thermometers. Torn gaskets and rusty shelving were found in refrigeration units. Toilet room door was not self-closing. Items were stored on the basement floor and cardboard was used as ceiling attachments.

headline: Passed re-inspection; door openings must be sealed
summary: Openings at the rear exit door and dock door could let pests in and must be sealed. Splash guard missing at a salumeria handwashing sink, exposed preset tableware, and a toilet room receptacle and door closer needed repair.

headline: Failed: unwashed hands, warm food, 50+ live flies
summary: Dishwasher handled dirty dishes, then clean dishes, without washing hands. Over 50 live small flies found in multiple areas, including dining room and basement. Prep coolers at 58.8F and 54.9F. Some food discarded; sanitizer corrected during inspection.

headline: Conditional; no certified manager on site
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open and operating. Also noted: missing handwashing signs, unlabeled containers, a cutting board with dark stains, dirty floors, and two food handlers without certificates. Opening at rear exit door bottom.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; eggs held too warm
summary: No certified food manager on site, a priority violation. Eggs stored above a grease trap were 69-70F and were discarded. The three-compartment sink had no cleaning agent or sanitizer, and handwashing sink lacked soap and paper towels.

headline: Failed: repeat violations, missing food handler certificates
summary: Unlabeled rice in a prep area container; no backflow device on espresso machine; no allergen training for certified manager. Previous priority and core violations were not corrected. Food handler certificates were not on site.

headline: Passed; no allergen certificate; upkeep repairs needed
summary: No allergen awareness training certificate was shown for the sanitation manager. Other items were upkeep: slow floor drain, non-working urinal, leaking faucet, and a non-working light in a kitchen hood.

headline: Failed: about 50 mouse droppings found
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were on the rear storage floor behind a chest freezer and under shelves. Additional pest control service is needed. Food containers were also stored on the floor and must be raised at least six inches.

headline: Passed; chicken thawed at room temperature
summary: Frozen cooked chicken was being thawed at counter room temperature. Inspector instructed thawing according to the health code. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint.

headline: No food handler certificates on premises
summary: Slight buildup inside the ice machine and dust on a cooler condenser. No food handler certificates on premises; manager must provide certificates with employee names.

headline: No hot water at sinks; restored during inspection
summary: Hand sinks read 59.7–64.4°F and 3-compartment sink 63.3°F. Hot water was restored to 100°F and 110°F by 10:30 AM. Garbage bags left on lids were moved. Summary report not posted; debris on floors and drains. Citations issued.

headline: Bent thermometer probe; litter in refuse area
summary: Passed. A food temperature probe is severely bent with an unreadable screen; other probes are in good repair. Litter in shared outdoor refuse area. Wall and base coving behind sinks soiled with dried food debris.

headline: No food handler training proof on site
summary: No proof of food handler training for food handlers. Staff must provide training records and keep them on site at all times. Passed.

headline: Leaking faucet and dirty men's restroom
summary: Passed. Leaking faucet on 1-compartment prep sink needs repair. Men's restroom needs detailed cleaning. Sponges should be replaced when discolored or in poor condition.

headline: Sink backup repaired; grease and gasket issues
summary: Three-compartment sink backed up when the first basin drained; repaired 9-27-2024 and no longer backing up. Broken gaskets in two-door reach-in coolers, stained cutting boards, grease in deep fryer and under cooking equipment, and items stored in food areas.

headline: Food on floor; expired food handler certificates
summary: Food stored on freezer floor, food handlers without hair restraints, deep scratches on cutting boards, torn cooler gasket, employee toilet door not self-closing, hole in ceiling above fryers, and expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Handler skipped handwashing before ready-to-eat food
summary: Food handler changed gloves without washing hands after handling raw fish, then prepared ready-to-eat food. The wax paper was discarded. Also overflowing outdoor garbage, damaged toilet door closer, and no allergen certificate for a certified manager.

headline: No paper towels at sink; summary not visible
summary: Handwashing sink by cooking line had no paper towels until the manager supplied them. Slow drainage in 3-compartment sink fixed during inspection. Grease on floors and fryers, no toilet-room receptacle, beards without guards, public summary ripped.

headline: Roach glue boards found; cold food too warm
summary: Glue boards filled with roach carcasses found; manager told to remove them. Foods that must be kept cold held at 46–52°F; about $200 of food discarded. Prep cooler air at 52°F; cooler tagged. Also missing hair restraints, greasy filters, and debris behind coolers.

headline: Ice machine buildup; food in grocery bags
summary: Ice machine has mineral buildup that must be cleaned. Egg rolls and won tons were stored in plastic grocery bags in the walk-in cooler; management told to use food-grade storage bags and containers. Passed.

headline: Cardboard hood cover, grease and rust found
summary: Cardboard used as hood filter cover in bakery prep. Blackened faucet and rust on prep sinks, peeling plastic liners on shelves, grease and food splatter on cook-line equipment, and a dirty floor drain. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; wings held too cool
summary: No certified manager on duty while Italian beef was prepared. Chicken wings in hot-hold unit measured 98.6–104°F; about 5 lbs ($25) discarded. Walk-in cooler thermometer broken; torn gasket on front beverage cooler.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: Re-inspection found no certified manager on site or valid certificate posted while foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared and served. Also unlabeled bulk container, uninverted single-use items, no covered receptacles in women's washrooms, syrup spills.

headline: Single-use items in restroom; floor drains soiled
summary: Single-use cups, utensils and straws stored in employee bathroom, a prohibited area. Floor drains below sinks heavily soiled with food debris. Employee bags and jackets stored on food and supply boxes. Passed.

headline: Improper thawing; training and cleaning gaps
summary: Frozen chicken thawed in standing water in a prep sink, an improper method; running water required. Aluminum foil and cardboard used as shelf liners, slow-draining handsink, food debris on floors, and missing food handler training for several employees.

headline: Passed re-inspection; ice machine exterior soiled
summary: Re-inspection passed. Outer surfaces of the ice machine had food debris and rust. Manager instructed to clean them often enough to prevent buildup.

headline: Sanitizer missing; cooler at 48°F
summary: Low-temperature warewashing unit reads 0 ppm chlorine and cannot sanitize; must be repaired or removed. Large two-door cooler at 48°F, above the 41°F limit. No pest logbook or proof of service. Raw wood under counter. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food on floor, dirty equipment
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food containers stored on the floor in walk-in cooler and prep areas. Knives stored in a box under grill, plates not inverted, stained cutting boards, cardboard liner, torn gasket, and a hood system not working.

headline: Storage room floor cluttered
summary: Passed. Caterer's storage room floor is cluttered. Boxes and items must be raised off the floor or removed.

headline: Leaky drain; expired food handler and allergen training
summary: Passed. Leaky drain pipe under rear kitchen prep sink needs repair, and floors behind cooling equipment need cleaning. Some food handlers have expired training certificates, and one certified manager has expired allergen training.

headline: No manager certificate or handwashing sink
summary: No original City of Chicago food manager certificate on site; manager instructed to provide it. No handwashing sink near the griddle and prep area in the kitchen center; manager instructed to install one. No citation issued.

headline: No certified manager on premises; several violations
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager on premises; citation issued. Non-working metal stem thermometer, food handler without hair restraint, cases of beverages on floor, damaged cooler gaskets, non-working toilet in one restroom, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Hair restraint missing; dirty fryers and ventilation
summary: Food handler not wearing a hair or beard restraint. Fryers have grease, food and dirt buildup; walk-in freezer floor has food and debris; toilet room ventilation not working. Instructed to correct and maintain.

headline: Rat droppings found; undercooked food advisory missing
summary: About 50 rat droppings found, including in the first-floor westside dry storage room. Licensed pest control service recommended; citation issued. Also no asterisk or menu disclosure for undercooked animal-derived foods, and an opening at the rear exit door.

headline: Dirty floors under heavy equipment
summary: Dirt and debris built up on floors under and behind heavy equipment such as mixers, dishwasher and coolers, and in corners. Manager instructed to detail clean and maintain.

headline: Trash, fecal residue, and prior violations uncorrected
summary: Trash under basement stairs and fecal residue inside food prep toilet bowl; cleaning ordered. Prior core violations not corrected: no backflow device found on ice machine, and no self-closing door on toilet room leading to food prep. Citation issued.

headline: No health policy or cleanup procedure
summary: No written employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure on premises. Ice buildup in upright freezer, leaking faucet at 3-compartment sink, damaged floor tiles, and ventilation and light out in unisex employee washroom. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Food on floors, debris, and rusty racks
summary: Food items stored on walk-in cooler floor, rusty storage racks, leaking drain pipe under 3-compartment sink, and food debris on rear prep floor. Person in charge instructed to correct and maintain. Passed.

headline: Wastewater backs up into food prep area
summary: Failed. Wastewater backs up from a floor drain into food prep when a handsink runs for a long time; that sink is no longer to be used until repaired. Leaking grab-and-go cooler, food debris under cooking equipment and in floor drains, and poor walk-in freezer lighting.

headline: Exposed ice, missing test kit, uncorrected violations
summary: Ice bin in first-floor bar had no lid. Spoons were corrected on site, and a missing sanitizer test kit was delivered during inspection. Prior violations uncorrected; rear door gap allows pest entry; leaking sink stopper; missing data plate; citation issued.

headline: Pest activity; sink blocked; food held too warm
summary: About 25 rodent droppings in furnace room. Handwashing sink blocked with bucket and cutting board. Cold food at 59–62°F, including raw chicken and rice, discarded. No sanitizer on site until bleach bought. No hand drying supplies. Citations issued.

headline: No spill cleanup procedure or supplies
summary: No procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea cleanup. Facility must provide a procedure and necessary supplies, including a disinfectant effective against norovirus. Priority violation under 7-38-005; pass with conditions.

headline: Gap under front door must be sealed
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be rodent-proofed. No pests were observed during inspection.

headline: No health policy, vomit procedure, or pest logbook
summary: No employee health policy, no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure, and no pest control logbook on site. Non-service dogs were brought inside; employees drinking at prep area. Missing sanitizer test kit and food handler certificates. Citations issued.

headline: Storage and cleaning issues; allergen proof needed
summary: Utensils stored over hand sink, soiled linens uncovered, milk crates used for elevation, foil liner under grease trap, dirty microwaves, and excessive grease under deep fryer. Proof of allergen training needed for all three certified managers. Passed.

headline: Blocked handwashing sink; corrected on site
summary: Kitchen prep handwashing sink was blocked with a cutting board, plates and spoons; manager removed items during inspection. Citation issued. Also no hair restraints, wiping cloths on prep tables, leaking faucet, and missing food handler proof.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; cooler tagged, food discarded
summary: Steam-table soup at 120.4°F and chicken at 69.5°F. Cold food at 53–58°F in prep cooler; about 40 lbs discarded. Prep cooler tagged and held until reinspection. Also improper thawing, debris, leaking faucet.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan; several fixes needed
summary: No procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; required items include gloves, face masks, disposable mops and norovirus-killing sanitizer. Backflow device not located at mop sink; door not self-closing; no visible thermometer in reach-in cooler.

headline: Black and pink slime in ice machine
summary: Black and pink slime residue at the top inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used by customers. Also a torn cooler gasket, black mold-like caulk at the rinse sink, and a leaking three-compartment sink faucet. Citation issued.

headline: Black mold-like residue on potato slicer
summary: Potato slicer had food debris buildup and a black mold-like substance; cleaning ordered and citation issued. One employee lacked a food handler certificate. No visible thermometer in upright cooler. Also a split wall, dirty floors, and dirty buckets.

headline: Pork held at 46°F; 30 lbs discarded
summary: Pork inside the walk-in cooler measured 46°F. Manager immediately and voluntarily discarded 30 lbs (about $100). Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Passed; cleaning and repairs needed
summary: Passed. Upper interior of large ice machine needs cleaning. Cold-water faucet knob at exposed handsink by ice cream freezer needs repair. Unused customer washroom needs cleaning and clutter removed. Vent above large oven needs cleaning.

headline: Leaking drainpipe under sink
summary: Passed. Leaking drainpipe under the 3-compartment sink in rear prep area needs repair and maintenance.

headline: Leaking sink; uncorrected prior violations
summary: Employee prepared food without a hair restraint. Leaking faucet base at 3-compartment sink must be repaired. Prior violations uncorrected: dirty shelving and grease trap, unsealed raw wood, water-damaged ceiling tiles, unused coolers and freezers, and no allergen training.

headline: Cold food too warm; chemical mislabeled
summary: Cooked pasta in walk-in cooler and 2-door cooler held at 45–50°F; cold food must be 41°F or below. An unlabeled blue chemical bottle, later labeled as glass cleaner. Broken freezer gasket in basement. Citation issued.

headline: Rodent droppings in employee restroom
summary: About 30 mouse droppings on the floor of the employee restroom near the rear exit. Additional pest control service needed; citation issued. Also cardboard used as liners on food prep equipment, food debris, and no food handler training proof.

headline: No hot running water in men's restroom
summary: Men's restroom handwashing sink had no hot water; readings were 70–76°F, but at least 100°F is required. Manager instructed to repair. Women's restroom lacked a covered trash receptacle.

headline: Garbage cans without lids in restrooms
summary: Restroom garbage receptacles have no lids. Floors inside electrical unit rooms and along wall bases need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food stored on floors
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Food stored on floors in walk-in cooler and freezer, grease and debris on equipment and walls, a ceiling in poor repair, duct tape on sink pipes, and no food handler certificates on site.

headline: No valid city certificate; broken thermometers
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed with conditions. No valid original City of Chicago certificate or certified manager on site while pork and fish were prepared; citation issued. Broken freezer thermometer, cardboard shelf liners, greasy fryers, rusty walk-in cooler.

headline: Rodent droppings in five areas; citation issued
summary: Evidence of rodent activity: about 20–30 droppings each in five areas, including dry storage shelves, under the customer counter and under the 3-compartment sink. Pest control service recommended. Also 3 of 6 food handlers lacked training proof.

headline: Hot food below safe temperature; discarded
summary: Chicken puffs at 100–115°F, veggie rolls at 97.5–105°F and veggies at 84–93°F held under a hot lamp. Hot food must stay at 135°F and above. Food discarded. Also no hair restraints and a bearded employee without a beard restraint.

headline: No certified manager during raw seafood prep
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on duty while raw fish, tuna and other ready-to-eat seafood were prepared, handled and served. The certified manager must be on site at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Door sweep needed; cleaning and leak repairs
summary: Passed. Rear exit door needs a new door sweep to be rodent-proofed. Ice machine interior, reach-in cooler sides, front bar floor drain, and hood filters need cleaning. Leaking ice bin needs repair. Ice scoop must be stored in a clean container.

headline: Grease, debris, and grease trap smell
summary: Passed. Interior of reach-in prep coolers, exterior doors of walk-in freezer and cooler, floors under heavy equipment, and washroom need detailed cleaning. Smell from grease trap. Hood above cooking equipment needs grease removed.

headline: Missing window and rear door screens
summary: Sliding window above display case has no screen, and the rear door needs a screen or flaps. Windows and other openings must be kept in good repair to keep pests out. Passed.

headline: Door gaps, milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom of the front entrance door and along the rear exit must be sealed to keep pests out. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced; raw wood shelves need sealing or paint.

headline: Loose sink handles and dirty floors
summary: Handsink handles are loose and the faucet splatters, making hand washing harder. Floors under the 3-compartment sink and around the soda dispenser need cleaning. Passed.

headline: No employee health policy; no test kit
summary: No written employee health policy on premises. No chemical test kit for sanitizer at 3-compartment sink and low-temperature dishwasher. Food handler without certificate. Women's washroom lacks self-closing door and covered sanitary receptacle. No allergen training for certified manager.

headline: Sink backs up; food stored in furnace room
summary: Water backs up into the first and third basins when the second basin drains; must be repaired. Food stored in rear furnace room, a prior uncorrected violation. Missing and stained ceiling tiles and openings in walls. Citation issued.

headline: No vomit spill kit; leaking three-compartment sink
summary: No vomit and diarrhea spill kit or cleanup procedure. Three-compartment sink leaks heavily at the drainpipe. Broken dumpster lid, unlabeled seasoning containers, a scoop used in bean container, and no food handler training proof. Citations issued.

headline: No handwashing signs; bulk food unlabeled
summary: Handwashing sinks at preparation areas have no signage. Bulk food including flour and sugar is not labeled. Manager must provide signs and labels. No other findings listed.

headline: Cleaning needed on shelves and walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. Shelves in the first-floor WIC area need debris and spills removed. Walls, ceilings and floors in the basement and first-floor walk-in coolers need cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: Re-inspection passed; hand sinks and training
summary: Re-inspection passed. Low hot water pressure at restroom hand sinks and slow drain at men's sink must be repaired. Missing meat display thermometer, written sanitizing procedure for oversized pots, backflow device at ice machine, and food handler training for some employees.

headline: No certified manager; rice lacked discard dates
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No certified manager on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared and served. Cooked rice held over 24 hours without discard dates. Missing hair restraint, food handler certificates, and sink drainage repair.

headline: Missing oyster tags; warm food; pet dogs inside
summary: Live oysters lacked shellfish tags. Chicken at 44–54°F and other cold food at 44–51°F in prep cooler; cooked potatoes 56°F. Customers brought pet dogs inside. About 50 live flying insects near sinks and in prep area; pest control needed.

headline: Re-inspection passed; door gaps and floor tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom and middle of front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Missing floor tiles and grout in prep and dishwashing areas; dusty ceiling vents; a certified manager without allergen training.

headline: Rodent droppings; drinks stored under sewage pipe
summary: About 40 rodent droppings: 20 in dry storage room, 10 on basement shelf, and 10 behind ice machine and freezer in food prep. Pest control service recommended. Canned drinks stored under a basement sewage pipe; stained cutting boards. Citation issued.

headline: Rear door gap; exposed caulk and raw flooring
summary: Passed. Damaged weather-strip and a 1/4-inch gap along the rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. Exposed foam caulk in restroom and raw unfinished wood flooring in rear need sealing or covering.

headline: Cold food held at 49–50°F; discarded
summary: Eggs, steak, chicken and carnitas held at 48.9–50°F in a 4-door prep cooler; about 10 lbs ($120) discarded. Cooler air at 49°F must be repaired to 41°F or below. Also torn gaskets, dusty condensers, and no ventilation in employee washroom.

headline: Passed re-inspection; hair restraint and storage issues
summary: Re-inspection passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint while preparing food. Boxes stored on utility closet floor. Damaged floor tiles, ceiling holes, peeling paint, and a soiled floor under a sink.

headline: No hot water; failed re-inspection
summary: Re-inspection failed. No hot water throughout premises; 3-compartment sink water at 70°F. Must provide hot water above 110°F at 3-compartment sink and above 100°F at handwashing sinks; citation issued. No food handler or allergen training certificates.

headline: Passed; floor storage and grease issues
summary: Re-inspection passed. Hand soap and paper towels were at a food prep sink and must be moved. Bulk dry food and single-use items stored directly on basement floor. Grease and dried debris under deep fryers must be cleaned.

headline: Door gaps and missing handwashing signs
summary: Passed. 1/4-inch gaps at the overhead and front entrance doors must be sealed against pests. Missing handwashing signs, self-closing washroom door device, covered waste receptacle, and working washroom ventilation. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Food uncovered and on floors; training missing
summary: Food stored uncovered in walk-in freezer and on floors in walk-in cooler and by 3-compartment sink. Food in plastic grocery bags. No proof of food handler training. No allergen certificate for certified manager. Clutter, missing ceiling tile, and dirty vents.

headline: No certified manager; no person in charge
summary: No person in charge on site at inspection. Food handlers prepared and sold foods that must be kept hot or cold without the certified manager, who arrived 40 minutes later. Also dirty wiping cloths, cardboard shelf liners, icy freezer, cluttered floors. Citations issued.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; overflowing dumpster
summary: No chlorine sanitizer testing device for the low-temperature dishwasher. Outside dumpster overflowing with trash, lid not tightly closed. Soiled mop heads not hung properly; manager instructed to hang them to prevent insect breeding. Citation issued.

headline: Missing rear screen; no cooler thermometers
summary: Re-inspection passed. No ambient air thermometer inside coolers. Incorrect license number on both sides of the truck. No screen on the rear door. Facility must provide and maintain these items.

headline: Soiled knife rack and clothing; passed
summary: Passed. Knife storage rack visibly soiled with food debris and residue. Both employees wore visibly soiled outer clothing during food prep. Debris on floors along walls and under 3-compartment sink.

headline: Cooked ready-to-eat food held past 7-day limit
summary: Cooked chili, sliced deli meat and cooked chorizo in walk-in cooler were held past the 7-day limit. Prep dates were 3/15 and 3/20. Cooked ready-to-eat food can be held for a maximum of 7 days. Citation issued.

headline: Blocked handwashing sink fixed on return visit
summary: Rear dishroom handwashing sink was blocked by stored chemicals, so hands could not be washed. Shelf was removed on return visit (2-6-2024), making the sink accessible. Also missing food handler and allergen training certificates.

headline: Debris in washroom vanity; damaged floor tiles
summary: Debris found inside a washroom vanity cabinet, and damaged floor tiles in the sales area. Manager instructed to clean the cabinet and repair or replace tiles so floors are smooth and cleanable.

headline: Passed re-inspection; training gaps remain
summary: Re-inspection passed. Pizza prep cutting board has deep grooves and dark stains. Multiple employees lack food handler training; they must complete it and keep records on site at all times.

headline: No hot water, health policy, or pest logbook
summary: No employee health policy and no pest control logbook on site. No hot water throughout; sink readings 53–60°F, below required minimums. No allergen training on site. Also missing date marks on ready-to-eat food.

headline: Improper thawing and door gap found; passed
summary: Two frozen food items were thawed in the three-compartment sink, an improper method. A small opening at the bottom of the front door must be rodent-proofed. Microwave interior had food splatter. Passed.

headline: Floor spills in prep and bar areas
summary: Spills found on floors in prep and bar areas. Manager instructed to clean and maintain. Passed.

headline: No spill cleanup procedure, no pest logbook
summary: No procedure or spill kit for vomit and diarrhea cleanup. No handwashing sink easily accessible in front prep areas. No pest control logbook on premises. Citations issued for the cleanup and pest logbook.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing sink inaccessible
summary: No certified manager on site while hamburgers were prepared. Rear handwashing sink was inaccessible; its floor drain backs up when the sink runs. Grease and food debris in fryers, on floors and walls. Citations issued.

headline: Missing handwashing sign, menu advisory, and training
summary: No handwashing sign at rear dishwashing sink, no consumer advisory for raw or undercooked food on the menu, leaking drainpipe under 4-compartment sink, and no valid allergen training for certified manager.

headline: Re-inspection passed; raw wood and rust
summary: Re-inspection passed. Raw wood surfaces behind the front counter and rust deposits inside a reach-in cooler must be sealed or removed. Floors and floor drain under the 3-compartment sink need cleaning.

headline: Rodent droppings, no certified manager, multiple violations
summary: About 40 rodent droppings in basement dry storage; extra pest control ordered. No certified food manager on site during food prep. Also no thermometers in prep coolers, grinder debris, burnt-out light, expired allergen training.

headline: Food debris under shelving and equipment
summary: Food debris found under shelving and behind equipment. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain the area. Passed.

headline: No handwashing sinks in beverage and bar areas
summary: Re-inspection failed: no exposed handwashing sinks in the beverage area or bar. Manager instructed to install them for employee use. No citation issued.

headline: Passed; floor storage and cleaning issues
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Food stored on walk-in cooler floor, soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, pizza boxes on floor, damaged freezer gaskets, worn cutting board, leaking faucet, food spills and debris.

headline: Door gaps and hole; dust and debris found
summary: Passed. Front door center needs sealing and the left door has a hole; both must be repaired to keep pests out. Dusty vents and floors with food debris, missing restroom vent cover, water-stained ceiling tiles, and unprotected walk-in cooler light.

headline: Wet floors in dishwashing area
summary: Passed. Dishwashing area floors need cleaning, and standing water must be removed. Manager instructed to correct and maintain.

headline: Fish held too warm; cleanliness violations
summary: Cooked fish held at 112.8–113.5°F in a turned-off toaster oven; discarded. Drinks in open cups in sushi prep. Food stored on floors, cardboard used as liners, and soiled curtains. No food handler training proof; prior violations not corrected.

headline: Re-inspection passed; several repairs needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Required fixes include a gap at the front door (pest entry), missing splash guard, unlabeled containers, greasy fryers and hood, missing sump pump lid, loose wall panel, and no food handler or allergen training shown.

headline: No pest logbook, no refrigeration, no thermometer
summary: No working cold-holding equipment or refrigeration on premises. No metal stem thermometer for checking delivered food. No bodily fluid spill kit or cleanup procedure. No current pest control logbook or pest inspection reports. Priority violations cited.

headline: Opening at entrance doors; dirty hood
summary: Re-inspection passed. An opening is in the middle of the double entrance doors and must be sealed. The men's washroom hand sink is not working. Food debris is under barista and holding equipment, and hood lights and filters need attention.

headline: Summary report not displayed
summary: The 2019 inspection summary was not visible to the public. Today's summary was issued and posted for public view. A citation was issued.

headline: Employee washroom door not self-closing
summary: Passed. The employee washroom door has no self-closing device. Management was instructed to install one.

headline: Ham, eggs and cheese held above safe temperatures
summary: Sliced ham was at 45.3°F inside a cold holding unit. Shelled eggs sat on the counter at 57.9°F, and sliced cheese was at 48°F. About 10 lbs were discarded. Food handler certificates were missing for employees.

headline: Mop sink too close to dish rack
summary: Mop sink is too close to the clean dish rack. The operator was instructed to install a barrier between them.

headline: Failed re-inspection with repeat violations
summary: No proof of food handler training for required employees. Stored items were on floors, a floor drain cover and tile were broken, washroom ventilation was inoperable, and earlier violations, including the raw-food menu disclosure, were not corrected.

headline: Leaking sinks; cardboard and grease buildup
summary: No ambient thermometer in the hot-hold unit. Cardboard is used on shelves and floors and must be removed. Hand sinks in the hot food and raw meat prep areas leak, and grease is built up behind equipment and on filters.

headline: No handwashing signs; freezer fans iced over
summary: Re-inspection passed. Exposed hand sinks at the first-floor bar, food prep area and second-floor bar lack handwashing signs. Basement walk-in freezer fans have heavy ice buildup and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Undated cooked chicken; no handwashing signs
summary: Cooked chicken in the walk-in cooler had no date markings. Discard dates are required for TCS foods held over 24 hours. Restrooms lack handwashing signs, mops and brooms were stored in food prep areas, and pooling water was found in a cooler light fixture.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings; no sanitation certificate
summary: No valid sanitation certificate was posted while TCS food was prepared. About 30 rat droppings were found behind the counter, under the pizza oven and under sinks, plus about 30 mouse droppings in a washroom. Two live house flies were on prep tables.

headline: No health policy or vomit procedure
summary: No employee health policy or written vomit and diarrhea procedure was on site. A covered trash receptacle is missing in the restroom. Fryer sides have grease, and the sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Employee eating near exposed food
summary: A food employee was eating in the main grill line where exposed food is stored. A designated eating area is required. Encrusted grease is on grill and stove surfaces, and dry food debris has built up under equipment and shelving.

headline: Grocery bags used to cover hot-held food
summary: Re-inspection passed. Plastic grocery bags covered food in the hot-holding unit near the grill and must be replaced with proper covers. The three-door cooler lacks an ambient thermometer, and some handlers lack hair restraints or beard guards.

headline: No certified manager; hot dogs and chicken served
summary: No certified food manager was on site and no certificate was posted while hot dogs and cooked chicken were served. Refrigeration units and sinks were cleaned, but floors are sticky in the rear prep area and unclean in the front store area.

headline: Plates stored upright; leaking faucet
summary: Serving plates and bowls on shelves were not stored properly and must be inverted to prevent dust. A leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Pest devices above open food containers
summary: Re-inspection passed. Pest control devices in rear storage are installed directly above open food containers and must be relocated. Aluminum foil lines a wall shelf, and a panini press has heavy grease buildup. The outdoor grease bin is soiled.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; floors need cleaning
summary: Re-inspection passed. No handwashing sign at a hand sink near the three-compartment sink. Floors in prep and dishwashing areas, including behind heavy equipment, need cleaning to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Raw beef in standing water at 69.9°F
summary: Raw ground beef was stored in standing water on a sink drainboard at 69.9°F, and about 10 lbs were discarded. A pot of beef was thawing in still water and staff were instructed on proper thawing. A sink stopper is missing.

headline: Milk crates used for storage; torn gasket
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. Milk crates are used for elevation and must be replaced with proper shelving, since they create pest hiding places. A torn gasket on a prep refrigerator and dusty ceiling fans also need attention.

headline: Only one restroom; cooler at 51°F
summary: The premises has only one toilet room. A two-door reach-in cooler at 51°F was tagged and must not be used until repaired. The ice machine lacks a backflow device, and the menu lacks a raw or undercooked food advisory.

headline: Spoiled chicken found; cooler tomatoes too warm
summary: About 1.5 lbs of spoiled, rancid-smelling chicken was discarded. Sliced tomatoes and cheese were above 64°F in the prep cooler. The operator bought and provided paper towels on site. No pest control log was on site.

headline: Utensils in stagnant water; deli cups misused
summary: Passed. In-use utensils were stored in stagnant room-temperature water. Deli cups were not air-dried after washing and were used as scoops for bulk food. Staff were told to correct each practice.

headline: No certified manager; dogs inside bar
summary: No sanitation certificate was posted while frozen pizzas were cooked and served. Two customers brought pet dogs into the bar; only service animals are allowed. No food handler certificates were shown, and a 2019 inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Unlabeled sugar container
summary: A large food container of sugar has no common-name label. Bulk and working food containers must be labeled with contents when not in original packaging.

headline: Beard restraints needed; cooler leaking
summary: Multiple male food handlers had no beard restraints. Worn caulking was found between the wall and tomato prep hand sink. A condenser leak is causing water to collect in the bottom of a storage cooler in the prep area.

headline: Stained ceiling tiles in kitchen prep area
summary: Ceiling tiles in the kitchen food prep area are stained. The operator must replace them and keep them maintained.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea response procedures
summary: No procedures or supplies exist for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events; the operator was instructed to provide them. Food and drinks were stored on the floor in rear storage, and ice cream freezer has spills and ice buildup.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; condensate drains to bucket
summary: The ice bin interior needs cleaning, and ice must be removed before cleaning. Condensate water from the basement ice machine drains into a plastic bucket and must go to a floor drain or other proper plumbing.

headline: Unlabeled containers and worn cooler gaskets
summary: Re-inspection passed. Storage containers, shakers and squeeze bottles must be labeled when not in original packaging. Worn gaskets, a missing cooler handle, and grease and debris buildup under fryers and in the walk-in freezer need correction.

headline: Slime dripping into ice from ice machine
summary: Blackish-pink slime was found in the ice machine reservoir and dripping into the ice bin. It must be cleaned and sanitized. Bulk foods are unlabeled, and food is stored under waste water pipes. Citation issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; shellstock tags incomplete
summary: Dish machine reached only 140°F final utensil temperature, but 160°F is required. A technician serviced it on site. Shellstock tags lacked sold-by dates, and wastewater from the three-compartment sink floods the floor.

headline: Mouse droppings and flies; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager was on site. About 30 or more mouse droppings were found in food prep, storage and washroom areas, and about 5 flies in dining and prep areas. Pest control was recommended.

headline: Flies throughout prep areas; no certified manager
summary: No certified manager with valid certificate was on site while milk, eggs and sausage were prepared. About 45 live flies were found throughout prep areas, on counters and syrups, and must be eliminated. No food handler certificates were on site. Citation issued.

headline: No backflow device on mop sink faucet
summary: Passed. The mop sink faucet has no visible backflow preventer and one must be installed. Employee handwashing signage is missing at the main prep and dishwashing hand sink.

headline: Missing thermometers; burnt-out light bulbs
summary: Re-inspection passed. Visible working thermometers are needed in the walk-in cooler and pizza prep cooler. Wiping cloths are on prep tables, frozen meats are in plastic bags, and personal belongings are stored in food areas. Light bulbs are burnt out.

headline: Cooler at 50°F; no food inside
summary: A two-door cooler measured 50°F and must be 41°F or below. No TCS foods were in the cooler, so it was tagged without a citation. Rusted racks in the basement walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced.

headline: Ice machine residue; oversized items
summary: Residue was found on the ice machine interior panel and must be cleaned. Large containers and cutting boards do not fit the three-compartment sink, so an alternative washing method or larger sink is required.

headline: Dairy held at 58°F; about 20 lbs discarded
summary: Milk and liquid creamer in a refrigeration unit were at 58°F, but must be 41°F or below. Manager discarded about 20 lbs of dairy. A minor pipe leak by the CO2 tanks and toilet paper on the women's washroom floor also noted.

headline: Prior allergen violation still uncorrected
summary: A core violation for allergen training remains uncorrected from earlier reports. Managers must obtain the training or more citations will follow. Also noted: spills in the rear prep cooler and dusty vent and ceiling tiles.

headline: Hands not washed; roaches and mouse droppings
summary: An employee touched food after rubbing his nose without washing, and another picked food off the floor. Both were corrected on site. Staff found a live roach, dead roaches, rodent activity and over 50 mouse droppings in the kitchen. Citation issued.

headline: No health policy; no vomit kit on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and the person in charge could not produce a vomit kit or response procedure. Both must be provided with norovirus-effective supplies. No citation was issued.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; no certified manager
summary: No certified manager was on site while yogurt, cantaloupe and pico were prepared. Several cold foods were between 48 and 76°F and were discarded. No sanitizer test strips or pest control records were available. Citations issued.

headline: No allergen training certificate on site
summary: No allergen training certificate was on site. The operator must provide allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: Person in charge lacks certificate
summary: The person in charge does not have a City of Chicago food service manager certificate. One must be obtained and kept on site. No citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager; door gap and worn equipment
summary: No person in charge or valid sanitation certificate holder was on site. A 1/4-inch gap was found at the rear door, sanitizer test kit was missing, and food debris and rust were present. Urinal leak and damaged ceilings also noted.

headline: Slimy ice machine interior; ice to be discarded
summary: Ice machine interior was heavily soiled with black and gray slime dripping onto ice used for drinks. Manager was told to discard the ice and clean the machine. Citation issued. Other issues included a missing cooler thermometer and food stored on the floor.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; standing water
summary: A three-door refrigerator has food debris on its doors and handles, and cooking equipment has food and grease debris. Floors under the cooking line have grease, debris and standing water. Staff were instructed to clean all of these.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and improper storage
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at the front bar and basement women's washroom. Wiping cloths and ice scoops sit on ice bins, and single-use items are on the floor. Ceiling tiles are water-damaged and washroom ventilation is not working.

headline: Missing and expired allergen certificates
summary: Some food allergen training certificates for City of Chicago certified food managers were missing or expired. Valid certificates must be kept on premises.

headline: Tagged cold unit still in use at 65.8°F
summary: A cold hold unit tagged for inspection was in use at 65.8°F. Staff must repair it and not store TCS foods such as tomatoes and cheese in it until reinspection. Alternative unit is in use. Walk-in cooler floor is damaged. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; gap at front door
summary: Person in charge lacks a sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site while chicken was prepared. A 1/4-inch gap at the front door must be sealed. A bearded food handler had no beard guard, and one handler lacked a certificate.

headline: No probe thermometer for food temperatures
summary: No metal-stem probe thermometer was on site to check hot and cold food temperatures. A priority violation citation was issued. Aluminum foil lines the beverage cooler and must be replaced, and the basement hand sink drains slowly.

headline: No sanitation manager; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: No sanitation manager was on site during chicken prep. Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Walk-in cooler held chickpeas at 50.2°F and soup at 50.8°F; 63 lbs discarded. No vomit kit or allergen certificate.

headline: Espresso machines lack backflow devices
summary: A core violation from June 2024 was not corrected. The espresso coffee machines at counter areas have no backflow prevention device. The operator must show where they can be located and serviced.

headline: Peeling paint near soda syrup dispenser
summary: Re-inspection passed. White peeling paint was found on a basement wall near the soda syrup dispenser. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: New employees lack food handler certificates
summary: New employees were working without food handler certification. They must obtain it and provide proof on site at all times.

headline: About 30 flying insects; unauthorized dog
summary: About 30 live small flying insects and 3 house flies were on walls and ceilings in produce prep and the meat walk-in cooler. Additional pest control service is needed. A citation was also issued for a non-service dog in the store.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; prep table lacks legs
summary: Several handwashing sinks lack signage. A food prep table in the rear kitchen is missing legs and is not sealed to the floor. Nonfood-contact surfaces of cooking equipment are heavily soiled with dust and grease.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water
summary: No certified food manager was on premises while rice and chicken were prepared. Sinks had no running hot water and measured 72.5°F, though 100°F minimum is required at hand sinks. Mop sink lacks a visible backflow device.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Several food handler certificates and manager allergen certificates have expired. Citations will follow if they are not renewed. Also noted: raw plywood shelving, a dirty basement storage area, a dirty grill filter and a missing garbage can lid.

headline: Leaking pipes under three-compartment sink
summary: A leak was found at the bottom pipes of the three-compartment sink. The manager was instructed to repair it and keep it maintained.

headline: Greasy fryers and broken floor tiles
summary: Fryer interiors and exteriors have grease, dirt and food buildup. Broken floor tiles are in front of cooking equipment and the three-compartment sink, and wall tiles near the rear door are missing. Expired allergen certificates for certified managers.

headline: Gaps at rear door; expired allergen certificate
summary: The rear exit door is not sealed on its sides, creating a possible pest entry point. Deep freezer has ice buildup. A certified manager's allergen certificate is expired, and more citations will follow if not corrected.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; rusty storage racks
summary: Re-inspection passed. No handwashing sign at an exposed rear prep sink. Rusty storage racks in the basement walk-in cooler must have rust removed and be kept smooth and cleanable.

headline: Mineral buildup in ice machine; beard restraint
summary: Mineral buildup was found in the ice machine water reservoir and must be cleaned and sanitized. An employee with a beard was not wearing a restraint. Milk crates cannot be used for elevation and more sink stoppers are needed.

headline: Wiping cloths and food handler certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Prep-area wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution between uses. No proof of food handler certificates was found for required employees.

headline: No hand soap at prep sink; no hair restraints
summary: Passed with conditions. The prep-area hand sink had no hand soap, a priority foundation violation. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Staff were instructed to comply.

headline: Rodent droppings; open food area lacks handsink
summary: No handsink is accessible to the front open food area. About 50 mouse droppings were behind the water heater and under dry storage racks. A cooler at 51.1°F tagged for repair. Food at 44-48°F was discarded, and pest control is needed.

headline: Coving detached; splash guard loose
summary: Re-inspection passed. Minor grease was in the fryer interior and must be cleaned. Coving has detached under a basement dry storage shelf, and a splash guard at the prep hand sink is detached. Both must be repaired.

headline: No handwashing sink at main prep line
summary: No handwashing sink is located at the main prep line. One must be installed with hot and cold running water. The toilet room door is not self-closing, unused equipment is stored outside, and a hood light is not working.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; discarded on site
summary: Coleslaw, elote, cut cucumber, carrots and chickpeas/feta were held at 55-60°F instead of 41°F or below. Priority violation. Manager voluntarily discarded 13 lbs (about $565).

headline: Frozen chicken thawing on prep table
summary: Frozen chicken was thawing on a food prep table. Staff were told to thaw under cold running water, in the refrigerator or in the microwave. Soiled wiping cloths and mop heads were stored improperly, and food debris is on equipment and floors.

headline: Hole in outside dumpster
summary: Re-inspection passed. The outside garbage dumpster has a hole and must be repaired.

headline: Pink residue in drink dispenser; sink backs up
summary: Re-inspection passed. Pink buildup was in drink dispenser guns and holders and must be cleaned and sanitized. The utility sink backs up with dirty mop water and must drain properly. Debris under bar areas needs cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy; food on floor
summary: No employee health policy was on premises. Menu lacks a consumer advisory for raw sushi. Employees were not wearing hair restraints, and items were stored on the floor in the rear kitchen. The utility sink lacks a backflow device and a ceiling tile is water-damaged.

headline: Rusty prep shelves; open oyster sauce can
summary: Rusty metal prep shelves and a rusty grease box under the three-compartment sink must be repainted or replaced. Oyster sauce from an open can must be moved into a food-grade container in the walk-in cooler.

headline: No certified manager; hair restraints missing
summary: No certified food manager was on site when inspectors arrived while the facility was open. Staff were not wearing hair restraints, wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and the ice machine interior was stained. Citation issued.

headline: Eggs left at room temperature; 30 lbs discarded
summary: About 15 dozen eggs were at 56.3-58.1°F in the rear prep area. The manager discarded about 30 lbs ($70). Cold TCS foods must stay at 41°F or below. Bulk ingredients are unlabeled and shelves have rust.

headline: Openings at dock and entrance doors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Openings were found at the base of the dumpster dock door and at the entrance doors, and all must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Non-food items are stored on the floor and a sanitizer drain pipe is leaking.

headline: Walk-in cooler and freezer floors need cleaning
summary: The floors of the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer need detail cleaning. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain both units.

headline: Food on freezer floor; allergen training missing
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer and must be raised six inches. Shelving is rusty, grout is missing and floor tiles are damaged in dishwashing and utility areas. No allergen training is available for managers.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager was on premises while rice and corn were prepared. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. Large holes in both washroom walls must be sealed, and one manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Gap in rear door; no food handler training
summary: Re-inspection passed. A gap in the center of the rear double doors must be made tight-fitting. A splash guard is needed at the hand sink, and debris must be cleaned from walk-in cooler pop sleeves. Employees lack food handler training.

headline: Handwashing sign missing at banquet sink
summary: The hand sink next to the two-compartment sink in the banquet kitchen needs handwashing signage.

headline: No certified manager at start of inspection
summary: No certified sanitation manager was on duty when time-controlled foods were being handled. The manager arrived about 9:05 AM, and a citation was issued. Other issues include unlabeled containers, unsanitary wiping cloths, a leaking drainpipe and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: About 20 live flying insects; sewage lines overhead
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in the food prep area, washrooms and basement. Additional pest control service is needed. Sewage lines over food and single-use items were not shielded. Citation issued.

headline: Utensils not sanitized; 0 ppm; citation issued
summary: Employee rinsed utensils without sanitizing them, and sanitizer measured 0 ppm. Staff were instructed on proper sink setup. Also: no allergen or food handler training, no raw-food menu advisory, and no sink stoppers.

headline: Dishes not sanitized during manual washing
summary: Staff washed kitchenware but did not sanitize it, and a citation was issued. Staff must set up the three-compartment sink and sanitize by immersion for at least 30 seconds at 50 ppm. Working thermometers are needed inside all cooling units.

headline: Hair restraints missing; floors have droppings
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Floors in corners and under equipment have food, dirt, droppings and debris. Walls and ceilings have grease buildup. Food handler proof and allergen certificates for managers were also missing.

headline: Failed re-inspection; no front hand sink
summary: Large pots do not fit any sink, so a written clean-in-place procedure is required. Storage racks have rust. A prior priority violation was not corrected: no handwashing sink in the front service area. Citation issued.

headline: Frozen chicken thawing in standing water
summary: Bags of frozen chicken were sitting in water in sink compartments. Staff were told to thaw under cool running water, in a microwave, or in the cooler. Fly strips hang over the sink, lime was stored in the ice machine, and several areas need cleaning.

headline: Dead roaches found; food stored on floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dead roaches were found under the dishwasher, on a prep table, on carpet, and under cooking equipment. Two containers of rice were on the floor without lids. Greasy floors and a non-self-closing employee washroom door also noted.

headline: Dead insects in basement storage closets
summary: A variety of dead insects were on the floor of basement storage closets. Staff were told to clean and remove them. A slow-draining upstairs coffee-prep hand sink must be repaired.

headline: No allergen training; soiled mop heads
summary: Re-inspection passed. Fountain drink nozzles and the dish machine interior need detail cleaning. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding. No allergen training was on site; certified managers must complete it and keep records.

headline: No certified manager; bare-hand food contact
summary: No sanitation certificate was posted while beef and toppings were prepared. Cook handled ready-to-eat cheese and cilantro with bare hands. Undated cooked chicken and rice were discarded. Prep sink was blocked. No pest service records were available.

headline: Expired handler certificates; slow hand sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. Expired food handler and allergen training certificates were found. The washroom hand sink drains slowly. Grill exterior and fryer bottoms need cleaning.

headline: Cooked corn thawing at room temperature
summary: Cooked corn was thawing at room temperature on the main prep counter. Staff were told to move it and thaw food under refrigeration or another approved method. Greasy floors and pipes behind fryers need cleaning.

headline: 60 mouse droppings; dead mouse found
summary: Over 60 mouse droppings were on the floor in the rear prep area under and around the cooler. A dead mouse was on a glue board in the office. Pest control service is required before reinspection. Food-contact and nonfood surfaces also need cleaning.

headline: Thermometers and labels needed in coolers
summary: Ice machine interior has mineral buildup. Thermometers must be visible in all coolers, and food containers need common-name labels. Food and nonfood items must be stored six inches off the floor. Food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Prep cooler at 55.7°F; sink has no faucet
summary: A reach-in prep cooler measured 55.7°F and must be repaired to hold 41°F or below. The three-compartment sink has no faucet or running water. A hole in prep area floor tiles and missing food handler training records were also noted.

headline: Over-age TCS food discarded; certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: TCS items including sauces, pastrami, and grilled onions were dated 3/7/2026 to 3/24/2026, beyond the seven-day limit, and about 40 lb ($200) was discarded on site; a citation was issued. Employee personal items were stored above food, and shrimp was thawing in room-temperature water. A certified manager lacked allergen training. Passed with conditions.

headline: Restroom has no ventilation
summary: The restroom has no ventilation. The business was instructed to install it. Passed.

headline: Sewage backup and missing certificate; manager fixed drain
summary: No valid sanitation certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. Wastewater backed up onto the floor from the three-compartment sink drain; the manager fixed it during the inspection. Soiled mop heads were not properly stored, and no allergen training was on site. Passed with conditions.

headline: Hand sinks lack hot water; drain pipe runs into sink
summary: Hand sinks in both customer restrooms do not reach the required water temperature of at least 100F; a priority citation was issued. A drainage pipe runs into the hand sink at the rear bar and must be rerouted or covered. Failed.

headline: No working toilet; missing certificates; prior violations unfixed
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. No pest control log book was provided, and a citation was issued. No working toilet was on site, and the locked second washroom must be opened. Prior violations were not corrected, including missing food handler and allergen training certificates. Failed.

headline: Gaps under doors and a leaky toilet handle
summary: Gaps along the side and front doors could let insects in, so the doors must fit tightly. No insects were found. A toilet handle in the women's restroom leaks and must be repaired, and floor grout in prep and bar areas needs repair. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Rusty, dirty shelving; food manager lacks allergen training
summary: Shelving inside the walk-in cooler was rusty and not clean. The city sanitation certificate holder had no allergen training. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; bare-hand food contact and hand-washing violations
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager was on site while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared. An employee served ready-to-eat food with bare hands, and staff washed hands in the prep sink. Dishes were washed without sanitizer, which the manager corrected immediately. Clutter and flour buildup were also noted. Passed with conditions.

headline: No food handler or allergen certificates on premises
summary: No food handler certificates were on premises, and the manager was told all food handlers must have them with employee names. No allergen training certificates were present for city certified food managers. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No city certified manager was on site while chicken, fish, shrimp, and burgers were prepared, and a citation was issued. There was no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure. Three food handlers washed hands in the food sinks. About 35 lb of cooked chicken wings and fish held at 70-82F were discarded. Passed with conditions.

headline: Person in charge lacks sanitation certificate; ice contaminated
summary: The person in charge had no city sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate was posted. Black slime was dripping into ice from two ice machines, which was a citation. A front door gap of 1/4 to 1/2 inch needs repair. Other items included missing food handler and allergen certificates. Failed.

headline: No temperature indicator for high-temperature dish machine
summary: No irreversible temperature indicator was on the premises to check dish surface temperature in the high-temperature dish machine. Management was told to provide one. A citation was issued. Failed.

headline: Repeat allergen training violation remains uncorrected
summary: A core violation from June 2025 was not corrected: no certified food manager had allergen training. The business must provide documentation, and a citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Openings at rear door; no food handler training shown
summary: Openings at the base and top of the rear exit door from the prep area must be sealed to prevent pests; no pests were found. No proof of food handler training was provided for any handler, and no allergen training certificates were shown. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Food debris, ice scoop storage, missing backflow device
summary: Heavy food and grease debris was found under the flattop grill and inside the fryer, and a brownish substance was on the ice machine panel. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer, and an ice scoop was stored in the ice bin with its handle down. Food bags were on the floor, and the ice machine lacks a findable backflow device. Staff were told to correct each item. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Outdated inspection summary still posted
summary: The most recent inspection summary was not posted for public view; an older summary from 10/22/25 was still posted. The business was instructed to always post the latest summary, and a citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Grease and debris in fryer and on equipment
summary: Grease and food debris were inside the deep fryer oil filtering unit and on cooking equipment, coolers, and shelves. Cardboard was used as a floor liner in prep areas and must be removed. Heavy dirt and grease are on walls and floors along the hot food line. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Milk crates used for elevation in basement
summary: Milk crates were used to elevate containers in the basement storage area and must be replaced. Adequate shelving must be provided to raise all food and nonfood items at least six inches off the floor. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Dish machine rinse too cool; rat droppings near storage
summary: The high-temperature dish machine's internal rinse read 166F; it must be 180-194F, and a citation was issued. Rat droppings were found inside a linen storage box and around the garbage area, and the business was instructed to clean them. Milk crates were used for elevation and unfinished wood shelving was used. Passed with conditions.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; water leak; no summary posted
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site, a priority citation. A previous core violation for a leak under the three-compartment sink was not corrected, and a citation was issued. The inspection summary was not posted for public view, and a citation was issued. Failed.

headline: Knife stored improperly between uses; plates not inverted
summary: A knife was stored improperly between the prep table and the wall in the prep area. Plates were not inverted and were corrected. Foil covered a storage shelf near the prep line, and a light shield over the prep table needs cleaning. Passed.

headline: Repeat allergen training violation; low water pressure
summary: Low cold water pressure was found at the handwash sink near the dish area. A repeat core violation was not corrected: the sanitation manager still lacked allergen training, and a citation was issued. Worn gaskets, grease, mold on walls, stained ceiling tiles, and burnt-out lights need attention. Passed with conditions.

headline: No person in charge; tofu held over 24 hours; allergen training missing
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certificate holder was on site while tofu was prepared. Ready-to-eat items held over 24 hours were unlabeled, and 33 lb ($176) was voluntarily discarded; this was a citation. A leaking faucet needs repair, and a previous allergen training violation was not corrected. Passed with conditions.

headline: Foil liners and greasy pipes behind cooking equipment
summary: Aluminum foil was used as a liner on a storage rack and the oven exterior and must be removed. Pipes behind the cooking equipment have grease buildup and must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled sugar, open containers, pest-control device above fruit
summary: Brown sugar and other dry ingredients were unlabeled. Milk, sugar, and other dry items were not covered, and an electrical insect control device was stored above fruit and must be moved. The women's restroom receptacle lacks a lid, and handwashing signage was missing. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No service sink; damaged floor and ceiling tiles
summary: The facility has no service sink, and the business was instructed to install one. Floor tiles are missing or damaged throughout the store and toilet room, and ceiling tiles show water damage. Repairs must be kept up. Passed.

headline: No certified manager while sandwiches made; rusted shelving
summary: No city certified food manager was present while TCS sub sandwiches were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. A frozen dessert lacked a manufacturer address. Stainless shelving under the prep table has a hole and rust and must be replaced. Basement prep tables and a deli light fixture need attention. Passed with conditions.

headline: Fruit flies found; shrimp held too warm; sink blocked
summary: About 25 small fruit flies were found, mainly in the second-floor bar area, and a citation was issued. Shrimp tempura was held at 44-46F; management discarded about 5 lb. A prep handwashing sink was blocked by a hose, and a black mold-like substance was behind the ice machine panel. Previous violations were not corrected. Failed.

headline: Small flies throughout; hand sink has no hot or cold water
summary: About 35 small flies were found near the dish area, front and rear prep, and bar, and a citation was issued; pest control consultation is needed. A dish-area hand sink had no hot or cold water, a priority citation. The ice bin interior needs cleaning, and a bar hand sink leaks. Failed.

headline: Ice maker panel won't close; expired certificate
summary: The ice maker is in poor repair and its upper panel cannot close; it must be repaired. A food handler certificate for kitchen staff was expired and must be updated. Passed.

headline: Dish machine rinse too cool; two toilets clogged
