summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager on site while food was served; manager arrived at 10:10 a.m.; citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine; tagged held. Brown rice at 117.1°F in hot-hold unit; about 4 lbs discarded. Hand-wash signage missing.

headline: Failed: 25 live flies; improper waste drainage
summary: Fail. About 25 live flies on walls and inside the four-compartment sink cabinet; pest control and cleaning required; citation issued. Portable sink in the café has no proper wastewater drain; waste drains into containers. Operator must install a proper drain.

headline: Improper thawing corrected; posted report missing
summary: Pass with conditions. Frozen beef pizza was thawed improperly; manager corrected it. An employee lacked a hair restraint; manager provided one. Last inspection summary was not visible to customers; citation issued. Raw wood shelves and a torn cooler gasket noted.

headline: Oversized pots; debris on shelving
summary: Pass. Pots and equipment are too big for the three-compartment sink. Manager was told to create a clean-in-place procedure for them. Light debris buildup on shelving; manager was told to clean it.

headline: Leaking backflow device in prep area
summary: Pass. The backflow prevention device is leaking in the prep area. Operator instructed to have it serviced and maintained.

headline: Missing thermometers; soiled utensil storage
summary: Pass. Several prep coolers lack thermometers. A nylon sheet is used as a barrier between soiled and clean utensils. Old stickers left on utensils during washing. Employee clothing and bags placed on food shelves.

headline: No hair restraints; no food handler certificates
summary: Pass. Food prep employees without hair restraints. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Pots too large for sink and dish machine. Mops not hung to dry. Food handlers have no certificates; certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: No person in charge; expired certificates; food on floor
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge was present. No certified food manager was on duty while food that must be kept hot or cold was prepared; certificates on site were expired; citation issued. Food stored on floors; leaking faucets; managers lack allergen training.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; corrected during inspection
summary: Pass with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine. Manager replaced the chlorine container; by the end of inspection it held 100 ppm. Citation issued. Dust on ceilings; two panini presses need mechanical ventilation.

headline: Failed: no hand-wash water; flies; cold cooler too warm
summary: Fail. Basement hand sink has no running water. Other hand sinks lack soap or paper towels. Prep cooler at 68.9°F; cheese at 53.2°F; cooler tagged. Numerous flying insects in prep, dish, storage, and basement areas; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled packaged desserts; no hair restraints
summary: Pass. Packaged cookies and cake slices in a display case were not properly labeled. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints; they were provided during inspection. Wet wiping cloths left on prep surfaces. Not all food handlers had proof of training.

headline: Front door gap; leaking rear office ceiling
summary: Pass. Front entry doors have an opening at the bottom, in the middle; must be sealed. Leaking ceiling in the rear office; operator instructed to repair it.

headline: Missing thermometer; hair restraint not worn
summary: Pass. Two-door sandwich cooler needs a working, visible thermometer. An employee in the front prep area did not wear a hair restraint while preparing food. Rear hand sink needs more water pressure. Dust on a vent in the employee washroom.

headline: Failed: person in charge lacks certificate; no hot water
summary: Fail. Person in charge lacked a valid certified food manager certificate; district manager brought one during inspection; citation issued. No hot water at one men's room sink or a rear prep sink. Hand-wash signs missing. Previous core violations not corrected.

headline: No certified manager; coolers too warm; food discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager on site while eggs and other food that must be kept hot or cold were prepared; citation issued. Reach-in coolers held food at 56.8 to 68.1°F; about 100 lbs ($200) discarded. Coolers tagged and cannot be used until reinspected.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; leaking sink
summary: Pass. Beige and pink mold-like substance inside the upper ice machine. Ice had to be discarded, and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Live potted plants stored above a cold unit. Leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink. Hood filters greasy.

headline: Offensive odor from grease trap
summary: Pass. Offensive odors are coming from the grease trap. Operator instructed to clean the trap and maintain it.

headline: Food stored on floor; expired handler training
summary: Pass. Cooking equipment stored on the floor. Cardboard used as shelf liner in walk-in cooler and on carts. Food debris and spills in walk-in cooler; wet mops left on floor. Employees could not show food handler training certificates during inspection.

headline: No hand-wash sign; mold-like buildup in walk-in
summary: Pass. No hand-washing signage in the women's washroom. Storage racks inside the walk-in cooler have mold-like buildup; operator instructed to detail clean them.

headline: Ice machine debris; rusty shelves; clutter in basement
summary: Pass. Debris inside the ice machine must be removed. Soft drinks stored under a sink must be raised off the floor. Rusty shelving, a torn refrigerator gasket, and grease on cooking equipment noted. Basement clutter must be cleared to prevent rodent hiding places.

headline: Employee lacks food handler certificate
summary: Pass. One food handling employee had no food handler certificate. Management was told that all food handling employees must show proof of food handler training.

headline: No covered waste receptacle in washroom
summary: Pass. No covered waste receptacle in the unisex washroom. Operator must provide and maintain one.

headline: Failed: flying insects, no sanitizer, warm cold food
summary: Fail. About 25 live small flying insects on walls and equipment in the front bar; pest control needed; citation issued. Dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine. Coleslaw at 44.9°F and chicken chili at 46.5°F; about 10 lbs discarded.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; greasy fryer area
summary: Pass. Bulk ingredients in unlabeled containers on kitchen dry storage racks. Encrusted grease under fryers needs deep cleaning. No covered trash in women's washroom. Clutter, a hole in a basement wall, a cracked wash bowl, and dusty vents noted.

headline: Slow-draining hand sink; dirty stove hood vents
summary: Pass. The washroom hand sink drains slowly and must be corrected. Vents in the hood above the stove need cleaning. All food handlers must obtain food handler training, and all certified managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Double doors have gap at bottom
summary: Pass. Double entrance doors have an approximately 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. Operator must repair them so they fit tightly. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dish area floor drain and floors need cleaning
summary: Pass. Floor drain under the three-compartment sink needs cleaning. Floors in the dish area need cleaning under the sink, around the hot water tank, and in corners.

headline: No certified manager; food held at 49-58°F
summary: Fail. No City of Chicago certified manager on site while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. Chicken, potatoes, and lentils held at 49 to 58°F in reach-in cooler; about 45 lbs ($250) discarded. Cooler at 50°F tagged and held. Expired food handler training.

headline: No paper towels; grease buildup; no allergen training
summary: Pass with conditions. No paper towels at the prep hand sink; staff got some during inspection, but a citation was issued. Grease buildup found on cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelving. Certified food manager lacks allergen training; proof required.

headline: Failed: dead roach in tomatoes; live roaches
summary: Fail. Dead roach found in sliced tomatoes; food discarded. About 8 live roaches on shelving above prep table, and a dead roach in a small cooler. Two large flies in dining area. Pest control recommended; citation issued. Previous core violations not corrected.

headline: Wiping cloths left out; missing hand-washing sign
summary: Pass. Wiping cloths were left on bar and kitchen prep counters instead of in sanitizing solution. Staff were told to store them properly. No hand-washing sign at the main bar hand sink; operator told to provide one.

headline: Raw chicken and beef stored together; food discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Raw chicken and raw beef stored together in one container; about 15 lbs discarded. Eggs and fried chicken held at 61 to 63°F; about 10 lbs discarded. Employees drinking from open cups near food; cigarette butts in break area; citation issued.

headline: Rear door gap; leaking sink faucet; greasy hood
summary: Pass. Rear exit door sweep has a 1/4-inch gap and must be rodent-proofed. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks at the base. Grease buildup on the ventilation hood must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; missing health policy
summary: Fail. No City of Chicago certified manager on site while eggs, yogurt, and shakes were handled; citation issued. Missing employee health policy, vomit cleanup kit, food thermometer, and chlorine test strips. No pest control log. Soap and towels were provided during inspection.

headline: Failed: hot food too cool; no health policy
summary: Fail. Cooked chicken at 52°F, hamburgers at 98°F, and pork at 64°F were below the 135°F hot-holding minimum; food discarded; citation issued. No employee health policy or vomit cleanup procedure. No sanitizer test strips. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed: 45 mouse droppings behind bar
summary: Fail. About 45 mouse droppings found behind the bar and near the ATM. Manager told to remove them, sanitize, and call pest control; citation issued. No certified manager on duty. Kitchen and bar hand sinks had water at 66°F and 67°F; hot water restored during inspection.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings; no health policy
summary: Fail. About 15 to 20 rodent droppings at the hot water tank area; removal and extra pest service required; citation issued. No verifiable employee health policy, food thermometer, or sanitizer test devices on site. Food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Boxes on crate; wall holes; door not self-closing
summary: Pass. Boxes stored on a crate in dry storage must be raised at least six inches. Food debris inside both microwaves and under prep tables. Employee all-gender washroom door is not self-closing. Hole in a dry storage wall; dim prep lighting.

headline: Failed: no approved food safety plan; large leak
summary: Fail. No health-department-approved HACCP plan (food safety plan) or variance for vacuum-sealed meats in walk-in freezer; about 30 lbs ($1,200) tagged and held. Large leak at basement hand sink. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Sink stopper not holding water; no mop hangers
summary: Pass. Sink stopper at the left compartment of the three-compartment sink does not hold water; operator instructed to repair it. No mop hangers provided; operator instructed to install them.

headline: Failed: no paper towels, thermometer, or test strips
summary: Fail. Hand sinks lacked paper towels, and no metal stem thermometer or sanitizer test strips were on site. Citations issued. Also noted: missing hand-wash sign, a leaking pipe under a hand sink, and a dirty hand sink interior.

headline: Food debris in coolers and cabinets; uncovered trash
summary: Pass. Dried food debris inside coolers holding breakfast sandwiches and in storage cabinets. Both unisex restroom trash receptacles lack covers. Food debris under shelving and heavy equipment in the prep area.

headline: Leaking drain pipe; liquor stored on floor
summary: Pass. Single-use items not inverted in prep area. Leaking drain pipe under a hand sink. Liquor stock stored on the floor in back storage; clutter and dust noted, plus debris in corners. Missing light shield in the sandwich cooler.

headline: Food on floor; leaking drain; allergen training missing
summary: Pass. Food stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler must be raised six inches. Leaking drain pipe under rear hand sink. Food debris and spills under equipment and in corners. Two certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Ice buildup in freezers; restroom fan not working
summary: Pass. Thick ice buildup inside ice cream freezers in front of the store. Greasy, dirty walls and conduits in the kitchen. Dirty corners. Water-stained ceiling tiles in front of the store. Restroom ventilation does not work.

headline: Ice machine buildup; leaking prep sink faucet
summary: Pass. The ice machine interior needs detail cleaning to remove buildup. A large can opener needs cleaning. A faucet on the three-compartment prep sink leaks; operator instructed to correct it.

headline: No certified manager; expired food handler certificates
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager on duty with an original certificate; manager showed a college receipt; citation issued. Employees lacked valid food handler certificates. Leaks at two- and three-compartment sinks, a large ceiling hole, and stained cutting boards.

headline: Failed: no certificate; noodles at 120°F
summary: Fail. No City of Chicago sanitation certificate on site while food was handled; citation issued. Chow mein noodles at 120°F in display case were discarded. Front hand sink backs up dirty water from floor drain. Outside garbage area not maintained; citation issued.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; corrected on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Prep-area hand sink had no soap; staff obtained soap during inspection; citation issued. A panel inside the ice machine touching ice had black mold-like substance. Manager removed and cleaned the ice during inspection; citation issued.

headline: Failed: food in open dumpster; leaking faucet
summary: Fail. Compactor removed for maintenance; food discarded in a large outside dumpster without a lid. Citation issued; tight-fitting lids required. Minor leak at three-compartment faucets. Dust and dirt on prep area walls and floors.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; milk crates as shelves
summary: Pass with conditions. No written procedures or supplies for vomiting or diarrhea events; citation issued. Ice scoop stored with its food-contact surface exposed. Milk crates used as shelves with tea containers on top. Food debris and spills on floors and surfaces.

headline: Clutter throughout the facility
summary: Pass. Clutter found throughout the facility. Manager instructed to declutter and remove unnecessary items.

headline: Sinks lack grease interceptor; chipped kitchen paint
summary: Pass. Two three-compartment sinks lack an approved grease interceptor; operator must obtain, install, and maintain one. Chipped paint on kitchen walls near the boba pots and ice machine must be repainted.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; flies; cold food too warm
summary: Fail. No certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Cold foods at 53 to 66°F in display cooler were discarded (about $500). Cooler at 62°F tagged. About 15 small live black flies in prep area. Food handler lacks training certificate.

headline: No certified manager on site; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Pass with conditions. No City of Chicago certified food manager was on the premises; citation issued. Also noted: a leaking sprayer at the three-compartment sink, missing ceiling tiles, missing grout and damaged floor tiles, dusty vents, and no allergen training proof.

headline: Certified managers lack current allergen training
summary: Pass. Certified food managers had expired or no allergen training on site. Operator instructed to complete training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Dust buildup around griddle filters
summary: Pass. Dust has built up around the filters above the griddle. Manager instructed to clean them.

headline: No health policy; food held too hot and too cold
summary: Pass with conditions. No written employee health policy; citation issued. Cooked beef at 118 to 130°F was discarded. Cooked pork, chicken, and chorizo held at 48 to 74°F in a cooler. Tamales cooled improperly; corrected on site. Water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: No certified manager on duty; food stored on floor
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager on duty while food that must be kept hot or cold was handled; citation issued. Food stored on floors and left uncovered in cooler and prep areas, and some containers unlabeled. Food debris and dust buildup throughout.

headline: No certified manager; cooked beef held over 24 hours
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager on duty while beef, chicken, and steak were handled; citation issued. Cooked beef held over 24 hours without a discard date; citation issued. Frozen cheese and hot sauce thawed improperly. Grease and debris around equipment.

headline: Certificate does not match person; wastewater backup
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared; the presented certificate did not match the person on duty; citation issued. Wastewater backed up onto the floor from the three-compartment sink; manager fixed it during inspection; citation issued.

headline: Blocked hand sink; no soap or towels; ice machine drain
summary: Pass with conditions. The rear prep hand sink was blocked by equipment, had no soap, and had no paper towels. Equipment was removed and soap and towels were provided during inspection; citations issued. Ice machine lacks a backflow device and drains into a bucket.

headline: Failed: outdated pest records; no allergen training
summary: Fail. Pest service agreement dated 2005; current service records and license number required. Test strips on site were for quat sanitizer, not the chlorine used. Toilet room lacks lidded receptacle and self-closing door. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Damaged floor tiles and stained dish-area ceiling
summary: Pass. Missing grout and damaged floor tiles in the dish area must be repaired to a smooth, cleanable surface. Missing and stained ceiling tiles in the dish area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: One certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Pass. One of two certified food managers lacks allergen training. Operator instructed to complete the training and keep records on site.

headline: Food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Pass. No food handler training certificates for any food handler. Operator instructed to have those without certificates obtain valid ones.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; flies; food too cool
summary: Fail. No certified food manager on site on arrival; citation issued. Hot tofu and chicken held at 110°F with no time-control record; food reheated to 165°F. More than 15 small flies in the kitchen; pest control recommended; citation issued.

headline: Dust buildup on dish-area ceiling
summary: Pass. Dust has built up on the ceiling in the dish area. Operator instructed to dust and maintain it.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; cracked floor tiles
summary: Pass. Bulk rice, seasoning, and sugar lack name labels. Milk crates used as shelving. Cracked floor tiles throughout the walk-in cooler. Food debris and spills on floors and cooking equipment.

headline: Boxes on basement floor; restroom door not self-closing
summary: Pass. Boxes stored on the basement floor near the three-compartment sink must be elevated. Two second-floor washrooms lack covered receptacles. Basement employee washroom door is not self-closing. Missing grout and dusty ceiling tiles in dish area.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing; flies throughout
summary: Fail. Low-temperature dish machine in the bar had 0 ppm sanitizer; it must be 50 to 100 ppm; citation issued. About 30 or more small live flies on walls, dried kitchenware, near floor drains, and in indoor seating areas. Pest control required; citation issued.

headline: Broken door on sushi-area cooler
summary: Pass. The door of the reach-in cooler in the sushi prep area is broken. Operator instructed to repair it and keep it maintained.

headline: No certified manager on site; no health policy
summary: Fail. No City of Chicago certified manager on site with an original certificate; must be on site at all times. No employee health policy. Toilet room door not self-closing. Floors in prep areas, toilet room, and shopping aisles need cleaning; floor by hood needs repair.

headline: No employee health policy; side door needs sealing
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy or verification that food employees know to report illness. Priority violation. Bottom of side exit door must be rodent-proofed.

headline: Soiled breading station; several plumbing leaks
summary: Pass with conditions. Chicken breading station heavily soiled with flour, batter, and food debris. Walk-in cooler shelves had spilled food. Leaks at a hot water handle, a three-compartment faucet, and a rear hand sink drain. Expired food handler certificates.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup procedure; cold hand-wash water
summary: Fail. No written procedure or supplies for vomiting or diarrhea cleanups; supplies must include sanitizer that kills norovirus. Citation issued. Employee restroom hand sink water measured 72°F; it must be at least 100°F. Citation issued.

headline: Floor near sink not smooth and cleanable
summary: Pass. The floor in the rear area in front of the three-compartment sink is not smooth and easy to clean. Operator instructed to restore the floor to a cleanable condition and maintain it.

headline: No hand-wash signs; worker without hair restraint
summary: Pass. An employee preparing and serving food did not wear a hair restraint. Basement prep areas lack hand-washing signs. Also noted: rusty shelving, missing sink stoppers, a leaking faucet, missing floor tile, and dirty ceiling light shields.

headline: No grease trap; two staff lack food handler training
summary: Pass. The three-compartment sink is not connected to a grease trap; operator must install one. Two employees lack food handler training. Missing hand-wash sign at the employee washbowl. No covered trash in the employee toilet room.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; grease and standing water
summary: Pass. Bulk food containers need labels. Ice machine interior and blender bases have buildup. Cooking equipment, prep tables, and shelves need degreasing. Wastewater pools on the basement floor by the mop sink. Ventilation needs detail cleaning.

headline: Walk-in freezer light out; loose wall base
summary: Pass. Walk-in freezer light is not working and must be replaced. Loose wall base with food debris behind it in prep and serving areas. Floors need cleaning along walls and in corners. Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning.

headline: Failed: rusted racks; leaks; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Fail. Rusted racks with chipped coating in cooler and walk-in; no drain plugs for the three-compartment sink; leak at a sink on the sushi service line; certified manager lacks allergen training. Prior violation on greasy oil container in alley not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Broken cooler gaskets; leaking sprayer faucet
summary: Pass. Broken gaskets in four-door drawer cooler under grill must be repaired or replaced. Leaking faucet on sprayer sink near basement dish machine. Unused dish machine in basement bar must be tagged, repaired, or removed. Allergen training records required.

headline: Food handlers lack certificates; re-inspection passed
summary: Pass. Food handlers had no food handler certificates. Operator instructed to obtain them.

headline: Missing hand-wash sign in dish prep area
summary: Pass. The hand sink in the dish prep area had no hand-washing sign. Operator instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing
summary: Pass. The toilet room door is not self-closing. Operator instructed to install a self-closing device.

headline: Unlabeled containers; damaged cooler gasket
summary: Pass. Food storage containers on the prep table and rolling cart are unlabeled. A rubber gasket on a two-door cooler is in poor repair. Grease and food particles on fryer and grill. Storage room has unnecessary items.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on floors and counters
summary: Pass. Several wet wiping cloths stored on floors and counters upstairs, in the bar, and downstairs. Must be kept in sanitizing solution. Torn freezer gasket; slow-draining hand sink; floors in several areas need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no hot water; heavily soiled ice machine
summary: Fail. Rear prep hand sink had no hot water, only cold; citation issued. Ice machine interior heavily soiled with black and grey substance; citation issued. Boxes of food and drinks stored on the walk-in freezer floor. One food handler lacks training proof.

headline: Rear door gap; cooler lacks thermometer
summary: Pass. The rear exit door has a gap of at least 1/4 inch at the floor and must be rodent-proofed. A two-door prep cooler has no thermometer. Floors behind cooling units and under shelving need cleaning.

headline: No hand-wash signs; no utility sink; no lidded trash
summary: Pass. No hand-washing signs at sinks in the toilet room and storage room. No utility sink on site for mop water. No covered trash receptacle in the toilet room. Operator instructed to provide each item.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; greasy exhaust hood
summary: Pass. No working thermometers were visible inside refrigeration units, so cooler temperatures could not be checked. Kitchen exhaust hood and filters have excessive grease buildup; operator told to deep clean them.

headline: Unlabeled self-serve dates and radishes
summary: Pass. Packaged Medjool dates and radishes for customer self-service lacked labels. Operator must add a label with food name, address, ingredients, net quantity, and allergens if applicable.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer; no hand-wash signs
summary: Fail. No chemical sanitizer available for equipment and utensils; priority violation. No hand-washing signs at sinks in restrooms or rear prep area. Food guard missing in front prep. Rust inside three-compartment sink; wall and ceiling damage noted.

headline: Cold food at 45-59°F; coolers too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Cold foods including chicken, ham, cheese, and tuna held at 45.3 to 59.2°F; about 7 lbs ($126) discarded; citation issued. Three cold-holding units at 46.9 to 52°F; two later reached 38.5 to 39.7°F. Leaking hand sink faucet.

headline: Debris in ice machine; stained cutting boards
summary: Pass. Debris encrusted inside the ice machine must be removed and cleaned. Bulk containers lack labels. Stained cutting boards on storage rack. Greasy pipes behind the grill. Floor tiles under and around coolers need regrouting.

headline: Failed: 50-60 rodent droppings; door gap
summary: Fail. About 50 to 60 rodent droppings in an unused rear bulk area; citation issued. Pest control service required before March 2, with proof of service. Side alley door has a 1/2-inch gap. No hand-wash signs; leaking hot water knob; dirty bar floor.

headline: Greasy fryer and broken restroom door closer
summary: Pass. Grease found at the bottom of the fryer in the cooking area; operator told to clean it. The self-closing device on the washroom door is in poor repair; operator told to fix it.

headline: Person in charge lacks certificate; loose wall base
summary: Pass with conditions. Person in charge lacks a certified food manager certificate, and no valid certificate was posted; citation issued. Ice machine interior has debris buildup. Loose wall base under the dish machine must be repaired.

headline: Cold cooler too warm; about $30 food discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Chicken and beef in a prep cooler measured 46.2 to 48.5°F, above the 41°F limit for cold food. About 10 lbs was discarded. The cooler, at 49.6°F, was tagged and held. Torn walk-in gasket was held with duct tape.

headline: Cook skipped handwashing; food held too warm
summary: Cook handled raw burgers, buns, and gloves without washing hands; manager corrected it. Cooked rice held at 110–121°F and chicken with rice at 51–61°F. About 10 lbs rice and 3 lbs chicken discarded. Overflowing dumpsters and dirty floors also cited.

headline: Cook touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands
summary: A cook touched bread, cheese, and lettuce with bare hands while assembling a sandwich; manager told not to allow bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food. Restrooms lack handwashing signs. An open ice bin at the bar needs a cover or food guard.

headline: Re-inspection passed; unlabeled foods
summary: Re-inspection passed. Oatmeal, raisins, almonds, sugar, and other items are out of original containers without labels. Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Debris around the dumpster and soiled mop heads also cited.

headline: Passed re-inspection; storage and repair fixes
summary: Re-inspection passed. Boxed food on the walk-in freezer floor must be elevated. Multi-use utensils must be inverted on shelves. Debris on walk-in cooler shelving and fan guards must be cleaned. Floor damage and a wall-floor gap need repair.

headline: Over 30 flies found; no manager on arrival
summary: Over 30 small flies found in dish, dry storage, and kitchen areas. The pest control report is under the old license name, and an updated report is required. No certified food manager on arrival. Raw meat stored above ready-to-eat food was moved on site.

headline: No certified manager on duty; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS food was prepared; citation issued. A women's restroom faucet must stay on longer for handwashing. Also a leaky dump sink pipe, a worn cooler gasket, debris on counters, and expired food handler training for some employees.

headline: Passed; food on floor, holes in ceiling
summary: Passed. Multiple boxed food items sat on the floor in the rear prep area and must be raised six inches. Cardboard shelf liners in the beverage cooler must be removed. Multiple holes in front ceiling panels need repair.

headline: No food handler training certificates on site
summary: Re-inspection found no food handler training certificates on site. The facility must provide food handler training.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet, food debris on walls
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be repaired. Walls throughout the premises have accumulated food debris that needs detail cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; wrong sanitizer test strips
summary: Person in charge lacked a City sanitation manager certificate, and none was posted; citation issued. Test strips at the three-compartment sink were wrong for the sanitizer; citation issued. No food handler or allergen training certificates were presented.

headline: Passed; foil lines cooler interior
summary: Passed. Aluminum foil lines the nonfood-contact interior of a two-door reach-in cooler. It must be removed, and surfaces must stay smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters; no paper towels at sinks
summary: Both handwash sinks lacked paper towels; manager provided them during inspection and citation issued. Dumpsters overflowed with lids open; citation issued. Female food handlers lacked hair restraints, and the toilet room had no covered receptacle.

headline: Grease and debris; core violations uncorrected
summary: Grease and food debris remain on cooking equipment, coolers, and shelving. Outside grease container is encrusted with debris; citation issued. Previous violations were not corrected, including missing sink stoppers and dirty floors. Also damaged wall bases and dirty hood filters.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. No food handler certificates were on site. Employee unisex bathroom lacks a self-closing door, and washroom trash cans lack lids. Soiled mop heads were not hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Passed; oven not under hood
summary: Passed. A large oven in the main kitchen is not under a hood. The facility must notify the building department or ventilation for approval.

headline: Passed re-inspection; training proof missing
summary: Re-inspection passed. Only one food handler had training proof on site, and no allergen training proof was provided for any employee. Also clutter in the dumpster enclosure, missing grout in dish area, and debris in a floor drain.

headline: Passed; missing floor tiles, greasy floor
summary: Passed. Missing floor tiles in front of the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Grease and food debris under all cooking equipment in prep must be cleaned.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings in basement; citation
summary: About 100 mouse droppings found in the basement under storage racks, on pallets, and in containers. Additional pest control is needed; citation issued. Also no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedure, and an ice machine dripping black and brown buildup.

headline: Mouse droppings and flies; no manager on site
summary: Over 200 mouse droppings found at the bar, sushi bar, dish area, and kitchen prep, plus over 20 live small flies and 5 live house flies. Citation issued. No person in charge or certified food manager was on site while food was prepared.

headline: About 50 dead insects on upstairs windowsills
summary: About 50 dead outdoor insects on upstairs window sills must be removed. A reach-in cooler door is off its hinges and in poor repair. A garden hose not designed for food service is used at the dish machine, and the floor by the ice machine is heavily soiled.

headline: Passed; loose doors and missing handwash signs
summary: Passed. Exterior doors near the kitchen and basement entry do not fit tightly at the bottom and must be fixed to prevent pest entry. Men's restroom lacks handwashing signage, and a kitchen fridge has residue inside.

headline: Re-inspection passed; worn door weather stripping
summary: Re-inspection passed. Worn weather stripping at the bottom of all doors must be repaired to prevent pest entry. The ice machine chute, equipment sides, coolers, floors, walls, and hood filters also need cleaning.

headline: No certified food manager on premises
summary: No City-certified food manager was on premises; one must be present at all times. Citation issued. Both front doors were propped open, and openings at the rear door base must be sealed. Also leaking faucets, a leaking ceiling vent, and a damaged cooler gasket.

headline: Passed; freezer ice buildup must be cleared
summary: Passed. The basement deep freezer has ice buildup that must be defrosted and cleaned. Spills in the upright freezer must also be cleaned.

headline: Hot and cold food unsafe; about 25 lbs discarded
summary: Noodles held at 88.6–96.7°F on the steam table, too cool to keep hot. Raw beef, raw pork, and other cold food held at 55–65°F. About 25 lbs discarded, worth about $175. Covered cooling food and a loose dial thermometer were also cited.

headline: Cold rice unsafe; menu and dish machine issues
summary: Rice held at 52.2°F; about 8 lbs discarded on site. Dish machine wash water at 144°F, repaired on site to 162°F. Menu lacked raw-food advisory, added on site. Also sink leaks, low handwash water pressure, no allergen training proof.

headline: Cold food too warm in cooler; about 310 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken, beef, eggs, yogurt salsa, and milk held at 53.6–66.0°F in a reach-in cooler; about 310 lbs worth $700 discarded. The cooler, at 58.9°F, was tagged and citation issued. Bulk food is unlabeled and floors need cleaning.

headline: Passed; can opener needs cleaning
summary: Passed. The large can opener has buildup that must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; dirty floors and drain
summary: Passed. Dirt and debris have built up on the food service area floor under and behind equipment. The service counter floor drain is dirty. Cleaning is required to prevent possible insect or pest activity.

headline: Passed; torn gaskets, low hot water pressure
summary: Passed. Torn gaskets on a reach-in cooler must be repaired. Dust on walk-in freezer fan guards needs cleaning. Hot water pressure is low in the sushi prep area and must be repaired.

headline: No employee health policy on premises
summary: No employee health policy on premises. Documentation of employee duty to report illness must be provided. Washroom doors lack self-closing devices, basement has clutter, and food handlers must obtain required training.

headline: Cold food and milk too warm; discarded
summary: Cold TCS food, including milk, held at 45.0–49.3°F, above the 41°F limit. Manager voluntarily discarded about 148 lbs worth $165 on site. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Passed; pooled chicken blood on cooler floor
summary: Passed. Pooled chicken blood and water on the walk-in cooler floor must be removed and cleaned. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, equipment had heavy dried food splatter, and some bulbs are burned out. The certified manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: Dead insects in light shields; grease and stains
summary: Dead insects were found in rear light shields and must be removed. Tape is on prep table side shields, and cutting boards are heavily stained and grooved. Deep fryers have grease buildup, and wire rack walls need cleaning. Food handler training is missing.

headline: No current pest control logbook on premises
summary: No current pest control logbook on premises. A licensed pest control company must provide at least two inspections a year, with reports kept in the logbook. Citation issued. Also restroom fixtures have residue, no covered restroom receptacle, and boxes stored on the sales floor.

headline: Passed; ice scoop in bin, leaking faucets
summary: Passed. An ice scoop was found in the ice bin and must be kept in a clean, sanitized container. Both three-compartment sink faucets leak. Hot line needs degreasing, two lights need shields, and allergen certificates are required.

headline: Moldy salad, cold food unsafe, cooler tagged
summary: Six containers of moldy salad were discarded. Deli cooler held TCS food at 47–51°F; about 68 lbs discarded. Cooler must not be used until reinspected by CDPH. Also missing food handler and allergen training records, no test kit, and no date marking.

headline: No certified manager on duty; citation issued
summary: No City-certified food manager was on duty while TCS food was prepared; citation issued. Manager has no allergen training proof. Also unlabeled food containers, no thermometers in freezers, missing basement light shields, and scoops stored inside containers.

headline: Hair restraint fixed; repeat allergen violation
summary: An employee without a hair restraint was given a hat during inspection. Encrusted grease under fryers and grime on floors and walls by sinks must be cleaned. Two certified food managers still lack allergen training proof, a repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: Passed; no allergen certificates on site
summary: Passed. No allergen training certificates for certified food managers were on site. A splash guard is needed near the kitchen handwash sink, and a cooler gasket is broken. Foil lines cooking equipment, and the gas stove is greasy.

headline: Restroom hot water too cool for handwashing
summary: Women's restroom hot water measured 65.6°F and men's 71°F, below the 100°F needed for handwashing; citation issued. Cutting boards with dark, open seams must be replaced. A rear sprayer leaks in the meat prep cooler, and a cooler vent is dusty.

headline: Toxic cleaner misused on dining tables
summary: Full-strength Fabuloso cleaner was sprayed on dining tables and other prohibited surfaces; citation issued. Food was stored on the floor. Bowls and pots were used as scoops inside dry storage containers, and wiping cloths were left on prep tables.

headline: Only prep handsink in poor repair; repaired
summary: The only prep-area handwash sink had a stripped hot-water handle; the manager repaired it during inspection. A handwash sink removed from the dish area must be reinstalled; citation issued. Also unlabeled containers, worn cutting boards, and dirty floors.

headline: Wrong sanitizer test strips; sink backs up
summary: No test kit for the quat sanitizer; manager offered bleach test strips, so a proper test kit is required; citation issued. The three-compartment sink drains poorly and sometimes backs up into the food prep sink; citation issued.

headline: Cold food unsafe; cooler tagged; no certified manager
summary: Raw fish, chicken, and shrimp held at 54.6–62.7°F; about 100 lbs ($300) discarded. A reach-in cooler at 55.1°F is tagged and must not be used until reinspected by CDPH. No certified manager or valid food handler training on site.

headline: Live flies on walls; prior pest violation uncorrected
summary: About 10 live house flies and 30 small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in food prep and dry storage areas. A pest violation from October 2, 2025 was not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: Passed; seal wall gap, clean soda area
summary: Passed. An open gap at the wall edge around the utility sink must be sealed to prevent possible insect harborage. Spillage under the rear soda storage must be cleaned.

headline: Oversized pot won't fit sink; basement floors wet
summary: Re-inspection passed. An oversized pot cannot be submerged in the three-compartment sink. It must be removed, washed in a larger sink, or covered by a written cleaning procedure. Basement floors have pooling water and must be dried.

headline: Dish sink wash water too cool
summary: The three-compartment sink cannot provide the required 110°F minimum wash water in all compartments. One faucet peaks at 101°F, then drops to 98°F. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Passed; cook lacks food handler certificate
summary: Passed. Reach-in freezers need interior cleaning of spills and debris. A cook was working without his food handler training certificate, as required.

headline: Passed; leaky pipe, broken men's handsink
summary: Passed. A leaky pipe under the middle of the three-compartment sink and a non-working men's restroom handwash sink must be repaired. The manager on duty lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Dead insects in traps under dish sink
summary: Insect traps with dead insects hung under the three-compartment sink; they must be removed, and only pest control may service the facility for insects. A hole in the floor cover over the grease trap was covered by a cup. A food handler and the manager lacked training proof.

headline: No health policy; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; citation issued. Previous violations were not corrected, including missing handwashing signs, a leaky faucet, and an uncertified allergen-training manager. Also improperly stored ice scoops, rust, freezer ice buildup, and widespread grease and dirt.

headline: Passed; no allergen proof for managers
summary: Passed. Women's restroom stalls lack covers for feminine waste cans. No proof of allergen training was on site for City-certified food managers.

headline: Passed; nonworking cooler and missing certificates
summary: Passed. A nonfunctional reach-in cooler in first floor dry storage must be removed. Food handler certifications were not on site and must be provided at all times.

headline: Passed; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. Milk crates are used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas. They must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor so the facility can be cleaned.

headline: Passed; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. Milk crates are used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas. They must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Passed; hair nets, jewelry, and cleaning issues
summary: Several food handlers prepared food without hair nets and wore dangling jewelry. Ice machine interior is dirty. Handwashing signs are missing. Also rusty racks, torn cooler gaskets, and food debris on floors and under cooking equipment.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and grease buildup
summary: Passed. Some food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and no food handler training certificates were on premises. Grease and food debris are on walls and equipment behind the cooking line, and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Hot water trickles; cigarettes stored in washing area
summary: Hot water trickles at the dish-area handwash sink; a steady flow is required for handwashing. Two burnt-out cigarettes were stored in a pan in the washing area. The employee discarded them during inspection; citation issued.

headline: Passed; coolers dirty, ceiling tiles damaged
summary: Passed. Walk-in and reach-in coolers need interior cleaning. A black substance must be removed from the ceiling, fan covers, and shelving. Broken, missing, and water-stained ceiling tiles must be replaced.

headline: Mouse droppings in dry storage; citation issued
summary: About 15 mouse droppings found in rear dry storage under cluttered racks; pest control recommended and citation issued. Raw chicken was stored above open ready-to-eat salsa, which was discarded. Missing handwashing signs and menu consumer advisory also cited.

headline: Re-inspection passed; wood walls, leaks, tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Missing handwashing sign in men's restroom. Raw wood walls and shelves must be sealed or replaced. The three-compartment sink faucet base leaks, and basement ceiling tiles and rear prep floor tiles need repair.

headline: Ice machine slime tagged; manager absent
summary: Ice machine had heavy black slime dripping onto ice for customers. It was tagged held for inspection; citation issued. No certified manager was on duty until 12:25 p.m. while TCS food was prepared. Also missing health policies and expired food handler training.

headline: Passed; hose drains into handwash sink
summary: Passed. A hose draining water purifier waste into an exposed handwash sink must be rerouted. Also missing handwashing signs, a loose faucet, low restroom water pressure, torn cooler gaskets, and an unused low-temperature dish machine at the lobby bar.

headline: Passed; food on floor, scratched cutting boards
summary: Passed. Boxes of food, utensils, and pots were on the dish and prep area floor and must be raised six inches. Cutting boards have deep scratches. Reach-in coolers have spill residue, one handwash sink drains slowly, and pooled water and debris need cleaning.

headline: About 50 live flying insects found; citation issued
summary: About 50 live small flying insects on walls, ceilings, and stock in basement prep, dish, storage, liquor, and bar areas. Additional pest control is needed; citation issued. Also leaking beer lines, soiled floors, and no allergen training certificates.

headline: Passed; trash can needed near handwash sink
summary: Passed. A trash can must be placed near the handwashing sink at the front serving line for used paper towels.

headline: No health policy; hot water initially too cool
summary: No employee health policy on site. Three-compartment sink reached only 104.9°F and handwash sink 94.3°F; both were corrected before inspection ended. Refrigerator, milk shake machines, and cash register not secured for vehicle movement.

headline: Passed; routine cleaning instructions
summary: Passed. Cooking equipment exteriors need grease removed, and floors around equipment need cleaning. Ceiling and hood vents are dusty. Food handler training is required for all handlers, and an allergen certificate has expired.

headline: Passed; missing signs, holes, stained ceilings
summary: Passed. Women's restroom handwash sink lacks signage. Stained ceiling tiles in rear prep need replacing. A hole at the base of the wall by the three-compartment sink and stains and holes in the basement ceiling must be repaired.

headline: Passed; ice machine residue, expired certificates
summary: Passed. Residue found inside two ice machines, and an ice scoop was stored on the bin cover. A restroom washbowl had no running water. Some employees have expired food handler certificates. Floor drains, ceiling tiles, and floor tiles need repair or cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection passed with condition
summary: Re-inspection passed with a condition. The men's restroom metering faucet must run for at least 15 seconds without reactivating. Chipped paint and rust on walk-in cooler wire racks must be removed, and the racks repainted or replaced.

headline: No prep-area handwash sink; no hot water
summary: No handwashing sink in kitchen prep area. Several sinks lack hot water. Two holes at the front door must be sealed to block rodents. Oven hood not working. A food service manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: Passed; door gaps, cardboard, and ice buildup
summary: Passed. Gaps at the bottom of the front door and in the rear door corner must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Cardboard is in chip displays, ice has built up in the ice cream freezer, and weeds and debris are around the dumpster.

headline: Manager absent; handwashing and utensil lapses
summary: No certified food manager was present while TCS food was prepared and served. An employee did not wash hands before gloves or after the restroom. The prep-area handwash sink was blocked and had no paper towels. Utensils were not sanitized; summary not posted.

headline: Re-inspection passed; employees eating in prep
summary: Re-inspection passed. Employees were drinking and preparing food in the prep area; management must provide a designated eating and drinking area. Serving plates on shelves must be inverted, and ceiling fans above the dish area are dusty.

headline: Passed; cleaning, hair restraints, expired certificates
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior needs cleaning. Cardboard boxes may not be used as food containers in coolers, and a bulk rice lid is broken. Hair restraints are required, several certificates are expired, and allergen training proof is missing for the manager.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings in food areas; citation
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were found on floors, cabinets, and under pallets in the grill and sushi prep areas. Citation issued; pest control treatment required. No paper towels at the sushi-area handwash sink. Milk crates used for elevation must be replaced.

headline: Cold food held too warm; discarded
summary: Cold food including ground chicken, cooked noodles, eggs, and half-and-half held at 45–52°F inside a cold holding unit. About 15 lbs discarded, worth $50. Citation issued. Working sauce containers must be labeled.

headline: Passed; storage, gasket, and grout repairs
summary: Passed. Single-service items were stored on the floor. A walk-in freezer door gasket is damaged, and grout is damaged near handwash sinks. Soiled mop heads must be hung to dry, and a walk-in cooler light bulb is out.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, ice buildup
summary: Passed. Bulk containers are unlabeled, and ice has built up in the walk-in freezer. Milk crates are used as shelving in rear storage. Staff restroom lacks a covered waste container, and prep-area light shields have debris.

headline: Unlabeled containers; dish machine lacks indicator
summary: Dry storage containers lack labels. Hot-water dish machine has no temperature indicator. Loose handwash faucet behind coffee bar and missing walk-in cooler light shield. Food handler certificates could not be verified for all employees and must be kept on site.

headline: Passed; employee food stored with customer food
summary: Passed. Employee food was stored with customer food and must be separated. Several food handler certificates were expired and need updating.

headline: No certified manager while food prepared
summary: No certified food manager was present while TCS food, including coffee with milk and sandwiches, was prepared and served; citation issued. Several food handlers lacked certificates. The basement milk cooler and chest freezer need interior cleaning.

headline: Dead mouse found in paper goods storage
summary: A dead mouse was found along a wall in paper goods storage and must be removed, with the area cleaned and sanitized. Also no raw-food advisory on menus (citation), ice machine residue, unlabeled bulk containers, and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Dish machine too cool; tagged held for inspection
summary: High-temperature dish machine in the bar reached 152.6°F, below the required 160°F; it is tagged held for inspection and citation issued. A repeat uncorrected missing backflow device at the ice machine, torn cooler gaskets, and expired manager allergen training were also cited.

headline: Re-inspection passed; one handler lacks certificate
summary: Re-inspection passed. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate. The person in charge must provide training certificates for all food handlers.

headline: Mouse droppings in store; more pest control needed
summary: Mouse droppings were found on the floor and in chip boxes on racks. Additional pest control is needed; no citation issued. Also food stored on floors, dirty reach-in coolers and freezers, and no food handler certificate on site.

headline: Passed; clothing, dusty ceiling, poor lighting
summary: An employee wore a sleeveless top in the food prep area and was told to wear proper clothing. Stained, dusty ceiling tiles and vents in prep need cleaning. The toilet room has poor lighting.

headline: Three-compartment dish sink backs up
summary: Three-compartment sink backs up. When the middle compartment drains, water flows into the first and third compartments. The person in charge was told to repair and maintain it. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: No employee health policy or training on site
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; priority violation. Also milk crates used for elevation, a slow-draining handwash sink, greasy walls behind cooking line, a hanging vent cover, debris around the garbage container, and spray foam sealant that must be removed.

headline: Passed; wiping cloths left on counter
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were stored on a counter instead of in sanitizer solution when not in use.

headline: Handwash water too cool; moldlike buildup
summary: Handwash sink water reached only 93.6–94.8°F, below the 100°F minimum; citation issued. Chicken tinga held at 49.6°F in the walk-in; about 4.25 lbs discarded. Pink and black moldlike substance found inside both ice machines. No allergen training proof.

headline: Coolers lack thermometers; core violations uncorrected
summary: Coolers lack interior thermometers. Previous violations were not corrected, including soiled coolers and freezers and dirty floors; citation issued. Also torn gaskets, a missing backflow device at the mop sink, unlabeled bins, and webs and dust on ceilings.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificate on site
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificate was on site, and a certified food manager lacks allergen training. Handwashing signs and cooler thermometers are missing. Restroom trash bins lack lids. Basement clutter and dusty floors need attention.

headline: Passed; debris around dumpster and storage floors
summary: Passed. Leaves and debris lie on the ground under and around the rear dumpster. Floors along walls, in corners, and under storage shelves in the rear storage area need detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; personal items stored with beverages
summary: Passed. A handwash sink lacks signage. Employee personal care items are stored with beverages at the bar, and salt and dry spices are uncovered near splashes. Floors under cooling equipment are soiled, and employee drinks are stored near food.

headline: Over 150 rat droppings found throughout
summary: Over 150 rat droppings found throughout, including basement alcohol storage, floor by dry food storage, and an electrical closet. Citation issued. Also a torn rodent strip at kitchen door, ice machine mineral buildup, and a cook without a hair restraint.

headline: Passed; sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. A City of Chicago sanitation manager has no allergen training. Proof of allergen training must be provided.

headline: About 140 mouse droppings found throughout facility
summary: About 140 mouse droppings were found in rear storage, front prep, and storage areas. The person in charge must remove and sanitize them; citation issued. No thermometers were in hot-hold cabinets, and some vent light bulbs were not working.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; repaired on site
summary: The low-temperature warewashing machine was sanitizing at 0 ppm. The owner repaired it during inspection, and it now sanitizes at 100 ppm. Citation issued. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and wet wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces.

headline: Cook skipped handwashing between raw beef and food
summary: A cook handled raw beef patties, then bread, lettuce, and cheese without washing hands or changing contaminated gloves. The manager was instructed to have all food handlers wash hands. Also noted: a food handler lacked a certificate and hair restraints.

headline: Cold foods discarded; dish machine and cooler tagged
summary: Several cold TCS foods were held at 45-52F, and about 35 lbs ($120) were discarded. A cooler under the griddle read 47F and was tagged. The dish machine's chlorine sanitizer read 0 ppm and was tagged out of use.

headline: Leaking faucet at deli hand sink
summary: The hand sink behind the deli counter has a leak at the faucet base. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; basement clutter
summary: No chemical test kit for sanitizer was available; citation issued. Handwashing signs were missing at the bar and washroom sinks. Dirt and food debris were under pallets in the basement liquor storage area. Clutter, including an unused chest freezer, must be removed to prevent rodent harborage.

headline: Stained cutting boards and sink leaks found
summary: Stained cutting boards in the rear prep area must be resurfaced or replaced. Leaks at the three-compartment sink faucet and drain pipe must be repaired. Dust on ceiling vent covers also needs removal.

headline: No proof of food handler or allergen training
summary: No proof of food handler training was available for food handlers. No proof of allergen training was provided for City of Chicago certificate holders. The operator must provide and keep these records on site.

headline: Food handler certificates unavailable for review
summary: Food handler certificates were not available for the inspector's review. Also noted: no covered receptacle in the women's toilet room, and a brown-black substance on the wall under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Dead roaches found; no certified manager on site
summary: Dead roaches were stuck to a handwashing sign and lay on the floor in the dish area. No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared. Chicken was cooling in uncovered containers near an open door. Citations issued.

headline: Low hot water pressure in restroom
summary: The restroom had low water pressure for hot water and must be repaired. A light fixture above the restroom door needs repair and a light shield.

headline: Damaged restroom walls and wall gap
summary: Walls under the women's restroom hand sinks must be restored to a smooth, easily cleaned surface. A gap in the wall above a pipe access closure next to the ice machine needs full coverage.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or policy was on site; citation issued. The kit must include a disposable mop, gloves, mask, and sanitizer that eliminates norovirus. Also noted: no splashguard at the cook-line handsink and a slow-draining handsink.

headline: Leaking drain pipe under three-compartment sink
summary: A small leak was at the drainpipe under the three-compartment sink and must be repaired. Food debris and stains had accumulated in the drain under the sink and must be cleaned.

headline: Handwashing sink blocked; three-compartment sink leaks
summary: A handwashing sink in the dish and prep area was blocked by utensils and a container; citation issued. The three-compartment sink leaks excessively when drained. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly, and no allergen training was on site.

headline: Cold burgers and chicken discarded; soap missing
summary: Hamburgers at 53.4F and chicken at 51.8F were held in an open-top cooler; about 15 lbs ($100) were discarded. Both dish-room handwashing sinks lacked soap, and a cook-line sink lacked paper towels. Citations issued. No allergen certificates were on site.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint in the food prep area. The handler was instructed to wear one.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; mop water disposal issue
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure was in place, though a blood-borne spill kit was present. There is no utility sink, and staff said mop water was thrown into the alley. No proof of food handler training; inspection summary not posted.

headline: Live rats and about 50 droppings found
summary: Multiple live rat sightings were recorded, including one rat on a proofer and one running under a standing mixer. About 50 rat droppings were found in several areas. Pest control service is needed. Citation issued; no certified manager was present during TCS food prep.

headline: Hot food below 135F; sleeping quarters in basement
summary: Chicken stew, chicken soup, and beef were held at 114.3-122.3F, below the 135F minimum; 15 lbs ($250) were discarded. Living and sleeping quarters, including a bed, were found in the basement storage area. Citation issued; items must be removed.

headline: Rear door opening and expired allergen certificate
summary: An opening under the rear exit door in the liquor storage area must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Missing grout in dish and cook-line areas and a hole in a wall need repair. An allergen training certificate for the sanitation manager had expired.

headline: Frozen meat thawing in sink water; many repairs
summary: Frozen meat was thawing in standing water in a sink compartment. Staff must thaw it under cold running water, in the cooler, or in the microwave. Also noted: sink leaks, dirty walk-in shelving, a missing handwashing sign, and no allergen certificate for the certified food manager.

headline: Food handlers not wearing hair restraints
summary: Food handlers were preparing food without hair restraints. The person in charge was instructed that all food handlers must wear one.

headline: Plates not inverted; no washroom exhaust fan
summary: Plates were not inverted after sanitizing and air drying. The washroom had no exhaust ventilation fan, and the operator was instructed to provide a working one.

headline: Pork, eggs, and beef too warm; 30 lbs discarded
summary: Pork at 55.6F, eggs at 80.3F, and beef at 56.3F were held above 41F in the rear prep area. The manager discarded 30 lbs ($200). No handwashing sink is in the rear prep area; citation issued. Food was stored on floors.

headline: Over 100 small flies; mold inside ice machine
summary: Over 100 small flies were seen throughout the facility, including food prep and washroom areas. Black, pink, and beige mold was found inside the ice machine, and the ice had to be destroyed. Citation issued. Expired allergen training proof and leaking drains were also noted.

headline: Rusty shelves and food debris on floor
summary: Rusty storage shelves were in the walk-in cooler in the rear prep area and must be cleaned. Accumulated food debris was on the floor throughout the rear prep area.

headline: Basement storage and sink upkeep items
summary: A splash guard is needed between the basement prep handsink and clean stored pans. All stored items in the basement must be elevated off the floor. A raw wood floor prop must be sealed, and the basement employee washroom door needs a self-closing device.

headline: Cleaning and repainting needed in several areas
summary: Storage shelves in a storage closet, a prep table under the grill, and the top of the dish machine need cleaning. Floors in the storage closet and walls behind the grill and stove need cleaning. A chipped wall by the grill must be repainted.

headline: Thick buildup in dish area drains
summary: A thick substance had built up in the drains under the three-compartment sink and the dishwashing machine in the rear dish area. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Soiled ice machine panel; splattered walls
summary: The interior panel of the ice machine was slightly soiled and must be cleaned. Walls throughout the prep and warewashing area had food debris and spills.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: The food service sanitation manager did not have a food allergen training certificate. The operator was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Vacuum-packed chicken without approved plan
summary: Vacuum-packaged chicken was on site with no approved HACCP (hazard analysis) plan or variance for vacuum packaging TCS foods. The manager discarded 3 lbs ($10). The certified manager lacked allergen training, and oversized kettles need a clean-in-place procedure.

headline: Some handwashing faucets shut off too soon
summary: Some timed handwashing sink faucets did not stay on for the required minimum of 20 seconds. The operator was instructed to adjust the faucets where needed.

headline: Uninverted single-service items; dust and debris
summary: Single-service articles were not inverted in the rear storage area. Dust was on ceiling vents, tiles, and light shields in prep, and food debris was on floors along walls. Spiderwebs were in the front storage area, and ceiling tiles in dining were stained.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and grease buildup
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the exposed hand sink in the rear warewashing area. The women's toilet room had no covered trash receptacle. Grease had accumulated on floors under the deep fryers in the rear prep area.

headline: No certified manager on site; chicken held cool
summary: The certified food manager left before the inspection ended, and no other certified manager remained. Cooked chicken was held at 117F, below the 135F minimum; 3 lbs ($10) were discarded. Heavy soil around the dish and ice machines was a repeat violation.

headline: No handsink in prep area; no cold holding unit
summary: There was no handwashing sink in the food prep and dishwashing room. No cold holding unit was present for the kitchen, and no proper cooking equipment was available for ground beef prepared on site. No allergen training proof for the certified food manager.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; restroom ventilation broken
summary: Handwashing sinks in the front self-service area had no signage telling food employees to wash hands. The all-gender restroom's mechanical ventilation was in poor repair and nonfunctional and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Food on freezer floor; no hair restraints worn
summary: Boxes and buckets were on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised at least six inches. Food handlers were not using effective hair restraints. Knives were stored in gaps between prep coolers and tables. Mops were stored submerged, and grease was heavy under fryers.

headline: Grease buildup on prep equipment
summary: Heavy prep area equipment, including grills and fryers, needs cleaning to prevent pest harborage. Grease and food buildup must be removed.

headline: Repeat violations not corrected from 2024
summary: Previous core violations were not corrected: unlabeled dry food containers, grease inside the deep fryer and coolers, and a leaking drain pipe at the three-compartment sink. All must be corrected by the reinspection date.

headline: No employee health policy; no allergen training
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site. Items on the floor and outside the rear yard must be elevated, removed, or organized. The food manager had no food allergen training.

headline: Cardboard liners, ice buildup, and gasket debris
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner on reach-in cooler shelving and under the gyro machine, and must be removed. Ice buildup was in the rear reach-in freezer, and food debris was in the gaskets of reach-in coolers.

headline: Live dog in food establishment; citation issued
summary: A live dog was inside the establishment; a patron held it while ordering, and employees did not ask whether it was a service animal. Only service animals are allowed. Citation issued. The certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Raw meat stored above green beans; citation issued
summary: Raw meat was stored directly above green beans; the manager had the beans moved on site. Black buildup was found inside the ice machine. Prior violations not corrected include basement clutter, expired food handler certificates, and no allergen training for the food manager.

headline: No city sanitation manager certificate posted
summary: The person in charge did not have a City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate, and none was posted on site. A citation was issued, and the certificate must be provided.

headline: Slow drain at front handwashing sink
summary: The handwashing sink in the front prep and service counter drains slowly. The operator was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Ice scoops stored inside ice machine
summary: Ice scoops were improperly stored inside the ice machine; the manager must provide a clean container for them. A water-damaged ceiling tile above the men's washroom must be replaced.

headline: Wiping cloths on food surfaces; exterior needs cleaning
summary: Wiping cloths were found on food contact surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Exterior surfaces between the steam table and prep cooler also need cleaning.

headline: Missing thermometers; greasy shelves and floors
summary: Thermometers must be visible inside all prep and reach-in coolers. Grocery bags were used in the chest freezer and must be replaced with food-grade bags. A slow-draining handsink, dried debris on floors, and hanging grease above the kitchen hood also need attention.

headline: Green slime on restroom sinks
summary: Slight green slime buildup was seen on washbowl sinks in both toilet rooms. Staff were instructed to detail clean, sanitize, and maintain the sinks in good condition.

headline: Rear storage and break area floors need cleaning
summary: Floors at the rear storage and break areas were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine interior dirty; dumpster missing lid
summary: The interior of the ice machine in the side service area must be cleaned. The outside dumpster was missing its lid, which could give pests access to food sources; citation issued. Floors behind the bar, in the dish area, and inside the walk-in need cleaning.

headline: Over 30 live flies; no hand soap
summary: Over 30 small live flies were on walls in the rear prep and dishwashing area. No hand soap was at any hand sink; paper towels were corrected on site. Food handlers lacked proof of training. Prior violations, including clutter and debris, were not corrected.

headline: Rust and grease buildup on equipment and shelves
summary: Rust was building up on walk-in cooler shelving and fan vents. Shelving must be cleaned, painted, or replaced. Grease, spills, and dust on cooking and prep equipment must be cleaned to prevent possible pest activity.

headline: Small flies found; food stored inside ice machine
summary: About 15-18 small flies were in the rear prep and dish area; a citation was issued. A tea container was submerged in the ice machine, and an ice scoop was stored inside it. Sinks lacked hand drying supplies until paper towels were brought in. Prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Ice buildup in walk-in freezer
summary: Ice buildup was found in the walk-in freezer condenser unit and on the floor. The operator must defrost the freezer and maintain it.

headline: Bare-hand garnish contact; glove use lapse
summary: An employee picked up a garnish without washing hands or wearing gloves, placed it on a customer's drink, and served it. Another employee wiped his nose while wearing gloves, then prepared food without changing gloves or washing hands. Citation issued.

headline: Debris in soda dispensers; greasy floors
summary: Debris was in the lower compartments of soda dispensers in the grill and pantry areas and must be cleaned. Floors beside the deep fryers and pipes had slight grease buildup.

headline: No thermometer in hot-hold unit
summary: The hot-hold unit at the front counter had no thermometer. The person in charge was instructed to provide one to monitor ambient air temperature.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food service
summary: No certified food manager was on premises while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedure was on site. A leak under the front prep handsink also needs repair.

headline: Live roaches found; dish machine gauge broken
summary: Three live roaches were crawling on the floor, and several were on glue boards in kitchen electrical and storage closets. The manager must call an exterminator. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and the high-temperature dish machine's final rinse gauge was not working.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing, with a final rinse of 0 ppm. It is tagged and must not be used until the Chicago Department of Public Health re-inspects it. A handwashing sign was also missing at the front sink.

headline: Food stored on floors in walk-in units
summary: Boxed food was on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer and must be raised six inches on shelving. Scoops were stored inside dry storage containers, and food debris covered the floors in rear prep areas.

headline: Cooler, deli prep area, and floors need cleaning
summary: Display cooler needs cleaning of spills and debris around prepackaged meats, milk, and eggs. Deli prep area is cluttered and must be organized for cleaning and pest monitoring. Floors along wall bases and in corners need cleaning.

headline: Eggs too warm; cooler tagged; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served. Eggs held at 53.2-56.8F were discarded (11 lbs, $45). The reach-in cooler at 57.9F was tagged and cannot be used until re-inspected by CDPH.

headline: Blocked handwash sink; no employee health policy
summary: A handwashing sink was blocked by items and lacked paper towels and soap; these were provided during inspection. No written employee health policy and no pest control log book were available; citation issued. Employees were not wearing hair restraints.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; no handler certificates
summary: The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed to keep out rodents. No food handler certificates were on site. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Cold foods held at 44-61F; discarded
summary: Various cold TCS foods were held between 44 and 61F, above the 41F limit. The manager discarded about 12 lbs of burger meat, mozzarella, cooked noodles, and chicken ($75). Citation issued.

headline: Cold salads held too warm; food discarded on site
summary: Chicken salad at 50.2F and tuna salad at 57.2F were held above the 41F limit. The manager discarded about 10 lbs ($80) on site. Boxes were stored on the floor, sink plumbing leaked, and only one food handler certificate was provided.

headline: No food handler certificates or allergen training
summary: No food handler certificates were on site, and no allergen training was present. No verifiable employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea kit and procedure were on site. Soiled mop heads must be hung, and a basement bulb was burnt out.

headline: Personal items on food prep table
summary: Employee personal items were placed on a prep table. Employees were instructed to keep personal items off food prep tables.

headline: Three-compartment sink water temperature unstable
summary: Water at the three-compartment sink could not consistently hold the 110F minimum, swinging from 135F down to 76F. The cold water handle was loose. A technician was sent to service the sink. Citation issued.

headline: No food handler training; several upkeep gaps
summary: Employees had no valid food handler training. The previous allergen certificate issue was not corrected. Also noted: missing handwashing signs, an uncovered bulk container, uninverted single-service items, floor debris, and no operable washroom ventilation.

headline: No food handler certificates; ventilation not working
summary: No employees had food handler training certificates on site. The food prep area ventilation system was not working and must be repaired. Also noted: a washroom door that is not self-closing and floor debris in utility and storage areas.

headline: No food handler or allergen training proof
summary: No proof of food handler training or certificates was available for employees. No allergen training proof was available for the certified food manager. Blackened caulking at the three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Dish machine final rinse too low; tagged
summary: The high-temperature dish machine in the expo area had a final rinse of 143.2F, below the required 180-194F. It was tagged and held for inspection. Also noted: a loose faucet, no covered trash receptacles in women's restrooms, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Handwashing sinks blocked, lacked soap and towels
summary: A rear handwashing sink was blocked by water cases and bottles, which were removed during inspection. Both prep and dish area sinks lacked soap and hand drying supplies; these were provided during inspection. Citations issued.

headline: About 30 fruit flies found; failed inspection
summary: About 30 fruit flies were seen in the storage and front cashier areas. The person in charge was told to remove them and call pest control. Citation issued. Damaged ceiling tiles and missing allergen training were also noted.

headline: Several workers lacked food handler certificates
summary: Several food handlers did not have a food handler certificate. Management was told all food handlers must show proof of training. Floor tiles under the cooking equipment must be regrouted.

headline: Sushi fish frozen-status verification still missing
