summary: About 60 small rodent droppings in rear prep, on prep table shelves, inside boxes of unused equipment, and beside the three-compartment sink; citation issued. No valid certified food manager on site while chicken, tomatoes, and beef were prepared; citation issued.

headline: Three burned-out bulbs in drink prep area
summary: Three burned-out light bulbs in the drink prep area. Inspector instructed replacement of bulbs and lighting maintenance.

headline: Loose handwashing sink; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Handwashing sink loose beside dish 3-compartment sink; must be secured. Prior violations from January 2024 not corrected: greasy wok station and stove, dirty floors and walls, greasy hood, and no certified manager with allergen training. Correct by 4/10/2025.

headline: Ice machine slime and lard; unsafe thawing
summary: Ice machine in dish/prep area had black slime and lard-like substance dripping onto ice; citation issued. Frozen chicken thawed in stagnant water in prep sink. No chlorine test kit. Menu lacked raw or undercooked food advisory for burgers and steak; citation issued.

headline: Uncovered food on floor; no hair restraints
summary: Uncovered food stored on walk-in cooler floor; cooked rice stored in grocery bags. Food handlers not wearing hair restraints. Residue inside ice machine. Missing handwashing signs. Greasy floors and walls behind cooking equipment. No food handler training for employees.

headline: Poor floor tiles and low grout at dishwash
summary: Floor tiles in the dishwash area are in poor repair with low grout. Manager instructed to repair and regrout the floor tiles.

headline: Re-inspection: no training proof for food handlers
summary: No proof of food handler training for any food handlers, and no allergen training proof for certified food managers. Records must be kept on site. Encrusted grease in compartment under cook-line fryers.

headline: Re-inspection: missing, damaged floor tiles
summary: Missing and damaged floor tiles in rear prep area. Instructed to repair them to create a smooth, easily cleanable surface and maintain.

headline: Boxed food on floor; ceiling hole reported
summary: Boxed food items on floor in rear walk-in cooler and freezer; must be elevated six inches on raised shelving. Hole in ceiling above electronics aisle must be repaired.

headline: Re-inspection: missing and dirty hood filters
summary: Missing filters above cooking equipment in front prep area must be replaced. Filters at cooking equipment hoods in both prep areas must be cleaned.

headline: No thermometers in coolers
summary: No ambient air thermometers inside reach-in and display coolers. Instructed to provide conspicuous, easily readable thermometers inside all refrigerator units.

headline: Walk-in cooler foods too warm; hair restraints
summary: Cooked eggs and sausage at 45°F, cream cheese and milk at 48°F in walk-in cooler; cold TCS foods must be 41°F or below; citation issued. Several food handlers without hair restraints. No sanitizer test strips at three-compartment sink. No food handler certificates provided.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; gaps in doors
summary: Sliced tomatoes at 50.4°F, mozzarella at 46.8°F, and boiled eggs at 49.8°F; cold foods must be 41°F or below. Manager discarded about $20 of food on site. Small cold-holding unit at 54.9°F was tagged. Gaps at entrance and patio doors must be sealed. Data plate and thermometer were provided on site.

headline: Re-inspection: torn gasket; allergen certificate missing
summary: Torn door gasket on top left main prep line cooler must be replaced. Certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate; training must be completed and certificate kept on site.

headline: Urine smell at dumpster; dust; items on floor
summary: Box stored on crate near cashier; food and non-food items must be elevated six inches. Stench of urine around dumpster enclosure; ground must be cleaned. Unused coffee and slushie machine on counter must be removed. Dust on front sales floor vents and floors.

headline: About 100 live flies; no certified food manager
summary: No certified food manager on site while sliced tomatoes, chicken, and gyro were prepared; citation issued. About 100 small black live flies in rear prep and storage areas, on equipment, boxes, and dressing bottles; citation issued. Food handler lacked hair restraint and food handler certificate.

headline: Handsink blocked by utensil; uncovered food
summary: Kitchen handwashing sink blocked by a bowl and scoop; must be kept accessible for handwashing only; citation issued. Food uncovered in walk-in freezer and prep cooler. Also unlabeled containers, wet wiping cloths, plates not inverted, and no covered restroom waste bin.

headline: No certified manager; handsink blocked, no soap
summary: No person in charge with valid certificate and no certified manager when TCS foods were prepared; citations issued. No soap at washroom handsink. Containers and utensils stored inside prep handsink. Soiled wiping cloths, no chemical test kit, and leaking drain pipe under handsink.

headline: No handwash signs; unlabeled dry ingredients
summary: No handwashing signage at front and rear prep handsinks. Bulk and small dry ingredient containers unlabeled. Food handler without hair restraint. Utensils and containers not inverted. One sink stopper missing. Dust on prep ventilation cover. No prior inspection summary report posted; citation issued.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings in basement storage
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings on basement dry storage shelves and in corners of an adjacent utility closet; citation issued. Pest control service recommended before reinspection. Scoops with handles touching stored food. Heavy debris in basement utility room. One of three managers lacks allergen certificate.

headline: No certified manager; pest logs incomplete
summary: No certified food manager on site with valid certificate while milk and heavy cream were prepared; citation issued. Pest control logbook showed one 2025 service and none in 2026; citation issued. Excess spider webs in corners. No sanitizer test strips at three-compartment sink.

headline: Re-inspection: tongs on peppers; grease; leaks
summary: Tong handles lying on peppers; plastic containers used as dispensing utensils. Single-service articles not inverted. Deep-grooved, stained cutting boards. Grease buildup on cooking equipment. Dust on coolers and freezers. Leaking faucets on three-compartment sink.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit; door gaps
summary: No written employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit on premises. Front service area lacks a handwashing sink. Front and rear doors have quarter-inch gaps. Display cases not protected by food guards and not self-closing. Warped, loose flooring in rear dishwashing area.

headline: Unlabeled foods; side door lacks screening
summary: Foods in walk-in cooler containers lack common-name labels. Side door opened without adequate mesh screening, risking pest entry; doors must stay closed or be screened. Backflow device on ice machine could not be located.

headline: Wash water too cool; repair ordered; citation
summary: Three-compartment sink wash water fluctuated between 104°F and 106°F; must be at least 110°F. Instructed to repair and use two-compartment sink with sprayer during repair. Citation issued.

headline: Non-food items stored on floor under table
summary: Non-food items stored in crates on floor under table near handwashing sink. Instructed to declutter, stop using crates, and store items on shelving at least six inches off the floor.

headline: No handwashing sign; no food guard
summary: No handwashing sign at rear kitchen areas. No food guard between handsink and front sandwich-line preparation area. Both must be provided.

headline: Pink ice machine buildup; food buildup in coolers
summary: Slight pink buildup inside ice machine must be cleaned. Accumulated food buildup inside prep reach-in coolers along cookline. Grease and food accumulation on prep floor under cooking equipment. One food manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Re-inspection: labeling, rust, allergen training needed
summary: Dry food in plastic containers needs common-name labels. Used cloth left on cutting boards. Rust on walk-in shelves and prep table bases. Single-serve utensils must be inverted. Mop-sink faucet missing. Additional allergen training certificate required on site.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty equipment areas
summary: Bulk storage containers must be labeled with the product name. Instructed to clean exteriors of bulk containers, prep tables, stove top, shelves, and floors under and behind kitchen equipment. Hole in washroom wall next to toilet must be sealed.

headline: Vehicle cooler at 99°F; several violations
summary: Two-door cooler on vehicle at 99°F; must reach and maintain 41°F or below. No hand-drying supplies at prep/dish handsink; no license number on vehicle; no lidded garbage receptacle; cold-holding doors unprotected while in motion; low three-compartment sink water pressure; liquid spillage in refrigerator.

headline: Re-inspection: rear exit door has gaps
summary: A 1/4 to 1/2 inch gap at bottom and left side of rear exit door leading outside. Instructed to completely rodent-proof the door.

headline: No certified manager; mold-like ice machine panel
summary: No original certified food manager certificate on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Ice machine panel touching ice had black and pink mold-like substance; citation issued. No employee health policy. Food stored on dry storage floors. Milk crates used as shelving. Fusion sinks not accepted.

headline: Holes to outside near water heater; food debris
summary: Small holes in the floor leading directly outside, by the hot water heater; must be sealed. Accumulated food debris on floor between and under flat-top grills; instructed to clean.

headline: Stained cutting boards with dark grooves
summary: Stained cutting boards with dark grooves in pizza prep area and attached to prep cooler. Instructed to remove stains and grooves or replace the cutting boards.

headline: Pink buildup in ice machine; drain and trash lids
summary: Pink mineral buildup inside rear ice machine must be cleaned. Drain pipe from bar counter goes into bar lounge handwashing sink; must be closed or relocated. No lids on trash cans in all women's toilet rooms.

headline: Missing covers, dusty cooler motor, drain buildup
summary: Missing cabinet cover under pasta cooker and missing vent cover on prep cooler. Excessive dust on prep cooler motor. Heavy buildup in three-compartment sink floor drain basin. Instructed to replace covers and clean.

headline: Utensils not stored properly; cut cutting boards
summary: No storage for utensils between reach-in coolers. Cutting boards with deep cuts must be replaced. All cooking equipment needs cleaning of spills and buildup. Leaking faucet in ladies' room sink must be repaired.

headline: No burger advisory; coolers too warm; citation
summary: Menu lacks consumer advisory for made-to-order burgers; citation issued. Two coolers at ambient air temperatures of 46°F and 49°F; must be 41°F or below; citation issued. Pest control logbook lacked Illinois license number or certificate.

headline: Dirt and debris in coolers and prep areas
summary: Walk-in cooler and freezer floors have debris and dirt under shelving and along wall corners. Floors around cooking equipment have dirt and food debris. Ceiling vents dusty. Instructed to clean to prevent possible pest or insect activity.

headline: No valid manager certificate; hot water too hot
summary: No valid City of Chicago food sanitation manager certificate on site; citation issued. Hot water at washroom handsink above 120°F; must be 100-120°F; citation issued. Also rust under prep tables, a leaking front handsink, and clutter around rear handsink.

headline: Expired sushi rice lab report; no variance
summary: Sushi rice lab report expired, dated 2019. No approved variance or HACCP plan approved by Chicago Department of Public Health on site for specialized processing; citation issued.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan or kit
summary: No procedure or supplies for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events. Must provide plan and kit with gloves, face masks, disposable mops, and norovirus-effective sanitizer. Instructed to detail clean kitchen exhaust hoods and filters to remove dust.

headline: Ice machine slime; prep handwashing sink unusable
summary: Black slimy buildup inside ice machine dripping onto ice for customers; must be cleaned and sanitized. Prep-area handwashing sink was inaccessible because it was disconnected due to leaking. Also unlabeled oatmeal and bread crumbs, soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, and dirty floors.

headline: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer
summary: Wiping cloths not stored properly when not in use; must be kept in sanitizing solution at required strength. Can opener with food and dirt buildup. Greasy deep fryer interiors. Dirty floor drains, corners, walls, and ceiling tiles with splatter and dust.

headline: No certified manager while TCS food prepared
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken, fish, coleslaw, and rice were prepared and served; citation issued. Frozen chicken thawed in standing water in three-compartment sink. No soap at rear dishwashing handsink. Food handler without hair restraint. Dirty floors and walls.

headline: No certified manager during burger service
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on premises while burgers, fries, and shakes were prepared and served; citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection: rust and chipped paint on racks
summary: Chipped paint and rust on wire storage racks in the prep line cooler. Instructed to remove chipped paint and rust and repaint or replace the shelves.

headline: Walk-in cooler and freezer floors need cleaning
summary: Floors inside the walk-in cooler and freezer had spills and debris and need cleaning. No other issues were listed.

headline: Missing hair nets; uncovered toilet receptacle
summary: Food handlers without hair nets were handling food during inspection. Handwashing signage is needed at prep-area sinks. Crates are used for elevation, and the 3-compartment sink hot-water handle spins. The unisex toilet lacks a covered receptacle.

headline: Failed: flies on wall above donut shelves
summary: Over 20 small live flies were on the wall above donut display shelves in the front prep area. Staff were instructed to remove and sanitize; pest control is recommended; citation issued. Ice machine needs cleaning.

headline: Food boxes on dairy cooler floor
summary: Boxes of food were stored on the floor in the dairy cooler area and must be elevated 6 inches. The high-heat dish machine is heavily soiled with calcium. The deli 1-compartment sink faucet leaks when in use.

headline: Condensate drain discharged onto floor
summary: A condensate line from the ceiling drained into an open container on the floor and must be rerouted to an approved drain. A soiled mop head was not hung up, which can lead to insect breeding. Utility area floors need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager while food was served
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served; citation issued. A prep table with blenders has no hand sink. Foil lines shelves; cardboard must be removed.

headline: Knives stored between prep tables; dirty areas
summary: Knives were stored between prep tables and must be kept on a clean surface or in a holder. Dirty cloth curtains, mop sink, and grease on cooking equipment were noted. Floors under cooking equipment and the floor drain need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine interior and carpet need attention
summary: The ice machine interior needs debris removed. A large can opener and a cutting board need cleaning. A 3-compartment sink faucet leaks. Carpet in storage must be replaced, and raw wood doors need sealing.

headline: Failed: mold in ice machine; food too warm
summary: Pink and brown mold was found in the ice machine used for drinks; citation issued. Burgers at 88.5 to 90.9 degrees F and eggs and tomatoes held too warm were discarded. A refrigerator at 50 degrees F was tagged.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; no hair restraints
summary: Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Certificates were expired and a manager lacked allergen training proof. Milk crates are used as shelving, and an ice scoop was stored exposed on the ice machine.

headline: Prepared cold foods lacked date labels
summary: Ready-to-eat ham, roast beef and gyro sauce in the walk-in cooler had no date labels. No food handler training proof was provided. Prior thermometer and manager allergen certificate violations were not corrected; citation issued.

headline: No allergen training proof for managers
summary: Minor debris on dry storage and food prep floors needs cleaning. Food service managers had no proof of allergen training; the facility was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Cookware not inverted; grimy cold-hold drawers
summary: Large pots and bowls were not stored inverted. Front cold-hold drawers had grime and food debris. Rear prep walls near metal shelves had food splatters. The person in charge was instructed to clean these areas.

headline: Cutting board with open seams; stained ceiling
summary: A cutting board in front prep has open seams and orange stains and must be refinished or replaced. Cardboard lines walk-in cooler shelves and must be removed. Stained ceiling tiles near the walk-in freezer need repair.

headline: Failed: dead roach; no certified manager on site
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site while open; citation issued. A dead roach was found in damaged pipe encasing. Shellfish lacked tags; about 15 lbs mussels and 10 lbs oysters were discarded. Ice machine has black mold.

headline: Grease on shelves; leaking restroom faucet
summary: Grease built up on shelving and cabinet doors in the front kitchen, prep and soda areas. A leaky faucet at the men's and women's restroom hand sink needs repair.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; roaches found
summary: No city-certified food manager was on premises; citation issued. Cold food held at 48 to 60 degrees F was discarded (about $125). Dead roaches were found throughout; four live roaches were on a box and floor.

headline: Cooled chicken on floor; plate used in beans
summary: A plate was stored inside refried beans and used to transfer food; utensils must be used. Cooled chicken was stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Cardboard is under mats, and the rear hand sink lacks handwashing signage.

headline: Cooking equipment and floors need cleaning
summary: Cooking equipment has food spills to clean. A small leak is under the front bar's 1-compartment sink. Floors under the front bar need detail cleaning. All city sanitation certificate holders need allergen certificates.

headline: Broken thermometers in grab-and-go coolers
summary: Thermometers inside both reach-in grab-and-go coolers were broken. Staff were instructed to remove and replace them so they work properly.

headline: Greasy fryers, broken floor tiles, missing light shields
summary: A torn gasket is on the 1-door cooler and freezer. Grease is on the deep fryer and cooking equipment. Floor tiles are missing or broken near the walk-in cooler and bar. Light shields are missing, and a bulb is burned out.

headline: Failed: about 50 rodent droppings in storage
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were on the floors and corners of a newly renovated rear storage room; citation issued. Sticky fly traps hang in dish area. No consumer advisory on menus, and a food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: No certified manager on duty during service
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served; citation issued. A prep table with blenders has no hand sink. Cardboard and foil line shelves.

headline: Dirty floors behind front ovens
summary: Floors behind and below the ovens at the front of the premises were not clean. The facility was instructed to clean them.

headline: Shellfish tags missing; gap at rear door
summary: Shellfish in two containers had no tags; oysters were discarded (about $5). The rear exit door has an opening at the bottom corner. The high-temperature dish machine has no data plate, and a basement hand sink drain leaks.

headline: Failed: about 500 mouse droppings found
summary: About 500 mouse droppings were found throughout the kitchen, storage room, furnace room, walk-in cooler and office. No valid pest control receipt was on site; citation issued. Oil drips from the hood onto the floor.

headline: Splash guards needed; allergen certificate missing
summary: Splash guards are required on both sides of the front sushi-prep hand sink. A one-compartment prep sink must be installed for sushi prep. The certified food manager has no proof of allergen training.

headline: Dead roaches in sandwich prep area
summary: Dead roaches and insects were found under the bread cart and on shelves under ingredients in sandwich prep. The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap. Washroom lacks handwashing signage, and a wall hole needs sealing.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings; dish machine inoperable
summary: Over 30 rodent droppings lined the rear prep walls, with 10 more behind the water heater and 10 under cooking equipment. The dish machine was tagged. A leaking hand sink was corrected on site; citations issued.

headline: Stripped hot-water knob; unused equipment in dining
summary: The hot-water knob on the 3-compartment sink is stripped and must be repaired. The unisex toilet room lacks a covered trash receptacle. Unused refrigerators, a cold brew unit and an espresso machine are stored in the dining area.

headline: Rice on floor; hair restraints missing; grease buildup
summary: Rice bags were stored on the floor in rear storage. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Grease and debris are on woks, fryers and equipment, and ceilings and light shields are dusty.

headline: No pest logbook; no sanitizer, thermometer or soap
summary: No pest logbook was on site, and the last service ticket was from 2022; citation issued. No bodily-fluid cleanup kit, sanitizer, food thermometer or test strips were on site. Hand sinks lacked signage, soap and towels at first.

headline: Loose hot-water handle; debris on office shelf
summary: The hot-water handle at the hand sink next to the 3-compartment sink was loose; the manager was instructed to repair or replace it. Debris built up along a shelf base in the rear office.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm; citation issued
summary: Basement walk-in cooler #2 held cold food at 44 to 54 degrees F; about 20 lbs discarded and cooler tagged. Also: staff drank on prep table, ice machine reservoir dirty, no hair restraints, moldy racks, no commercial dumpster.

headline: Cutting boards have deep cuts; greasy fryers
summary: Cutting boards in the prep area have deep cuts and stains and must be replaced or restored. Heavy grease is under the fryers on the cook line and must be deep cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Wet wiping cloths and ice scoop stored improperly
summary: Wet wiping cloths sat on the prep table instead of in sanitizing solution. An ice scoop was stored in the ice bin. Grease built up on the outside oil tank. A prior allergen-training violation was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice chute; clutter; allergen proof missing
summary: The ice chute on the self-service ice dispenser was not clean and must be cleaned and sanitized. Clutter in the rear washroom must be removed. No proof of allergen training was on site for certified food managers.

headline: Broken freezer lid; loose hot water knob
summary: The deep freezer door or lid is in poor repair. The 3-compartment sink hot-water knob is loose and leaks. The washroom self-closing door and ventilation are not working. Dust covers kitchen walls and ceilings.

headline: Pest log missing; fly trap over dish area
summary: No current pest control logbook was on site. A fly trap hangs above the dish-area sink, which the food code prohibits in food areas. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Missing health policy and training proof; citations issued.

headline: Slow-draining hand sink; hood grease buildup
summary: The drive-through prep hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired. Clutter is on the floor in the rear warewashing area. Heavy dirt and grease are on the exhaust hood, pipes and filters.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; food held too warm
summary: No valid city-certified food manager was on site while meat loaf was served; citation issued. Chicken and beef at 49 to 92 degrees F were discarded. The reach-in cooler at 60 degrees F was tagged, and the ice machine has black mold.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; unused fryer on cook line
summary: No handwashing sign at the cook-line hand sink, no covered trash can in the unisex bathroom, and an unused fryer beside the cook-line hand sink. Two burnt-out hood bulbs also noted. Each was instructed to be fixed.

headline: Scoops stored in stagnant water
summary: Scoops were stored in stagnant water at room temperature. They must be kept under cold running water or in a clean, empty container.

headline: Missing thermometers; dirty floor drain
summary: Thermometers are missing from prep coolers. Multi-use utensils were not stored inverted. The floor drain and pipes at the 3-compartment sink have excessive debris. A women's restroom outlet cover is missing.

headline: Missing handwashing signs in several areas
summary: Several hand sinks in the warewashing area, rear kitchen and washrooms lack handwashing signs. Light fixtures above front and rear food prep areas provide inadequate light and need repair or replacement.

headline: Unapproved vacuum packing; unlabeled soup
summary: Sausages and fish were vacuum-packed on site without an approved HACCP (food safety) plan or CDPH approval; citation issued. Packaged soup lacked labels. Pans were stored on the walk-in cooler floor, and shelves are rusty.

headline: Door gap; food managers lack allergen certificates
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the Erie Street door sweep must be rodent-proofed. No allergen training certificates were shown for food managers; the facility was instructed to obtain them.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; beards unrestrained
summary: The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer at final rinse during use; priority violation. Bulk sugar was unlabeled. Long beards were not restrained at the cook line. Knives were wedged between prep tables.

headline: Grimy floor drain near coffee station
summary: A floor drain under the coffee station beside the service window had pink and brown grime. Staff were instructed to deep clean and sanitize it.

headline: Grease on grill, fryer and floor
summary: Grease must be cleaned from the side of the grill and the interior of the deep fryer. Grease on the floor beneath cooking equipment also needs cleaning.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The sanitation manager had no allergen training. Documentation must be provided.

headline: Food stored on floors in basement coolers
summary: Food was stored on the floor of the basement walk-in cooler and freezer and must be raised 6 inches. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Floors are dirty, and a small freezer needs a visible thermometer.

headline: Failed: no certified manager on site
summary: No certified food manager was on site while beef and deli meat were prepared; citation issued. The pest logbook was not accessible to staff, and test strips were inadequate. No soap in toilet room sink; floors in the butcher area are dirty.

headline: Grease and dirt on equipment, floors and hood
summary: Dust, dirt and grease covered cooking and non-cooking equipment, floors under and around equipment, and the hood vent system and filters. Staff were instructed to clean all of these areas.

headline: No cold running water at all three hand sinks
summary: All three exposed hand sinks had no cold running water; hot water measured 106 to 113 degrees F. A visible gap under the rear exit door was also noted, and the facility was instructed to rodent-proof it.

headline: Failed: rodent and insect activity, droppings
summary: About 50 small flies and 15 large flies were found, including near the ice machine and walk-in cooler. About 10 large droppings were at the bar. Gaps at the front door, sink problems, and a sewage backup; citation issued.

headline: Thermometers hard to see; hair restraint missing
summary: Thermometers could not be easily viewed and were moved to an accessible spot. A sandwich maker was not wearing a hair restraint and was instructed to wear one.

headline: Damaged hall wall; clutter near restroom
summary: The wall around a hallway utility box is damaged and must be made smooth and cleanable. Clutter in the hall near the restroom must be removed and organized.

headline: Failed: about 60 rodent droppings; live cat
summary: About 60 large rodent droppings were found across the sales floor, storage, office and toilet room; citation issued. A live cat walked through the beverage area and must be removed; citation issued.

headline: Failed: 300 lbs unsafe food; no hot water
summary: Cold food held too warm, including raw pork, tripe and chicken feet at 53 to 71 degrees F; about 300 lbs ($1,500) discarded. Hot water was missing in prep areas. Employee rinsed dishes improperly; ice machine had black mold.

headline: Dead insects; prior violations not corrected
summary: Dead insects were on the floors of the restroom and furnace room and must be removed. Prior violations were not corrected: missing floor tiles, damaged walls, missing baseboards, slow sinks, and low lighting. Citation issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; hand sinks faulty
summary: The low-temperature dish machine at the bar read 0 ppm sanitizer; chlorine must be at least 100 ppm. Hand sinks drain slowly, and the rear pizza prep sink has no cold running water. Repairs required.

headline: No health policy; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No written employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site. The mop sink must connect to the basement floor drain. The 3-compartment faucet leaks, and exposed wires need sealing.

headline: Floors needed detail cleaning in rear
summary: Floors under all storage shelves in the rear area and around the mop sink needed detail cleaning. The manager corrected all issues on site.

headline: Failed: no hot water in toilet-room sink
summary: The toilet-room hand sink measured 62.4 degrees F and must provide 100 degrees F. No vomit and diarrhea policy or supplies were on site. Floor tiles are broken and missing, and a wall has holes leading to the toilet room.

headline: Cold ready-to-eat foods above 41 degrees discarded
summary: Sushi, shrimp, tuna, noodles and other cold foods were held at 45.9 to 64.6 degrees F in a prep cooler; about 34 lbs ($250) discarded. The cooler at 68.7 degrees F was tagged; air later measured 35.3 degrees F.

headline: Failed: about 200 mouse droppings found
summary: About 200 mouse droppings were scattered under the bar, behind the safe, along the kitchen perimeter, on the fryer cover and in keg storage. Citation issued. A rear warehouse door gap and a hallway hole were also noted.

headline: Low hot water pressure; cardboard used as mats
summary: Handwashing signs are missing in popcorn and deli dish areas. Hot water pressure is low at the grill-station hand sink. Cardboard is used as floor mats in the meat room, and a wet mop was stored in a bucket.

headline: Dead roaches on glue boards; corrected on site
summary: Dead roaches were found on glue boards in prep areas. The boards were removed on site. A hole in the wall base at the front serving counter must be sealed.

headline: No food handler training proof; cloths stored improperly
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep surfaces. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer and cooler. An ice machine door cover is missing near the beverage station. Food containers lack labels, and one food handler lacked training proof.

headline: Cutting board, milk crates and floors need work
summary: A cutting board with deep seams and stains on the prep cooler needs refinishing or replacement. Milk crates are used as storage shelves. Floors along walls and corners in dry storage, the office closet and furnace room need detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm; dish machine underheated
summary: Shrimp, tzatziki, beef, salmon and short rib held at 48.6 to 56.8 degrees F; about 100 lbs ($1,000) discarded. Coolers at 52 to 60 degrees F were tagged. Dish machine final rinse at 130 degrees F was tagged; citations issued.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings; cold food too warm
summary: About 45 large rodent droppings were under a beverage dispenser cabinet, with 12 more under freezer units. Cold food at 55 to 71 degrees F was discarded (about $250). A cooler at 69.4 degrees F was tagged.

headline: Failed: display case at 45 degrees F
summary: A display case held food at 45 degrees F; the refrigerator unit must not be used until reinspected by CDPH. No written employee health policy was on site. Menus lacked a consumer advisory on undercooked foods.

headline: Unlabeled food storage containers
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels with the common names of their contents. The facility was instructed to provide labels.

headline: Food stored on floor in walk-in cooler
summary: Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised 6 inches. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags; food-grade bags are required. An ambient thermometer was missing in the front display cooler.

headline: Condensate pipe drains into hand sink
summary: A condensation pipe from the ceiling discharges directly into the hand sink in the main dish area. Condensate must drain from the discharge point to proper disposal, as required by law.

headline: Food stored on floor; no food handler proof
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in boxes in the walk-in freezer, cooler and storage areas and must be raised 6 inches. A food handler wasn't wearing a beard restraint. No food handler training proof or restroom handwashing signage.

headline: Food stored in mechanical room, under stairwell
summary: A deep freezer was stored in the mechanical room and under an open stairwell, which is prohibited. Equipment was also stored there. A cutting board is heavily grooved, and floor drains have excessive debris.

headline: Leaking faucet; dusty hood system
summary: The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks and needs repair. The cook-line wall needs coving. The hood vent and exhaust system have large dust buildup and need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine upper parts need cleaning
summary: Upper parts of the ice machine need cleaning. Blackened, moldy caulking at the dish machine must be replaced. The dirty floor drain and greasy wall under the dish machine also need cleaning.

headline: Detail cleaning and floor repairs needed
summary: Prep tables, food displays and reach-in coolers need detail cleaning. Deli cooking equipment has grease buildup. Broken and missing deli floor tiles let wastewater collect, and service-area floors need debris removed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; missing food handler training
summary: Dry storage containers of beans and flour lack product names. Foods were stored in grocery bags in the reach-in freezer. One male food handler lacked training proof. The manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Multiple repairs needed: floors, caulk, ceiling, faucets
summary: Missing floor grout in dish and prep areas, exposed foam-like caulk on walls and floor drains, a hole in the basement ceiling, and leaking bar hand sink and 3-compartment sink faucets. Repairs were instructed.

headline: Food stored on floor; sink faucet leaks
summary: Food was stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer and must be raised 6 inches. A small leak at the 3-compartment sink faucet needs repair.

headline: Food debris under ovens; dusty exhaust fan
summary: Dried food debris under and behind the bakery and toaster ovens needs detail cleaning. The exhaust fan above the oven has excessive dust. A baseboard in the customer washroom is missing.

headline: Clean equipment, leaking sink, dusty walls
summary: Clean the stove, fryer, prep tables, containers, steamer and microwave. Repair a drain leak under the dish-area hand sink. Clean grease from floors, walls and ceiling tiles, and seal corner seams in rear prep.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Several food handlers handled toasted bread, cheese and bacon with bare hands. The manager was instructed not to do so; priority violation. Clean utensils were placed on cloth towels to dry; staff were told to stop.

headline: Bloody liners in meat coolers; faucet leak
summary: Meat display cooler liners are stained with blood, dirt and debris and must be changed. The rear meat 3-compartment sink has a leaking right faucet. Meat prep walls have mold-like stains and blood splatters.

headline: No certified manager posted; no health policy
summary: No city sanitation certificate was posted, and a manager must be present when food is handled. No employee health policy was provided. The dish machine lacked test strips, and the previous inspection summary was not displayed.

headline: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedures on site
summary: No written procedure or supplies existed for vomit or diarrhea cleanup, including sanitizer that kills norovirus. The facility was instructed to provide them. No citation issued.

headline: No food service certificate posted; no summary
summary: No valid city food service sanitation certificate was posted for employees; citation issued. No current inspection summary was posted; citation issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning, and the dining room floor has deep cracks.

headline: Failed: no handwashing signs; greasy garbage area
summary: No handwashing signs were at the front bar and washroom sinks. Some staff lacked hair restraints, and wiping cloths were on prep tables. The outside grease container was encrusted and surrounded by grease, which is a food source for pests; citation issued.

headline: Failed: no health policy; sausage held too warm
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site; citations issued. The ice machine interior had a brown and pink substance. About 30 lbs of sausage at 54 to 55 degrees F were discarded.

headline: Clean fryer cabinet; add mop hooks
summary: Clean grease from the fryer cabinet interior. A hook system is needed to hang wet mops. A brick wall in rear dry storage has heavy calcium buildup and needs sealant or paint.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; damaged ceiling tile
summary: No chemical test kit was available for the chlorine dish machine; citation issued. The person in charge obtained test strips on site. Foil lines the bottoms of prep tables, and a ceiling tile in rear storage is damaged.

headline: Unlabeled containers; worn gaskets; greasy surfaces
summary: Shakers and squeeze bottles need labels. Sandwich cooler panels and gaskets are damaged or worn, and walk-in shelving, ice machine panel and grill have grease. Floor grout is missing under coolers and cooking equipment.

headline: Missing allergen certificate; leaks and rust noted
summary: The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate. Also noted: leaking faucet and pipe at the 3-compartment sink, rust on walk-in cooler racks, dirty gaskets, grease under equipment, water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Peeling ceiling plaster in washroom
summary: Ceiling plaster in the washroom is peeling. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Burnt-out bulb in prep refrigerator
summary: A blown-out light bulb inside the refrigerator in the prep and dishwashing area was noted. The facility was instructed to replace it.

headline: No hot water and no mop sink backflow device
summary: No hot water was found on premises, a priority violation; no citation issued, but hot water must be provided. The mop sink faucet also lacks a backflow prevention device, which must be provided.

headline: Broken washbowl and leaking hot water knob
summary: Right washbowl in women's toilet room does not work. Hot water knob on cooking-line handwash sink leaks. Manager instructed to fix washbowl and leak and maintain good plumbing.

headline: Water leak in rear storage; missing shield
summary: Water leak in rear storage near soda storage must be repaired. Dust on wall where ice machine was removed needs cleaning. Burned-out bulb in rear storage near water heater and missing protective shield in rear prep area must be fixed.

headline: Rear door gap; greasy floors; certificates missing
summary: Rear exit door to outside receptacle has at least a 1/4-inch gap, so it is not rodent-proof. No pests were observed. Grease and food debris under heavy equipment. No food handler certificates on site; person in charge lacks allergen training proof.

headline: No hot water at men's handwash sink; citation
summary: No hot water at men's employee/customer toilet room handwash sink; water measured at 63°F. Priority violation, citation issued. Refrigerator at 45°F with TCS foods; unit tagged and foods moved; citation issued. Cold holding unit lacks thermometer.

headline: Missing light shield in walk-in cooler
summary: A light shield was missing in the walk-in cooler. Inspector instructed the facility to install one and maintain it.

headline: Expired allergen training for certified manager
summary: Certified food manager's allergen training had expired. Manager instructed to renew certification and keep certificates on site for review.

headline: Dirty freezer gaskets, drains and storage racks
summary: Gaskets on small second-floor freezer have black buildup; beverage nozzle has slimy buildup. Bar hand sink needs a splashguard. Spice rack has debris buildup. Drains in several areas have grime and organic debris. Kitchenware stored upright should be inverted.

headline: No employee health policy or training on site
summary: No employee health policy or training was found on site, a priority foundation violation; facility must establish one and keep verifiable documents on site. Both restroom doors lack self-closing devices.

headline: Bare-hand food handling; cooler too warm; citation
summary: Employee wearing gloves touched ready-to-eat fried potatoes and sausage patties, then wiped prep table and portioned food without changing gloves or washing hands; citation issued. Cooler at 46.5°F, food still frozen; maintenance called. Eating and drinking in prep area.

headline: Frozen food in plastic grocery bags
summary: Frozen food stored in plastic grocery bags inside refrigeration units at rear storage; must use food-grade bags or containers. Detail cleaning required for fryer, wok sides, coolers, gaskets, dish machine top and carts.

headline: Dirty cooling units and soiled mops
summary: Cooling units in prep area need cleaning; plumbing fixtures in toilet room need cleaning. Soiled mops stored improperly inside mop water and beside shelving; must be hung to dry to prevent pest breeding.

headline: No pest control logbook; license number missing
summary: No pest control logbook on site at inspection; must be provided with full name and receipts. Truck must display license number on the side. Corrected: no citation issued for pest logbook violation.

headline: Damaged floors, chipped walls, burned-out bulbs
summary: Missing, broken and damaged floor tiles in dish room with worn grout; floors must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable. Chipped paint and a 2-by-2 inch hole in wall at three-compartment sink. Two burned-out light bulbs must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager on duty; sinks lack hot water
summary: No certified food manager on duty while TCS food was sliced, handled and served; citation issued. Several handwash sinks had no hot water or were loose or inoperable; repairs required. Missing food storage labels, unelevated boxes, rusty shelves, and missing thermometers.

headline: No certified sanitation manager; thawing issues
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation manager on site while chicken was being prepped; citation issued. Frozen chicken was thawing in a plastic container at room temperature; manager told to use approved methods. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Live flies, rodent droppings, warm cooler; citation
summary: About 30 live large black flies in butcher and rear prep areas; about 40 rodent droppings in taqueria prep area and under equipment. Pest control and cleaning required; citation issued. Cooked steak and pork at 56–59°F discarded; walk-in cooler at 58.9°F; no thermometers; citation.

headline: Cold food held too warm; food discarded
summary: Cold TCS foods, including brownie trifle and yogurt parfait, held at 46–63.7°F; must be 41°F or below. About 26 lbs ($404) discarded by manager; citation issued. Corrected on site: norovirus cleanup kit proof provided. Also: milk past discard date, missing splashguard.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; grease buildup
summary: Milk crates used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas; must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off floor. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelving; floors under equipment and in corners in prep, dishwashing, storage and basement need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine black and pink buildup; citation issued
summary: Black substance on ice chute and walls of seafood ice machine; black and pink substance inside dispenser of Stan's Donuts ice machine, in contact with ice used for consumption. Priority foundation violation; citation issued. Also: missing handwash signs and leaking sprayer.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site at inspection; all employees must complete training and keep records on site. To-go items stored face-up on prep shelf were corrected by instruction to invert equipment.

headline: Hand sink water too cold; citation issued
summary: Hand sink water temperature measured between 72°F and 83°F, and minimum must be 100°F; citation issued. Wet floors in dishwashing area must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink; slow drain
summary: Leak at bottom of three-compartment sink middle compartment; handsink next to it drains slowly; manager must repair. Pop crates, boxes and other items stored on floor near rear dish area; litter on floor behind counter.

headline: No soap at front handwash sink; flies in prep
summary: No hand soap at front prep handwash sink; soap was brought to sink during inspection. About 30–40 small flies on cabinets, counters and walls in main prep area; pest control required. Floors and walls need cleaning of splatters and flies.

headline: Food stored on floor; leaking hot water faucet
summary: Frosting buckets and cases and single-use boxes were stored on the floor in a converted dry storage room; items must be 6 inches up. Hot water leaks from a faucet next to the three-compartment sink. Lighting out in storage and exhaust hood over fryers.

headline: Clutter under stairwell; soiled mop heads
summary: Clutter stored under stairwell to second floor storage area must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Soiled mop heads not properly stored; must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Cold foods too warm; flies; citation issued
summary: Cold TCS foods held at 46–53°F; manager discarded lettuce, kale and cooked vegetables (about $15); citation issued. More than 10 small flies in bar area and 3 in dish area; pest service required; citation issued. Also: cracked ice machine lid, debris under sink.

headline: Over 30 rat droppings in basement storage
summary: Over 30 rat droppings in basement storage; manager told to call an exterminator and clean. Cooler at 73°F; repair required; priority citation. Rear exit door has 1/2-inch gaps at bottom corners; must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Missing gaskets on reach-in cooler
summary: Gaskets on two-door reach-in cooler in kitchen area are partially missing and in poor repair; must be repaired or replaced. Nonfood-contact interior of one-door cooler soiled. Wiping cloth and rubber bands used on three-compartment sink faucet must be removed.

headline: Dust, food debris and spills throughout kitchen
summary: Dust on fan guards in walk-in cooler; food debris and spills on cooking equipment, beverage machines, holding units, prep tables and coolers. Food debris and spills on floors under equipment and along walls in prep and storage. Manager instructed to clean.

headline: No certified manager; open drinks near prep
summary: No certified food service manager on site, and no certificate posted while chicken and beef were handled; priority violation. Open drinks on prep table; bulk flour unlabeled; deli cups not air-dried; inadequate lighting at main walk-in cooler.

headline: No certified manager; repeat sanitizer violation
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on site while open and operating; citation issued. Two employees had no hair restraints. Priority violation from prior report not corrected: no sanitizer test strip kit on site; citation issued.

headline: Wood ceilings in prep areas
summary: Wood paneled ceilings in prep areas are smooth and cleanable. Inspector recommends a drop ceiling for kitchen prep areas. No violations were cited.

headline: Customers could touch food; cleanup supplies missing
summary: Food in a cold unit and single-use items at a prep station lacked barriers against customer contact; inspector ordered barriers installed. Vomit/diarrhea cleanup items were not on site. Also: rust, leaking handwash drain, no covered receptacle, dirty dumpster pad, no allergen certificates.

headline: No certified manager; thawing and TCS food issues
summary: No certified food service manager on site and no certificate posted while chicken and rice were handled. Frozen food was thawed improperly in a prep sink at room temperature. Manager must obtain certification and correct thawing practices. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Ice machine rust and slime; warm soup, rice
summary: Ice machine interior has excessive rust and black slime, and water drips onto ice; must be cleaned and sanitized, citation issued. Soup at 51.4°F and rice at 44.6°F in reach-in cooler; about 27.5 lbs (about $40) discarded; citation issued. Prior violations not corrected.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; expired food handler certificate
summary: Torn door gasket inside one-door stand-up cooler in rear must be replaced. A food handler had an expired certificate; employee must show proof of training for all food handlers.

headline: Cracked concrete floor; food debris on surfaces
summary: Concrete floor in rear prep and dish area chipped and cracked; must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable. Food debris and spills on floors and surfaces in first and second floor prep areas. Expired food handler certificates; records must be kept current.

headline: Mouse droppings found in several prep areas; citation
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. About 25–35 mouse droppings in front and rear prep areas, under the service counter; pest control needed; citation issued. Sinks lacked hot or cold water; citation issued.

headline: Dead flies in drink cooler and on floors
summary: Dead large and small flies in display drink cooler and on floors under chip racks near the front door; must be removed and cleaned. Raw wood shelves in rear storage must be sealed or painted. Missing light shield above soda rack.

headline: Unlabeled flour and sugar; soiled mop head
summary: Some food items, including flour and sugar, lacked labels showing ingredients or allergens; manager instructed to provide labels. Soiled mop head not properly stored; must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep; citation
summary: No City of Chicago food service sanitation manager on site while time-sensitive foods were prepared, cooked, served and stored; citation issued. Original certificate must be posted. Mop stored improperly in mop sink area. No allergen training proof on site.

headline: Missing handwash sign; spilled soda syrup, glass
summary: Bar handwash sink had no handwashing sign. Basement alcohol storage had leaking soda syrup, glass shards and debris on floor; manager told to clean. Also: grease on used cooking oil container, a missing light bulb over the grill, and dust on prep-area vents.

headline: Live flies in dining and restroom areas
summary: About 5 large and 10 small live flies found in customer area, toilet room and by utility sink. Citation issued. Dumpster lid half missing, overflowing garbage; citation issued. Also: liquor stored in toilet room and on floor, no covered receptacle in restroom.

headline: Grease and debris on grill; dirty freezer
summary: Inside of reach-in freezer needs detail cleaning; grill and flattop sides have grease buildup and small debris. Floor in front service area near the cash register needs detail cleaning. Manager told to clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Missing handwash sign; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Handwash sink in mezzanine toilet room needs a handwashing sign. Stained and missing ceiling tiles in mezzanine staff storage closet must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Scoop stored on lid; debris in basement
summary: Scoop stored on lid of white chocolate container in basement dry storage, instructed to store with handle above food. No covered receptacle in all-gender customer washroom. Debris on floors and along walls in basement and dry storage; grime under three-compartment sink.

headline: Employee health policy form not on site
summary: Employee health policy form was found for one employee, but a signed policy must be on site at all times; priority violation, no citation issued. No lid on garbage container in vehicle; must be provided and maintained.

headline: Broken thermometer; grease and trash at refuse area
summary: Broken thermometer for upright cooler in front prep area must be replaced. Grease buildup between grill and shelving in front prep area. Excessive trash around refuse receptacles and behind freezer chest must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Ice machine interior needs cleaning
summary: The inside of the ice machine must be cleaned. This was the only item noted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; citation issued
summary: Low-temperature dish machine was not in use with 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer; repair and maintenance required; priority violation. Menus had incomplete raw/undercooked food advisories. Front door gap of about 1/4 inch at bottom left; manager must make door tight-fitting.

headline: Panini grill lacks proper ventilation; restroom bin
summary: Panini grill sat next to pizza prep area without adequate ventilation; must be moved under ventilation. Employee lower-level toilet room had no covered receptacle; must be provided.

headline: Leaking drainpipe under serving-area handsink
summary: Leaking drainpipe under handwash sink in serving area must be repaired. Spills and debris on equipment and inside self-service beverage cabinets must be cleaned. Floor drains in all areas need cleaning. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager during fried food service
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager present while fried fish and chicken were prepared and served; citation issued. Also: no handwashing signs, a damaged gasket on a cold unit near fryers, and buildup on cold-holding shelves.

headline: Rodent droppings in basement; citation issued
summary: About 20–30 large rodent droppings in rear basement along north wall; no food stored there and none found in first-floor prep areas. Pest control needed; citation issued. Single-use plastic cups used as scoops in bulk containers; personal care items above dry food shelf.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Three-compartment sink faucet was leaking; manager instructed to repair it. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Bread and food left uncovered in kitchen
summary: Several food items, including bread, were uncovered in the kitchen. Manager instructed to keep food covered to prevent contamination.

headline: Mop sink near clean utensils; knives stored wedged
summary: Mop sink sits between clean utensil shelves with a garbage bag as splash barrier; permanent barrier required. Knives wedged between prep tables and large spoons left in standing water. Deli cups stacked wet and used as bulk scoops; chipped walls behind pot racks.

headline: No employee health policy; missing backflow devices
summary: No employee health policy was found on premises; no citation issued, but one must be provided. Two basement ice machines, a bar coffee machine and a mop sink lack backflow prevention devices; these must be provided in serviceable locations.

headline: Multiple violations; no health policy or pest log
summary: No verifiable employee health policy; citation issued. Handwash soap missing in employee washroom, corrected on site. Non-working thermometer; no pest control logbook; citation issued. Missing wall panel, damaged gaskets, buildup in walk-in cooler, and no allergen certificates.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Certified food manager did not have an allergen training certificate on site. Management was instructed that all certified food managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: Black substance found inside ice machine
summary: Black, dark substance found at the lip and inside the ice machine; manager ordered ice removed and machine cleaned and sanitized. Citation issued. Also: utensils stored between reach-in and cutting area, dirty can opener and cooking equipment, a mop-area hose leak, dirty floors, and no allergen certificate.

headline: Chili kept past discard date; citation issued
summary: Three containers of cooked chili dated 12/18 were in the refrigerator near restrooms, past the seven-day limit; about 10 lbs (about $75) discarded. Citation issued. Also: dirty dicer, damaged prep-area floors, manager lacks allergen training, and expired core-violation items not corrected.

headline: No certified manager while serving TCS food
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on premises while chicken, salads and soups were prepared and served; citation issued. Also: handwash signs missing in several areas, unlabeled white containers under prep tables, and no covered waste can in women's employee washroom.

headline: Mop sink lacks backflow device; doors not self-closing
summary: Mop sink has no backflow prevention device; one must be installed so it can be serviced. Staff and customer toilet rooms lack self-closing door devices; these must be provided.

headline: No certified manager; chemicals stored near food
summary: Person in charge lacked a sanitation manager certificate, and none was on site while chicken and eggs were handled; citation issued. Oven cleaner and other toxic items were stored above food prep sink; citation issued. Clogged three-compartment sink drained slowly; cleared during inspection; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty coolers and freezers
summary: Two bulk storage containers at prep station had no labels and must be labeled. Open food in deep freezer was not protected; food must be stored in food-grade containers or bags. Leaky hand sink pipe must be repaired; floors and coolers dirty.

headline: Improper beef thawing; repeat violations; citation
summary: Repeat core violations not corrected from prior report: beef thawed improperly and expired allergen training certificate. Manager must correct thawing and allergen compliance; priority violation, citation issued. Heavy grease on used cooking oil container in rear parking area.

headline: No certified manager on site; cooler and dish machine issues
summary: No certified food manager on site while beef and chicken were prepared; priority citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer; corrected on site to 100 ppm after technician arrived; citation issued. Expired food handler training and missing allergen certificates.

headline: Handwash sink not conveniently located
summary: Handwash sink was not conveniently located for the rear prep area staff; manager must install one in an accessible location. Priority foundation violation; no citation issued.

headline: Pushcart needs license number and name
summary: Pushcart must display its license number and name at least 2 inches in size on lateral sides.

headline: Greasy exhaust hood and filters
summary: Dirt and grease buildup inside and on edges of exhaust hood and filters above cooking equipment; must be detail-cleaned and maintained.

headline: Flies on food equipment; rodent droppings found
summary: About 30 live black flies in prep area, on equipment and sink basins; about 20 small rodent droppings near basement chip rack. Citation issued; pest control service and removal of droppings required. Also: broken cooling unit handle, and many repeat core violations including dirty cooler and clutter.

headline: Unlabeled containers; torn freezer gaskets
summary: Food storage containers (flour, sugar, cinnamon) under front prep tables must be labeled with common names. Torn gaskets inside reach-in freezer in rear storage area must be repaired.

headline: Food debris, dirt and clutter throughout kitchen
summary: Boxed food stored on floor in rear prep area; person in charge told to raise items at least six inches. Accumulated food debris on cooking equipment, coolers and shelving; dirty floors under equipment and along walls; no mechanical ventilation in employee toilet room.

headline: About 75 live fruit flies; citation issued
summary: About 75 live fruit flies in basement area; person in charge must abate activity, clean and inform pest control; citation issued. Also: leaking handwash pipe in meat packaging room, uncovered restroom waste receptacle, and missing basement ceiling drywall exposing pipe.

headline: Wiping cloths and utensils improperly stored
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Multi-use scrapers and clean knives were stored between the wall and behind the three-compartment sink; they must be stored in a clean, protected manner.

headline: Rear patio door gap; food on box floor
summary: Front entrance patio door has a 1/2-inch gap and must be made rodent-proof; no pests were observed. Food on boxes in walk-in cooler must be raised off the floor. Dirt and debris in basement floor drains; dust on washroom vents.

headline: No written employee health policy; missing thermometers
summary: No written employee health policy on site; facility must establish one with signed copies; priority violation, no citation. Missing metal stem and ambient air thermometers. No pest control log book. No sneeze guard at second-floor buffet; installation required.

headline: Unlabeled flour and sugar containers
summary: Bulk storage containers of flour and sugar had no labels; person in charge instructed that all bulk and working ingredient containers must be labeled with contents' names.

headline: Trash and product on floors in aisles
summary: Heavy equipment and garbage receptacles in produce prep area had dried food splatter, which must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage. Floors under shelving in aisles 11 and 12 had accumulated trash and product; manager told to clean.

headline: Rodent droppings and live flies; citation issued
summary: About 50 mouse droppings under dry storage shelves and in washroom corner; about 50 live small flying insects on walls, ceiling and boxes, and behind wok and stove. Pest control service needed; citation issued. Also: heavy grease and buildup on prep tables and floor.

headline: No HACCP records for smoking and curing
summary: No records were maintained for the approved HACCP plan covering smoking, curing and reduced oxygen packaging of meats. This is a priority foundation violation.

headline: No allergen training on site for managers
summary: No allergen training was on site for City of Chicago food managers. Management instructed that all managers complete allergen training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 50 mouse droppings
summary: Pasta salad, potato salad and cheese in prep cooler measured 45–51°F; cold foods must be kept at or below 41°F. Citation issued. Basement storage had about 50 mouse droppings; cleaning and additional pest control required. Citation issued.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at zero; tagged out
summary: Bottom-floor dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer; it was not in use, was tagged, and manager must reach 50 ppm. Olives and fruit uncovered at bar. Also: rust on shelving, no drain plugs at bar sink, oversized pots for sink, and ceiling leak with open hole.

headline: Hot holding unit on soda crates; grease buildup
summary: Hot holding unit supported by soda crates; must be repaired or replaced and crates discontinued for support. Cutting board with dark stains and deep grooves must be replaced. Grease near three-compartment sink and grease trap must be cleaned.

headline: Mouse droppings and dead mouse; citation issued
summary: Dead mouse on glue board in basement corrected on site. Over 100 mouse droppings in basement and 40 under dishmachine and prep tables; cleaning and pest control service required before reinspection; citation issued. Food handler training certificates missing.

headline: Dead mice, about 200 droppings; citation issued
summary: Dead mouse on glue board under exposed handwash sink and dead mouse in basement. About 200 mouse droppings found around sinks, behind smoker, in dry storage, washroom and basement. Pest control service required throughout premises; citation issued. Prior grease-hood violation not corrected.

headline: Straws stored near handwash sink; floor debris
summary: Unwrapped straws were stored under the paper towel dispenser near a handwash sink in the prep area; manager told to remove single-use items from handwashing areas. Debris found on floors and inside floor drains in prep area; manager told to clean.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Certified food manager had no food allergen training on site. Manager instructed to ensure all certified managers have allergen certificates.

headline: Greasy walls; expired allergen training; citation
summary: Grease on walls behind hand sink and cooking equipment must be cleaned. Previous core violation not corrected: no allergen training certificates for certified managers; priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: Bartender used bare hands on lime garnish
summary: Bartender used bare hands to squeeze lime onto a customer's drink rim; instructed to discard, priority violation with citation issued. Sink stoppers in poor repair at two concession stands; peeling paint at popcorn and ice cream stand and at Lilly Q hot holding area.

headline: Cold sandwich ingredients too warm; discarded
summary: Roast beef at 49.7°F, chicken at 47.9°F, turkey at 48.3°F and eggs at 46.8°F in sandwich prep cooler; must be 41°F or below. Person in charge discarded all affected items; priority violation, citation issued. Soiled mop head not properly stored.

headline: Burnt-out kitchen bulbs; missing ceiling access panel
summary: Burnt-out light bulbs inside fixtures in fifth-floor kitchen prep area must be replaced. Missing ceiling access panel at prep area entrance must be provided. Low cold water pressure at sixth-floor men's handwash sink. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Live roaches on prep area walls; complaint
summary: Two live roaches on prep area walls; manager must remove all roach activity before reinspection. Dead roaches also on prep walls. Pest control operator advised. Priority foundation violation under 7-38-020(A).

headline: No pest control logbook; no allergen certificate
summary: No pest control logbook or inspection record on site; licensed pest control technician must inspect and records kept on site; priority violation. No handwashing signs at front and rear prep sinks. No allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Missing handwash sign; sauce on storage lids
summary: No handwashing sign at the bar handwash sink. Lids on bulk containers were covered in sauce and not sanitary; black and pink buildup inside ice machine. Rear storage near back door is cluttered and disorganized; manager must declutter.

headline: No city sanitation certificate; flies; citation
summary: Person in charge and posted certificate both lacked City of Chicago sanitation certificate; citation issued. Unused fly eliminator must be removed. Bulk foods unlabeled, bearded cook without restraint, and dirty dishwasher, shelves and walls. Holes in basement ceiling must be sealed.

headline: Unlabeled containers, dirty freezer, broken dishwasher
summary: Storage containers lacked common-name labels; no thermometer in beverage cooler; bearded cooks lacked beard restraints; utensils stored in food containers. Excess ice in walk-in freezer. Inoperable dishwasher must be removed from the premises.

headline: Re-inspection Pass: hoses drain into hand sink
summary: Two hoses drained into an exposed hand sink in front prep; must be rerouted. Dirt and food debris under cook line and dish machine; peeling baseboard; heavy grease and dust on hood filters above oven.

headline: Pass: food on floors, heavy grease buildup
summary: Food stored on walk-in cooler and freezer floors; manager told to elevate it six inches. Heavy grease and debris under sinks, equipment, and cooks line; fryer oil filter dirty; debris around dumpster. Detail cleaning instructed.

headline: Fail: door gap, paper goods in restroom
summary: Gap under southeast door must be sealed; no pests seen. Paper food products stored in toilet room must be moved. Expired food handler certificates. A previous core violation was not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: Canvass Pass: rusty shelves, cardboard liners, tape repair
summary: Rusty shelving in cook line reach-in and a melted plastic pitcher must be replaced. Cardboard liner in kitchen must be removed. Tape used on bar hand sink splashguard. No self-closing staff restroom door or covered waste bin.

headline: Canvass Pass: unlabeled packaged salsa, sandwiches
summary: Packaged salsa and sandwiches in display cooler lacked proper labels; must include business name, address, and ingredients. Food spills and debris on coolers and freezers. Dust on rear ventilation hood.

headline: Short Form Pass: hair restraints, plates stored face-up
summary: Two pastry employees worked without hair restraints; instructed to wear one. Plates stored face-up at service line; instructed to invert. Mineral buildup inside soda dispenser; open drink cup on operating dish machine.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: blocked hand sinks, 0 ppm sanitizer
summary: Hand sink between cook line and dish room lacked paper towels; bar hand sink blocked by pizza racks; citations issued. Low-temperature dish machine at bar had 0 ppm chlorine; tagged and held. Grease and grime behind fryers.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: pork held too cool, discarded
summary: Pork in the front hot-holding unit measured 116°F to 126°F, below the required 135°F for hot TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold). About 25 lbs ($205) discarded; citation issued.

headline: Complaint Pass: door gap, unlabeled display items
summary: Half-inch gap around rear exterior door must be repaired. Insect control device above dry food must be moved. Single-use paper cup used as scoop. Display cooler lacks internal thermometer; packaged items lacked required labels and were withheld.

headline: Fail: no certified manager, no sanitizer test strips
summary: No certified food manager on site on arrival while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were prepared and served; citation issued. No test strips to measure quat sanitizer concentration; citation issued.

headline: Pass: dry storage needs more lighting
summary: Inspector noted not enough lighting inside the dry storage area. Manager instructed to add lighting there.

headline: Pass: ice machine calcium, dirty shelves and walls
summary: Ice machine interior panel has calcium buildup. Storage shelves, microwave interior, cooking equipment sides, and fryer bottoms have excessive debris. Walls behind the three-compartment sink and wall bases are heavily soiled.

headline: Pass: food debris in prep-area floor drains
summary: Food debris built up in floor drains in prep areas. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Pass: ice machine debris, no food handler certificates
summary: Debris encrusted inside ice machine must be removed and cleaned. Broken light shield above three-compartment sink. No food handler certificates on premises; certified manager's allergen training expired.

headline: Pass: wall opening under drink station
summary: Opening along wall base under self-serve drink station must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Certified manager on duty lacks required allergen training.

headline: Canvass Fail: food held too warm, clogged drain
summary: Various TCS foods held at 46°F to 55°F; manager discarded about $100 of food. Cooler and front pie display cooler ambient air at 55°F and 52°F; rear prep cooler tagged. Floor drain under dish machine completely clogged; citation issued.

headline: Pass: milk on floor, utensils stored in food
summary: Milk stored on walk-in cooler floor; uncovered food in prep containers. In-use utensils stored inside food containers. No proof of food handler training for workers on duty. Instructed to correct each item.

headline: Pass: floors under equipment need cleaning
summary: Floors along wall bases and under equipment must be cleaned and maintained, especially at the dishwashing area and front counter by the ice cream machine.

headline: License Fail: dead mouse, pest gaps, no vomit procedures
summary: Dead mouse on floor in rear storage; 1/4-inch gap under front and rear doors; no pest control log. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedures or supplies; no employee health policy; no commercial dumpster.

headline: Pass: beef thawed on counter, unlabeled dry goods
summary: Frozen beef was thawing on a rear counter; instructed to thaw under refrigeration or cold running water. Wiping cloths improperly stored; dry storage items lacked common-name labels; stained cutting board; certified manager needs allergen training.

headline: Pass: food handler and allergen training needed
summary: Food handlers were instructed to obtain required food handler training certificates. City-certified food service managers must obtain required food allergen training.

headline: Complaint Pass: milk crates, dirty deep fryer
summary: Milk crates may not be used to elevate stored items. Deep fryer inside cabinet must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: no health policy or vomit kit
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea kit on premises; citations issued. Food handlers lacked required hair restraints; corrected on site. Food handlers and managers need required training. Washroom hand sink leaks.

headline: Pass: food boxes on floor, no hair restraint
summary: Food boxes stored on walk-in cooler floor, and an employee lacked a hair restraint in prep. Ice scoops stored inside ice bins. No food handler certificates on site; certified manager lacks allergen training. Also missing hand-washing sign and dirty bar floors.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: Low-temperature dish machine in Boleo Bar had 0 ppm chlorine; tagged and not in use. Raw-food consumer advisory missing from menu, corrected on site. Ice bins lacked covers. A grease trap could not be verified.

headline: Pass: cooler gaskets, dust, bar floor litter
summary: Ripped cooler door gaskets, dusty prep cooler condensers, and food litter on the bar floor were noted; manager instructed to repair, clean, and maintain. A burned-out light above the dish machine must be replaced.

headline: Complaint Pass: stained boards, torn gasket, grease
summary: Mold-like buildup and grease on storage racks and cooking equipment; torn gasket on rear dairy walk-in cooler; missing hand-washing signage; unlabeled bulk containers; stained cutting boards and improperly stored pots.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: cold foods too warm, discarded
summary: Turkey, black beans, eggs, and chicken in the cooler measured 44.8°F to 48.6°F, above the 41°F limit for cold TCS foods. Manager voluntarily discarded about 20 lbs ($250). Cooler unit at 50°F; citation issued.

headline: Canvass Pass: disposable cups used as scoops
summary: Disposable cups were used as scoops for bulk food containers. Instructed to use a proper scoop.

headline: Re-inspection Pass w/ Conditions: no CFM on premises
summary: No city-certified food service manager on premises; citation issued. Expired food handler training proof. Debris and spills on floors in rear prep, under the three-compartment sink, and in the hallway; wet mop stored in bucket.

headline: Canvass Pass: cardboard liner, dirty reach-in
summary: Cardboard used as liner in rear prep reach-in cooler; instructed to remove. Interior of reach-in coolers needs detail cleaning.

headline: Conditions: handled cash then made sandwiches unwashed
summary: Staff handled cash and cards, then made sandwiches without washing hands; corrected on site. No certified food manager (CFM) on duty while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were prepared. Also no food handler training or employee health policy.

headline: Fail: no person in charge, no CFM on duty
summary: No person in charge (PIC) present, and no certified food manager (CFM) on duty while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were prepared; citation issued. Undercooked hamburgers served without a consumer advisory. Employees ate and drank in prep areas.

headline: Re-inspection Fail: no CFM while eggs, lattes prepared
summary: No certified food manager on site while eggs and lattes were prepared; manager arrived at 9:20 AM; citation issued. Display cooler door falls off when opened. No chemical test kit; allergen training proof missing, a repeat violation.

headline: Fail: no hand soap, paper towels, or sink
summary: Hand soap and paper towels missing at women's restroom sink; no hand sink in men's restroom. Soiled wiping cloths left on prep tables; food stored in plastic grocery bags. Grease and debris on cooking equipment; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: expired ready-to-eat foods discarded
summary: Expired refrigerated ready-to-eat foods found, including stuffed peppers, al pastor, chorizo, pork skin, and corn with squash, past the 7-day limit. About 25 lbs ($250) discarded; citation issued.
