headline: License Pass: dirty display cooler, scrap near dumpster
summary: Display cooler shelves had a black substance; instructed to clean. Scrap materials stored near dumpster and on wall; must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Washroom ventilation not working and heavily dusty.

headline: Complaint Pass: dirty dough tray cover, floor debris
summary: Plastic dough tray cover must be detail cleaned or replaced. Food debris on floors under soda machine boxes and on bottom shelves of rear prep tables must be cleaned.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: raw fish too warm, dead bugs
summary: Raw fish found at 58.9°F to 60°F on sink rims and drainboard; about 25 lbs ($185) discarded; citation issued. Dead bugs on floors by walk-in freezer and in office. Ice scoop stored atop ice machine.

headline: Canvass Pass: broken splash guard, leaks
summary: Broken splashguard at hand sink by prep table must be repaired. Ice buildup around condensers in reach-in and walk-in; leaks behind ice machine and at dishroom sink. Dish machine needs deliming. No food handler certificate on site.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: clogged hand sink, repaired on site
summary: Hand sink at dishwashing area was clogged and not accessible; citation issued. A plumber repaired the sink and clog before the inspection ended.

headline: Pass: missing cooler thermometers, mop sink leak
summary: Two reach-in coolers had no thermometers; one was provided during inspection. Leak at mop sink faucet in kitchen must be serviced. Paper towel dispenser in dishwashing area damaged; repair or replace.

headline: License Pass: rusty shelves, milk crates for elevation
summary: Rusty, dirty shelves in seafood-area walk-in coolers; torn, dirty rubber strips on produce cooler doors. Milk crates used for elevation must be replaced with proper shelving. Heavy dust on kitchen ceiling and fans.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: refrigerator at 47.7°F, tagged
summary: Three-door refrigerator measured 47.7°F, above the 41°F limit, and was tagged; no TCS foods inside at the time. Grease buildup near fryer and floors; cardboard boxes on floor; toilet door not self-closing.

headline: Canvass Pass: no running water at dish sink
summary: Dishwashing-area hand sink had no running cold water and must be provided. Noodle cooling method inadequate; raw shrimp stored directly on ice. Wet mops stored throughout kitchen; loose bar sink faucet.

headline: Canvass Pass: dust on walk-in shelves, greasy hoods
summary: Dust and soil buildup on walk-in cooler shelves and ceiling; instructed to clean. Grease and dust accumulation on hoods above griddle; instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Pass: no food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates on site for food handling employees; person in charge must obtain them. Food debris on bottom of a multi-door reach-in cooler, and no covered receptacle for sanitary products in restroom.

headline: Pass: dirty ice bin, unlabeled bulk flour and sugar
summary: Ice bin interior needs cleaning; remove ice and detail clean. Bulk flour and sugar containers unlabeled in bakery. Cutting boards with open seams and stains need replacing. Grease buildup on exhaust hoods and filters; all instructed to correct.

headline: License Fail: missing certificates, pest log, thermometers
summary: No printed certified manager certificate, employee health policy, or pest control log on site. No probe thermometer for TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold); no thermometers in holding equipment. No food handler or allergen certificates on site.

headline: Canvass Pass: items on floor, tin foil liner
summary: Items stored on floor in front prep must be elevated. Tin foil used as liner on cooking equipment must be removed. Missing hand-washing signs and covered waste receptacle. Dust, missing ceiling tiles, and floor drain debris in rear prep.

headline: Canvass Pass: preset tableware uncovered
summary: Preset tableware was left uncovered on tables. Instructed to provide covers to prevent contamination.

headline: Canvass Fail: food on floors, sink draining issues
summary: Food stored on walk-in and freezer floors; frozen meat thawing in a plastic container. Ready-to-eat TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) lacked date marks. Three-compartment sink not draining properly; citation issued.

headline: Canvass Fail: about 50 rodent droppings found
summary: About 50 small rodent droppings found in prep area, cooler floor, under sink, and storage rooms. Pest control recommended; citation issued. Toilet door not self-closing; gaps between walls and floors in storage and prep.

headline: License Pass: missing hand-washing signs, wall opening
summary: No hand-washing signs at sinks in front prep, rear prep, and all-gender restroom. Opening at base of rear double doors toward the dumpster must be sealed to keep pests out.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: no hand washing after nose wiping
summary: Food handler wiped her nose, then handled clean plates and bowls without washing hands; corrected on site. Hand sink blocked by a bucket and lacked soap. Three-compartment sink sanitizer at 0.0 ppm; citation issued.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: no soap or towels at prep sink
summary: No soap or paper towels at rear prep sink; manager obtained them during inspection; citation issued. Fish thawed in vacuum packaging; wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer; worn cutting boards; cooler and cooking equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Pass: employee lacked food handler certificate
summary: A food handling employee lacked a food handler training certificate. Management was instructed that all food handling employees must show proof of training.

headline: Canvass Pass: door gap, rust, broken floor tiles
summary: About 1/4-inch gap under rear exit door toward trash; seal needed. Large basement cutting board stained and grooved. Rust on basement shelving; broken floor tiles with standing water. New manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection Pass: dead cockroaches in basement
summary: Several dead cockroaches found on basement floor; must be detail cleaned. Unused equipment and articles in storage area must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. Debris on floors in utility and storage areas.

headline: Pass: entry gaps, damaged refrigerator gaskets
summary: Openings at the base of front and rear double doors must be sealed to keep pests out; no pests seen. Damaged gaskets on a rear two-door refrigerator need repair. Employee washroom needs mechanical ventilation installed.

headline: License Pass: no vomit cleanup supplies, no utility sink
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedures or supplies on site; 90-day grace period given. No utility sink for cleaning mops; must install one. Uncovered waste receptacle in unisex restroom must be covered.

headline: Canvass Fail: about 25 live flying insects
summary: About 25 live small flying insects on walls and ceiling of rear food prep, dish area, and behind bar; more pest control needed; citation issued. Dust and food splatter on prep area ceiling tiles; certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: no hand soap, plastic bowl scoop
summary: No hand soap at grill-area hand sink; person in charge added soap on site; citation issued. Cooked beef cooled under plastic wrap; plastic bowl used as sugar scoop; reused single-use containers hold TCS foods. Ice scoop stored in water.

headline: Re-inspection Pass: food on freezer floors, exposed insulation
summary: Food containers stored on floor inside walk-in freezers; must be raised six inches. Broken, exposed insulation above prep table. Walk-in coolers and ice bin interior need cleaning. Backflow device missing at utility sink; leaking drainpipe.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: No valid city-certified manager (CFM) on site while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were prepared; citation issued. Flour bags stored on floor, to be raised six inches. Bathroom doors not self-closing; inspection summary not posted; citation issued.

headline: Complaint Fail: flying insects on food containers
summary: Numerous flying insects landed on barbecue sauce, hot sauce, spices, and single-service pans in rear storage; exterminator called for; citation issued. Gap under rear screen door. Food handler training missing.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: cold foods 49°F–58°F, discarded
summary: Chicken, cheese, and other TCS foods held at 49°F to 58°F in a reach-in cooler and walk-in; about 90 lbs ($300) discarded. Reach-in cooler at 54.5°F tagged by health department; citation issued. Repeat allergen training violation.

headline: Canvass Fail: no CFM, no soap, pest entry points
summary: No certified food manager on premises while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were served; citation issued. Front prep hand sink lacked soap and towels. Door sweep opening could let pests in; food stored on floor; missing thermometers.

headline: Canvass Fail: cold foods 44.6°F–48°F, discarded
summary: Cooked chicken and vegetables in prep cooler held at about 44.6°F to 48°F; no time-temperature log. About 35 lbs ($300) discarded; citation issued. Dry food lacks common-name labels; several previous core violations not corrected.

headline: Short Form Pass w/ Conditions: non-service dogs on site
summary: About six non-service dogs were on site during the inspection. Facility must ensure non-service animals are not on site; citation issued.

headline: Pass: no handwashing sign, ice machine buildup
summary: Handwashing sink in front prep area lacks a sign; instructed to provide one. Splash guard needed at that sink. Slight buildup inside ice machine; instructed to clean.

headline: Canvass Pass: shellstock tags missing sold dates
summary: Shellstock tags lacked last-sold dates; staff must date-mark before storing. Leaks at rear hand sink and salad-area sink faucet. Basement refrigerator gasket loose. Dried food debris under basement shelving; dusty kitchen vents.

headline: Complaint Pass: broken hand sink handle, floor debris
summary: Hot water handle in poor repair at northwest prep-area hand sink; manager instructed to repair. Food debris and spills under all equipment, along walls, and in corners; floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: no certified manager on premises
summary: No city-certified manager on premises; one arrived at 2:45 pm, corrected on site; citation issued. Soap dispenser repaired on site. Unwrapped utensils stored handles-down; corrected on site. Soda on floor crates; hole in restroom wall.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: no CFM, missing date marks
summary: No certified food manager on site while beef and chicken TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were handled. Cooked pork and ground beef held over 24 hours in walk-in lacked date marks; prep day counts as day one.

headline: Canvass Fail: bar hand sinks inaccessible
summary: Two of three bar hand sinks not accessible; citation issued. Cooked ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours lacked date marks. Oyster tags lacked last-sold dates. Food handler training proof missing, a repeat violation; leak below basement sink.

headline: Canvass Pass: no hair restraint, missing restroom signs
summary: Food handler prepared food without a hair restraint; management must require restraints. Missing hand-washing signage at first-floor customer and employee restroom sinks.

headline: Complaint Fail: no CFM, blocked sinks, no vomit kit
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were handled. Hand sinks blocked by utensils and aprons; cooked food lacked date marks; no food thermometer, pest control service, or vomit cleanup kit.

headline: Canvass Pass: broken three-compartment sink stopper
summary: Right drain stopper in three-compartment sink not working; sink only fills when clogged with plastic. Manager instructed to service the sink.

headline: Canvass Fail: pest log incomplete, cracked ceiling
summary: Pest control log book missing required records; citation issued. Dry product containers lacked common-name labels. Warewashing gauge broken; citation issued. Loose ceiling tiles above front prep with gaps up to 2 inches must be repaired.

headline: Re-inspection Pass: clutter, expired allergen training
summary: Rear storage area must be detail cleaned and cleared of unnecessary equipment and an unused prep cooler to prevent pest harborage. Cleaning equipment must be elevated six inches. Certified manager's allergen training expired.

headline: Pass: dead bugs, hair restraints, food handler proof
summary: Dead bugs on rear prep windowsills. Food handlers lacked effective hair restraints. Two of four food handlers had no proof of training. Soiled wiping cloths left on tables; food debris and trash on floors under heavy equipment.

headline: Canvass Pass: grime inside ice machine door
summary: Grime buildup found inside the ice machine door. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Canvass Pass: expired food handler certificates
summary: Expired food handler certificate found; butcher area food handler has no certificate. Wall coving in rear storage in poor repair. Floors under shelves, equipment, walk-in cooler and freezer need cleaning; meat slicer and grinder need cleaning.

headline: Complaint Pass: dirty meat slicer, greasy floors
summary: Meat slicer's round blade housing and sharpener had food debris; instructed to clean. Floors under deep fryers had grease spills and food trash. Inadequate lighting in walk-in cooler; instructed to add light.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: hand sink blocked by bucket
summary: Rear prep/deli hand sink blocked by a bucket of water; must be cleared and used only for handwashing; citation issued. Food handler lacked hair restraint; ice scoop improperly stored; water-stained and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Canvass Fail: rodent droppings, no valid certificate
summary: About 15 mouse droppings on utility room and rear dock floors near walk-in cooler and freezer; additional pest control needed; citation issued. No valid original city food sanitation certificate on site. Dish machine gauge not working.

headline: Pass: food stored on floor, cluttered coolers
summary: Food stored directly on the floor in prep and basement areas; manager instructed to raise all food six inches. Clutter found in coolers and prep areas; manager told to organize and maintain.

headline: Canvass Pass w/ Conditions: no vomit cleanup items
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup items on premises; must have them. Food debris and dust in two-door prep freezers. Uncovered trash in both washrooms. Damaged prep floor around a drain; brush stuck in dish machine floor drain.

headline: License Fail: no accessible hand sink in prep area
summary: No accessible hand-washing sink in prep area #2; no splashguard between hand sink and prep table. Drainpipe leak under three-compartment sink. Vent fans not working in employee washrooms.

headline: Complaint Pass: worn cutting boards, dusty fan guards
summary: Cutting boards with open seams and stains must be refinished or replaced. Dust on walk-in cooler fan guards; instructed to clean. Certified managers lack current allergen training; certificates must be kept on site.

headline: Complaint Pass: staff need food handler certificates
summary: Staff without a city sanitation certificate need food handler certificates; instructed to obtain and maintain them.

headline: Pass: heavy dust on restroom fans
summary: Heavy dust on ventilation fans in both restrooms must be removed and cleaned.

headline: Canvass Fail: no hand soap, cardboard and crate shelving
summary: Hand sink in front coffee area had no hand soap; food handler obtained soap during inspection; citation issued. Cardboard and milk crates used as shelving; food containers stored on walk-in floor; no chemical test kit; ice bin needs cleaning.

headline: Canvass Fail: cold foods 51°F–56°F, cooler at 59°F
summary: Several TCS foods held at 51°F to 56°F; manager discarded eggs, cream cheese, sour cream, and pork (about $45). Cooler ambient air at 59°F; tagged, citation issued. Three-compartment sink floods when one compartment drains.

headline: Canvass Pass: dirty basement storage floors
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and dust buildup on basement storage floors and corners. Instructed to detail clean and increase floor cleaning frequency.

headline: Complaint Pass: dirty shelves, debris outside
summary: Storage shelves have food and dirt on lower surfaces. Cardboard and pop crates on ground in rear must be removed. Floors under shelves and in aisles are stained with food, dirt, and debris.

headline: Pass: no backflow devices, poor lighting
summary: No backflow prevention devices found at two lower-level ice machines; manager must provide them in a serviceable location. Poor lighting where food containers are stored; must relocate storage or add light.

headline: Pass w/ Conditions: cold foods above 41°F, discarded
summary: Sandwich cooler held dressing, mayonnaise, cheese, pasta, tuna, and more at 46.8°F to 48°F; all discarded (42 lbs, $209). Cooler ambient air measured 51°F and must be repaired.

headline: Complaint Fail: live cockroaches, raw meat stored over RTE
summary: Five live cockroaches found in prep area, rice storage room, and dishwashing area; more pest control needed; citation issued. Raw chicken kabobs stored beneath ready-to-eat vegetable kabobs; no consumer advisory on raw or undercooked foods.

headline: Beard restraints missing; crates and dusty cooler
summary: Male food handlers were not wearing beard restraints. A cooler motor cover at Gene's Bistro is missing. Black crates hold cilantro in the walk-in cooler and must be replaced. Dust and dirt were on a prep cooler motor, and a pot cart was greasy.

headline: Missing handwashing signs at restrooms and bar
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at the employee restrooms and at the front bar handsink. The person in charge was told to provide and maintain them.

headline: Dish machine too cool; three live roaches found
summary: The high-temperature dish machine reached only 155.5°F; it must reach 160°F and was tagged. Three live roaches were seen in the rear kitchen and more pest control is required. Heavy grease and grime were on the floor and walls behind the cook line.

headline: No hot water at handsinks; no sanitizer; coolers off
summary: Handsinks in the toilet room had no hot running water. No sanitizer was on site, and the coolers were off; they must stay on at 41°F or below. There was no food thermometer, no pest control logbook, and no licensed dumpster.

headline: Fly strips hung in prep; no hair restraint
summary: Fly strips were hanging in the food prep area and must be removed. A female employee handling food had no hair restraint. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer, and fryers, walk-in racks and floors were greasy or dirty.

headline: Rear door gap; missing signs, lids, and certificates
summary: The rear exit door has a gap of about 1/4 inch at the bottom and must be sealed. There are no employee health policy or handwashing signs. Washrooms have trash cans without lids. Some employees lack food handler certificates; new hires have 30 days.

headline: Clutter in storage; wet floors throughout
summary: Slight clutter in the dry storage room behind the deli counter must be removed to avoid hiding places for pests. Floors throughout the deli, bakery and meat areas were wet and must be kept dry, including floor drains.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: The food service sanitation manager does not have an allergen training certificate. It must be obtained.

headline: No handwash sink in new coffee prep area
summary: A newly built coffee prep area in the dining room has no handwashing sink. A barrier is needed between the rear prep area and the customer restroom. Also noted: mold above a sink, floor debris, standing water, and dusty vents.

headline: No hot water at handsinks; overflowing dumpster
summary: The rear dishwashing handsink had no hot running water (64.2°F), and the front prep handsink had no drainpipe or water. Residue was in the ice machine. The outside garbage area was overflowing and the lid did not fit tightly.

headline: Missing handwash signs; unlabeled containers
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at the employee cafeteria sinks. Food storage containers in the pastry prep area must be labeled. A handsink in pastry prep drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Debris behind cooler, dirty drains and light shields
summary: Dirt and food debris were on the floor behind a refrigeration unit in the rear prep area. Dust was inside light shields in that area. Floor drains in the rear dishwashing area had dirt and debris.

headline: Coolers lack thermometers; food uncovered, unlabeled
summary: Reach-in and display coolers have no thermometers to check air temperature. Food was stored unlabeled and uncovered in coolers, and on the floor in the walk-in cooler and prep areas. Floors had grease, food debris and spills.

headline: Food on floor; leaking backflow device; greasy kitchen
summary: Rice bags were stored on the prep area floor. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces, and frozen chicken was in plastic bags. A backflow device leaks and sprays water at the high-temperature dish machine. Grease and food debris were found throughout.

headline: Hair restraint not worn properly; brooms stored near utensils
summary: A food handler's hair net did not contain long braids, which stuck out. Brooms and dustpans were stored next to the clean utensil rack and must be moved away.

headline: Faulty sink stopper, leaking faucet, no allergen training
summary: The middle sink stopper at the three-compartment sink does not work, and the faucet leaks. The grease storage area in the basement must be cleaned. The certified manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; 200 lbs discarded
summary: Many cold foods, including cheese, yogurt and mayo, were held at 47.4–91.9°F. About 200 lbs ($390) was discarded on site. Three cold units ran too warm and were tagged. An ice machine door was held shut with a spoon.

headline: Repeat violations: torn gaskets, no allergen proof
summary: An employee had a long beard and no beard guard. Heavy clutter was found in the basement. Heavy dirt and grease were in the exhaust hood and filters. Previous violations were not corrected: torn gaskets on several rear coolers and no allergen certificates.

headline: Ice buildup at walk-in cooler entrance
summary: A small amount of ice buildup was on the floor at the walk-in cooler entrance. It must be cleaned.

headline: Hot-held food too cool; ice machine slime
summary: Cooked chicken (101.6°F) and falafel (110.7°F) in hot holding were too cool; about 7 lbs ($65) was discarded. The ice machine had black and pink slime dripping onto ice. Handsink water was 87.8–90.5°F and was fixed to 100°F during inspection.

headline: Floors need cleaning near cooking and sushi areas
summary: Floors around cooking equipment and in the sushi prep area have spills, debris, and grease. They must be cleaned.

headline: Employees missing food handler training
summary: Employees were missing food handler training. It must be provided, and verification must be kept on site.

headline: Sink stopper missing; greasy floor under cooking
summary: A proper stopper is missing for the three-compartment sink. Low water pressure was found at the first restroom handsink. Grease had built up on the floor under the stove, fryer and a deep freezer.

headline: Missing splash guard, utility sink, and drainboard
summary: No splash guard separates the three-compartment sink from the exposed handsink. No drainboard is attached to the sink, and there is no space to add one. No utility sink is present, and the washroom door lacks a self-closing device.

headline: Stove without handsink; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were missing. A stove in the break room has no nearby handsink and must be moved to a prep area with one. No barrier separates customers from the front prep area.

headline: No food handler certificates; ice machine lacks backflow
summary: Food handlers had no food handling certificates or training. No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine water line. Basement storage was cluttered with old equipment and boxes.

headline: Dead roaches found under bar sink
summary: Dead roaches were found under the bar three-compartment sink and must be removed, detail cleaned, and sanitized. Wiping cloths were stored near a handsink, and fans, light shields and vents were dusty.

headline: No food handler certificates; sushi rice testing missing
summary: Sushi is on the menu without a sushi letter or pH testing device. Food handler certificates were not on site. Items out of original containers lacked labels, and food was stored on the walk-in floor. The sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no food handler certificates
summary: The low-temperature dish machine behind the bar had no chlorine sanitizer at final rinse and must be repaired. No food handler certificates were on site, a repeat violation. Excess garbage was on the ground around the outside dumpster.

headline: Missing handwash sign; milk crates used as shelves
summary: A handwashing sign is missing at the basement sink. Milk crates are used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced. Rust and food debris were on storage racks in the walk-in cooler and basement. Grease was found at the kitchen smokers.

headline: Improper cooling; person in charge lacks certificate
summary: Cooked potatoes at 122.7°F and chicken at 119.3°F were cooling improperly; the manager removed all foods. Sour cream gyros sauce at 58.6°F was discarded. The person in charge lacks a valid certificate, and utensils were stored in 68.1°F water.

headline: No certified manager; improper thawing corrected
summary: No certified food manager was on premises. Chicken, soup, guacamole and beef were thawed on a prep table; this was corrected on site by moving them to the walk-in cooler. Also noted: a gap at the front door and missing handwashing signs.

headline: Door gap; no sink stoppers; no allergen certificate
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed to rodent-proof it. The basement prep area needs a splash guard and ceiling pipes encased. The three-compartment sink has no stoppers, and no allergen certificate was on premises.

headline: Peeling baseboards and exposed caulk
summary: Exposed foam-like caulk on walls behind cold holding units in the bar prep area must be smoothed and resurfaced. Baseboards are peeling off the walls in prep areas and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Greasy fryers and grill; foil liner
summary: Grease was found inside the deep fryers and under the flat grill. Aluminum foil is used as a liner for cooking equipment and must stop.

headline: Over 35 small flies in basement prep area
summary: Over 35 small flies were found throughout the basement food prep area. Pest control service was recommended and a citation was issued. Also noted: no temperature indicator for the dish machine, a taped cooler handle, and dirty sinks and coolers.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; several lights out or broken
summary: Two prep cooler door gaskets are heavily torn. Some coolers lack thermometers, and the microwave interior is heavily soiled. A bar handsink handle is missing, and several lights are out or broken, including one hanging from a walk-in cooler.

headline: Dirty steam table shelving
summary: Steam table shelving in the front prep area needs cleaning. Dried food debris must be removed.

headline: Overfilled outdoor trash lid not tight-fitting
summary: An outside garbage lid does not close tightly because it is overfilled. All outside receptacles must close tightly to prevent rodent hiding places. Floors in the rear prep and dishwashing area need cleaning.

headline: No allergen training proof for manager
summary: No proof of allergen training or certificate was available for the certified food manager. This must be provided.

headline: Floor debris and damaged cabinet noted
summary: Residue and debris built up on the front service area floor, under a cabinet, and beside the ice machine. A cabinet in the front prep area is damaged on one side. The person in charge was told to clean and repair.

headline: Dirty ice dispenser and floors
summary: The outside of the ice chute dispenser needs detail cleaning. Floors behind the deep fryers, around a hot hold unit, and under a soda dispenser were dusty and had debris.

headline: No valid certified manager; greasy floors, leaks
summary: No valid certified food service manager certificate was on site, and the person in charge must be present when TCS foods are handled. Milk crates were used as shelving. Floors were broken and greasy, and sink faucets were leaking.

headline: Frozen food in walk-in freezer held at 41°F
summary: Frozen food in the walk-in freezer was held at 41°F. Frozen food must be kept frozen.

headline: Rodent droppings found in several areas
summary: About 200 rodent droppings were found behind cooking equipment and under dry storage shelves, about 150 in other back areas, and about 100 inside fryers. Pest control is recommended. Also: macaroni salad lacked discard-date labels and the front door has a gap.

headline: Food on floor; no food handler training
summary: Food was stored on the floor in prep and storage areas and must be raised six inches. Food debris and spills were on the prep area floor. No food handler training was available on site.

headline: Cardboard floor mats; wet cloths; dirty floors
summary: Light pink residue was inside the ice machine panel. Wet wiping cloths were stored throughout the main cooking area. Cardboard was used as floor mats in the rear prep area and must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable surface. Floors in prep areas and the walk-in cooler need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine buildup; gap at rear door; expired certificates
summary: Ice machine interior has slight buildup and must be cleaned. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed. The employee washroom lacks a covered trash receptacle, and some food handler certificates have expired.

headline: No food handler certificates; no allergen proof
summary: No proof of food handler training certificates was available for all food handlers. There was no proof of allergen training for managers. Heavy dust was on a vent in the unisex employee washroom.

headline: Half-inch door gap; no summary posted
summary: A half-inch gap at the bottom of the side exit doors must be sealed. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. The inspection report summary was not posted for customers, and a copy was given to management. A second employee restroom toilet is not working.

headline: No certified manager; rat droppings; sanitizer failures
summary: No certified food manager on site. About 45 rat droppings were found in the food prep area. Two dish machines had 0 ppm sanitizer and were repaired on site. About 15 lbs of oysters were discarded for a missing shellfish tag.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; taped handle; no allergen proof
summary: A cook-line cooler has a torn door gasket and a broken handle repaired with tape. Stored items in the rear hallway must be raised off the floor. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and missing baseboard coving need repair.

headline: Pots too large for sink; no training proof
summary: Large pots do not fit fully in the three-compartment sink. The facility must install a larger sink, use smaller equipment, or use an approved manual method. No proof of food handler training or manager allergen training was provided.

headline: No certified manager; food truck lacks hot water
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate manager was on duty for TCS foods such as chicken egg rolls. The food truck lacked hot and cold running water at its three-compartment sink and handsink, which is a priority violation.

headline: Dishwasher hot water too cool; greasy equipment
summary: Hot water at the three-compartment sink measured 99–100°F, below the required 110°F for washing utensils. Grease and food debris were found on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers and shelving. Food manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: No commissary agreement; hot holding and water failures
summary: This mobile food operation has no commissary agreement, so its water and wastewater sources are not proven. One hot holding unit ran at 108–124°F, below the required 135°F. Hot water reached only 77°F, and soap and hand towels were missing at the handsink.

headline: Door opening; temperature indicator corrected on site
summary: An opening in the front entrance doors could allow pests in and must be sealed. A missing dish temperature indicator was delivered on site before the inspection ended. Also noted: a leaking bar faucet, cardboard outside the dumpster, and missing grout.

headline: Deeply cut, stained cutting board in deli
summary: A cutting board attached to the deli prep cooler has deep cuts and stains. It must be sanded and resealed, or replaced, so it can be cleaned properly.

headline: Missing restroom handwash signs; cluttered prep
summary: Employee restrooms lacked handwashing signs. Walls behind the front and rear prep areas must be smooth and easy to clean. Unnecessary items were stored in the kitchen prep area and must be removed.

headline: Repeat violations: torn gaskets and dirty coolers
summary: Previous violations were not corrected: torn door gaskets on several coolers, and dirty interiors with food debris. Several handsinks lack wash-hands signs. An open container of potatoes was stored beside a handsink.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; 40 lbs discarded
summary: Multiple cold foods were held above 41°F, including beef at 54.9°F, chicken at 50.4°F and tuna at 47.5°F. About 40 lbs (about $500) was discarded. A reach-in cooler at 51.2°F was tagged.

headline: No certified manager; many required items missing
summary: The person in charge has no sanitation manager certificate, and there is no employee health policy. Missing items include a vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, stem and cooler thermometers, pest control log, test kit, dumpster, and allergen training.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no soap; no hair restraints
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; the manager raised it to 50 ppm during inspection. Handsinks in prep and the restroom lacked soap, which staff obtained during inspection. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Worn cooler gasket, rust, basement clutter
summary: A reach-in cooler has a worn door gasket that needs repair. Its shelves have light rust and need cleaning. Items stored under the basement stairs must be removed to avoid hiding places for pests. Dirt and debris were found behind basement freezers.

headline: No food handler certificates; items on floors
summary: No employee health policy or food handler training records were on site. Equipment and supplies were stored on basement floors and must be raised six inches. Several bathrooms lack self-closing doors or covered trash cans.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; washrooms lack lids
summary: Some food handler certificates were expired and must be updated. Washroom trash receptacles have no lids and must be provided with covers.

headline: No valid certified manager; no food handler training
summary: No person in charge held a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate was posted. Handwashing sinks in washrooms lacked signs, and there was no splash guard between the handsink and three-compartment sink. No food handler training was available.

headline: Beard guard missing; only one sink stopper
summary: A male food handler with a beard was not wearing a beard guard. The three-compartment sink had only one sink stopper. At least two stoppers must be kept on hand at all times.

headline: Missing raw-food consumer advisory; no allergen certificate
summary: No consumer advisory was posted for raw or undercooked foods such as over-easy eggs. The customer restroom lacks a covered receptacle, and floor tiles are missing near the utility sink. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Soap and hair restraint provided; bulk food unlabeled
summary: The main prep handsink had no soap, and a food handler had no hair restraint. Both were provided during the inspection. Bulk flour and sugar lacked labels and must be labeled.

headline: Food on floor; leaking sink; dumpster debris
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the rear storage area and must be raised six inches. A faucet at the three-compartment sink is leaking. Excessive debris was on the ground around the outside dumpsters.

headline: Leaky toilet pipe, dirty hood, greasy floors
summary: A pipe under the women's restroom toilet is leaking. Dusty ceiling tiles, vent covers, and the hood over the dish machine need cleaning. Floors under the wok, fryer and cooking equipment were greasy, and a grease trap odor was noted.

headline: Leaking sink drain; food handler lacks certificate
summary: The three-compartment sink leaks at the drain line and must be repaired. A food handler did not have a food handler certificate and must show proof of training.

headline: Six live roaches found under sink; failed
summary: Six live roaches were under sink stoppers, and four small roaches were entering through unsealed baseboards under the three-compartment sink. The inspector noted this was not an infestation. Also: foil liners, greasy grill and fryer, damaged cutting boards.

headline: No paper towels; cold food held too warm
summary: There were no paper towels at any handsink and no hand dryer. Rice and beans at 52.1°F and cabbage at 59°F were too warm in the display cooler; the manager discarded 7 lbs ($80) on site. Also noted: no sink stoppers and no allergen training.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: The certified food manager has no allergen training certificate. It must be provided for all certified food managers.

headline: Ice maker lacks visible backflow device
summary: No backflow prevention device could be located on the ice maker. It must be installed in an easy-to-find place.

headline: Gap in front door; worn cooler gaskets; damaged surfaces
summary: A gap along the bottom of the front door must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. Worn gaskets on a milk cooler must be replaced. Shelves, carts and fan guards had mold and dirt. Damaged ceiling tiles, floors and walls need repair.

headline: Slow drain, greasy hood, no allergen certificate
summary: The three-compartment sink floor drain drains slowly and must drain quickly. Grease and food buildup on the ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned. The food manager has no food allergen training certificate.

headline: Ice machine buildup; cleaned during inspection
summary: The ice machine interior had a slight black and pink buildup. The manager wiped it down during the inspection and must keep it clean.

headline: No certified manager; two dish machines not sanitizing
summary: No certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served. Both low-temperature dish machines showed 0 ppm chlorine and were tagged. About 15 small flies were found in basement and upstairs prep areas; pest control is advised.

headline: Fly strip, unlabeled containers, dirty fryers
summary: A fly strip was hanging in the food prep area and must be removed. Bulk ingredient containers were unlabeled, and food handlers lacked hair restraints. Fryers, ice machine parts, and floors were greasy or dirty. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Cold foods too warm; 15 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken was held at 47°F and shrimp, beef and noodles at 47–53°F; TCS foods must be 41°F or below. About 15 lbs ($175) was discarded by an employee. The prep cooler measured 49°F. Greasy equipment and floor violations were not corrected.

headline: No pest control logbook; several other issues
summary: No pest control logbook was on site. Licensed pest control service records and an active license are required. A pipe under the three-compartment sink leaks. Items were stored on the floor and in a restroom, and the hood has no filters. No manager allergen certificate.

headline: Loose sink handles; greasy cook line
summary: The hot and cold handles at the bar handsink are very loose but work. Ceiling tiles above the cook line were soiled with grease and dust. Floors and walls under and behind the cook line were heavily soiled.

headline: Bar sinks lack soap and towels; many gaps
summary: Bar handwashing sinks had no soap or paper towels. Also missing: chemical sanitizer, metal stem thermometer, pest control log, test kit, and commercial dumpster. No employee health policy and no allergen training certificate were on site.

headline: Dirty ice bin, cardboard liners, greasy floors
summary: The ice bin interior needs cleaning. Cardboard was used as a liner on prep equipment and tables and must be removed. Cutting boards have open seams and stains, and floors under equipment were greasy.

headline: No metal stem thermometer; no splash guard
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on site for measuring food temperatures. The exposed front handsink needs splash guards on both sides. Fryers, walk-in shelves and floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; handsink water too hot
summary: Cooked bacon was held at 80.1°F and cold foods at 45.5–65.8°F, including tuna, salmon and chicken. About 15 lbs ($85) plus 0.25 lbs bacon ($20) were discarded. Handwashing sink water reached 134.4°F, above the 120°F maximum.

headline: Standing water in hot water tank room
summary: Standing water was on the floor in the rear hot water tank room. The floor must be kept dry and clean at all times.

headline: Floors behind soda machines not clean
summary: Floors behind and under soda machines were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: No food handler or allergen certificates on site
summary: A two-compartment vegetable sink is not sealed to the wall. A walk-in cooler light fixture is broken and not working. No food handler certificates or allergen awareness certificates were on site.

headline: Manager must obtain allergen training
summary: The certified food manager must obtain allergen training.

headline: Paper towels in restroom; dirty freezer and trash bin
summary: Paper towels were stored in the employee toilet room, which is not allowed. The upright freezer exterior was heavily iced and soiled. The indoor trash bin was too greasy to clean and must be replaced.

headline: Egg whites held too warm; corrected on site
summary: Egg whites were held at 55.4°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager voluntarily discarded about 5 lbs ($15) on site. Also noted: towels under bar cold units, floor buildup, and no covered trash in an employee restroom.

headline: Missing handwash sign; mops not hung to dry
summary: No handwashing sign is posted at the employee restroom wash bowl. Mops were not stored properly and must be hung up to air dry.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No certified food service manager or sanitation certificate was on site during preparation of TCS foods such as potato salad. The vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit and procedure were not on site; management provided them on 01/14/26. The front door has an opening at the bottom.

headline: Damaged caulk at grease trap
summary: Damaged caulk at the base of the grease trap must be removed and recaulked smoothly for easy cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled packaged food; torn gasket; greasy hood
summary: Packaged food lacked common name labels. A torn door gasket on the rear two-door cooler must be replaced. The manual can opener needs detail cleaning, and the kitchen exhaust hood has grease buildup.

headline: Seasonal room openings must be fully enclosed
summary: Outer openings in the seasonal room with the enclosed bar are not protected. The top set of windows must be installed to fully enclose the space.

headline: Greasy fryer and food debris; leaking hand sink pipe
summary: Re-inspection passed. The rear deep fryer's oil filtering unit had grease and food debris, and heavy equipment had excess food debris. A hand sink pipe was leaking onto the toilet room floor. Duct tape covered some ceiling tiles and walls, and some tiles were water-stained.

headline: Cooked chicken held at 53 F; hand sink blocked
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked chicken was held at 53 F, and other TCS foods were held at 50-56 F. About 25 lbs, valued at $200, was discarded. A hand sink was blocked by a table, moved during inspection. Standing water was in a prep cooler, and a hood was not working.

headline: Passed: unlabeled empanadas; openings and doors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Unlabeled self-service empanadas in the dining room display must be labeled with name, ingredients and source. An opening at the front entrance base needs sealing. Doors in both all-gender washrooms were not self-closing.

headline: Failed: three-compartment sink leaks; no chlorine test strips
summary: Failed. The three-compartment sink leaked to the floor when drained. The dish machine uses chlorine sanitizer, but no chlorine test strips were on site, and a citation was issued. Rusted walk-in shelving and grease at the outdoor receptacle were also noted, and no certified manager on site had allergen training.

headline: Dish machine repaired during inspection
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine was off for repairs and was fully working by the end of inspection. Torn plastic liners on hot-holding drawers and two non-working sinks in the second-floor men's room were noted. Floors below deep fryers were heavily greasy.

headline: Failed: raw meat above ready-to-eat food; soup cooling error
summary: Failed. Raw pork and beef were stored above ready-to-eat food, and management removed them. A 5-gallon soup batch cooled improperly at 111 F and about 25 lbs was discarded. Hot-held chicken at 115.7 F and onion at 109.2 F were discarded. No allergen proof was provided for certified managers.

headline: Failed: 40+ mouse droppings; no allergen training
summary: Failed. Forty or more mouse droppings were on the rear storage closet floor, and a pest control service was required before reinspection. A food handler's hair restraint was corrected on site. Both certified managers lacked allergen training, and a hand sink valve leaked.

headline: Failed: no training proof; food stored outside, unsafe ice
summary: Failed. Rusty freezers and a cooler holding food were outside the rear door, open to birds, and must be moved inside. No food handler or allergen training certificates were on site. Ice machine had black and white slime, and no pest control log was provided.

headline: Failed: pizza prep sink had no running water
summary: Failed. The hand sink in the pizza prep area had no hot or cold running water. Food containers were stored on the dry storage floor. Sushi rice was found in a cooler without a lab analysis letter or test kit, and a citation was issued.

headline: Passed: sanitary bin missing; damaged tiles and walls
summary: Re-inspection passed. A toilet room lacked a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Duct tape covered a hole in a stainless steel splash guard. Stained ceiling tiles, damaged wall bases and broken floor tiles were found in several areas. Dry storage had excess food debris.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; cold food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. The dish machine's chlorine sanitizer read 0 ppm and was later restored to 50 ppm. Many cold foods were held at 46-50 F, and about $300 of food was discarded. Rusted racks, cardboard shelf liners and clutter were also noted.

headline: Passed: missing hand-washing signs and mop sink tiles
summary: Passed. No hand-washing signage was found at preparation-area hand sinks. The exterior walls of the mop sink had missing tiles. The sanitation manager had no allergen training.

headline: Passed with conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago certified manager or valid documentation was on the premises while TCS foods were prepared and served; a citation was issued. No vomit and diarrhea procedure was in place. A front prep hand sink was blocked, and sticky fly trap rolls hung above the rear prep area.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings still found; open dishwashing area
summary: Failed. Mouse droppings were still found on the washroom floor, rear storage floor, and front window sill. The dishwashing and prep area was not protected from the public. A washroom door lacked a self-closing device, and carpet remained in rear areas.

headline: Passed: peeling bar surfaces, rust, and leaking faucets
summary: Passed. Peeling white surfaces, rusty wire shelving, and worn wood were found at the bar. Both three-compartment sinks leaked from their faucets. Bar sink faucets, basins and surrounding walls had debris buildup and needed cleaning.

headline: Passed with conditions: no health policy; door, trash issues
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy was on site. The toilet room had no receptacle, and the washroom door was not self-closing. Debris was found on floors and corners throughout the facility, and vents in the rear prep area were dusty.

headline: Passed with conditions: no sinks, signs or allergen proof
summary: Passed with conditions. A consumer advisory on the menu was corrected on site. Hand-washing signs were missing, ice was exposed in the bar ice bin, and no prep sink was in the bar or barista station. Three employees lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Passed: brooms too near utensils; dark film on ice maker
summary: Passed. Brooms were stored too close to the clean utensil rack and must be moved or separated. A dark film was on the ice maker's bottom panel. Lighting in the walk-in cooler was inadequate.

headline: Failed: repeat violations, drinks in washroom
summary: Failed. Single-service lids were not inverted in prep and beverage areas, and straws were stored in a washroom. Previous core violations were not corrected, including soda cases in the employee washroom, leaking three-compartment sink faucets, and no allergen training for the certified manager.

headline: Failed: three-compartment sink floods; clutter
summary: Failed. Wastewater at the three-compartment sink backed up, so when one compartment drained, another flooded. Heavy clutter throughout the facility was also noted and needed decluttering to avoid pest hiding spots.

headline: Failed: many missing records, supplies, and equipment
summary: Failed. The person in charge had no sanitation manager certificate, and none was posted. No employee health policy, vomit kit, pest control log, stem thermometer, or test strips were found. No hand sink was at dishwashing and no backflow device was on the mop sink faucet.

headline: Passed: missing ceiling tile above three-compartment sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. A ceiling tile was missing above the three-compartment sink and must be replaced.

headline: Passed: leaking hand sink; dirty prep area and hood
summary: Passed. The front prep hand sink leaked at the cold knob base. Dust, dirt and debris covered the prep area floor, and the hood ventilation system had dirt and grease buildup that could contaminate food.

headline: Passed: detail cleaning needed for equipment and floors
summary: Passed. The sides of cooking equipment needed a detail cleaning. Floor areas in the main kitchen, including under and behind equipment and along walls, also needed detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: over 50 mouse droppings; no dumpster
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings were found on the floor and shelves in the storage area. An exterminator was required, and a citation was issued. No outside commercial dumpster was on site, and the washroom had no operable ventilation fan.

headline: Torn rodent strip at kitchen door; ice machine buildup
summary: Passed. A torn rodent-proof strip at the bottom of the rear kitchen door must be repaired. Pink mineral buildup was found inside the basement ice machine. No allergen training certificates were on site for certified food managers.

headline: No certified manager on site during food service
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge lacked a City of Chicago sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site while TCS foods were served; a citation was issued. Cardboard shelf liners were removed during inspection. No food handler training proof was provided, and no certified managers had allergen training.

headline: Failed: food too warm; flies and roaches found
summary: Failed. Prep cooler held cold foods at 46.5-59.7 F, and the cooler measured 53.4 F; about 20 lbs were discarded. About 25 or more live small flies were found, plus numerous dead roaches near the hot water tank and bar storage. No allergen training for the manager.

headline: Passed with conditions: one worker lacked food handler training
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. One employee lacked food handler training. The previous inspection's summary report was not posted for public view, and a citation was issued. A new summary was left and must be posted.

headline: No certified manager during food service; no cleanup kit
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago certified manager was present while TCS foods were prepared and served; a citation was issued. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedures were available. Hand sinks were blocked and lacked paper towels and cleanser until staff provided them during inspection.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, unsafe cold food temperatures
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on duty until 4:23 PM while TCS foods were prepared. Foods including ground beef, shrimp and chicken were held at 45.7-60.8 F and discarded, about $325. Health policies, food handler training and pest control logs were also missing.

headline: Failed: main three-compartment sink floods
summary: Failed. The main kitchen three-compartment sink was not working properly. When water drained from one compartment, another flooded. A priority citation was issued, and the manager was instructed to service the sink.

headline: No certified manager on site during hot dog prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge held a City of Chicago certified manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while hot dogs were prepared. A citation was issued. Rust was found on racks in the rear two-door cooler.

headline: Failed: no pest control logbook; dusty floor edges
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook with required documents was on site, and a citation was issued. Dust built up on the floor along wall bases and needed cleaning.

headline: Passed: grease in fryers; dry storage lighting weak
summary: Passed. Excessive grease was found inside the deep fryers, and walls and floors of the indoor garbage area were not clean. An ice scoop was stored on the ice machine. Lighting in the dry storage area was inadequate.

headline: Passed: missing thermometer; unlabeled ingredients
summary: Re-inspection passed. A thermometer was missing inside a two-door cooling unit. Working ingredients stored in unlabeled containers, a missing hot water handle in the toilet room, and an uncovered garbage can were noted. Food handler training and allergen training certificates were required.

headline: Failed: about 100 rat droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 100 rat droppings were found on the basement floor and in the HVAC closet. Additional pest control service was needed. Cold foods were held at 44-57 F and the prep cooler measured 50 F. A leak was found at the three-compartment sink drain line.

headline: Failed: ice cream cooler at 64.4 F
summary: Failed. The ice cream cooler was not holding proper temperature, reading 64.4 F. The manager was instructed to repair it and keep it at 41 F or below. A soiled mop head was not stored properly.

headline: No certified manager on duty during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge had no certified food manager certificate. No certified manager was on duty while hamburgers and chicken were prepared; the manager arrived at 3:35 PM. Gaps in doors, a missing freezer handle, and loose wall bases were also noted.

headline: Failed: no pest control logbook; hole in wall
summary: Failed. No current pest control logbook was on the premises, and a citation was issued. Rusted walk-in shelving, a hole behind the pizza station, and clutter at basement stairs were noted. Expired food handler certificates were found. A prior hair restraint violation remained uncorrected.

headline: Passed: no thermometer in cooler; grease buildup
summary: Passed. No visible thermometer was in the wait staff reach-in cooler. Food and grease debris were on walk-in cooler floors and under cooking equipment, and dust and grease covered vent fans above the cook line.

headline: Failed: 60 mouse droppings on site
summary: Failed. Approximately 60 mouse droppings were found on floors around hot water tanks and dishwashing equipment, in the mop sink closet and office, and inside deep fryers. A citation was issued. The operator was instructed to remove them and sanitize. A small opening in the front door was found.

headline: Passed with conditions: moldlike ice machine shields
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. Moldlike substance was found on the shields of both large ice machines. Dust covered walls and ceilings in the rear prep area. A summary report from the last inspection was not posted, but was corrected on site.

headline: Passed: leaking pipes in utility area ceiling
summary: Passed. Domestic water was leaking from piping in the ceiling of the utility area and needed repair.

headline: Passed: torn cooler gasket taped; ice buildup in freezers
summary: Passed. A torn rubber gasket on a display cooler was taped with Scotch tape and needed repair. Ice buildup was in chest ice cream freezers. Display coolers were dirty, and rear dry storage clutter could hide pests.

headline: Failed: rat and mouse droppings; broken cooler glass
summary: Failed. Twenty rat droppings and five mouse droppings were found, including on a cashier shelf and under a cold holding unit. Pest control was recommended. Broken glass was in a freezer and cold holding unit. Stained and missing ceiling tiles, floor damage, and clutter were also noted.

headline: Passed: dangling bracelets; greasy floors; expired certificates
summary: Passed. Multiple food handlers wore dangling bracelets while preparing food. Cutting boards had deep scratches and stains. Food spills and grease covered prep area floors and areas under cooking equipment. Several allergen awareness certificates had expired.

headline: Passed: torn gasket, rusty tables, leaking faucet
summary: Re-inspection passed. A torn door gasket was on the three-door front prep cooler. Prep tables were rusty, and the three-compartment sink faucet base leaked. Water-damaged ceiling tiles were in the front dining area. Two certified managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Passed with conditions: cold foods held at 43-46 F
summary: Passed with conditions. About 90 lbs of TCS foods in the walk-in cooler read 43.8-45.5 F and were discarded, valued at $1030. Grease and debris were on the outdoor receptacle, clutter was in the men's mop closet, and a mop sink faucet leaked.

headline: Passed: liquor stored under unshielded sewer lines
summary: Passed. Liquor was stored under unshielded sewer lines in the basement. Cutting boards were heavily stained and ceramic cups were on site. Food handler training and an allergen training certificate were missing for the certified manager.

headline: Passed: leaking sink faucet base; grease on floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. The three-compartment sink faucet base in the kitchen leaked and must be repaired. Grease buildup under cooking equipment and dirt inside the walk-in cooler were found, and the basement floor needs cleaning.

headline: Failed: black residue dripping onto ice; wall hole
summary: Failed. A black and brown substance built up inside the rear ice machine bin, dripping onto ice used for consumption. The inspector instructed removal and cleaning of the ice. A hole in the fire exit wall covered with plastic and tape and cluttered booth storage were also noted.

headline: Passed: thermometer needed in cooler
summary: Re-inspection passed. A thermometer must be provided inside the nine-door cooling unit.

headline: Failed: food items stored in restroom; expired certificates
summary: Failed. Coffee liners, napkins and gloves used for food preparation were stored in a toilet room. Several food handlers had expired certificates. Milk crates were used as shelving, a prior core violation was not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings; food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings were found in the rear storage area and behind the front counter. An exterminator was required, and a citation was issued. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables.

headline: Passed: openings at door corners; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Openings at the outer corners of the revolving door need sealing to prevent pests. Stained ceiling tiles above the microwave, a wall opening behind the utility sink, and holes in a utility closet ceiling must be repaired.

headline: Complaint passed; dead roaches found under equipment
summary: Passed. Dead roaches were found on the floor under equipment in the rear storage and dishwashing areas, and the manager was instructed to remove all dead insects. Grease and spills were on fryers and holding units, and damaged floor tiles needed repair.

headline: Passed: worn door weather strip; dirty floors
summary: Passed. The double back door weather strip needs replacing to prevent pests. Floors in the walk-in produce and dairy coolers, and in meat walk-in shelving, need detail cleaning. Dust covered fans and floors in several areas.

headline: Passed: missing food handler certificates; storage errors
summary: Passed. Proof of food handler certificates was required for all required employees. Vinyl gloves were stored in a washroom, and a pending certified manager lacked allergen training proof. Other items included used tin cans used as utensil containers and peeling plastic on a cooler.

headline: Passed: unused cooler running too warm
summary: Passed. An unused cooler was running at an ambient temperature of 60.1 F. The owner must either repair it and keep it in good condition or remove it from the premises.

headline: Failed: no certificate posted; ice machine slime
summary: Failed. No verifiable City sanitation certificate was posted for food employees. The ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice used for consumption. Other items included food on the walk-in floor, uninverted plates, slow drains, broken floor tiles, and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Passed: unlabeled bulk bins; leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Bulk dry food bins were not labeled with the common name of the food. A hanging fly trap was near the grill line and needed relocating. The waffle iron was heavily soiled, and the three-compartment sink faucet leaked.

headline: Vacuum packaging machine tagged without approved plan
summary: Passed with conditions. A vacuum packaging machine lacked a health department-approved HACCP plan and was tagged. No vacuum-packed food was on site. Other items included a gap under the front door, missing splash guards, and no allergen training for the food manager.

headline: Failed: 100 fruit flies; expired shellfish and warm beef
summary: Failed. About 100 fruit flies were found in the front bar, rear bar and rear restroom. A 20 lb shellfish container lacked a required tag and was discarded. About 5 lbs of cooked beef at 52.2 F was discarded. Chlorine test strips were missing for the bar dish machine.

headline: Failed: 140 live flies; hand sink water too cool
summary: Failed. Evidence of 140 or more small live flies was found in the rear bakery and deli prep areas, and a citation was issued. Paper towels were added on site. Hand sink water measured 88.9 F, below the required 100 F. Two washroom hand sinks were not working.

headline: Passed with conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. The person in charge had no City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate. No sanitation manager was on site while soup and pork were prepared and served. A citation was issued for each violation.

headline: Failed: 60 mouse droppings in fryers and closet
summary: Failed. Sixty mouse droppings were found inside fryers, in the hot water tank closet, and under a toilet room cabinet. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were served. Soap, paper towels and food handler proof were also missing.

headline: Failed: moldlike slime in ice machine; ice to be emptied
summary: Failed. The ice machine's interior had pink and black slimy buildup likely to contaminate ice. The operator was instructed to empty it and wash, rinse and sanitize it. Rusty racks, a hot faucet running continuously, and mold-like buildup in walk-in coolers were also noted.

headline: Dead roaches in storage cabinet; hot water timing issue
summary: Dead roaches were found in a storage cabinet below the three-compartment sink and must be removed. Restroom hand sink hot water did not run for at least 15 seconds without reactivating the faucet.

headline: Passed: restroom receptacle and door issues
summary: Passed. The women's restroom lacked a covered receptacle, and restroom doors were not self-closing. Storage rooms holding the hot water tank and furnace were cluttered. No allergen certificate was on site for certified managers.

headline: Ceramic cups found; missing handwashing sign; clutter
summary: Ceramic or clay cups, plates and bowls were on site and needed lead-safety documentation. A handwashing sign was missing, outdoor clutter was noted, and food handler training verification was missing.

headline: Passed: broken faucet knob and water-damaged ceiling tile
summary: Passed. A cold water knob on the kitchen hand sink was in disrepair. A water-damaged ceiling tile was found in the rear dry storage area. Both were to be repaired.

headline: Passed: gap under rear door; dust on equipment
summary: Passed. A gap greater than 1/4 inch under the rear kitchen door needed a door sweep or replacement. Compressors were heavily dusty. Exposed untreated wood was found at the front service line, and dust built up beneath equipment.

headline: Passed: cardboard liners reused; fryers greasy
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cardboard was reused as a liner in prep coolers and must not be reused. The interior of the fryers had accumulated grease, dirt and food debris, and was instructed to be cleaned.

headline: Black slime on ice machine; ice cleaned during inspection
summary: Passed with conditions. Black slime built up inside the ice machine and was dripping onto ice for consumption. The machine was cleaned and sanitized during the inspection. Rusty shelving, dusty vents, and damaged floor tile were also noted.

headline: No employee health policy or food handler certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and a template was left. No food handler certificates were present. Toilet room lacked covered trash, and dirt and old debris were on floors and corners throughout.

headline: Cold foods held at 47-49 F; food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Several TCS foods were held at 47-49 F in a one-door prep cooler, which had an ambient air temperature of 40.8 F. About 17 lbs, valued at $125, was voluntarily discarded. Food debris was on bar walls.

headline: Failed: dish machine at 0 ppm; 235 lbs food discarded
summary: Failed. The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine and was repaired on site to 50 ppm. Over 235 lbs of cold TCS foods at 46-64 F were discarded. Mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine. About 50 small flies were found in the facility, and a chlorine test kit was obtained during re-check.

headline: Passed with conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person with an original City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate was on site, and a citation was issued. Splash guards were missing at a sixth-floor hand sink. Leaks came from the high-temperature dish machine, and a washroom door was not self-closing.

headline: Passed: no hand-washing signs; food on floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. No hand-washing signs were posted throughout the facility. Coolers lacked thermometers, and food was stored on the dry storage floor. No utility sink was on site, and a washroom door was not self-closing.

headline: Passed: dirty microwave; grease under vent filters
summary: Passed. The microwave needed cleaning. Dust and grease had built up in the ventilation area below the filters, and the person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager during operation; flies in cooler
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was present while the coffee shop operated. A manager arrived at 11 AM. About 15 small dead flies were in a basement cooler. The three-compartment sink hot water was restored to 111.2 F during inspection.

headline: Failed: more than 20 small flies throughout facility
summary: Failed. More than 20 small flies were found throughout the facility, including both kitchens and both bars. A pest control service was required for all affected areas. A men's room urinal also could not flush.

headline: Dead insects on floors; door gap; no food handler training
summary: Dead insects and debris were found on floors in sales, prep and storage areas. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear door needed sealing. No food handler training was shown for employees.

headline: Passed: food handler not wearing hair restraint
summary: Passed. A food handler on site was not wearing a hair restraint, and the operator was instructed to provide one.

headline: Failed: dish machine and walk-in cooler problems
summary: Failed. The dish machine lacked soap, and its final rinse gauge was broken, so temperature could not be checked. About 100 lbs of TCS food in the walk-in cooler was discarded after reading 49-50 F. The cooler measured 55 F and was tagged. Several prior violations remained.

headline: Passed: no backflow device found on ice maker
summary: Passed. The inspector could not find a backflow prevention device for the ice maker. The inspector instructed the operator to expose the plumbing for inspection.

headline: Failed cold holding: foods at 47-50 F discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Steak, pork, chicken, shrimp and other TCS foods were held at 47.7-50.5 F in drawer coolers. About 50 lbs, valued at $300, was discarded. Both two-drawer cooler units were running at 49-50 F. The certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed: soiled wiping cloths; greasy equipment
summary: Passed. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on a prep table and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Grease and food debris were on equipment, coolers and shelving. Garbage area had spills and debris, and unused equipment was stored throughout.

headline: Failed: 30-40 flies, leaks, and unusable front bar sink
summary: Inspection failed. About 30-40 flies were found at the small bar area, in the three-compartment sink, and on walls and ceiling. The front bar hand sink was unusable due to a large leak. Pest control service was required.

headline: Passed: dish room floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Floors in the dish room needed cleaning, and the manager was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Passed: splash guard, cardboard liner, trash lid needed
summary: Passed. A splash guard was missing between the hand sink and three-compartment sink in the hot food prep area. Cardboard was used as a shelf liner in the rear walk-in cooler. Both all-gender toilet rooms lacked covered trash receptacles.

headline: Certified manager not on site during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge did not have the original City of Chicago food manager certificate on site. A ServSafe certificate with a 2022 exam date was shown instead. A citation was issued for lacking a certified manager during TCS food preparation.

headline: No hot water at two sinks; failed inspection
summary: Failed. The big bar hand sink and three-compartment sink had no hot water, measured at 73.0 F. The establishment is on a two-day workaround from the health department. An ice scoop was stored improperly on the ice machine.

headline: Food handlers lacked training proof; beard guard missing
summary: Inspector found food handlers with no proof of food handler training, and a male food handler with a beard but no beard guard. Both were required to be corrected.

headline: Failed: glove misuse and no food handler training
summary: Failed. A food handler wore plastic gloves while handling cash and ready-to-eat food, including sliced ham, without washing hands. No employee health policies or food handler training were shown. Several other items were noted, including missing hand-washing signs and no consumer advisory on the menu.

headline: Passed: some workers lacked hair restraints
summary: Passed. Some food employees were not wearing hair restraints while preparing food. A hand sink in the pick-up area drained slowly and needs repair.

headline: No certified manager on duty; hand sink lacked supplies
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. The kitchen hand sink lacked soap and paper towels; staff supplied them during inspection. Food was on floors and grease built up; food handler proof was missing.

headline: Passed with conditions: no vomit cleanup supplies; openings in doors
summary: Passed with conditions. Necessary items for vomit and diarrhea cleanup, including norovirus-effective disinfectant, were not on site. Hand-washing signs were missing. Openings were found at the base and middle of the front entrance doors and must be sealed.

headline: Passed: no food handler certificates; rust and leaks
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificates were provided for any food handler at the time of inspection. Rust was found on shelving in the walk-in cooler and rear storage. Soda crates were stored on the floor, and a drainpipe under the three-compartment sink was leaking.
